English | [中文](README.zh.md)

> A curated list of plugins for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`).

DeepSeek Harness is DeepSeek's open-source agent harness — a runnable coding agent (Web and headless), built on a framework where everything is a plugin: models, tools, sandboxes, session storage, UI, even the agent loop itself. Plugins can extend the official coding agent, swap out its core parts, or assemble something entirely different.

This list collects community plugins that are installable via `dsh plugin add` (each declares a `dsh.bundle` manifest). [PRs welcome](#contributing).

> 📡 **This list is also a plugin market index.** On dsh 0.2.1+, open **Plugins → Discover → Index sources** and add `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dsh-plugin-catalog/index.json`. That is this list as a format-1 index, served from npm so it loads quickly everywhere: dsh gives a source 15 seconds, and the GitHub Pages copies of the same document — `https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/index.json` and its mirror `https://dshmarket.com/index.json` — can exceed that from some networks. The Discover tab and the `plugin_market` agent tool then search the same entries. The index covers plugins published on npm with a known version; GitHub-only entries still install with the command beside them.

> 🛒 **Recommended: [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market#readme)** (optional) — the plugin market inside DeepSeek Harness, with every plugin on this list. Simple, friendly UI: one-click plugin install and upgrade, one-click theme switching:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dshmarket
```

<a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dsh-market/dsh-market/main/assets/demo-en.png"><img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dsh-market/dsh-market/main/assets/demo-en.png" width="320" alt="dsh-market plugin browser inside DeepSeek Harness Settings: searchable plugin cards with one-click Install, category filters and a Themes tab"></a>

<sub><i>The plugin market inside Settings — click to enlarge.</i></sub>

> 💡 Prefer chat? [dsh-find-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/dsh-find-plugin#readme) lets your agent find plugins for you (`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-find-plugin`).


> ℹ️ **On desktop clients.** This list is client-agnostic. A plugin is listed because it follows the official protocol — it declares a `dsh.bundle` manifest and installs with `dsh plugin add` — not because it adapts to any particular client.
>
> Clients worth a look: [dsh-desktop](https://github.com/dataelement/dsh-desktop), [deepseek-harness-desktop](https://github.com/hairyf/deepseek-harness-desktop), and [deepseek-harness-desktop](https://github.com/anywhere-labs/deepseek-harness-desktop) by anywhere-labs — all ship dsh-market built in, so everything on this list is one click away. Any other good third-party client works too.

> [!WARNING]
> Installing a plugin runs third-party code on your machine with your own permissions — it can read your files, use your credentials, and reach the network. Tool approvals don't sandbox plugin code. Being on this list is not a security review: check the source before you install, and try unfamiliar plugins somewhere that doesn't hold your keys. See the full disclaimer at the bottom of this page.

<details>
<summary><b>What it takes to be listed here</b></summary>

An entry is added when the plugin installs with `dsh plugin add`, does what its one-line description says, sits in the right category, and is maintained. Every submission is checked against its own source before merging — if a description claims "46 tools", someone counts them.

That is the whole bar. **This list doesn't rank plugins or judge their quality, and we don't want to.** Plenty of good software will never appear here, and a slot here proves nothing beyond meeting those rules. They exist so that whatever you pick installs and behaves the way the line said it would.

A listing isn't permanent either: entries whose repos go away, stop being maintained, or turn out to be broken get removed. Full criteria and the review checklist: [how submissions are reviewed](contributing.md#how-submissions-are-reviewed--收录如何评审).

</details>

## Plugins

<!-- BEGIN PLUGINS -->
### AGI Architecture Exploration

- [Anmulzhao/DSH-AGINT](https://github.com/Anmulzhao/DSH-AGINT) - Self-evolving agent framework on DeepSeek Harness (dsh): 40 Cordis plugins and 4 presets covering memory, reflection, gates, metrics and an auditable evolution loop. Not a one-command install. Clone the repo and run install/install.sh --profile=web (needs bash, Node 20+, python3, DSH 0.1.7-rc.1 or newer with an initialized profile), then restart.
- [AnonyJcy/dsh-j-space](https://github.com/AnonyJcy/dsh-j-space) - J-Space Cognition Suite SV1 native agent preset and standalone Cordis plugin: 13 modules, persistent controller and decoupled workspace.
- [benrong2048-boop/dsh-prompt-polish](https://github.com/benrong2048-boop/dsh-prompt-polish) - Turns a one-line DSH draft into a complete task brief (role / goal / constraints / output format). The engine is a byte-verified port of linshenkx/prompt-optimizer (three modes, 10 templates identical to upstream); history is consent-gated with version chains and structural comparison; every run reports its token usage. Nothing is written back or sent without a click.
- [burning-frappuccino/dsh-turbo](https://github.com/burning-frappuccino/dsh-turbo) - Per-session execution gears for the DSH composer: an OVERDRIVE toggle turns Turbo on for the current session only, the Fast and Max gears swap the agent's planning and verification policy and may lower the request's reasoning effort, and the Host keeps the authoritative mode plus per-turn latency, step count, tool calls and whether a verification command ran.
- [dsh-answer-reviewer](https://github.com/bycall/dsh-answer-reviewer) - Agentic answer reviewer for DeepSeek Harness: each final assistant turn is re-reviewed by a separate LLM graded 1-100; below-threshold scores steer the agent back with concrete feedback. The score is shown as a chip on the answer's action row (green pass / red needs-work, with retry count and reason on hover). Live gate config from the Reviewer 配置 tab in the conversation view ring above the composer (对话 / 轨迹 / 记忆系统 / Reviewer 配置), from a 127.0.0.1 HTTP server, or from an optional right-sidebar tab via dsh-better-sidebar.
- [CAI-MH/dsh-quality-review](https://github.com/CAI-MH/dsh-quality-review) - Audit each finished assistant turn with an independent reviewer model and steer the agent to fix failed output, with at most 2 review rounds per turn and SOP-folder standards injected as an extra review dimension.
- [CanaryJing/dsh-big-fat-whale-maid-adaptive](https://github.com/CanaryJing/dsh-big-fat-whale-maid-adaptive) - Agent preset with adaptive tool presentation and environment-aware shell routing. Ports modules from yjh051108/dsh-routing-suite and xiaobright/dsh-anchored-standard (the former is listed here), so do not enable it alongside those presets.
- [ccll/dsh-advisor-flow](https://github.com/ccll/dsh-advisor-flow) - Executor/advisor workflow ported from pi-advisor-flow: the executor calls ask_advisor for a second opinion at key decisions, after repeated failures and before completion; equivalent repeated tool calls are intercepted before execution for an advisor review with a proceed/revise/blocked verdict, and hard mode force-reviews every turn before it closes. Per-call token and cost ledger with /advisor status readout, privacy tiers for repo context and file contents, six-shape secret redaction, and a web settings card; advisor failures never stall the main loop.
- [Clearailhc/clearai-dsh](https://github.com/Clearailhc/clearai-dsh) - An agent preset for evidence-checked research: every step advances only through system-verified observations, L3+ claims go to an independent evaluator, and the session folds into a replayable ledger that grows into a browsable domain ontology. Requires DSH >=0.1.7-alpha.1.
- [DoreiHime/dsh-help-me-to-ask](https://github.com/DoreiHime/dsh-help-me-to-ask) - On the first real work message of each chat window, asks for the missing goal, deliverable, constraints and acceptance criteria, then turns the answers into a short task sheet and injects it into the chat. Pure greetings are ignored.
- [FelixJiashengFu/dsh-force-collab](https://github.com/FelixJiashengFu/dsh-force-collab) - Forced collaboration: a composer picker sets 0–6 sub-agents, and while it is on every hands-on task must be split across exactly that many child agents through a collab_fanout tool that has no count parameter, then merged by the main agent.
- [FelixJiashengFu/dsh-muse-code](https://github.com/FelixJiashengFu/dsh-muse-code) - Meta's Muse Code CLI inside DSH: a composer switch starts muse serve, a right-sidebar panel and five chat tools (muse_open, muse_prompt, muse_read, muse_status, muse_interrupt) share one Muse session, approvals are decided only in the panel, and a local spend guard hard-stops at $10 by default. Windows only; needs the Muse Code CLI installed and signed in. The $10 cap is a local estimate for the muse serve this plugin starts.
- [ff66ccff/dsh-ATN](https://github.com/ff66ccff/dsh-ATN) - Adaptive topology multi-agent preset for DeepSeek Harness with peer messaging, task handoff and live network visualization.
- [Funny1Potato/dsh-outsourcing-expert](https://github.com/Funny1Potato/dsh-outsourcing-expert) - Agent presets whose leader does no work itself: every non-management tool call is denied at the harness boundary so the task has to go to a subagent, after a one-time lookup of the available subagent models and a per-task model choice; a second preset deliberately picks the model least suited to the task.
- [FuRongJun-1999/dsh-memory](https://github.com/FuRongJun-1999/dsh-memory) - White-box AGI architecture exploration: metacognition (self-cognition loop), continual learning (knowledge flywheel), world model (condition space, spatiotemporal memory graph), self-improvement (bootstrap discipline), zero-LLM white-box pipeline, and auditable trust guardrails.
- [HYClub/deepseek-harness-game-studios](https://github.com/HYClub/deepseek-harness-game-studios) - DeepSeek Harness port of Claude Code Game Studios (CCGS v1.1.2, MIT): 76 skills, 49 agents, hook bridge.
- [icyaaaww/dsh-soul](https://github.com/icyaaaww/dsh-soul) - Records recurring task corrections and tool failures locally, then compiles them into changes to eight harness components through explicitly started evolution, paired baseline/candidate checks, trial activation and rollback. Includes a budget and audit ledger; requires Node.js 24+ and a compatible DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 or later 0.2.x host.
- [JiewiW/dsh-cot-anchor](https://github.com/JiewiW/dsh-cot-anchor) - Injects conclusions already established in the previous reasoning block after each tool result, so the model continues from them instead of re-deriving the same conclusions.
- [jiuaiwo/dsh-expert](https://github.com/jiuaiwo/dsh-expert) - Expert roster for DeepSeek Harness: 636 experts across 22 divisions with full Chinese names and bios, summoned as subagents from the @ menu or by the model through list_t_experts / summon_t_expert / summon_t_experts, plus custom experts and a skill on/off switch.
- [dsh-proactive](https://github.com/john-walks-slow/dsh-proactive/tree/main/packages/dsh-proactive) - Host-level proactive wake-ups for DeepSeek Harness: the model schedules its own alarms (once, recurring interval, or cron, with optional random jitter), cold sessions are woken on time by session resume, model-initiated follow-ups are gated by quiet hours and a daily delivery budget, silent wake turns end with proactive_reclaim and fold out of model context as tombstones, declared schedule files glob-sync JSON schedules into host alarms idempotently, min_idle_seconds defers wakes until the destination session quiets down, and a web panel (settings section plus per-session tab, SSE live refresh) manages alarms and wake history — the heartbeat engine for AI companions and roleplay characters with their own daily routines and world evolution.
- [john-walks-slow/dsh-simulated-life](https://github.com/john-walks-slow/dsh-simulated-life) - Simulated life context for DeepSeek Harness: every turn injects the past 24h of simulated life events from the workspace .life/ directory (sliding-window filter, session-level deduplication with delta updates, world summary) as a collapsed context notice, and the life_react tool lets the agent record feelings, thoughts and actions back into its life log for the next round of world evolution — turning a DSH agent into a roleplay character with a persistent daily life.
- [Jonah-Wu23/dsh-gungnir#dsh-plugin](https://github.com/Jonah-Wu23/dsh-gungnir/tree/main/packages/dsh-plugin) - Evidence-driven goal verification plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Locks goals via /ultragoal and verifies completion against command exit codes and generated artifacts, preventing the model from falsely reporting task completion.
- [Kanadego/dsh-heartbeat](https://github.com/Kanadego/dsh-heartbeat) - Heartbeat loop for DeepSeek Harness: every 20 minutes (by default) the agent wakes on its own to keep a local profile of your interests and preferences, search the web for things you care about, and keep what it finds. When it has something worth sharing, it sends a short package of notes to the sessions you link it to. A set of rules in code - quiet hours, busy windows, a daily limit, a cooldown - decides whether it may speak at all, and the agent in that session decides whether to actually say anything. Windows only.
- [kenz1117/dsh-engram](https://github.com/kenz1117/dsh-engram) - Cross-session long-term memory as a local SQLite store: dual scopes (user + per-git-origin project), hybrid FTS5 + local-vector retrieval fused with RRF, an evidence gate that forces an explicit sufficiency judgement, provenance audit chains, SM-2 spaced-repetition review, consolidation distillation and decay forgetting, and a nine-view "Memory Palace" sidebar panel. 22 narrow-parameter tools, no external service, no API key, no Docker.
- [leeyoung1/dsh-advisor-plugin](https://github.com/leeyoung1/dsh-advisor-plugin) - Pairs the running executor with a stronger reviewer model through zero-parameter advisor() calls and step-based patrol checks, returning plan, correction, or stop guidance.
- [lifangjin/dsh-maoying](https://github.com/lifangjin/dsh-maoying) - Web-novel writing assistant preset for DeepSeek Harness: the main agent acts as editor-in-chief and delegates outlining, drafting, review, lore-keeping and research to five helpers across a seven-phase workflow, with the whole novel kept as a structured markdown/YAML novel/ directory (character cards, a foreshadowing state machine, timeline, narrative memory), plus a sidebar creator panel and six zero-dependency CLI commands.
- [LittleAlety/dsh-team-conductor](https://github.com/LittleAlety/dsh-team-conductor) - Control plane for the harness's own Agent Teams: members are ordinary independent sessions created through the same seam the GUI uses, each with its own model, so they open and continue like any other conversation while a sidecar roster and task board coordinate them. Task entries carry a definition of done, a member's completion is submitted and waits for the Lead's review, and availability tells idle apart from awaiting-review or a failed last turn. With delegationEngine=auto it uses independent sessions, continuable subagents, or the kernel roster depending on what the composition provides.
- [mazov2love/dsh-remote-control](https://github.com/mazov2love/dsh-remote-control) - Let Agents directly control independent local DSH instances with zero intrusion—no plugins or components required on the target. Isolated environments enable autonomous configuration and testing, while Agents with different models and personalities can chat, role-play, or form nested control chains. Supports conversational setup, user-like operations, incremental reading, saved references, and remote session/workspace search.
- [MichengAI/dsh-pua](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-pua) - Adds /pua to steer the agent to try another approach and verify results before claiming completion, with 15 company styles, persona modes, global and per-conversation settings, and an optional loop that continues until a verification command passes, the iteration limit is reached, or the user cancels.
- [mrzturn/dsh-switchman](https://github.com/mrzturn/dsh-switchman) - Turns the main model into a dispatcher: six pools (economy/mechanical/main/hard/vision/review) route each subtask to the right model, with ranking and per-route reasoning-effort pins. A context watermark (50k/90k/130k) nudges delegation early and, at the force level, forks a backup session, writes a handover doc, compacts, and continues without losing in-flight subagent work; /ctx-pause, /ctx-resume and /ctx-handover pause, resume or trigger the same machinery by hand. Optional Agent Teams mode adds persistent teammates and a shared task board; /vision lets text-only models handle images via the vision pool; tiered verification sends bigger diffs to a tester and an independent reviewer. Settings UI, READMEs and the conversation / code-comment / document language preferences all cover the same 11 languages (en, zh, zh-TW, ja, ko, de, es, fr, it, pt, ru); the plugin UI follows the DSH app locale unless forced otherwise. Bundles three skills: read-only MySQL/Redis verification, commit-message generation, and a requirements/design document convention.
- [NEINC1/muche-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/NEINC1/muche-dsh-plugin) - Chat panel for the MuChe companion with per-user backend settings, plus an outbound bridge that runs tasks on the user's local dsh.
- [panando/dsh-pua](https://github.com/panando/dsh-pua) - Fork of @michengai/dsh-pua that removes the upstream global kill-switch so the composer entry is always visible while the feature stays off by default and can be toggled per session; the entry is a dropdown (Turn on / Turn off / Options) with a more compact options panel.
- [pk14742952-AD/dsh-host-rsi](https://github.com/pk14742952-AD/dsh-host-rsi) - Reflective self-evolution plugin for local Qwen3.8 27B/3.8 Flash and online APIs: a coding-loop convergence steerer curbs Qwen3.8 27B/Flash repeated-verification deep-thinking to converge faster and cut thinking time; a five-state delivery guard detects and corrects stuck turns and infinite loops; model-agnostic host logic, mostly compatible with online APIs; per-use continual self-improvement with counter-reason self-checks, critic escalation, inverted-index memory retrieval, coding-loop convergence steering, and a five-state delivery guard.
- [qian-dsh/dsh-as-mcp-server](https://github.com/qian-dsh/dsh-as-mcp-server) - Exposes DSH as an MCP server so another agent can watch its thinking, tool calls and file writes in real time, share intent, take a floor lock that denies DSH's write/edit/git tools, inject mid-turn alerts, and delegate reviews.
- [qian-dsh/dsh-outer-brain](https://github.com/qian-dsh/dsh-outer-brain) - A philosopher's way of thinking made executable: dialectics and practice-testing to govern hallucination and long-session drift, so done is a verifiable fact rather than a claim.
- [Qulierm/orbital-agents](https://github.com/Qulierm/orbital-agents) - Persistent Endeavour and Challenger peer sessions for DeepSeek Harness that plan, execute sequential tasks, and verify reported results.
- [rootsbymenda/dsh-second-angle](https://github.com/rootsbymenda/dsh-second-angle) - Checks each claim in a finished answer against the tool output that same turn read: a contradiction whose quote is found in that output steers one correction in the same turn, and claims the output does not back are flagged in the session log and on stderr. A free scan for absolute words and unmatched numbers runs first, and a turn that ran no tool never reaches the model.
- [samirliu/dsh-goalloop-agentteams](https://github.com/samirliu/dsh-goalloop-agentteams) - Deterministic goal-completion gate for DSH: a contract-first AC grammar with named failable check commands, a gate that re-runs every check itself (zero model trust), verdicts bound to a tree digest so file changes void passing verdicts, and a hard deny on false completion at update_goal via tools/pre-execute with a false-complete counter that blocks after two catches; scope-aware task-level claim handling (strict or goal-only) keeps multi-task Agent Teams loops from deadlocking.
- [sososilencing/dsh-network-engineer](https://github.com/sososilencing/dsh-network-engineer) - Standalone Network Engineer Assistant agent preset plus a bundled 32-doc command knowledge base skill for DPtech, H3C, Huawei and Ruijie switches and routers: KB-first retrieval, cross-vendor command translation, topology and CLI-output screenshot reading, online manual lookup with cited sources, and mandatory risk annotations for dangerous commands; answers networking topics only.
- [STARDUSTLC666/dsh-dream](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-dream) - Experience memory and reflection for DSH agents: automatically extracts candidate lessons after tasks and recalls user-reviewed lessons in relevant later tasks. Supports source provenance, project-scoped retrieval, conflict handling, usage feedback and expiry review; capture and recall have separate controls, and writing lessons to AGENTS.md requires preview and explicit application. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
- [starkingcn/dsh-story#story-mode](https://github.com/starkingcn/dsh-story/tree/main/story-mode) - Story Mode preset for DeepSeek Harness: role-play GM persona, three-way choices, .md character cards and world book, context distillation and prompt wrapping.
- [syyr1987/dsh-linghun](https://github.com/syyr1987/dsh-linghun) - A judgment core for DeepSeek Harness: a cognition loop that gives every decision a source and attribution and drives planning to a close, hippocampus memory that condenses running experience into knowledge (journal ledger, episodic archive, low-confidence decay), judgment identity responsibilities in the architecture (consistent rubric, judgment bound to its source), and an A2A memory-management team via dsh-linghun-assembler. Requires DSH ^0.1.0-rc.7 (rc.2 supported).
- [syyr1987/dsh-linghun-assembler](https://github.com/syyr1987/dsh-linghun-assembler) - Memory-assembly team for DeepSeek Harness: every message triggers a five-step cognition loop (judge, retrieve, assemble, feedback, calibrate) carried by role-playing subagents (judge, retriever, archivist, advocate, editor, scribe), using BM25 retrieval, time-ordered material, and LLM assembly to build useful material packs injected into linghun. Works with dsh-linghun.
- [Tests4gptplay/deepseek-servant](https://github.com/Tests4gptplay/deepseek-servant) - Autonomous AI assistant with Foreground, Planner and Worker roles, persistent tasks, restart recovery, on-demand working memory, and optional private-Git collaboration.
- [Tisitan/dsh-my-go](https://github.com/Tisitan/dsh-my-go) - Multi-agent orchestration preset: a lead agent dispatches subagents from a built-in role roster over separate read and write lane pools with per-role model binding, and collects each subagent report on a shared board; adds go_work/continue/need_help/forward tools, a tree-view panel and a settings page.
- [WDahah/portable-dsh-multi-agent-plugin](https://github.com/WDahah/portable-dsh-multi-agent-plugin) - Route each task to one model and its review to a different one, with qualification evidence, failover and a durable journal.
- [ws1234567891011/dsh-interim-narration](https://github.com/ws1234567891011/dsh-interim-narration) - Makes the agent narrate its process: every turn opens with how it reads the message and what it will do first, then short interim notes between tool-call batches, with in-app settings for style, sentence cap and toggles.
- [wuanthony397-hash/dsh-codex-peer](https://github.com/wuanthony397-hash/dsh-codex-peer) - Peer collaboration between a DeepSeek Harness agent and the local Codex CLI: split a goal into a shared work list, hand tasks over, review what comes back, and keep every prompt, event stream, and answer on disk.
- [yunxiyang/dsh-loop-continue](https://github.com/yunxiyang/dsh-loop-continue) - Resumes an agent turn that ended after narrating its next action without calling a tool: the guard replays the turn log on agent/turn-stopping, asks a judge model one true/false question, and steers the same turn to run one more step.
- [zhoulvyuan/dsh-plugin#dsh-claude-code-web](https://github.com/zhoulvyuan/dsh-plugin/tree/master/dsh-claude-code-web) - Claude Code-style workbench in DSH: workspace/session sidebar, streaming document-style transcript with unified tool cards and thinking, Markdown and Mermaid rendering, dark theme, and a draggable overlay panel backed by an in-host HTTP/WebSocket service.

### UI Enhancements

- [18569663yz-web/dsh-plugin-crypto-ticker](https://github.com/18569663yz-web/dsh-plugin-crypto-ticker) - A live crypto ticker card in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar footer, above the balance and Settings, showing BTC, ETH, SOL and JUP prices, 24-hour change and 24-point sparklines, with a pulse on each price tick, zero dependencies and no API key.

- [2002XiaoYu/dsh-session-diff](https://github.com/2002XiaoYu/dsh-session-diff) - Session-scoped diff view for the DSH Web right sidebar: opening a file the current conversation changed renders it in place with git-style added/removed line backgrounds, +/− gutter markers and dual old/new line numbers under syntax colouring, a header with +added −removed counts, a Changes only / Whole file toggle and a Re-read button, plus a companion tab that lists every file the session changed and opens each one in the same view. - [2384418321/dsh-integration-settings](https://github.com/2384418321/dsh-integration-settings) - Adds two visual pages to DSH Settings. Thinking unlock probes each OpenAI-compatible gateway for the reasoning efforts it really declares and writes the per-level config back while leaving other hand-written YAML byte ranges untouched; the available model list syncs from a separate button that previews additions and removals, then writes levels and models in one atomic pass, and can also run on the page schedule.
- [2404376192/dsh-dian-du](https://github.com/2404376192/dsh-dian-du) - Marks paragraphs or a single code line in an answer and asks the model about it in a docked right-hand column, leaving the conversation itself unmodified.
- [2768651338/dsh-effort-slider](https://github.com/2768651338/dsh-effort-slider) - A Claude Code-style reasoning-effort slider for the DSH Web UI: stepless drag, snap-on-release, a WebGL fire trail, and real, working thinking-effort control for any custom third-party model or provider.
- [2nd1st/dsh-plugin-open-app](https://github.com/2nd1st/dsh-plugin-open-app) - Runs open-mcp-apps inside DSH: every MCP app gets its own sidebar container with a separate workspace, session, and App mode, an agent status strip under the app, and inline app rendering in ordinary chats.
- [3361805598-gif/dsh-workspace-archive](https://github.com/3361805598-gif/dsh-workspace-archive) - Batch-archive or restore all conversations of a workspace from a sidebar panel or its row menu, hide a workspace from the sidebar once every conversation in it is archived, and pin workspaces to the top. - [3450892121/dsh-task-monitor#dsh-task-monitor](https://github.com/3450892121/dsh-task-monitor/tree/main/dsh-task-monitor) - Right-side overlay panel for DSH sessions showing git status, background jobs, skills and MCP usage, artifacts and visited pages, with a commit/push dialog and one-click GitHub publish.
- [379385796-sys/dsh-chat-comfort](https://github.com/379385796-sys/dsh-chat-comfort) - Adjust chat bubbles and message spacing with comfortable or compact density on verified Windows Desktop RC2/RC3 layouts, retaining native styles for unknown host fingerprints.
- [3Tiga3/dsh-plugin-namecards](https://github.com/3Tiga3/dsh-plugin-namecards) - Icon, Chinese display name and a one-line note for every DSH plugin, organized with folders, favorites, drag or pinyin ordering, list and grid views. Display-only: plugin files and cordis config are never modified; enable switches call the official plugin manager.
- [439436269-ctrl/dsh-blend-preview](https://github.com/439436269-ctrl/dsh-blend-preview) - Opens .blend files in the right-Sidebar document preview: Blender headless exports a cached GLB with scene statistics, rendered by a dependency-free WebGL viewport. - [439436269-ctrl/dsh-stl-preview](https://github.com/439436269-ctrl/dsh-stl-preview) - Opens STL meshes in the right-Sidebar document preview: binary/ASCII parsing in the browser, a WebGL viewport, and size, volume, surface-area and watertightness statistics.
- [5101good/amoji#amoji](https://github.com/5101good/amoji/tree/main/adapters/dsh) - AI-native expressions for two-way chat: people see images, while text-only models read fixed meanings; includes a picker, custom expressions, import/export, and two visual styles.
- [514006234/dsh-weekly-check#dsh-weekly-panel](https://github.com/514006234/dsh-weekly-check/tree/main/packages/dsh-weekly-panel) - Sidebar panel for a weekly, human-curated Chinese ranking of the DSH ecosystem: 31 tracked projects (17 installable plugins plus tools/skills) ranked by live GitHub stars with week-over-week deltas, and a real-call availability survey of the "free" models. Sponsor slots are labelled and sit outside the ranking.
- [534119219/chicheng-peak](https://github.com/534119219/chicheng-peak) - Edge breathing border showing DeepSeek peak/valley hours, with flowing light and scheduled push reminders.

- [AdilAlmahmoud/dsh-rtl-chat](https://github.com/AdilAlmahmoud/dsh-rtl-chat) - Right-to-left reading mode for the conversation answer area, with a button to switch back to left-to-right.

- [advance-lion/dsh-brand](https://github.com/advance-lion/dsh-brand) - One-click brand replacement for the DSH web GUI — logo, product name, version badge, hero headline, tab title and favicon.

Windows only, and LX Music has to be installed with its local Open API enabled.

- [Aik358/dsh-anchored-monitor](https://github.com/Aik358/dsh-anchored-monitor) - A whip for DeepSeek V4 Pro: it watches the reasoning fingerprint of every thinking block and pulls the model back when it slips from focused "We will / I will" mode into scattered "let me" mode.
- [AikenFra/dsh-alive](https://github.com/AikenFra/dsh-alive) - Zero-token online status indicator for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: an always-visible online/offline dot in the conversation header, auto-refreshed every 15 seconds with no LLM calls.

- [aiyacharley/dsh-at-sider](https://github.com/aiyacharley/dsh-at-sider) - Enhances the native right-sidebar Files tab rather than replacing it: each row gets an @ reference button that inserts the canonical path mention into the composer, plus a size column, a sortable modification-time column, and a status dot for untracked, unstaged and staged files. A header search box walks the workspace recursively and can open a result or expand the tree at it, preview tabs offer reveal-in-tree and one-click @, the tree is keyboard navigable with ARIA tree semantics, and a right-click entry on the Files tab switches back to the native tree at runtime.

- [akilonewbility/dsh-workspace-optimize](https://github.com/akilonewbility/dsh-workspace-optimize) - Redraw the left-hand workspace sidebar to add color highlighting, sorting, status indicators, and system notifications. - [AKIRACOD/dsh-drag-and-drop](https://github.com/AKIRACOD/dsh-drag-and-drop) - File-drag fork: drop documents as removable chips above the composer, send without typing.

A derivative of MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget (MIT).

- [AKS1st/dock-files](https://github.com/AKS1st/dock-files) - File explorer for the dock workbench: tree browsing of the session workspace with create/rename/copy-paste/delete, drag-and-drop import and paste of local files and clipboard images.

- [AKS1st/dock-spreadsheet](https://github.com/AKS1st/dock-spreadsheet) - Read-only XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV and TSV viewer for dock-files with worksheet tabs, sorting, filters, search and cell links.
- [AKS1st/dsh-sysmon](https://github.com/AKS1st/dsh-sysmon) - System status floating widget: live CPU/memory/disk usage in the bottom-right corner of the DSH Web UI with threshold colour warnings.

- [AlannerFranklin/dsh-cutout-pet](https://github.com/AlannerFranklin/dsh-cutout-pet) - Turns an uploaded picture into a floating desk pet by cutting out its background in the page, with idle animation and a live account-balance bubble.
- [alccs/dsh-visual-intelligence-engine](https://github.com/alccs/dsh-visual-intelligence-engine/tree/main/package) - Render interactive diagrams, charts and staged learning visuals alongside native prose in DeepSeek Harness.
- [AlexPeng07/dsh-custom-plugin](https://github.com/AlexPeng07/dsh-custom-plugin) - Web GUI convenience suite with appearance controls, timeline navigation, project folders, prompts, conversation export, Mermaid rendering, quote reply, and DeepSeek balance and daily token usage.
- [AlexYin-Tongji/dsh-ui-enhancer](https://github.com/AlexYin-Tongji/dsh-ui-enhancer) - Desktop-style UI enhancements for the DSH Web client: adaptive wallpapers, a desktop pet companion with an activity feed and feeding economy, @file workspace references, and the resizable file/preview right panel.
- [Aliboder/dsh-prompt-forge](https://github.com/Aliboder/dsh-prompt-forge) - Composer prompt refinement: rewrite the draft through the harness LLM, preview the result, then apply or send it, with style presets, model-aware reasoning effort, cost estimate and a settings page.
- [AliceLJY/dsh-thumb](https://github.com/AliceLJY/dsh-thumb) - A phone shell for the web GUI - the sidebar becomes an overlay drawer that closes when a session is tapped, the settings sheet goes full-screen single column, and the transcript is retuned for phone reading.
- [alingalingling/ui-status-label](https://github.com/alingalingling/ui-status-label) - Customize the "deep diving" thinking status label to anything you like.
- [Aliuyanfeng/dsh-soul](https://github.com/Aliuyanfeng/dsh-soul) - Personalization for the agent: a Web UI panel (about-you, reply style & tone, traits for headings/lists and emoji, output language, custom instructions) and `/soul` commands, with nickname/occupation/bio/style/traits/language compiled into a system prompt and re-injected into active sessions. Exposes `soulConfig` for other plugins and a `set_persona` tool the agent can call.
- [ALIve114514awa/dsh-prompt-optimizer](https://github.com/ALIve114514awa/dsh-prompt-optimizer) - Refine prompts with guided questions and editable previews using Harness AI or native Codex across Web, desktop and TUI, applying drafts only after user confirmation.
- [All3nCN/dsh-better-sidebar-N23](https://github.com/All3nCN/dsh-better-sidebar-N23) - Full workbench fork of dsh-better-sidebar: explorer, editor, terminal, Git, browser and split panes, plus a VSCode-like shell refactor with a full-width compact header and activity rail; publishes as @all3cn/dsh-better-sidebar-n23 on npm.
- [AlLHHH/dsh-perf-boost](https://github.com/AlLHHH/dsh-perf-boost) - Client-side rendering optimizations for DSH Desktop: skips offscreen message rendering, pauses frames and timers while the window is hidden, lazily loads media, coalesces session-list repaints, pre-warms large session files, and shows the measured main-thread saving in settings.
- [AloneFu/dsh-calendar-plugin](https://github.com/AloneFu/dsh-calendar-plugin) - Obsidian daily notes, tasks and Day Planner time blocks in the DSH sidebar: a Monday-first month grid with per-day word-count and task dots, a compact timeline for HH:mm time blocks, the selected day's diary excerpt and task list, and write-back of checkbox state, task text and times to the Markdown files; a first-run wizard detects the vault or accepts a path.
- [AlyceStocking/hover-glossary](https://github.com/AlyceStocking/hover-glossary) - Shows local glossary definitions when hovering over terms in chat messages.
- [amazing-fish/dsh-piano-nav](https://github.com/amazing-fish/dsh-piano-nav) - Conversation navigation with full-history turns, collapsible process steps, final-result and structured question-and-answer keys, and pointer-following piano interaction.
- [Amengclass/dsh-settings-hub](https://github.com/Amengclass/dsh-settings-hub) - Unify third-party plugin settings in DeepSeek Harness. Auto-discover, group, and reorder plugin settings under one collapsible nav entry with drag-and-drop support.
- [amstlkqp114514/dsh-desktop-tweaks](https://github.com/amstlkqp114514/dsh-desktop-tweaks) - Desktop tweaks: F11 fullscreen toggle; enables Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V copy and paste in the terminal, both switchable in the General settings.
- [an-an-618/dsh-hook-followup](https://github.com/an-an-618/dsh-hook-followup) - Adds a lightweight follow-up row under each DSH answer: one anchor question plus 1-3 user-voice quick replies, so the next turn is one click away; supports always / balanced / conservative strategies and optional refusal or emotional-context skips.
- [an-an-618/dsh-intelligent-ui](https://github.com/an-an-618/dsh-intelligent-ui) - Declarative interactive cards for DSH: the model writes a spec, the Host compiles it into a JSON program, and the client renders forms, tables, charts and lists with local state and explicit submit.
- [Andor-Z/dsh-turn-outline](https://github.com/Andor-Z/dsh-turn-outline) - Adds a sidebar tab that folds a session into user turns (input, tool steps, output) with one-click jump back into the conversation.
- [androidly/dsh-restart-control](https://github.com/androidly/dsh-restart-control) - Adds a restart control at the DSH Web sidebar foot: the host exits through its own graceful path and the detected supervisor (systemd, Kubernetes or Docker) boots the replacement, or the plugin starts one directly when it finds no supervisor; a frame-wide notice polls the host pid until a new process answers.
- [anitman/dsh-plugin-video-player](https://github.com/anitman/dsh-plugin-video-player) - TikTok-style video feed in a floating sidebar window: swipe local or SMB-NAS folders, or paste online video URLs (yt-dlp, bilibili/YouTube, cookies.txt login state); the window auto-fits the video aspect ratio, with fullscreen, drag-resize, Range streaming and an agent video-queue endpoint.
- [ankesu/dsh-live2d-pet](https://github.com/ankesu/dsh-live2d-pet) - Live2D companion for DSH: a floating Cubism model with state-driven expressions and mouse tracking; config-driven geometry (size/position from the plugin config); official Haru sample bundled (© Live2D Inc.).
- [Anna-la/dsh-simplify](https://github.com/Anna-la/dsh-simplify) - Clean-mode for the Web GUI: hover any element and right-click to remove it; removals survive reloads and are restorable from the settings page.
- [anneheartrecord/dsh-desk-pet](https://github.com/anneheartrecord/dsh-desk-pet) - macOS desk pet that lives outside the DSH page: a real always-on-top window that clears fullscreen Spaces, six states driven by local DSH, a native right-click menu with quiet mode and a session list, and a bundled skill that turns one photo into a full eighteen-pose skin on your own image tool and credentials; system Python and ctypes, no Electron and no dependencies.
- [anonamerjaxon-dev/dsh-model-grid](https://github.com/anonamerjaxon-dev/dsh-model-grid) - Responsive card grid for the DeepSeek Harness composer model picker, grouped by provider. Host-only: injects a stylesheet through webserver/index-inject without rebuilding the client bundle, and supports both the stock picker and the dsh-peakrate menu.
- [antnesswcm/dsh-shell-card-plus](https://github.com/antnesswcm/dsh-shell-card-plus) - Replaces the stock bash/pwsh terminal rows in the DSH web UI with shell command cards: long commands soft-wrap with line numbers instead of truncating, plus separate copy-command and copy-output buttons.
- [anye-99/dsh-next-step-suggest](https://github.com/anye-99/dsh-next-step-suggest) - Next-step suggestions for the DSH composer: after each completed turn, one auxiliary call on the session's current model returns 3 clickable follow-up suggestions above the input box, and clicking one fills the draft.
- [anzhaohao/DragView](https://github.com/anzhaohao/DragView) - Drag-and-drop file attachments as Codex-style cards, with in-app PDF/text/video/audio previews and system-default opening for other formats.
- [AomiRaku/dsh-accountDisplayName-edit](https://github.com/AomiRaku/dsh-accountDisplayName-edit) - Replaces the sidebar account label — the phone number, email, username, or account name — and avatar with your own display name and image. A new "Edit display name" row in the account menu opens one dialog for both, so screenshots do not expose the original.
- [apanzinc/dsh-no-preview-badge](https://github.com/apanzinc/dsh-no-preview-badge) - Removes the Preview badge on DSH.
- [AppliedYuu/dsh-WallpaperAndCost](https://github.com/AppliedYuu/dsh-WallpaperAndCost) - Merged plugin: wallpaper customization (original-resolution uploads, crop editor, per-area opacity, MP4/WebM dynamic wallpapers) + Steam Workshop wallpaper extraction (parses scene.pkg/.tex via a bundled Python script, preview/download) + DeepSeek balance & usage widget + OpenCode Go plan usage (rolling/weekly/monthly percents in a top header pill; expand for progress bars & reset countdowns). API keys are read from DSH's credential store by the host — never stored in source or the browser.
- [appthin/dsh-mcp-manager-plus](https://github.com/appthin/dsh-mcp-manager-plus) - MCP management page in DSH Settings: list, enable/disable, restart and delete MCP servers, edit them in form or JSON mode, expand a server to see the tools it registers, and paste-import MCP configs from 14 tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code and more) in one go.
- [AprilCrystal/dsh-client-ui-font-scale](https://github.com/AprilCrystal/dsh-client-ui-font-scale) - Conversation font-size controls for the Web UI: a stepper in the composer row, keyboard shortcuts, and Ctrl+wheel zoom, all writing through the theme service setFontSize.
- [AprilCrystal/dsh-client-ui-gpt-helper](https://github.com/AprilCrystal/dsh-client-ui-gpt-helper) - ChatGPT-desktop-style model picker whose thinking-level slider carries a particle trail, plus a visual-only fast-mode toggle and a hold-to-lock for it.
- [ArcaneOrion/dsh-model-selector-search](https://github.com/ArcaneOrion/dsh-model-selector-search) - Session model selector with search: two-stage loose matching (normalised substring first, subsequence as fallback, so glm53 finds GLM-5.3 and ds finds DeepSeek), providers with recent successful calls pinned first, and a reasoning-effort pane that remembers each model's last explicitly chosen effort.
- [ArcaneOrion/dsh-teaching-board](https://github.com/ArcaneOrion/dsh-teaching-board) - Teaching board view: agent-generated self-contained HTML is projected into a sandboxed iframe as a board, annotated by hand (brush, four colours, eraser, undo), extended in place across several tool calls, and screenshotted back into the conversation as a real user message.
- [Archaofan/dsh-source-deck](https://github.com/Archaofan/dsh-source-deck) - In-conversation source deck for DSH Desktop: the current chat model runs LLM search rounds, candidates render as GitHub-aware cards, and keep/exclude feedback, favorites, and the selected sources stay in the same conversation.
- [arcnapan/dsh-chat-answer-anchor](https://github.com/arcnapan/dsh-chat-answer-anchor) - Freezes the DSH chat scroll position: new replies no longer drag the viewport to the bottom — it stays where you left it. Only after you send a message does it follow to the bottom so you can see your own input, then it locks again once the answer starts streaming. Each session remembers its own position (persisted across reloads), a settings toggle turns it off, and it never intercepts your own scrolling.
- [ardesp0630/dsh-work-progress](https://github.com/ardesp0630/dsh-work-progress) - Persistent work-progress row in the band below the composer: task completion, a progress bar, and what the agent is doing right now (generating a reply or running a tool), expandable into the full task list with turns, steps, timings and context usage.
- [Arfrsa/dsh-sidebar-sections](https://github.com/Arfrsa/dsh-sidebar-sections) - Split the DSH sidebar workspace list into Active, Session tasks and Inactive sections with manual pins and an activity threshold, keeping the official search, archive filters, row menus and drag and drop, with a one-click switch back to the shipped list. The Session tasks section uses a fixed Windows workspace at D:\files\history-tasks; other platforms must create that directory manually.
- [ArimaKana-Akane/dsh-whale-tools](https://github.com/ArimaKana-Akane/dsh-whale-tools) - Replace the dsh-whale-widget mascot with your own image through a built-in cutout pipeline, plus a session-header restart button, a browser heartbeat, and an opt-in patch self-heal that is off by default.
- [Arrosam/dsh-better-workspace-file-manager](https://github.com/Arrosam/dsh-better-workspace-file-manager) - Adds upload, download, new folder, delete, drag-to-move, drag-to-chat and in-place text editing with auto-save to the workspace Files tab and file previews.
- [Arrosam/dsh-smart-prompt](https://github.com/Arrosam/dsh-smart-prompt) - One-click prompt refinement for the DSH composer: the ✦ button next to Send rewrites the draft into an agent-ready prompt in Standard or Light mode, with Revert and Retry; asks follow-up questions through the question card when the draft is missing information; checks that paths, identifiers, numbers, URLs, inline code and @mentions survive the rewrite and adds back any that were dropped; runs on the conversation model or a dedicated model chosen on the Plugins page.
- [asd13006/dsh-multi-lang-ui](https://github.com/asd13006/dsh-multi-lang-ui) - Add six languages (繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Français, Deutsch, Español) to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI language options, with hand-polished per-language translations and automatic fallbacks (Simplified-to-Traditional conversion for zh-TW, English for the others) covering upstream updates and third-party plugins.
- [asfre/dsh-mcp-global-manager](https://github.com/asfre/dsh-mcp-global-manager) - Scans MCP configs from the tools it knows (28 built-in sources plus custom ones), syncs diffs into DSH, and lets you import, write back, or edit MCP servers from the DSH sidebar.
- [ashz555/dsh-term-glossary](https://github.com/ashz555/dsh-term-glossary) - Select a term in a DeepSeek Harness conversation and press the Search button beside it to read the explanation in place: basic meaning, purpose and usage, with the token cost of that answer. The call is auxiliary — it writes nothing to the session log.
- [Asteroid-Code-Channel/dsh-workspace-atlas](https://github.com/Asteroid-Code-Channel/dsh-workspace-atlas) - AGENTS & Skills Studio: edit AGENTS.md, create spec-compliant SKILL.md files with structured frontmatter, manage and rename skill folders, and install from Anthropic, OpenAI, Cursor, and Matt Pocock catalogs.
- [asukasec/dsh-message-preview](https://github.com/asukasec/dsh-message-preview) - Right-edge user-message navigator with an adaptive block layout that fits the available height, plus hover previews, keyboard controls, and click-to-jump navigation.
- [asun-labs/dsh-plugin-agent-switch](https://github.com/asun-labs/dsh-plugin-agent-switch) - Adds interactive agent-switch CLI terminals with tab and grid layouts, Codex delegation cards, and live or saved task output in the right sidebar. Requires agent-switch on PATH, at least one target coding CLI, and a node-pty build allowlist; implemented and tested on Windows.
- [asxiuxiu/dsh-quick-open](https://github.com/asxiuxiu/dsh-quick-open) - Quick-open palette for the Web GUI: Ctrl+P fuzzy-searches an in-memory index of the session workspace (about 51k entries, median query 5 ms) with per-segment path anchoring, dir: and file: prefixes, Tab directory drilling and :line jumps, opens the picked file in the native right sidebar, and drops a file reference into the conversation draft with Ctrl+Enter. Also adds in-file find (Ctrl+F) and a selection-to-reference action to the built-in file preview.
- [Asza-other/dsh-narrator](https://github.com/Asza-other/dsh-narrator) - Watches a turn for long silences and, once the threshold passes, injects a user message asking the model to state in prose what it is doing before carrying on, so the turn keeps going. The same text is mirrored in a lower-left overlay above the composer. The silence threshold and the minimum gap between reports are set in minutes, the prompt can be replaced wholesale, and it runs with no runtime dependencies. Requires DSH 0.2.1+ and Node.js 18+.
- [Audrey-cn/dsh-bot-codex-ui](https://github.com/Audrey-cn/dsh-bot-codex-ui) - Unified install for DS Bot and the Codex-style sidebar: one package that mounts both and fixes their layout conflicts (composer alignment, sidebar footer, account entry, conversation width).
- [AumiSatori/dsh-ui-beautify](https://github.com/AumiSatori/dsh-ui-beautify) - Configurable DSH UI surfaces, overlay sidebars, task and Artifact cards, custom user-message bubbles, local media and particle backgrounds, welcome animations, and focus mode.
- [awaYFawa/dsh-plugins-folders](https://github.com/awaYFawa/dsh-plugins-folders) - Folders for the DSH Plugins page: group installed plugins, toggle a whole group, batch move with undo, search across groups, long-press drag to reorder, reinstall removed plugins from their record, and restart Harness with one click.
- [AWL-MC2/DSH-Plugin_awl](https://github.com/AWL-MC2/DSH-Plugin_awl) - Wallpaper-aware readability repair for the DSH Web GUI: it lifts the three low-contrast secondary text tokens with color-mix plus an adjustable text halo, adds content rules (bold, permanently underlined or recoloured links, tinted headings and body text) scoped to conversation Markdown only, offers adjustable rainbow-edge and gradient-fill heading effects, loads custom fonts from the plugin folder or the DSH home, and ships a draggable WYSIWYG preview with a WCAG contrast badge.
- [Awu12277/dsh-sleep-send](https://github.com/Awu12277/dsh-sleep-send) - Schedule-send button and panel to the right of the composer, with smart time slots, a custom date/time picker, several queued sends at once, and localStorage persistence that restores pending tasks after a page reload.
- [ayahunter/dsh-trail#bundle](https://github.com/ayahunter/dsh-trail/tree/main/packages/bundle) - Replaces the Web GUI trajectory tab with a new-user-friendly round-by-round storyline, plain-language tool labels, category filters and fuzzy search.
- [ayingQAQ/dsh-web-launcher](https://github.com/ayingQAQ/dsh-web-launcher) - Windows desktop launcher bundle for DSH Web that creates a managed shortcut, then restarts DSH in the background and refreshes the existing browser page.
- [azazo1/dsh-deep-diving-back](https://github.com/azazo1/dsh-deep-diving-back) - Restores the blue shimmering Deep diving turn status row that DSH 0.1.6 and earlier showed at the end of the transcript.
- [azazo1/dsh-reduce-effects](https://github.com/azazo1/dsh-reduce-effects) - Adds a UI effects page to Settings that switches off DSH Web animations and transitions, loading and progress animations, backdrop blur, smooth scrolling, hover title scroll, shadows, gradients and JS motion one category at a time, to cut browser rendering cost.
- [Azetus/dsh-quorfloat](https://github.com/Azetus/dsh-quorfloat) - System-level desktop floating-window plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a global hotkey opens a floating window; the plugin supports workspace and session switching, approval and follow-up handling, and export of its own diagnostic logs for plugin troubleshooting.
- [azkbzxf/dsh-account-balance-pill](https://github.com/azkbzxf/dsh-account-balance-pill) - Shows the signed-in DeepSeek account's remaining balance in the DSH composer bottom bar, next to the shipped turn/step and token-usage pills, and refreshes it periodically and after each turn.
- [azkbzxf/dsh-vscode-scrollbar](https://github.com/azkbzxf/dsh-vscode-scrollbar) - Gives the DSH conversation the Visual Studio Code editor chrome: a 14px always-visible scrollbar with a flat, translucent thumb, plus a VS Code-style minimap in the right margin (half-window column, media not painted, hover-only minimapSlider, click/wheel scrolling) and auto-expanded older pages.
- [AzureSkyHuHu/dsh-chinese-mode-modern](https://github.com/AzureSkyHuHu/dsh-chinese-mode-modern) - Adds a Chinese-mode toggle beside the composer that opens a panel for switching reply, reasoning, and tool-narration language, persisted in the profile.
- [B612wang/dsh-ui-transparency](https://github.com/B612wang/dsh-ui-transparency) - Whole-window opacity for the DSH desktop window from one button at the sidebar foot: a 0-90% slider whose value is remembered between runs. It only sets the window alpha - no restyling, no extra panels, and no other feature is touched. Windows only.
- [bagpipe1289/dsh-paperflight#plugin](https://github.com/bagpipe1289/dsh-paperflight/tree/main/plugin) - PaperFlight is an experimental future-retro DSH Web workbench with session management, file previews, approvals, and optional preset-scoped browser and terminal tools.
- [Bai-2008/dsh-better-panel](https://github.com/Bai-2008/dsh-better-panel) - Replaces the model button in the DSH composer with its own two-level panel (provider list, then a searchable model list) built around a continuous draggable reasoning-effort slider: blue-to-violet fill, nebula and star particles on higher levels, and a distinct color per level. Picking a model keeps the panel open and moves the slider to that model's middle level. The implementation started from Microqian2th/dsh-codex-effort-slider 1.0.0 (credited in the README); the panel, the seat takeover, the offline test suite and the docs are new here.
- [baifagg/dsh-plugin-busy-workspace](https://github.com/baifagg/dsh-plugin-busy-workspace) - Ranks workspaces holding a session that wants attention to the top of the sidebar session list - waiting on you first, then running, then finished-but-unopened, then just read - and draws those rows with a state bar, tinted surface and coloured title, plus a one-shot settle pulse when a run stops. Every colour is taken from the active theme's own tokens, and the three windows that decide how long a finished session stays promoted are settings.
- [bainianlaoyao/easy-archive](https://github.com/bainianlaoyao/easy-archive) - Two-step inline archive on workspace sidebar rows — one click arms a red confirm, the second click archives; the archive entry is removed from the ⋮ menu.
- [baisama-cloud/dsh-composer-history](https://github.com/baisama-cloud/dsh-composer-history) - Command history for the DSH composer: press Up/Down to cycle through previously sent instructions, then restore the draft at the end of the history; works in the official desktop app and web-profile builds.
- [Baisbt/dsh-GreaterClarity-plugin](https://github.com/Baisbt/dsh-GreaterClarity-plugin) - Enhances the DSH web session view — one-click collapse of reasoning and tool chains, numbered history quick-jump, Markdown export, AI avatars.
- [balue8246-maker/dsDragPasteALL](https://github.com/balue8246-maker/dsDragPasteALL) - Drag or paste any local file onto the DSH page; it resolves the real absolute path (Spotlight + size/mtime + head/tail fingerprint match) and inserts it into the composer, with a content-cache fallback.
- [BangBang-03/dsh-client-ui-quote](https://github.com/BangBang-03/dsh-client-ui-quote) - Turn any DSH selection into a reviewable quote — chat, file preview, terminal and diff; code quotes carry path#line. A sent quote keeps a source highlight and ordinal and jumps back, then joins a searchable review list with status, tags, multi-select insert, and Markdown/JSON export. Quotes collect above the composer as a 引用 ×N bar with per-chip edit and remove; side threads can bring their conclusion back to the main draft; a sent quote can be revised, with the old capsule marked superseded; replies can answer each quote by number.
- [BaoBao1996121/dsh-huaci-pinglun](https://github.com/BaoBao1996121/dsh-huaci-pinglun) - Selection comments and quoted conversations (dsh划词评论 / dsh-huaci-pinglun), based on the MIT-licensed BangBang-03/dsh-client-ui-quote 0.11.1 with attached textarea measurement, border-aware height and long-text scrolling.
- [BaoBao1996121/dsh-restart-ui](https://github.com/BaoBao1996121/dsh-restart-ui) - Adds a restart button to the DSH Web UI through a loopback-only endpoint that requests a relaunch using the current process executable, arguments and working directory.
- [dsh-keep-awake](https://github.com/bearice/dsh-keep-awake) - Holds the OS wake lock while any agent, subagent, or background job runs, releases it after a configurable grace period, and provides a bilingual web settings page with live status, manual hold, and display-on options.
- [Beership/dsh-download-progress](https://github.com/Beership/dsh-download-progress) - Live download progress in the DSH session header — percentage, transfer speed, ETA and phase per download, with file-size probing before a transfer starts and byte-range resume after an interruption. The progress cards render as a fixed overlay at the top-right of the chat window.
- [BEIDAOU/dsh-boot-animation-custom](https://github.com/BEIDAOU/dsh-boot-animation-custom) - Customizable startup animation for DeepSeek Harness with eight bundled clips, random rotation, tail fade and time-of-day greetings. Based on lxj5820/dsh-boot-animation, so do not install it with the upstream plugin; bundled clips and the welcome voice carry their own media terms.
- [BestQ-A/dsh-session-tree](https://github.com/BestQ-A/dsh-session-tree) - Hierarchical session tree for the sidebar - native subagent trees plus an optional organization-derived hierarchy, with collapsed branch counters and orphan/cycle defense.
- [better-er/dsh-classic-coding](https://github.com/better-er/dsh-classic-coding) - Slides out a Monaco editor plus a lazy-loaded file-tree panel in the DSH Web conversation, so you can edit the local workspace inline without switching to an external editor.
- [better-er/dsh-edit-diff](https://github.com/better-er/dsh-edit-diff) - Client-side re-render of edit/write tool cards with a near-linear line-level diff that drops duplicate unchanged lines and underlines the actual changed characters inside replaced lines.
- [better-er/dsh-mobile-drawer](https://github.com/better-er/dsh-mobile-drawer) - Below 1024px the sidebar collapses to a 44px floating square and expands into a 280px overlay drawer; picking a session collapses it again and the focus grab that would raise the soft keyboard after a session switch is suppressed.
- [better-er/dsh-tool-autoexpand](https://github.com/better-er/dsh-tool-autoexpand) - Auto-expands newly arrived tool-call cards in the DSH Web UI, with a sidebar toggle cycling no-op/expand/collapse and the state persisted to localStorage.
- [BeyondandSharp/dsh-plugin-scaling](https://github.com/BeyondandSharp/dsh-plugin-scaling) - Independent per-pane zoom for the DSH web shell: Ctrl+wheel over a pane, Ctrl+± / Ctrl+0 for the focused pane. Works with the official look and every skin.
- [bf185003/dsh-favicon-status](https://github.com/bf185003/dsh-favicon-status) - Browser tab status indicator for dsh web: paints the document favicon from the session list (blue spinning while work runs, amber while waiting on the user, green when finished).
- [big-head-pigeon/dsh-session-menu](https://github.com/big-head-pigeon/dsh-session-menu) - Adds mark-unread, copy session info, reveal in Finder or open with your IDE, and permanent delete (with child sessions) to the DSH sidebar session menu, plus error and unread status dots, hover-card details, one-click delete for archived rows, and a settings panel that switches each menu item on or off; the interface is available in English and Chinese.
- [bigbigman-001/dsh-quote-to-composer](https://github.com/bigbigman-001/dsh-quote-to-composer) - Select text anywhere in DeepSeek Harness, click the quote pill next to the pointer, and the selection lands in the composer as a small quote chip; hover the chip to read the full quote.
- [biggerboy/dsh-conversation-anchors](https://github.com/biggerboy/dsh-conversation-anchors) - Codex-style left-gutter tick rail for each user turn, with hover preview and click-to-scroll.
- [bilbillm/dsh-steam-startup-animation](https://github.com/bilbillm/dsh-steam-startup-animation) - Steam Big Picture-style six-second Canvas startup animation for DSH Desktop with a variable-width terminal-to-whale transition, optional stereo startup audio, volume controls, preview, Escape skip, and reduced-motion support.
- [bill9109/dsh-drag-and-drop](https://github.com/bill9109/dsh-drag-and-drop) - Cross-platform file drag-and-drop with raw path insertion, no file copying.
- [bitterSmilezzz/dsh-model-selector](https://github.com/bitterSmilezzz/dsh-model-selector) - Enhanced model selector for the DSH composer with searchable provider groups, keyboard and accessibility support, and an inline reasoning-effort slider.
- [bitxeno/dsh-github-picker](https://github.com/bitxeno/dsh-github-picker) - Composer GitHub picker: click the GitHub icon at the bottom-right of the input box to search the workspace repository's issues and pull requests via the gh CLI, and insert the reference as a URL or @owner/repo#number mention.
- [BlackBearCC/dsh-pet-sprite](https://github.com/BlackBearCC/dsh-pet-sprite) - A pixel companion living in the chat area: hatches from an egg into one of three sprites or an LLM-drawn custom one from a text description, platform-jumps over message bubbles on its own, WASD controllable, chats in character through the models you already configured, and carries a nurture system (mood/power/health, levels, shop) driven by real token usage.
- [Blackman99/codsh#codsh-bundle](https://github.com/Blackman99/codsh/tree/main/packages/bundle) - Terminal coding agent for DeepSeek Harness with a full-screen alternate-screen UI, turn-aware session navigation, and a gated /ship workflow that takes one-line requirements through specification, TDD, and rerun acceptance checks.
- [blacktaoK/dsh-skill-zh-overlay](https://github.com/blacktaoK/dsh-skill-zh-overlay) - Chinese summaries for the dsh-skill-mcp-panel skill cards: each expanded card gets a short Chinese overview, a category tag and a few bullet points, while the English description the panel already renders is folded behind a "原文" toggle. Skills missing from the bundled map are translated on demand by the host with your current default model and cached on disk, keyed by a hash of the original text, so a new skill needs no manual entry. Skills whose own description is already Chinese are skipped.
- [blueziii/dsh-peakvalley](https://github.com/blueziii/dsh-peakvalley) - Composer-dock badge showing DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing on a Beijing-time calendar whose China holiday schedule is fetched online at runtime (off-peak costs half the peak rate); auto-hides for non-DeepSeek models and cycles seven readouts on click.
- [Bobnemimimmi/dsh-always-status-bar](https://github.com/Bobnemimimmi/dsh-always-status-bar) - Keeps the native per-message status line always visible without hovering — date and time on every message, run duration, TTFT, and tokens per second on assistant messages.
- [boogoo619/dsh-focus-overlay](https://github.com/boogoo619/dsh-focus-overlay) - Focus mode with a full-screen reading overlay that hides the header and composer and folds AI tool calls into summaries.
- [BrianHIO-x/dsh-think-expand](https://github.com/BrianHIO-x/dsh-think-expand) - Auto-expands every Think row after switching sessions, with a header switch to turn it on or off.
- [BroCC57/dsh-pending-review-glow](https://github.com/BroCC57/dsh-pending-review-glow) - Highlights sidebar session rows by state (pending approval, running, just finished) with color, animation and a matching status dot.
- [btsd321/dsh-oh-my-terminal](https://github.com/btsd321/dsh-oh-my-terminal) - Bottom terminal panel for the DSH Web GUI, providing multi-tab interactive terminals powered by node-pty (Windows ConPTY / POSIX openpty) with split panes, a side terminal list, and a dropdown new/split menu. Also compatible with DSH-better-sidebar — auto-detected at runtime, it switches to a bottom workbench tab so PTY sessions do not bind the DSH session write handle.
- [buaaflyaway/dsh-question-note](https://github.com/buaaflyaway/dsh-question-note) - Adds an optional note field under each selected option in the DSH Web UI ask_user_question popup; submitted notes travel to the model in the answer's custom field.
- [burningg/dsh-workspace-categories](https://github.com/burningg/dsh-workspace-categories) - Sidebar category groups for DSH workspaces: the flat project list becomes collapsible named sections, workspaces re-file by dragging a row onto a group or picking one from a dropdown, one toolbar button collapses every group at once, an appearance panel sets font size, text color and background tint for each of the three levels, and Ctrl+Tab cycles recently opened sessions.
- [dsh-code-collector](https://github.com/bycall/dsh-code-collector) - Session code collector for DeepSeek Harness: a composer-side panel gathering every code block the model produced in the current session, with by-language / by-file views, per-file version history, live search, per-entry copy, copy-all, download-all as Markdown, and click-to-jump back to the exact turn (Alt+Shift+C).
- [dsh-conversation-timeline](https://github.com/bycall/dsh-conversation-timeline) - Conversation timeline dock bar for DeepSeek Harness: a turn-level timeline above the composer with user-prompt hover tooltips and click-to-jump back to the exact chat position.
- [CAI-MH/dsh-agent-group-panel](https://github.com/CAI-MH/dsh-agent-group-panel) - Feishu multi-agent robot console: start, stop and reconnect the daemon, view status and recent activity, and jump to the task workspace.
- [caimc21069065-prog/dsh-my-music](https://github.com/caimc21069065-prog/dsh-my-music) - Full-page NetEase Cloud Music player for DSH: daily recommendations, playlist browsing by category, charts, new releases, search, playlist/album/artist pages, QR-code login, synced lyrics, queue and downloads, plus four agent tools for search, song URLs, lyrics and playlist tracks.
- [caisiyang123/dsh-tick-rail](https://github.com/caisiyang123/dsh-tick-rail) - Tick-rail conversation navigator: one tick per message you sent, a lit peak that follows the mouse with an even falloff, hover previews, click or keyboard to jump.
- [Canary-Builds/dsh-mobile-ui](https://github.com/Canary-Builds/dsh-mobile-ui) - Adds touch-friendly navigation, layout refinements, and standalone PWA styling to the existing DeepSeek Harness web interface.
- [CAOGGL/dsh-port-token](https://github.com/CAOGGL/dsh-port-token) - Puts a key badge in the bottom-right corner of the dsh Web GUI that shows the port this instance is listening on and the remote-access token printed by dsh web at startup, with a copy button per value; clicking the badge rotates the key into a cross, and clicking it again or anywhere beside it collapses the panel.
- [CarrotFish/dsh-file-and-terminal](https://github.com/CarrotFish/dsh-file-and-terminal) - Adds host file management and an interactive Bash terminal to the DSH WebUI.
- [CaT-Hode/DSH-app](https://github.com/CaT-Hode/DSH-app) - Windows Electron companion sharing the DSH Web profile, conversations and plugins, with startup logs, update recovery and diagnostics.
- [CatLollipop/dsh-composer-draft-cache](https://github.com/CatLollipop/dsh-composer-draft-cache) - Composer enhancements: caches unsent drafts per workspace for new sessions and per Session id for existing ones, restoring them after switching away and dropping them once sent or cleared; adds an @plugin completion group that mentions an installed plugin so the agent receives that plugin's metadata as runtime context for the turn.
- [causebefore/dsh-pomodoro](https://github.com/causebefore/dsh-pomodoro) - Pomodoro focus-and-break timer for DSH Web with configurable cycles, a draggable mini panel, and in-app, sound, and browser notifications.
- [cayan0x/dsh-fold-context](https://github.com/cayan0x/dsh-fold-context) - Auto-fold context/system messages in DSH conversation — collapse think blocks, tool calls, and tool results into grouped expandable bars.

- [ccll/dsh-activity-pane](https://github.com/ccll/dsh-activity-pane) - Activity overview pane for the DSH web UI: running, awaiting-response and recent sessions with child agents, progress, model and reasoning level in one sidebar pane.
- [ccq1/dsh-side-panel](https://github.com/ccq1/dsh-side-panel) - Side panel with file browser, terminal, and Git review for quick file previews.
- [cdredfox/dsh-prompt-shortcuts](https://github.com/cdredfox/dsh-prompt-shortcuts) - Pinned prompt shortcuts in a single row above the composer — one click replaces the draft with the saved text — plus a searchable panel for pinning, editing and deleting prompts, overflow collapsed into a "More" menu, storage in a Host-side JSON file, and a prompt_shortcuts agent tool that reads and writes the same file.
- [Ceelog/dsh-plugins#dsh-plugin-setting-mcp](https://github.com/Ceelog/dsh-plugins/tree/main/src/plugins/dsh-plugin-setting-mcp) - Manage MCP servers from the Web settings panel: view, add, edit, remove, enable or disable them, with hot reload on save.
- [Celebrate-W/dsh-topic-trail](https://github.com/Celebrate-W/dsh-topic-trail) - Turns each long dsh conversation into a three-level trail (topic to progress steps to milestone timeline) and shows it in a draggable overlay, where one click jumps back to the matching message in the transcript. Topics are distilled by the DeepSeek model with a zero-cost rule-based fallback, can be renamed, locked, merged by drag and drop, and support per-conversation notes plus a vector drawing board.
- [Centaurea5547196/dsh-page-zoom](https://github.com/Centaurea5547196/dsh-page-zoom) - Page zoom for the DSH Web UI: Ctrl+mouse wheel scales the entire interface in 5% steps (30%-200%), remembers the zoom level locally, and shows a magnifier with the percentage in the bottom-right corner.
- [CH4ACKO3/dsh-turn-fold](https://github.com/CH4ACKO3/dsh-turn-fold) - Codex-style turn folding for the DSH Web UI: keeps final answers visible, groups consecutive reasoning and tool activity, and shows configurable live duration, tool-call, and token metrics with multilingual summaries.
- [Chaiyahang/dsh-scratchpad](https://github.com/Chaiyahang/dsh-scratchpad) - Scratchpad panel for DeepSeek Harness: tagged notes, image/file attachments, Markdown task lists, send-to-chat, a wake-up shortcut, JSON export/import, and Agent tools.
- [chaochaokongbai/dsh-beginner-hub](https://github.com/chaochaokongbai/dsh-beginner-hub) - Beginner panel for DeepSeek Harness: routes a plain-language request into ready-to-use plans (prompt variants, matching skills, advanced moves) with a local keyword engine and fills the chosen plan into a new session in one click.
- [chargeduck/xechat-dsh](https://github.com/chargeduck/xechat-dsh) - Dockable side panel that keeps an XEChat chat session connected over a single WebSocket: markdown messages with images and emoji, server switching through #showServer and #login, an online member list, a full-screen panic overlay, and dock side, width and visibility persisted to localStorage.
- [charliesbyte/dsh-workspace-activity](https://github.com/charliesbyte/dsh-workspace-activity) - Shows a spinner on a sidebar workspace row while any of its sessions are running, and a short-lived finished mark after they stop.
- [charrywhite/dsh-sticky-notes](https://github.com/charrywhite/dsh-sticky-notes) - Draggable sticky notes with 9 skins, image notes, and agent-readable to-do lists for DeepSeek Harness.
- [CheeseFox259/dsh-better-composer](https://github.com/CheeseFox259/dsh-better-composer) - Markdown visual enhancement and session workbench for DSH Web Composer: live syntax presentation with caret-row source reveal (inactive-line markers can be hidden or faded), deterministic local completions, and list/quote continuation on line break with ordered-list renumbering; long pastes fold into persistent chips with inline context or file-mode delivery (@path across 50+ extensions) plus sidebar LLM rewrites (stop, preview diff, undo/redo); real-time context map with token gauge, composition breakdown, per-turn growth chart with anchor lines, in-place /compact, turn forking, and a Context Doctor workspace (overview, diagnostics, analysis, feedback).
- [chen731215-dev/dsh-muv-engine](https://github.com/chen731215-dev/dsh-muv-engine) - MUV engine for DeepSeek Harness: runs the regex_scripts from a character card against model output, tracks variables, renders a status bar, expands macros and LaTeX, and styles tagged code blocks such as letter, terminal, newspaper and phone. Needs dsh-muv-table installed as well, which is its companion plugin.
- [chen731215-dev/dsh-muv-table](https://github.com/chen731215-dev/dsh-muv-table) - MUV variable table editor for DeepSeek Harness: a tree view of the variables being tracked, a macro test panel for random, pick and roll, a dice shortcut bar and pick-cache management. Companion plugin for dsh-muv-engine.
- [chen8923/dsh-task-progress](https://github.com/chen8923/dsh-task-progress) - Live progress for long-running DSH tasks: a script appends JSON lines to a per-session progress file, the Web UI draws them in a floating overlay and a right-sidebar tab that also lists background jobs which reported nothing, and `dsh-progress run -- <cmd>` wraps a command that cannot report for itself.
- [ChendarCe/dsh-perf-hud](https://github.com/ChendarCe/dsh-perf-hud) - A transparent, draggable performance HUD for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: CPU, GPU and memory usage in three compact rows that float directly over the interface without any card background, snapping to the nearest window corner so resizing or maximising keeps them in place; CPU package temperature comes from an optional elevated helper (LibreHardwareMonitor + PawnIO) and the plugin itself stays at a fraction of a percent of CPU. Windows only.
- [chendefine/dsh-composer-markdown](https://github.com/chendefine/dsh-composer-markdown) - Markdown editing aids for the DSH web composer: ordered and unordered list continuation with continuous renumbering, Tab-nested list levels, inline-code styling, and code-fence auto-closing, with the sent draft kept as literal Markdown.
- [ChengX0721/dsh-client-ui-skin-alice-greyrat](https://github.com/ChengX0721/dsh-client-ui-skin-alice-greyrat) - A pale rose-and-gold Mushoku Tensei skin for the DSH web GUI: an arcane sigil and two full-body Eris figures behind the conversation, a young Eris standee and gilt plugin glyphs in the sidebar, and its own settings card.
- [chengzhi43/dsh-file](https://github.com/chengzhi43/dsh-file) - VS Code-style file manager: browse the conversation workspace in a sidebar tree and edit files in the center column with Monaco, with theme import/export and Markdown preview.
