- [Li-Mingshuang/dsh-audio-control](https://github.com/Li-Mingshuang/dsh-audio-control) - Floating audio control panel in the Web GUI: play/pause/next/previous for Windows media sessions (SMTC) and the system master volume/mute, served by a Node route half that runs a PowerShell helper.
- [LiangshouX/dsh-ide-workbench](https://github.com/LiangshouX/dsh-ide-workbench) - JetBrains-style IDE workbench in the DSH sidebar: Project file tree, Commit panel, Git history with a swimlane graph, a real PTY terminal and an embedded editor with Markdown preview and Find in Files, plus chat file links and send-to-chat references.
- [liaoyuqing/dsh-shutdown-idle](https://github.com/liaoyuqing/dsh-shutdown-idle) - Runs a chosen power action (shutdown / restart / hibernate / sleep / lock / logoff) once every Agent session and background job has gone idle: the plugin samples in-process sessions once per second, counts running sessions as always busy, checks running background jobs through a configurable option (considerJobs, on by default, shown with its live count in Settings), waits a confirm window and then a cancellable countdown, and shows a draggable bottom-right card with the current phase and remaining seconds; the enable toggle never survives a host restart, any newly started session or Cancel aborts the countdown, and if the agents service is unavailable the machine is treated as busy so nothing ever fires. Windows only (the built-in shutdown / rundll32 actions); every action except none degrades to none elsewhere.
- [liggest/dsh-alt-enter-newline](https://github.com/liggest/dsh-alt-enter-newline) - Adds Alt+Enter as a newline to the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web composer.
- [Light-EI/dsh-chat-perf-css](https://github.com/Light-EI/dsh-chat-perf-css) - A long conversation that renders many LaTeX formulas at once can become laggy, because the browser keeps styling, laying out and painting content that is off screen. This plugin applies content-visibility: auto to the off-screen message bodies and block formulas, so that work is skipped and the lag is reduced.
- [liguobao/dsh-file-viewer](https://github.com/liguobao/dsh-file-viewer) - Read-only Web client file-preview panel with image, PDF, CSV/TSV, text, source-code, Markdown, JSON and YAML renderers, large-file range loading, and a provider API for non-local content.
- [lihang-lh/dsh-moon-light](https://github.com/lihang-lh/dsh-moon-light) - A marquee mood-light ring around the DSH web UI edge that reacts to session state, turning green while the agent works, pink when done, and yellow when something needs attention, with colors, ring width, rotation speed, and flash frequency configurable from the settings panel.
- [lihang-lh/dsh-task-panel](https://github.com/lihang-lh/dsh-task-panel) - Task panel for the DSH Web sidebar: publish tasks, auto-distill related sessions, and drive plan/develop/review stages with subagents plus in-panel acceptance.
- [LihiHe/dsh-thinking-slider](https://github.com/LihiHe/dsh-thinking-slider) - Turns the composer's reasoning-effort menu into a draggable slider and takes over the stock model-and-reasoning-level chip. Dragging follows the pointer continuously; releasing snaps to the nearest level and submits one session update per drag. The track draws its own fill, tick marks and white knob, only the highest levels (xhigh, max, ultra) get a flowing brand-colour gradient, and both ends carry the lowest and highest level names. The same card expands into the official model list. Arrow keys step one level, PageUp and PageDown two, Home and End jump to the ends, and each move submits. A generation counter on the directory object discards late responses, and reduced-motion turns the animations off. All data comes from the stock modelDirectories directory; no new capabilities are added.
- [lihongxu0221/dsh-workspace-browser](https://github.com/lihongxu0221/dsh-workspace-browser) - Replaces the shipped sidebar workspace browser with Recents, a project editor that adds extra source folders, and pin, rename, fork, and archive row actions.
- [lijinhao315/dsh-question-index](https://github.com/lijinhao315/dsh-question-index) - Question index: an ordered, collapsible list of your asked questions floating on the right side of the conversation; click a question to jump the session to that point. Auto-indexes each session's full history on open, persists it locally, and jumps to older questions by growing the window on demand.
- [lilcandi/dsh-continue-button](https://github.com/lilcandi/dsh-continue-button) - A continue button in the composer tool row, immediately left of the send key: one click writes an interruption-aware prompt into the draft and submits it, so an interrupted task resumes without retyping the context. The prompt names the interruption and appends the current task plus the tail of the last reply; Alt-click or right-click sends a bare 继续, and a non-empty draft is appended to rather than overwritten.
- [lilcandi/dsh-music-on](https://github.com/lilcandi/dsh-music-on) - A music dock for the DSH web GUI. A draggable capsule in the bottom-right corner opens into a player card with a queue, previous and next, a draggable progress bar, a volume knob driven by drag or mouse wheel, three loop modes and per-track cover art for resolved links (local files show a vinyl placeholder); audio files dropped onto the card play immediately. Paste a Bilibili, NetEase Cloud Music or QQ Music track or playlist link to resolve it: NetEase and QQ audio is signed by the host into an opaque HMAC token, so the browser never receives a plain CDN address and cannot forge one. A spectrum canvas along the page bottom reads a real AnalyserNode and draws in six styles (dots, bars, blocks, mirror, line, wave) with adjustable width, bar count, sensitivity, glow, height, frame rate and placement; the row is fitted to the container width, falling back to a slight overflow when the gaps would fall below half a pixel. Seven colour themes (whale blue-white, aurora, mint, sunset, rose, neon, mono). The settings section is grouped into interface, theme, playback, links and spectrum, and carries favorites and history tables.
- [lilcandi/dsh-session-live](https://github.com/lilcandi/dsh-session-live) - Live preview inside the sidebar session hover card: what the session is doing right now (running tool with elapsed time, thinking, last tool duration), an attachment thumbnail with click-to-enlarge, the latest user prompt and assistant reply with injected system scaffolding stripped out, a recent-tool icon strip, turn count plus token totals plus model name on one line, and a 12-item settings page (11 switches plus a slider) persisted to the profile.
- [liliuCourier/dsh-chat-outline](https://github.com/liliuCourier/dsh-chat-outline) - Persistent conversation outline: per-turn questions and final replies, keyword filter, one-click jump, light/full history modes, and Ctrl/Shift+click to open the same position in the Trajectory view.
- [Limitinfinitude/DSH-Right-Sidebar](https://github.com/Limitinfinitude/DSH-Right-Sidebar) - DSH Web right-side output dock: session-scoped tabs for reports, images, data, video, and audio, with inline previews, output quality checks, and a searchable per-turn history.
- [linandadada-pixel/dsh-screenshot](https://github.com/linandadada-pixel/dsh-screenshot) - Native, instant region-screenshot button for the DeepSeek Harness composer: one click freezes the screen, a WeChat-style overlay (gray mask, green selection) appears, and the cropped PNG is inserted into the current draft. An optional eye toggle hides the whole DSH window before capturing, then restores it. No ms-screenclip, about 10 ms per drag frame, coexists with voice input. Windows 10/11 x64 only; the first capture compiles a helper with the built-in .NET Framework csc.exe.
- [linglanxin/dsh-feng-gu-lite](https://github.com/linglanxin/dsh-feng-gu-lite) - Offline Beijing-time peak/idle indicator below the conversation composer, with a 2026 calendar, uncertainty labels, and brief peak reminders; no API key or runtime network access required.
- [lingr7/dsh-reversed-chat](https://github.com/lingr7/dsh-reversed-chat) - Moves the composer to the top of an active conversation and renders the transcript plus the turn navigator newest-first, so replies appear right under the composer.
- [linhx1999/dsh-writing-pad](https://github.com/linhx1999/dsh-writing-pad) - Session-scoped Markdown writing pad docked beside the conversation, with edit/preview modes, selection-based AI rewrites, diff review, undo, and draft recovery.
- [LinJohn8/dsh-model-group-collapse](https://github.com/LinJohn8/dsh-model-group-collapse) - Makes the provider groups in the composer model menu collapsible, keeping only the provider of the current model expanded.
- [linkbag/dsh-capyreporter](https://github.com/linkbag/dsh-capyreporter) - Always-on-top capybara task reporter for DSH Web — a transparent floating pet that narrates each trajectory step in a speech bubble, names the project it reports for, and alerts you when a task completes while you work elsewhere.
- [linshufan21/dsh-boot-compass](https://github.com/linshufan21/dsh-boot-compass) - Desktop full-screen boot splash. It covers DSH's loading card before first paint, plays a 4.5 s five-stage compass sequence, then hands off to the app; clicking anywhere skips ahead, and reopening the window from the tray replays it. The first cold start may hitch once, then runs smoothly.
- [liqiGeGe/dsh-plugin-execution-graph](https://github.com/liqiGeGe/dsh-plugin-execution-graph) - Adds an Execution graph conversation-view tab that renders each turn's prompts, replies, and tool calls/results as a foldable timeline with a detail panel and PNG export.
- [liqiming-whu/dsh-status-card](https://github.com/liqiming-whu/dsh-status-card) - Adds a configurable dsh-ui status card before each DSH agent reply, with bilingual templates and a live settings preview. Requires @omdsh-dev/dsh-genui from dsh-market; without it, the card markup is emitted unrendered.
- [lisniuse/dsh-modal-enhancer](https://github.com/lisniuse/dsh-modal-enhancer) - Window-like controls for every Web UI modal: drag by title bar, eight-way resize, pin against outside clicks, maximize to the full viewport, removable backdrop blur, and per-dialog persistent state.
- [littleboylittlegirl/dsh-community-hot](https://github.com/littleboylittlegirl/dsh-community-hot) - Floating community panel for the Web UI: 24h hot topics and hot plugins TOP10 with a draggable, always-on-top button.
- [liu19666/dsh-model-block-picker](https://github.com/liu19666/dsh-model-block-picker) - Composer model selector grouped by provider: pick a provider card, then drill into that provider to choose a model, with cross-provider search and Reasoning Effort kept.
- [liu19666/dsh-screenshot](https://github.com/liu19666/dsh-screenshot) - Windows screenshot overlay: highlights the window, screen or taskbar under the cursor and dims the rest, then annotates (shapes, arrows, pen, text, mosaic) and drops the image into the composer without sending it.
- [liu3734/jira-tasks-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/liu3734/jira-tasks-dsh-plugin) - JIRA task panel under the DSH composer: per-workspace project key and optional JQL, listing the issues assigned to the current user with status, priority and issue-type chips, a total count, collapse and refresh, links to JIRA, plus a settings card for the base URL and token with a connection probe.
- [liudapeng0311/dsh-pwa-launcher](https://github.com/liudapeng0311/dsh-pwa-launcher) - Turns the browser PWA shortcut already on your desktop into a real launcher: it adopts that shortcut and keeps its icon, then starts dsh web silently on double-click and opens the app window; adds restart and dsh self-update (with rollback) controls to the web UI. Windows only.
- [liuhaolong16/dsh-quote-reply](https://github.com/liuhaolong16/dsh-quote-reply) - Keeps quotes out of the message body: quoting any passage from an assistant turn opens an editable quote tray above the composer, the quotes are injected into the next turn as system-prompt context (attributed with source and time), and an expandable quote row under that turn shows exactly which quotes were used. Quotes persist across page reloads and are claimed per turn; the host and client halves hand-shake on version and report a compatibility verdict.
- [liujia-io/dsh-image-picker](https://github.com/liujia-io/dsh-image-picker) - Adds a paperclip image-picker button to the conversation composer - pick reference images through the system file dialog and feed them straight into the official attachment pipeline (thumbnails, limit checks, upload with message).
- [liumorrisclaw/dsh-composer-input-history](https://github.com/liumorrisclaw/dsh-composer-input-history) - Recalls messages you already sent in the DSH composer with ArrowUp; ArrowDown walks forward, restores the draft you were writing, and one more press discards it and clears the composer.
- [liushQAQ/dsh-prompt-optimizer](https://github.com/liushQAQ/dsh-prompt-optimizer) - Smart prompt optimization & dynamic thinking effort adaptation with composer capsule, DSH/custom models, undo/re-optimize, and native settings.
- [liushuchang-2012/dsh-boot-splash](https://github.com/liushuchang-2012/dsh-boot-splash) - Boot film for the web UI: a blue whale floods black from below as the page loads, then glides left and pulls the | deepseek HARNESS wordmark out of itself before the app appears.
- [liuzwZYW/dsh-pwa-ui](https://github.com/liuzwZYW/dsh-pwa-ui) - Gives an installed dsh web app a native-looking window caption through Window Controls Overlay - the manifest route is served with display_override, the app's own sidebar brand row and session header become the drag region, and the app's own trailing controls are inset clear of the browser's caption chrome.
- [liwangzimo/dsh-calendar-diary](https://github.com/liwangzimo/dsh-calendar-diary) - A plain-notebook calendar in the DSH sidebar: a 70-day, Monday-first grid whose cells print that day's note; one note per day is stored in a .xlsx you choose, in the DesktopCal two-column layout (Excel date serial plus free text, newest date first). Clicking a day opens the editor for it, and import/export move that same format in and out, with a preview step and a conflict policy (keep, overwrite, concat or skip).
- [liweidong1722/dsh-work-list](https://github.com/liweidong1722/dsh-work-list) - Local-first DSH Web work checklist with rich-text notes, categories, folding, drag reordering, search, JSON import/export, and a restorable trash.
- [liyansong0015/dsh-sao-link-start](https://github.com/liyansong0015/dsh-sao-link-start) - Adds a configurable SAO-inspired full-screen startup animation to DeepSeek Harness.
- [liyuxuan20111101/dsh-ui-stronger](https://github.com/liyuxuan20111101/dsh-ui-stronger) - Calm monochrome UI with lavender accents, startup and switching motion, a thinking workspace, scoped skills, and optional local voice and pet connections.
- [lizilong1993/dsh-unlimited-effort](https://github.com/lizilong1993/dsh-unlimited-effort) - Composer infinity switch: while the highest reasoning effort is selected, one click appends a configurable notice to the system prompt.
- [lizixuan200410-cmd/dsh-ink-whale-leap](https://github.com/lizixuan200410-cmd/dsh-ink-whale-leap) - Plays a short ink-wash whale-leap animation over the DeepSeek Harness web UI when it loads, then fades out on its own.
- [lj100886/dsh-team-canvas](https://github.com/lj100886/dsh-team-canvas) - Renders an Agent Teams swimlane canvas above the composer: lead centred with members below, tasks laid out in lanes by longest dependency path, and four SVG connector families drawn as dashed paths (task dependency as a cubic bezier from the upstream card edge to the downstream card edge, lead bus, peer bus, member-to-task tether). Cards are absolutely positioned DOM, connectors are one SVG layer sharing the same geometry constants. Layout constants and path algorithms are ported from cc-haha. Reads the live per-session agentTeam projection (roster, shared tasks, dependency edges, running state) and falls back to the session todo list when the session has no team; team messages are not part of the projection yet, so the communication panel shows an empty state. Body colours come from host theme tokens; the eight member identity colours are the deliberate exception — fixed hues mixed with the theme accent via color-mix, declared as CSS variables because the same values feed an SVG stroke attribute that rejects colour functions. Ships zh/en dictionaries with identical keys.
- [ljxdsg12/dsh-composer-polish](https://github.com/ljxdsg12/dsh-composer-polish) - Adds a Polish button to the composer tool row right of the permission control: it reads the draft you have already typed, has the current model infer your intent and rewrite the draft into a clearer prompt, then turns the button into Cancel so one click restores the exact pre-polish text.
- [lk251066/dsh-tui-pro](https://github.com/lk251066/dsh-tui-pro) - A full-screen terminal workbench for DeepSeek Harness with a durable assistant, workspace-grouped project sessions, transcript-only scrolling, and structured thinking, tool, diff, plan, and subagent views.
- [Lkrain821/dsh-pixelwhale](https://github.com/Lkrain821/dsh-pixelwhale) - Turns the "deep diving" thinking status into a pixel font, with an animated pixel blue whale spouting and wagging its tail beside it.
- [lmmzss-jk/dsh-plugin-balance](https://github.com/lmmzss-jk/dsh-plugin-balance) - Balance and live session usage for the DSH web UI: header balance button (left of the Session log), dropdown with account balance, real-time token breakdown (cache miss/hit, cache write, output), cache hit rate, and official-rate cost estimates with peak/off-peak auto-switch.
- [lo2589/dsh-plugin-rightbar](https://github.com/lo2589/dsh-plugin-rightbar) - A shared right sidebar for the DSH web client — other plugins register tabs into the `rightbar.tab` slot instead of each pinning a `position:fixed` panel; ships a `rightbar-tab` skill for agents and an opt-in mode that moves legacy fixed panels aside.
- [loadingvx/deepseeh-harness-ultra-slash](https://github.com/loadingvx/deepseeh-harness-ultra-slash) - Separate slash-command group in the Web UI composer: /steer injects text on the agent's next step without interrupting the turn, /new starts a blank session, /skill and /docs wrap /steer with post-turn skill or docs tasks, and custom /steer aliases are configurable in Settings.
- [loadingvx/deepseek-harness-workbench-plugin](https://github.com/loadingvx/deepseek-harness-workbench-plugin) - Fills in the Web UI's missing IDE workbench: resizable chat / editor / files-and-Git columns in Conversation, multi-tab file editing with save and new-file, workspace Terminal, a file tree with name filter and open-in-external-editor, SCM (stage/commit/push/pull, branch switch, Git graph, inline diffs), a status bar, and git_* model tools.
- [lokih1028/dsh-plugin-canvas-pro](https://github.com/lokih1028/dsh-plugin-canvas-pro) - Adds a Canvas drawer and eight model tools to create, patch, version, and export HTML, Markdown, Mermaid, SVG, and React artifacts.
- [lokih1028/dsh-prompt-optimizer](https://github.com/lokih1028/dsh-prompt-optimizer) - One-click prompt enhancement and structuring button for DSH composer.
- [LonelyHerbivore/dsh-image-question#plugin](https://github.com/LonelyHerbivore/dsh-image-question/tree/main/plugin) - Ask the user a question about a local image; the DSH Web card offers zoom, pan, box, brush and lasso annotation, NG/OK/unsure verdicts and a note, and the agent receives annotations back in source-image pixel coordinates.
- [long6177/dsh-markdown-input](https://github.com/long6177/dsh-markdown-input) - Markdown live rendering for the DSH Web UI composer: typed Markdown (bold, lists, code fences) renders as you type in a CodeMirror-based takeover composer; sent user messages render as Markdown; pasted rich text becomes clean Markdown.
- [Lostforest7/dsh-revise](https://github.com/Lostforest7/dsh-revise) - Visual frontend revision workbench: point at a real page element, describe the change, send it into the current DSH session, then review fixed-viewport before/after screenshots (1280x800 and 390x844) beside a captured source diff, accepting each revision item by item. Revision records are kept per session under .dsh-revise/ and export as a single portable HTML report.
- [lov0vo/dsh-composer-autopair](https://github.com/lov0vo/dsh-composer-autopair) - Auto-pairs brackets and quotes in the DSH chat composer, inserting the closing half with the caret in between; it also wraps selected text with the typed pair and handles brackets committed by an IME.
- [LoveIrishCoffee/dsh-effort-ultra](https://github.com/LoveIrishCoffee/dsh-effort-ultra) - A native reasoning-effort control for the composer: a blue-to-violet tier bar with a starfield and a sheen sweep. It owns the model seat and drives the official model-directories service, so the ladder comes from each model's own reasoning declaration and no other plugin is required.
- [lovvvve/dsh-quick-actions#composer-quick-actions](https://github.com/lovvvve/dsh-quick-actions/tree/main/packages/composer-quick-actions) - Global Quick Actions beside every session-backed composer in DSH. One press sends a preset or your own saved text, with per-action send confirmation.
- [loyalchiiina/dsh-artifact-linker](https://github.com/loyalchiiina/dsh-artifact-linker) - Turns every file artifact the agent names in chat into a clickable entry — and refuses to paint one that does not resolve. Hover resolves asynchronously, and only a file that really exists becomes a hand pointer with a dashed blue outline (30 s TTL cache, so repeated hovers cost nothing); confirmed non-artifacts stay plain text and the right-click falls through to the host menu untouched. Left click reveals the file in Explorer already selected (Shell.Application Explore plus SelectItem with SVSI_ENSUREVISIBLE, so the pane scrolls to it; explorer.exe /select is deliberately not used because it silently drops the selection when an instance is already running). Right click offers seven actions: preview in DSH's built-in sidebar, open with the default app, reveal in Explorer, save as, copy the file itself to the clipboard, copy the absolute path, or insert the path into the composer. Ctrl or Shift with left click opens with the default app, Alt with left click copies the path. Names resolve through the absolute path, the session workspace and every profile workspace, then a cached basename index built with a depth budget, shrinking from the left when a mention swallows leading words. The host half also keeps six system-prompt rules resident, so absolute paths stay in tool arguments while the body shows only file names, and every route is loopback-only.
- [loyalchiiina/dsh-chat-image-lightbox](https://github.com/loyalchiiina/dsh-chat-image-lightbox) - Full-screen lightbox for chat images: click any image to open the full-resolution original with zoom (wheel, buttons, shortcuts), drag panning, prev/next paging, filename caption and download, plus keyboard-arrow and touch-swipe navigation. One "image display control" popover next to the composer collapses every image in the conversation into a thumbnail grid whose column count (1-12) is configurable and remembered, or hides them entirely so the space closes up and restores them later; images are styled in place and no node is ever moved or reparented. The host-side display_image tool takes a local path or directory (TIFF/HEIC transcoded, originals still saved on download), a remote URL, or a keyword search over Bing, Huaban and Sogou that samples loadability before picking a source, re-saves images blocked by hotlink protection and drops dead links after a magic-byte check, returning paste-ready Markdown. It also keeps a system-prompt rule that every delivered image must appear in the reply body as ![](…) markdown, because collapsed tool rows are invisible to the reader.
- [loyalchiiina/dsh-font-enhancer](https://github.com/loyalchiiina/dsh-font-enhancer) - DIY the DSH UI typography and colours: 10 built-in regions plus box-select region creation, each with its own Chinese and English font, size, line-height, weight (100-900), italic switch and text colour picker; 18 Chinese and 18 English fonts ship in the pickers, every region can be overridden by one unified setting, and named theme presets can be saved, applied, renamed and deleted. Random font assignment and random colour generation are available for the whole UI or per region, and 8 fonts (LXGW WenKai, Smiley Sans, ZCOOL KuaiLe, Comic Neue, Baloo 2, Fredoka, Nunito, Caveat) can be downloaded and installed with one click (only Comic Neue ships in the package) alongside your own .ttf/.otf files. An Aa floating ball opens the panel, position and settings persist, and the ball is shown or hidden from the DSH settings floating-ball section together with the other two balls, which share one 128-skin catalogue.
- [loyalchiiina/dsh-lobsterai-daddy](https://github.com/loyalchiiina/dsh-lobsterai-daddy) - Turns the LobsterDaddy multi-account console into a floating ball in the DSH window: drag it anywhere and the position persists, and the panel can be set to follow the ball. Clicking it slides out a drawer that renders the console as native DOM (no iframe) from the loopback-only same-origin proxy, showing action buttons, the account LobsterAI is currently signed in as, and a per-account list with balance, check-in state and last check-in time; a resizable persisted drawer, a live online/offline dot and an account-count badge are included.
- [loyalchiiina/dsh-skill-browser](https://github.com/loyalchiiina/dsh-skill-browser) - Browse the skill library from a floating-ball panel: you choose the skill root yourself through a native directory chooser (defaults to ~/.dsh/skills, no path is shipped with the plugin), skills are grouped into first and second level categories, descriptions are read from each SKILL.md frontmatter, search filters by skill name, description or original text, and a card opens the full SKILL.md. Skills can be switched on and off per card, per category or for the whole library — the toggle rewrites disable-model-invocation in that SKILL.md and keeps a .bak-toggle backup, and disabled cards grey out until restored. A failure ledger separates automatic from manual entries and records skill successes and failures by listening to tools/result events, reusing an existing ledger file if one is found in the library and otherwise creating one under skill-master/references. The DSH settings page gains a floating-ball section that shows or hides the three balls and offers one-click restore of a ball dragged off-screen.
- [loyalchiiina/dsh-todo-float-ball](https://github.com/loyalchiiina/dsh-todo-float-ball) - Draggable floating ball showing the current DSH session todo checklist live: done/total on its face (capsule mode adds the running task title), a matching progress ring, click to expand or fold the list, right-click for capsule mode, and state colours (pulsing orange in progress, green done, blue pending, grey empty). Replaced plans are archived as history rows that can be hidden, cleared and restored instead of counting towards progress, other sessions can be pinned side by side, and the data comes from the runtime sessions projection first with the official todo panel as a fallback — so the full list survives even when the official strip is collapsed. 128 shared skins (plus the 6 classic ones), Shadow DOM isolation, position remembered per profile, identical on desktop and web.
- [Lphehe/dsh-composer-assist](https://github.com/Lphehe/dsh-composer-assist) - DSH input assistant for next-message prediction, draft autocomplete (text completion), and prompt polishing/rewrite. Session-local suggestions; Tab accepts into the draft without sending. Requires a configured model; calls may incur charges. Source-available; modifications require prior written permission.
- [lrplrplrp/dsh-live2d](https://github.com/lrplrplrp/dsh-live2d) - A Live2D waifu plugin for DSH.
- [lsdt45/dsh-plan-plus](https://github.com/lsdt45/dsh-plan-plus) - Plan review enhancement for DeepSeek Harness Web: reply to the plan-review card inline to have the model revise the plan, and browse, compare, edit and archive every plan version in a full-screen overlay.
- [lsdt45/dsh-workspace-plus](https://github.com/lsdt45/dsh-workspace-plus) - Hierarchical workspace tree plus browser-style session tabs for the DSH sidebar: a "/" in a workspace or session title creates a virtual folder, with sections, pinning, time buckets, drag ordering, unified 6px status dots, per-row appearance customization (colour, glow, weight, icon) and a floating full-text search over session titles and message bodies. Several settings switches restore any behaviour to the host default, and a host-side route deletes sessions permanently (DSH ships archive only). Fork of KannaKuron/dsh-better-workspace.
- [lsh2002/dsh-custom-fonts](https://github.com/lsh2002/dsh-custom-fonts) - Customize the UI's Chinese and English fonts, code font, and global font-size offset on a settings page, with a live preview and one-click reset.
- [lsq-dsh-plugins/dsh-workbench-layout](https://github.com/lsq-dsh-plugins/dsh-workbench-layout) - Rearranges DSH Web into a three-column workbench with file editing, Git views, Markdown preview, and workspace terminals.
- [Luaphes/dsh-web-attention-badge](https://github.com/Luaphes/dsh-web-attention-badge) - Attention reminders: frame badge, tab-title count, and a status-colored whale favicon for sessions waiting for input or finished unopened.
- [lucas07814-hub/dsh-pet-guardian-dragon](https://github.com/lucas07814-hub/dsh-pet-guardian-dragon) - A draggable desktop pet for the DSH web interface with interactive actions and growth states.
- [lucky01222/dsh-workbench-shell](https://github.com/lucky01222/dsh-workbench-shell) - Compact 56px app navigation rail with a separate conversation list and sidebar collapse control for the DSH web UI; also hides embedding, rerank and image/video generation models from the chat model menu and /model.
- [LUgABeEEE/dsh-global-todo](https://github.com/LUgABeEEE/dsh-global-todo) - Global cross-session todo list in the sidebar that the person and the agent both write to: ten global_todo_* tools add, batch-capture, update, attach documents and links to, append progress notes to and complete items from any session, and each item can be handed to an agent session in one of four modes with the outcome recorded on the item. The list is a single JSON file.
- [LUgABeEEE/dsh-sidebar-density](https://github.com/LUgABeEEE/dsh-sidebar-density) - Lightweight sidebar UI for DeepSeek Harness: five fold switches, three density presets and three width presets, served from one footer row plus a settings section — no dependencies and no background service.
- [LUMIAO9527/DSH-suggestions](https://github.com/LUMIAO9527/DSH-suggestions) - Context-based next-message suggestions and draft rewriting for DeepSeek Harness, with candidate paging, shortcut recording, and companion MCP tools.
- [lumine-423/dsh-session-popout](https://github.com/lumine-423/dsh-session-popout) - Drag a session out of the DSH sidebar and it opens in its own native OS window, showing the full standard conversation UI (Markdown, toolbar, settings) with only the sidebar trimmed away, so several sessions can be watched side by side instead of switching back and forth. Windows verified; macOS and Linux untested. Runs in the DSH desktop app (Electron).
- [Luminet-LT/dsh-inapp-chat](https://github.com/Luminet-LT/dsh-inapp-chat) - Adds a sidebar entry that opens DeepSeek web chat in an in-app window for quick questions while working. Fork of zerorigin-studio/dsh-deepseek-chat (already listed); it uses its own settings namespace, so both can coexist. Needs the desktop bridge (window.dsh.desktop.openWindow).
- [lumoping/dsh-todo-inbox](https://github.com/lumoping/dsh-todo-inbox) - Global cross-session todo inbox for DSH web: any session's agent records human-action todos (merge MRs, approve work orders, reviews) via inbox_add/inbox_done/inbox_list; a sidebar entry shows a count badge and an expandable list to open and complete them, persisted to ~/.dsh/todo-inbox.json.
- [Lushdawn/dsh-effort-dial](https://github.com/Lushdawn/dsh-effort-dial) - Codex-style reasoning-effort card for the composer: takes over the model selector and shows the current level, the model row and a segmented slider over the model's own adapter-provided levels, with a model list, a reset, and a purple aurora with twinkling particles at the maximum level.
- [LUX09947-CMYK/dsh-re](https://github.com/LUX09947-CMYK/dsh-re) - Adds a refresh button to the DeepSeek Harness desktop title bar next to the Edit menu, reloading the interface without restarting the app.
- [luxi233/dsh-settings-nav-scroll](https://github.com/luxi233/dsh-settings-nav-scroll) - Adds a visible vertical scrollbar to the DSH Web settings navigation when its sections exceed the viewport.
- [luyiheng1111/dsh-context-window-picker](https://github.com/luyiheng1111/dsh-context-window-picker) - Adds a session-scoped context window selector next to the reasoning-effort row in the DeepSeek Harness model popup: a pill showing the effective window opens a dropdown of presets below the model default, the choice applies to the next request of that session only, and a new session falls back to the profile default. It writes no config file and appends nothing to the session log.
- [LWLAymh/dsh-tool-emoji](https://github.com/LWLAymh/dsh-tool-emoji) - Replace tool-card leading icons with emoji while preserving the original cards.
- [lxj5820/dsh-boot-animation](https://github.com/lxj5820/dsh-boot-animation) - Replaces the kernel boot page with a full-window video clip that dissolves into the app; the clip pool, enter mode and fade length are configurable in Settings → Plugins.
- [ly14278/dsh-prompt-brief](https://github.com/ly14278/dsh-prompt-brief) - Adds an Optimize button to the composer that rewrites a one-line idea into a structured product brief: a positioning sentence, 3–6 key features, visual references and design tokens; it sits beside your original text in a compare dialog where you can accept it into the input, generate another version, or cancel and keep the draft untouched. No settings page and no API keys — it calls the model channel you already configured.
- [LyaxZ/dsh-fonttune](https://github.com/LyaxZ/dsh-fonttune) - A font plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: the conversation gets its own font, size, line height, weight, tracking, word gap, paragraph gap and first-line indent, the interface font follows it, code keeps its own axis with ligature control; light and dark can each hold their own set, whole setups save as presets, and a floating panel puts every axis a dot away.
- [LyaxZ/dsh-goodies](https://github.com/LyaxZ/dsh-goodies) - Effort slider in the model menu, a live tokens-per-second and turn-total readout beside the running status, a per-answer input/output/cached report, and a completion notification when a turn finishes, for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
- [LyaxZ/dsh-quick-toc](https://github.com/LyaxZ/dsh-quick-toc) - Conversation outline for DeepSeek Harness: the Markdown headings of the whole session, grouped by turn, in a side panel or a full-width curtain; hover previews can be pinned for comparison, bookmarks keep the places you come back to, and a right-click jumps to a section or copies a heading and the levels below it. Six theme colours and a translucent material, title/prompt/full-text/cross-session search, reading-position follow and a Chinese/English interface.
- [lyhue1991/dsh-soup](https://github.com/lyhue1991/dsh-soup) - Project file explorer in the details column (multi-select, drag-move, upload, download, rename, trash, system-open) with an in-session read-only preview tab for Markdown/HTML/JSON/CSV/notebook/PDF + code highlighting, a live model throughput badge, and a multiline GoalBar.
- [lyonleeeee/dsh-steer](https://github.com/lyonleeeee/dsh-steer) - Adds a live status badge to the session header and delivers guidance added mid-task without interrupting the turn.
- [lyx0717/dsh-washer](https://github.com/lyx0717/dsh-washer) - Renders DeepSeek Harness session state as a washing machine: a desktop floating widget animates live session activity, with three skins (precision, anime, pixel). The overlay offers two sizes, optional click-through, and follows the host app's dark mode. Settings live inside the DSH UI.
- [Lzh3070/dsh-file-review-tab](https://github.com/Lzh3070/dsh-file-review-tab) - Review agent file changes as a dsh-better-sidebar sidebar tab or chat turn-tail row — line-level diffs and undo.
- [lzpway-jpg/dsh-plugin-brand-custom](https://github.com/lzpway-jpg/dsh-plugin-brand-custom) - Custom brand icon and name for the DSH Web sidebar and conversation hero, editable live from a settings card on the plugin detail page.

- [Martlet-Tech/dsh-open-folder-fix](https://github.com/Martlet-Tech/dsh-open-folder-fix) - Fixes the Windows workspace-open action. The shipped opener runs `explorer.exe "<file:// URI>"`, which on some hosts reports success without raising a window — the exit-code verdict cannot tell an opened window from nothing happening. This routes that one action to `explorer.exe /e,<dir>`, which raises a window reliably, and leaves every other application in the menu on the shipped path.

A pill on the top edge of the composer shows the preview, the sent message shows the same pill, and clicking either opens the whole paste in a side panel with a copy button. Pure in memory: nothing is written to disk and no token is saved.

- [NanQing233/dsh-rimlight](https://github.com/NanQing233/dsh-rimlight) - Adds a comet-like light band that flows along the window edge of DeepSeek Harness — up to four in parallel, colored by each session's model, reversing direction while waiting for your reply, and returning to the composer or the workspace once the conversation ends.
- [nanshang328/dsh-power](https://github.com/nanshang328/dsh-power) - Windows-only power card injected into the DSH page: the artwork carries two hit zones (left shuts down, right restarts), the first click only turns the card into a yes/no question and the second click fires, and the restart engine stops only this instance's process tree, waits for the port to free, relaunches outside the host's Job Object and confirms the new instance answers on the plugin's own status route.
- [NativeDog1/dsh-boot-animation](https://github.com/NativeDog1/dsh-boot-animation) - Plays an intro full-frame on a new conversation, or every time you open the one you pinned. Four clips ship inside the plugin itself — embedded in code, with no separate video files — and an in-app library switches between them, previews the choice, and accepts your own clip. The pin button sits beside Settings.
- [Natsubrei/dsh-comfyui-panel](https://github.com/Natsubrei/dsh-comfyui-panel) - The real ComfyUI editor as a sidebar tab in DeepSeek Harness, with per-session tools that read and edit the graph on screen and a panel that can start, stop and restart ComfyUI without installing anything into it.
- [Natsubrei/dsh-mermaid-panel](https://github.com/Natsubrei/dsh-mermaid-panel) - Renders the open conversation's Mermaid diagrams as a right-sidebar page, one card per diagram, each clickable to open full screen with zoom and pan; the chat's own code block is left untouched, so copying or quoting the source still works.
- [NattoCB/dsh-plugin-pin-session](https://github.com/NattoCB/dsh-plugin-pin-session) - Adds Pin/Unpin to the sidebar session-row menu and a collapsible Pinned Sessions group above the session list, with host-side persistence, hover quick-unpin, collapse memory, and live running-state dots.
- [NattoCB/dsh-plugin-sidebar-views](https://github.com/NattoCB/dsh-plugin-sidebar-views) - Adds a Workspaces / Recent-sessions switcher above the sidebar list, with a pinned-sessions group, a per-row menu (pin/unpin, copy session id), title filtering, and browser-local pin storage with a one-shot migration from dsh-plugin-pin-session.
- [NattoCB/dsh-widget-center](https://github.com/NattoCB/dsh-widget-center) - Native macOS desktop widgets for DSH: manage any number of widget instances — share quote tickers (5-provider fallback, trading-phase-aware throttling) and notes memos — each an independent NSPanel+WKWebView window spawned detached from the host, dragged anywhere, with a type-aware right-click menu. Instances are edited as cards in a three-view settings page (list / type picker / detail), and a market_quote model tool serves standardized quotes to any session. A Type Studio flow seeds a creation-mode session with an issue-template prompt for authoring new widget types.
- [NecromanAlbert/dsh-show-media](https://github.com/NecromanAlbert/dsh-show-media) - Shows a local image or short video in the current conversation card, with click-to-preview.
- [neobones/dsh-locale-es-cl](https://github.com/neobones/dsh-locale-es-cl) - Adds Chilean Spanish (es-CL) to the Web UI language list: 2,603 strings across 57 namespaces, with per-key fallback to English.
- [NeoXider/neoxider-agent-deck#dsh-agent-deck](https://github.com/NeoXider/neoxider-agent-deck/tree/main/integrations/dsh-agent-deck) - Opens the NeoXider Agent Deck desktop widget (chat, the slime pet avatar or the hinge handle) from a Harness session, and reports its mode, installed version, running state and whether it follows the same Harness.
- [Neptune810/dsh-power-button](https://github.com/Neptune810/dsh-power-button) - Adds a draggable power pill to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: a live status dot plus restart and stop actions, where restart is handed to a detached helper that resumes the same boot invocation once the port is released.
- [Nethur-auro/dsh-multi-root-explorer](https://github.com/Nethur-auro/dsh-multi-root-explorer) - Replaces the sidebar workspace region with a two-tab browser: several workspace roots stay registered side by side while conversations are filed under the real working directory of each session, with a read-only resource tree that previews files in the right sidebar. Hiding is per tab, display-only and fully reversible; a resource folder or file can be copied as a path or dragged into the composer as a native reference, and @ completion covers every registered root rather than the working directory alone.
- [Neumannzc/dsh-archive-manager#plugin](https://github.com/Neumannzc/dsh-archive-manager/tree/main/plugin) - Beautified archive-manager settings section listing archived sessions grouped by workspace, with a hover unarchive action and relative timestamps.
- [NICEGSP/call-map](https://github.com/NICEGSP/call-map) - Adds a conversation view that maps which skills, MCP tools and subagents a session actually used, with an attribution tree, a call table and an unused inventory.
- [Nicercz007-cloud/schedule](https://github.com/Nicercz007-cloud/schedule) - Three draggable, resizable, auto-positioning floating desktop widgets for DSH Desktop — daily schedule, goals tracker, and calendar planner.
- [nickkkkkk123123/dsh-whale-girl](https://github.com/nickkkkkk123123/dsh-whale-girl) - Interactive whale-girl desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: live balance/usage/context occupancy, slingshot toss, easter-egg bubbles, eco mode. 346KB package, zero extra processes.
- [nickzhangcomes/dsh-markup](https://github.com/nickzhangcomes/dsh-markup) - Review DeepSeek Harness responses with inline annotations, document reading, comment threads, and text revisions, then bring a reading summary back to the main conversation.
- [nico-zhuang/dsh-chat-file-actions](https://github.com/nico-zhuang/dsh-chat-file-actions) - Open and copy local files and web links from a chat turn.
- [nico-zhuang/dsh-nav-fold](https://github.com/nico-zhuang/dsh-nav-fold) - Collapses global sidebar navigation into an icon grid with inline name hints, animated transitions, and drag-to-reorder.
- [Nihao7-L/dsh-prompt-chain](https://github.com/Nihao7-L/dsh-prompt-chain) - One-click prompt rewriting in the composer with up to 5 continue rounds, two regenerate modes, automatic version history with jump-back, line-by-line diff, and a customisable button icon.
- [nikoart-liu/dsh-open-in-x](https://github.com/nikoart-liu/dsh-open-in-x) - Open DSH workspace directories in installed file managers, terminals, and supported editors from the Web UI.
- [ninepoin4/dsh-rich-cards](https://github.com/ninepoin4/dsh-rich-cards) - Renders the final fenced card block of an answer as a typographic card, with card and article layouts, twelve block types and credited images.
- [ninglovegithub/dsh-workspace-combiner](https://github.com/ninglovegithub/dsh-workspace-combiner) - Multi-workspace manager: bind a docs anchor plus ordered code-project repositories into one session, injecting their absolute paths, a recursive file index, a server/client endpoint index and optional coding standards, and syncing writable directories into the sandbox.
- [NingTiAn-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui](https://github.com/NingTiAn-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui) - Offline-replayable charts and interactive explanations in DSH rc.2 Web chat, with optional AMap itineraries, confirmed follow-ups, and HTML export.
- [NingTiAn-byte/dsh-linked-workspaces](https://github.com/NingTiAn-byte/dsh-linked-workspaces) - Link local project directories from a project context menu, with scoped search, source reading and explicit per-session snapshot synchronization. Supports DSH 0.2.1-alpha.4 and 0.2.1-rc.2 only.
- [NingYuanLee/dsh-image-viewer-pro](https://github.com/NingYuanLee/dsh-image-viewer-pro) - In-chat image viewer for the web UI: takes over content image clicks (Markdown images, message attachments rendered as blob: URLs, and read_image results) and opens a dialog with pointer-centered wheel zoom and an editable percentage, drag pan, 90° rotation, download with progress, copy as PNG, open with the default app, and ←/→ gallery browsing across the conversation.
- [nirvanaslash/dsh-artifact-preview](https://github.com/nirvanaslash/dsh-artifact-preview) - Adds a produced-files card row to the chat and a resizable split-screen preview panel for workspace artifacts (Markdown, source code, CSV, JSON, images, HTML), plus a localhost port preview.
- [Nishikinov/dsh-sidebar-settings-button](https://github.com/Nishikinov/dsh-sidebar-settings-button) - Adds a Settings row to the sidebar header before Plugins, which opens the shell's Settings panel.
- [Nixz0824/dsh-composer-alcove](https://github.com/Nixz0824/dsh-composer-alcove) - Collapses the composer to an iPhone-style home indicator while you scroll, then restores it on hover, click, or scroll up. Corner arcs dock the real composer into the left or right gutter.
- [nnnanann/Deepseek-harness-freeze-content-on-window-resize](https://github.com/nnnanann/Deepseek-harness-freeze-content-on-window-resize) - Freezes the DSH Web GUI reading column at a fixed width and re-aligns the reading position after the window is resized or zoomed.
- [NoCandles/dsh-stock-bar](https://github.com/NoCandles/dsh-stock-bar) - Always-on quotes strip pinned to the top of the DSH window: watchlist, holdings with share counts and cost price, P&L, candlestick and intraday charts, 5-level order book, trade ledger, price alerts, and streamed AI review of the selected symbol.
- [NOirBRight/dsh-codex-sidebar](https://github.com/NOirBRight/dsh-codex-sidebar) - Codex-style details sidebar for DSH with Files, Review, Browser, and Terminal panes, transcript file links and diff stats, annotations, and Host-managed browser controls.
- [NOirBRight/dsh-llm-assistant](https://github.com/NOirBRight/dsh-llm-assistant) - Resident Web overlay seat with its own assistant session: chat, images, reminders, a duty heartbeat, and on-demand read-only task reference.
- [NOirBRight/dsh-llm-providers-ui](https://github.com/NOirBRight/dsh-llm-providers-ui) - Mounted owner of the LLM Providers Settings page: provider cards, drag-reorder card order, and picker sort.
- [NONEMIN/dsh-sidebar-panels](https://github.com/NONEMIN/dsh-sidebar-panels) - Manage the left global panel list from Settings → General: show or hide entries, reorder them by dragging in the sidebar or in the dialog, and keep entries that have their own sidebar switch in step with it.
- [NormanFxxkingRockwell/dsh-keyboard-history](https://github.com/NormanFxxkingRockwell/dsh-keyboard-history) - Minimal ↑/↓ input history for the DSH web composer: press ↑/↓ to walk back through sent messages. Nothing else.
- [Nothree-code/folder-tree-sh](https://github.com/Nothree-code/folder-tree-sh) - Workspace file tree for the Web UI: multi-tab preview (text/DOCX/PDF/Markdown/CSV/images), inline Markdown editing, a Git changes panel, and file operations (rename/delete/copy/move/create) via context menu.
- [null-dat/dsh-whale-tail](https://github.com/null-dat/dsh-whale-tail) - Four whale-tail animations for the DeepSeek Harness thinking indicator, cycling on every thinking turn.
- [Num86/dsh-functions](https://github.com/Num86/dsh-functions) - Adds an extensible Functions menu to the DSH top bar, where plugins register one-click actions with staged confirmations and submenus. Since 0.4.0 it bundles a built-in "Restart DSH" action, so no separate restart plugin is needed.
- [objectivex666/dsh-settings-search](https://github.com/objectivex666/dsh-settings-search) - Instantly find DSH settings pages, tabs and rows by keyword, pinyin, intent or AI — and jump straight to them.
- [Odefined/dsh-mobile-webui](https://github.com/Odefined/dsh-mobile-webui) - Mobile-viewport fixes for the dsh web GUI: overlay drawer sidebar with swipe gestures, icon-only composer with a mode · model · effort status line, centered popovers, and horizontal-overflow/scrollbar centering fixes.
- [oioiphainon/dsh-widget](https://github.com/oioiphainon/dsh-widget) - A transparent always-on-top desktop fish that mirrors the current DSH session - turn, step, tool calls, todos, background jobs and team tasks - with optional login autostart, an option to stay after DSH exits, and a right-click hide. Windows only.
- [omdsh-dev/dsh-annotation](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-annotation) - Select text → annotate → send with your message; replies map back to each annotation.
- [omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar) - Full sidebar workbench with file rendering and editing, terminal, Git, and subagents; third-party plugins can register new tabs.
- [omdsh-dev/dsh-genui](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-genui) - Interactive UI components rendered inline in replies: layout, charts, forms, quizzes, mermaid, 3D scenes, and an action event loop back to the model.
- [omdsh-dev/ex-setting](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/ex-setting) - Settings extensions for DSH.
- [omdsh-dev/web-components](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/web-components) - Web Components support.
- [OnTheWay111/dsh-plugin-path-completion](https://github.com/OnTheWay111/dsh-plugin-path-completion) - Completes @path references in the Web composer: type @ (optionally ./src/ma) to list matching files and directories, pick one with the arrow keys, and the draft receives an @./relative/path reference (quoted when the path has spaces).
- [OolongBlackCoffee/dsh-wuwa-pet](https://github.com/OolongBlackCoffee/dsh-wuwa-pet) - Puts a WuwaTappo desktop pet's bubbles to work: shows the DeepSeek balance, today's spend and a per-turn cost bubble, and keeps an amber reminder bubble up while the agent waits for an answer or an approval. Talks to the pet over CDP, enabling its debug port with a one-time, revertible byte patch.
- [openAGFS/dsh-agfs](https://github.com/openAGFS/dsh-agfs) - File-browser web app for DSH: React frontend and REST API served by the host webserver, a /dsh-agfs command that opens at the current session workspace, and a browse_files model tool.
- [opencues/opencues#integrations-dsh](https://github.com/opencues/opencues/tree/master/integrations/dsh) - Word alternatives and underscore-gated fill-ins in the composer. End a line with _ and it is filled; misspellings are flagged as you type. Routes through the model dsh is already configured with, so it needs no API key.
- [openma-ai/Martty#npm](https://github.com/openma-ai/Martty/tree/main/npm) - A DSH-first Rust/ratatui agent TUI with streamed tool calls, subagents, durable sessions, and a Cordis-extensible client UI.
- [OrderG-X/dsh-design-studio](https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-design-studio) - Design workbench in the right sidebar. When the model builds web pages, app screens, posters, slides or emails, each HTML file shows up as a screen on a canvas inside a device frame and refreshes when the file changes; local dev servers are proxied with hot reload intact. Click an element or drag a region to put its selector, source file and styles into the composer. Also has a design tokens panel, nine style presets, a style panel (font size, colors, radius, padding and more) that writes back to the HTML or hands the change to the model together with the CSS rule and line behind each property, versions saved before and after each turn with drag-to-compare and restore, export to images, PDF and PPTX (links between screens stay clickable), a LAN QR link for viewing on a phone, link arrows and a click-through demo mode, a multi-size view, in-place text editing, reference-image palettes, and a design check (overflowing, clipped or overlapping text, contrast, tap target size and more). Bundles a ui-design skill and three tools: preview_page opens a preview; check_design measures every screen at real sizes in a hidden local Chrome or Edge (bars covering content, script errors, missing assets, dead links; CSS file and line for contrast and font-size issues; cropped screenshots of serious problems); look_design hands real screenshots to the model. Adds a Design mode for new sessions (Standard mode's tools plus the skill, the three tools and a design persona); each part has its own switch on the Plugins page. When DSH is opened from a phone or another computer, local-file designs are bundled into a sandboxed frame so they still show.
- [OrderG-X/dsh-video-preview](https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-video-preview) - Plays local video and audio inside the conversation. Media files the model writes during a turn - screen recordings, transcodes, voiceovers - get a player under its final reply automatically when their paths appear in its commands, the command output or the reply; the play_video tool plays any other file. Video shows as compact cards with a hover preview, audio as a slim seek bar, streamed over HTTP Range so long files seek instead of loading into memory. Also registers a sidebar media preview renderer, since the built-in previewer treats mp4 as unviewable. The look_video tool lets the model see a video itself: a hidden local Chrome or Edge grabs frames into a time-labelled contact sheet (or big frames at given times, or a short range frame by frame), checks the audio (silence, too quiet, clipping, one channel only) and the picture (black or frozen frames), and reads MP4 / MOV headers for phone compatibility (codec, HDR, faststart and more), with ffmpeg fixes.
- [orphiczhou/dsh-region-probe](https://github.com/orphiczhou/dsh-region-probe) - A read-only Cordis Inspect provider that lets an agent see the interface it is driving: outline() reports which UI regions the running shell actually rendered, with occupancy, geometry and current or past failure state; snapshot() returns one region's rendered node tree (tag, role, aria-label, own text, geometry, computed styles) addressed by slot key or CSS selector; failures() keeps a history of regions that failed to render and whether they recovered. Regions are addressed by the anchor the shell already writes for every slot, so it needs no region list and covers regions added later or contributed by other plugins. No UI, no tools, no dependencies, no network access.
- [orphiczhou/dsh-session-tree](https://github.com/orphiczhou/dsh-session-tree) - Replaces the left sidebar session list with a tree of every session and its nested subagent descendants, with click-through to each conversation's multi-turn history and a tree_send tool for messaging any continuable session anywhere in the tree.
- [oumaekumiko0821/dsh-splash-gojo](https://github.com/oumaekumiko0821/dsh-splash-gojo) - Full-screen boot animation for the DSH web client: the boot HTML paints a cover-fit artwork on its first frame, adds a slow settle, a scanning light sweep and a progress HUD, then hands the viewport over when the app mounts. Click or press Esc / space / Enter to skip.
- [overact/dsh-statusline-plus](https://github.com/overact/dsh-statusline-plus) - Displays account quotas, Git state, context usage, public API reference costs, Subagent activity, and streaming speed in DeepSeek Harness Web.
- [oxlyn/dsh-flyout-sidebar](https://github.com/oxlyn/dsh-flyout-sidebar) - Flyout sidebar with a file tree, uncommitted-changes list and multi-tab file/diff previews; pops out into a standalone browser tab.
- [Oxygen-Wang/dsh-cursorlike-sidebar](https://github.com/Oxygen-Wang/dsh-cursorlike-sidebar) - A Cursor-like sidebar for DeepSeek Harness with file browsing, code editing, Git diffs, terminal, side chat, and Ctrl+L references.
- [oxygenforce/dsh-agent-activity](https://github.com/oxygenforce/dsh-agent-activity) - Live done/now/next card above the composer while the agent is still working.
- [OZONGO/dsh-keyboard-shortcut](https://github.com/OZONGO/dsh-keyboard-shortcut) - Adds a Keyboard Shortcuts page to the DSH Settings panel with six rebindable commands — permission-mode cycling, reasoning-effort stepping, a status-page and a task-list shortcut — plus PgUp/PgDn input navigation and an optional composer Enter remap.
- [p56568833/dsh-plugin-groups](https://github.com/p56568833/dsh-plugin-groups) - Category tabs (All, Appearance & UI, Usage & account and more) for the Installed list on the Plugins page, remembering the chosen tab; patch plugins named in an editable parent table are indented under the plugin they patch. Display-only, writes no files.
- [Paimonshen/dsh-coding-plugin](https://github.com/Paimonshen/dsh-coding-plugin) - Coding-learn floating panel: edits and runs Python/JavaScript/TypeScript/PowerShell with exit code and timing, grades JSON course lessons with progress export, keeps Markdown notes and snippet library, and sends code plus a question into the current conversation for the main model to answer.
- [panando/dsh-prompt-optimizer](https://github.com/panando/dsh-prompt-optimizer) - One-button prompt optimizer: rewrites the composer draft via a configurable strategy, with an editable template, few-shot examples, pinned models and reasoning effort.
- [panando/dsh-quote-sidechat](https://github.com/panando/dsh-quote-sidechat) - Select text in a reply and quote it into the composer as an atomic reference chip: delete the whole chip in one keystroke, click it to scroll back and highlight the quoted turn, and expand it into a bounded reference block at send time so the model can tell the quote apart from what the user typed. Also opens the snippet in a side chat, or copies it to the clipboard.
- [PangXitong/dsh-restart-button](https://github.com/PangXitong/dsh-restart-button) - Power button in the DSH Web UI session header that lets you close or restart the whole DSH process.
- [PaoMoXML/dsh-paste-names](https://github.com/PaoMoXML/dsh-paste-names) - Paste non-image files or folders into the chat composer as native @path references, or drag them in as absolute paths, instead of the images-only error.
- [Pasumao/dsh-plugin-workbench](https://github.com/Pasumao/dsh-plugin-workbench) - Adds a VS Code-style workspace file explorer to the dsh web GUI: file tree, editable preview with syntax highlighting, tabs, line numbers, right-click file operations, and inline image preview.
- [pc439527/dsh-model-provider](https://github.com/pc439527/dsh-model-provider) - Provider-first three-level model selector for the DSH Web model seat: pick a provider, then a model from that provider, with inline search on both levels, failed-provider retry rows, and a Model · Provider trigger.
- [pc439527/dsh-side-monitor](https://github.com/pc439527/dsh-side-monitor) - Sidebar system monitor for the DSH Web UI: live host overview (CPU/memory/network/disk), process list, and Docker container status, all read-only.
- [penguin-oo/dsh-pathlink](https://github.com/penguin-oo/dsh-pathlink) - Ctrl+click file paths and links in chat: paths open their folder in the OS file manager (with the file selected), links open in a new browser tab.
- [pengyue-polaron/deepseek-harness-genui](https://github.com/pengyue-polaron/deepseek-harness-genui) - Code-first React and TypeScript task apps rendered inline, in Canvas, full screen, or on localhost, with interaction state available to later agent turns and approval-gated MCP and API access.
- [perdakovich/dsh-prompt-edit](https://github.com/perdakovich/dsh-prompt-edit) - In-place prompt editing in the web chat: cleanly forks session history at the edited turn, preserves image and file attachments, and auto-archives the superseded branch.
- [PerryLink/dsh-community-bench](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-community-bench) - Adds a Community Bench tab that reads the public task-conditioned registry and shows the same score everyone sees; it does not compute a local score.

- [ph4310822/dsh-edex-jarvis-ui#bundle](https://github.com/ph4310822/dsh-edex-jarvis-ui/tree/main/packages/bundle) - JARVIS-style sci-fi HUD shell over the DSH web GUI: electric-cyan VITAL SIGNS / RT-MONITOR / RT-LOG left bar, POWER CORE gauges and a rotating RADAR scan disc on the right with up/down traffic chart, filesystem browser with file preview, and a terminal-styled composer with a JARVIS header strip that follows the active workspace.
- [ph4310822/dsh-edex-ui#bundle](https://github.com/ph4310822/dsh-edex-ui/tree/main/packages/bundle) - eDEX-UI-style shell over the DSH web GUI: system-telemetry left bar with per-core CPU sparklines, encom-globe world-map right bar with up/down traffic chart, filesystem browser with file preview, and a terminal-styled composer that follows the active workspace.
- [Phant0Meow/dsh-meow-smooth](https://github.com/Phant0Meow/dsh-meow-smooth) - Mobile-first UX polish for the DSH Web UI: composer auto-fold, enter-as-newline on phones, compact sidebar/header/settings, zoom and overscroll lock, plus approval/question/completion notifications via in-page cards, Web Push, and webhook — zero dsh changes.
- [Phoeky/dsh-refresh-plugin](https://github.com/Phoeky/dsh-refresh-plugin) - Adds F5 / Ctrl+R page reload to the DeepSeek Harness desktop web UI, which production builds lack by default (the "Reload Page" menu item and bare-F5 accelerator are development-gated). Binds soft reload (F5, Ctrl+R) and cache-busted hard reload (F5 with a modifier, Ctrl+Shift+R, appending a _dsh_refresh timestamp) through a capture-phase client key listener.
- [Physicolor/dsh-lifeline](https://github.com/Physicolor/dsh-lifeline) - Right-side message navigation rail for DeepSeek Harness: per-message tick marks, hover-to-expand preview drawer, smooth jump to any historical message, star bookmarks, realtime slide animation with interrupt support, full session index with virtualization, dynamic panel avoidance, official --dsw-* token styling.
- [Physicolor/dsh-ui-harmonizer](https://github.com/Physicolor/dsh-ui-harmonizer) - UI harmonizer for DeepSeek Harness: normalizes unfinished or self-contradictory official UI, reconciles style conflicts between installed plugins, and unifies the visual language via official design tokens — with live-customizable chat width, markdown font size, workspace scale, UI font stack and a rounded center-column card from Settings → General; client-only dsh bundle, zero model cost, no host side, removable without residue.
- [Physicolor/dsh-widgets](https://github.com/Physicolor/dsh-widgets) - A customizable widget rail for the right side of DeepSeek Harness: 61 cards covering session stats, tokens and cache, context, background jobs, subagents, machine metrics, OpenCode Go and Command Code quota, session cost, peak pricing and the GitHub review queue. Cards install from an in-rail market into 1-4 column grids and 2x2 or 2x4 tiles, with per-instance settings, a magnification wave under the pointer and a one-click hide. Works on DSH 0.1.x and 0.2.x, web UI and desktop app.
- [picklerick422/dsh-conv-progress](https://github.com/picklerick422/dsh-conv-progress) - Live per-turn progress capsule with an empirical ETA table and a click-to-open turn history, docked under the composer.
- [picklerick422/dsh-motion](https://github.com/picklerick422/dsh-motion) - Popup and overlay motion for DeepSeek Harness: spring clip-morph entrances for nearby popups, fade-up far dialogs, coherent hover bubbles, image-zoom FLIP, and a live-preview settings page.
- [pingg02/dsh-plugins#dsh-desktop-entry](https://github.com/pingg02/dsh-plugins/tree/main/dsh-desktop-entry) - Creates a Windows desktop shortcut that starts DeepSeek Harness when needed and opens the Web UI in a Chrome or Edge app window.
- [pingg02/dsh-plugins#dsh-quote-selection](https://github.com/pingg02/dsh-plugins/tree/main/dsh-quote-selection) - Lets users quote selected conversation text with optional notes, then attaches the references to their next message.
- [plolpl789/dsh-raw-html](https://github.com/plolpl789/dsh-raw-html) - Renders agent HTML output as real UI in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, with visual cards, KaTeX math, Mermaid diagrams, built-in open-source fonts, and design-spec injection.
- [plyflai/dsh-ux-plus](https://github.com/plyflai/dsh-ux-plus) - A UX enhancement pack for the DSH web chat: one plugin that collects small interface conveniences, each with its own switch under Settings → UX Plus applied immediately — chat-area font size and reading width under Settings → General → Chat area, a session-row menu that copies the session ID or inherits the conversation into a new session on a chosen model, workspace and session rows ordered by recent activity with 24-hour idle auto-collapse and age labels, and settled ask_user_question cards left expanded. The switch list is generated from its own feature registry, so the pack grows as conveniences are added instead of being fixed at a count.
- [pomelo-ccc/dsh-pi-composer](https://github.com/pomelo-ccc/dsh-pi-composer) - Swaps the composer's model control for a PI-Desktop style picker: a two-pane menu with search and provider grouping, a reasoning-effort slider, ArrowUp/ArrowDown prompt-history recall, and a prompt-rewrite button with undo.
- [PPsz-qqq/dsh-restart-button](https://github.com/PPsz-qqq/dsh-restart-button) - Restart button at the right end of the session header that restarts the whole client: the Windows desktop app (Electron shell and Host, through the Host's own graceful shutdown) or the dsh web server. It can wait until running turns and background jobs finish, reopens the open session afterwards with one-click continue for interrupted sessions, flags plugin updates that only take effect after a restart, and shows Host uptime and memory on hover.
- [prettyfox/dsh-selection-quote-auto](https://github.com/prettyfox/dsh-selection-quote-auto) - Copies selected assistant text to the clipboard and shows a Comment chip that opens the inline comment box in DeepSeek Harness; the right-click quote menu and Cmd+L still work.
- [prgrmrwy/dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon](https://github.com/prgrmrwy/dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon) - DeepSeek Harness plugin: show a provider + model icon in the sidebar for every session, updated live from the composer model selector with a last-request fallback for history sessions; aggregator routes render the provider logo with a 10px model logo in the corner.
- [psychiiii/dsh-three-window#personal-web](https://github.com/psychiiii/dsh-three-window/tree/publish/packages/personal-web) - Three-window workbench for dsh web: chat, construct, and a read-only review window side by side for each workspace, per-window hooks, and an anonymous multi-model review that asks before it runs, groups findings by issue, and reports in Markdown.
- [Pudge1996/dsh-composer-stretch](https://github.com/Pudge1996/dsh-composer-stretch) - Expand button for the DSH Web UI composer — appears at 3+ lines, stretches to near-fullscreen height, auto-collapses on send, and inserts a newline on Enter or Shift+Enter in expanded mode while Cmd/Ctrl+Enter sends.
- [pure-craft/dsh-actions](https://github.com/pure-craft/dsh-actions) - Deterministic project actions shared by people and agents: one actions.json, a right-sidebar run panel, and agent tools.
- [pure-craft/dsh-capability-panel](https://github.com/pure-craft/dsh-capability-panel) - Manage MCP servers, skills, and tools for your agent — true in-context state (loaded/truncated/evicted) and per-session switches.
- [pyf2818/dsh-bili-widget](https://github.com/pyf2818/dsh-bili-widget) - Floating Bilibili video mini-player for DSH — always-on-top window with discover/search/follow-UP channels, auto-playlist, mini & focus modes, persisted watch history and window minimize-to-ball.
- [python3603/dsh-weather-panel](https://github.com/python3603/dsh-weather-panel) - Sidebar weather panel: current conditions, 5-day and 24-hour forecasts, an hourly rain chart, temperature history, CMA alerts with graded reminders and county-level matching, a radar mosaic, FY-4B satellite imagery, typhoon tracks, and ECMWF / NW Pacific sea surface temperature charts.
- [Qcsj777/dsh-process-panel](https://github.com/Qcsj777/dsh-process-panel) - Adds a per-answer Process drawer that streams, in Simplified Chinese, the agent thinking, tool calls and errors for that turn.
- [qgd1850890306-rgb/dsh-todo-checklist](https://github.com/qgd1850890306-rgb/dsh-todo-checklist) - Todo sidecar for DeepSeek Harness: turn selected text into a todo, capture todos from a conversation, review them in a left sidebar panel, get due reminders as an in-app popup or an IM bot message, and export everything to HTML, Markdown, Excel, CSV or JSON.
- [qgx1992/dsh-ui-tools](https://github.com/qgx1992/dsh-ui-tools) - Five web UI tools in one plugin: a provider + model two-button selector with reasoning-level control, collapse/expand-all for sidebar workspace groups, a session tab listing the files the session changed (needs kernel 0.1.2-alpha.1+, silently absent on older kernels), a workspace badge next to the session title, and a settings page that toggles them.
- [qgynisc/dsh-inline-pastes](https://github.com/qgynisc/dsh-inline-pastes) - Inline image chips for the DeepSeek Harness composer — paste an image and it lands in the text as a numbered chip (image-1.png) with hover preview. Images still ship through the official attachment pipeline, names restart per message, the dock and sent-message thumbnails carry a sequence badge, and a pre-send self-check warns when the names in the text no longer match the images in that message.
- [QianLuo-Ly/dsh-weather](https://github.com/QianLuo-Ly/dsh-weather) - Top-centered weather bar for the DSH Web UI: geolocation, current conditions, 12h/7d forecasts and severe-weather notifications via Open-Meteo (free, no API key).
- [QiaoSchoco/dsh-lit-shot](https://github.com/QiaoSchoco/dsh-lit-shot) - Screenshot button for the DSH composer on Windows: drag a region over the frozen screen and the picture lands in the draft as a normal image attachment, with a global hotkey and an editable shortcut.
- [qinpeizhan77/deepseek-harness-novel-studio](https://github.com/qinpeizhan77/deepseek-harness-novel-studio) - Local-first fiction workspace that links outlines, chapters, characters, timelines, writing rules, and continuity checks to the conversation.
- [qipengxiang/dsh-chat-actions](https://github.com/qipengxiang/dsh-chat-actions) - Hide or show each button under an assistant reply, reorder them by dragging, and collect the hidden ones behind a single ⋯ button.
- [qipengxiang/dsh-enter-combination](https://github.com/qipengxiang/dsh-enter-combination) - Rebind which key sends a message and which key starts a new line in the DeepSeek Harness composer; Enter sends and Cmd/Ctrl+Enter breaks the line by default, and either chord can be re-recorded from a settings page.
- [qipengxiang/dsh-message-quote](https://github.com/qipengxiang/dsh-message-quote) - Quote any message of the current conversation into the composer: pick one from the @ menu, click the quote button on a user or assistant message, or select text and use Quote in the right-click menu. - [QIRSHENG/dsh-tray-restart](https://github.com/QIRSHENG/dsh-tray-restart) - Adds Restart App and Host, Reload Page and Force Quit items to the Windows system tray of the official DSH desktop app by patching app.asar in place, and re-applies that patch after each desktop update.
- [QIUZAIYOU/dsh-composer-rewind](https://github.com/QIUZAIYOU/dsh-composer-rewind) - Composer history that restores the whole input state: composer contents, image and file attachments, @ references and slash commands, plus the model, thinking effort, permission and agent preset used.
- [qiweiii/dsh-brand-studio](https://github.com/qiweiii/dsh-brand-studio) - Custom branding for the shared DSH Web UI: a Settings → Branding panel for the name, badge, and local logo/wordmark images with size and rounding, live preview, optional page-title brand, and reset to the official look.
- [qjcnmd/dsh-reasoning-slider](https://github.com/qjcnmd/dsh-reasoning-slider) - Codex-style reasoning-effort slider embedded in the model selector.
- [qrxf/dsh-workspace-graph](https://github.com/qrxf/dsh-workspace-graph) - Draggable bubble graph of DeepSeek Harness workspaces and sessions in the Web UI: workspaces are large bubbles, sessions are small ones, and lines show real membership. Layouts are saved in the browser.
- [qt9494/dsh-seeyon-workbench](https://github.com/qt9494/dsh-seeyon-workbench) - Seeyon workbench that mounts OA to-dos and meetings, the skill catalog, and one-click aTrust VPN in one panel. Its vendored modules replace the author's dsh-seeyon-todo, dsh-skillhub and dsh-vpn — install this bundle or those plugins, not both. Requires a Seeyon OA account; the VPN part is Windows-only and needs the Sangfor aTrust client.
- [Quinn2006/dsh-guise](https://github.com/Quinn2006/dsh-guise) - Persona wardrobe for DeepSeek Harness: save multiple personas, apply them globally or per workspace, with a master switch, an adjustable API balance guard, and a lazy token-loving tired mode that speaks on the agent's behalf when quota runs out. Files-as-config, hot reload, zero dependencies.
- [Qulierm/dsh-macos-settings-shortcut](https://github.com/Qulierm/dsh-macos-settings-shortcut) - Restores Cmd+, to open the existing Settings dialog in DeepSeek Harness on macOS.
- [qwert702/dsh-auto-translate](https://github.com/qwert702/dsh-auto-translate) - Full-pipeline Chinese translation for the dsh web GUI: live translation of the model reasoning as it streams, in-place Chinese below each English reply, and one-line Chinese summaries for tool outputs and tool-call glosses — a standalone provider request that never enters the session transcript.
- [qwerty-k-de/dsh-attach-picker](https://github.com/qwerty-k-de/dsh-attach-picker) - Toolbar picture button in the DSH Web composer: click to pick multiple images through the native file dialog — they join the same draft-image rail as drag-and-drop and paste, with the host image-format, per-message-count and per-image-size limits enforced inline.
- [qwh15622336051/dsh-prompt-optimizer](https://github.com/qwh15622336051/dsh-prompt-optimizer) - Rewrites the composer draft into a precise prompt with a configurable model and a fully editable rewriting instruction; reads the content behind @file, @folder and @session references for context and keeps the reference chips intact; offers a one-click undo that restores the text you wrote yourself, and places the button in either composer toolbar with an adjustable colour and size.
- [qwq-wny/dsh-eta-forecast](https://github.com/qwq-wny/dsh-eta-forecast) - Adds an ETA widget to the DSH web and desktop UI that estimates when the current turn will finish from the todo list and step pace, and shows the remaining time, a progress bar and a confidence badge.
- [qwq1999/dsh-panellist](https://github.com/qwq1999/dsh-panellist) - Panellist manager: reorder the entries on the left rail, rename them, replace their icons, hide them, and fold several into a Group with a flyout menu, from a Settings tab.
- [qys0012/dsh-hotspots](https://github.com/qys0012/dsh-hotspots) - Real-time hot topics panel for the DSH web GUI: AI news and engineering news, each item with a distilled summary and the source link, shown from a sidebar entry with three views, keyword/source filters, read-state marking and hotkeys.
- [qyw233/dsh-deeplink](https://github.com/qyw233/dsh-deeplink) - Deep links: open a specific session or workspace via `?session=` / `?workspace=`.
- [qzz19970504/dsh-model-picker-control](https://github.com/qzz19970504/dsh-model-picker-control) - Model picker control for the DSH composer: a settings section beside the built-in Models page renames model display names and provider group names, adds a short coloured suffix capsule after a name, groups models from different providers into a new partition, reorders provider groups by drag or keyboard, sorts models inside a group by catalog order or name, and hides a provider or a single model without removing it from the catalog.
