- [Rabbit-bot-No-002/dsh-chat-avatar](https://github.com/Rabbit-bot-No-002/dsh-chat-avatar) - Adds an avatar to the left of each turn's final AI reply and to the right of each user message; upload your own image and set its size and circle or square frame.
- [RadicalGitter/dsh-ui-translate](https://github.com/RadicalGitter/dsh-ui-translate) - Translates visible Chinese UI and content in DeepSeek Harness Web, using a browser-local OPUS-MT model for session titles, workspace names, messages, search results, and opted-in plugin prose while keeping remote translation limited to allowlisted UI labels.
- [RAFOLIE/dsh-desktop-windowos](https://github.com/RAFOLIE/dsh-desktop-windowos) - Windows tray desktop shell: auto-installs and auto-updates the exe from GitHub Releases, creates desktop shortcuts for both the app and the web UI, and exposes a desktop_launch tool to start it from the conversation.
- [Ragnoryok1/dsh-client-locale-ru](https://github.com/Ragnoryok1/dsh-client-locale-ru) - Russian for the dsh web GUI: the whole interface plus the menus of 520 third-party plugins — 584 sections, 67,666 strings.
- [RAK7S/dsh-task-tree](https://github.com/RAK7S/dsh-task-tree) - A draggable task-tree panel inside the chat page: capture tasks by voice or text, drag to reorder, edge-snapping collapse, and a plain-text queue file you can edit or version yourself.
- [RAK7S/dsh-weather-whisper](https://github.com/RAK7S/dsh-weather-whisper) - Weather card once per session: remembers your home city so a VPN never moves it, inline city picker, theme presets, custom separators, optional TTS hook for third-party voices.
- [rakibulrocky14/dsh-cli](https://github.com/rakibulrocky14/dsh-cli) - Full-screen terminal TUI for DeepSeek Harness with Web-GUI parity, live streaming, agent presets, and DeepSeek blue styling.
- [ramwin/dsh-workspace-tree-status](https://github.com/ramwin/dsh-workspace-tree-status) - Shows an aggregated session-status dot in front of every folder in DSH Web's sidebar workspace tree — waiting for input, just finished, or running — and bubbles the sessions of nested workspaces up to their parent folder.
- [rans725/dsh-workspace-ranswork](https://github.com/rans725/dsh-workspace-ranswork) - Sidebar workspace panel that switches between running tasks and all conversations, shown as one freely sortable card list with per-card pin, rename, copy ID, fork, stop, and archive actions.
- [Raphaelutumn/dsh-mood](https://github.com/Raphaelutumn/dsh-mood) - A tiny behavioral mood ring for AI coding agents — folds session behavior (consecutive failures, repeated calls, activity) into a four-state Mood (GOOD / CONFUSED / FRUSTRATED / OVERWHELMED) shown as a low-friction session-header status light.
- [Ratevoid/dsh-aseprite](https://github.com/Ratevoid/dsh-aseprite) - A browser pixel-art and sprite animation editor with Aseprite-compatible files, local crop/outline blueprints, and optional LLM workflow nodes.

- [raven3005672/dsh-plugin-highlight-notes](https://github.com/raven3005672/dsh-plugin-highlight-notes) - Highlight or quote any passage of an answer, attach a note to it, then send the excerpt back to the composer as a quoted instruction.
- [rayafriandion/dsh-oc-tui](https://github.com/rayafriandion/dsh-oc-tui) - An opencode-inspired terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness that boots as a dsh profile app plugin, with a session sidebar, streaming chat, markdown tool cards, todo lists, slash-command suggestions, a telemetry footer with a context meter and inline approval prompts.
- [RCYD857/857-dsh-file-attach](https://github.com/RCYD857/857-dsh-file-attach) - Drag or paste files or pictures into the DSH Web composer as one scrolling row of chips, sent as @path references.

- [realguan/dsh-deepseek-chat-embed](https://github.com/realguan/dsh-deepseek-chat-embed) - Embeds chat.deepseek.com directly inside DeepSeek Harness desktop with persistent login sessions and dual-entry chat panels.

- [realhacker/dsh-theme-colorizer](https://github.com/RealHacker/dsh-theme-colorizer) - A Deepseek Harness plugin that gives its UI color themes.

Separately, the permission trigger renders in the theme error colour whenever full access is the active preset, including its row in the permission menu.
- [REALOIYO/dsh-settings-button](https://github.com/REALOIYO/dsh-settings-button) - Adds a gear button beside the sidebar account row that opens the Settings panel in one click. - [redfox-data/redfox-skill-gallery](https://github.com/redfox-data/redfox-skill-gallery) - Adds a sidebar entry that opens a card gallery of all Red Fox Community skills from the redfox-community-dsh plugin.
- [reg4916/dsh-bar#plugin](https://github.com/reg4916/dsh-bar/tree/master/plugin) - Host plugin for the macOS menu bar companion: live DeepSeek Harness session state, Approve/Deny for tool approvals, stop the current turn, open the exact session. The native app is a free universal build in GitHub Releases.
- [regrevia/dsh-chat-link-actions](https://github.com/regrevia/dsh-chat-link-actions) - Right-click any attachment or path in the transcript and hand it to your own action: send it to a WeChat contact, open it in Chrome, or anything else you configure — one right-click, anything you want. Ships with quote-into-composer, reveal in the OS file manager, copy path and Send to…, and lets you add your own entries (command, open with, shortcut, link, PowerShell). Menus are drawn in the app's own style, never the system one.
- [regrevia/dsh-vantage](https://github.com/regrevia/dsh-vantage) - A read-only overview tab beside the conversation: what this round asked, what was observed, what still needs checking, and a bounded history you can step through round by round.
- [renat3u/dsh-web-archive](https://github.com/renat3u/dsh-web-archive) - Collapse noisy messages (Think, Bash, etc.) in conversations.
- [researchrepo-backup/dsh-countup-pomodoro](https://github.com/researchrepo-backup/dsh-countup-pomodoro) - Count-up Pomodoro: focus counts up with no ceiling and never stops itself at 25 minutes, finishing drops straight into a short break, and a status board plus the four quadrants keep the task list in view.
- [rex178178/dsh-turnbar](https://github.com/rex178178/dsh-turnbar) - Video-style turn navigation for the Web UI: full-map progress bar with hover preview cards (tools/files/tokens), drag scrub, ⌘K in-conversation search, ⌘↑/⌘↓ stepping, Esc-return. Event-log powered — works beyond the loaded window. Dual-half plugin on the official composer.dock slot.
- [rezon-aki/dsh-streamfold](https://github.com/rezon-aki/dsh-streamfold) - Streaming-transcript fold for the DSH web UI: thinking and tool rows fold away while the newest thinking window opens itself; a finished turn scrolls back to your question, which also stays pinned at the top while you read; blue sparks fly from the thinking window edge and the answer writing head.
- [rg2304luyue/dsh-pa](https://github.com/rg2304luyue/dsh-pa) - A diamond button in the composer that rewrites your draft into a structured prompt and puts the original draft back when clicked again.
- [Ri0n72Y/dsh-workspace-scope](https://github.com/Ri0n72Y/dsh-workspace-scope) - Per-workspace Skill and MCP enablement for DeepSeek Harness: control which skills and MCP servers new sessions load, per project.
- [Rice00/dsh-job-progress](https://github.com/Rice00/dsh-job-progress) - Live progress for long-running background jobs in the DSH web GUI: a draggable floating ball in the session that owns the job, expanding into a panel with done/total, speed and ETA.
- [Rice00/dsh-loupe](https://github.com/Rice00/dsh-loupe) - Explain a selected word or sentence from a DSH conversation in a floating window: a channel of its own that leaves the session untouched, and the answer can be pinned to a session of its own.
- [Ricketts-Guo/dsh-shortcuts](https://github.com/Ricketts-Guo/dsh-shortcuts) - Fully customizable keyboard shortcuts for the Web UI: 34 pre-registered features (sessions, views, clipboard, models, silent permission cycling, settings), one-click recording to bind your own, and a shortcut cheatsheet with built-in diagnostics.
- [riesbri/dshline#dshline](https://github.com/riesbri/dshline/tree/main/packages/dshline) - Terminal-native TUI frontend for DeepSeek Harness that presents sessions, models, plugins, jobs, subagents, todos, and provider configuration through Harness capabilities while preserving real terminal scrollback.
- [rinsoraa/dsh-pulse-rail](https://github.com/rinsoraa/dsh-pulse-rail) - Turns the DSH turn-navigation rail into a music visualiser: each thin bar grows and thickens with its own frequency band, from system audio captured with WASAPI loopback. Geometry only, no colour or glow, and the rail keeps its native hover preview, click-to-jump and wheel scrolling.
- [rivenshanghai/dsh-toomuch-plugins](https://github.com/rivenshanghai/dsh-toomuch-plugins) - Collapses the global panel entries above the workspace in the DSH Web sidebar into a single toggle in the sidebar footer.
- [rsbsnv/dsh-mobile-adapt](https://github.com/rsbsnv/dsh-mobile-adapt) - Mobile layer for DSH Web: swipe-gesture drawer sidebar with adjustable width, layered back key, bigger tap targets, Enter inserts a newline instead of sending, keyboard avoidance and a 15px font floor.
- [ruaibeite/dsh-files-to-chat](https://github.com/ruaibeite/dsh-files-to-chat) - Right-click a file or folder in the right sidebar file tree to add it to the composer as an @ reference (⌘/Ctrl and Shift multi-select insert a whole batch), open it with the default application, or reveal it in the system file manager. Open and reveal go through the built-in open-in-app host capability, so those entries appear unless the host explicitly reports the capability as unsupported.
- [ruaibeite/dsh-input-polish](https://github.com/ruaibeite/dsh-input-polish) - A polish button in the composer trailing controls that rewrites the draft in place with the model. Context is matched by topic, not by recency: anchors from the draft (paths, identifiers, quoted text, CJK bigrams) pick the earlier messages about the same task, so a session that interleaves several tasks does not leak another task goal or files into the rewrite — and the prompt explicitly lets the model ignore the extract when it does not fit. The result goes back through the same undo-able editor path a human edit uses. Drafts holding reference chips (@file, folder, session) or a claimed /command, and drafts mid-submission, disable the button instead of silently dropping references.
- [ruanimal/dsh-sidebar-panel-buttons](https://github.com/ruanimal/dsh-sidebar-panel-buttons) - Collapses the DSH Web sidebar panel menu (plugins, extensions, scheduled tasks, IM) from a vertical labelled list into a horizontal row of 36×36 icon buttons with hover tooltips; a Settings → General option switches back to the list and is remembered per browser.
- [Rudyy898/dsh-drag-path](https://github.com/Rudyy898/dsh-drag-path) - Like Codex/Claude Code: drag any file or folder (no format limit) onto the DSH web page and its real absolute path is inserted into the composer instantly — no typing paths by hand. Workspace-first smart lookup, size checks, same-name picker, batch and clipboard paste support, Windows/macOS.
- [Ruiming-cn/dsh-ask-in-sidebar](https://github.com/Ruiming-cn/dsh-ask-in-sidebar) - Ask a sidebar assistant about selected assistant text: an ephemeral right-side panel answers from a snapshot of the main conversation's LLM history with streaming Markdown, collapsible thinking and multi-turn follow-ups, without touching the main conversation.
- [Ruiming-cn/dsh-better-at](https://github.com/Ruiming-cn/dsh-better-at) - Fast `@` file/session reference caching for the DSH Web GUI: preloaded indexes, browser-local keystroke filtering and native mention serialization.
- [ruisenbai/dsh-turn-fold](https://github.com/ruisenbai/dsh-turn-fold) - Folds streaming reasoning and tool calls into collapsed step bars and collapses each finished turn into a single summary bar; step bars show native tool icons, filenames, edited line counts, and failure counts, finished turns restore duration, first-token time, token usage, generation speed, and cache hit metrics from recorded Session events, and preferences persist on the Host. Changes browser presentation only. Requires DSH 0.1.5-alpha.1.
- [ruiyukirin/dsh-prompt-optimization-master](https://github.com/ruiyukirin/dsh-prompt-optimization-master) - Adds a button to the composer that rewrites the unsent draft into a clearer, more specific prompt, with one-click restore, a settings page and an optional per-request model override.
- [runcat-tommy/dsh-chinese-poetry](https://github.com/runcat-tommy/dsh-chinese-poetry) - Token-free Chinese classical poetry tab in the DSH conversation view with search, filters, 飞花令, daily poem, favorites, festival topics and a share-card image; AI explanation reuses your own DSH session.
- [runcat-tommy/dsh-panda-calendar](https://github.com/runcat-tommy/dsh-panda-calendar) - A conversation-view tab for DeepSeek Harness Web showing solar/lunar dates, ganzhi year/month/day, Chinese zodiac, 24 solar terms, festivals, China public holidays including make-up workdays, multi-city weather, an epoch↔date timestamp converter with a time-zone picker, and bundled offline "on this day" history from free sources without an API key.
- [runcat-tommy/dsh-view-manager](https://github.com/runcat-tommy/dsh-view-manager) - View tab manager for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI session header: enable, hide, reorder and rename the conversation view tabs (Chat / Trajectory), with locale-aware zh/en copy and npm update reminders.
- [Ryuu-64/dsh-find-all](https://github.com/Ryuu-64/dsh-find-all) - Search titles and saved text across ordinary DeepSeek Harness (DSH) conversations in all workspaces, optionally including archived chats, with Ctrl+F / Cmd+F search inside the current conversation.
- [S-anZZz/dsh-deepseek-web-sync](https://github.com/S-anZZz/dsh-deepseek-web-sync) - Desktop only. DeepSeek Web in the Harness right Sidebar with synchronized theme, automatic launch, one-time web sign-in, and one-click question transfer.
- [s3yf1337/dsh-desktop#bundle](https://github.com/s3yf1337/dsh-desktop/tree/main/bundle) - Desktop profile for dsh: native Tauri window over the harness web surface with tray, native notifications, a file-manager panel, and one-click updates.

- [Saknutella/dsh-thinking-quips](https://github.com/Saknutella/dsh-thinking-quips) - Personalises the DSH running-turn status line: rotating bilingual quips, a configurable animated loading icon (5 styles x 3 sizes) and one-click matching to the active theme colour, all in a General-settings panel, plus a # Chinese / # English sectioned quips editor. Five hand-drawn styles (whale light-sweep, pulse, stardust, typewriter, radar rings) — or drop in your own video / GIF. A settings panel controls speed, particle count, accent colour, wording, mute and fit. The exit animation needs the bundled one-time desktop-shell patch (node tools/patch-asar.mjs --apply, reversible); without it closing only hides the window.

- [sanqiPanax/dsh-sticker-board](https://github.com/sanqiPanax/dsh-sticker-board) - Fridge-magnet quick-task stickers docked above the composer: one-click sends a preloaded prompt into the current session, grouped long-term/short-term.
- [sanshanya/better-model-provider](https://github.com/sanshanya/better-model-provider) - Settings page for per-model capabilities: reasoning-effort levels with their wire spellings, input modalities, and token capacities, written as declarations or sparse catalog overrides.
- [SanYe-SanJiu/dsh-power-switch](https://github.com/SanYe-SanJiu/dsh-power-switch) - Windows-only process control for the harness: a sidebar button that shuts DSH down through the host's own graceful exit path, an app-window / normal-tab switch on the Plugins card that rewrites the desktop shortcut and restarts, and advanced settings for the wait before exit, the process exit code and a force-quit option.

- [scottzx/feature-blueprint](https://github.com/scottzx/feature-blueprint) - Adds mind maps and an Excalidraw canvas to the DSH sidebar, with local blueprint-file editing, Excalidraw file previews and standalone CLIs.

- [seeingrain/dsh-upload-file](https://github.com/seeingrain/dsh-upload-file) - Upload any file to DSH, isolated per workspace and session — a composer file library with server-side thumbnails and a context menu to open, copy, re-download or delete.

- [senyayume/dsh-edit-diff](https://github.com/senyayume/dsh-edit-diff) - Redraws line-level diffs on edit, write, insert and str_replace_editor tool cards — unchanged lines render once and changed characters are underlined — covers run_code (PTC) sub-calls, adds a per-turn changed-files card, and opens or copies any of those paths from the card rows and the tool rows through a host route the plugin serves itself.
- [sereinmono/dsh-desktop-pet](https://github.com/sereinmono/dsh-desktop-pet) - A plugin that adds a desktop pet to your DeepSeek Harness, supporting the Codex pet format, you can use hatch-pet or Petdex to add your pets.

- [sevenhsu7/dsh-codex-like-markdown](https://github.com/sevenhsu7/dsh-codex-like-markdown) - In-place Markdown editing for the right-sidebar document preview: a file keeps the shipped renderer's look, clicking a paragraph, heading, list, fence, or table cell puts the caret exactly where you clicked, and only the edited range is written back through ctx.fs.writeText, optionally guarded by the version it read.
- [SeverusZh/dsh-skills-mcp-group-manager](https://github.com/SeverusZh/dsh-skills-mcp-group-manager) - Group installed skills and manage MCP servers from a left-panel UI: filter the model skill catalog by enabled groups (union-deduped) and toggle MCP servers independently.

- [shenj13/dsh-book-library](https://github.com/shenj13/dsh-book-library) - Read books in the DSH sidebar - import EPUB/TXT/Markdown, get a five-part close reading for every chapter (paragraph summary, best sentences, what the author is doing, the AI's own opinion, what is missing), listen with TTS, ask questions while listening, and export the whole book to one HTML page. Export collects the chapters that already have a close reading rather than unread chapters.
- [SherUnlocked-4869/dsh-plugin-msg-nav](https://github.com/SherUnlocked-4869/dsh-plugin-msg-nav) - Conversation node navigation rail for the DSH Web UI: one dash per user message on the right edge, reading-position tracking, hover preview card, click-to-jump with highlight line, sliding window, and auto-hide.
- [shijiacheng520/dsh-skill-groups](https://github.com/shijiacheng520/dsh-skill-groups) - Grouped skill picker for the composer. - [shimingming520/dsh-conversation-process-collapse](https://github.com/shimingming520/dsh-conversation-process-collapse) - Collapses each settled turn's process rows into one expandable disclosure in the DeepSeek Harness Web conversation while keeping the final answer visible.

- [StarMoon-win/dsh-restart-plugin](https://github.com/StarMoon-win/dsh-restart-plugin) - Adds a sidebar Restart button to DeepSeek Harness Desktop on Windows that stops the whole application process tree and reopens the app.

- [studyzy/dsh-suggest-prompt](https://github.com/studyzy/dsh-suggest-prompt) - After each completed agent turn, a bounded auxiliary LLM call writes one suggested next prompt into the session log; the web composer renders it as ghost placeholder text, adopted via Tab.

- [sunnystarye-ui/dsh-plugin-text-quote](https://github.com/sunnystarye-ui/dsh-plugin-text-quote) - Codex-style text annotation for conversations: select text, add a quote with your comment, inject it into the composer, and expand sent annotations as a pill.
- [sunshaobei/dsh-file-mention](https://github.com/sunshaobei/dsh-file-mention) - Codex-style @file/@folder mentions for the DSH web composer: workspace file/folder picker menu, plain-text colored mention tokens via the platform lexicon scan, and a nested-git-aware file index.
- [sunshaobei/dsh-input-history](https://github.com/sunshaobei/dsh-input-history) - Input history switcher for the DSH composer that locally persists every submitted prompt (text plus attachments, max 50) and re-fills the empty composer with ArrowUp/ArrowDown, re-attaching file references and image previews.
- [suntianc/dsh-ui-settings-icons](https://github.com/suntianc/dsh-ui-settings-icons) - Adds custom icons to the DSH Settings sidebar and exposes a keyed `settings.section.icon` slot for third-party settings sections.

- [suyunxing/dsh-welcome-greeting](https://github.com/suyunxing/dsh-welcome-greeting) - Rewrites the New Session hero headline with a short greeting written by the model the session already uses, from the local time, the current city and the live weather; falls back to a local time-based greeting when no model is reachable.
- [SUZUNAMI/dsh-workspace-hide](https://github.com/SUZUNAMI/dsh-workspace-hide) - Hide chosen workspaces from the DSH sidebar and archive their sessions along with them, so those sessions never spill into the ungrouped list. - [sweet560/dsh-plugin-deepseek-chat](https://github.com/sweet560/dsh-plugin-deepseek-chat) - Sidebar panel that embeds chat.deepseek.com full-width in the DSH main area (desktop shell only), restores the last conversation, and keeps a crashed embedded page inside the panel.
- [swenbo1-web/dsh-web-search-button](https://github.com/swenbo1-web/dsh-web-search-button) - Direct web search button and /search slash command plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
- [swiftlc/dsh-annotation](https://github.com/swiftlc/dsh-annotation) - Adds text selection annotation tools and annotation chips to the dsh web composer.
- [swyc520/dsh-plugin-model-whitelist](https://github.com/swyc520/dsh-plugin-model-whitelist) - Tick which models appear in the DSH model selector, and fold provider groups in the settings panel.

Requires dock-base; a broken install fails loudly instead of silently doing nothing.

The dock-base Workbench integration ships separately as the dock-flash adapter.

- [TheGoodMorty/chat-pace](https://github.com/TheGoodMorty/chat-pace) - Configurable chat auto-scroll — paced section-by-section reading with size-proportional pauses, smooth follow, step and hold modes, hotkeys, and per-session open positions.
- [ThinkofRain1213/dsh-smooth-cursor-patched](https://github.com/ThinkofRain1213/dsh-smooth-cursor-patched) - Comet-mode animated caret for the DSH Web composer: a glowing trail glides to the text position, with configurable accent color, thickness, trail, and a 500 ms idle blink. Maintained fork of Lacquervii/smooth-cursor.

- [Thunderunruly/session-kanban](https://github.com/Thunderunruly/session-kanban) - Session board in the left sidebar: every chat session's current work, todos and progress, with a searchable overview heatmap and one-click navigation back to the session.
- [Thyxqz/dsh-plugin-quick-invoke](https://github.com/Thyxqz/dsh-plugin-quick-invoke) - Adds an installed-plugin picker beside the composer: drag a plugin name into the prompt at the drop point, open a draggable plugin rail in the right sidebar by double-clicking the entry, and choose which plugins (and remarks) appear in Settings.
- [tianlaoban/DSH-Chinese-Talk](https://github.com/tianlaoban/DSH-Chinese-Talk) - Switches every session's thinking and answers to Chinese — terse, a little wry, plain-spoken — while keeping proper nouns in English, and adds an "answer only what was asked" interaction rule. - [tinyfinddong/dsh-close-all-tabs](https://github.com/tinyfinddong/dsh-close-all-tabs) - Right-Sidebar tab menu enhancement for DeepSeek Harness: adds a 'Close other tabs' item that closes every content tab of the session except the one whose menu is open and the docked guide.
- [tipoLi5890/dsh-file-mention](https://github.com/tipoLi5890/dsh-file-mention) - Session-scoped @file/@folder mentions in the composer with Git-aware indexing, drag-drop and paste managed uploads, and validated path markers.
- [TixAn9/DSHdesktop-restart-bottom](https://github.com/TixAn9/DSHdesktop-restart-bottom) - Restart button for DSH Desktop placed directly above the sidebar account button.

- [Tleon-H/dsh-next-prompt](https://github.com/Tleon-H/dsh-next-prompt) - After each reply, shows a gray next-prompt suggestion in the empty composer that Tab or → accepts; in an empty composer, ↑ / ↓ browse the messages you sent in the session. - [tomowang/dsh-tui](https://github.com/tomowang/dsh-tui) - Full-screen terminal client for DeepSeek Harness built on pi-tui: session replay/resume, streaming responses, collapsible tool cards, in-terminal approvals and questions, model/preset/permission/plan/goal management, shell mode, and a trajectory ledger.
- [tonyischen/ds_ask_graph](https://github.com/tonyischen/ds_ask_graph) - Interactive topic graph for DSH session history: groups questions into topics, drills into per-topic Q&A timelines, supports semantic regrouping, and exports HTML, SVG, and Bluepin vaults.

- [toujianjian/dsh-do](https://github.com/toujianjian/dsh-do) - One plugin for DeepSeek Harness with durable autonomous loops, sidebar GitHub discovery, AI-assisted installation, and workspace shortcuts.

- [ttmouse/dsh-model-picker](https://github.com/ttmouse/dsh-model-picker) - Model picker for the DSH web composer that replaces the model seat: a search-first popup whose left column indexes the suppliers and scrolls the grouped list, with a favorites group pinned at the top, image icons separating native from bridged vision input, and a reasoning-effort panel opened from the right zone of the trigger.

- [tumi-huakai/dsh-plugin-meow-speech](https://github.com/tumi-huakai/dsh-plugin-meow-speech) - Display-layer text replacement for DSH chat messages: rewrite how any configured text appears on screen without touching the real conversation, with per-rule whole-word matching and code-block protection.
- [tuogusa/dsh-word-complete](https://github.com/tuogusa/dsh-word-complete) - Word auto-completion in the Web composer: prefix-matched suggestions sorted by closeness, arrow-key selection and Enter to confirm.
- [tuoLuoSuan/dsh-peak](https://github.com/tuoLuoSuan/dsh-peak) - A chip at the left end of the composer tool row showing whether DeepSeek bills at peak or off-peak right now. Clicking it opens a card with the current state and rate, the next switch with a countdown, and why this instant is in that state: a weekend, a named statutory holiday, a 调休 make-up workday, or simply outside the peak windows. Times are resolved in Beijing time with an explicit UTC offset, so the verdict does not depend on the machine clock; a hard-coded 2026 Chinese holiday table carries the 33 holiday days and the six 调休 workdays, and a year beyond the table says so instead of guessing.

- [TZHR-invest/dsh-plugins#dsh-mobile-ui](https://github.com/TZHR-invest/dsh-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-mobile-ui) - Mobile UI for the Web GUI on narrow screens: full-width responsive layout, overlay session drawer, 44px touch targets, safe-area support, and reading enhancements with zero desktop impact.
- [uckkk/dsh-valley-meter](https://github.com/uckkk/dsh-valley-meter) - Peak-Valley Meter (峰谷电表) — a tiny DeepSeek usage companion: a minimal two-part balance chip above the composer (currency symbol + number, nothing else), official balance refreshed every 5s; click the symbol to open the official top-up page in a new tab; hovering the chip fades in a circular backdrop under the symbol, its left arc flush with the chip's own left edge, and expands a 24h peak/valley timeline (orange=peak, blue=valley, glowing marker at the current local time) so off-peak hours are obvious; independent today-spend metering; a settings panel with 10 muted color presets plus custom valley/peak colors, detailed/minimal styles and readout toggles; all-Chinese UI.
- [Uid-762/dsh-ai-workbench](https://github.com/Uid-762/dsh-ai-workbench) - Turns one plain-language request into a live workbench window: a sidebar panel asks a few clarifying questions, the model writes a single-file HTML artifact, and the plugin mounts it in a resizable floating window or a standalone browser tab. Declared window actions are recorded as info-level project journal entries (without their payloads), and workbenches can be imported, exported, or installed from a market index.
- [uigdwunm/dsh-conversation-jump](https://github.com/uigdwunm/dsh-conversation-jump) - A rail of four circular buttons in the DSH Web conversation that step to the previous or next user message, or to the top or bottom, paging older history in automatically.

- [uio-o/dsh-plugin-operation-log](https://github.com/uio-o/dsh-plugin-operation-log) - A right-sidebar session panel that lists every Skill, MCP tool call and file read or write by turn and step, with per-failure error detail.
- [UncleK/dsh-think-translate](https://github.com/UncleK/dsh-think-translate) - Translate DSH reasoning, tasks, answers and review reasons into 9 languages. Ollama, custom OpenAI/Anthropic APIs or Google/Bing; ordered fallback, local model memory controls, originals preserved.
- [UndeadSheep/dsh-file-preview#dsh-file-preview](https://github.com/UndeadSheep/dsh-file-preview/tree/main/packages/dsh-file-preview) - Floating workspace file-preview window for the Web client: lazy file tree, CodeMirror preview and in-window edit with save, Markdown and image preview, Quick Open search, and opening paths clicked in the conversation.
- [UnknowCao/dsh-dock](https://github.com/UnknowCao/dsh-dock) - Windows desktop launcher for DeepSeek Harness: a one-click whale icon plus a sidebar More menu with Settings / Restart-Refresh / graceful Full Exit, and a scrollable multi-DSH picker on the cold-start card.
- [Utmotc/dsh-balance-card](https://github.com/Utmotc/dsh-balance-card) - Shows the API balance of the provider behind the current model as a dsh Web sidebar card, with per-package progress bars, currency/credit-aware units, a settings tab, and subscription and credit quota monitoring.

- [weshopai/weshop-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/weshopai/weshop-dsh-plugin) - Infinite-canvas e-commerce visual workspace for product photography, virtual try-on, background edits, and video, synced live with the Harness conversation.
- [wf-ping/dsh-message-injector](https://github.com/wf-ping/dsh-message-injector) - Presets message-injection content combos and auto-injects them into every message.

- [WhatCannotBeSaid/dsh-im-workspace-buttons](https://github.com/WhatCannotBeSaid/dsh-im-workspace-buttons) - Adds one 28x28 icon button per dsh-im channel that holds an account to the official Workspaces header row. Buttons appear only for channels with a connected account.
- [WhatCannotBeSaid/dsh-session-eva-status](https://github.com/WhatCannotBeSaid/dsh-session-eva-status) - Colors DSH sidebar Session rows by their official status, in an Evangelion-flavored palette: a blue left rail for a row awaiting interaction, red for the session open in the main view, purple for finished-but-unviewed, and a static rainbow title for pinned rows. - [whiteguo233/dsh-openbiliclaw](https://github.com/whiteguo233/dsh-openbiliclaw) - OpenBiliClaw consumer panel for DSH: recommendations, saved lists, Socratic dialogue, profile views, and Agent Bridge tools.

- [whiteS18/dsh-terminal-button](https://github.com/whiteS18/dsh-terminal-button) - Embedded terminal for DeepSeek Harness: opens an in-app terminal panel in the right sidebar (DockKit) or bottom composer dock, with PSReadLine geometry protection and full theme sync.
- [whybebabo/dsh-better-workspace](https://github.com/whybebabo/dsh-better-workspace) - Topic grouping layered over the native workspace list: emoji folder groups, filtering and search, batch archive, and safe permanent deletion.
- [whybebabo/dsh-code-nav](https://github.com/whybebabo/dsh-code-nav) - Code preview for dsh-better-sidebar with per-language syntax highlighting, symbol outline, in-file search, and selection-to-conversation.
- [wilsonchengassistant/dsh-media-web-preview](https://github.com/wilsonchengassistant/dsh-media-web-preview) - Plays video and audio files in the right Sidebar preview pane, streamed over an authenticated HTTP Range route so a remote browser can play and seek a large file without launching a native player on the Host.
- [wilsonchengassistant/dsh-mobile-sidebar](https://github.com/wilsonchengassistant/dsh-mobile-sidebar) - Below 1024px the sidebar leaves the shell frame entirely and is opened as an overlay drawer from a header button, so the conversation gets the full viewport width; wider layouts are untouched.
- [wilsonchengassistant/dsh-quick-workspace](https://github.com/wilsonchengassistant/dsh-quick-workspace) - Replaces the host-side folder chooser in the Add workspace flow with a name dialog, so a remote browser can create and open a workspace instead of an OS dialog appearing on the Host screen.
- [wilsonchengassistant/dsh-zh-hant](https://github.com/wilsonchengassistant/dsh-zh-hant) - Adds a Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant) language to the web GUI, registered through the locale service with one dictionary per namespace and selectable in Settings, General, Language.
- [winditer/dsh-paste-spill](https://github.com/winditer/dsh-paste-spill) - Folds each 4-50 KB paste in the DSH composer into its own chip (expand or delete it individually), and turns a paste of 50 KB or more into a real file attachment. Declares DSH >=0.1.7-rc.2 <0.3.0-0, so it stays visible on the 0.2 release line.
- [winditer/dsh-prompt-optimizer](https://github.com/winditer/dsh-prompt-optimizer) - Polishes the draft in the composer into a clearer, better-structured prompt from the ✨ button or Alt+O; streams the result live over SSE with reasoning shown first, and follows the session's default model with zero configuration or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
- [winditer/dsh-recent-tasks](https://github.com/winditer/dsh-recent-tasks) - An always-last, collapsible Recent tasks workspace group in the DSH sidebar: a sidebar entry and the Mod+Alt+N / Mod+Shift+N shortcut start a chat in a dedicated folder, so it lands in that group instead of 未分组. The group is a genuine workspace record rather than a plugin-drawn look-alike, so collapse, rename, search and drag order behave normally, and its folder, group name, pin-last and auto-repair are live settings.
- [winditer/dsh-temp-chat](https://github.com/winditer/dsh-temp-chat) - Floating translucent DeepSeek whale elf on the DSH page that opens a draggable, minimizable temporary chat window using the session model or a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with real-time streaming.
- [windrover/dsh-minimal-UI-panels](https://github.com/windrover/dsh-minimal-UI-panels) - Four right-Sidebar panels for the dsh web client: artifacts, long-term memory, terminal and notes. They pair two per tab with a draggable split, so two panes show all four at once. The host half ships nine memory_* tools, artifacts_list, the /memory command, and the /api/artifacts/* and /api/terminal-notes/* routes. The terminal runs one bash command per line, with a default 120-second deadline and a stop button. Requires dsh 0.1.5 or newer, and 0.2.
- [windrover/dsh-prompt-optimizer](https://github.com/windrover/dsh-prompt-optimizer) - A prompt optimizer in the composer input tool row: pick a category and a template, then ✨ rewrites the draft in place with one-click undo. Pick from the Basic, Context and Image categories; you can cancel a run, and it shows elapsed time and token usage. Ships 15 templates covering task-instruction rewriting, step planning, safety-research framing, system-prompt role cards, and text-to-image / image-to-image prompts; context templates read the recent turns of the session for coreference resolution. Calls go through the host model service, and a settings section exposes the model and the budgets. Output guards check that user-written constraints survive, warning rather than auto-retrying. Adapted for dsh 0.1.7 and 0.2.
- [WindyPro-rourou/dsh-code-studio](https://github.com/WindyPro-rourou/dsh-code-studio) - File-change monitor and code editor for the DSH Web UI. Agent edits appear beside your conversation as real-time line-by-line diffs, with a syntax-highlighted editor, one-click revert, change history, workspace switcher, and per-session isolation.
- [Wine-Red/dsh-codex-timeline](https://github.com/Wine-Red/dsh-codex-timeline) - Left-edge user-Turn navigation rail with reading-position highlighting, hover previews of per-turn metrics and model-answer excerpts, keyboard and click-to-jump controls, and local conversation search.
- [Winter-And-You-Gone/dsh-deep-verbs](https://github.com/Winter-And-You-Gone/dsh-deep-verbs) - Rotates the model status line through a 53-phrase English/Chinese deep-theme pool: a random pick at turn start, event-driven switching on new thinking segments or tool calls (3s throttle), and a click on the status line toggles the language.
- [Winter-And-You-Gone/dsh-turn-fold](https://github.com/Winter-And-You-Gone/dsh-turn-fold) - A better fold bar: automatically folds tool calls and Think segments into step fold bars, and collapses each finished turn into a single turn header with live metrics (duration, TTFT, token, tok/s, cache hit) — only the final summary stays visible; customizable leading icons with animated poker cards built in (suit-cycling card animation while running, a deck when collapsed, a fan when expanded), a settings row for the official fold mode, compatible with both new and old DSH versions. Zero intrusion into DSH source.
- [Witherwithwinter/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget-Bowl](https://github.com/Witherwithwinter/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget-Bowl) - A fixed-corner DeepSeek balance whale widget for the DSH web GUI: three switchable skins (default / bowl-on-head / bowl-in-hand), balance with today usage, per-turn cost popups, peak/off-peak price conversion, press sound effects and random talk lines. Modified from MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget.
- [Witherwithwinter/DSH-Codinput](https://github.com/Witherwithwinter/DSH-Codinput) - Replaces the chat composer with an editor-style input panel on CodeMirror 6: line numbers, edit + markdown-preview split, a floating window mode and a full-height sidebar tab — one input surface at a time. Drafts ride the official input machine; the official voice-input button is rendered when the host provides one, and the stats row and context meter read the same data as the official dock.
- [wjf1/dsh-prompt-enhance](https://github.com/wjf1/dsh-prompt-enhance) - Sparkle button immediately left of the model selector that rewrites the composer draft into an executable prompt in place, modelled on WorkBuddy: the host calls the conversation LLM with a prompt-engineering system prompt, multi-level undo keeps up to 8 previous drafts, and a token-level diff card shows added and removed spans, the number of changed spots and the net character delta. Runs on the session model, is disabled while the draft is empty, and keeps the browser-session cookie fence in front of the LLM call.
- [wjingshan/dsh-dock-launcher#dsh-dock-bridge](https://github.com/wjingshan/dsh-dock-launcher/tree/main/plugins/dsh-dock-bridge) - Publishes the running dsh Web server's PID, port and tokenized URL to a runtime file for the DeepSeek Harness Switch Dock app, and removes it on shutdown.
- [wjingshan/dsh-sidebar-focus](https://github.com/wjingshan/dsh-sidebar-focus) - Orders and folds the DSH left sidebar by what is actually running — a workspace floats to the top when one of its sessions starts and keeps that place when the session finishes, only the N most recently active workspaces stay expanded, and six switches plus one count control each rule.
- [WJNCT55555/dsh-web-preview-float](https://github.com/WJNCT55555/dsh-web-preview-float) - Google AI Studio-style floating preview for the Web UI: a draggable/resizable iframe preview with aspect-ratio and resolution presets, plus a VS Code-style code window with direct editing, confirmed writes, and session-log recording.
- [WJZ-P/dsh-attachments](https://github.com/WJZ-P/dsh-attachments) - Adds file and folder drag-and-drop attachments to the Web UI, with composer cards, persistent history, and workspace-backed paths.
- [wlj521/dsh-ui-tweaks](https://github.com/wlj521/dsh-ui-tweaks) - Live-tune the DSH Web conversation UI from Settings: message font size, Claude Desktop-style markdown tables, dialog width, an optional timeline rail, and a GitBar with branch management, per-file diff, and commit & push.
- [WLV-ZEDD/dsh-btw](https://github.com/WLV-ZEDD/dsh-btw) - Interactive Side-Assistant Dock to ask quick side questions via /btw with real-time thinking status and history pagination without interrupting the active agent loop.
- [wmengxiang/dsh-prompt-optimizer](https://github.com/wmengxiang/dsh-prompt-optimizer) - Adds an icon button to the composer that optimizes the current draft prompt through the active model.
- [WMXS-A/dsh-utility-plugins#dsh-skill-cheatsheet](https://github.com/WMXS-A/dsh-utility-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-skill-cheatsheet) - Composer button that opens a panel listing every skill available to the current session with Chinese titles, purposes and usage examples, and lets you catalogue newly installed skills in one click (saved locally).
- [wodongx123/dsh-desktop-tray](https://github.com/wodongx123/dsh-desktop-tray) - Adds a system tray icon to DSH Desktop, with settings to hide the main window to the tray on minimize or close and self-healing after app updates.
- [Woeful001/dsh-refresh](https://github.com/Woeful001/dsh-refresh) - Adds a refresh button to the sidebar footer that reloads the plugin list and the page so newly installed plugins take effect without restarting the desktop app.
- [WolfGenerals/ncm-player](https://github.com/WolfGenerals/ncm-player) - Floating NetEase Cloud Music player for DSH Web: draggable collapsible window with mini mode, playlist discovery with search and hot lists, synced lyrics with translations, persistent playback queue, QR-code or Cookie login, colors following the DSH skin theme.
- [WongYuYe/dsh-composer-recall](https://github.com/WongYuYe/dsh-composer-recall) - Arrow-key input history for DSH 0.1.2-alpha.1: press ↑ in an empty composer to recall this session's prompts, ↓ to go forward, Esc to restore the draft.
- [WongYuYe/dsh-diff-card](https://github.com/WongYuYe/dsh-diff-card) - Per-turn file-change card for DSH Desktop: +N −M badges, aligned diffs, and Mac/Windows file open (system app, Finder/Explorer, VS Code).
- [wood007924/dsh-approval-enter](https://github.com/wood007924/dsh-approval-enter) - Keyboard confirmation for approval cards: the card takes focus when it appears, so Enter allows once and Esc rejects, and those two keys are forwarded through the card handler when focus has moved elsewhere. It never auto-approves and never steals focus from a text field.
- [woody-dx/dsh-pdf-bookmarks](https://github.com/woody-dx/dsh-pdf-bookmarks) - PDF outline navigation and local reading bookmarks in the existing right-sidebar file preview; supports adding, renaming, deleting and revisiting page positions, with version and integrity guards. Verified on macOS Apple Silicon with dsh Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.3.
- [wqx-txdsyl/dsh-ds-attach](https://github.com/wqx-txdsyl/dsh-ds-attach) - **DeepSeek Chat (chat.deepseek.com) same-style attachments**: paperclip upload button, 240×64 DS-style file cards with official colored doc icons (PDF/DOCX/XLSX/PPT/IMG extracted from the DS frontend bundle), drag-and-drop, text extraction (PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT) injected into the message, and real attachment cards rendered in the transcript (custom user renderer) with the model reading full content.
- [WSL043/dsh-reasoning-slider](https://github.com/WSL043/dsh-reasoning-slider) - Adds a model-aware reasoning effort slider with native and animated modes, light and dark palettes, and shared or per-model colors.
- [WsTe47/dsh-step-clock](https://github.com/WsTe47/dsh-step-clock) - Shows the running agent step above the web composer as a Chinese sentence: its step number, the tools it is running, and how long it has been going. A finished step keeps its duration on screen until the next one starts, so a slow step can be identified after the fact.
- [wsxwj123/dsh-plugins#dsh-composer-tools](https://github.com/wsxwj123/dsh-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-composer-tools) - Composer input toolkit: arrow-key session history (first/last-line gated, IME and command-menu safe), an instructions viewer/editor for global and project AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, and a prompt library of 780 Chinese prompts (Cherry Studio agents-zh corpus, AGPL-3.0) inserted into the composer in one click. Ships on npm as `dsh-composer-tools`.
- [wsxwj123/dsh-plugins#dsh-turn-scrubber](https://github.com/wsxwj123/dsh-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-turn-scrubber) - Compact right-edge turn rail with hover summaries and click-to-jump navigation. Ships on npm as `dsh-turn-scrubber`.
- [wszhoho/dsh-file-attachment](https://github.com/wszhoho/dsh-file-attachment) - Drag-and-drop / paste / upload files and images; on non-multimodal models images are auto-described by a configured VLM.
- [wt0812/dsh-vocab-study](https://github.com/wt0812/dsh-vocab-study) - Offline vocabulary panel: a capsule beside the composer opens a word card, and a dockable tabbed panel tracks today, progress, the mistake book and settings.
- [wuaisaber/dsh-think-zh-plus](https://github.com/wuaisaber/dsh-think-zh-plus) - Keeps DSH reasoning in Simplified Chinese and auto-expands every Think row in the Web UI.
- [wucl12/dsh-side-branch](https://github.com/wucl12/dsh-side-branch) - Read-only side branch in the right sidebar: quote text to ask follow-ups without polluting the model context of the main session; every follow-up rebuilds the branch from the latest settled turns of the main session, and writes are refused at the tool-execution layer so the prompt prefix stays cacheable.
- [WuHututu/dsh-side-chat](https://github.com/WuHututu/dsh-side-chat) - Opens a temporary side conversation in the right Sidebar that reuses the host conversation UI, so answers render with the same markdown, tool steps, timing and token usage as the main thread. The side chat runs on its own memory-only session: the parent snapshot is supplied as reference context, and nothing is written to the session log.
- [wukiQAQ/dsh-enter-using](https://github.com/wukiQAQ/dsh-enter-using) - Codex-style keyboard answers for the pending command-approval panel — 1 allows once, 2 rejects, Enter confirms the highlighted choice, arrow keys move it, and Esc rejects, with the buttons still usable by mouse.
- [wuuuuu123-32/dsh-open-artifacts](https://github.com/wuuuuu123-32/dsh-open-artifacts) - Adds an action to the session menu and the session title bar that opens the artifacts folder of that conversation: it reads the session log, works out which directories the conversation wrote files to, and opens them in Explorer.
- [wuwaka/dsh-clipboard-menu](https://github.com/wuwaka/dsh-clipboard-menu) - Adds a right-click menu to DeepSeek Harness inside desktop shells that ship no context menu: cut, copy, paste and select all in the composer, copy and copy-as-plain-text on selected text elsewhere, and a search entry that opens the default browser with a configurable engine.
- [WWFZS/dsh-plugin-startup-animation](https://github.com/WWFZS/dsh-plugin-startup-animation) - Full-screen boot animation covering the loading page until the app UI is ready. Ships a built-in video/wallpaper/audio library, accepts your own files, and adds uninstall and one-click update buttons on its settings page.
- [wwumit/dsh-phone#client](https://github.com/wwumit/dsh-phone/tree/main/client) - iPhone-style agent phone: dual-panel calls & SMS, RCS group chat with trust gates, cross-device agent messaging via the registry inbox bridge, L0–L4 trust badges and evidence audit. Experimental: trust summaries are not a security guarantee, and SMS/signalling is relayed through the operator's inbox (visible to them); E2E encryption is planned.
- [www02310/dsh-go](https://github.com/www02310/dsh-go) - Launch splash screen for DSH — a row of white marquee dots lights up, then the DeepSeek Harness wordmark is written stroke by stroke before the main window takes over. Installs as a runtime-injected overlay plugin; the repository also ships an optional native build.
- [wwwangzilin/dsh-role-cards](https://github.com/wwwangzilin/dsh-role-cards) - Replaces the new-session hero with a combined picker: role cards for the agent presets and a workspace card, collapsed into capsule buttons that expand into two scrollable rows.
- [wx-yss/dsh-message-rail](https://github.com/wx-yss/dsh-message-rail) - Codex-style left-side message navigation rail for the Web UI: one tick per user message, hover previews, and click-to-jump across the whole history.
- [wydddddcool/dsh-hover-approve](https://github.com/wydddddcool/dsh-hover-approve) - Anchors an approve/answer bubble to each DSH Web sidebar session row — one-click handling of authorization, questions, plan reviews and blocked goals without opening the conversation.
- [wyzh0117/dsh-notebook](https://github.com/wyzh0117/dsh-notebook) - Sidebar notebook with titled notes and inline images (videos rejected); click a title to copy its body to the clipboard, reference a note in the composer with @, and optionally open the notebook for every new session.
- [Wzh0718/dsh-minimal-transcript](https://github.com/Wzh0718/dsh-minimal-transcript) - Minimal DSH Web transcript toggle: hide thinking, tool-call, and turn-process rows from the session header while preserving assistant answer text.
- [wzn16/dsh-task-capsule](https://github.com/wzn16/dsh-task-capsule) - Session-header task capsule with color-coded run states, click-to-jump and a multi-task dropdown, plus task notification cards (done / error / waiting-for-confirmation) with synthesized sound and optional system notifications.
- [wzz3034026545/dsh-rule-manager](https://github.com/wzz3034026545/dsh-rule-manager) - Manage DSH rules from the web settings panel — edit global/project AGENTS.md, or auto-split pasted rules into layered AGENTS.md and skills via LLM.
- [x2802490130-prog/dsh-client-ui-writing](https://github.com/x2802490130-prog/dsh-client-ui-writing) - Client-side writing panel for the Web UI: project volumes and stats, corpus library, full-text search, evolution version-chain diffs, and an SVG thread graph, shown only in writing-preset sessions.
- [xchannel1987/dsh-sdd-progress-xc](https://github.com/xchannel1987/dsh-sdd-progress-xc) - SDD task progress (todos) and progress ledger (sdd/progress.md) as a right-sidebar tab bound to the current session, rendered with the official MarkdownText, auto-refresh every 5s.
- [XcodeFish/dsh-file-link-menu](https://github.com/XcodeFish/dsh-file-link-menu) - Adds a right-click menu on file references in chat output, listing registered applications with icons for open-with, revealing files in the file manager, and copying absolute or relative paths resolved against the session workspace, while code blocks, plain text and external links keep the native menu.
- [XHR666/dsh-mpkg-wallpaper](https://github.com/XHR666/dsh-mpkg-wallpaper) - Load Wallpaper Engine .mpkg files as the DSH web background: embedded video, time-of-day switching, unified frosted blur, local wallpaper library & rotation.
- [xi-zhao/OpenQuantum#openquantum-web-branding](https://github.com/xi-zhao/OpenQuantum/tree/main/packages/openquantum-web-branding) - Applies OpenQuantum branding, browser metadata, and PWA assets to the native DeepSeek Harness web UI.
- [xiaheng1/dsh-turn-nav](https://github.com/xiaheng1/dsh-turn-nav) - Turn histogram navigation rail for DeepSeek Harness Web with mixed, DeepSeek, and Codex visual variants.
- [xiamubumu/dsh-composer-launcher](https://github.com/xiamubumu/dsh-composer-launcher) - A launcher panel for DSH: manages the capability composer, the plugin inventory and the MCP bridge, and walks you through installing the browser tab-bridge extension.
- [xianrui69/dsh-quick-phrases](https://github.com/xianrui69/dsh-quick-phrases) - Adds a draggable, position-persisted chip bar of configurable quick phrases to DeepSeek Harness, plus a /-triggered phrase menu with per-phrase pin, slash-menu, bar-visibility, and click-to-send toggles.
- [Xiaofei-fei/dsh-prompt-history](https://github.com/Xiaofei-fei/dsh-prompt-history) - Terminal-style composer for the DSH web GUI: shell prompt history (↑/↓, prefix search, Ctrl+R), Codex-style completion and next-prompt prediction (Tab or → to accept), selection toolbar (copy / quote / ask in side chat), right-click paste, draggable chat TOC, and a parallel side-chat thread in the right sidebar.
- [xiaokaizhou/dsh-media-preview](https://github.com/xiaokaizhou/dsh-media-preview) - Renders local audio/video paths as inline, playable previews in DSH chat: replaces paths with <audio>/<video> players backed by same-origin /api/media-preview/* route, with explicit error statuses.
- [xiaomujiang/dsh-user-question-nav](https://github.com/xiaomujiang/dsh-user-question-nav) - ChatGPT-style question nav rail with up/down arrow buttons — per-question tick marks on the chat edge, hover-triggered drawer listing every user question with real-time search filter, one-click smooth-scroll jump, and active-question highlight synced to scroll position.
- [XiaoOu2024/dsh-novel-generator](https://github.com/XiaoOu2024/dsh-novel-generator) - Novel generator: builds a world snapshot along a story timeline and, from the latest snapshot and the most recent chapters, deduces the next chapter. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2.
- [XiaoSHang05/dsh-sidebar-fold](https://github.com/XiaoSHang05/dsh-sidebar-fold) - Puts one collapsible row above the sidebar panel icons. Click it to hide the icons, click again to show them. The choice is remembered in the browser. Because folding is done in CSS, icons from plugins you install later are folded too. It does not depend on any other plugin.
- [xiaoshihou514/dsh-tui](https://github.com/xiaoshihou514/dsh-tui) - Clean and simple TUI.
- [xiaosurongjia/dsh-improved-inline-edit](https://github.com/xiaosurongjia/dsh-improved-inline-edit) - A mid-run steer input for DeepSeek Harness Web: while the agent works, an input bar appears above the composer to inject modification requests into the next decision via agent.steer(), without stopping the conversation. Drafts persist per session, unread injected messages can be recalled from the bubble, and an optional guiding prefix is supported.
- [xiaotuchu/dsh-file-tree](https://github.com/xiaotuchu/dsh-file-tree) - Adds a resizable workspace file tree beside the native preview, with directory expansion, filtering of loaded files, and refresh.
- [xiaoyangcheng84-svg/dsh-skin-manager](https://github.com/xiaoyangcheng84-svg/dsh-skin-manager) - Skin manager for the DSH web GUI: discovers installed skins and switches the active one from a dedicated Settings page, mutually exclusive, hot-reloaded without restart.
- [xiaoyi-xx/dsh-peak-status](https://github.com/xiaoyi-xx/dsh-peak-status) - Header chip for the DSH web GUI that shows whether the current Beijing time is inside DeepSeek's API peak window, with a live clock and countdown to the next transition.
- [xiaoyuer3921/dsh-showreel](https://github.com/xiaoyuer3921/dsh-showreel) - Turns the latest completed DSH session turn into a shareable vertical recap video: editable five-scene storyboard, host-side privacy redaction, optional AI polish and TTS narration, MP4/WebM export with PNG cover.
- [xiex16070-jpg/dsh-prompt-enhance](https://github.com/xiex16070-jpg/dsh-prompt-enhance) - Adds an enhancement chip to the composer input action row, left of the model selector: it rewrites the draft in place using the model already selected in the session, in five styles, with one-click undo and an /enhance slash command.
- [xiezouqu12/agent-trees](https://github.com/xiezouqu12/agent-trees) - Live multi-way tree of the current session's agents in the DeepSeek Harness conversation view and right sidebar, with status, plan progress, tokens, cost (requires dsh-cost-meter), and runtime on every card.
- [XiLuovo/dsh-session-timeline](https://github.com/XiLuovo/dsh-session-timeline) - Session timeline down the left of the conversation: every user message at a glance, current-message tracking, hover preview of the message and its reply, click to jump, collapsible.
- [xindady/dsh-prompt-enhancer](https://github.com/xindady/dsh-prompt-enhancer) - Adds a prompt enhancement button to the composer toolbar that rewrites the draft through a model call, keeps @file references verbatim, and offers one-click undo.
- [DSH Canvas](https://github.com/xindong/dsh-client-canvas) - An AI-native multimodal canvas for DSH: preview images, video, audio, 3D models, PDFs, documents, and code; connect ideas and collaborate with agents in a persistent local workspace.
- [xing-shuyin/dsh-ui-tools](https://github.com/xing-shuyin/dsh-ui-tools) - Developer tools panel for the DSH web UI: file browser with preview, edit, and path-only file mentions; multi-tab terminals with quick commands; Git panel with commit, push, pull, and branch switching; and background job management. UI ported from pi-web-ui.
- [Xingkong42/dsh-open-workspace](https://github.com/Xingkong42/dsh-open-workspace) - Adds Open workspace entries to the sidebar session-row menu and the session header actions slot, opening the session workspace folder in the system file manager.
- [Xingkong42/dsh-zh-labels](https://github.com/Xingkong42/dsh-zh-labels) - Re-applies Chinese UI labels to the DSH client modules on every start, so translations survive upgrades.
- [xingxingbk-git/dsh-deepseek-chat](https://github.com/xingxingbk-git/dsh-deepseek-chat) - Adds a switch between DeepSeek web chat and the Harness workspace in DSH Desktop.
- [xinming-chenniang/dsh-button](https://github.com/xinming-chenniang/dsh-button) - Editable quick-action buttons beside the DSH composer: send preset text or insert it into the draft, then reorder, move, or resize the buttons. Text-only: runs no host commands and never overwrites an existing draft.
- [xinspark/dsh-better-session-topbar](https://github.com/xinspark/dsh-better-session-topbar) - Better Session Topbar: replaces the session topbar title with a workspace and session breadcrumb, switching workspaces, sessions and subagents from topbar dropdowns; adding a workspace hands off to the host's own directory picker, which is the OS folder dialog on desktop.
- [xintingcui/dsh-sidebar-panels-fold](https://github.com/xintingcui/dsh-sidebar-panels-fold) - Collapses the sidebar global-panel rows to a few visible entries and adds a picker for choosing which ones stay, so a long panel list stops squeezing the workspace and session area; rows are hidden only, never unregistered.
- [Xinyuan-Gao/xy-dsh#xy-dsh-lamp](https://github.com/Xinyuan-Gao/xy-dsh/tree/main/xy-dsh-lamp) - Always-on-top lamp board for macOS: one lamp per agent, one row per session, collapsing to one lamp per running task; a lamp turns blue and blinks while an approval or a question is waiting on you, and the root agent finishing raises a system notification.
- [Xinyuan-Gao/xy-dsh#xy-dsh-question-nav](https://github.com/Xinyuan-Gao/xy-dsh/tree/main/xy-dsh-question-nav) - Keeps the question you are currently on pinned above the composer, with a dropdown of every earlier question that scrolls the conversation back to that turn; questions folded into process groups are expanded first, and Escape, scrolling or clicking outside collapses the panel.
- [xiong356/dsh-draft-optimizer](https://github.com/xiong356/dsh-draft-optimizer) - Adds a ✦ button below the DSH composer that rewrites the current draft into a more complete prompt with a single call to the configured default model, keeping the original intent and language, and replaces the draft in place without sending it.
- [XIUDENBENNY/dsh-claude-quote](https://github.com/XIUDENBENNY/dsh-claude-quote) - Claude Code Desktop-style selection quoting: select text in a conversation to reply to that passage from a popover, or fork the session into a side chat in the right sidebar with the selection quoted. Quotes sit above the composer as removable cards, are sent as plain Markdown blockquotes in the same format as Claude Code Desktop, and render as clamped quote blocks in sent messages.
- [xixingyingmie/dsh-gpt-niang-widget](https://github.com/xixingyingmie/dsh-gpt-niang-widget) - A GPT/ChatGPT-persona desktop pet pinned to the bottom-right corner of the DSH web GUI — shows balance, today's usage, peak/off-peak pricing and per-turn cost, with editable bubbles (text, balance, usage, pricing, images, random lines and weighted choices), per-line styles and fonts, a floating quick editor, sound effects, custom character art/animation/audio, and snapping/flipping. 54 GPT-flavored lines across five groups. Its routes, bundle id and data files are namespaced so it can run alongside the whale and Xiaoke widgets. A derivative of MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget (MIT).
- [xiyuepcl/dsh-approval-translator](https://github.com/xiyuepcl/dsh-approval-translator) - DSH审批汉化 — approval dialogs translated to Chinese before they render: DeepSeek-powered, host-side, nothing for React to revert.
- [xkjxziochu/dsh-input-optimizer](https://github.com/xkjxziochu/dsh-input-optimizer) - Rewrites the draft in the DSH composer into a clearer, more executable prompt through the harness's own LLM routes, showing an original/optimized comparison before you adopt it.
- [xlennart/dsh-goal-mode-enhance](https://github.com/xlennart/dsh-goal-mode-enhance) - Visual goal lifecycle for the DSH web UI: a composer dock to create, multiline-edit, pause, resume, complete and clear session goals with live round progress, plus a phase-dot composer entry and a settings-page goal overview.
- [xlennart/dsh-side-chat](https://github.com/xlennart/dsh-side-chat) - Native side-by-side chat beside the main conversation: an independent archived DSH session with full native UI, on-demand parent-context retrieval, selection quoting, and a keep-or-delete lifecycle.
- [Xliecc/dsh-session-theme](https://github.com/Xliecc/dsh-session-theme) - Shows every session theme in the DSH Web left sidebar immediately on page load by warming the session projection cache at startup; no need to click into a conversation first.
- [xmlans/dsh-xmlans](https://github.com/xmlans/dsh-xmlans) - Desktop pet for DSH: 兰酱, an angel-winged maid in a transparent always-on-top window who reacts to session states (thinking, working, waiting, done, error), shows task progress and DeepSeek balance, and responds to drags, head pats, pokes and wing touches.
- [xmmtr/dsh-better-right-click](https://github.com/xmmtr/dsh-better-right-click) - Better Right-Click: right-click menu on file references in the DSH transcript. Copies the absolute path, reveals the file selected in Explorer by reusing and focusing an existing window, and lists every app registered for that file type so you can open it with the one you want. Menu labels follow the DSH display language (Chinese and English). Windows only (Explorer reveal and the registered-apps list use PowerShell).
- [XMoon/dsh-pi-tui](https://github.com/XMoon/dsh-pi-tui) - Third-party TUI mode for DeepSeek Harness (dsh --profile pi-tui), built on a vendored pi-tui fork: covers the main session loop plus approvals, commands, session switching and full-text search, as well as presets, skills, model/settings menus and slash commands.
- [xmwengxing/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-perfmon](https://github.com/xmwengxing/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-perfmon) - Host performance monitor in the right Sidebar: CPU, memory and swap gauges, a GPU clock and VRAM bar, CPU / GPU / motherboard / drive temperatures, and a process table sortable by CPU, memory or name.
- [xmwengxing/dsh-sidebar-enhancement](https://github.com/xmwengxing/dsh-sidebar-enhancement) - Enhanced right-sidebar files panel: rename, create, upload, download (a directory is zipped on the fly), copy the full path and delete from the tree; an editable document renderer for 128 text extensions with Ctrl/Cmd+S save and conflict detection; plus an independent bottom terminal panel with tabs and a quick-command library persisted under the DSH home.
- [xswt442-cmd/dsh-xswt-tauriapp#dsh-desktop-app](https://github.com/xswt442-cmd/dsh-xswt-tauriapp/tree/main/plugins/dsh-desktop-app) - Installer entry for the dsh-xswt-tauriapp desktop shell, a Tauri desktop shell for DeepSeek Harness: on the first dsh start after installation it downloads this platform's installer from the release, checks it against the release SHA256SUMS before writing it, and opens it with the system installer. It installs nothing itself and adds no UI to dsh.
- [xt765/dsh-message-edit](https://github.com/xt765/dsh-message-edit) - Inline user message editor: adds a pencil edit button next to Copy below sent user bubbles, switches the bubble in-place into a rounded editor card, and resends via session branch fork or in-session follow-up.
- [xt765/dsh-selection-quote](https://github.com/xt765/dsh-selection-quote) - Cursor and GitHub PR Review style selection toolbar: quote selected text to chat (Cmd+L), write inline comments (Shift+Cmd+L), and batch-insert from a composer dock.
- [xuanfu-web/dsh-metaphysics](https://github.com/xuanfu-web/dsh-metaphysics) - Chinese metaphysics (xuanxue) plugin: eighteen systems in one — eight chart systems (BaZi with 42 shensha, pattern / useful-god and luck scoring; Zi Wei Dou Shu with star brightness, 34 patterns and decade / annual mutagen; LiuYao, MeiHua YiShu, Da Liu Ren, Qi Men Dun Jia, compatibility charts and Tarot) plus ten quick references (almanac, solar–lunar conversion, date selection, bone-weight fortune, Xiao Liu Ren, horoscope, numerology, life-curve, feng shui, name analysis). Ask-driven interpretation, evidence cards, DST correction, all computed locally with networking off by default.
- [xuexiaolei1997/dsh-plugin-stock-x](https://github.com/xuexiaolei1997/dsh-plugin-stock-x) - Financial quantitative workbench and stock ticker: floating ball and drawer panel, real-time A/HK/US/global market quotes, multi-period K-lines and 5-day intraday charts, depth order book, capital flow, sector heat map, and AI investment research.
- [xufu5438-netizen/dsh-boot-video](https://github.com/xufu5438-netizen/dsh-boot-video) - Full-screen video boot splash — play an mp4 at startup, skip with a click, import your own clip, and non-playable codecs are transcoded to H.264 automatically.
- [xwh5/dsh-diff-review](https://github.com/xwh5/dsh-diff-review) - Session change-review for DeepSeek Harness: tracks write/edit tool calls and renders VS Code-style side-by-side diffs via diff2html, auto-following the theme, with subagent aggregation and one-click revert.
- [XWIDE/dsh-draft-keeper](https://github.com/XWIDE/dsh-draft-keeper) - Keeps the images you pasted or attached in the composer, per session: they are mirrored locally in the browser and handed back through the official draft channel when you return to the conversation or the composer remounts, and dropped as soon as the message is sent or you remove them.
- [XWIDE/dsh-picflow](https://github.com/XWIDE/dsh-picflow) - Pasted screenshots become numbered references: each Ctrl+V image is stored in the attachment library under a stable number, listed in a composer-dock thumbnail panel with an image source in the @ menu, and inserted as a reference chip at the caret — automatically after paste when the auto-insert switch is on.
- [XWIDE/dsh-xwide-annotation](https://github.com/XWIDE/dsh-xwide-annotation) - Select text in a conversation to attach a numbered highlight with a colour stored per note, keep every mark in an outline panel that jumps back to its quote, and let a corner self-check badge report style, selector and saved-key problems without opening dev tools.
- [xx529/dsh-capability-settings](https://github.com/xx529/dsh-capability-settings) - Adds a capability panel to the DSH web GUI: browse, install (upload, zip, host path or URL), enable, edit and export skills, and add or edit Claude Code-compatible MCP servers, at global and per-project scope — with project copies, per-project shadow stubs, live mount status and a zero-side-effect connection probe. A session view toggles capabilities for the current conversation only, and a TypeSafe Jev tab scores skills and MCP servers for the session from the input draft. Requires the dsh web shell 0.2.0-rc.2 or later. Forked from chengdb/dsh-plugin-capability-panel; it shares a patch id with that plugin and with pure-craft/dsh-capability-panel, so do not install them together.
- [xx529/dsh-shell-cmd](https://github.com/xx529/dsh-shell-cmd) - /cmd <command> in the composer runs that shell command in the session working directory, sends the command and its output to the model as a user message, and renders the input as a terminal card with exit status, expandable output and copy buttons; a bare /cmd opens an interactive terminal whose transcript is sent to the model with Ctrl+Enter. Runs with its own terminal permissions (danger-full-access) by default; set useSessionPolicy: true to use the session sandbox.
- [xx529/dsh-task-gantt](https://github.com/xx529/dsh-task-gantt) - Agent-team task Gantt chart for the DSH sidebar - one swimlane per teammate, real session-log time on the x-axis, and every shared task drawn with its title and summary. Requires dsh-better-sidebar 0.4.0 or later (the tab has nowhere to register without it).
- [xx529/dsh-terminal-panel](https://github.com/xx529/dsh-terminal-panel) - Read-only terminal view tab in the conversation header: aggregates bash output, background jobs and persistent terminal sessions from the current session, subagents and Agent Team teammates into one filterable panel, with type and session-scope filters, command/output search, auto-collapse, follow-scroll and a maximize dialog; foreground bash shows final output only. Requires DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2 or later (0.2.x).
- [XXP-AI-SPACE/dsh-snip](https://github.com/XXP-AI-SPACE/dsh-snip) - Snipaste-style screenshot for DeepSeek Harness: press F1 (a real Windows global hotkey) to freeze and dim the whole screen, drag a region, then draw red boxes and click-to-type text annotations with wheel-resizable font; the annotated PNG drops into the composer at native resolution. Esc exits. Windows 10/11.
- [Xxsttb/dsh-input-optimizer](https://github.com/Xxsttb/dsh-input-optimizer) - Adds a four-pointed-star button left of the composer's model selector that rewrites the unsent draft in place — grammar, wording, punctuation and execution order — preserving code, commands, paths, identifiers, numbers and URLs byte-for-byte, answering nothing and never overwriting text typed while it runs. A pencil under every user message reopens that message for editing without touching the draft; because the Harness session log is append-only, an edit forks the conversation before that message rather than rewriting it. A circular restart icon under every reply asks that one question again in a fresh conversation that carries none of the earlier turns. Both are refused while a turn is still answering, and disabled when the reply used a tool that can leave a trace or when the files the message named have since changed. A right-sidebar memory tree draws the conversation as turns, showing what was actually asked and answered, every answer to one question on its own line labelled original, edited or memory-free, newest first, with arrows that re-read an answer in place; right-clicking jumps to a branch or removes it from the plugin's own history.
- [Xxsttb/dsh-sillytavern-presets](https://github.com/Xxsttb/dsh-sillytavern-presets) - Imports SillyTavern AI presets as switchable, editable prompt layers: preserves the raw JSON, edits prompt order and sampler parameters, previews the injected System Prompt, exports back to SillyTavern-compatible JSON, and archives or permanently deletes presets with confirmation. Applies temperature and maximum output tokens to Harness requests; other sampler fields are preserved and exported but not applied.
- [xxxSnack/dsh-market-dock](https://github.com/xxxSnack/dsh-market-dock) - A stock market panel for DeepSeek Harness, forked from dsh-xueqiu: A-share/HK/US quotes, K-line and intraday charts, hot lists, search and 7x24 news, plus local holdings with live-computed P&L, host-side price alerts, and a hide switch that unmounts the panel and stops market polling while alerts still fire. Replaces dsh-xueqiu; do not install both.
- [XXXXXQ-0206/dsh-prompt-for-me](https://github.com/XXXXXQ-0206/dsh-prompt-for-me) - Adds a composer button that optimizes the current prompt or designs the next one from the current session and project context.
- [xxxyz/DeepSeekHarness-MCP-Manager](https://github.com/xxxyz/DeepSeekHarness-MCP-Manager) - MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness: add, edit, enable/disable, restart and delete MCP servers from Settings → MCP 管理, with JSON export/import, four mcp_manager_* model tools and an HTTP API; install via npx, npm or cross-platform scripts.
- [xyAxzy/dsh-conversation-map](https://github.com/xyAxzy/dsh-conversation-map) - A live conversation map for DeepSeek Harness web: real-time session tree with subagent lineage, running state, and one-click navigation.
- [xyzYaeMiko/dsh-deepsleep-progress](https://github.com/xyzYaeMiko/dsh-deepsleep-progress) - Shows an elapsed/budget progress bar with a moving head picture under blocking tool calls in the DSH Web conversation flow, and adds a graphical settings page for its style and tool list.
- [xyzYaeMiko/dsh-session-groups](https://github.com/xyzYaeMiko/dsh-session-groups) - Edge-style tab groups for the DSH sidebar on Web and Desktop, with nested groups up to three levels, workspace tree, single-list view, recursive sorting, RGB colors, collapsed status summaries, subagent expansion with status, and an approval-gated agent tool for organizing groups.
- [Y1X1n/dsh-prompt-optimizer](https://github.com/Y1X1n/dsh-prompt-optimizer) - Adds an optimize button beside the composer that analyzes and rewrites the prompt draft with SSE streaming, conversation-context awareness (template vs intent-polish strategies), an edit-continuity memory chain, undo, and model routing with fallback and a connectivity test.
- [yangdongzhen590/dsh-knj-menu](https://github.com/yangdongzhen590/dsh-knj-menu) - Third-party menu manager for the DSH Web UI: collects new menu entries added by other plugins into one place, with fold/collapse and pinned menu items.
- [yangdongzhen590/dsh-knj-prompts](https://github.com/yangdongzhen590/dsh-knj-prompts) - Prompt scene picker for DSH: choose a scene from a dropdown and it opens a new session with the prompt already filled in (with {variable} placeholders), so you only tweak and send.
- [yanglingrise/dsh-erii-boot-splash](https://github.com/yanglingrise/dsh-erii-boot-splash) - Erii (Sakura) themed boot splash animation — falling sakura petals, a mint monster mascot with a blossom on its head, and a soft pink progress bar; fades out after ~3 seconds without blocking input.
- [YangShen-SWE/dsh-plugin-chat-zoom](https://github.com/YangShen-SWE/dsh-plugin-chat-zoom) - Zoom only DSH chat messages and input (80%–200%) using Ctrl shortcuts or settings, with local memory and no sidebar scaling.
- [yangshen830-eng/dsh-editor](https://github.com/yangshen830-eng/dsh-editor) - VS Code-style code editor: sidebar file tree over the workspace, Monaco editing, file read/write, Git status and diff, search, and Markdown preview.
- [yangzhenyu0817/dsh-session-color](https://github.com/yangzhenyu0817/dsh-session-color) - Right-click any session row in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar to color-tag it with a default red, ten palette colors or a custom picker, persisted locally.
- [yangzhenyu0817/dsh-settings-drag](https://github.com/yangzhenyu0817/dsh-settings-drag) - Moves and resizes the DeepSeek Harness settings panel; its position and size are remembered per browser.
- [yanli-nyan/dsh-open-in-app-fix](https://github.com/yanli-nyan/dsh-open-in-app-fix) - Removes the inherited ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE variable from the environment the open-in-app package hands to launched editors, so the desktop host's "Open in ..." launches stop failing with HTTP 502 launch-failed; app.asar is untouched.
- [yanli-nyan/dsh-sidebar-entry-manager](https://github.com/yanli-nyan/dsh-sidebar-entry-manager) - Per-row display switches for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar's panel entries: a hidden row is still reachable from the More menu, and the choice is kept in localStorage across reloads and restarts.
- [yannicksong0106/dsh-550c-boot](https://github.com/yannicksong0106/dsh-550c-boot) - Full-screen 550C boot intro for DSH: a 4-second simple cut and a 16-second rewrite sequence, skippable by click or Esc, with four phosphor palettes. The host half injects the opening frame while the document is still parsing, so the built-in loading card never shows; the desktop caption strip turns transparent, so those window buttons float on the animation.
- [YannZhou/dsh-about](https://github.com/YannZhou/dsh-about) - About section for the DeepSeek Harness settings: version info, npm latest/next update check with one-click install and auto-restart, and GitHub release history.
- [yaoshuo530/dsh-prompt-enhancer](https://github.com/yaoshuo530/dsh-prompt-enhancer) - Prompt enhancement for the composer: an "✨ Enhance" button rewrites your draft prompt into a clearer, more structured version with first-principles thinking, grounded in session context, memory and recent conversation; asks clarifying questions in a card when key info is missing, then previews the result before applying it to the input.
- [Yaoxxxxxxx/dsh-plugins#dsh-focus-composer](https://github.com/Yaoxxxxxxx/dsh-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-focus-composer) - Returns the caret to the session composer on Ctrl+I; the key is rebindable in Settings and works from any region of the desktop window.
- [YaphetHayate/codeRDD#dsh-rdd-goal-tree](https://github.com/YaphetHayate/codeRDD/tree/master/dsh/rdd-goal-tree) - Read-only goal-tree status strip above the composer: planners see the full node tree, workers see their claimed node, and worker reports call back to the planner session.
- [YearnCy/dsh-question-tree](https://github.com/YearnCy/dsh-question-tree) - Tree-style questioning for DSH: click "Ask in tree" on a selection to add a node to the right-sidebar tree and ask inline under it; clicking another node makes it the current parent, so later selections nest there, Alt+click opens a root node, Ctrl+click appends another passage to the same node, double-click jumps back to the quoted text, a red/green dot marks each node as understood or not, and the panel switches between a list view and a horizontal branch graph. "Add to composer" instead puts the quote into the input box as a reference chip, without creating a node. Nodes live in localStorage and nothing is injected into the prompt.
- [yefengliu1/dsh-agent-grid](https://github.com/yefengliu1/dsh-agent-grid) - Replaces the DSH sidebar with a fixed 2×4 board of eight standing agent seats; each seat shows its own status, latest tool call, reasoning and result, and a settings switch restores the stock sidebar at any time.
- [YEYEYEYESHIFU/dsh-result-only-view](https://github.com/YEYEYEYESHIFU/dsh-result-only-view) - Results-only conversation toggle for the Web GUI: hides thinking and tool-call process rows, keeps one live status line while the agent works, restores working animations under prefers-reduced-motion, zh-CN/en localized. Works in the stock composer and inside dsh-split-screen panes; verified on DSH 0.1.1 and 0.1.5.
