- [YEYEYEYESHIFU/dsh-split-screen](https://github.com/YEYEYEYESHIFU/dsh-split-screen) - Split-screen workspace for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI - chat with several agents side by side in panes that look and behave exactly like the stock conversation: drag-to-split, live sessions with queued messages and in-pane ask_user/approval cards, per-pane view tabs (Chat/Trajectory/plugin views), a compact TUI composer mode (Alt+T) and pane-focus shortcuts. Requires DSH 0.1.5+.
- [yezitotempeace/dsh-auto-think](https://github.com/yezitotempeace/dsh-auto-think) - Expands the assistant reasoning block while it streams and folds it back when done, animated in both directions; the sidebar switch only controls whether that happens automatically.
- [yezitotempeace/dsh-job-progress](https://github.com/yezitotempeace/dsh-job-progress) - Draggable floating card that follows background jobs: a progress bar and percentage parsed from wget/curl/apt/pip output, elapsed time, ETA when present, and the latest output line.
- [yfwu2020/dsh-full-view](https://github.com/yfwu2020/dsh-full-view) - Keeps the current chat in a movable, resizable floating window when the right file or browser panel enters full view, with a compact input bar, a whale restore button and a return to the original split layout.
- [yfwu2020/dsh-recent-sessions](https://github.com/yfwu2020/dsh-recent-sessions) - Opens the recent sessions in a sheet that floats over the sidebar workspace list, from one row above Settings: rows sorted by last activity with their run state, a draggable height, and a list that settles onto whole rows after stopping. The sheet paints no surface of its own, so it reads as part of the sidebar.
- [yfwu2020/dsh-selection-explain](https://github.com/yfwu2020/dsh-selection-explain) - Select text in the DSH web UI to stream a translation and an explanation of what it means in that specific context, read against the conversation it came from; the panel keeps a replayable history and can be promoted into a full session.
- [yfwu2020/dsh-think-flow](https://github.com/yfwu2020/dsh-think-flow) - Chain-of-thought panel for the DSH Web right sidebar: folds the live reasoning stream of each session into turn → step groups carrying the reasoning text and the tool calls made in that step. Only the newest turn is expanded by default and earlier turns collapse to one line; steps are grouped into activity phases by a local rule, the step waiting on a tool is marked, tool failures show their reason, full reasoning text is fetched per step on demand, an all-turn directory searches turn titles, user text and turn numbers locally, and a whole turn can be summarised into a Chinese title with one model call.
- [Ygritteee/dsh-ygritte-boot](https://github.com/Ygritteee/dsh-ygritte-boot) - Full-screen ice-and-fire boot intro for DSH: a frost-to-ember boot sequence with typed bilingual logs and a hairline progress line, then Ygritte's five-step identity authorization. Esc skips, Enter or click fast-forwards, and a settings page switches it off/quick/full or replays it; the host half paints the opening frame while the document parses, so the built-in loading card never shows.
- [Yhx888/dsh-quote-context](https://github.com/Yhx888/dsh-quote-context) - Chat quotes for DSH: select text in any message to quote or comment; quotes wait above the composer and become jump-back quote cards in the sent message.
- [yi-yezhiqiu/dsh-prompt-market](https://github.com/yi-yezhiqiu/dsh-prompt-market) - Prompt market beside the composer: browse and search three built-in online prompt sources, bookmark or write your own, and insert into the input box.
- [yicun0316/dsh-claude-slider](https://github.com/yicun0316/dsh-claude-slider) - Replaces the reasoning-effort dropdown with a draggable snapping slider, and draws 13 canvas effects across five style families (thrust, fluid, fantasy, tech, texture) with three tiers that unlock as the effort level rises. Custom mode combines 10 particle forms with 8 flow trajectories; 9 accent presets and a hex picker recolor every effect, and optional key sounds cover two voice clips, a synthesized duck squeak, a mechanical click and a local audio file.
- [Yinxe/deepseek-harness-plugins#archive/file-change-viewer](https://github.com/Yinxe/deepseek-harness-plugins/tree/main/archive/file-change-viewer) - Takes over the edit/write rows in the chat stream with the official native row shell and collapse behavior; expanding shows per-file code cards with file-type icon, add/delete stats, per-block collapse, highlight/plus-minus toggle, syntax-highlighted unified diff with real file line numbers, and a configurable context margin. Also ships a patch tool (beta, off by default) that applies multi-spot multi-file patches atomically via the *** Begin Patch envelope. Frozen archive: keep the pinned version, as the author no longer adapts it to newer DSH releases.
- [YiRan0/dsh-mobile-glass](https://github.com/YiRan0/dsh-mobile-glass) - Mobile adaptation for the DSH Web UI on narrow screens: reveal drawer with the chat layer on top, drag gestures, bottom-sheet settings panel, composer and header fixes, zero desktop impact.
- [yishengjun8/dsh-workspace-studio](https://github.com/yishengjun8/dsh-workspace-studio) - Three-pane workspace layout with file-tree browsing, file editing, a non-linear conversation mindmap view, and mobile mode support.
- [YizhouLouisLu/dsh-math-copy](https://github.com/YizhouLouisLu/dsh-math-copy) - Copying rendered math from the chat puts the formula's LaTeX source on the clipboard instead of KaTeX's visual glyph text.
- [YizhouLouisLu/dsh-select-ask](https://github.com/YizhouLouisLu/dsh-select-ask) - Select text in the chat to quote it into the composer as an annotation, or to ask about it in a throwaway side panel that leaves no record.
- [ylw-ux/dsh-pins-fixtool](https://github.com/ylw-ux/dsh-pins-fixtool) - Pins passages selected in a conversation into a per-conversation right-sidebar panel, marks them in the transcript, jumps back to the source passage on click, and quotes a pinned passage into the composer from the selection toolbar or by typing @; the panel tags, searches, filters and exports the pins as a Markdown outline.
- [Yocaihua8/dsh-prompt-improver](https://github.com/Yocaihua8/dsh-prompt-improver) - Improves conversation drafts with optional conversation, memory and project context, side-by-side previews, a dedicated model and one-step restore; never sends messages automatically.
- [Yokira404/dsh-thinking-highlight](https://github.com/Yokira404/dsh-thinking-highlight) - Counts keywords inside thinking rows and highlights them once a row is expanded, with a count chip per keyword on the title line that doubles as an on/off switch for that word, per-keyword tint, text colour and text size (10-22px, the same range the host body-text setting uses), typeface, bold / italic / underline and whole-word matching, plus a dedicated settings section.
- [YokosWY/dsh-calibration-tier](https://github.com/YokosWY/dsh-calibration-tier) - Adds a tier bar to the DSH composer with three thinking tiers (normal, strict, max), an exclusive loop mode whose three levels run 3, 5 or 8 self-review rounds, and a counter-review toggle that stacks on either; the model reads the current tier through the clarify_tier and forge_level tools.
- [yongfanbeta/dsh-pomodoro](https://github.com/yongfanbeta/dsh-pomodoro) - Classic 25/5/15 pomodoro timer for DSH that ties each run to the current session task or a manual project name, with a stats panel, a 365-day heatmap, a draggable floating timer and a corner pill, local JSON storage, and CSV export.
- [YooRarely/dsh-open-explorer](https://github.com/YooRarely/dsh-open-explorer) - Adds buttons to open the current DSH workspace root in the host file manager.
- [youqisibun/dsh-claude-effort-slider](https://github.com/youqisibun/dsh-claude-effort-slider) - A six-stop reasoning-effort slider for DeepSeek Harness, with a pixel-texture Ultracode mode that sweeps in from right to left and adapts to light and dark themes.
- [youyaemmm-pixel/dsh-custom-lists](https://github.com/youyaemmm-pixel/dsh-custom-lists) - Groups the composer model picker into customizable official, plugin and relay sources, with hierarchical navigation, an Our Free Model four-category view, and a dedicated settings page. The Our Free Model view needs dsh-our-free-model installed.
- [YQing0123/dsh-artifact-center](https://github.com/YQing0123/dsh-artifact-center) - Artifact center: search, preview and open files produced by DSH conversations.
- [ysqp6-lang/dsh-attachment-panel](https://github.com/ysqp6-lang/dsh-attachment-panel) - Delivery panel in the DSH sidebar: indexes every image and file sent to the harness (content-addressed attachments plus @-mentioned local paths), rebuilds Taildrop send history per target device from tailscale file cp calls in the session logs, lists incoming files (the Tailscale inbox plus unmarked files in ~/Downloads), and sends new files to a device from the panel with online status and upload progress.
- [ysyyhhh/dsh-pet](https://github.com/ysyyhhh/dsh-pet) - Native desktop pet for DSH that follows agent activity, supports Codex pet packages, and imports approved pets directly from Petdex without its CLI.
- [Yu-tao-Li/dsh-read-image-view](https://github.com/Yu-tao-Li/dsh-read-image-view) - Display read_image results in DSH Web and Desktop: complete previews, grouped multi-image galleries, transparency checkerboards, keyboard and touch zoom, and session-authorized loading. Verified with DSH Desktop 0.11.1 / Harness 0.2.0-rc.2.
- [yu-wenchao/dsh-free-models-hub](https://github.com/yu-wenchao/dsh-free-models-hub) - A drawer panel for the DSH web UI with a paginated list of free LLMs; one-click or batch writes each as a custom model provider into Settings, plus a local multi-key rotation proxy.
- [yuanbaoerer/dsh-decision-split](https://github.com/yuanbaoerer/dsh-decision-split) - Decision split view for DSH web UI: a decision summary card in the main window plus the full plan in an independently scrollable side panel, so you can review the whole plan while writing decisions and send them back to the agent with one click.
- [yuanyiHY/deepseek-media-gallery](https://github.com/yuanyiHY/deepseek-media-gallery) - Sidebar button that opens a semi-transparent popup for browsing, previewing, downloading and deleting generated images and videos, with a settings page for the media, record and download directories.
- [yuanyiHY/dsh-rail-equalizer](https://github.com/yuanyiHY/dsh-rail-equalizer) - System-audio visualizer for the turn navigator rail: the rail reacts in real time to whatever the default playback device is rendering, with four motion modes (spectrum, pulse, sway, travelling wave), a 16-band logarithmic spectrum from a 2048-point FFT on the host, and live sensitivity, strength, bass-punch and wave-speed controls. Audio is captured host-side through WASAPI loopback, so there is no permission prompt, no microphone and no screen capture. The browser half adds one attribute, one stylesheet, some CSS variables and a sidebar control row, and never patches the official component; switching it off removes the attribute, the stylesheet and the variables, returning the rail to its default styling. Windows only.
- [yuanzhenqi/dsh-mobile-ui](https://github.com/yuanzhenqi/dsh-mobile-ui) - Phone-first drawer shell for DSH Web. Collapses the session list into a tap-to-open drawer, keeps header plugin actions, and turns Settings into a full-width sheet.
- [Yuer6327/NoLetMe](https://github.com/Yuer6327/NoLetMe) - Real-time 'We need…' and 'Let me…' reasoning-trajectory keyword stats for the DeepSeek Harness web chat.
- [Yujm888/dsh-turn-rail](https://github.com/Yujm888/dsh-turn-rail) - Codex-style auto-hiding right-edge turn rail: edge-peek show/hide, per-turn tooltip, in-rail search, and a scrolling 30-turn window for long sessions.
- [YukoZ1227/dsh-ui-design-toggle](https://github.com/YukoZ1227/dsh-ui-design-toggle) - Requires the ui-ux-pro-max design skill to be installed; this plugin only gates it. Adds a switch to the DSH sidebar footer that enables or disables the ui-ux-pro-max design skill at runtime; the choice is stored in the profile settings.
- [yuloop/dsh-web-split](https://github.com/yuloop/dsh-web-split) - Split-screen panel for the Web UI: draggable panes, each rendering one Session's real conversation, with unread dots and a layout saved per browser.
- [yuluo554/dsh-prompt-polisher](https://github.com/yuluo554/dsh-prompt-polisher) - Composer prompt polisher: a button in the input tool row rewrites the current draft through the session model (workflow engine, enabled automatically) or an OpenAI-compatible standalone API with host-side key storage, backfills the rewritten text with a replace/give-up dialog when the draft changed mid-run, and ships concise/structured style presets, custom templates with a {draft} placeholder, one-click restore from the status dock and reference-chip protection.
- [yumiao-dev/dsh-chat-thinking-editor](https://github.com/yumiao-dev/dsh-chat-thinking-editor) - Adds an edit action to finalized assistant replies in DeepSeek Harness, letting you rewrite the reply text or reasoning chain; the edit is saved as a surface replacement.
- [yumm007/dsh-reveal-files](https://github.com/yumm007/dsh-reveal-files) - Turns each produced-file chip into a per-file menu: open the file, copy its path, reveal it in the native file browser, or open a terminal cd-ed into its directory.
- [YunLiZeMeng/dsh-window-control](https://github.com/YunLiZeMeng/dsh-window-control) - Tired of going fullscreen by hand every time you open Harness? This plugin fills the screen for you - auto-maximize (keeps the window buttons) or true fullscreen on launch, then maximize / restore / minimize / always-on-top anytime. It quits only after a native confirmation dialog - Esc, double Esc, or Ctrl+Q; in fullscreen, Esc leaves fullscreen first. The window channel installs itself, so no script or Python is needed; the first install takes effect after two DSH restarts.
- [yunxiyang/dsh-wide-conversation](https://github.com/yunxiyang/dsh-wide-conversation) - Sets the DSH web client conversation column to a percentage of its own width (40-100, default 100 = full width) instead of the built-in 680-920px reading measure, edited from a collapsible card under Settings > Plugins.
- [Yur0918/dsh-sidepanel](https://github.com/Yur0918/dsh-sidepanel) - A Codex-style right side panel for the DSH Web UI — session artifacts browser (live file tree, scan include, preview, reveal) plus a side chat that forks the current session with a model picker, human-pacing scheduled runs and smart send-to-bottom scrolling.
- [Yur0918/dsh-soul](https://github.com/Yur0918/dsh-soul) - SoulFusion-style personalization: 9 response styles, custom instructions, persona cards, per-session switching, long-term memory with audit trails.
- [yushui6666/dsh-learning-mode](https://github.com/yushui6666/dsh-learning-mode) - Learning Mode toggle in the input toolbar: injects a teaching prompt into the current session so the assistant introduces a topic, teaches it, tests it, and corrects mistakes, rendering graded quizzes through GenUI. Requires the GenUI plugin (@changfenhuang/dsh-genui); without it the teaching text still works but quizzes, sliders and charts degrade to plain text.
- [yusufameri/dsh-t3-model-picker](https://github.com/yusufameri/dsh-t3-model-picker) - A port of the T3 Code model picker into the composer: a provider rail, search results grouped under provider headings, favorites kept in the browser, unavailable-provider badges, and Cmd/Ctrl+1..9 jump shortcuts for the first nine rows of the visible list.
- [yusufameri/dsh-t3-new-session-screen](https://github.com/yusufameri/dsh-t3-new-session-screen) - A T3 Code-style New Session screen for the composer: a "What should we build in <project>?" headline whose project name opens a workspace menu, a reasoning-effort picker in the composer tool row, and a git branch strip under the card that searches local and remote refs and switches with git checkout.
- [yusufameri/dsh-t3-session-ui](https://github.com/yusufameri/dsh-t3-session-ui) - Session-context surfaces ported from T3 Code: a session-row hover card showing machine, git branch, model, agent preset, approval policy and token usage, a status pill covering pending approval, awaiting input, working, error and subagent work, a provider and model chip, a per-session header strip, a lineage breadcrumb, row-menu actions that copy the context or run DSH compaction, and a preference row in DSH Settings for choosing which facts appear. Nothing is added to the composer.
- [yutao8/dsh-custom-style](https://github.com/yutao8/dsh-custom-style) - Adds a Custom CSS section to Settings for adjusting dialog dimensions, font sizes, full-window wallpapers, and inspecting stable selectors.
- [yutianliang/dsh-assistant-bubble](https://github.com/yutianliang/dsh-assistant-bubble) - Adds a configurable bubble behind assistant replies, with an optional liquid-glass material and matching chrome for process, tool-call and reasoning rows.
- [Yuuhann1999/dsh-bloub-mood](https://github.com/Yuuhann1999/dsh-bloub-mood) - Animated mood icon: swaps the favicon, sidebar wordmark and hero headline for bloub expression animations that follow session state (working / awaiting input / done / idle), with 8 shapes, 12 colors and custom wordmark texts configurable in Settings.
- [yzhclcl/dsh-plan-build-mode](https://github.com/yzhclcl/dsh-plan-build-mode) - Plan / Build mode switcher for DeepSeek Harness: an always-visible dropdown in the composer beside the permission control that switches the current session both ways through the shipped /plan and /plan off commands, plus a Default mode row in Settings → General that decides the starting mode for newly created sessions.
- [YZz-S/dsh-workspace-files-explorer](https://github.com/YZz-S/dsh-workspace-files-explorer) - Floating workspace file-tree browser for the Web GUI with line-numbered syntax highlighting and Markdown preview.
- [z1223473749/dsh-QiuYaTools](https://github.com/z1223473749/dsh-QiuYaTools) - Adds TXT attachments, session windows, batch archiving, plan comments, menu shortcuts, next-message suggestions and an optional Q theme. Computer use ships in 0.6.x, is on default and needs screen-recording and accessibility permission. Suggestions use the current model with extra usage.
- [Zai-G/dsh-preset-workshop](https://github.com/Zai-G/dsh-preset-workshop) - Preset workbench for editing per-agent personas, system prompt sections and tool descriptions, selecting tools and skills, previewing request context, and importing or exporting JSON/YAML configurations.
- [zclDragon/dsh-side-chat](https://github.com/zclDragon/dsh-side-chat) - Codex-style /side side conversations for DeepSeek Harness: a temporary fork of the current chat in a floating panel, inheriting context without interrupting the main task.
- [zealot00/dsh-pet](https://github.com/zealot00/dsh-pet) - Desktop pet for the DSH Web UI: sprite-sheet animation, agent state linkage, drag, alarm (daily/one-shot) and pomodoro widgets, skin picker with preview.
- [zengxiaolou/dsh-annotation](https://github.com/zengxiaolou/dsh-annotation) - Annotate quoted answer text in the transcript: each selection keeps its quote plus a note of your own, notes pile up as chips in the composer and travel with the message, and two or more also get a chip above the input to jump back or clear them. The chips need dsh-paste-chip installed; without it each note is a plain text line in the draft.
- [zengxiaolou/dsh-effort-dial](https://github.com/zengxiaolou/dsh-effort-dial) - Reasoning-effort slider for the DeepSeek Harness composer: drag through the thinking levels the current model declares and release to write the chosen level into the session. An auto band escalates one level after a tool error and another after two or more, and optional model routing picks a provider/model per task type.
- [zengxiaolou/dsh-paste-chip](https://github.com/zengxiaolou/dsh-paste-chip) - Collapses long pasted text into an expandable chip in the composer: hover shows the body and where it came from, sending expands it back in place, and long text written by other plugins is taken over the same way.
- [Zenjibad/dsh-any-attachment](https://github.com/Zenjibad/dsh-any-attachment) - Lets the DSH web UI attach files of any type as pathless @-mentions: pick a workspace file from the @ menu or drop one into the composer, and the agent reads it directly.
- [Zenjibad/dsh-drop-any-file](https://github.com/Zenjibad/dsh-drop-any-file) - Extends the DSH web chat drag-and-drop to accept every file type: non-image files are saved into the active session workspace so the agent can read and use them.
- [Zenjibad/dsh-mcp-toggle](https://github.com/Zenjibad/dsh-mcp-toggle) - Enables or disables MCP servers from Settings → MCP Servers: stops or starts each @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client connection immediately and persists the change across restarts.
- [zenvertao/dsh-inline-comments](https://github.com/zenvertao/dsh-inline-comments) - Annotate on selection, persist through refresh; send the notes with your message and the model answers each one.
- [Zephinel/dsh-intelligent-ui](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-intelligent-ui) - Render OpenUI Lang answers as interactive cards or reading articles in DSH chat, with maps, charts, forms, PNG export and standalone interactive HTML export.
- [zerorigin-studio/dsh-deepseek-chat](https://github.com/zerorigin-studio/dsh-deepseek-chat) - Web chat entry for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar button opening chat.deepseek.com in a dedicated desktop window under dsh-desktop, with in-webview fallback for plain web environments.
- [zerorigin-studio/dsh-desktop-shell](https://github.com/zerorigin-studio/dsh-desktop-shell) - A dsh web plugin that wraps the running Harness in a native Windows desktop window: it bundles a Wails v3 desktop client (so installing the plugin is enough), probes the web port and writes the ~/.dsh/dsh-web-port.json protocol file for the client, registers a system tray, desktop/Start Menu shortcuts and a startup autostart toggle, and the client can start dsh itself if it is not running.
- [zeusxx/dsh-composer-live](https://github.com/zeusxx/dsh-composer-live) - Live Markdown rendering and typing enhancements for the DSH web composer - syntax-highlighted code blocks, list/quote continuation, format toolbars.
- [zhang-guangjie/dsh-video-bg](https://github.com/zhang-guangjie/dsh-video-bg) - Play a local video behind the DeepSeek Harness chat UI, with play/pause, opacity, scrim and fit controls.
- [zhang24xiao/dsh-snippets](https://github.com/zhang24xiao/dsh-snippets) - Manages CSS and JS snippets for the DSH web GUI, injecting enabled CSS as style elements and running enabled JS in the page, with a sidebar-footer quick toggle, its own page in the Settings navigation, and optional folder or Gist sync.
- [ZhangBo-cmd/dsh-coros-badge](https://github.com/ZhangBo-cmd/dsh-coros-badge) - Shows the linked COROS watch model and cumulative activity days in the Web UI, expanding to a one-line review and suggestion when clicked.
- [ZhangBo-cmd/dsh-pricing-badge](https://github.com/ZhangBo-cmd/dsh-pricing-badge) - Shows the DeepSeek API peak and off-peak hours, the current model's output price and the account balance in the Web UI.
- [zhangliang0115/ai-plugin#dsh-plugin](https://github.com/zhangliang0115/ai-plugin/tree/main/dsh-plugin) - Aipx toolkit: skills plus a Hub Console that fronts every MCP server with ~4 meta tools — server pool health, per-tool enable/disable, a tool catalog, and a search playground showing exactly what mcp_search hands the model.
- [zhangTELL/dsh-diagram](https://github.com/zhangTELL/dsh-diagram) - Renders mermaid code blocks in the chat as diagrams in place (flowchart, sequence, class, state, ER, gantt, pie), with zoom, source toggle, copy PNG and SVG download.
- [zhao-guang-ai/dsh-quote-annotate-pro](https://github.com/zhao-guang-ai/dsh-quote-annotate-pro) - Adds selection quoting and anchored annotations to DSH conversations: selected text enters the composer as an anchored quote reference, a quote bar jumps back to the source message and highlights it, and the sent quote block names the turn and role it came from.
- [zhaochengggg/dsh-a2ui-studio](https://github.com/zhaochengggg/dsh-a2ui-studio) - A2UI-inspired agent-authored application cards with a persistent machine directory, SSH probes, and reviewed monitoring and control actions. SSH probes require OpenSSH (ssh, ssh-keyscan, ssh-keygen).
- [zhaoxiagongsi001/dsh-prompt-forge](https://github.com/zhaoxiagongsi001/dsh-prompt-forge) - Prompt optimizer for the composer: a button in the tool row rewrites your draft through a model channel you already configured, streaming into a panel that floats above the composer without taking up layout. Your draft changes only when you click Accept — and Accept is refused while the answer is still streaming, so a half-finished reply can never be written back. It asks first when the draft carries @ references or attachments, which a whole-draft replace would flatten into plain text. No global keyboard shortcuts, and no API key ever reaches the browser: the host half makes the call.
- [ZhaoZeW/dsh-rollback](https://github.com/ZhaoZeW/dsh-rollback) - TRAE-style conversation rollback rebuilt for DSH 0.1.7-rc.2: per-turn file checkpoints restore touched files and truncate the model context in place under the same session id. Adds a /rollback doctor framework-contract self-check, an affected-file diff preview computed against the current on-disk state so it stays correct after a restart, a one-click undo-last action with a Ctrl+Shift+Z shortcut, a setting for whether rolled-back messages stay hidden, and English UI text.
- [ZhaoZiyangShaanxi/dsh-netease-music](https://github.com/ZhaoZiyangShaanxi/dsh-netease-music) - Windows only, needs the NetEase Cloud Music client installed. NetEase Cloud Music player for the DSH Web UI: a mini bar that expands into a liquid-glass card with search, synced lyrics and volume, a click-to-open spinning vinyl view, and it signs in with the local NetEase client account (cookie decrypted on this machine only) so VIP tracks play and the client current song can be pulled in.
- [dsh-settings-nav-organizer](https://github.com/zhengjy01/dsh-settings-nav-organizer) - Declutter the DSH settings nav: fold third-party plugin entries under collapsible group rows, with bookmark-style custom groups, a fold toggle, and auto classification (market tags → name rules → your AI model).
- [zhengzeyong9527-droid/ai-input-enhancer](https://github.com/zhengzeyong9527-droid/ai-input-enhancer) - Adds prompt optimization, cancellation, and undo controls to the DeepSeek Harness composer.
- [zheshiyigehenchang/dsh-chat-typography](https://github.com/zheshiyigehenchang/dsh-chat-typography) - Set the DSH Harness conversation flow's font, font size and line spacing, plus the padding between the conversation text and the window edges.
- [zhifengjiang/dsh-hover-archive](https://github.com/zhifengjiang/dsh-hover-archive) - Codex-style session archiving: hovering a sidebar conversation row reveals an Archive icon at the far right; one click archives the session via the official workspace archive API.
- [zhishengplus/dsh-image-annotate](https://github.com/zhishengplus/dsh-image-annotate) - Draws circles, arrows, boxes and text on the DSH image preview, keeps every mark selectable so it can be dragged, scaled or re-edited later, and attaches the flattened PNG to the composer at the original image resolution.
- [zhousun55-byte/dsh-postman](https://github.com/zhousun55-byte/dsh-postman) - Upload files and folders straight into the conversation — images attach as real message blocks, text content is written into the composer draft, folders land by directory structure.
- [zhqowo/dsh-whale-tray](https://github.com/zhqowo/dsh-whale-tray) - Whale tray launcher for DeepSeek Harness: a Windows system-tray app and a macOS menu-bar app that start/stop the dsh service, summon the Web UI, restart and top up — running independently of the dsh process, like a Steam launcher for dsh.
- [zhu1090093659/dsh-web#packages/dsh-task-board](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/tree/main/packages/dsh-task-board) - Task board for the dsh web GUI: a sidebar multi-column kanban whose cards run in real DSH agent sessions and can also be scheduled with cron expressions, executed host-side even with the browser closed.
- [zhu1090093659/dsh-web#packages/dsh-web-all](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/tree/main/packages/dsh-web-all) - Plugin and skin collection for the DSH Web UI: task board, Git graph, right-side panel, remote mobile UI, pet, live token stats, and a skin center.
- [zhubaohi/dsh-gpu-pulse](https://github.com/zhubaohi/dsh-gpu-pulse) - Floating GPU monitor for the DSH Web UI: a compact, draggable strip with one row per discrete GPU (exact name, utilization, VRAM, temperature, power draw) from nvidia-smi, stays visible over side panels and side cards, with a top-VRAM-process list when the driver reports it; degrades to an n/a pill on machines without an NVIDIA driver.
- [zhuifengqug/dsh-adaptive-reasoning](https://github.com/zhuifengqug/dsh-adaptive-reasoning) - Pixel-art reasoning-effort slider for DSH Web with continuous 0–100 dragging, 16ms throttled writes, snap-to-level commits, and a WebGL ember fire that ignites as the slider moves.
- [zhujiuyi/dsh-leftpanel](https://github.com/zhujiuyi/dsh-leftpanel) - Lists every entry that can appear in the left sidebar and gives each panel entry its own hide/show switch from a section in Settings.
- [zhuran305-web/dsh-feedback-combined](https://github.com/zhuran305-web/dsh-feedback-combined) - One-click thumbs up/down feedback UI that injects rating summaries into model context.
- [zhxnix/dsh-sidebar-annotations](https://github.com/zhxnix/dsh-sidebar-annotations) - Browser and mini-program element annotations with collapsible composer notes and source locations.
- [Zian-anson/dsh-prompt-seed](https://github.com/Zian-anson/dsh-prompt-seed) - Rewrites drafts with one model call or predicts the next reply when empty; independent tasks, safe draft replacement, result previews, and original-text recovery.
- [ZichengGurrr/dsh-window#kit](https://github.com/ZichengGurrr/dsh-window/tree/main/kit) - All-in-one bundle for DSH: the native Windows desktop window (WebView2), DeepEye vision (GLM-4V-Flash), and voice input (mic button) in a single install.
- [ZichengGurrr/dsh-window#plugin](https://github.com/ZichengGurrr/dsh-window/tree/main/plugin) - Native Windows desktop window (WebView2) for DSH: one-command install, auto-fetches the app zip from GitHub Releases, creates a desktop shortcut, and adds a desktop_launch tool to start it from chat.
- [ZilongYang/dsh-multiline-input](https://github.com/ZilongYang/dsh-multiline-input) - Single/multi-line composer toggle for the DSH Web GUI: an editable shortcut (registered through the harness shortcut service) — Cmd/Ctrl+E on desktop builds and Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+E in the browser, with Linux browsers unbound until you pick one — switches the composer between its native single-line shape and a four-line-plus draft area; a small tab on the composer shoulder always shows the current shortcut and target mode; while multi-line, Enter inserts a newline and Shift+Enter sends, and the mode is remembered per device.
- [Zimeng-Luo/dsh-source-fold](https://github.com/Zimeng-Luo/dsh-source-fold) - Replaces the composer model picker with a compact panel for provider-to-model navigation and an adaptive reasoning-effort slider, with a Default stop and no slider for models without adjustable efforts.
- [zirscard/dsh-taskboard-epic](https://github.com/zirscard/dsh-taskboard-epic) - A client-side panel for DeepSeek Harness: it stacks the epic cards of a dsh-taskboard project in their epic:children order, shows the position, code, name and version of every module along the arc, and marks the start, middle and end modules. The order can be changed by drag or by buttons, and the new order is written back through the the taskboard own public update API, so it persists and is shared by everyone viewing the project. Requires the cloader/dsh-taskboard plugin.
- [ZIye1208/dsh-settings-nav-manager](https://github.com/ZIye1208/dsh-settings-nav-manager) - Adds edit mode to the DSH settings nav for drag-reordering, per-section show/hide and named collapsible drawer grouping saved in the plugin's own settings namespace, plus pinning up to five sections to the main sidebar for one-click access.
- [zizhongfeiyang/dsh-settings-drawer](https://github.com/zizhongfeiyang/dsh-settings-drawer) - Lets you choose which items appear in the DeepSeek Harness settings left nav.
- [zkl22492-star/Toolfolk-for-DSH](https://github.com/zkl22492-star/Toolfolk-for-DSH) - Visualize the plugin and model call flow as a 3D office with six fixed workstations, thought bubbles and a delivery sheet.
- [zlqd123/dsh-composer-keys](https://github.com/zlqd123/dsh-composer-keys) - Composer key remap for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: bind Enter, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter, Shift+Enter or any custom chord to the Send, Newline or Interrupt actions, with cross-action migration, durable persistence and native behavior preserved by default.
- [zmh2000829/DSH-agent-bridge](https://github.com/zmh2000829/DSH-agent-bridge) - Adds a Web composer switch between the native DSH agent and Grok Build, proxying Grok Build sessions and slash commands through ACP.
- [zmm863-commits/dsh-paperclip](https://github.com/zmm863-commits/dsh-paperclip) - DSH Web GUI paperclip button: a 📎 button in the composer opens a file picker (drag & drop supported) and inserts file contents into the textarea.
- [zmm863-commits/dsh-sticky-notes](https://github.com/zmm863-commits/dsh-sticky-notes) - Quick sticky notes with colored labels, pin, timed reminders, and password protection for DeepSeek Harness.
- [zoe1nan/dsh-cockpit](https://github.com/zoe1nan/dsh-cockpit) - Command deck for DeepSeek Harness: a live session rail and team roster, a task board with approvals and write actions, an activity stream, and a desktop HUD capsule that follows the working conversation. The HUD capsule is Windows-only.
- [zoe1nan/dsh-startup-intro](https://github.com/zoe1nan/dsh-startup-intro) - Startup video intro with per-clip playback parameters (segment, speed, brightness, fit, blurred cinema fill, hold ratio and fade duration) and light/dark clip variants selected by the app theme.
- [ZRAZN/dsh-effort-slider-split-seat](https://github.com/ZRAZN/dsh-effort-slider-split-seat) - Fork of dsh-effort-slider that splits the composer model seat into two buttons: the model name opens the model list, the effort label opens the Claude-style slider with WebGL fire.
- [zrrrrrrr77/dsh-print-screen](https://github.com/zrrrrrrr77/dsh-print-screen) - Adds a scissors button to the DSH composer: freeze the desktop, drag a region, and insert the crop as an image attachment. Ctrl+Alt+1 captures with DSH hidden, Ctrl+Shift+Alt+1 keeps DSH visible. Windows only.
- [ZSeven-W/dsh-openpencil](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/dsh-openpencil) - OpenPencil design preview and editing plugin.
- [zszz3/dsh-model-provider-prefix](https://github.com/zszz3/dsh-model-provider-prefix) - Replaces the composer model control with an inline Provider/Model trigger — clicking it opens a two-column card with providers on the left and the hovered provider's models on the right — and moves the reasoning effort into its own trigger beside it, unlike single-button model pickers.
- [Ztyss/dsh-draft-fold](https://github.com/Ztyss/dsh-draft-fold) - Folds long composer drafts into a compact summary card once a character threshold is reached, without changing message submission.
- [zuoguyoupan2023/adhdgofly-dsh-ext](https://github.com/zuoguyoupan2023/adhdgofly-dsh-ext) - Highlights parts of speech (nouns green, verbs red, adjectives/adverbs purple) in rendered DSH Web Markdown, with light/dark palettes, toggles, and stream-aware updates.

Tested on DSH Desktop only; the DSH web build is untested.

### Usage & Billing

- [01men/ybkkasi](https://github.com/01men/ybkkasi) - Asset governance console for self-hosted AI infrastructure. Registers MCP servers, skills, agents, AI apps, model channels, SaaS connectors and NAS storage in one ledger with a lifecycle state machine, per-tool RBAC permission points, department x agent x skill cost attribution, dependency topology and an append-only audit trail. At v1.5.0: 29 plugin packages, 450 REST routes and 86 MCP tools, with 1610 end-to-end assertions green. Self-hosted, MIT, no hosted tier and no cloud contract.

Adds hot-reloadable member budgets, 80%/100% webhook alerts, optional over-budget enforcement, a team_cost_report tool with CSV export, and a settings-page team dashboard served over a Typert RPC service.

Zero dependencies, default zero egress, session files are never written.

Peak rules (Beijing time Mon-Fri 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00; weekends, Chinese public holidays and 调休 weekends are valley all day) are evaluated in the host and served over two no-auth routes, /plugins/dsh-peak-reminder/state and /config; settings live in settings.section and are stored in ~/.dsh/peak-reminder.json.

Replays each session, classifies every turn's task complexity from its request shape (deterministic, no LLM), and reports two kinds of waste: an expensive model on cheap work (the difference is measurable), and a cheap model on expensive work that failed on its own merits — where every retry re-sends the whole context, so the downgrade cost more than the upgrade. Distinguishes provider-capacity retries (RATE_LIMIT/TIMEOUT/TRANSPORT) from model failures so it does not cry wolf. Derives routing rules from the evidence, priced against a built-in per-million table.
- [bushizhanghan/dsh-workspace-switch-cost](https://github.com/bushizhanghan/dsh-workspace-switch-cost) - Quantify what switching projects costs. Measures each workspace's cold-start overhead (AGENTS.md + skill catalog + tool schemas + runtime context), its steady state, and how many turns it takes to reach it — then compares workspaces and attributes the difference. Attribution requires at least three workspaces and says so instead of inventing a correlation from two points; a factor with no spread across workspaces is reported as a property of the profile, not of the project. Recommends which workspaces to keep warm, which to archive, by entry cost times visit frequency. Deterministic.

- [czk200518-hash/dsh-tlogs](https://github.com/czk200518-hash/dsh-tlogs) - Token usage meter in the DSH sidebar footer that runs both data sources at once rather than picking one: the DeepSeek platform account's usage and cost endpoints, which cover every device on the account but only the official channel, and local session logs, which cover this machine in real time across every provider but carry no cost. The two are merged per day — the official channel takes the larger figure, since one call is recorded by both, and providers the platform cannot see are added on top. History is backfilled month by month from the platform, providers are classified by channel rather than model name, days follow the platform's UTC boundary, and no token has to be pasted because the platform figures reuse the DSH account you are already signed in to. Totals appear as all-time, current-project, today, week, month, last-7 and last-30 in a compact bar, an expand panel and a detail modal with calendar, chart, model, provider, year, month and day tabs.

In off-peak mode every task, including one already running, is held at its next agent step or tool dispatch when a Beijing peak window starts (Monday to Friday 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00, statutory holidays excluded), and one timer releases it at the boundary; weekends and holidays are idle all day. - [ParticleLight/dsh-all-usage](https://github.com/ParticleLight/dsh-all-usage) - Analyze usage across models, providers, workspaces, and time ranges — including custom start/end dates over the full retained history — with live cache-hit visibility and separate model and provider breakdowns. Includes hourly single-day trends, daily cross-day trends, a 53-week GitHub-style heatmap, usage streaks, model and workspace Token-share donut charts with Token, cost, and percentage details, independent combinable filters, cache-efficiency trends, DeepSeek account balance, workspace aliases, CSV export, and a durable ledger that preserves successfully flushed usage after session deletion — and after a workspace is deleted, where its recorded usage is summed into one Deleted row — and rebuilds incrementally — on restart, unchanged sessions are applied from the ledger without re-reading their logs (a per-session log revision is the change signal), and only changed/new events are folded. The workspace registry is kept fresh automatically through the DSH domain/changed probe: only added/removed workspaces are reprocessed incrementally, unchanged workspaces reuse their computed aggregates and ledger with zero rescan, and usage is strictly limited to DSH-registered workspaces (unregistered cwds are ignored). After a scan, lightweight revision status fetches full history only when the Host/data state changes and exposes non-sensitive sync health (revision reuse, rereads, ledger recovery, and failures). Token accounting is explicit: input is fresh (cache read/write and reasoning are separate buckets) and zero-usage replays never overwrite recorded usage. Chinese uses local time, English uses UTC; API access is loopback-only.

- [regrevia/dsh-fast-mode](https://github.com/regrevia/dsh-fast-mode) - DeepSeek Harness's own fast mode: a few configs that set how fast a task runs — bound where thinking settles, bound the process narration, bound the steps per task — faster delivery without touching the model or its thinking strength. Measured over 10 task families and 30 complete units: the default reaches 0.72x total time, 0.74x output tokens and 0.71x steps; moving the "write it once" reminder from step 4 to step 2 gives debugfix 0.535x, ledger 0.506x, migrate 0.751x, and 0.625x pooled over 13 pairs with 0.614x output tokens (migrate alone 0.509x with 0.528x output at step 3). Hidden tests passed in every pair. Short 1-5 step repairs and data reshaping do not pay for the reminder, so try it once per task shape.

- [WFMinerva/dsh-turn-cost](https://github.com/WFMinerva/dsh-turn-cost) - Per-turn and per-session estimated cost in the DSH Web UI, computed from provider-reported token usage in four buckets with the built-in official DeepSeek CNY peak/off-peak card — peak hours are Monday-Friday 9:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00 Beijing time, weekends and Chinese statutory holidays are off-peak all day. An optional local JSON rate table overlays prices for other or self-hosted models, and models without a price show tokens only.
- [WihteCo/dsh-opencode-go-quota](https://github.com/WihteCo/dsh-opencode-go-quota) - OpenCode Go quota in the sidebar foot under the workspace list: one cell for the most constrained window plus a hover popover with the rolling 5-hour, weekly and monthly percents, each with a usage bar, an elapsed-time marker, the remaining share and a reset countdown, refreshed every 60 seconds from OpenCode's official usage API using the key already in the DSH credential store.
- [wingsky-1/dsh-plugin-hub#packages/dsh-provider-usage](https://github.com/wingsky-1/dsh-plugin-hub/tree/main/packages/dsh-provider-usage) - Multi-provider usage stats framework (v2 adapter contract): persistent capsule plus detail panel; DeepSeek official (interval-bookkeeping daily usage derivation with a peak/valley countdown badge, working even without an official usage endpoint) and OpenCode Go built in; any other data source joins by dropping in a single mjs adapter file, hot-swappable from the settings page, with API keys kept on the host.
- [WJDdidi-1/ai-context-doctor#plugin](https://github.com/WJDdidi-1/ai-context-doctor/tree/main/plugin) - Scans a repository when a Harness agent starts working in it and, if more than a fifth of it is build output, lockfiles and logs, injects a note naming the largest offenders plus an .aiignore block that cuts them. Stays silent on clean repositories.
- [wjf1/dsh-plugin-usage-analytics](https://github.com/wjf1/dsh-plugin-usage-analytics) - Local-first usage analytics for DSH: subscribes to session events and aggregates tool calls, turns, errors, latency and capability usage into daily tables, shown in a sidebar panel (6 KPIs, 14-day trend, top tools, capability breakdown) and served over a fenced local HTTP API with 18 JSON-RPC methods. Zero runtime dependencies, local mode makes no outbound requests, and no message bodies are collected.
- [wjingshan/dsh-cost-gauge](https://github.com/wjingshan/dsh-cost-gauge) - Peak/off-peak billing cost dial for the DSH Web GUI: session token usage billed at the official DeepSeek peak and off-peak rates, a rate dial with a model-colored needle and switch countdown, a balance ring with a low-balance alarm, drag-to-resize, and a minimized status-lamp mode.
- [wkscc310/dsh-client-ui-cpa-quota](https://github.com/wkscc310/dsh-client-ui-cpa-quota) - CLIProxyAPI quota for DeepSeek Harness: a ring beside the model picker plus a settings panel listing every account quota windows with plans and reset times.
- [wojiao42/dsh-token-cost](https://github.com/wojiao42/dsh-token-cost) - Live token usage and estimated cost in the sidebar: the current task plus every session combined, an as-of clock for those totals, per-session time detail (elapsed, turns/steps, first-token, model vs tool time, decode speed), and a per-turn breakdown with each turn cost on hover.
- [woodfood111/dsh-token-live](https://github.com/woodfood111/dsh-token-live) - Composer readouts for the DeepSeek Harness: CJK-weighted draft token count, session spend at official peak/idle rates, context occupancy, and what the same usage would have cost on the costliest other model; client-only, with no host half and no credential access.
- [woosh2010/dsh-usage-dashboard](https://github.com/woosh2010/dsh-usage-dashboard) - DeepSeek Harness usage analytics dock on the composer: Beijing-time peak/valley pricing with all-day weekend valley rate, live balance, cross-session history, by-date drill-down and charts.
- [wssfk12138/dsh-damage-pulse](https://github.com/wssfk12138/dsh-damage-pulse) - Tracks DeepSeek token usage, per-call and session costs, and account balance with cache-aware charge animations in the DSH Web UI.
- [wwu328763-netizen/dsh-billing-compass](https://github.com/wwu328763-netizen/dsh-billing-compass) - Composer-dock billing panel: DeepSeek account balance, official per-model usage and spend with cost per 100M tokens, plus cost estimates for this run and the whole conversation. Clicking opens a popover that matches the composer's width and position; balance comes from /user/balance, usage and spend from platform's usage endpoints, and the whole-conversation total is folded read-only from the local session log. Zero dependencies (node:https + node:zlib), writes nothing to disk.
- [X-Xyy/dsh-api-balance](https://github.com/X-Xyy/dsh-api-balance) - Live DeepSeek API balance and this session's token usage in the conversation header, with a detail panel for the topped-up / granted balance split, request count, input, output and cache-hit tokens, and context pressure. The API key is read on every query and is never cached, written to disk or returned to the browser.
- [x2802490130-prog/dsh-balance-float](https://github.com/x2802490130-prog/dsh-balance-float) - A floating balance widget for the Web UI: live DeepSeek account balance with manual refresh and a Y/N-confirmed graceful exit.
- [xchannel1987/dsh-token-usage-xc](https://github.com/xchannel1987/dsh-token-usage-xc) - Token usage statistics plugin for DeepSeek Harness - today's token consumption by model, cache hit rate, 7-day trend chart, optional header badge, persistent storage with auto cleanup.
- [xfpuls/dsh-usage-suite](https://github.com/xfpuls/dsh-usage-suite) - Tracks this turn cost under the input box, today tokens and spend in the sidebar with peak and idle pricing, and pins the latest question to the top of the conversation.
- [xfqz86/dsh-usage-stats](https://github.com/xfqz86/dsh-usage-stats) - Token usage statistics by model, session and date in a sidebar panel, plus OpenCode Go quota, DeepSeek balance and Z.ai quota monitoring.
- [xgxx666/dsh-clear-usage](https://github.com/xgxx666/dsh-clear-usage) - Local Token usage dashboard in DSH Settings with hourly activity, daily heatmaps, custom date ranges, model breakdowns, local/API filters, and native cache-hit accounting, without cost estimates or composer overrides. Requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or newer.
- [xiangrikuibaize/dsh-tide-badge](https://github.com/xiangrikuibaize/dsh-tide-badge) - Billing-period and balance pill under the DSH composer: it shows the account balance and the current conversation cost alongside the peak/off-peak state and a countdown to the next switch. The peak/off-peak rules cover China statutory holidays and weekends, and the conversation cost is measured as the decrease in account balance between the plugin's 60-second idle balance refreshes.
- [XiaoOu2024/dsh-self-review](https://github.com/XiaoOu2024/dsh-self-review) - Holds every final answer before delivery, has one independent minimal-context model call re-derive and check it, and releases only the verified text; the draft is never shown. Reviewed answers cost one extra model request and appear a few seconds later.
- [xiaweiliang060035/dsh-opencode-go-usage](https://github.com/xiaweiliang060035/dsh-opencode-go-usage) - Floating widget showing real-time OpenCode Go subscription usage (rolling/weekly/monthly) for every API key, with rate-limit alerts and automatic key-pool discovery.
- [Xidong-AI/dsh-rate-limiter](https://github.com/Xidong-AI/dsh-rate-limiter) - Proactive per-provider token-bucket rate limiting that queues over-limit requests before they are sent, preventing upstream 429 errors.
- [xie-tj/dsh-token-usage-ledger](https://github.com/xie-tj/dsh-token-usage-ledger) - Persistent token-usage ledger and Web Usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness.
- [xinghe-1018/dsh-token-plan-quota](https://github.com/xinghe-1018/dsh-token-plan-quota) - Balance badge that follows the active model provider: official readings for DeepSeek, Qwen Token Plan and Aliyun BSS, plus Moonshot and OpenRouter endpoints not yet key-verified.
- [xobexo/dsh-smart-scenario-router](https://github.com/xobexo/dsh-smart-scenario-router) - Routes dsh requests by conversation scenario and retries with fallback models when requests fail.
- [xohmai/dsh-cpa-status](https://github.com/xohmai/dsh-cpa-status) - CPA account-pool status panel: sidebar health light, quota bars, success-rate ticks, and gateway key endings.
- [xraywu/dsh-service-monitor](https://github.com/xraywu/dsh-service-monitor) - Monitor the account balance for 3rd-party services those AI agents often use, such as Tavily, SerpAPI, Firecrawl, Bocha, Tinyfish, etc. Optionally you can select to inject the account balance into the system prompt, so the agent can use the services accordingly.
- [xtd1145/dsh-deepseek-cost-live](https://github.com/xtd1145/dsh-deepseek-cost-live) - Real-time DeepSeek API balance (official endpoint) and today-spend estimate (this DSH instance session-log usage x per-model price table) for the DSH web: composer dock strip, always-on floating badge, full settings dashboard (7-day trend, per-model cost, editable price table and polling, history rescan). The API key never leaves the host.
- [xueccci/dsh-prompt-lab](https://github.com/xueccci/dsh-prompt-lab) - Agent-structured prompt optimizer for DeepSeek Harness: rewrites composer drafts into role/task/context/constraint/format with normal, slim, and expand modes, a confirm modal with score, continue-optimize, and local, hybrid, DSH, or cloud-API engines.
- [xuezhining/dsh-deepseek-balance](https://github.com/xuezhining/dsh-deepseek-balance) - Shows the DeepSeek API account balance and live round-trip latency to the configured inference provider in one sidebar widget, with a configurable low-balance alert threshold. The balance needs DEEPSEEK_API_KEY configured in DSH credentials, otherwise the widget shows a missing-key notice.
- [xuzihao66/dsh-token-frugal](https://github.com/xuzihao66/dsh-token-frugal) - Cuts session input tokens three ways, each with its own switch in a panel under the composer: lossless structure-aware compression of tool results on `tools/post-execute`, then a per-tool head/tail elision that always names a recovery path through the shared spill store; tool-catalogue visibility per agent on `agent/created`; and a per-workspace memory document that recall matches against each new message and injects through `agent.inject`, so the transcript is not re-read. Measured 41.76% fewer prompt tokens over 149 recorded requests, with a bundled script that re-measures any profile.
- [xxvk/dsh-cost-crystal](https://github.com/xxvk/dsh-cost-crystal) - Floating cost crystal for the Web UI: balance card, real-time tok/s, peak/off-peak billing countdown, last-24h spend, and a 🔮 next-message cost forecast, all timezone-aware.
- [y2zyyr/dsh-token-usage-sidebar](https://github.com/y2zyyr/dsh-token-usage-sidebar) - Persistent local token-usage accounting for DSH Web with automatic history discovery and compact provider/model details.
- [yangyongzhen/dsh-session-report](https://github.com/yangyongzhen/dsh-session-report) - Per-session cost & usage report cards: tokens, cache hits, duration.
- [yanlijin/dsh-qwen-balance](https://github.com/yanlijin/dsh-qwen-balance) - Alibaba Cloud / Qwen balance card above the Settings row in the DSH web sidebar: account available and cash balance, coupon balances with expiry dates (student vouchers included) read through the BSS OpenAPI, and OpenAI-compatible relay quota. An official DashScope sk- key has no balance endpoint at all, so real money and coupons require an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey with bss:DescribeCoupons + bss:DescribeAcccount (AliyunBSSReadOnlyAccess is enough); secrets stay in the host process, the browser only sees a masked AccessKey ID, and /api/dsh-qwen-balance/* is loopback-only.
- [Ychris12138/dsh-usage-stats](https://github.com/Ychris12138/dsh-usage-stats) - Multi-provider usage dashboard with provider/model token breakdowns, calendar drill-downs, account balances, and OpenCode Go / Z.ai subscription quota tracking.
- [yflmq001/dsh-cost-tracker](https://github.com/yflmq001/dsh-cost-tracker) - Per-model token cost tracking with configurable cache-hit/miss, output and peak-window pricing, a live session cost bar, and unconfigured-model flags.
- [Yhx888/dsh-free-egg-credits](https://github.com/Yhx888/dsh-free-egg-credits) - Free Egg credits panel for the DSH sidebar: WorkBuddy / Qoder account balances, daily budget, check-in state and per-turn spend (WorkBuddy credits priced per input / cache / output token type where rates are known), with one-click switching of the platform whose credits are spent first when new-api is configured. Requires a local WorkBuddy2API or Qoder gateway.
- [yijiezhong/dsh-output-setting](https://github.com/yijiezhong/dsh-output-setting) - Auto-expand reasoning and tool cards, tune code-block font size and line spacing, and choose the model output language (auto, Chinese or English).
- [Yinxe/deepseek-harness-plugins#archive/token-meter](https://github.com/Yinxe/deepseek-harness-plugins/tree/main/archive/token-meter) - Unified token quota and usage statistics for dsh: multi-vendor rolling/payg quota with sidebar cards and provider ops, plus session-log token aggregation with trends, heatmap, and per-model breakdown. Frozen archive: keep the pinned version, as the author no longer adapts it to newer DSH releases.
- [Yochor-Debug/dsh-float](https://github.com/Yochor-Debug/dsh-float) - Floating DeepSeek API balance capsule for the DSH Web GUI: a corner pill shows the remaining balance, clicking expands the total, granted and topped-up breakdown, double-clicking refreshes at once and the balance polls every 5 seconds; the host half proxies /user/balance so the key never reaches the browser.
- [yoiizesdev-crypto/DSH-Balance-display](https://github.com/yoiizesdev-crypto/DSH-Balance-display) - Real-time DeepSeek account balance badge in the sidebar footer with odometer roll animation, multi-currency support, balance trend chart, per-key usage statistics with historical backfill, and GitHub version auto-check.
- [yokesky/dsh-usage-lens](https://github.com/yokesky/dsh-usage-lens) - Usage statistics dashboard for the DSH Web UI: info cards, a 280-day GitHub-style activity heatmap, daily token trend, and model-usage donut chart.
- [Young4ever33/dsh-token-attention](https://github.com/Young4ever33/dsh-token-attention) - Token attention management panel for DeepSeek Harness: per-task/day/week/month token usage and cost tracking (input hit/miss, output, reasoning), DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing, task-type recognition, and advice on when to switch sessions, write a hand-off, or compact context.
- [ypingcn/dsh-web-search-insights](https://github.com/ypingcn/dsh-web-search-insights) - Web search insights for the agent: it keeps a local log of what was looked up and which pages came back, and counts searches, returned pages, citations and pages opened per turn and across the session, with the numbers shown in a small entry under the answer and a right-sidebar panel.
- [YQzhangsan/dsh-sidebar-usage](https://github.com/YQzhangsan/dsh-sidebar-usage) - Keeps DeepSeek usage and account balance in a bar at the bottom of the window.
- [yyb16yyb-hub/dsh-deepseek-usage](https://github.com/yyb16yyb-hub/dsh-deepseek-usage) - Real-time DeepSeek API usage: account balance with low-balance alerts (browser notification on threshold crossing), token & request stats (total/today/last-60s windows, per-model and per-session), estimated cost — a composer dock plus a settings-page usage panel.
- [YZz-S/dsh-billing-balance](https://github.com/YZz-S/dsh-billing-balance) - Shows DeepSeek API account balance and Volcengine Ark Coding/Agent Plan quota windows (5h/weekly/monthly with reset countdowns) in the settings panel, composer dock, and a draggable floating refresh button.
- [YZz-S/dsh-token-cost-meter](https://github.com/YZz-S/dsh-token-cost-meter) - Real-time session token usage and estimated cost in the composer stats row, with pricing fetched from DeepSeek official pricing page.
- [zdt3476/dsh-metrics](https://github.com/zdt3476/dsh-metrics) - Token usage and cost dashboard: requests, tokens, RPM/TPM over the last 60 minutes, cache hit rate, per-model and per-provider breakdown, a 12-month activity heatmap, and cost estimated from OpenRouter prices. Data stays in a local ledger; no telemetry.
- [zeng6125-rgb/dsh-usage-heatmap](https://github.com/zeng6125-rgb/dsh-usage-heatmap) - Token usage dashboard in the DSH settings page: nine metric cards (total, today, yesterday, peak day, longest session, active-day streak, active days, sessions, subagent tokens), a GitHub-style daily/weekly/cumulative heatmap, and an activity insight list, aggregated locally from session logs and projection caches, keeping token history after a session is deleted.
- [Zenjibad/deepseek-cost-usage-status-plugin](https://github.com/Zenjibad/deepseek-cost-usage-status-plugin) - Adds a colored status line under the DSH conversation stats showing live DeepSeek API cost, usage and account balance, with on/off-peak pricing indicators.
- [Zenjibad/headroom-stats-plugin](https://github.com/Zenjibad/headroom-stats-plugin) - Shows real-time token and cost savings from the Headroom compression proxy in the DSH web UI: a Settings dashboard plus a persistent stats line under the composer.
- [Zenjibad/llmtrim-stats-plugin](https://github.com/Zenjibad/llmtrim-stats-plugin) - Live llmtrim savings dashboard in the DSH web UI: Settings page with paid, would-have-cost, saved-today and saved-this-week cards plus per-model breakdown, and a configurable rotating or static stats strip under the composer.
- [zer0zio-stack/dsh-opencode-go-quota](https://github.com/zer0zio-stack/dsh-opencode-go-quota) - Bottom-right 余额 badge for the DSH Web UI: on expand it fetches the currently-selected provider's OpenCode Go plan limits or DeepSeek prepaid balance, plus local token usage and pricing-based spend estimates.
- [zh667/TokenLedger](https://github.com/zh667/TokenLedger) - Sidebar usage panel that attributes tokens to the relay site that served each request, read from your existing provider config: today/month/all-time totals, per-site and per-model breakdowns, a year activity heatmap, and New API / Sub2API / DeepSeek balances.
- [zhang-jiazhi/dsh-stats-panel](https://github.com/zhang-jiazhi/dsh-stats-panel) - Token usage statistics for DeepSeek Harness. Per-channel usage with balances and plan quotas for mainstream providers, CNY cost estimates, and daily charts — a settings-sidebar section.
- [ZhaoZiyangShaanxi/dsh-codex-plus](https://github.com/ZhaoZiyangShaanxi/dsh-codex-plus) - See your real ChatGPT / Codex subscription quota inside DSH. Reads /wham/usage: 5-hour and weekly windows, reset countdown, extra-usage balance, additional limit groups and the code-review limit; lists and redeems server-issued reset credits with a stable, retry-safe idempotency key; switches between multiple accounts; reads /codex/models to show the account's real model catalog, showing empty rather than a built-in list when unavailable. One-click sign-in from Settings (browser authorization or device code, with a paste-the-callback fallback); credentials stay in DSH's credential service. Model calls reuse DSH's built-in llm-pi-ai Codex route instead of claiming a provider route — it degrades to a pure quota console when another plugin owns it. A remaining-quota chip sits beside the composer.
- [zhifeiNi/dsh-usage-orb](https://github.com/zhifeiNi/dsh-usage-orb) - Cross-session usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: an always-on usage ring plus a draggable panel that aggregates token usage, cache-hit rate, cost and balance from local session logs, with per-tool cost attribution, iOS-style tile layout editing and an optional animated companion face.
- [zhongyichang1998/dsh-mini-usage](https://github.com/zhongyichang1998/dsh-mini-usage) - Local token totals, per-model usage and a 12-week heatmap in a Chinese sidebar panel.
- [zhouchengke2046/dsh-sidebar-balance](https://github.com/zhouchengke2046/dsh-sidebar-balance) - DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows the DeepSeek API account balance and OpenCode Go plan usage (consumption ring, hover details) in the sidebar footer, with adaptive polling and zh/en locale support.
- [zhu168/dsh-save-money#plugin](https://github.com/zhu168/dsh-save-money/tree/main/plugin) - Pause and resume tasks automatically during user-defined time windows to avoid peak-hour API costs; includes account balance display and 10-minute granularity spend bar chart.
- [zhujiuyi/dsh-balance-meter](https://github.com/zhujiuyi/dsh-balance-meter) - Reads the API balance or subscription quota behind the current DSH route — including OpenDesign (AMR) wallet and Design Plan windows via the control plane — and never guesses a figure: a miss reports its cause (the raw response is echoed only when parsing fails). OpenDesign needs `vela login` or a desktop `controlKey` in `~/.amr/config.json`.
- [zhujiuyi/dsh-tokenDashBoard](https://github.com/zhujiuyi/dsh-tokenDashBoard) - Token usage dashboard in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: daily totals from session logs with a 12-month heatmap, per-provider breakdown over today/7d/30d/all (hourly for today) including each route's average output speed, and a per-session ranking that includes archived and deleted sessions and folds subagent usage into its parent.
- [zhujunzhujunzhu/ai-token-report#dsh-plugin](https://github.com/zhujunzhujunzhu/ai-token-report/tree/main/packages/dsh-plugin) - Token usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: a bar above the composer opens billing token totals, trend charts, per-model and per-project breakdowns and a custom date range, read from local session logs of DSH, Codex, Claude Code, Trae and WorkBuddy. With a self-hosted portal URL and an app key it also reports usage events to that portal; with neither configured it collects nothing. It exposes token_usage tools plus a ctx.tokenReport service, and never collects conversation content.
- [zhuzichen362/dsh-call-shrink](https://github.com/zhuzichen362/dsh-call-shrink) - Extreme LLM-call compression for DeepSeek Harness: title short-circuit, in-flight dedup, 24h replay cache, and batch-merging N parallel requests into 1 upstream call via a `[[TASK n]]`/`[[ANSWER n]]` delimiter protocol - fewer API calls, less spend, same answers.
- [ZiOstudio/dsh-budget-handoff](https://github.com/ZiOstudio/dsh-budget-handoff) - Session budget gate for DeepSeek Harness: prices every turn against the official price table, warns at 80%, stops the task at 100%, and writes a handoff snapshot so the next session can continue the work.
- [Zoria-Lind/dsh-token-optimizer](https://github.com/Zoria-Lind/dsh-token-optimizer) - Token-cost pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: pressure-aware layered compaction (lossless projection below 40% context pressure, LLM summarization above), per-agent tool allowlisting, long-text-to-image with vision summarization, and a /token-status command tracking pressure, tiers, and saved tokens.
- [zouxiaoyang/dsh-commandcode-usage](https://github.com/zouxiaoyang/dsh-commandcode-usage) - CommandCode usage & balance panel for DeepSeek Harness: API usage, credit balance, 5-hour/weekly windows from the sidebar footer.
- [zy12342/usage-widget](https://github.com/zy12342/usage-widget) - Sidebar account-balance quick view for DeepSeek Harness: balance, bonus credit, current model and the official peak/off-peak pricing period, with ruby/amber/jade/gold tiers and a low-balance warning.

### Themes & Appearance

- [0nt-one/dsh-neo-skin](https://github.com/0nt-one/dsh-neo-skin) - Neo-brutalism skin with two switchable schemes (Blue Command / Aged Newspaper), hard shadows, sharp corners, and light/dark theme support.
- [1015677515/dsh-theme-holo](https://github.com/1015677515/dsh-theme-holo) - Spice and Wolf theme for DeepSeek Harness: parchment palette, closable 12-second intro, six switchable right-rail standby clips, draggable wordmark and peeker, sidebar wheat layer, and one-click Holo role import for dsh-whale-widget.
- [137/dsh-chatgpt-style](https://github.com/137/dsh-chatgpt-style) - ChatGPT-like conversation layout for the DeepSeek Harness Web client: a 768px centered column, right-aligned neutral bubbles for user turns, full-width assistant text at 16/28, and rounded code blocks with their own copy banner. Adds semantic inline markup (`==confirmed==`, `!!risk!!`, `++key word++`, with bare 4xx/5xx codes highlighted automatically) and line-start check/warn/tip callouts; a fast/thinking chip in the composer that switches the model reasoning effort through ctx.modelDirectories; and sidebar contrast, where the selected session gets a tinted row with an accent bar and workspace folder icons are colored.
- [4444Hao/dsh-codefall](https://github.com/4444Hao/dsh-codefall) - Adds a Matrix-inspired digital-rain startup animation for DeepSeek Harness, a rectangular light portal that opens to both sides, optional replay when the desktop window reopens, and a green UI theme with adjustable hue.
- [456erddgr/dsh-boo550wt-animation](https://github.com/456erddgr/dsh-boo550wt-animation) - Plays a full-screen video while DeepSeek Harness starts and reveals the UI only after it ends. Esc skips it.
- [AaronKate/dsh-codex-appearance](https://github.com/AaronKate/dsh-codex-appearance) - Adds an appearance settings page to DeepSeek Harness: five eye-comfort light themes, each with its own accent and link colours, plus controls for the accent and background colours, UI and code fonts and sizes, font styles, content width, contrast and reduced motion.
- [AB-png123/dshplugin](https://github.com/AB-png123/dshplugin) - Imports wallpapers newly downloaded by the Hao Wallpaper app into the DSH wallpaper engine on startup, incrementally and idempotently. Requires the Hao Wallpaper app, Python 3.8+ and the dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine plugin (elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine) installed first. Supports macOS and Windows.
- [acdsh4869/dsh-aqua-theme](https://github.com/acdsh4869/dsh-aqua-theme) - Aqua glassmorphism theme for the DSH Web UI, adapted to DSH v0.2.x and desktop v0.22.3+: the header, sidebar, composer, stats line and trajectory view become frosted glass panes over a live WebGL fluid board or an image/video wallpaper, with mica and compatibility layouts, adjustable blur, frost, hue and brightness, marine decorations (particle whale, fish, mesh, cursor glow), a one-click reset-to-defaults button, and a master switch whose off state restores the stock UI exactly; adapted from WYH66666666's original (0.1.x) and du-u-uck's 0.1.1-rc.2 port.
- [ahian-lee/dsh-bliss-glass](https://github.com/ahian-lee/dsh-bliss-glass) - Theme that pairs Windows XP-era scenery wallpapers with a modern frosted-glass interface: a fixed background layer behind the DeepSeek Harness web UI, panel styling applied through theme tokens, a wallpaper picker with custom image import, and a light/dark toggle. Works on desktop and mobile web surfaces.
- [AIR-pixel/air-pixel-liquid-glass](https://github.com/AIR-pixel/air-pixel-liquid-glass) - A configurable Liquid Glass theme for DeepSeek Harness with translucent surfaces, wallpaper, desktop transparency, window blur, custom cursors, click ripples, and per-side conversation contrast controls.
- [AKS1st/dsh-cyber-particle](https://github.com/AKS1st/dsh-cyber-particle) - Particle-network background overlay for the DSH Web shell: full-screen, click-through, zero runtime dependencies.
- [AKS1st/ikun-theme-skin](https://github.com/AKS1st/ikun-theme-skin) - IKUN fandom skin for the DSH Web UI: star-blue and black-gold palettes in the system theme list, full-screen photo wallpaper rotation, a music box, and a send-button voice line.

Frozen archive: keep the pinned version, as the author no longer adapts it to newer DSH releases.
- [ymh0000123/dsh-theme-endfield](https://github.com/ymh0000123/dsh-theme-endfield) - Arknights: Endfield industrial-editorial theme for the DSH Web UI: cream paper, ink text, zero border radius, two switchable accent palettes (signal yellow / teal-cyan), plus optional marching-squares contour background, ENDFIELD watermark and boot progress plate.
- [yq1930/dsh-skin-asuka-p01](https://github.com/yq1930/dsh-skin-asuka-p01) - Unofficial Asuka-themed skin for DeepSeek Harness with dual character illustrations, day and night city-dome backdrops, and five appearance settings covering mode, backdrop, character position, backdrop intensity, and character size.
- [YRN-playmaker/dsh-wallpaper_share](https://github.com/YRN-playmaker/dsh-wallpaper_share) - Syncs the wallpaper currently applied in Wallpaper Engine to the DSH Web UI background through a local bridge: preview/capture/full render modes, monitor lock, a wallpaper library panel for local and market content, focus lens with eye tracking, immersive mode, and a Windows app launcher that installs software from direct links or a cloud-drive share link and starts it with one click.
- [yrsxy/dsh-warm-theme](https://github.com/yrsxy/dsh-warm-theme) - Five warm, low blue-light color themes that retint the whole DSH interface, including the sidebar, popups and shadows, without touching layout.
- [yryd/dafy-whale-theme](https://github.com/yryd/dafy-whale-theme) - Ocean-blue theme for the DSH web interface: swimming fish, rising bubbles, a daily-quote ticker above the input box, and a replacement brand area; Settings → Marine Theme exposes 7 groups and 32 options (brand text and size, badge, primary color, watermark, fish, quotes, overall scale) that apply instantly without a reload, plus a two-step reset to defaults.
- [YSDLNGF/dsh-acrylic-light](https://github.com/YSDLNGF/dsh-acrylic-light) - Transparent acrylic window material and layered frosted panels for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: the window reveals the desktop wallpaper (Windows Acrylic supplies the blur), the composer is a pane of frosted glass, and chat text is hard-clipped at the composer's top edge. Note: the page styling installs with the plugin, but making the window itself transparent needs a one-time app.asar patch (the patch bundle in this repo's Releases; double-click enable-transparency.cmd). The patch takes effect after a restart and must be re-applied after every DSH update. The plugin works without it — the window simply stays opaque.
- [yu502950715yang/dsh-use-wallpaper](https://github.com/yu502950715yang/dsh-use-wallpaper) - Renders Wallpaper Engine scene wallpapers in real time in the browser (three.js player plus a Rust/WASM CPU particle simulation) and plays video and web wallpapers, falling back to the preview image, with no Wallpaper Engine runtime required. Scans the local Steam workshop library (431960) by auto-detection or a manual path, and offers a settings panel for wallpaper selection, library and engine directories, glow, pause and quality.
- [yunxiiQwQ/dsh-maid-whale-UI#maid-whale-webui](https://github.com/yunxiiQwQ/dsh-maid-whale-UI/tree/main/maid-whale-webui) - Whale-maid theme for DSH desktop and Web UI with light and dark palettes, ocean illustrations, hand-drawn frames, and a native Windows companion.
- [yzke/dsh-icon-theme](https://github.com/yzke/dsh-icon-theme) - Automatic and user-customizable Fluent-style icons for DSH Settings and sidebar actions, with offline SVG packs and original-icon preservation.
- [zampie/sakura-afternoon-skin](https://github.com/zampie/sakura-afternoon-skin) - Sakura-afternoon pastel skin for the DSH Web UI: light and dark sakura token palettes, a click-through falling-petal overlay with a soft vignette, a header petal toggle and a General-settings master switch.
- [ZaVang/dsh-diorama](https://github.com/ZaVang/dsh-diorama) - Character skins with an editable decoration board — Yukino warm daily and occult editorial themes, each with dual character sprites + sticker sheets, drag/resize/rotate coordinate editor, custom asset upload, and shareable diorama packs (assets + layout bundled).
- [zdjmrq/dsh-shadertoy-skin](https://github.com/zdjmrq/dsh-shadertoy-skin) - ShaderToy backgrounds for DeepSeek Harness: a WebGL2 player with a background library and five bundled presets, adjustable opacity, brightness, resolution and frame rate, playback options, and an in-app editor for the running shader.
- [zdt3476/dsh-simplify-theme](https://github.com/zdt3476/dsh-simplify-theme) - Minimal theme for dsh that removes shadows, glass blur, and brand tinting while tightening radii, plus UI extras: sidebar archive tabs with type-to-filter, model and reasoning-effort controls under the composer, per-turn subagent topology cards, colored cache-hit and context meters, and per-turn duration.
- [Zeppeli777/dsh-stardew-skin](https://github.com/Zeppeli777/dsh-stardew-skin) - Stardew Valley theme (component-override edition): an official-mechanism client theme that stacks a cream-paper alias-token layer, stitched pixel font and valley wallpaper over the intact official React UI. npm: dsh-theme-stardew-valley.
- [Zeppeli777/dsh-theme-stardew-fullskin](https://github.com/Zeppeli777/dsh-theme-stardew-fullskin) - Stardew Valley theme (full-skin edition) for the dsh web UI only: replaces the served web frontend with a self-contained pixel-farm interface — Junimo dialog, farm-select presets, quest journal HUD, session-as-day valley calendar, chiptune SFX and desktop pets. Not available in the desktop window and not compatible with other UI-changing plugins.
- [zhang66633/dsh-pixel-ui](https://github.com/zhang66633/dsh-pixel-ui) - Four-palette pixel-art skin for DSH Web (wood, parchment, warm, terminal green) with a bundled CJK pixel font served by the plugin's own host route, and a flat, shadow-free look.
- [zhijun-dai/Catppuccin-dsh-theme](https://github.com/zhijun-dai/Catppuccin-dsh-theme) - 🐱 Catppuccin theme plugin: the lively, relaxing official 26-color pastel palette — 🌻 Latte / 🪴 Frappé / 🌺 Macchiato / 🌿 Mocha — with one-click switching; the whole UI is tinted from the palette and hover interactions glow in the theme accent.
- [zhijun-dai/dsh-Fonts](https://github.com/zhijun-dai/dsh-Fonts) - Font system plugin: OFL webfont presets served offline from the plugin, user-imported custom woff2 fonts, and a ctx.fonts registry other plugins can extend.
- [zhijun-dai/Solarized-dsh-theme](https://github.com/zhijun-dai/Solarized-dsh-theme) - Solarized theme plugin: the classic low-contrast, eye-friendly dual palette system — Ethan Schoonover's Solarized plus Selenized (its refined take), dark and light each, built for long sessions with canonical syntax colors.
- [zhongyichang1998/dsh-open-meadow](https://github.com/zhongyichang1998/dsh-open-meadow) - A coastal theme for official macOS DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2, with animated clouds, local waves, swaying foreground plants and Chinese settings.
- [ZHOUcourier/dsh-theme-whalegirl](https://github.com/ZHOUcourier/dsh-theme-whalegirl) - Whale Girl light theme for the DSH Web UI, ported from a DreamSkin skin package: registers one native runtime theme with a full --dsw-* token remap derived from the source palette, layers the artwork as an ambient fixed wallpaper behind a frosted UI, and pins the theme against appearance-preference resets.
- [ZHUBAI0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix](https://github.com/ZHUBAI0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix) - Import your own fonts, set three sizes and six weight stops, and pick a separate palette for body, chat and hint text — an Aqua glass theme for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.3, with adjustable blur and frost, a fluid or image/video wallpaper, per-region text tuning, and a switch that restores the stock UI. Continues the Aqua theme by WYH66666666 (DSH-Transparent-UI-Plugin v1.3.0); do not install alongside the upstream.
- [zhuifengqug/pixel-skin](https://github.com/zhuifengqug/pixel-skin) - Pokémon-style skin for DSH Web with GBA frames, HP-bar status, effort level panel, and customizable color palettes.
- [zhxqc/dsh-oh-my-theme](https://github.com/zhxqc/dsh-oh-my-theme) - Web theme and file workspace plugin with global typography controls, @file mentions, a project file tree, Markdown preview, and a resizable side panel.
- [ZJUZhiyuCai/dsh-ivory](https://github.com/ZJUZhiyuCai/dsh-ivory) - Warm light and dark theme for DSH Web with responsive layout, bilingual settings, safe Markdown preview, per-block copy controls, and no telemetry.
- [zkforge/dsh-claude-desktop-theme](https://github.com/zkforge/dsh-claude-desktop-theme) - Claude Code Desktop-style theme for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 on macOS and Windows, with compact sidebar and chat layouts, light and dark themes, model and reasoning-effort controls, and an interactive pixel whale with spout, hop and tail-wag reactions on new sessions.
- [zmm863-commits/dsh-client-ui-paopaocat](https://github.com/zmm863-commits/dsh-client-ui-paopaocat) - Fantasy glassmorphism skin for the DSH Web UI: a moonlit nether-forest scene with drifting teal clouds, red spider lilies spreading from the lower-left and a sleeping cat in the corner, drawn over a WebGL2 fluid background with its own wallpaper and video backgrounds.
