Ships two switchable variants (pale / saturated blue), plus cat-paw, fish, bubble and starlight decorations. One switch restores the stock interface exactly.
- [zuoyunlai/dsh-theme-palette](https://github.com/zuoyunlai/dsh-theme-palette) - Five palettes for DeepSeek Harness — mono, warm sand, indigo, moss and a custom three-colour palette — each rebuilt in OKLCH for light and dark, with text and surface contrast solved per palette. Includes config export/import codes and a high-contrast mode.
- [zxbc/dsh-vscode-themes2](https://github.com/zxbc/dsh-vscode-themes2) - Browse, search, install, and apply VS Code color themes to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: bundles 14 curated themes with live color-swatch previews, searches the official VS Code Marketplace for more, and one-click installs map any theme's palette onto the DSW design tokens with live switching and persisted selection.
- [zys2026/dsh-theme-tide](https://github.com/zys2026/dsh-theme-tide) - Coastal light and dark palette for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, built as a token-only ThemeRuntime overlay covering all 107 official alias tokens.

### Models & Providers

- [1069137617/dsh-reasoning-tiers](https://github.com/1069137617/dsh-reasoning-tiers) - Declares per-model reasoning-effort ladders for third-party providers in the llm-pi-ai settings section, so DSH's stock thinking-intensity selector works on models the pi-ai catalog does not describe.
- [11zld22/dsh-model-info-fill](https://github.com/11zld22/dsh-model-info-fill) - Fills missing context window, max tokens, thinking levels, and image input on custom DSH models from models.dev, and lists unmatched models for manual edits.
- [1373700184/dsh-subagent](https://github.com/1373700184/dsh-subagent) - Registers local Qoder, QoderCN, OpenCode, Pi and CodeBuddy CLIs as DSH subagent backends, with ordered model fallback, live progress, per-run credit display, a settings page, and slash commands. Requires the corresponding CLI installed and logged in.
- [1624318455/dsh-plugin-adapter](https://github.com/1624318455/dsh-plugin-adapter) - Exposes OpenCode Zen free models to DeepSeek Harness with no API key, tracking Zen gateway changes.
- [2239058652/dsh-loomy-connect](https://github.com/2239058652/dsh-loomy-connect) - Registers the models bundled with the Xunfei Loomy desktop app as a `loomy` provider in DSH, reading the app's local sign-in session instead of an API key. Fork of gdrpzym/dsh-loomy-connect adapted to DSH 0.2.1, adding a per-model enable/disable switch. Requires the Loomy desktop app installed and signed in; it cannot be installed alongside gdrpzym/dsh-loomy-connect because both register the same `loomy` provider.
- [2404723600/dsh-router-loomy](https://github.com/2404723600/dsh-router-loomy) - Registers the Xunfei Loomy cloud channel as an OpenAI-compatible supplier in dsh-router, adding model listing and streaming chat completions.
- [2861292267/DSH-Official-WorkBuddy-Credit-Proxy](https://github.com/2861292267/DSH-Official-WorkBuddy-Credit-Proxy) - Pools every WorkBuddy account signed in on this machine into one auto-failing-over provider, serving OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages from the same pool, with model aliases, usage statistics and scheduled credit automation.
- [643048695/dsh-subagent-role-router](https://github.com/643048695/dsh-subagent-role-router) - Route DSH subagent delegations to configured models with per-role routing for explore, plan and patch subagents, round-robin or random distribution, cross-provider failover, and active-window slicing of fork seeds.
- [66rapper/dsh-model-auto-enricher](https://github.com/66rapper/dsh-model-auto-enricher) - Model channel auto-enricher for DeepSeek Harness: eliminates manually configuring contextWindow, maxTokens, \[text, image] multimodal input, and {low, high, max} reasoning effort tiers model by model after adding a provider channel, with live auto-enrichment on save, a Settings UI page, and timestamped backups.
- [a1141171521/dsh-multi-agent-gateway](https://github.com/a1141171521/dsh-multi-agent-gateway) - Adds six AI coding platforms to DSH — OpenCode, Qoder, Qoder CN, TRAE, WorkBuddy and WorkBuddy International — each as its own group in the native model picker, and manages their accounts from one settings page, with daily check-in where the platform has one, credit balance lookups, and retry on another account of the same platform when one is rate-limited. Models carry their credit multiplier where the platform declares one. OpenCode's anonymous free tier works with no credential, and TRAE stays hidden by default until it is enabled in the settings.
- [a2580vb/dsh-llm-opencode-go](https://github.com/a2580vb/dsh-llm-opencode-go) - OpenCode Go in the DeepSeek Harness model list, providing subscription quota display, model discovery, session affinity, and more.
- [a331266223/dsh-multi-model-discussion](https://github.com/a331266223/dsh-multi-model-discussion) - Multi-model deliberation pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: independent proposals, blind peer review, program-executed evidence verification, immutable revision and independent acceptance on a fresh context.
- [A42Null/dsh-opencode-zen-plugin](https://github.com/A42Null/dsh-opencode-zen-plugin) - OpenCode Console (Zen) models for DeepSeek Harness: paste a Console API key under Settings → Plugins and the Console's chat models become selectable, with the catalog synced automatically, each model routed to the endpoint the official docs assign, and free *-free models hidden by default because they only run inside the OpenCode client.
- [a981008/dsh-switch](https://github.com/a981008/dsh-switch) - Mirrors cc-switch providers and models into DeepSeek Harness the moment they are saved, and shows each provider's plan windows, account balance, or custom usage script in the composer and the settings card.
- [aa2246740/dsh-antigravity-oauth](https://github.com/aa2246740/dsh-antigravity-oauth) - Unofficial Gemini Cloud Code Assist OAuth integration with isolated account storage; carries account-ban risk.
- [aa2246740/dsh-model-fusion](https://github.com/aa2246740/dsh-model-fusion) - Adds a model route where a Lead plans and reviews while a Sidekick performs code changes.
- [aa2246740/dsh-oauth-login](https://github.com/aa2246740/dsh-oauth-login) - Adds subscription OAuth and provider Plan API-key logins through Pi adapters, using a DSH-owned credential store.
- [AdonisSheldon/dsh-openai-oauth](https://github.com/AdonisSheldon/dsh-openai-oauth) - Connect a ChatGPT account to Codex models in DeepSeek Harness through browser PKCE or device-code OAuth, with automatic token refresh and Web or headless login.
- [aerince/dsh-models-dev-reasoning](https://github.com/aerince/dsh-models-dev-reasoning) - Adds models.dev reasoning levels to unconfigured third-party DeepSeek Harness models.
- [ai-yukin/dsh-0-tools](https://github.com/ai-yukin/dsh-0-tools) - One-click free-model setup for DSH web, built for coding beginners: one-click installer for Windows (install.bat) and macOS/Linux (install.sh, v1.7.0+); four permanently free channels — Zhipu GLM (text + image), SiliconFlow (Qwen3-8B plus 15+ sub-9B models), iFlytek Spark Lite and the OpenRouter free pool, which routes through openrouter/auto and picks from a pool that changes over time; bottom-left setup hint hides once any free model is connected; real-time DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing reminder; bundled beginner help center.
- [AIcivilization/dsh-model](https://github.com/AIcivilization/dsh-model) - One authenticated OpenAI-compatible endpoint (built on CLIProxyAPI) for dsh and other tools: gathers WorkBuddy, OpenCode Zen, local Ollama / LM Studio and CLI subscriptions such as Codex and Kimi, signs in from the dsh page without installing their CLIs, and syncs the picked models into dsh grouped by source. The settings page has a switch per source with free / paid tags, plan usage, API keys with 24-hour stats, per-source model picking, and update / uninstall. Runs on macOS, Linux (including next to dsh-vps) and Windows.
- [AidenOrz/dsh-workbuddy-connect](https://github.com/AidenOrz/dsh-workbuddy-connect) - Drop-in successor to the now-deleted corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect, keeping its package name, config row id and provider ids so an existing install upgrades in place. Also fixes the 400/11128 channel check by neutralising the DSH identity sentences and scrubbing the product name from system messages, and reads the real Windows client and bundled CLI versions instead of a compiled constant, unlike the functy and community forks. Verified 2026-10-21 on Windows, WorkBuddy 5.8.3, DSH 0.2.1-rc.2.
- [Akiyuki1130/dsh-ark-coding-provider](https://github.com/Akiyuki1130/dsh-ark-coding-provider) - Unofficial Volcengine Ark Coding Plan LLM provider: registers an `ark-coding` route with 12 models (capacity facts measured per model), multi-account with automatic rotation, a bundled pinned arkcli for the official model catalog and live plan quota, plus a settings wizard and a sidebar usage card.
- [Alice-Marx/dsh-model-router](https://github.com/Alice-Marx/dsh-model-router) - Routes DeepSeek Harness work across configured model APIs and supported vendor CLIs with dependency-aware packages and cost previews.
- [AlyceStocking/dsh-harness-switch](https://github.com/AlyceStocking/dsh-harness-switch) - Adds Kimi models to native DSH sessions with per-model selection of the embedded Kimi core or DSH native execution.
- [amlyczz/dsh-agy-link](https://github.com/amlyczz/dsh-agy-link) - Google Antigravity (agy CLI) models for DSH — streaming chat with Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS subscriptions, native tool cards, thinking turns, and in-GUI Google OAuth login.
- [Ansonfishing/dsh-model-manager](https://github.com/Ansonfishing/dsh-model-manager) - Control panel for local LLM inference servers in the DSH web view: service registry with health checks and stop controls, named parameter profiles for llama.cpp, SGLang and vLLM with pre-save KV/VRAM validation, GPU detection, and tok/s benchmarks.
- [antonio-mastropaolo/dsh-anthropic-membership](https://github.com/antonio-mastropaolo/dsh-anthropic-membership) - Sign in to DeepSeek Harness with a Claude Pro/Max membership (no API key), downscale Anthropic request images to a 2000px long edge, slim /compact summarizer payloads, and show 5-hour/weekly plan usage plus DSH message counts.
- [anye-99/dsh-codearts-auth](https://github.com/anye-99/dsh-codearts-auth) - Signs in to Huawei Cloud CodeArts and registers CodeBuddy, WorkBuddy, LobsterAI, Qoder (global and China), TRAE, Cline, Loomy, Raccoon Work, MiniMax Code, TeleAgent, ZCode, Step Code and Antigravity as LLM providers, with per-provider account pools; several of them also show quota balance and daily check-in in the same panel.
- [apolenkov/dsh-provider-proxy](https://github.com/apolenkov/dsh-provider-proxy) - Routes outbound model traffic per provider host or per model ID through chosen proxies, loopback or direct, configured from a Plugins settings page.
- [ArcaneOrion/dsh-model-channel-manager](https://github.com/ArcaneOrion/dsh-model-channel-manager) - Model channel manager: several provider/model candidates share one virtual route (roundrobin/<group>) with failover, retry, timeout and cooldown; a settings tab edits providers and groups, runs per-model speed tests and real single-model request tests, and a seven-day health panel aggregates latency, failures and upstream token usage (input, output, cache and reasoning).
- [architect-xyz/liquid-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/architect-xyz/liquid-dsh-plugin) - Adds the Liquid Inference auction exchange as a model route, with liquid.auto and its ranking variants, and four tools that read offers, markets, routers and job receipts. Requires a Liquid Inference API key (LIQUID_API_KEY, spend scope).
- [Asheblog/dsh-ollama-cloud](https://github.com/Asheblog/dsh-ollama-cloud) - Ollama Cloud provider for DeepSeek Harness: adds the chat route on install, publishes each model's own thinking levels for the composer effort control, keeps the model list current from the endpoint (/api/tags and /api/show, cached for offline boots), shows the account allowance with an API-key field in the Models page and sidebar, and offers Ollama's web search and fetch as selectable DSH web providers.
- [Ayelsh/reasoning-setup](https://github.com/Ayelsh/reasoning-setup) - Edit reasoning effort levels and thinking formats for models that declare none.
- [Ayowait/dsh-official-reasoning-effort](https://github.com/Ayowait/dsh-official-reasoning-effort) - Official-style model + reasoning-effort control for the composer. Reuses the official picker and always offers Off/Low/High/Max — exactly like the official DeepSeek control — even when a gateway model declares no reasoning effort, with a small hint at the panel bottom when upstream does not natively support it.
- [Ayowait/dsh-reasoning-effort-new](https://github.com/Ayowait/dsh-reasoning-effort-new) - Fork of dsh-reasoning-effort with a two-level model picker in the composer: a provider list, a model pane that slides out beside it, search, and compact rows, alongside the reasoning-effort slider and its max-level effects.
- [Ayowait/dsh-send-photos](https://github.com/Ayowait/dsh-send-photos) - Declares image input on relay routes whose endpoint omits modality metadata, so models that can see photos stop being rejected as text-only. This also overrides routes that are explicitly declared text-only.
- [bainianlaoyao/dsh-codex-harness](https://github.com/bainianlaoyao/dsh-codex-harness) - Codex-shaped coding tools and agent presets for GPT models on DeepSeek Harness: exec_command, write_stdin, apply_patch and view_image, plus OpenAI Chat Completions and Responses API routes, bridged to DSH-native plan, ask, approval and compaction. Long-running commands become DSH background jobs with bounded head/tail output readable through job_output, and each subagent type can be pinned to its own preset, provider, model and reasoning effort.
- [bainianlaoyao/dsh-llm-api-pool](https://github.com/bainianlaoyao/dsh-llm-api-pool) - Pools several OpenCode Go API keys and hot-switches each request to the least-used one, with official usage and balance lookup plus a graphical settings page.
- [BaoBao1996121/dsh-chatgpt-subscription](https://github.com/BaoBao1996121/dsh-chatgpt-subscription) - Adds native Codex OAuth sign-in, main-Agent default model selection, and direct or local-proxy settings for DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 on Windows.
- [Bazley13/dsh-multi-model-orchestrator](https://github.com/Bazley13/dsh-multi-model-orchestrator) - Multi-model orchestrator: the main brain decomposes complex tasks and dispatches subtasks to GLM / Kimi / Qwen sub-agents by each model's strengths, with per-model token usage.
- [beijingwahw/dsh-proactive](https://github.com/beijingwahw/dsh-proactive) - Proactive multi-model scheduling plugin: multi-source signal intake with dedup and urgency ranking, a four-way execute/defer/dismiss/ask-user decision engine, DAG plan generation with parallel model execution, quality reflection with automatic retry and model switch, long-term memory for task patterns and lessons, and strategy evolution via genetic algorithms with sandboxed evaluation and canary rollout.
- [bill277048-hash/DSH-model-router](https://github.com/bill277048-hash/DSH-model-router) - Rule-based multi-provider model routing for DeepSeek Harness with pre-first-token failover, cooldown circuit-breaking, usage accounting, and a status API.
- [bitxeno/dsh-magpie-connect](https://github.com/bitxeno/dsh-magpie-connect) - Magpie gateway provider for DSH: syncs gateway models into the picker with visibility control, image input and thinking levels.
- [boe1900/owndsh#owndsh-plugin](https://github.com/boe1900/owndsh/tree/main/plugin/packages/bundle) - Early-stage plugin connecting DeepSeek Harness to a separately deployed, self-hosted OwnDsh server for team identity, model access control, quotas, and usage auditing.
- [Boomerangz/dsh-openrouter-live](https://github.com/Boomerangz/dsh-openrouter-live) - OpenRouter provider that reads the live /models list, so new models appear without a harness release: models sorted by name with input/output prices, per-model reasoning levels, image input, reasoning_details replay, Anthropic prompt caching, and actual spend per session including subagents from OpenRouter usage.cost, shown under the Web UI composer and by /cost.
- [BruceLanLan/dsh-tier-router](https://github.com/BruceLanLan/dsh-tier-router) - Two-tier model routing: a strong tier plans, advises and reviews while a cheap tier implements, with plan-mode-aware auto routing, a high-impact escalation guard, failure auto-escalation, and subagent tiering.
- [bushizhanghan/dsh-workbuddy-harness](https://github.com/bushizhanghan/dsh-workbuddy-harness) - Brings WorkBuddy free/paid models (domestic + international) into DSH without the desktop app, published as @bushizhanghan/dsh-workmate. This package is a maintained fork of Faide-cyber/dsh-workbuddy (whose upstream entry is already listed in this catalogue); do NOT co-install both, as they register the same provider id "workbuddy-ai" and will collide. v1.2.7 relocates over-long system prompts past the domestic gateway channel-risk classifier, rewrites the DSH brand string, and adds a debug dump; supports dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 through 0.2.1 (incl. prereleases).
- [callqh/dsh-codex-oauth](https://github.com/callqh/dsh-codex-oauth) - Adds a Codex sign-in page to DSH settings, driving the built-in llm-pi-ai OAuth flow for browser or device-code login and showing masked account status without a separate provider or credential store.
- [CARVIN94/dsh-router](https://github.com/CARVIN94/dsh-router) - An AI routing gateway that runs as a DSH plugin. Adds a Routing System sidebar panel for suppliers, account pool, fallback combos and API keys, and serves an OpenAI-compatible endpoint at http://localhost:3080/v1.
- [CARVIN94/dsh-router-codebuddy](https://github.com/CARVIN94/dsh-router-codebuddy) - CodeBuddy supplier plugin for dsh-router. Handles one account at a time with polling OAuth login and token refresh, leaving account selection, cooldown and check-in to dsh-router core.
- [CARVIN94/dsh-router-traework](https://github.com/CARVIN94/dsh-router-traework) - TRAE SOLO supplier plugin for dsh-router, ported from traework2api. Provides the traework supplier, a free SOLO chat channel, and reports single-account status to dsh-router core.
- [ccccwwwxx/dsh-bifenggang](https://github.com/ccccwwwxx/dsh-bifenggang) - Time-based model routing: a settings panel defines weekday peak and off-peak windows and the provider/model each one uses, the choices are read from the harness registry (API keys and subscription logins alike), and a global switch decides whether that policy sets the model and reasoning effort of every request. The switch is independent per session, each session row carries a light showing its own state, and the settings panel names the model in force right now and why. A day no window matches — every weekend and holiday — uses the primary model of the first plan; the advanced thinking model is a separate axis, used only when a session itself asks for max reasoning.
- [Cci-65/deepseek-harness-plugin](https://github.com/Cci-65/deepseek-harness-plugin) - Adds configurable reasoning levels for third-party models and a model-strength picker in the composer.
- [ccl4-56-23-5/DSH-Plugins#api-switcher](https://github.com/ccl4-56-23-5/DSH-Plugins/tree/main/Api-Switcher插件/2.3.0) - Manage API providers and enabled models, with provider-grouped model switching and keyword search in the native model menu.
- [ccsert/dsh-subagent-hub#subagent-hub](https://github.com/ccsert/dsh-subagent-hub/tree/main/packages/subagent-hub) - Named subagent presets bound to model-route allowlists, where an out-of-list child model is refused before a delegation starts and each child conversation shows the model its last request actually used.
- [ChaYeWuu/dsh-hyperworkbuddy](https://github.com/ChaYeWuu/dsh-hyperworkbuddy) - Bring the WorkBuddy accounts signed in on this machine into DSH, managing CN and international accounts separately. Supports automatic failover between accounts, one-click refresh of model catalogs and credits, the CN daily check-in, and a togglable OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
- [chen704290901chen/dsh-newapi-video](https://github.com/chen704290901chen/dsh-newapi-video) - Call a new-api (one-api style) relay station's video model from the conversation with @-referenced image/video materials, supporting Seedance 2.0 and Happyhorse text-to-video and image-to-video across four relay protocols.
- [chengshenyangtai/dsh-workbuddy-trae-qoder-connect](https://github.com/chengshenyangtai/dsh-workbuddy-trae-qoder-connect) - One DSH plugin that aggregates the models of WorkBuddy (personal multi-account, enterprise and the WorkBuddy AI international edition), Qoder CN and Trae CN into a single model picker with a shared conversation history, live credit multipliers, per-model reasoning effort, the largest context window the international edition declares, and daily check-in where the channel offers one.
- [chengzhi-c/dsh-wtq-pool](https://github.com/chengzhi-c/dsh-wtq-pool) - Brings the WorkBuddy, Trae and Qoder desktop logins on this machine into DeepSeek Harness as OpenAI-compatible local endpoints, with an account pool, automatic account switching when WorkBuddy is rate limited, and a settings panel.
- [chimneyQ/dsh-model-rotator](https://github.com/chimneyQ/dsh-model-rotator) - Ranks the models a DeepSeek Harness install already discovered by measured connectivity and speed, and switches to the next candidate inside the same turn when the one in use fails without producing any output. Ships a settings page with a grouped model list, per-model and per-channel switches, and a quota-aware cooldown that rests an exhausted model until the next day.
- [ckanner/dsh-plugin-chatgpt](https://github.com/ckanner/dsh-plugin-chatgpt) - Signs in to a ChatGPT account over OAuth and serves that plan's models as a DeepSeek Harness provider route, calling api.openai.com/v1/responses with the account's plan scope rather than the Codex backend.
- [Clukay-Fun/dsh-gpt-link](https://github.com/Clukay-Fun/dsh-gpt-link) - Signs in to ChatGPT by driving DSH's bundled pi-ai Codex OAuth flow from a settings page, revokes the session at OpenAI on sign-out, shows the signed-in account's five-hour and weekly quota, and limits the Codex route to seven GPT models with low, medium, high and xhigh reasoning (default low).
- [CREAIT-nl/dsh-plugins#gen-limit](https://github.com/CREAIT-nl/dsh-plugins/tree/main/gen-limit) - Per provider/model generation concurrency, with a settings card: a cap on how many sessions may stream at once, enforced at the stream and again at subagent spawn, where a fan-out past the cap waits in a FIFO queue instead of failing.
- [CREAIT-nl/dsh-plugins#think-level](https://github.com/CREAIT-nl/dsh-plugins/tree/main/think-level) - A thinking level stored per provider and model, so reasoning effort outlives the session it was set in and also reaches subagents, which dsh never asks. The in-session picker still wins, and a model with no row keeps its provider default.
- [ct-jyjntc/dsh-model-modality](https://github.com/ct-jyjntc/dsh-model-modality) - Declare whether a configured third-party model accepts image (multimodal) input; writes the modality into the owning provider settings and verifies it through runtime model resolution.
- [ctianye/dsh_gearbox](https://github.com/ctianye/dsh_gearbox) - Reasoning-effort gear presets for third-party models: 16 vendor/model presets with per-mode custom wire values, written into dsh-llm-pi-ai with pre-write validation and per-rule rejection; per-model switching between OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages with automatic route regrouping; plus a composer Optimize button and a settings section that rewrite the input text with a model you pick.
- [cuboteam/dsh-plugin-dit](https://github.com/cuboteam/dsh-plugin-dit) - DIT.ai provider bundle for DeepSeek Harness: installs 29 OpenAI Chat Completions models and 10 Anthropic Messages models from one DIT_API_KEY, with protocol-specific thinking configuration.
- [cv-superding/dsh-deepseek-web-login](https://github.com/cv-superding/dsh-deepseek-web-login) - Adds a deepseek-web provider that uses chat.deepseek.com web models in DSH, with browser login capture, PoW request signing, SSE streaming, and prompting-based tool calls.
- [CynthiaYX/dsh-plan-act-models](https://github.com/CynthiaYX/dsh-plan-act-models) - A simplified version of the Plan/Act feature in the RooCode and Cline VS Code extensions, binding one provider, model and reasoning effort to plan mode and another to act mode, with per-workspace overrides.
- [CypherNaught-0x/DSH-Subagent-Model-Router](https://github.com/CypherNaught-0x/DSH-Subagent-Model-Router) - Automatically and intelligently routes each delegated task to the best configured model using aliases, capability tags, and usage guidance—keeping routine work fast and affordable while sending complex work to stronger specialists. Configure your model team in the Web UI or guided setup, run specialists in parallel with reliable result joining, and see the chosen model at a glance in subagent views and inline in Better Sidebar's Tasks tree.
- [Dalizi2026/dsh-factory-provider](https://github.com/Dalizi2026/dsh-factory-provider) - Factory (Droid) subscription quota as native DSH model providers, with three protocol routes, your own API key through a loopback gateway, and a settings page for connection status, quota, per-model token statistics and key switching.
- [darkings/dsh-agy-provider](https://github.com/darkings/dsh-agy-provider) - DSH model provider for the locally authenticated AGY CLI: Gemini/Claude model discovery, independent reasoning effort, DSH-owned tools, bounded context and tool-result handling, and Windows-safe streaming. Report problems in GitHub Issues: https://github.com/darkings/dsh-agy-provider/issues.
- [dat-lequoc/dsh-kiro](https://github.com/dat-lequoc/dsh-kiro) - Kiro model provider with Builder ID, Identity Center, Google, GitHub and credential-import sign-in, automatic token and profile refresh, account usage, live model discovery, selectable reasoning efforts, streaming tool calls, provider stop-reason and context-overflow handling, and token accounting that uses Kiro's exact counters when it sends them and otherwise scales the context-usage percentage it does send by the model's advertised window.
- [DavidRm1911/dsh-llm-subscription](https://github.com/DavidRm1911/dsh-llm-subscription) - Adds Claude, Gemini, and a local Ollama model to DSH's native model picker, using your existing Claude Code / Antigravity CLI logins instead of a metered API key, with a working reasoning-effort selector for Claude.
- [dawnliming/dsh-chinese-mode](https://github.com/dawnliming/dsh-chinese-mode) - Global Chinese mode: a compact pill switch beside the composer that injects a language requirement into any preset's system prompt (complete personas excepted); reply, thinking and tool output each toggle between Chinese and English, and anchored presets are supported.
- [DeepseekDays/dsh-ofm-model-manager](https://github.com/DeepseekDays/dsh-ofm-model-manager) - Per-model enable/disable and renaming for every provider in DeepSeek Harness: a panel at the bottom of Settings - Models with a search box, status chips with counts, a provider filter, collapsible provider groups with group-level switches, and batch actions scoped to the current view. Disabled models leave the model picker and custom names replace the built-in ones. Preferences persist in the profile and apply immediately, without reloading the page or restarting DSH.
- [DeepseekDays/dsh-provider-toggle](https://github.com/DeepseekDays/dsh-provider-toggle) - Adds a one-click switch to every provider row in Settings - Models: turn a provider off and it leaves the model picker, turn it back on and it returns. It works by wrapping the model catalog call, so it affects the catalog and the picker only, never routing, keys or provider config; existing sessions that already use such a model keep working.
- [DeZhou123/dsh-model-orchestrator](https://github.com/DeZhou123/dsh-model-orchestrator) - Two-level model routing: pick the best model group first, then the best channel within that model; a failure switches channel before switching model. Preference mode pins one model across its channels, a status bar under the composer shows the live model, channel health and the day's token usage, and a speed/intelligence report can be imported as the routing prior. Exposes a model_orchestrator tool and a /route command.
- [dingminhua/dsh-connect-qoder](https://github.com/dingminhua/dsh-connect-qoder) - Connects Qoder (Lingma CN / international) models to DSH through their PATs, with a per-region multi-account pool, daily check-in, automatic failover, and read-only credit visibility.
- [dingminhua/dsh-connect-trae](https://github.com/dingminhua/dsh-connect-trae) - Connects locally signed-in Trae CN models to DSH, supports DSH-executed tool calls, account switching, and Work/general credit visibility.
- [dingminhua/dsh-connect-workbuddy](https://github.com/dingminhua/dsh-connect-workbuddy) - Connects locally signed-in WorkBuddy models to DSH, supports per-model image input opt-in, account switching, and a read-only credits overview with daily check-in.
- [dingminhua/dsh-subagent-default-model#plugin](https://github.com/dingminhua/dsh-subagent-default-model/tree/main/plugin) - Configurable default model for subagent delegations via settings.yaml, with single-model and multi-model round-robin or random strategies.
- [DragonHorizon-xtihc/dsh-connect-opencode-free](https://github.com/DragonHorizon-xtihc/dsh-connect-opencode-free) - Connect OpenCode Zen free-tier models into DeepSeek Harness. Real-time model discovery, per-model toggle in settings, one-click provider write. No API key required.
- [DragonHorizon-xtihc/dsh-connect-trae-models](https://github.com/DragonHorizon-xtihc/dsh-connect-trae-models) - Aggregates all local Trae accounts into one auto-failover model provider, with manual and automated daily check-in, credits and expiry monitoring, and a model selection settings card.
- [drscrewdriver/dsh-llm-openai-completions](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-llm-openai-completions) - OpenAI-completions-compatible adapter for custom gateways (vLLM / LM Studio / self-hosted proxies): always role:"system", thinking driven by the model config, Qwen-style response split, and vision-model image input (single / multiple).
- [drscrewdriver/dsh-thinking-levels](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-thinking-levels) - Per-round thinking-level (reasoning_effort) control for DeepSeek Harness: pick Auto and it schedules low/high/max from the recent tool-call history, or fix a wire level (off/on/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max) manually, with custom wire mapping, a model-aware capability guard, and context-window presets (64K–1M); its per-model capability card pairs with a separate plugin, [dsh-llm-openai-completions](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-llm-openai-completions) (installable from dsh-market), so custom OpenAI-compatible gateways (vLLM / LM Studio / self-hosted) can try reasoning — the card writes llm-pi-ai capabilities, the adapter drives the wire (compat.thinkingFormat), and this plugin auto-maintains the takeover list.
- [dsh-plugin-lab/dsh-workbuddy-bridge](https://github.com/dsh-plugin-lab/dsh-workbuddy-bridge) - Brings WorkBuddy desktop-app models into DeepSeek Harness: the China and international builds each appear as their own group in the model picker, with the reasoning tiers the upstream declares, per-reply credit cost and remaining balance, per-account model visibility, and image input where supported.
- [du-yuxuan/OneKey-Models](https://github.com/du-yuxuan/OneKey-Models) - One-click TokenDance gateway access for DeepSeek Harness: OAuth sign-in stores the API key, a live model catalog with per-model visibility, and agent tools for chat, image generation, video generation and typed decisions.
- [Duskriver/dsh-opencode-go](https://github.com/Duskriver/dsh-opencode-go) - OpenCode Go provider with live gateway model discovery, online models.dev capability metadata, session routing, and Web settings with subscription usage.
- [dylan121322/llm-adaptive](https://github.com/dylan121322/llm-adaptive) - Adaptive model routing: per-request complexity classification with automatic provider routing.
- [DZQJOKER/dsh-plugin-local-model](https://github.com/DZQJOKER/dsh-plugin-local-model) - Local model plugin for DeepSeek Harness: manage GGUF models in settings, auto-launch llama.cpp on first message, and auto-unload after 5 minutes of idle time to free VRAM.
- [ebluffy/dsh-model-router](https://github.com/ebluffy/dsh-model-router) - English-only fork of dsh-model-router. Routes each agent step across a configurable model pool and adjusts reasoning effort based on task complexity, tool failures, and cost.
- [Ebony-Vinyl/dsh-our-free-model](https://github.com/Ebony-Vinyl/dsh-our-free-model) - Adds free model lanes to DeepSeek Harness — DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Kimi K3 and others — with no login, sign-up or API key, plus a local OpenAI-compatible gateway, fallback routing and a usage dashboard.
- [edge-sky/dsh-oauth-adapter](https://github.com/edge-sky/dsh-oauth-adapter) - Provides an OAuth account page for DSH Web, currently supporting OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Anthropic, Kimi For Coding, OpenRouter, and xAI.
- [eghrhegpe/dsh-connect-agnes-token-plan](https://github.com/eghrhegpe/dsh-connect-agnes-token-plan) - One-tap connect Agnes language, image and video models into DSH (off by default), with image recognition and thinking level filled in automatically. After signing in to the Agnes console (re-login uses AGNES_PASSWORD), you can see the quota windows (5-hour requests, weekly requests, daily images, video), account-wide cumulative usage, and a usage pill beside the input box. AgnesCode desktop models can be connected too (Windows only), re-reading the desktop app login when the token expires, with rate-limit hits backing off on their own.
- [eghrhegpe/dsh-connect-modelscope-token-plan](https://github.com/eghrhegpe/dsh-connect-modelscope-token-plan) - One-tap connect ModelScope language and image-generation models into DSH (off by default), with image recognition and context window filled in automatically. You can also see the free Magicube balance, jump to a model's info page, and record local call counts, trends and rate-limit events, with a usage pill beside the input box showing the balance and today's local count. All of it needs only an API key, with no account sign-in.
- [eghrhegpe/dsh-connect-qoder](https://github.com/eghrhegpe/dsh-connect-qoder) - Registers Qoder CN and international language models into DSH, fetching each model's rate automatically as it shifts with off-peak hours. It also provides a daily check-in, a usage pill and a credit lookup. Needs the Qoder login state on this machine, or one browser login.
- [eghrhegpe/dsh-connect-sensenova-token-plan](https://github.com/eghrhegpe/dsh-connect-sensenova-token-plan) - One-tap connect SenseNova Token Plan language and image models into DSH (off by default), with image recognition and thinking level filled in automatically. On a rate limit it backs off and retries on its own instead of misreading it as an exhausted quota. After signing in to the SenseNova console you can see the usage pill, credit pools and per-model consumption. Xiaohuanxiong can also be signed in by QR code, bringing in its models and their consumption multipliers, and taking over DSH web search.
- [elegant01/dsh-codearts](https://github.com/elegant01/dsh-codearts) - Connects Huawei Cloud CodeArts to DeepSeek Harness with built-in OAuth2 sign-in (PKCE + DPoP) or a pasted token, after which CodeArts models are available in the DSH conversation window. Reads per-account credit balance, expiring credits and daily check-in from the CodeArts credit API, counts requests and tokens locally, and shows a per-account credits popover under the chat input box; the credits line and the upstream queue hint can each be turned off in settings.
- [EliteOtaku/dsh-opendesign-go](https://github.com/EliteOtaku/dsh-opendesign-go) - OpenDesign Go provider: 12 subscription models over Chat Completions, the real 5-hour and 7-day quota read from the local OpenDesign app, per-model parameters and switches, and multi-account failover.
- [elizax/dsh-http-proxy](https://github.com/elizax/dsh-http-proxy) - Wraps globalThis.fetch to route DeepSeek Harness model-API requests through an HTTP/SOCKS proxy by target domain, leaving all other requests on the direct connection, without modifying Harness source.
- [EmotionG/dsh-llm-config](https://github.com/EmotionG/dsh-llm-config) - Requires DSH >= 0.2.0-rc.2 < 0.3.0. Declare any number of LLM providers, each with its own endpoint, credential and per-model parameters (reasoning-effort vocabulary, image input, retry policy), across the OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Responses, Anthropic Messages and Google Gemini wire formats, configured from a settings page.
- [ethanweave/dsh-connect-workbuddy](https://github.com/ethanweave/dsh-connect-workbuddy) - Runs a local OpenAI-compatible gateway so DSH can use the model quota of a logged-in Tencent CodeBuddy (WorkBuddy) account: one-shot installer with SHA256 verification, logon scheduled task with duplicate-launch guard, manage.ps1 for status/start/stop/restart/logs/update/uninstall, and an agent skill that drives setup and troubleshooting.
- [Eve-146T/DSH-CODEX-SUBSCRIPTION-POOL](https://github.com/Eve-146T/DSH-CODEX-SUBSCRIPTION-POOL) - Use your ChatGPT/Codex subscriptions in DSH, with image generation and web search support.
- [Faide-cyber/dsh-workbuddy](https://github.com/Faide-cyber/dsh-workbuddy) - Bring WorkBuddy's free and paid models (domestic and international) into DSH — no WorkBuddy desktop app required.
- [FelixJiashengFu/dsh-haoba-mode](https://github.com/FelixJiashengFu/dsh-haoba-mode) - A gold switch beside the composer that raises every model request to the strongest reasoning effort the current model declares and to its default max output tokens, and adds a system-prompt section asking for exhaustive, self-checked work.
- [ffyuuu/dsh-llm-longcat](https://github.com/ffyuuu/dsh-llm-longcat) - LongCat-2.0 LLM adapter: 1M context, binary thinking mode, tool calling, and streaming over the OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
- [fieldnote-ops/keyringseam](https://github.com/fieldnote-ops/keyringseam) - macOS Keychain credential provider that replaces the local-file provider and uses a signed, notarized universal helper.
- [Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#anthropic](https://github.com/Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers/tree/main/packages/dsh-ai-anthropic) - Anthropic provider using the native Messages API for language models in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
- [Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#cohere](https://github.com/Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers/tree/main/packages/dsh-ai-cohere) - Cohere provider for language models, embeddings, and reranking through Cohere's native APIs in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
- [Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#dashscope](https://github.com/Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers/tree/main/packages/dsh-ai-dashscope) - Alibaba Cloud DashScope provider for Qwen language models, embeddings, reranking, speech, and image generation through native APIs in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
- [Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#jina](https://github.com/Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers/tree/main/packages/dsh-ai-jina) - Jina provider for embeddings and reranking in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
- [Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#localai](https://github.com/Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers/tree/main/packages/dsh-ai-localai) - LocalAI provider for language models, embeddings, reranking, speech, and image generation with LocalAI-specific controls in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
- [Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#ollama](https://github.com/Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers/tree/main/packages/dsh-ai-ollama) - Ollama provider for language models and embeddings, with model discovery, loading, and unloading in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
- [Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#openai](https://github.com/Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers/tree/main/packages/dsh-ai-openai) - OpenAI provider for language models, embeddings, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, and image generation in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
- [Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime](https://github.com/Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers/tree/main/packages/dsh-ai-providers) - AI provider runtime and configuration UI for shared credentials and embedding, reranking, speech, and image generation services in DSH.
- [Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#typesafe](https://github.com/Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers/tree/main/packages/dsh-ai-typesafe) - TypeSafe AI Jev decision provider for typed probabilistic choices and scores in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
- [FishBottle7/opencode2dsh](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/tree/master/packages/plugin) - Exposes OpenCode Zen free models to DeepSeek Harness, with no API key.
- [FitBBC/dsh-plugin-tokenmarket](https://github.com/FitBBC/dsh-plugin-tokenmarket) - Adds Token Market as an OpenAI-compatible model provider with DeepSeek V4 Pro, Kimi K3, and GLM-5.3.
- [Fleey/deepseek-harness-acp](https://github.com/Fleey/deepseek-harness-acp) - Registers external ACP (Agent Client Protocol) agents such as Codex, Claude Code and Gemini CLI as DSH model providers: maps each agent's thought_level options to the reasoning-effort selector, forwards images when the agent advertises promptCapabilities.image, and routes permission requests to DSH's approval dialog; ships an ACP Agents settings page that imports Zed agent_servers JSON and discovers models.
- [Fleey/deepseek-harness-trae](https://github.com/Fleey/deepseek-harness-trae) - Connects Trae enterprise models to DeepSeek Harness from a personal access token alone, calling llm_raw_chat directly with no trae2api or traecli process; fetches the model catalog from upstream on startup and shows remaining quota for personal packs and enterprise seats.
- [fortran2005/dsh-baipiao-shigege](https://github.com/fortran2005/dsh-baipiao-shigege) - Tiers free-channel models into three 1M fallback chains plus a custom chain; orders them by measured throughput, drops models below throughput or error-rate thresholds, and rotates accounts. Requires an OpenAI-compatible gateway (default :8326).
- [franksong2702/dsh-codex-connect](https://github.com/franksong2702/dsh-codex-connect) - Connect ChatGPT OAuth and OpenAI Codex models to DeepSeek Harness, with opt-in search and image tools.
- [frederico-kluser/dsh-orquestrator](https://github.com/frederico-kluser/dsh-orquestrator) - Pick the model your subagents run on — with a reasoning-effort ceiling and an output-token cap — enforced in code on every child DSH starts, whichever tool starts it.
- [fu827707013/dsh-codebuddy-cli](https://github.com/fu827707013/dsh-codebuddy-cli) - Reuses the CodeBuddy CLI sign-in to bring its models into DeepSeek Harness, with a settings card showing account, token expiry, and remaining credit.
- [functy23/dsh-workbuddy-panel](https://github.com/functy23/dsh-workbuddy-panel) - Hosts the WorkBuddy2API gateway in DSH with a native panel, a separately updatable kernel, and outbound fingerprint alignment with WorkBuddy Desktop 5.9.2.
- [FuSheng-cs/Trae2api-dsh](https://github.com/FuSheng-cs/Trae2api-dsh) - Use TRAE account model quota in dsh, with multi-account management, daily check-in, rotation, usage statistics, reasoning levels and model visibility. Requires Python 3.10+; the first run downloads Python dependencies.
- [GaoHu1997/dsh-model-think-level](https://github.com/GaoHu1997/dsh-model-think-level) - Third-party model settings for DeepSeek Harness: pick a provider and a model in the composer menu, gate a model's thinking level with one switch on the official Models page card, and configure per-route request headers.
- [Garybot126/dsh-subagent-models](https://github.com/Garybot126/dsh-subagent-models) - Set the provider, model and reasoning effort delegated subagents run with, from one chip beside the composer: a per-conversation override and a profile-wide default share the same two controls, and the chip always shows the effective route. Applied on the agent/request hook to every in-process child; no settings page, no preset edits, no model-facing tool parameters.
- [Gaudi-XIX/dsh-agy-cli](https://github.com/Gaudi-XIX/dsh-agy-cli) - Windows-only model provider for Google Antigravity CLI, continuing Darkings/dsh-agy-provider (install as dsh-agy-cli; do not install alongside the original). It reads the Antigravity token from the Windows Credential Manager and sends it only to the Google Cloud Code endpoints, lets DSH own the harness tool policy, streams the tail without rollback, and tracks the real quota windows.
- [GeekRicardo/claude-in-dsh](https://github.com/GeekRicardo/claude-in-dsh) - Hand a DSH web session to the locally installed Claude Code CLI: a per-session engine selector (DSH | Claude Code), Claude models and reasoning effort in the model seat, Claude permission modes in place of the access-mode selector, and permission requests, AskUserQuestion and ExitPlanMode routed to the native DSH approval, question and plan-review cards. The stream is written as native DSH session events, so the built-in transcript, tool cards and nested subagents render it; Claude slash commands merge into the command palette; the CLI is held by a detached broker, so plugin updates and DSH restarts do not interrupt a running turn.
- [gentle-knight/dsh-cannbot-connect](https://github.com/gentle-knight/dsh-cannbot-connect) - Connects CANNBOT gateway models to DSH by reusing the sign-in CANNWork already establishes for opencode: the JWT and virtual key are read from disk on every request, so no separate OAuth flow or extra key is needed, and the account's visible models are registered in the model picker.
- [GnaneshKunal/dsh-openrouter-plus](https://github.com/GnaneshKunal/dsh-openrouter-plus) - Per-Session OpenRouter routing: a loopback relay writes `service_tier`, `provider.sort` and the `:floor` variant into each request from one of nine presets picked on the composer chip, with a pinned base URL per preset for route-level defaults.
- [GodD6366/dsh-sub2api](https://github.com/GodD6366/dsh-sub2api) - Connect a sub2api gateway to DeepSeek Harness: OpenAI-compatible multi-provider routes (OpenAI / Claude / Grok / Gemini) behind one base URL, with per-key model discovery, usage lookup, and global vision/image tools.
- [GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-clinebot](https://github.com/GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-clinebot) - ClineBot and ClinePass integration for DeepSeek Harness: dedicated settings page, live quota dashboard, in-UI key saving, curated and custom model selection, and a /cline command.
- [GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-key-rotation](https://github.com/GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-key-rotation) - Keeps a pool of API keys per provider with auto-created clone routes, switches to the next key on quota or rate-limit errors, probes cooled keys for recovery, and exposes the pools, cooldown and switch codes in a Settings section.
- [GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-model-sync](https://github.com/GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-model-sync) - Synchronizes the model catalog of API-key providers from the provider itself instead of maintaining the model list by hand.
- [GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-subscriptions](https://github.com/GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-subscriptions) - Registers ChatGPT Codex, Claude, Grok and Antigravity subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers through OAuth, so no API key is needed for them.
- [GrannyProgramming/dsh-dario-sidecar](https://github.com/GrannyProgramming/dsh-dario-sidecar) - Harness-owned lifecycle for the dario proxy — starts it with your harness, readiness-gates it, and stops it when the harness stops, so subscription-backed (Claude/ChatGPT) model routes just work.
- [greatyao/dsh-connect-cursor](https://github.com/greatyao/dsh-connect-cursor) - Connects a locally-signed-in Cursor desktop app to dsh as a native LlmAdapter — reads the Cursor login token from state.vscdb or auth.json, drives the private agent.v1.AgentService/Run HTTP/2 bidi stream, and translates InteractionUpdate deltas into dsh StreamChunks. No loopback proxy. macOS, Windows and Linux.
- [guhanfei-ai/dsh-model-http-proxy](https://github.com/guhanfei-ai/dsh-model-http-proxy) - Only the domains you list go through a proxy: add a model host that needs the proxy to be reachable, and web search plus every other request stays on the normal network. Multiple named proxies can serve different domains, with a never-proxy list on top; saved settings apply on the next request without a restart.
- [gulagala001/dsh-response-id-reuse](https://github.com/gulagala001/dsh-response-id-reuse) - Reuses stored Responses IDs for continuation, with retry and branch isolation and verified history replay.
- [HAN102300/dsh-opencode-zen-free](https://github.com/HAN102300/dsh-opencode-zen-free) - OpenCode Zen free-tier models for DeepSeek Harness with anonymous no-key access, a loopback OpenAI-compatible shim, and real bash/read gate tools.
- [HaoyueQin/dsh-better-reasoning-effort](https://github.com/HaoyueQin/dsh-better-reasoning-effort) - Per-model reasoning-effort and input-modality configuration for third-party providers: suggestions fused from a model knowledge base and raw /models endpoint evidence with confidence labels, edited inside the official Models page card.
- [HateYouLittle/dsh-clinepass](https://github.com/HateYouLittle/dsh-clinepass) - ClinePass provider for DeepSeek Harness: 15 bundled subscription and free models, a settings page with per-model capacity overrides, subscription usage for the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows, and multi-account failover to a backup account.
- [HaydenSmith1121/dsh-opencode-go-plus](https://github.com/HaydenSmith1121/dsh-opencode-go-plus) - OpenCode Go subscription models as a DeepSeek Harness provider: re-resolves the live gateway catalog every few minutes, auto-adapts models the built-in table has not seen, and covers streaming, tool calls, image input and subscription usage. A maintained fork of dsh-opencode-go: a clash with the upstream package over the llm-opencode-go settings namespace makes it withdraw quietly instead of failing the whole plugin tree, and an already-claimed opencode-go route makes it serve on opencode-go-plus.
- [HB00/dsh-llm-failover](https://github.com/HB00/dsh-llm-failover) - Automatic provider failover on rate limits or quota exhaustion: switch between providers with configurable per-provider models, a cooldown, and a permanent last-entry fallback.
- [Headmaster218/dsh-llm-moe4all](https://github.com/Headmaster218/dsh-llm-moe4all) - Runs MoE4All models locally in DSH with automatic engine installation, model discovery and downloads, inference settings, and live speed monitoring, or connects to an existing service.
- [henrikdukefoss/dsh-standardcompute](https://github.com/henrikdukefoss/dsh-standardcompute) - Adds Standard Compute as an OpenAI-compatible model provider through the built-in pi-ai adapter, with its standardcompute router model and two direct model pins; configuration only, no code.
- [Henta111/dsh-more-models-thinking-level](https://github.com/Henta111/dsh-more-models-thinking-level) - Per-model reasoning effort (off/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh) for GPT, Codex, Gemini and OpenAI-compatible models. Installs a helper, not a runtime adapter: run enable-capabilities.ps1 once per profile (Windows) and restart — it declares the levels in ~/.dsh/settings.yaml, with a disable script and a backup to revert.
- [hi-fangj/dsh-models-radar](https://github.com/hi-fangj/dsh-models-radar) - Displays CodexRadar model capability benchmarks in a Settings page and shows the selected session model's DeepSWE score beside the composer.
- [HimA6652/dsh-workbuddy2api-hub](https://github.com/HimA6652/dsh-workbuddy2api-hub) - Registers the models of a local workbuddy2api-hub gateway into DSH as one OpenAI-compatible provider per gateway API key, each key keeping its own model selection, and shows the main key's credit balance plus today's and this week's tokens, credits and API-equivalent cost in a sidebar badge. Requires workbuddy2api-hub running locally.
- [HiSeax/dsh-better-model-setting](https://github.com/HiSeax/dsh-better-model-setting) - Replaces the official Models settings page with provider lifecycle management, per-model reasoning effort tiers, retry overrides, drag reorder and upstream model sync.
- [hmtxj/dsh-model-modality](https://github.com/hmtxj/dsh-model-modality) - Per-model input type and thinking level declarations on the 模型 settings page — 输入类型 checkboxes on every provider card, and a 思考等级 field in the provider 编辑 dialog. Writes the official pi-ai input and reasoningEfforts fields.
- [Hoemr/dsh-llm-cc-switch](https://github.com/Hoemr/dsh-llm-cc-switch) - Exposes the accounts in a local CC Switch database to DeepSeek Harness: every account (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Grok Build) becomes a model category in the picker, and the SQLite database is re-read on every model listing and request, so switching accounts in CC Switch needs no DSH restart. Requires CC Switch and the DSH desktop app.
- [home-river/dsh-opencode-cli-bridge](https://github.com/home-river/dsh-opencode-cli-bridge) - Bridge DSH to OpenCode-compatible models via the local OpenCode CLI: native LlmAdapter passthrough, persistent OC sessions with cross-turn tool results, tool mirroring, and a CLI environment check panel. Requires the OpenCode CLI installed locally.
- [HOWILLMAKEIT/dsh-model-context-catalog](https://github.com/HOWILLMAKEIT/dsh-model-context-catalog) - Match context windows for configured DSH models in one click, show capacity sources, and support selective bulk configuration, manual editing, and continuous synchronization.
- [Howthemeaning/dsh-model-settings](https://github.com/Howthemeaning/dsh-model-settings) - Model settings panel for DeepSeek Harness: set the default model for new sessions, plus separate provider/model/reasoning-effort overrides for subagents and goal rounds, with live reload.
- [hoyyang/dsh-glm-mode](https://github.com/hoyyang/dsh-glm-mode) - GLM Mode agent preset for zhipuai/glm-5.3-flash: PTC/Code Mode tool presentation, a reasoning loop guard and a tool spin guard (live-incident driven), and GLM-specific auto-compaction at 75%/22%.
- [hpfs0/dsh-provider-proxy](https://github.com/hpfs0/dsh-provider-proxy) - Configures forward proxies per enabled provider in Settings (HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5), keeping unconfigured providers and other traffic direct.
- [hualuo520-h/dsh-connect-scnet](https://github.com/hualuo520-h/dsh-connect-scnet) - Brings the models of the SCNet (超算互联网) Computing Service desktop client into DSH by reusing the API key that client already wrote, with a 30-model catalog and a per-model default thinking level.
- [huhaodong/dsh-auto-driving](https://github.com/huhaodong/dsh-auto-driving) - Model failover and turn keep-alive for DeepSeek Harness: a request that fails with a model error before any visible output falls through the models of the configured provider groups (then the next provider) until one streams; transient failures retry with backoff under a liveness watchdog, a dead turn self-resumes with templated 「继续」 wake-ups, and an optional full-auto mode auto-answers permission, question and plan approvals with every decision appended to an AUTO-MODE.md audit log.
- [hytime/dsh-thinking-effort](https://github.com/hytime/dsh-thinking-effort) - Configure reasoning-effort levels and sub-agent defaults for custom DSH models.
- [hZsFN/dsh-default-model-lock](https://github.com/hZsFN/dsh-default-model-lock) - Keeps the shared default model pinned, so switching the model inside a chat no longer rewrites the global default and no longer lowers that default's reasoning effort.
- [Ianzhyh/workbuddy-to-dsh#dsh-plugin](https://github.com/Ianzhyh/workbuddy-to-dsh/tree/main/dsh-plugin) - Registers a local OpenAI-compatible bridge as a native dsh model provider: reuses the models already signed in on the desktop app on this machine, manages the bridge and its local dashboard process, and adds five tools, a /workbuddy command and a nine-tab settings panel. Requires the desktop app to be installed and signed in on the same machine; the bridge binds 127.0.0.1 only.
- [iasiv5/dsh-copilot-auth](https://github.com/iasiv5/dsh-copilot-auth) - Adds a web device-code sign-in and sign-out entry for the built-in GitHub Copilot provider in DSH, presets an out-of-the-box Copilot provider route, keeps credentials in the built-in credential store, and manages the model catalog as a first-login fallback that never overwrites customized model entries.
- [IcedWatermelonJuice/dsh-provider-veark](https://github.com/IcedWatermelonJuice/dsh-provider-veark) - Volcengine Ark Coding Plan LLM provider for DeepSeek Harness: provider-scoped PDF and image input, with Responses API streaming support.
- [iJetLi/dsh-providers-hub](https://github.com/iJetLi/dsh-providers-hub) - Signs in and manages accounts for 16 AI coding providers, plus a cross-provider rotation channel: multi-account pools, automatic credential refresh, credit claiming where the provider offers it, and a local OpenAI-compatible gateway.
- [ijry/DeepSeek-Harness-Desktop-Ultra#dsh-plugin-ai-switch](https://github.com/ijry/DeepSeek-Harness-Desktop-Ultra/tree/main/plugins/dsh-plugin-ai-switch) - Pool AI provider accounts per platform and route them through a local loopback proxy that bridges the OpenAI, OpenAI-Responses, Anthropic and Gemini protocols, then write the proxy into Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Grok, OpenCode, OpenClaw and Hermes config files with snapshot-and-rollback safe writes; registers no agent tools.
- [itchenshi/dsh-gateway-models](https://github.com/itchenshi/dsh-gateway-models) - Declares the OpenCode Go and Command Code route wire protocol and endpoint (so the API address never has to be typed), adds the DeepSeek V4.1 models to the OpenCode Go route and puts them first, completes the Command Code model list from its public catalog, and attaches a per-conversation x-opencode-session header to OpenCode requests (fixes 400 MissingSessionID).
- [itongxiaojun/dsh-openrouter-free-models](https://github.com/itongxiaojun/dsh-openrouter-free-models) - Discovers OpenRouter's free models, measures their real speed and context size, and writes them into the DeepSeek Harness model list fastest-first, with speed and context in each display name, plus a Settings section to configure and run it.
- [Jaylor-Wang/dsh-tool-antigravity](https://github.com/Jaylor-Wang/dsh-tool-antigravity) - Connect Google Antigravity OAuth accounts to DeepSeek Harness with smart multi-account quota rotation, multi-model LLM routing, and Nano Banana 2 image generation.
- [JeffTsuiCUG/dsh-connect-minimaxcode](https://github.com/JeffTsuiCUG/dsh-connect-minimaxcode) - Connects the MiniMax Code models to DSH - reusing the desktop app's sign-in or signing in on its own - with Anthropic-compatible model access, a live model catalog, the daily check-in that grants the free credits, and a credit balance that follows the model you selected.
- [Jensen-Yao/dsh-model-palette](https://github.com/Jensen-Yao/dsh-model-palette) - Global Alt+M model command palette for DeepSeek Harness Web: fuzzy search over models and providers, favorites and recents, per-model reasoning effort, provider and model configuration, request retries, capacity presets, and optional OpenRouter image/video generation tools.
- [Jerry2262/dsh-fingerprint](https://github.com/Jerry2262/dsh-fingerprint) - Captures and compares single-token behavioral fingerprints of configured DSH model routes using the One Token Is Enough protocol.
- [jerry9692/dsh-workbuddy2api-panel](https://github.com/jerry9692/dsh-workbuddy2api-panel) - Reads a running workbuddy2api-panel over its HTTP API and syncs its models into the DSH model picker with credit multipliers, CN/international realm labels and per-model reasoning-effort levels; also shows remaining credits and usage in a settings page and a sidebar badge.
- [Jesse-njx/dsh-polyglot](https://github.com/Jesse-njx/dsh-polyglot) - The model switch for DSH: point it at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with curated free/cheap DeepSeek provider presets and automatic fallback when a free tier rate-limits you.
- [jiay98528-dev/dsh-model-sync](https://github.com/jiay98528-dev/dsh-model-sync) - Writes live provider model lists into DSH settings and shows 5h/7d plan windows or metered balance for the current session model.
- [jiay98528-dev/dsh-plugin-weaknet-adaptor](https://github.com/jiay98528-dev/dsh-plugin-weaknet-adaptor) - Weak-network adaptor: transparent long-backoff model-stream retries (10-min cap), local response replay cache, heartbeat auto-reconnect, and degraded-mode token economy, with a bilingual (zh/en) settings page.
- [john-walks-slow/dsh-set-model](https://github.com/john-walks-slow/dsh-set-model) - Model switching and reasoning-effort control for DeepSeek Harness: set_model and list_models agent tools let the agent autonomously change its provider, model or thinking depth (reasoning effort) mid-task with a mandatory reason, a provider whitelist and a context-window token-pressure guard, the active model is injected into the runtime context, and Plan Mode auto-transition switches to a configured planning model on entering plan mode and restores the previous execution model on exit.
- [Jonah-Wu23/dsh-agy-safe](https://github.com/Jonah-Wu23/dsh-agy-safe) - Compliantly use your own Antigravity quota in dsh: bridges your local logged-in official Antigravity CLI (agy) session as the chat and subagent model provider.
- [juliankang4/dsh-spark-scope](https://github.com/juliankang4/dsh-spark-scope) - Shows a Spark Scope card at the bottom of the dsh sidebar: model server decode and prefill rates with sparklines, running and queued requests, KV cache, TTFT and TPOT p95, and GPU temperature, power, load and memory for each DGX Spark node. Read-only; needs a running Spark Scope server. Works in dsh web and the desktop app.
- [JUNQINGV587/dsh-maestro](https://github.com/JUNQINGV587/dsh-maestro) - Planner/executor delegation with named roles: a strong planner steers, disposable executor sub-agents (per-role routes and prompts) implement. Default role plus per-delegation override, a global reasoning-effort knob in the composer chip, and a settings page for role management.
- [jyao-SUSE-power-group/dsh-provider-rate-limit](https://github.com/jyao-SUSE-power-group/dsh-provider-rate-limit) - Rate-limits LLM requests per provider and per model using a reservation-based token bucket, with queue or reject modes, plus gateway identity rules that rewrite user-agent and inject custom headers.
- [Kalospacer/dsh-model-capabilities](https://github.com/Kalospacer/dsh-model-capabilities) - Adds a settings page for declaring per-model reasoning efforts and vision support on pi-ai provider routes.
- [kam74515-boop/dsh-everything-oauth](https://github.com/kam74515-boop/dsh-everything-oauth) - Import local Codex, Grok, Claude, OpenCode, and CC Switch logins into DSH; pick sources and enable models in Settings.
- [kangjiazhen/dsh-workbuddy-codex](https://github.com/kangjiazhen/dsh-workbuddy-codex) - Registers the workbuddy model provider by mounting dsh-llm-workbuddy, supervises the local wb2api gateway, and runs a bundled Responses-to-chat-completions bridge so Codex CLI can use the same gateway. Skips work that is already running or already registered, and reports each part through a status tool. Requires a local wb2api gateway and a WorkBuddy account.
- [KannaKuron/dsh-agent-lang](https://github.com/KannaKuron/dsh-agent-lang) - Three independent language channels for model output — tool-call descriptions (every tool-call card title, including run_code in PTC-style presets), thinking, and replies — each set to follow the web GUI language, force a specific language, or turn off (default: only descriptions, following the GUI). One global runtime-context prompt directive on the host; the client half reports the GUI language; a Settings plugin card switches the modes.
- [katsos/dsh-claude-cli](https://github.com/katsos/dsh-claude-cli) - LLM provider that runs the locally installed Claude Code CLI as the model backend, so requests go through an existing Claude subscription instead of a metered API key; native tool calls are bridged over MCP.
- [ken95573/dsh-model-show](https://github.com/ken95573/dsh-model-show) - Shows Provider/Model in the DSH Web composer model selector trigger; the dropdown list and its search are unchanged.
- [kennethfan/dsh-bailian-catalog](https://github.com/kennethfan/dsh-bailian-catalog) - Bailian (DashScope / Model Studio) model catalog in the DSH settings page: lists every model the configured API key can reach, groups them by model family, probes whether a model is actually callable (an unopened model answers 403, which DSH reports as an invalid key), refuses to add models that fail the probe, and shows the active session's context window and remaining budget. An sk- key has no balance endpoint, so quota here means context quota.
- [kinoward/dsh-plugin-subhub](https://github.com/kinoward/dsh-plugin-subhub) - Use third-party subscription accounts in DeepSeek Harness: chat, image understanding, image generation, and image editing with the models your subscription covers, with available models and reasoning levels synced from your account; currently supports OpenAI/ChatGPT subscriptions, more providers planned.
- [kkj-luna/dsh-image-bridge](https://github.com/kkj-luna/dsh-image-bridge) - Text-to-image and image-to-image for a model that cannot draw, through any OpenAI-compatible image API, with multiple providers and an automatic fallback model.
- [knyazev741/knyazevai-dsh](https://github.com/knyazev741/knyazevai-dsh) - Adds the KnyazevAI API provider and its DeepSeek, GLM, and MiniMax model catalog to DeepSeek Harness.
- [koliy82/dsh-rustvy](https://github.com/koliy82/dsh-rustvy) - Vendor marks in the model picker plus a model list kept in step with the provider: mirrors the public catalog and logos to loopback, and regenerates the pi-ai route's models from that route's own endpoint, showing the drift before anything is written.
- [KouzakiUmi/dsh-antigravity-acp](https://github.com/KouzakiUmi/dsh-antigravity-acp) - Adds the official Google Antigravity ACP agent as a DeepSeek Harness model provider, with tool execution and approval kept in DSH, Node 22.19+ and a signed-in Antigravity account required, a per-model quota pill and a settings page.
- [kyle123740/dsh-zcode-cli-proxy](https://github.com/kyle123740/dsh-zcode-cli-proxy) - Relays the ZCode CLI (the client-bundled coding agent) into DeepSeek Harness as a model provider: a resident app-server session injects the Start Plan account and signs each request with the OAuth plan token, so model requests burn ZCode Start Plan / Coding Plan quota directly — real streaming, image input, per-session resume, no API key.
- [lcestou/dsh-oh-my-claude](https://github.com/lcestou/dsh-oh-my-claude) - Runs your logged-in Claude Code CLI as a dsh model provider: live model list, session resume, approval relay, rewind, memory panel and remote SSH workspaces.
- [Leafyezi233/dsh-model-gateway](https://github.com/Leafyezi233/dsh-model-gateway) - Exposes the models already configured in DeepSeek Harness through an OpenAI-compatible gateway, so other local projects can call them with any standard OpenAI client. Multiple provider candidates share one named group with ordered, balanced or random dispatch; upstream failures before any output switch to the next candidate transparently, and rate-limited requests are retried after the provider's backoff. Per-candidate call statistics (attempts, answers, failures, token/TTFT totals) appear as badges in the settings page, and daily aggregates persist to a local file with a 30-day heatmap and trend view. Until you create a key in the UI, the endpoint accepts calls from anyone who can reach it; keys (stored as SHA-256 hashes) then turn authentication on, and the endpoint stays locked even after the last key is revoked. Exposing the optional LAN listener without a key leaves the port open to the whole network. Runs on DSH 0.1.2-rc.1 through 0.1.7-alpha.1 and later.
- [Lequait/dsh-glm-web](https://github.com/Lequait/dsh-glm-web) - Unofficial Zhipu Qingyan (chatglm.cn) web provider — run DeepSeek Harness on web-app credits with a login token, streaming and prompt-bridged tool calls included.
- [liaoyuqing/dsh-llm-error-retry](https://github.com/liaoyuqing/dsh-llm-error-retry) - LLM request retry plugin for DeepSeek Harness: when a model request fails with a configured HTTP status code, machine code, or provider field=value match, it sleeps for the per-rule delay and re-issues the request automatically, so subscription quota and rate-limit errors (429 / insufficient_quota) do not interrupt a run.
- [liaoyuqing/model-failover-manager](https://github.com/liaoyuqing/model-failover-manager) - Model routing groups for the session model picker: bind a group to a session, and once a model exhausts every retry policy the plugin records the failure with its error code, switches to the next usable model in the group and continues the same turn. Groups carry per-model priority, Beijing-time active windows and expiry dates; subagents inherit their parent session's group and can also pick models or bind their own; models served by dsh-our-free-model retry another account before failing over.
- [libre-webui/dsh-native-provider](https://github.com/libre-webui/dsh-native-provider) - Use your DSH models in [Libre WebUI](https://github.com/libre-webui/libre-webui) for chat, sandboxed Work and usage tracking, with provider credentials kept in DSH. Requires Libre WebUI 0.37.0 or later.
- [LightingHa/dsh-cc-switch](https://github.com/LightingHa/dsh-cc-switch) - Brings the providers you already configured in cc-switch into DeepSeek Harness: reads the cc-switch database, converts Claude / Codex / OpenClaw / MCode / Pi entries into llm-pi-ai routes with their API keys, and adds a health check that measures time-to-first-byte and whether each stream completes.
- [liqiaohuia/dsh-proxy-routes](https://github.com/liqiaohuia/dsh-proxy-routes) - Per-provider (account) proxy routing for DSH. SOCKS5/HTTP proxy pool with account-level routing based on API keys. Supports forced direct connections and hot-swapping built-in web tools proxies. Managed via a graphical settings page in DSH.
- [LiZhenNet/dsh-antigravity](https://github.com/LiZhenNet/dsh-antigravity) - Google Antigravity / Cloud Code Assist model provider with quota management and model selector.
- [lj100886/dsh-framework-doctor](https://github.com/lj100886/dsh-framework-doctor) - Configure model providers by probing their endpoint, check DeepSeek Harness health, and repair what can be fixed.
- [llmpolska/oh-my-dsh](https://github.com/llmpolska/oh-my-dsh) - Tiered model routing for DeepSeek Harness: think/build model tiers, vision delegation (the vision model only describes images; the working model acts), image generation, and a high-impact guard.
- [lninghaha/dsh-coding-subscription-oauth](https://github.com/lninghaha/dsh-coding-subscription-oauth) - Coding-subscription OAuth for SuperGrok/Grok Build, ChatGPT Plus Codex, Kimi Code and Claude Code, plus an opt-in loopback OpenAI/Anthropic gateway: local login without pasting tokens, AUTH refresh-and-retry, grok-4.6 xhigh, and API-key route coexistence.
- [log-li/dsh-peakrate](https://github.com/log-li/dsh-peakrate) - Peak / off-peak rate badges for the model selector (every row) and the composer tool row, judged per provider by its own time zone and schedule; the live catalog is served from the host over a fenced route.
- [lornwolf/dsh-claude-subscription](https://github.com/lornwolf/dsh-claude-subscription) - Adds a Claude Pro/Max OAuth provider with multiple accounts, optional account failover, cached quota reporting, live model catalogs, and quota UI in settings and conversations. Uses the Claude Code client identity; quota reporting uses an experimental endpoint.
- [lovezi0/dsh-model-extension](https://github.com/lovezi0/dsh-model-extension) - Models+ settings page for the DSH web UI: per-model reasoning-effort tables, input modalities and compat flags saved through the official settings pipeline, with models.dev metadata prefill and API key management.
- [loyalchiiina/dsh-deepseek-web-free](https://github.com/loyalchiiina/dsh-deepseek-web-free) - Registers a `deepseek-web` provider that drives your own signed-in chat.deepseek.com account as an extra model in DSH, so no Open Platform API key is needed: the sidebar footer lists your Web conversations, Fork to Workspace opens an independent Harness session that never writes back to the original conversation, native search stays on for the `default` model, and `/clean` is a session toggle that sends only the human text. Fork of y-wi/dsh-deepseek-web, kept working on DSH 0.2.1-alpha.2: the peer ranges are widened so the compatibility gate no longer rejects the whole bundle, the removed settings API is replaced with `ctx.settings.configure()` plus `.volatile()` config fields, the renamed client icons are updated, and an upstream SSE error now surfaces as a real error instead of an empty message that poisoned the session history. The fork also repairs what the rename to `-free` left behind: the session-list route used to derive its suffix from a hard-coded length inherited from the old package name, which had turned every conversation request into a 404 while sign-in still worked; and the sidebar conversation panel now paints on an opaque surface token instead of the host's translucent menu token, which only reads as a menu beside the backdrop blur a body-mounted panel cannot install.
- [loyalchiiina/dsh-model-fold](https://github.com/loyalchiiina/dsh-model-fold) - Groups the DSH model picker by provider: the menu lists sources with their model counts, and hovering a source slides that provider's models out in a side panel (default); in panel mode a click opens the same panel, and double-clicking a source title cycles hover -> panel -> inline (expand below the title). The active model stays visible at a glance. Pure DOM enhancement with zero intrusion - the panel is plugin-owned DOM mounted on body and selection happens by programmatically clicking the real menu buttons, so no React-managed node is moved or removed, keeping the host rendering intact and coexisting with other UI plugins. Styling follows the host by reusing the official --dsw-* theme tokens, with an enforced opaque background, sufficient contrast, and one shared set of sizing and colour tokens for both menu levels. No network access and no telemetry. Built for DSH kernel 2.0.15-next.
- [lsdt45/dsh-model-config](https://github.com/lsdt45/dsh-model-config) - Configure thinking toggles and reasoning efforts per model for llm-pi-ai and official DeepSeek, and specify input modalities (input or inputModalities) in the DSH settings panel.
- [lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot](https://github.com/lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot) - GitHub Copilot LLM adapter: OAuth device-flow sign-in, live model discovery from the Copilot API, vision support for image-capable models (gpt-4.1, gpt-4o), and two wire protocols (Chat Completions and Responses API) with automatic endpoint routing per model.
- [MaRi23333/dsh-grok-kit](https://github.com/MaRi23333/dsh-grok-kit) - Unofficial Grok integration for eligible X Subscription, SuperGrok, or X Premium accounts: shared Grok CLI OAuth, chat with optional main-loop web/X search, and experimental image generation, image editing, and video generation (all media features disabled by default).
- [Mars-Sea/dsh-commandcode-provider](https://github.com/Mars-Sea/dsh-commandcode-provider) - Unofficial Command Code LLM provider: registers a `commandcode` route with a live model catalog and reasoning-effort support.
- [marsma-101/dsh-qoder-connect](https://github.com/marsma-101/dsh-qoder-connect) - Connects Qoder CN desktop app models to DeepSeek Harness with zero user interaction: decrypts local OSCrypt credentials, signs requests with the COSY scheme against the CN gateway, and lists 14 models with free-tier badges.
- [marsma-101/dsh-trae-connect](https://github.com/marsma-101/dsh-trae-connect) - Connects Trae CN desktop app models to DeepSeek Harness with no OAuth flow: reuses the desktop sign-in, exposes 17 models (including deepseek-v4.1-flash) with consumption-rate badges and reasoning-effort mapping.
- [masknull/dsh-qoder-connect](https://github.com/masknull/dsh-qoder-connect) - Connects Qoder (China and Global) subscriptions to DSH through personal access tokens, keeping each variant on its own credentials and catalog, with saved-token switching, sidebar quota cards, per-model toggles, a context-window preference and a daily check-in.
- [mengge237/dsh-model-priority](https://github.com/mengge237/dsh-model-priority) - Reorder your own models: drag inside a provider card on the Models settings page, or use the Model order section when another plugin already occupies that card. The order is written through the host settings service with a revision check, so the settings page and the model picker stay in sync. The settings left nav can be reordered by drag as well.
- [mia-wong1016/dsh-codex-plus](https://github.com/mia-wong1016/dsh-codex-plus) - Brings the Codex (ChatGPT Plus/Pro) subscription already signed in on this machine into DSH. It (1) shows the 5-hour and weekly windows with their reset times and the remaining reset credits in a sidebar panel, with one-click reset that consumes a credit; (2) registers the subscription route in llm-pi-ai (openai-codex) when the quota is read, so the Codex models appear in the model picker; (3) refreshes the OAuth access token before expiry and writes it back atomically, so no key has to be replaced by hand; and (4) adds a codex tool that delegates a task to the local Codex agent. No API key has to be entered.
- [minutiae3/dsh-tier-brain](https://github.com/minutiae3/dsh-tier-brain) - Rates how hard the current message is and shows the cheapest model and reasoning effort that still fits, above the composer, before you send.
- [Missher12/Missher-DSH-Reasoning-Effort](https://github.com/Missher12/Missher-DSH-Reasoning-Effort) - Adds a thinking-depth slider mapped to declared model levels, configuration guidance, and optional inline model settings.
- [mo-n/dsh-provider-qoder](https://github.com/mo-n/dsh-provider-qoder) - Connects Qoder subscriptions to DeepSeek Harness, supporting Global and China regions, multimodal input, and tool calls.
- [Modellix/dsh-modellix](https://github.com/Modellix/dsh-modellix) - Modellix integration for DSH: schema-driven image, video and audio generation in a split Design workspace, a live LLM model catalog, and native web search and fetch providers through one API key.
