- [MoonlitDropOfBlood/dsh-model-prompt-injector](https://github.com/MoonlitDropOfBlood/dsh-model-prompt-injector) - Per-model system prompt injector for DeepSeek Harness: append custom prompt text to the END of the system prompt for locally configured models, matched by exact provider/model route or a provider-wide provider/* rule (both stack in order). A Settings page lists every configured provider and its models for per-route editing with instant effect, and rules persist to DSH_HOME so they survive restarts. Applies to main sessions, subagents, and workflow children alike.
- [MoRanYue/dsh-openrouter-providers](https://github.com/MoRanYue/dsh-openrouter-providers) - Route OpenRouter requests through a configured provider list and quantization cap, injected as provider.only/order with allow_fallbacks, plus provider.quantizations.
- [MoruTeaven/dsh-model-quickslots](https://github.com/MoruTeaven/dsh-model-quickslots) - A row of model preset buttons above the composer: left-click switches the session to that preset's provider, model and reasoning effort, right-click opens an editor for it, and each preset can carry a custom name instead of the model id. The editor reads the session's live model catalog, and presets are stored locally.
- [moxiaoren/dsh-xiaoyiwork-connect](https://github.com/moxiaoren/dsh-xiaoyiwork-connect) - Reuses the local model proxy of a logged-in XiaoyiWork desktop app (Windows only) so its models appear in DeepSeek Harness without a separate API key.
- [Mu-scorpio/dsh-reasoning-effort](https://github.com/Mu-scorpio/dsh-reasoning-effort) - Configures provider and model reasoning-effort mappings for DeepSeek Harness, with a grouped model picker and composer slider.
- [Mutx163/dsh-model-memory](https://github.com/Mutx163/dsh-model-memory) - Reasoning-effort tier manager for custom API models plus cross-session preference memory: inline low/medium/high/max toggles inside Settings → Models, with atomic settings writes.
- [mzzsfy/dsh-plugin#dsh-llm-pi-gateway](https://github.com/mzzsfy/dsh-plugin/tree/main/packages/dsh-llm-pi-gateway) - Session-affinity routing for LLM gateways: injects the session ID into every request sent to NewApi-style gateways so the gateway can pin requests per session and raise prompt-cache hits; takes over the official pi-ai routing on install and restores it on uninstall.
- [NEETnina/dsh-model-master](https://github.com/NEETnina/dsh-model-master) - Model selector for the DSH composer that keeps the native button and menu and takes over only when the small dropdown would open: search across providers, probe any model with a real streaming request to measure TTFT and TPS, and browse a leaderboard of up to 100 rows built from OpenRouter's catalogue, where clicking a row searches local channels of that name.
- [Neptune810/dsh-model-router](https://github.com/Neptune810/dsh-model-router) - Keeps a pool of models and routes every agent step to one of them with its reasoning effort set — configured by clicking in the composer, no JSON needed. The router takes over the composer's model cell, so one control shows the session's model and reasoning effort alongside the router's own settings. Three authorization scopes (model / effort / full) where a manual pick only counts in the scope that owns it, and in effort scope the router is bound to the one model you choose. Task presets with per-model weights, vision routing for image steps, session signals (active todo, context pressure, token budget, subagent depth), and an optional semantic task classifier. Thinking stays on, because DeepSeek rejects a thinking-enabled request whose history contains a tool call made with thinking off.
- [nickhelion/dsh-plugins#qwen-token-plan-cn-responses](https://github.com/nickhelion/dsh-plugins/tree/main/packages/qwen-token-plan-cn-responses) - Qwen Token Plan CN Responses provider for DeepSeek Harness via the OpenAI Responses API, with Qwen server-side tools, DSH local function tools, text/reasoning/tool-call multi-turn history, persisted image attachments, and a per-release official model catalog snapshot.
- [NingYuanLee/dsh-grok-byapi](https://github.com/NingYuanLee/dsh-grok-byapi) - Grok model provider for DeepSeek Harness with model discovery, image and video generation, text-to-speech tools, and durable local media tasks over an OpenAI-compatible gateway.
- [nobu121/dsh-opencode-session](https://github.com/nobu121/dsh-opencode-session) - Attaches a stable per-conversation x-opencode-session header to OpenCode / OpenCode Go provider requests, fixing 400 MissingSessionID errors and keeping session affinity and prompt-cache routing intact.
- [NOirBRight/dsh-llm-codex](https://github.com/NOirBRight/dsh-llm-codex) - ChatGPT Codex subscription chat: official OAuth, a Sol/Terra/Luna catalog with Fast rows, live usage limits, and optional search and view_image tools.
- [NOirBRight/dsh-llm-commandcode](https://github.com/NOirBRight/dsh-llm-commandcode) - Command Code Provider API chat for DSH with a Host-held API key, discovered model catalog, effort defaults, an optional zero-data-retention header, quota meters, and per-model OpenAI or Anthropic protocol selection.
- [NOirBRight/dsh-llm-cursor](https://github.com/NOirBRight/dsh-llm-cursor) - Unofficial Cursor subscription chat: Host-owned CLI session login, a displayed model catalog, and subscription usage rails. Cursor staff treat this class of private-client usage as against ToS.
- [NOirBRight/dsh-llm-grok](https://github.com/NOirBRight/dsh-llm-grok) - xAI Grok subscription chat: SuperGrok or X Premium+ OAuth, a displayed model subset, Responses through the Grok CLI proxy, and always-on server-side web_search and x_search.
- [NOirBRight/dsh-llm-ollama](https://github.com/NOirBRight/dsh-llm-ollama) - Ollama Cloud native chat adapter: direct NDJSON translation of the Ollama /api/chat wire format, model discovery with context windows and capabilities, and web search/fetch providers under the ollama-cloud id, plus a Web settings card.
- [NOirBRight/dsh-llm-opencode-go](https://github.com/NOirBRight/dsh-llm-opencode-go) - OpenCode Go subscription chat for DSH with per-model Completions, Responses, or Anthropic protocol selection, model discovery, context, vision and thinking metadata, effort defaults, and usage meters.
- [NOirBRight/dsh-model-switch](https://github.com/NOirBRight/dsh-model-switch) - Explicit model routing for Main, Subagents, web_search, and image generation, plus a catalog-driven Composer and Plan Review picker with Model, Effort, Context, Fast, and Thinking variants.
- [omdsh-dev/dsh-llm-fallbacks](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-llm-fallbacks) - Role-based LLM retry & fallback strategies.
- [omdsh-dev/Qwen-MM-Plugins](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/Qwen-MM-Plugins) - Qwen multi-modal plugin support.
- [OPaimon/dsh-model-gate](https://github.com/OPaimon/dsh-model-gate) - Single-model disable gate: hides denied models from DSH catalogs, blocks direct dispatch with an in-protocol error chunk, and exposes a settings UI for the denylist.
- [OpenTritium/dsh-codex-shim](https://github.com/OpenTritium/dsh-codex-shim) - Simulates a Codex environment for selected model routes to improve GPT-family model tool-call success.
- [oppnc/dsh-kernel-mesh](https://github.com/oppnc/dsh-kernel-mesh) - Registers Kimi, Grok, Codex, and MiniMax as DeepSeek Harness model routes, vendor subagent recipes, and kernel_status / kernel_run / kernel_switch tools.
- [orzgithub/dsh-ollama](https://github.com/orzgithub/dsh-ollama) - Use local Ollama in DSH with Ollama native API and params support.
- [oxlyn/dsh-model-health](https://github.com/oxlyn/dsh-model-health) - Model Health panel in Settings: lists every model configured in settings.yaml and batch-tests availability and latency for each.
- [passingby000/dsh-nl-model-switch](https://github.com/passingby000/dsh-nl-model-switch) - Switch the current DSH session's model with a natural-language sentence, on web, TUI, or IM bridges (WeChat, Feishu), without touching the panel.
- [penguin-oo/dsh-delegate-router](https://github.com/penguin-oo/dsh-delegate-router) - Automatic Flash/Pro routing for DeepSeek Harness subagent calls: light tasks run on a cheap model (e.g. V4 Flash), heavy tasks stay on the strong model — with per-call overrides and /delegate session modes.
- [PerryLink/dsh-autotier](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-autotier) - Automatic model-tier routing for DeepSeek Harness: one user instruction enters, one tier decision comes out — complex intent is planned on the strong tier and implemented on the cheap tier, simple intent stays cheap throughout, with a deterministic guard and a TTL escalation fallback.
- [PerryLink/dsh-local-ai](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-local-ai) - Ollama provider for DeepSeek Harness with model management, health checks, rule-based local routing, and cloud fallback.
- [PerseusNana7mi/dsh-model-kit](https://github.com/PerseusNana7mi/dsh-model-kit) - Fills missing model parameters from models.dev, imports models from configured providers, and writes per-field overrides for built-in models, with prices in USD or native CNY set as manual rates or a reference price times a multiplier.
- [pgjh/dsh-model-metadata](https://github.com/pgjh/dsh-model-metadata) - DSH plugin: matches a model you declared on a custom gateway to the capability metadata it should have — context window, output cap, reasoning levels and image support — by looking the bare model name up at runtime; the plugin never writes your settings document.
- [Phoeky/dsh-sensenova-pool](https://github.com/Phoeky/dsh-sensenova-pool) - Brings SenseNova (日日新) models into dsh with a per-key rotation pool: paste any number of API keys and requests rotate across them, a 429 rate-limit immediately retries on the next key with per-key exponential-backoff cooldown, local RPM pre-throttling avoids the limit instead of reacting to it, and an exhausted pool answers 503 with Retry-After so a 429 never reaches the caller. Ships a built-in model catalogue that works offline and refreshes from /v1/models, plus a settings card with masked keys, per-key probing and removal.
- [pigman18/dsh-openai-gateway](https://github.com/pigman18/dsh-openai-gateway) - Exposes every model of every provider configured in DeepSeek Harness through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint on a fixed loopback port, with a sidebar page for the base URL, key, port and model ids.
- [Plocr/dsh-commandcode](https://github.com/Plocr/dsh-commandcode) - Command Code for DSH connects Go / GOAT / Pro / Max subscriptions through llm-pi-ai provider profiles, with model sync previews, favorites and hidden models, per-model reasoning presets, explicit request diagnostics, usage alerts, configuration import/export and web search.
- [prgrmrwy/dsh-auto-model-routing](https://github.com/prgrmrwy/dsh-auto-model-routing) - Use Jev to adjust main-chat reasoning effort without switching its model, independently select and apply fresh sub-agent capability and effort, and inspect decisions with per-reply allocation feedback.
- [Pummelchen/TinyTitan#dsh-tinytitan](https://github.com/Pummelchen/TinyTitan/tree/main/plugins/dsh-tinytitan) - Keeps a local TinyTitan model server reachable from the harness: refreshes the llm-pi-ai route from the installed models and mounts a compaction backend that does not think.
- [pyh-pan/dsh-openai-oauth](https://github.com/pyh-pan/dsh-openai-oauth) - Use ChatGPT subscriptions in DeepSeek Harness Desktop via official Sign in with ChatGPT, with dynamic Agent registration and native model and reasoning selection.
- [QGG4588/dsh-model-failover](https://github.com/QGG4588/dsh-model-failover) - Model failover for DeepSeek Harness: pick one or more providers and the pool becomes every model inside them; when a request fails (rate limit, quota, timeout, server or transport error) the next untried model in the pool retries automatically, and the original error surfaces once the pool is exhausted. Configure from a seat beside the composer model picker or the model_failover tool, with no restart needed.
- [QI-seven33/dsh-jev-mode](https://github.com/QI-seven33/dsh-jev-mode) - Optional JEV decision mode with deterministic project reads, bounded semantic selection, native authorization checks and desktop credential settings.
- [qikairo7/dsh-gemini-pool](https://github.com/qikairo7/dsh-gemini-pool) - Multi-account Google Gemini provider: picks the account with the most remaining quota, fails over on 429 with exponential cooldown, probes disabled accounts in the background, and ships a Chinese/English settings page.
- [qipengxiang/dsh-cc-switch-bridge](https://github.com/qipengxiang/dsh-cc-switch-bridge) - Bridges the third-party providers saved in a local cc-switch app into DeepSeek Harness: Anthropic-format tool groups become adapter routes, Codex groups are handed to the built-in pi-ai adapter, and a settings page picks which groups to import and in which order.
- [qjf44/dsh-plugin-thinking-api](https://github.com/qjf44/dsh-plugin-thinking-api) - One-click OpenAI-compatible API (CodeBuddy/vLLM/proxies) with thinking mode, avoiding developer-role content_filter rejection.
- [changmodel](https://github.com/qq928820655/changmodel) - Model switching, model capability configuration, fixed compaction models, subagent routing, and input history enhancement.
- [r600a-code/dsh-swarm-router](https://github.com/r600a-code/dsh-swarm-router) - Sub-agent matrix swarm that routes heterogeneous tasks to the most suitable model from an OpenRouter-like gateway plus cfgpu.com/llm/square, dispatches each via in-process subagents or direct LLM calls, and tracks per-model token consumption with a feedback-driven ranking.
- [randomix777/dsh-opencode-zen](https://github.com/randomix777/dsh-opencode-zen) - Bring OpenCode Zen free models to DSH: 8 live-discovered providers with zero config, no API key; includes persistent quota tracker with rate-limit detection and reset countdown.
- [randomix777/dsh-plugin-subs](https://github.com/randomix777/dsh-plugin-subs) - OAuth sign-in for 9 subscription LLM providers (Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity, OpenRouter, Agnes AI, Qwen, Spark, ERNIE) with zero-config login and usage dashboards.
- [Rczlin/dsh-better-reasoning](https://github.com/Rczlin/dsh-better-reasoning) - Gives pi-ai routed models a reasoning-effort ladder without manual settings: falls back declared to models.dev to a 7-tier default, and replaces the composer model chip with a Codex-style vertical picker.
- [recyvan/dsh-model-proxy](https://github.com/recyvan/dsh-model-proxy) - Routes DeepSeek Harness model API requests through a system, custom or SOCKS proxy; requests outside the configured domains stay direct.
- [dsh-zed-provider](https://github.com/RGarrido03/dsh-zed-provider) - Use Zed AI hosted models in DSH.
- [ringoage/dsh-subagent-model-picker](https://github.com/ringoage/dsh-subagent-model-picker) - A GUI subagent-model selector beside the main model seat: pick a model and reasoning effort per session, applied to every in-process subagent.
- [robbywang25/dsh-llm-mlx](https://github.com/robbywang25/dsh-llm-mlx) - Use local MLX-LM or MLX-VLM models in DeepSeek Harness through a loopback OpenAI-compatible provider, with optional DSH-owned server startup.
- [roclee2692/dsh-model-groups](https://github.com/roclee2692/dsh-model-groups) - Grouped provider and manufacturer model selector for DeepSeek Harness, preserving provider/model routes and reasoning levels.
- [Sakana07X/dsh-plugin-team-subagent-control](https://github.com/Sakana07X/dsh-plugin-team-subagent-control) - Adds per-member model and reasoning-effort routing to DeepSeek Desktop Agent Teams, plus leader-initiated release of a teammate subagent run instance.
- [sanser9/dsh-opencode-connect](https://github.com/sanser9/dsh-opencode-connect) - Brings the free models of a locally installed OpenCode CLI into DSH: starts or reuses a local opencode serve, discovers the live catalog and refreshes it every five minutes, and bridges the session event stream to OpenAI-compatible SSE through a loopback-only shim that validates Host and Origin.
- [Saretheya/dsh-lantern](https://github.com/Saretheya/dsh-lantern) - Expose every model already configured in your local DeepSeek Harness to the LAN over OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints, with API keys, per-key rate limits, a circuit breaker, model filters and usage reports.
- [Scorp1o117/dsh-reasoning-options](https://github.com/Scorp1o117/dsh-reasoning-options) - Add missing reasoning-effort declarations to custom pi-ai models through DSH settings, enabling the native effort picker and handling models added later.
- [Seller-1990/dsh-model-smart-config](https://github.com/Seller-1990/dsh-model-smart-config) - Recognizes a model ID in the DeepSeek Harness model catalog and fills that row's context window, input modalities and reasoning levels as editable suggestions, from a bundled offline rule table covering 33 vendors.
- [seonzzy/dsh-zen-adapter](https://github.com/seonzzy/dsh-zen-adapter) - Registers OpenCode Zen free models as a native provider: the catalog is discovered live from opencode.ai intersected with models.dev pricing, and a detail page can re-fetch it or test which models answer. Declares no dependencies, so the host's pi-ai stays the only one.
- [sequoiayunus-hue/dsh-subagent-model-config](https://github.com/sequoiayunus-hue/dsh-subagent-model-config) - Settings-UI editor that assigns per-teammate model and reasoning-effort rules for DSH native agent teams, resolved at spawn time by wrapping SubagentRuntime.startContinuable. No official files are modified.
- [seriousz158/dsh-codex-use#dsh-codex-appserver](https://github.com/seriousz158/dsh-codex-use/tree/main/packages/dsh-codex-appserver) - Adds OpenAI Codex (ChatGPT) as a selectable DSH provider via the local Codex App Server.
- [serra006/dsh-connect-opencode](https://github.com/serra006/dsh-connect-opencode) - Expose every free model from a local opencode serve catalog — all providers, including your own custom ones — to DeepSeek Harness's model picker, with OpenCode's native tools denied so execution stays in DSH.
- [SeverusZh/dsh-plugin-subagent-director](https://github.com/SeverusZh/dsh-plugin-subagent-director) - Per-subagent LLM provider/model selection with role templates.
- [sharewiner/dsh-model-management](https://github.com/sharewiner/dsh-model-management) - Manages the default DSH model, provider and model visibility, and optional OpenAI Responses web search.
- [Sheep1x/dsh-aimy](https://github.com/Sheep1x/dsh-aimy) - Manages a relay station's many groups and rates for DSH, switching the station's billing group in place and refreshing the model list and rate on stations that expose /v1/token/group; stations without it fall back to read-only and keep serving models.
- [shenkonghui/dsh-llm-acp](https://github.com/shenkonghui/dsh-llm-acp) - LLM provider adapter that routes model calls through any ACP (Agent Client Protocol) server — Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Devin and more — with a registry browser, per-server settings UI, lazy authentication, and dynamic model discovery.
- [Shuai-S/dsh-sub2api-sync#sub2api-sync](https://github.com/Shuai-S/dsh-sub2api-sync/tree/main/packages/llm/sub2api-sync) - Syncs the groups, keys and models of one sub2api instance into dsh-llm-pi-ai provider routes, with panel-driven login (password / OAuth) and one provider route per relay key.
- [shuang-ying/dsh-ThirdApi-ThinkingMode](https://github.com/shuang-ying/dsh-ThirdApi-ThinkingMode) - Reads each third-party endpoint's own model listing and keeps llm-pi-ai's per-model reasoningEfforts in sync, so the composer offers the thinking levels a model actually has.
- [shuind/dsh-codex-harness](https://github.com/shuind/dsh-codex-harness) - Compact Codex coding mode for DSH: light prompt guardrails against GPT over-explaining, with an editable prompt and native Codex-style tools.
- [SISCHOI/daruma#dsh-daruma](https://github.com/SISCHOI/daruma/tree/main/packages/dsh-daruma) - Keeps long DSH sessions alive when a model channel starts failing: daruma takes over after the in-box retry gives up, trips a self-healing circuit breaker on repeated 429/5xx or a terminal error, and moves the next request to another channel in your chain. Works on DSH 0.1.x and 0.2.x hosts, including 0.2.1-rc.2 with verified failover and backup-management RPC. The backup can be picked in Settings or from a panel beside the composer — both stay in sync — with a durable JSONL audit log for every switch. Channel switches are recorded in that audit log instead of as in-conversation notice rows, because a plugin session event of a type the host does not know makes it refuse to load the whole session.
- [SkylerFee/dsh-llm-opencode-go-live](https://github.com/SkylerFee/dsh-llm-opencode-go-live) - An OpenCode Go model source for DSH: it reads the opencode-go catalog from Models.dev and serves it on a separate opencode-go-live route, leaving the built-in opencode-go route in place. The catalog snapshot is cached under the DSH home and a failed refresh keeps the last successful one; its own Models settings card edits the route key and can render OpenCode Go subscription usage.
- [SnailMann/dsh-quick-model-selector](https://github.com/SnailMann/dsh-quick-model-selector) - Search-first model selector with favorites, recent models, collapsible provider groups and keyboard navigation.
- [SnowAmberX/dsh-role-router](https://github.com/SnowAmberX/dsh-role-router) - Routes agent requests to configurable default, planner, and subagent models, automatically using the planner role in plan mode, with per-role reasoning effort and Web UI configuration.
- [songoao25/dsh-chatgpt-subscription](https://github.com/songoao25/dsh-chatgpt-subscription) - Bind your ChatGPT account via official OAuth and chat with ChatGPT models inside DSH, using your Plus/Pro subscription quota.
- [songzhiyin/dsh-local-model](https://github.com/songzhiyin/dsh-local-model) - Registers a local LLM provider that routes model calls to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint or the Ollama native API, with a connection-test card in the Models settings page and no account sign-in.
- [spdw666/dsh-credit-hub](https://github.com/spdw666/dsh-credit-hub) - Native multi-platform accounts and model routing with staggered check-ins, event notifications, and quota forecasts. Its background worker needs a standalone Node >=22.23.3 with node:sqlite (enforced by engines.node); Qwen Office coding additionally needs Python with cryptography and wasmtime.
- [SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-rollout-scout](https://github.com/SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-rollout-scout) - Detects which conversation model an account is being served: launches concurrent throwaway probe conversations, scores each streaming chain-of-thought by how its paragraphs open, and cancels probes that read as the older model within seconds. Includes an offline self-check that replays 13 hand-labelled chains-of-thought through the same classifier.
- [star-Cosmo/dsh-model-tidy](https://github.com/star-Cosmo/dsh-model-tidy) - Tidy the model list of DeepSeek Harness: hide any model from the selector, rename models and channels while keeping the provider billing rate, and arrange both with arrows. Search, per-provider batch toggles, back to top, one-click restore. Display only — no provider configuration is rewritten.
- [starefinger/dsh-llm-qwen-local](https://github.com/starefinger/dsh-llm-qwen-local) - LLM adapter plugin for locally deployed Qwen models behind a vLLM OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with per-model multimodal switch, fully configurable reasoning efforts, and a web settings page for editing the deployment from the frontend.
- [STLI69/coding-plan](https://github.com/STLI69/coding-plan) - Volcengine Ark Coding Plan provider route for DeepSeek Harness with all 15 Coding Plan models and per-model reasoning-effort control, generated from a single source and drift-checked weekly.
- [stoneface10/dsh-codex-connect-plus](https://github.com/stoneface10/dsh-codex-connect-plus) - Adds ChatGPT/Codex OAuth-backed Codex models and gpt-image-2 generation/editing to DSH without requiring an OpenAI Platform API key.
- [Stormycry-cryp/dsh-AuthInOne](https://github.com/Stormycry-cryp/dsh-AuthInOne) - Adds account login, API and custom Provider setup, model switching, image fallback for text-only models, and token/cost attribution to DeepSeek Harness 47f.
- [suntianc/dsh-antigravity-auth](https://github.com/suntianc/dsh-antigravity-auth) - Adds an unofficial Antigravity OAuth-backed LLM route, web search, image generation and editing, video understanding, quota status, and DSH Web settings controls.
- [suntianc/dsh-codex-auth](https://github.com/suntianc/dsh-codex-auth) - Reuses the Codex CLI ChatGPT login as an `openai-codex` LLM route and adds GPT Auth controls to DSH Web settings.
- [sunyifeisb-art/dsh-llm-chatgpt-web](https://github.com/sunyifeisb-art/dsh-llm-chatgpt-web) - Answers model calls by driving your own logged-in chatgpt.com session in a local Chrome, so inference spends the ChatGPT web quota rather than Codex quota, and adds a JSON tool-call protocol so the web model can run DSH tools.
- [superboy911/dsh-model-router](https://github.com/superboy911/dsh-model-router) - Deterministic keyword routing, allowlisted model switching, and an isolated image_gen channel for DeepSeek Harness.
- [superfish058/dsh-llm-proxy](https://github.com/superfish058/dsh-llm-proxy) - Per-model proxy routing for LLM requests: selected models go through a proxy (Clash etc.) while the rest stay direct, with automatic retry on transport errors, 429 and 5xx, configured live from the settings page.
- [SYXliuliuliu/dsh-apply-model-all](https://github.com/SYXliuliuliu/dsh-apply-model-all) - Apply the current session's model to every other session in one click, from a control beside the composer's model picker.
- [tafcear/kimi-tide#dsh-kimi-tide](https://github.com/tafcear/kimi-tide/tree/main/packages/dsh-kimi-tide) - Per-step model router: named presets with ordered image/keyword-group rules route each agent step across every mounted provider and model, adding collaboration flows for image transcription, an image guard, a multi-plan quota panel, and per-step decision observability.
- [taikaikaikai-pixel/dsh-tap](https://github.com/taikaikaikai-pixel/dsh-tap) - Unofficial upstream bundle for DeepSeek Harness. CodeBuddy gateway with a runtime-synced model catalogue, per-model reasoning efforts, web search/fetch, image generation and a streaming credential bridge, plus TraeWork CN and Qoder CN subscription channels via local translation gateways and a key-type OpenAI-compatible provider registry, all managed from an accordion settings card.
- [tako-dev/dsh-tako](https://github.com/tako-dev/dsh-tako) - Adds Tako chat models to the official llm-pi-ai provider list from Tako's public catalog, with live refresh, context windows from size tags, and browser one-click sign-in writing a cr_ key into DSH credentials.
- [tangyixiao/dsh-workbuddy-connect-community](https://github.com/tangyixiao/dsh-workbuddy-connect-community) - Community-maintained WorkBuddy and WorkBuddy AI model provider using local desktop sign-in, with model discovery and credit display. Declares DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 and rc.3 compatibility, with a CN compatibility layer that differs from the functy23 fork.
- [tangyixiao/dsh-zcode-plan-bridge](https://github.com/tangyixiao/dsh-zcode-plan-bridge) - Requires the ZCode CLI installed and signed in. Relays the ZCode CLI agent into DeepSeek Harness as a model provider. A resident app-server session streams each turn, and the model catalogue is read from the CLI at runtime, so context windows, image support and provider routes follow the installed CLI and account. Stable 0.5.1 declares DSH compatibility through engines.dsh; ZCode CLI 3.16.3 is the documented reference version. Tool permission requests are denied by default; unknown approval or permission methods are always denied, and full-auto requires an explicit opt-in. DSH approval UI does not mediate this separately spawned app-server process, and the policy is not an OS sandbox.
- [tearslee/dsh-workbuddy2api](https://github.com/tearslee/dsh-workbuddy2api) - Supervises a local workbuddy2api gateway process and exposes its models as an LLM provider, reading context windows and reasoning efforts from the gateway's own model endpoint.
- [Tests4gptplay/dsh-codex-native](https://github.com/Tests4gptplay/dsh-codex-native) - Connect OpenAI Codex app-server as a DSH main model with ChatGPT sign-in, HTTP transport, automatic official Codex latest runtime updates, on-demand live Codex model catalog, native tools, settings, selectable questions and automatic chat replies, on-demand local and connector skills, Windows Computer Use recovery, context management, quota and Token usage history.
- [TheStreamCode/dsh-muse-code](https://github.com/TheStreamCode/dsh-muse-code) - Adds Meta's Muse Code subscription as a DSH model provider: the bundle declares the shipped Meta route under Settings > Models, syncs the account chat catalog (Muse Wonder included) into the model picker, and adds a Sign in card plus the /muse-login command that run DSH's built-in Meta device-code flow, keep the minted key renewed, and show a red or green credential dot. Needs an active Muse Code subscription and no Meta CLI.
- [thibautrey/multivibe#dsh-multivibe](https://github.com/thibautrey/multivibe/tree/main/plugins/dsh-multivibe) - Connect DSH to a MultiVibe gateway and inspect available models and connection status.
- [TikaFlow/dsh-model-fix](https://github.com/TikaFlow/dsh-model-fix) - Provides a better model experience, including but not limited to: filling model parameters in multiple ways, improving model compatibility, remembering reasoning efforts, subagents following the parent's model and reasoning effort in real time, and AI self-adjusting reasoning effort.
- [TinyBOOOOM/dsh-cliproxyapi-pro](https://github.com/TinyBOOOOM/dsh-cliproxyapi-pro) - Connects CLIProxyAPI (CPA) to DeepSeek Harness (DSH) with multiple accounts, model filtering, native protocols, quota lookup and image / video generation; once configured, the selected models appear in the model picker automatically.
- [tkaiz0406/dsh-subagent-route-pin](https://github.com/tkaiz0406/dsh-subagent-route-pin) - Registers a wrapper provider that gives delegated subagents their own LLM route — one-off spawns through provider.start, Agent Teams members through a hook on startActivation — while the main agent keeps its model. Ships a Settings section for picking that route, a per-expert override file, a capability flag reporting which seams the hook caught, and a readiness record written at mount.
- [tonylee2022/dsh-xai-oauth](https://github.com/tonylee2022/dsh-xai-oauth) - Sign in to an xAI Grok subscription with device-code OAuth, refresh the access token, and use it as the xai route credential without an API key.
- [TonyWu2333/dsh-mercury-diffusion](https://github.com/TonyWu2333/dsh-mercury-diffusion) - Plays Inception Mercury's diffusion (denoising) stream live in the dsh Web UI answer bubble: for routes that support it, the request is re-sent with `diffusing: true` and the real frames are replayed from noise to final text, while only the converged answer reaches the session log. Support is detected per provider/model with a probe that is rejected before any token is generated, a floating per-model toggle turns it on, and attachments, auxiliary calls or unsupported routes fall back to the original adapter. Replaces the assistant-message renderer for all models while enabled.
- [troytse/dsh-plugin-subagent-roles](https://github.com/troytse/dsh-plugin-subagent-roles) - File-defined subagent roles for DeepSeek Harness: roles live in project and global .dsh/roles files, a delegating agent sees one catalog line per role, and each role's tool policy decides which tools its child can see.
- [uio-o/dsh-model-control](https://github.com/uio-o/dsh-model-control) - Replaces the composer model seat with a search-first picker and adds a model management page: create and edit llm-pi-ai channels, choose which of an endpoint's models exist, and declare per-model thinking ladders and capabilities.
- [upJiang/dsh-ccswitch](https://github.com/upJiang/dsh-ccswitch) - Adds CC Switch providers and models to DeepSeek Harness, with provider filtering and model-name search.
- [V1ki/dsh-plugin-subscriptions](https://github.com/V1ki/dsh-plugin-subscriptions) - Use ChatGPT (Codex), Claude, and Grok subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers, with Settings login, model catalogs, usage, plus image_generate, video_generate, and x_search tools.
- [Venshell/dsh-workbuddy-connect](https://github.com/Venshell/dsh-workbuddy-connect) - Brings the models available in the logged-in WorkBuddy desktop app into the model picker, reusing the app login and credits; the domestic and international builds appear as two separate provider groups. Continuation of the now-deleted corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect; it registers the same workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider ids, so it cannot be installed alongside other WorkBuddy bridges.
- [Venshell/dsh-zcode-startplan](https://github.com/Venshell/dsh-zcode-startplan) - Connects the free ZCode plan to the model picker: a multi-account pool with rotation, per-account rate-limit and quota display, and bigmodel/zai device login.
- [Vikrant-Aleph/dsh-opencode-bridge](https://github.com/Vikrant-Aleph/dsh-opencode-bridge) - OpenCode free models for DSH with dynamic model-list refresh, optional HTTP(S)/SOCKS proxy failover, a fail-closed tool bridge and offline agent-scoped compatibility auditing.
- [vitas/dsh-model-pricing](https://github.com/vitas/dsh-model-pricing) - Model pricing for the DSH settings page: ~7,250 models / 213 providers with the harness catalog overlaid, honest lowest-listed comparison, session costs priced by the actual route, cache-leak attribution, and a verified promotion feed.
- [volcengine/ark-cli#ark-plan-api](https://github.com/volcengine/ark-cli/tree/main/dsh-plugins/ark-plan-api) - Registers Ark Agent Plan, Coding Plan and postpaid model routes in the native DSH model picker.
- [Wahwayhale/dsh-connect-doubao](https://github.com/Wahwayhale/dsh-connect-doubao) - Reuses the sign-in already held by the local Doubao desktop app as a DeepSeek Harness model provider, and adds a read-only quota view for the 5-hour and weekly windows. Windows x64 only: the credential is decrypted with DPAPI.
- [wangyemen/agnes-ai-for-dsh](https://github.com/wangyemen/agnes-ai-for-dsh) - Agnes AI provider for llm-pi-ai: 4 multimodal chat models declared in the bundle patch, plus image and video generation tools.
- [webkubor/dsh-llm-hub](https://github.com/webkubor/dsh-llm-hub) - Fills in what the official pi-ai adapter leaves out on the Models page: gateway reachability probing with latency, one-click pull of the gateway model catalog with checkbox write-back into settings, DeepSeek balance and provider quota shown in place, the protocol and endpoint each provider is actually wired to, and a model dropdown that lists only what works right now — a dead key, an empty balance or an exhausted quota is hidden until you fix it, and comes back on its own.
- [welsione/dsh-model-router](https://github.com/welsione/dsh-model-router) - Unified model routing for DeepSeek Harness: one logical ModelID over multiple providers with first-token failover and cooldown, health-aware candidate ranking, three tiers (tier1/tier2/tier3) auto-selected by purpose, per-candidate reasoning effort, and a settings-page management panel.
- [wenheguo2/dsh-delegation-suite](https://github.com/wenheguo2/dsh-delegation-suite) - Ranked subagent delegation: role-based model routing with failover, per-route reasoning effort, model-transparent labels, fork delegation, and a visual route editor.
- [wenzetan/dsh-llm-newapi](https://github.com/wenzetan/dsh-llm-newapi) - NewAPI (OpenAI-compatible gateway) LLM provider: registers a `newapi` route with chat-only model discovery, auto-fills model parameters (context window, reasoning effort) from models.dev, and adds a Web settings section for the base URL and API key.
- [whoiszzj/dsh-opencodego](https://github.com/whoiszzj/dsh-opencodego) - OpenCode Go provider that verifies a model against the gateway rather than treating a recommendation as a measurement: the models.dev protocol suggestion is probed before it is used, reasoning levels follow a measured contract, and requests run through an ordered protocol fallback chain. Context window, max output and image-input numbers are declared by a runtime-refreshed models.dev layer rather than probed, with operator overrides above both. Several OpenCode Go credentials can be stored and switched from the settings page.
- [Willmylife/dsh-model-connection-test](https://github.com/Willmylife/dsh-model-connection-test) - Adds a connection-test panel under Settings -> Models: reads the deployment's model catalog and probes each configured model with one minimal chat round-trip (a short "ping" with a small output cap) through the Host LLM service, verifying connectivity with a real request. Each row reports success/failure with the harness failure code (NO_ADAPTER, MISSING_CREDENTIAL, AUTH, RATE_LIMIT, TIMEOUT, ...) plus first-token/total latency; single-model and concurrent test-all (3) are supported. Credentials are resolved inside the Host process and never reach the browser; probes are independent per model behind a same-origin-fenced route with a body-size cap. Pure JS, no build step, MIT.
- [WiseXin/dsh-antigravity](https://github.com/WiseXin/dsh-antigravity) - Google Antigravity and Cloud Code Assist model provider with Gemini 3.8 Flash, sandbox failover, and multi-account quota management.
- [wjf1/dsh-commandcode](https://github.com/wjf1/dsh-commandcode) - Command Code LLM provider for DSH Desktop: registers the commandcode route with a live model catalog, configurable request and stream-idle timeouts, multi-account rotation on 429/401, plan-aware model filtering, an OAuth login flow and a bilingual usage and billing panel.
- [WJZ-P/dsh-model-capabilities](https://github.com/WJZ-P/dsh-model-capabilities) - Adds an input-modality selector to custom model settings in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
- [WLV-ZEDD/dsh-chatgpt-web](https://github.com/WLV-ZEDD/dsh-chatgpt-web) - Free conversational ChatGPT Web (GPT 5.6 Luna) model provider for DeepSeek Harness with streaming Markdown.
- [WNJXYK/dsh-codex-oauth](https://github.com/WNJXYK/dsh-codex-oauth) - Use a ChatGPT/Codex subscription in DeepSeek Harness with GPT models, image generation, web search, subscription quota reporting, model and feature controls, and browser or device-code OAuth sign-in.
- [wqy8593521/dsh-model-pro](https://github.com/wqy8593521/dsh-model-pro) - Lifecycle management UI for the llm-pi-ai model provider: create, edit, delete, enable and disable providers with custom headers and AES-GCM-encrypted API keys; uninstall-safe restore of parked providers, remote model discovery with batch write, smart routing with five strategies, union/intersection composites, per-model connectivity tests, and request observability.

- [wss534857356/dsh-plugin-codex](https://github.com/wss534857356/dsh-plugin-codex) - Codex App Server model provider using a local Codex login, with session reuse, Harness tool bridging, native action traces, and durable generated-image projection.
- [wyouwd1/dsh-opencode-models](https://github.com/wyouwd1/dsh-opencode-models) - Manages OpenCode Zen free-tier and Go-tier models in settings.yaml — fetches the live model listings from opencode.ai, reports configured-versus-live drift per route, and adds or removes entries through four agent tools and an OpenCode Models settings section.
- [XDTrees/dsh-opencode-xdbridge](https://github.com/XDTrees/dsh-opencode-xdbridge) - Adds OpenCode Zen free models to DeepSeek Harness as one provider, backed by a managed, isolated OpenCode runtime, with a Settings page that lists each model and tests it.
- [XDTrees/dsh-workbuddy-xdpool](https://github.com/XDTrees/dsh-workbuddy-xdpool) - Merge every locally signed-in WorkBuddy account into DeepSeek Harness as one auto-failing-over model pool (multi-account rotation, live credits, and a model catalog showing per-model credit multipliers and free/night-discount tags).
- [XDTrees/dsh-xdpool](https://github.com/XDTrees/dsh-xdpool) - Merge every locally signed-in WorkBuddy account into DeepSeek Harness as one auto-failing-over model pool: multi-account rotation, 429 cooldowns, live credits, a model catalog with per-model credit multipliers and free/night-discount tags, QR-code login for 13 vendors, and aggregate free-tier channels. Accounts persist across restarts.
- [xiamubumu/dsh-aux-degrade](https://github.com/xiamubumu/dsh-aux-degrade) - Stops compaction summaries and session titles from burning their output budget on reasoning, by lowering the thinking level and raising the token floor for auxiliary calls only.
- [XiangSu-ce/dsh-plugin-freecodego#bundle-latest](https://github.com/XiangSu-ce/dsh-plugin-freecodego/tree/main/plugin/packages/freecodego/bundle-latest) - Unofficial FreeCodeGo for DeepSeek Harness: DeepSeek, Codex and Claude engines over one session and toolchain, with a 0-token free access channel for deepseek-v4.1-flash, deepseek-v4-pro, deepseek-v4-flash-free, glm-5.3-flash, grok-4.6, kimi-k3, nemotron-3-ultra-free, muse-spark-1.3, Qwen 3.8 Flash and mimo-v2.6-flash-free, plus a keyless private-key gateway.
- [xiaobbl/dsh-opencode-go-model-list](https://github.com/xiaobbl/dsh-opencode-go-model-list) - Serves the live opencode Go model catalog from the harness's built-in opencode-go provider route.
- [xiaohai-78/dsh-request-params](https://github.com/xiaohai-78/dsh-request-params) - Add your own parameters to the model requests dsh sends: OpenRouter provider routing and fallback models, reasoning, sampling and custom body fields, and headers, for OpenRouter or any other gateway. Parameters are organized by the channels dsh already has; a live preview shows what each request will carry, and a request log shows what was sent and what the gateway answered.
- [xiaomao49/dsh-model-probe](https://github.com/xiaomao49/dsh-model-probe) - Measures what an llm-pi-ai endpoint really accepts — context window from its own model list, output-token limit and reasoning levels read out of its own range errors, image support from a generated test image — then reports declared values that contradict that evidence and rewrites them only after confirmation.
- [xiaozhe7772222/dsh-opencode-zen](https://github.com/xiaozhe7772222/dsh-opencode-zen) - Zero-cost access to 6 free large models. No registration, no recharge, 6 free models built-in, multi-key rotation and rate-limit backoff.
- [xiean676/dsh-freemodels-opencode](https://github.com/xiean676/dsh-freemodels-opencode) - Connects the OpenCode Zen anonymous free lane to DeepSeek Harness: refresh the model list from upstream, tick which models the opencode provider exposes, test any of them with a real request that ends in one of seven verdicts, and order both the settings card and the model selector by a hand-written S/A/B/C capability rating.
- [xingzhen199186/dsh-advisor-group](https://github.com/xingzhen199186/dsh-advisor-group) - Consult multiple expert advisor models in a retro CRT chat-group card: one ask_advisors call runs an auto-deepen pipeline (driver deep-question, advisor relay, synthesis conclusion) with SSE streaming, 26 provider presets, a configurable daily quota, stop/resume, and optional advisor tool calling.
- [xingzhen199186/dsh-subagent-custom](https://github.com/xingzhen199186/dsh-subagent-custom) - Subagent model control: a Jev classifier labels each turn, and the subagent request itself is rewritten to the provider, model and reasoning effort that the label maps to, at the agent/request hook; a per-session inherit/auto/manual selector, one prompt per role injected ahead of the task, and offline replay of past verdicts.
- [xuan666-lab/dsh-openrouter-provider-advisor](https://github.com/xuan666-lab/dsh-openrouter-provider-advisor) - Ranks OpenRouter providers for the current DSH model by quantization, speed, cache-heavy price, context, and uptime, with one-click switching to help reduce token costs.

- [yfwu2020/dsh-opencode-go-second](https://github.com/yfwu2020/dsh-opencode-go-second) - Adds an independent OpenCode Go connection with credential settings, manual model discovery, and per-conversation session headers.
- [yoshino-xiao7/dsh-codex](https://github.com/yoshino-xiao7/dsh-codex) - Community Codex provider for DeepSeek Harness with ChatGPT OAuth, Codex models, image input, quota display, per-session Fast and transport controls, and safe stream recovery.
- [yoshino-xiao7/dsh-grok-provider](https://github.com/yoshino-xiao7/dsh-grok-provider) - Grok Build provider using the official CLI browser login, with dynamic account-visible models, streaming reasoning and tools, plus quota and model-capability settings.
- [young-tim/dsh-llm-governor](https://github.com/young-tim/dsh-llm-governor) - Governs multi-model access, monthly credits, manual/quality/credit/auto routing, failure rerouting, and usage auditing for DSH.
- [yu-wenchao/dsh-opencode-free-models#dsh-opencode-free-models](https://github.com/yu-wenchao/dsh-opencode-free-models/tree/master/plugin/dsh-opencode-free-models) - Free model provider plugin for DSH with 20+ models including Gemini, MiMo, GLM, etc.
- [Yuedalao/dsh-connect-minimax](https://github.com/Yuedalao/dsh-connect-minimax) - Connects an existing local MiniMax Code sign-in to DeepSeek Harness through a loopback reverse proxy without storing an API key or signing out.
- [Yuer6327/ModelTester](https://github.com/Yuer6327/ModelTester) - Model attribution panel for the dsh web chat — local, zero-network structural fingerprinting (template token leaks, glitch canaries, tokenizer usage-vector matching) that scores which of 29 AI vendors a session's responses most resemble, with a per-claim evidence ledger and a 12-probe active battery.

- [yuioi666/dsh-plugin-model-capability](https://github.com/yuioi666/dsh-plugin-model-capability) - Model Capability Manager for DSH Web: thinking levels, context window, output caps, input modalities, gateway compat presets, EN/中文 UI.
- [Yunado/dsh-qwen38-local-qol](https://github.com/Yunado/dsh-qwen38-local-qol) - Per-request thinking budgets, a compaction backend, and a settings tab for the local Qwen3.8 line (llama.cpp or NInfer).
