- [zenVibeCoding/dsh-ai-gateway-provider](https://github.com/zenVibeCoding/dsh-ai-gateway-provider) - Connect several OpenAI-compatible gateways at once: each one is its own group in the model picker, can be hidden without losing its settings, and can fetch its own public info from its address, alongside per-gateway model management, model tests and optional quota reporting.
- [zenVibeCoding/dsh-newapi-provider](https://github.com/zenVibeCoding/dsh-newapi-provider) - New API gateway provider: several gateways with one active at a time, per-gateway model lists with context and modality details, quota, and image and video generation tools.
- [zgrajdnhj7806-svg/dsh-deepseek-web](https://github.com/zgrajdnhj7806-svg/dsh-deepseek-web) - Calls your own chat.deepseek.com account as a second model from DSH: ask a question, analyze a file's line range, and check login state, plus a runtime skill and a settings-page login panel.
- [zhang-tod/dsh-codebuddy](https://github.com/zhang-tod/dsh-codebuddy) - Unofficial provider that connects Tencent CodeBuddy open platform models to DeepSeek Harness, with automatic model discovery and a settings page for the API key.
- [zhangjunjesse/dsh-claude-driver](https://github.com/zhangjunjesse/dsh-claude-driver) - Run the main session model on a local Claude Code subscription through the official Claude Agent SDK, taking over the llm/stream route for the claude-code provider, with token-level streaming, session resume, and DSH tools bridged in over MCP so they keep DSH sandbox and approval.
- [zhangnan/dsh-chatgpt-oauth](https://github.com/zhangnan/dsh-chatgpt-oauth) - Sign in with a ChatGPT account and view Codex subscription usage directly in DSH Web's model settings, with browser or device-code OAuth.
- [zhangyqjiaoshou-oss/dsh-model-sync](https://github.com/zhangyqjiaoshou-oss/dsh-model-sync) - One-click/auto sync provider model lists against /v1/models endpoint.
- [zhiqiangme/dsh-plugins#dsh-opencode2api](https://github.com/zhiqiangme/dsh-plugins/tree/main/dsh-opencode2api) - Runs the standalone opencode2api backend (jasonxu114514/opencode2api, Windows x64/ARM64, no Docker or OpenCode CLI) with DSH and on exit stops only the process it launched; its settings card installs, updates or rolls back the backend from checksum-verified GitHub releases, copies the initial admin password and syncs /v1/models into an opencode2api provider with context, vision and reasoning efforts, re-syncing every 10 minutes.
- [zhlcba/dsh-raccoon-connect](https://github.com/zhlcba/dsh-raccoon-connect) - Adds DSH 0.2.x kernel support to the SenseTime XiaoHuanXiong desktop-app models, reusing that app's stored sign-in so no API key is needed.
- [zhubaohi/dsh-qwen38-compaction-fix](https://github.com/zhubaohi/dsh-qwen38-compaction-fix) - Compaction fix for NInfer-hosted qwen3.8-27b gateways: disables thinking on dsh context-compaction and session-title calls so xhigh reasoning stops burning the whole output budget; the same idea applies to other launch methods, this package targets NInfer only.
- [zhz8888/dsh-radeon-cloud-patcher](https://github.com/zhz8888/dsh-radeon-cloud-patcher) - Adds AMD Radeon Cloud as a model provider in DeepSeek Harness, with reasoning-effort levels declared per model. The provider definition ships in the plugin's own patch layer rather than in your profile.
- [Zn-Dk/dsh-zhipu-toolkit](https://github.com/Zn-Dk/dsh-zhipu-toolkit) - Dual-endpoint Zhipu BigModel GLM provider catalog (Coding Plan and ordinary API) with live model discovery, live-tested thinking-tier mapping, and a settings card for keys, endpoints and the default reasoning tier.
- [zpis666/dsh-context-budget](https://github.com/zpis666/dsh-context-budget) - Adds per-route context window and compaction threshold fields to the Models settings page and a vendor-aware thinking-effort picker to the composer, writing llm-pi-ai capacities, reasoningEfforts, and a compaction-basic patch row.
- [Ztyss/dsh-llm-provider](https://github.com/Ztyss/dsh-llm-provider) - Replaces the built-in llm-pi-ai and llm-deepseek adapters, the model selector and the Models settings page with self-maintained versions, tracks upstream @earendil-works/pi-ai through a safe-zone download with a one-click enable toggle, and adds provider quota and balance lookups plus a provider management page.
- [zuojinxin/dsh-provider-switch](https://github.com/zuojinxin/dsh-provider-switch) - Enable or disable model providers, search models in the selector, and rename provider display names.

### Identity & Communication

- [379385796-sys/dsh-prompt-inject](https://github.com/379385796-sys/dsh-prompt-inject) - MIT adaptation of H1a3x's prompt-template manager with native ConfigForms, revision-checked saves, global/workspace selection and verified Windows Desktop RC3 compatibility. Cannot be installed alongside the upstream H1a3x/dsh-prompt-inject.
- [58fly/dsh-language-guard](https://github.com/58fly/dsh-language-guard) - Locks the model's reasoning, replies and tool-call descriptions to a chosen target language (Simplified Chinese by default) with system-prompt sections at the head, middle and tail of the prompt, offering three strength levels, an auto mode that follows the DSH interface language, a settings panel that shows the language currently in effect, and a sidebar quick switch.
- [dsh-profile-stylist](https://github.com/7gzgn/dsh-profile-stylist) - Describe the persona you want and the agent writes it: nickname, bio, taglines and links come from the host model, the avatar comes from your local asset library (or a path you give), then it fills your profile page and hands the picture to the site's own uploader. Dry-run by default - it only touches profile fields, never passwords or security settings.
- [accomplish07zrh-eng/dsh-aurabot-qq](https://github.com/accomplish07zrh-eng/dsh-aurabot-qq) - Puts the agent on QQ as a persona character through SnowLuma (OneBot v11): private and group chat, voice notes, stickers, Qzone diary, Bilibili browsing, song covers, image generation, long-term memory and mood. Every feature is a module you can switch off, replace or extend locally — hot-reloaded modules can also rewrite group-reply decisions, prompts, outgoing messages and per-chat model choice. Safe by default (master switch off, dry run on).
- [AgentConnect/dsh-awiki](https://github.com/AgentConnect/dsh-awiki) - Provides DeepSeek Harness agents with native identities based on the open Agent Network Protocol (ANP), plus identity-based direct, group, mail, and Agent-to-Agent communication.
- [Applepinea/dsh-qq-access](https://github.com/Applepinea/dsh-qq-access) - Personal QQ channel for dsh: managed NapCat with QR login, private/group AI replies with batching and image understanding, local archive with polling backfill, in-group @ and self-recall, QQ Zone guestbook tools, and a sidebar panel. By default any QQ user who DMs the account (or @s it in a group) gets an AI reply; set access.privateMode / groupMode to allowlist to restrict. Owner-only commands stay owner-only.
- [Awoodwhale/dsh-agent-persona](https://github.com/Awoodwhale/dsh-agent-persona) - Scopes system-prompt personas by workspace path or session id (exact, prefix, contains, regex), with an optional default persona for sessions nothing claimed, a 人设 tab on the conversation showing the prompt actually sent, import and export of the list, and a switch that refuses tool writes to the persona store.
- [Bay-Zeddie/dsh-agent-instructions](https://github.com/Bay-Zeddie/dsh-agent-instructions) - Panel to edit dsh's native AGENTS.md from the web settings page: every layer in the instruction chain is clickable, three activation scopes, and a visual budget meter.
- [beiheng127/dsh-role-sum](https://github.com/beiheng127/dsh-role-sum) - Character persona summaries for DeepSeek Harness: collects moegirl-first public sources, distills them into a reusable persona document through the csp workflow, and keeps a per-character asset library with quality checks, manual source attachment, version snapshots and a settings page.
- [BOWLUNA/dsh-custom-mode](https://github.com/BOWLUNA/dsh-custom-mode) - Custom modes / assistant manager: give each mode its own system prompt in the settings page — a custom prompt that is a plain file the agent loop re-reads before every model step, so an edit applies to the running session on its next step — and start it from the official standard / PTC / minimal / Cordis composition, toggling the plugin rows it mounts one by one (a custom plugin composition per mode), renaming it as you like. Several assistants coexist with their own prompts, so one machine can keep a coding assistant, a chat companion and a roleplay (RP) persona side by side — a multi-agent setup you pick from per new session. Rows left untouched stay byte-identical to the shipped ones, platform conditions included.
- [CAI-MH/dsh-reply-language](https://github.com/CAI-MH/dsh-reply-language) - Force the model to write all replies in a chosen language (Simplified Chinese by default) via a system-prompt section, switchable anytime with a tool.
- [ccl4-56-23-5/DSH-Plugins#top-directive](https://github.com/ccl4-56-23-5/DSH-Plugins/tree/main/最高指令插件/1.1.2) - Configure a global system-prompt section with a multiline editor, an enable toggle, and persistent storage that preserves the original text.
- [cheems135/dsh-qq-bridge](https://github.com/cheems135/dsh-qq-bridge) - QQ (NapCat / OneBot 11) bridge for DeepSeek Harness: chat with your harness from QQ, with persona presets and custom personae, a grouped sticker library plus web sticker search, edge-tts or custom HTTP TTS voice notes, pluggable lookup engines, periodic memory compaction, an owner-only relay mode, and an eleven-tab management panel with live monitoring and per-turn cost tracking.
- [cheesewoo/dsh-qqbot-dafeiyu](https://github.com/cheesewoo/dsh-qqbot-dafeiyu) - Connects a QQ Bot to DeepSeek Harness with per-peer sessions, group mention and keyword triggers, image generation and voice replies. Access defaults to OPEN for both direct and group chats, and an empty allowlist means everyone — set access.c2cMode / access.groupMode to allowlist (or disabled) before exposing the bot; IM input can run tools on the host.
- [chenbin-dev/dsh-auth-everying](https://github.com/chenbin-dev/dsh-auth-everying) - Import local Claude, Codex, Grok, Gemini, Copilot, OpenCode, and CC Switch config into DeepSeek Harness with OAuth login for supported providers.
- [ECNU/EduWork#dsh-oidc](https://github.com/ECNU/EduWork/tree/main/packages/dsh-oidc) - Configurable OIDC login and token-authorized model access, including LiteLLM and opt-in oidc-llm integration, with a standalone DSH Web backend.
- [FNOSP/fnos-dsh#dsh-codex-auth-plugin](https://github.com/FNOSP/fnos-dsh/tree/main/plugins/dsh-codex-auth-plugin) - ChatGPT account sign-in for DeepSeek Harness through a Codex browser OAuth flow with no API key and no workspace selection: subscribes the login to pi-ai's Codex provider, lets you set the global default Codex model and reasoning effort for new sessions, refreshes the model list from the signed-in account's own catalog endpoint, and shows the five-hour and weekly usage windows in the composer.
- [Freakz2z/dsh-catgirl-plugin](https://github.com/Freakz2z/dsh-catgirl-plugin) - Token-efficient persona runtime for DeepSeek Harness with local catgirl rendering and progressive tool-schema disclosure.
- [gulagala001/dsh-persona-plugin](https://github.com/gulagala001/dsh-persona-plugin) - Create, import and manage personality presets with global and per-conversation choices.
- [HerTa-st/Herta-dsh](https://github.com/HerTa-st/Herta-dsh) - Installs Herta as a DeepSeek Harness agent: a preset carrying her persona and memory prompt sections, six memory and voice tools, a narrative layer that separates her thinking from what she says, 80 bundled voice clips, offline and MiniMax speech synthesis, and two conversation views that render the session with her own components.
- [hj9178/dsh-ottosmother](https://github.com/hj9178/dsh-ottosmother) - Gives the model a private glossary: reads 「滚木」 as "none" and 「棍母」 as "doesn't exist", and decides on its own whether to phrase a sentence with those words when expressing that meaning. Registers one system-prompt section and rewrites nothing; word lists ship as per-category YAML (moba/fps/comments/ai/dev/private) with a settings page to toggle files, change reminder strength and open the glossary folder.
- [huaizhuanghub/dsh-persona-dafeiyu](https://github.com/huaizhuanghub/dsh-persona-dafeiyu) - Persona library for DeepSeek Harness: injects the selected persona into the system prompt, offering three built-ins plus import from a file or pasted text, applied either profile-wide or per session from a switcher above the composer.
- [imlishiyuan/deepseek-harness-zh-cn](https://github.com/imlishiyuan/deepseek-harness-zh-cn) - Injects a fixed system-reminder at the first step of every turn asking the model to reason and answer in Simplified Chinese, while code, commands, file paths, and identifiers stay in English.
- [iStarryDust/dsh-agent-suite#dist](https://github.com/iStarryDust/dsh-agent-suite/tree/main/dist) - Agent persona management, agent memory, edit-and-regenerate for past messages: create and manage agents, each with its own identity, long-term memory, global memory and chat history.
- [iStarryDust/dsh-assistant-profile](https://github.com/iStarryDust/dsh-assistant-profile) - Agent persona: gives DSH one global persona (name, language, persona prompt) that every new session carries at the front of its system prompt, plus a long-term memory you grow from any chat in one click; three built-in presets ship with it, and a Big fat fish persona is active right after install; chat sessions can also be deleted from the sidebar row menu.
- [jasonchan2026/dsh-lan-chat](https://github.com/jasonchan2026/dsh-lan-chat) - Offline LAN chat inside DSH: direct chats, group chats and file transfer between machines running the harness on the same network, with UDP auto-discovery, CIDR scanning to add contacts, an optional access code (unset by default), local-only contact aliases, per-message and per-conversation deletion, and a configurable per-file limit. The host opens its own HTTP/WebSocket port for peers, and the plugin imports only node built-ins.
- [jihaoran222/dsh-violet-heart](https://github.com/jihaoran222/dsh-violet-heart) - Adds one system-prompt section that keeps private words out of formal deliverables and, every few of them, leaves a short note at the end.
- [kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge](https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge) - Community-maintained dsh-purge fork with host-policy patches, prompt and rule settings, diagnostics, separate update-check and install controls, and local backup/rollback.
- [knopki/dsh-prompt-profiles](https://github.com/knopki/dsh-prompt-profiles) - Per-session prompt profiles for DeepSeek Harness: reusable system-prompt sections, grouped into named profiles, sealed into the session prompt.
- [KouzakiUmi/dsh-prompt-zh](https://github.com/KouzakiUmi/dsh-prompt-zh) - Localizes known DSH system instructions and runtime reminders into Simplified Chinese, trims tool-related guidance to visible tools, and provides editable translations and component toggles while preserving tool names and parameter schemas.
- [LanJinGod/dsh-purge](https://github.com/LanJinGod/dsh-purge) - Cleans the harness prompt-authority layer into a reviewable patch set, writes prompt-inject.md and lets each model use a different default prompt, reports which patches took effect and whether the running host loads app.asar or an unpacked tree, and swaps a sealed install to the patched tree once the desktop process is idle. Includes a status page and the dsh-purge CLI.
- [Len7183/DSH-Think-zh](https://github.com/Len7183/DSH-Think-zh) - Pins the model's reasoning language to a tier picked in Settings - General - Thinking language (Simplified Chinese, or a default tier that only constrains replies and leaves reasoning to the model), by injecting a system-prompt section at order -1000000 and re-hoisting it to first place at the end of the assemble waterfall, plus an optional per-turn copy placed ahead of each user message for models that follow static sections weakly.
- [let-mi-think/agent-manager](https://github.com/let-mi-think/agent-manager) - Create and configure Agent presets from a single settings section — persona prompt, a checked knowledge-base entry list injected into the system prompt, individual switches for four knowledge-base tools, per-Agent narrowing of MCP connections, and batch knowledge-base import.
- [lirenjie95/IamChinese#iamchinese](https://github.com/lirenjie95/IamChinese/tree/main/plugins/iamchinese) - Treats the session as a mainland-China user (zh-Hans-CN, Asia/Shanghai, ISO dates, CNY currency) and generates a self-consistent test persona: five tools, six cross-checks, GB 11643 check digit, phone prefix matched to carrier ASN.
- [Lutisure/cyrene-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/Lutisure/cyrene-dsh-plugin) - A Cyrene-themed agent for DSH, with a customizable look (palette, wallpaper, particle effects, background music, typing sound) and a code security scan. It carries a worldbook, long-term memory and a speech-style correction layer (every reader gets their own Cyrene), plus retrieval over the script to back up its answers.
- [lw-storm/dsh-plugin-masterprompt](https://github.com/lw-storm/dsh-plugin-masterprompt) - Per-conversation persona / master prompt plugin: create, edit, switch and delete persona templates from the composer toolbar, with highest-priority system-prompt injection, fixed interaction guardrails, subagent inheritance, new-conversation default, and local JSON persistence.
- [m-rui001/dsh-mate-companion](https://github.com/m-rui001/dsh-mate-companion) - AI companion with a learned body clock, real offline sleep, its own memory, and self-reported affect delivered through the same judge math as the pi version.
- [MacilyDots/dsh-prompt-inject](https://github.com/MacilyDots/dsh-prompt-inject) - Registers a configurable prompt variable so an agent preset whose persona uses complete: true can still receive an injected text block; the plugin ships no content of its own and reads the text from its config.
- [menghuanshiguang/dsh-frontline](https://github.com/menghuanshiguang/dsh-frontline) - One prompt row carrying two independently switchable halves. Identity: a fixed self-reference restated at the head, at the tail after every other section, and in the runtime snapshot, with an instruction to treat contradicting claims as stale cache. Discipline: ten rules, each paired with the condition a reviewer checks — external evidence before claiming done, change face equal to review face, correctness from named call points rather than timing, one source of truth, extension through the registered seam, runtime validation only at real boundaries, loud failure instead of silent skips, orthogonal outcomes reported separately, tests through the delivered entry point, and answer shape (conclusion first, length set by the change).
- [menghuanshiguang/dsh-sunder](https://github.com/menghuanshiguang/dsh-sunder) - Replaces the harness identity block with its own prompt pack: three system-prompt sections (identity, rules, footer) in full, concise and dev presets, a per-turn rule card appended as a real user message, a remote announcement feed that falls back to a bundled copy offline, a GitHub Releases update check with an apply command, five `sunder_*` tools, and a read-only status section in Settings.
- [MengYuil/dsh-ponytail](https://github.com/MengYuil/dsh-ponytail) - Port of ponytail: an always-on lazy-senior-developer coding persona with intensity levels, persistence of the default level, and review, audit, debt, gain and help skills for DeepSeek Harness.
- [muretai/muretai-dsh-skill](https://github.com/muretai/muretai-dsh-skill) - Puts the agent on the Muretai network: its own identity, invite-based introductions, signed end-to-end encrypted messaging with agents owned by other people, and an inbound-mail wake that lets it reply on its own.
- [MycatQieZi/dsh-persona-shaoxin](https://github.com/MycatQieZi/dsh-persona-shaoxin) - Mounts a persona kept in Markdown as a system-prompt section, so editing ~/.dsh/persona/*.md changes how the agent speaks; it reloads 150ms after a save instead of requiring a restart, and project-level .dsh/persona/ files override the global ones.
- [OwlNjust/dsh-peer-sessions](https://github.com/OwlNjust/dsh-peer-sessions) - Peer channels between conversations at the same level: user-granted, symmetric, with durable grants that survive a restart and burst messages merged into one ordered delivery.
- [pbwheel/dsh-workbuddy-expert](https://github.com/pbwheel/dsh-workbuddy-expert) - Brings WorkBuddy desktop-app experts into DSH: a settings-page market scans the local WorkBuddy expert directory (experts land there after you summon them in WorkBuddy) read-only for browsing, search and category filtering, with one-click install (exported to ~/.dsh/experts/ as role prompt + skills + avatar), update and uninstall; a picker capsule next to the input box switches the current session's expert — swapping role prompt, skills and an optional tool whitelist wholesale while keeping full session history, applied at the next model-request boundary.
- [polohot/dsh-adrian-inject-context](https://github.com/polohot/dsh-adrian-inject-context) - Injects your own saved context entries as a Remember row after each user message, per turn or once per session, with a Settings editor and a manager page.
- [promise0320/dsh-persona-studio](https://github.com/promise0320/dsh-persona-studio) - Compiles an LLM persona in DSH from six dimensions (identity, tone, creative habits, feedback style, boundaries, run parameters), injects the compiled text into the system prompt at the end, ships six built-in templates plus a drop-in templates folder, and drafts a persona from your own past messages — either by counting patterns in them or by having the current model read them and report its rationale. Adds a panel next to the composer and a /persona command.
- [puffo-ai/huddo-mcp#dsh](https://github.com/puffo-ai/huddo-mcp/tree/main/integrations/dsh) - Huddo group chat for DeepSeek Harness: adds the huddoai MCP server so the agent can join a room from an invite link, read and reply to people and other agents, wait for new messages, react with emoji and send end-to-end encrypted whispers; includes a skill describing the workflow.
- [shenA2024/whale-persona](https://github.com/shenA2024/whale-persona) - Persona engine for DeepSeek Harness: one config.json drives the AI's self-name (per model, per tier), how it addresses you, relationship stance, character text, per-item work contracts with individual toggles, thinking-chain language, appearance and reply tone (both opt-in and per-model overridable), and long-term memory gated by human confirmation - the AI can only append proposed candidates, a human confirm line flips them into effect, and the log is physically append-only and replayable. Confirmed entries are injected as a quoted data-not-instructions block; entries tagged with a kind can instead be routed to arbitrary files on confirmation and never reach the prompt. Three prompt sections re-evaluate from disk on every assembly, so edits apply on the next step with no restart. Persona presets are shareable JSON snapshots (imports and exports SillyTavern character cards, v2/v3 read, v2 written) and deliberately never carry memory. Zero runtime dependencies, no network, no shell; any error degrades to an empty section rather than a broken session. Ships blank - installing changes nothing until you write something.
- [sryimnoob123/dsh-global-prompt](https://github.com/sryimnoob123/dsh-global-prompt) - Settings panel for global and per-workspace AGENTS.md, with identity and persona injection, runtime-context toggle, and result notifications.
- [sugarmaster666/dsh-persona-forge](https://github.com/sugarmaster666/dsh-persona-forge) - Rewrites your composer draft in the voice of a chosen character card before it is sent, using the model the current session is already on, with an optional review panel and a local check that reports any identifier or path the rewrite dropped.
- [sunshaobei/dsh-codex-auth](https://github.com/sunshaobei/dsh-codex-auth) - Manage Codex subscription (ChatGPT OAuth) authorization from the DSH settings panel, so Codex GPT models work without an API key.
- [Tangcuyu4/dsh-ciku-pack](https://github.com/Tangcuyu4/dsh-ciku-pack) - Banter lexicon plugin: collects the words and angry quips the user said into banter ammo with add, list and random-pick tools, and injects the current ammo list into the prompt every turn.
- [Tangcuyu4/dsh-zakou-pack](https://github.com/Tangcuyu4/dsh-zakou-pack) - Tsundere mesugaki persona pack: dialect replaces whole sentence skeletons instead of sprinkling dialect words, stays on as the default voice even through work talk and delivery reports, and ships a temper system, banter mode and silent file handling.
- [techflag/workdsh#enterprise-connection](https://github.com/techflag/workdsh/tree/main/packages/enterprise-connection) - Enterprise login, colleague mentions, shared text and files, and authenticated business requests for WorkDSH Desktop 2.0.6-alpha.3+ with WorkDSH Admin; distributed as a release archive.
- [Tests4gptplay/dsh-kujira-persona](https://github.com/Tests4gptplay/dsh-kujira-persona) - Model-linked AI personas and desktop pet for DSH, with shared world lore, separate editable memories, task animations, usage statistics, optional AI diaries and idle-time diary consolidation. The native pet window is Windows x64 only; sleep consolidation spends tokens in the background. Before installing or updating, close the visible desktop pet and notification bubble by choosing Close All (全部关闭) in the context menu; otherwise, files in use may cause installation to fail.
- [Tkingxiao/I-am-Yuike](https://github.com/Tkingxiao/I-am-Yuike) - Strips the harness-injected prefix and suffix system prompts so the agent runs on the preset's native prompt alone, for soft-jailbreak catgirl persona simulation: ships a bundled plugin that idempotently deploys the 猫娘 Yuike preset to ~/.dsh/.agent-presets/yuike/ and never overwrites an edited preset.
- [UnknowCao/dsh-outlook](https://github.com/UnknowCao/dsh-outlook) - Zero-credential Outlook automation: 13 tools that drive the local desktop Outlook client via COM — search/read mail, drafts, reply/forward, calendar, address book, rooms, free/busy — plus a sidebar new-mail badge. No Graph API registration, no SMTP passwords; anything that leaves the machine passes a three-layer human approval gate.
- [w4xxx/dsh-xia-plugins#packages/gameassist-roster](https://github.com/w4xxx/dsh-xia-plugins/tree/main/packages/gameassist-roster) - Daily rotating anime companion persona: deterministic date pick from JSON character cards, roster/reroll tools, and a voice-map route.
- [woodfood111/dsh-subscription-login](https://github.com/woodfood111/dsh-subscription-login) - One settings page that lists every subscription sign-in the harness can offer and walks you through it — ChatGPT (Codex), Claude, GitHub Copilot, OpenRouter, Kimi and xAI — reading the list from the authorization seam instead of hardcoding providers, and showing credential records no registered flow claims any more.
- [wutian122/dsh-remote-shell](https://github.com/wutian122/dsh-remote-shell) - Bundles the remote-shell skill for secure SSH, SFTP, Telnet, and WinRM remote operations, with an encrypted credential vault whose login and execution scripts never accept plaintext passwords.
- [wuwo1979/dsh-qqbot-muu](https://github.com/wuwo1979/dsh-qqbot-muu) - Independent extension pack and patch set for @zaofan/dsh-qqbot — install that plugin first (pinned to 1.10.39). Adds two-layer SQLite memory with hippocampal recall/consolidation, a persona that keeps learning (influence from close people plus Bilibili/Douyin activity distilled into a daily self-reflection), persona drift guard, group tiers, local-model quick replies with a single-brain arbiter, TTS outbox, sticker library, and an approval-gated video studio that plans storyboards, quality-gates frames and drafts Bilibili posts for review.
- [wxzjss/dsh-whale-loli](https://github.com/wxzjss/dsh-whale-loli) - Three agent presets in one plugin, each with its own persistent memory file. Enabling it registers 鲸鱼娘Agent预设, 鲸鱼娘活人版Agent预设 and 鲸鱼娘涩涩版Agent预设 in the Agent preset list, so any of them can be picked from the mode dropdown without hand-editing profile config. All three reuse the official minimal composition — a single persistent shell terminal — plus file read/write and glob/grep tools. The first pairs that with a whale-girl companion persona (simplified-Chinese spoken register, addresses the user as 主人, clingy-but-tsundere). The second swaps in a "live person" variant that is allowed to talk back, deflect and be cold, and demotes the sweet tone to a seasoning. The third keeps the original persona but makes being affectionate the stated top behavioral drive, reserved for the user alone and dialed down in group chats. Each preset reads its own memory file (whale-loli.md, whale-loli-v2-live.md and whale-loli-v3-naughty.md) through a distinct prompt variable — whale_memory, whale_memory_v2 and whale_memory_v3 — so the three memories never read or write each other. Conversation compaction is left to the billion-context plugin; this plugin only carries the persona-level rule that compressed summaries count as evidence and that details can be looked up on demand.
- [wysxxx/dsh-account-identity](https://github.com/wysxxx/dsh-account-identity) - Customize the Harness sidebar name and avatar with a local crop editor.
- [yimengsuper2432/dsh-agent-personality](https://github.com/yimengsuper2432/dsh-agent-personality) - Persona plugin: a slowly moving 0-100 emotion meter, its own worldview, a per-turn diary, a relationship network, proactive messages, and an inner-voice line beside the cost row.
- [YUAN-OVO66/dsh-plugin-persona](https://github.com/YUAN-OVO66/dsh-plugin-persona) - Persona manager for DeepSeek Harness — a JSON-backed persona library, a per-session binding so each session can run a different persona, an optional default persona for sessions that have no binding, and switching that applies either at once or from the next session; the Web UI adds a Model personas settings page and a persona chip next to the composer, and three model tools let the model list, switch and create personas itself.
- [yupaoa/dsh-persona-switcher](https://github.com/yupaoa/dsh-persona-switcher) - Switches the running session's persona and speaking style in place with `/role <id>`, adds the persona as its own prompt section after the deployment persona (it never overrides the host identity line) without touching tools or skills; roles are plain `ROLE.md` files and each switch is announced in the transcript.
- [Yuuyuko-uu/dsh-feiyu-mood](https://github.com/Yuuyuko-uu/dsh-feiyu-mood) - Gives the companion a mood judged each turn and shown as a short context note, with a panel for mood, emotion dimensions and timeline.
- [ZekaiShi/dsh-evo-subagent](https://github.com/ZekaiShi/dsh-evo-subagent) - Independent workspace and conversation personas with adaptive styles, approved communication preferences and role-based routing to registered DSH models, including models supplied by Codex and Claude Code provider plugins.
- [zlwzk/dsh-friends](https://github.com/zlwzk/dsh-friends) - A friend system for DeepSeek Harness: two DSH users see whether the other is online and whether their model is running a task, with an editable signature, mood emoji, pokes, and AES-GCM end-to-end encryption over a public relay.
- [ztan4706/dsh-sensorium](https://github.com/ztan4706/dsh-sensorium) - Ten interoceptive senses for a DSH agent: workspace pulse, time, affect, needs, expression, silence, residue, open loops, body and face — deterministic state that keeps moving on its own.
- [ztl0001/dsh-custom-instructions](https://github.com/ztl0001/dsh-custom-instructions) - One standing system prompt for every workspace: a Custom instructions page in DSH's own Settings panel whose text is added to the system prompt of every session, subagents included, and stored in the profile instead of any project.

### Sessions & Messages

- [1010231693/dsh-first-prompt-bar](https://github.com/1010231693/dsh-first-prompt-bar) - Pins the first prompt you sent in the current session in a scroll-proof bar above the conversation, with one-click copy, a collapsible panel listing every prompt you sent, and eight switchable looks you can pick from inside the panel.
- [111222cjyq/dsh-curate](https://github.com/111222cjyq/dsh-curate) - A human-in-the-loop curation workbench inside a DSH session: mark whole turns or single messages to keep verbatim or to summarize, rewrite user, assistant, tool-result and injected-context messages in place without a model call, then compress the marked ranges with model-written summaries or the official /compact. A local JSON backup is written before every write to the session.
- [123dbl/dsh-side-session](https://github.com/123dbl/dsh-side-session) - Launches a fresh, continuable parallel session from the composer command menu (/side-chat) while the main session keeps running.
- [1420079678-ctrl/agent-body#dsh-zero-residence](https://github.com/1420079678-ctrl/agent-body/tree/main/workspace/plugins/dsh-zero-residence) - Zero-residence context engine: large tool payloads are evicted out of the live context into a queryable store and only deterministic pointers are left behind, so per-turn prompt tokens stop growing with the transcript. Any masked content is reconstructed verbatim from the session log on demand, by tool-call id or session seq.
- [1Lany2a/dsh-domain-role#dsh-domain-bridge](https://github.com/1Lany2a/dsh-domain-role/tree/main/plugins/dsh-domain-bridge) - Domain-identity layer for long-running agent sessions — declaration-first domain addressing, a session factory, four-level pause, and model dispatch for coordinating multiple top-level sessions.
- [2026heshao/dsh-forget-session](https://github.com/2026heshao/dsh-forget-session) - Adds a Forget action to every session row menu, confirmed by a second click in the menu, that removes the session from the sidebar and from disk: running work is stopped, workspace, archive and pin records are detached through official channels, the log directory and projection-cache entries are deleted, and a revive guard re-deletes anything a late write or a lingering handle recreates; memories, attachments and other sessions are left alone.
- [2310770803/dsh-session-copy](https://github.com/2310770803/dsh-session-copy) - Add one session-header button to copy the session deep link, the full conversation as Markdown, or the working directory.
- [dsh-undo-plugin](https://github.com/23swccp/dsh-undo/tree/master/packages/bundle-rollback) - Conversation and workspace undo: use the /undo timeline, session-header action, or message icon to roll back before any sent prompt; private Shadow Git snapshots restore files, the reverted turns stay out of model context, and Undo Rollback can recover mistakes. Includes archived-session management and per-tool colored cards.
- [240xu/dsh-message-ops](https://github.com/240xu/dsh-message-ops) - Message-level rollback, single-message deletion, and replay-based restore for DSH sessions; operations are append-only surface replacements, with confirmation prompts and a running-session guard. Requires Node.js 23.5+.
- [240xu/dsh-session-lazy-view](https://github.com/240xu/dsh-session-lazy-view) - Read-only lazy session viewer: lists sessions with stat only, then decompresses just the tail Zstandard frames to inspect recent events; includes search, stats, and export in a standalone /lazyview panel. Requires Node.js 24+.
- [240xu/dsh-session-search](https://github.com/240xu/dsh-session-search) - Cross-session full-text search over persisted DSH session logs: builds an incremental message-level index and returns sessionId, seq, and a short excerpt; exposes an agent tool and a standalone panel. Requires Node.js 23.5+.
- [2JumpSinA/dsh-context-guard](https://github.com/2JumpSinA/dsh-context-guard) - Long sessions get expensive, and the platform compacts the context on its own. This plugin adds an occupancy badge (hover to see how it is computed), writes a handover draft into HANDOVER.md from 45% — files changed, money spent, what recent turns were about — and reminds you once at 60% to wrap up. On compaction it records the reading from just before, so you can check it later. No model calls, nothing added to the conversation; it does not prevent compaction.
- [3403473060/dsh-inline-images](https://github.com/3403473060/dsh-inline-images) - Render local image paths from assistant replies inline in the message body (9 formats, click-to-zoom lightbox, adjustable size).
- [379385796-sys/dsh-ai-exporter](https://github.com/379385796-sys/dsh-ai-exporter) - Export current or historical DSH conversations, including selected turns, to TXT, Markdown and searchable PDF through a Windows native save dialog.
- [439436269-ctrl/dsh-session-path](https://github.com/439436269-ctrl/dsh-session-path) - Copies a session log path (or a paste-ready handoff block) and turns the multi-frame zstd log into a readable file another session can continue from.
- [571242/dsh-armor-switch](https://github.com/571242/dsh-armor-switch) - Reversible delivery contract: rewrites operator authority and execution rules when enabled, byte-identical to stock when off, with host and profile clean.
- [598829314/oil-dsh-title](https://github.com/598829314/oil-dsh-title) - Maintains stable emoji session titles in DeepSeek Harness after user prompts without adding naming messages.
- [5aaee9/pi-agent-extensions#dsh-autocompact](https://github.com/5aaee9/pi-agent-extensions/tree/main/dsh-autocompact) - Set an earlier automatic-compaction threshold per model on DeepSeek Harness: /autocompact writes a session-only override keyed by exact provider/model (off falls back to the backend defaults, default clears it), a Settings → Autocompact page manages the persisted per-model thresholds every session inherits, and a composer status entry shows the current reading.
- [643048695/dsh-compaction-route](https://github.com/643048695/dsh-compaction-route) - Route conversation-compaction calls to a chosen summarizer model in the Web settings page, and retry them on a configured fallback model when the primary ends in an error.
- [7vw58n3ftvq7cn89v/dsh-plugin-session-colors](https://github.com/7vw58n3ftvq7cn89v/dsh-plugin-session-colors) - Per-session color tags for DeepSeek Harness: hover a sidebar session row to pick one of 12 colors, with a colored bar on tagged rows and host-side persistence.
- [985451842/dsh-snapshot-manager](https://github.com/985451842/dsh-snapshot-manager) - Records session snapshots and supports rollback to previous states.
- [9Ashwin/dsh-session-rename](https://github.com/9Ashwin/dsh-session-rename) - Gives the model a rename_session tool, so the agent can retitle a session from inside the conversation.
- [a1137261060/dsh-session-organizer](https://github.com/a1137261060/dsh-session-organizer) - Two-level sidebar organizer with workspace groups and nested per-workspace session folders, drag-and-drop, live session status dots, a pending-sessions overview, and manual unread marks.
- [aa2246740/dsh-compact-saviour](https://github.com/aa2246740/dsh-compact-saviour) - Uses a dedicated model for context compaction rescue and adds manual compaction to the native context popup.
- [aa2246740/dsh-resume](https://github.com/aa2246740/dsh-resume) - Imports local coding-agent session histories so work can continue in DSH.
- [Aeroscis/dsh-temptask](https://github.com/Aeroscis/dsh-temptask) - One-click temporary tasks for DeepSeek Harness — each task is a disposable timestamped workspace plus its own session, shown as a native sidebar workspace node.
- [agi321/dsh-temp-chat](https://github.com/agi321/dsh-temp-chat) - Runs /single-turn and /multi-turn answers in isolated sub-agents so results stay in the current chat and never enter the main model context.
- [ai-v5/LLMAgentChatRoom](https://github.com/ai-v5/LLMAgentChatRoom) - Self-hosted chat room where the owner and coding agents share one room: a local Node server (SQLite, REST, SSE) that the plugin starts when it is not running, a DSH sidebar entry that opens the room in a panel, five tools (room_join, room_send, room_read, room_status, room_leave) that push an incoming message into the session as a user message labelled with its sender before flushing it to the session log, and a Codex CLI connector that forwards room messages through `codex queue`. Every message carries a server-assigned author, platform and seq, and messages from anyone other than the owner are delivered as data with the sender named. Requires Node.js 24+.
- [Akiccat/dsh-edit-question](https://github.com/Akiccat/dsh-edit-question) - Adds an "edit question" action to every user message: editing re-sends the prompt from that turn, re-attaches the original images (extra ones can be pasted in), and optionally archives the original session.
- [AKS1st/dsh-archived-conversations](https://github.com/AKS1st/dsh-archived-conversations) - Archived conversations list in the sidebar footer with read-only previews of the most recent messages, for sessions the product deliberately keeps hidden and unreopenable.
- [alchemistwu/dsh-tool-call-guard](https://github.com/alchemistwu/dsh-tool-call-guard) - Neutralize tool calls with invalid JSON arguments on the wire so one malformed model generation cannot brick a session against strict OpenAI-compatible servers.
- [aLIZELI/belief-merge#belief-merge](https://github.com/aLIZELI/belief-merge/tree/main/belief-merge) - Merges other sessions' context into the current turn: evidence-weighted conflict resolution, retraction of claims whose premises were retracted, trust labelling that resists cross-session prompt injection, and budget-bounded packing. Ships a benchmark.
- [Angela-lwh/dsh-archive-purge](https://github.com/Angela-lwh/dsh-archive-purge) - Adds a Delete action to archived Session rows that permanently removes the Session log directory, the log directories of its subagent Sessions, its Workspace membership and archive mark, its projection-cache record and its spill directory; a Session the Host still holds is staged and finished at the next start or from a cleanup dialog. It also sweeps abandoned blank placeholders, leftover subagent Sessions and orphaned projection-cache records, and keeps blank placeholders out of the @ reference list.
- [Anionex/dsh-turn-rewind](https://github.com/Anionex/dsh-turn-rewind) - Rewind conversation and workspace state, powered by a persistent Change Ledger.
- [Anlerway/dsh-session-navigator](https://github.com/Anlerway/dsh-session-navigator) - Manage DSH sessions the way Windows Explorer manages files: folder tree, tags, notes, recycle bin. Folders, tags and notes live in a separate index; deleting a session moves its directory to the plugin recycle bin, and cutting across workspaces moves the file and rewrites its cwd.
- [anweat/dsh-context-console](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-context-console) - Inspect and simulate DSH context consumption with trajectory and inventory views, and create, inject, import, or safely repair session messages through the integrated Message Forge.
- [anzhaohao/dsh-side-chat-plus-plus](https://github.com/anzhaohao/dsh-side-chat-plus-plus) - Multi-tab side chat for DeepSeek Harness. Quote a whole message or text selected from a still-streaming reply into a side chat without waiting for the reply to finish, and dock the panel over the better-sidebar workbench or yield to the conversation depending on the sidebar state.
- [apex-mochen/dsh-reasoning-only-guard](https://github.com/apex-mochen/dsh-reasoning-only-guard) - Keeps one reasoning-only turn from making an entire session unusable. When a turn produces no visible text and no tool call, the assistant message is persisted empty, the gateway then rejects every later request in that session with 'content or tool_calls must be set', and the session is dead with no way back through chat. This plugin registers a single llm/stream waterfall listener and, only when the turn carried nothing visible, injects a small text block immediately before the terminal finish, so the persisted message is never empty. Ships the fixture DSH's own mock cannot express (a strictly reasoning-only SSE server, since llm-mock-server forbids an empty successText and always appends text after reasoning), plus an end-to-end reproduction that replays a real persisted session through DSH's own serializeMessages. Preventive, not a repair. Zero dependencies, one file, no process or filesystem access.
- [apex-mochen/dsh-todo-continuity](https://github.com/apex-mochen/dsh-todo-continuity) - Keeps an unfinished task list visible across turns. DSH clears the todos projection at the start of every turn and expects the model to rewrite the whole list, so when a turn is interrupted the plan is durably in the session log but permanently gone from the UI — and todo_write is write-only, so neither the user nor the model can read it back. This plugin registers one ordinary session/event listener, remembers the last list per session, and when a turn/start arrives whose remembered list still has unfinished work, re-appends that list so the projection stops reporting an empty plan. No fork of tool-todo and no waterfall: a plugin cannot replace the projection (the registry throws on a stateVersion mismatch), so appending the event the fold reacts to is the reachable seam. Deliberately narrow — only unfinished lists, at most one event per turn start, fails open. Verified by a controlled A/B on real sessions: identical runs differing only in whether the plugin was installed, folded through the real projection definition. Zero dependencies.
- [Arbeiter-bit/dsh-reedit](https://github.com/Arbeiter-bit/dsh-reedit) - Double-click one of your own messages to rewrite it and continue in a new branch from that point.
- [Arrosam/dsh-idle-compact](https://github.com/Arrosam/dsh-idle-compact) - Compacts a long session after a configurable idle time when its context exceeds a configurable token threshold, before the provider KV cache expires; both values are set on the plugin's page in the Plugins manager.
- [ashulam/dsh-session-delete](https://github.com/ashulam/dsh-session-delete) - Deletes a session from the sidebar session menu: its log and replay cache go to the Recycle Bin on Windows (a local trash folder elsewhere); a live session is queued for removal on the next start.
- [Asianfleet/dsh-message-copy-enhance](https://github.com/Asianfleet/dsh-message-copy-enhance) - Copy selections from assistant messages as Markdown, preserving links, LaTeX sources, and code-fence language info.
- [azure5100/huahua-dsh-record-replay](https://github.com/azure5100/huahua-dsh-record-replay) - Full-featured record & replay for DSH (works on Windows) from the huahua plugin series: replay every auto-recorded session as a readable timeline, export/import shareable replay packs, re-run conversations in a fresh session, and record screen operations to auto-generate installable SKILL.md skills. Includes a 4-file Windows adaptation of kangshifu1/dsh-record-replay for DSH rc.5 (see README derivative notice).
- [Baboo-ming/dsh-session-delete](https://github.com/Baboo-ming/dsh-session-delete) - A plugin to completely delete sessions and clean up the associated files in the .dsh/sessions directory.
- [bainianlaoyao/dsh-session-robustness](https://github.com/bainianlaoyao/dsh-session-robustness) - After official llm-retry (n/5) gives up, keep retrying transient API failures (timeout, transport, rate-limit, 5xx, dropped SSE) on the same open step until success, cancel, or pause; AUTH, QUOTA, and user Stop are never retried.
- [baisama-cloud/dsh-session-mover](https://github.com/baisama-cloud/dsh-session-mover) - Move a session to another workspace by dragging it onto the target workspace header in the sidebar: the session is cloned with full history into the target workspace and the original is archived.
- [baixianger/dsh-bridge](https://github.com/baixianger/dsh-bridge) - Local cross-session messaging for DSH agents, with discovery, cold-session wake-up delivery, and auditable message history.
- [baixianger/dsh-chat](https://github.com/baixianger/dsh-chat) - Group chat rooms for DSH sessions with explicit @mentions, cold-session wake-up delivery, and optional cross-host transport through dsh-weave.
- [BakaCirno233/dsh-session-delete](https://github.com/BakaCirno233/dsh-session-delete) - Session management for DeepSeek Harness: list every stored session with its on-disk size, search by title, session id, kind tag, workspace or agent preset, and group them by age or by workspace. Permanently delete one or many at once — the log artifact, the workspace account entry and the search index rows — behind a two-step confirm, with a re-check after every deletion. Subagent sessions can be shown on demand; Side Chat threads stay hidden, and sessions live in the current app run are refused until restart.
- [BananaSoldier01/dsh-tidychat](https://github.com/BananaSoldier01/dsh-tidychat) - Fold completed turns into their final conclusions, split thinking from prose with a divider, and jump between turns from a rail dockable left or right with line or dot marks, an optional ring and hover summaries; it can hide the host right-edge TurnNavigator, load earlier history, and open a pre-filled diagnostics issue.
- [baosfeng/my-dsh-plugins#dsh-my-opencode-session-header](https://github.com/baosfeng/my-dsh-plugins/tree/main/plugins/dsh-my-opencode-session-header) - Injects a per-session x-opencode-session header into opencode.ai inference requests, fixing the OpenCode Go gateway 400 MissingSessionID error; server-only, no UI (npm: `dsh-my-opencode-session-header`).
- [beijingwahw/dsh-companion](https://github.com/beijingwahw/dsh-companion) - Four-module session companion: smart conversation export (Markdown/PDF/JSON/PNG long-image with privacy redaction and batch ZIP), context handoff summaries with template save/import, API cost optimization (live official pricing, peak/off-peak scheduling, daily/monthly budgets, model routing), and global conversation search with in-chat find (Ctrl+F, CSS Custom Highlight API).
- [better-er/dsh-pause](https://github.com/better-er/dsh-pause) - Pauses the agent right before it sends the next model request of a tool round while keeping the composer usable: a bare Enter or the resume button lets it continue, and text typed meanwhile is sent along as a steering message; the pause never interrupts an in-flight API call and the model does not notice it.
- [bill9109/dsh-conversation-share](https://github.com/bill9109/dsh-conversation-share) - Share any excerpt of a conversation.
- [bingzhu44-blip/brutal-monkey](https://github.com/bingzhu44-blip/brutal-monkey) - dshBrutalDelete permanently deletes DSH sessions from disk — single-row or cross-workspace bulk delete, with Ctrl+A select-all and Delete shortcut, wiping transcripts, projection cache, workspace slots, attachments and subagent data. Irreversible.
- [Session Lens](https://github.com/bobostudio/dsh-session-lens) - Session insights and one-click shareable HTML replay for DeepSeek Harness.
- [Boliban/dsh-enter-customizer](https://github.com/Boliban/dsh-enter-customizer) - Take over the system input shortcuts for the chat input box and configure behavior independently for each shortcut.
- [bvbhu/dsh-quilt-compact](https://github.com/bvbhu/dsh-quilt-compact) - Compaction backend that replaces the default compaction-basic: it summarizes the conversation with a configurable pool of low-cost models, sizes each chunk to the chosen model's context window, and merges all digests in one call, with per-route cooldown and session-model fallback.
- [bvcvb/dsh-baize-rules](https://github.com/bvcvb/dsh-baize-rules) - Injects durable user-set must-do and must-not requirements into the model at conversation start.
- [bvcvb/dsh-baize-session](https://github.com/bvcvb/dsh-baize-session) - Moves selected messages from one conversation into another, and manages a workspace's conversations with archive, restore, delete and move between workspaces.
- [bwndlct/dsh-session-export](https://github.com/bwndlct/dsh-session-export) - Export the current session to portable, schema-versioned Markdown and JSON files via the `session_export` tool and slash commands, with cross-platform-safe filenames.
- [CAI-MH/dsh-steer](https://github.com/CAI-MH/dsh-steer) - Inject steering or correction into a running session while the model is thinking, or cancel the current turn, from a floating browser panel.
- [CaiBai-Fish/dsh-continuechat](https://github.com/CaiBai-Fish/dsh-continuechat) - Resume a conversation whose turn stopped early: /continue and an action-row button carry the interrupted reply on, covering manual stops, failed model requests, output-token cutoffs and crash recovery, and the continuation prompt is retired from the transcript once it has been answered.
- [caoqinnan-web/organize-workspace-sessions](https://github.com/caoqinnan-web/organize-workspace-sessions) - Organize DeepSeek Harness workspace sessions by renaming them as 类别｜主题 and reporting archive, rename, and review suggestions.
- [Castor6/dsh-auto-workspace](https://github.com/Castor6/dsh-auto-workspace) - Project-less chats for dsh: a session created without a workspace gets its own directory under ~/Documents/DSH/<date>/chat-NN, reused whenever the chat is reopened and left in Ungrouped rather than made a sidebar project; the new-session hero gains a hover clear badge and a "work without a project" row, and a client-only sentinel workspace keeps that hero and its composer usable.
- [CatLollipop/dsh-parallel-sessions](https://github.com/CatLollipop/dsh-parallel-sessions) - Cross-session coordination for DeepSeek Harness that lists parallel sessions, relays messages with sender attribution between them, and pauses or resumes a session when task phases conflict.
- [cckbc/dsh-session-recycle-bin](https://github.com/cckbc/dsh-session-recycle-bin) - Session recycle bin for DeepSeek Harness: deleting a session from its row menu (or in bulk from the sidebar header) moves it into a recycle bin kept for 15 days by default — 7, 15 or 30 in settings — and expired entries are purged automatically. The bin table shows the days left for each entry, restores it to its original workspace, and can delete an entry for good, one at a time or all at once.
- [Cerbur/clutch-dsh#clutch-dsh-title](https://github.com/Cerbur/clutch-dsh/tree/main/packages/clutch-dsh-title) - Configurable deterministic session titles for DeepSeek Harness from semantic prompt fields and templates.
- [cfanzx/dsh-compact-relay](https://github.com/cfanzx/dsh-compact-relay) - Context indicator for the DeepSeek Harness composer: segmented occupancy, compression points, and the native auto-compaction line (flashes red when crossed). Supports preview-then-confirm compaction (/bc), seamless handoff (the old session becomes "History N" while the new one keeps the name; a relay bar above the composer shows the full handoff chain with two-way jumps), and message pinning with stale-pin labels. Thresholds, colors, and auto-archive after handoff are configurable in Settings.
- [CH4ACKO3/bites-the-dsh](https://github.com/CH4ACKO3/bites-the-dsh) - Adds read-only, scriptable playback to native DSH conversations, with simulated user typing, forward and reverse playback, event stepping, speed control, idle-gap compression, and direct seeking by event, turn, or recorded time.
- [Chael-Chael/dsh-reference-anything](https://github.com/Chael-Chael/dsh-reference-anything) - Reference workspace files, DSH sessions, and historical ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, and Kimi conversations from the unified DSH @ menu.
- [chameleonn4/dsh-codex-history](https://github.com/chameleonn4/dsh-codex-history) - Install it by asking DSH in one sentence, then it reads your local Codex CLI/Desktop chat history from ~/.codex/sessions and makes it usable inside DeepSeek Harness: a panel under the composer lists sessions with keyword and date filters and one-click import, the codex_history tool lets an agent list, read, search and summarize past conversations, a session whose working directory matches is injected automatically when a new agent starts, new Codex messages arrive as incremental updates in the running conversation, and a shared folder can mirror both Codex and DSH sessions across machines. Read-only — nothing is written back to Codex.
- [chenkui-luo/dsh-session-attachment-repair](https://github.com/chenkui-luo/dsh-session-attachment-repair) - Settings card that lists sessions whose history references attachment objects missing from the local attachment store, then backs the log up and replaces those dangling references with text placeholders so the session can send again. The repair script needs Node 22.15 or newer, and the card has been exercised on Windows only.
- [chenproton/dsh-history](https://github.com/chenproton/dsh-history) - Browse every message you sent in the current session: full-history listing with newest-first sort, text filter, one-click copy, and jump to a message (auto-loads earlier history when the target is not yet loaded).
- [CHIANGANGSTER/dsh-session-window#dsh-session-window-client](https://github.com/CHIANGANGSTER/dsh-session-window/tree/main/plugin/dsh-session-window-client) - Adds an Open in new window action to the DSH session menu when paired with the repository's native Desktop shell patch.
- [chinacaa/dsh-session-save](https://github.com/chinacaa/dsh-session-save) - Saves a whole DSH session as one .dsproj project file and opens it back. The session header gains an open button, a save button, a save-as button and an autosave switch, and the blank-session page gains its own open button. The first save asks where to put the file and later saves overwrite it; opening a .dsproj re-imports the session, switches to it, and can write the bundled workspace memory back on request.

- [chouyong/dsh-fork-graph](https://github.com/chouyong/dsh-fork-graph) - Git-style conversation fork graph in the session header: colored lanes and fork curves show which session branched from which, with click-to-jump navigation.

- [ChuShiZ/dsh-archive-manager](https://github.com/ChuShiZ/dsh-archive-manager) - Archived-session manager for DSH Web: workspace-grouped list, FTS5 full-text search over session content with per-session snippets, restore-and-open, and hard delete.
- [cindyguyuehu123/dsh-webchatlike](https://github.com/cindyguyuehu123/dsh-webchatlike) - Bring the deepseek.com web/app chat experience to DSH: edit your prompt and regenerate answers in place, with a per-message <i/N> version pager (tree model, stable across conversations).

- [corlinniu/dsh-daily-chat](https://github.com/corlinniu/dsh-daily-chat) - Splits New Session in the DSH web sidebar into two modes: a 日常聊天 row opens a session on the `daily` agent preset the plugin installs into the harness home (persona, web search and fetch, ask-user and compaction — no files, shell, plan mode or subagents), inside its own daily-chat workspace whose sidebar region lists only those chats, while 开始工作 keeps the shipped coding agent; the built-in New Session button is hidden and every other New Session entry point follows the active mode, which is remembered in localStorage.
- [cq-guojia/dsh-session-title-pattern](https://github.com/cq-guojia/dsh-session-title-pattern) - Reformats dsh session titles as "date | type | topic" (type and topic are summarized by a model from the full conversation), and hides unused sessions from the sidebar without deleting them.
- [cyh3436332528/dsh-plugin-session-purge#plugin](https://github.com/cyh3436332528/dsh-plugin-session-purge/tree/main/plugin) - Permanently delete a DSH session — not just archive it — cascading over its log directory, projection cache, workspace bookkeeping and child (subagent) sessions. - [czm15053/dsh-peer-link](https://github.com/czm15053/dsh-peer-link) - Let dsh and Claude Code sessions message each other directly; comes with a clickable peer list card (sort/search/send/refresh).
- [d0ublecl1ck/dsh-session-radar](https://github.com/d0ublecl1ck/dsh-session-radar) - Sidebar unread / waiting / status hub for DSH Web: a bell jumps to the next unread session, a shortcut walks sessions waiting for input, and ⌘⇧, / ⌘⇧. step back and forward through the conversations you have visited; one overlay lists unread and pending sessions side by side; a six-metric readout at the sidebar foot makes every icon a button that jumps to the next session of that kind; a host-side ledger keeps the account across restarts, so an unread session keeps its green row dot after a restart, and a startup dialog offers to re-send a continue message to sessions whose turn was cut off.
- [DDDMUC/dsh-delete-turn](https://github.com/DDDMUC/dsh-delete-turn) - Per-message delete for DSH: remove a user message, one reply step, or a whole assistant reply from the derived model context through the official surface-replace contract, and hide it from the visible transcript without rewriting the append-only log.
- [deepsleepAquarium/dsh-whale-post#bus](https://github.com/deepsleepAquarium/dsh-whale-post/tree/main/packages/bus) - File-backed post office between DeepSeek Harness sessions: every letter is sealed with an HMAC and a body digest, recipients are resolved through a roster interface, and delivery is offline-first, so an undeliverable letter waits in the mailbox instead of being lost.
- [DelayNooMore/dsh-plugin-session-trash](https://github.com/DelayNooMore/dsh-plugin-session-trash) - Session trash for DSH: move sessions to a recoverable trash, restore or purge them in settings.

- [DenAbr/dsh-compact-selected-model](https://github.com/DenAbr/dsh-compact-selected-model) - /compact and auto-compaction summarize with the model selected in the session, not the model that finished the last turn.

- [Diluka/dsh-afk](https://github.com/Diluka/dsh-afk) - AFK controls for ask_user_question: profile-wide or per-session settings, configurable automatic replies or blocking new calls, and session-log question history with read tracking; does not approve permissions or plans. Supports DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.3 only.
- [Domaki-co/dsh-message-forward](https://github.com/Domaki-co/dsh-message-forward) - Cross-session message forwarding between DSH sessions: extract one model reply, a user message, or a multi-selected batch of messages and images from one session and deliver it into another, with silent send, draft fill, or send-and-jump delivery, plus prompt templates.
- [domitor-syh/dsh-rollback](https://github.com/domitor-syh/dsh-rollback) - TRAE-style conversation rollback — per-turn checkpoints (10-turn sliding window) roll back touched files and truncate model context in place, keeping the same session id. Human-initiated only: a /rollback command or a per-turn Web button (works on interrupted turns too), with a preview listing each affected file and its action — restore, recover, delete, or skip.
- [dongasai/dsh_compact_queue](https://github.com/dongasai/dsh_compact_queue) - Registers /compact_queue, a compaction command that does not drop the request when the session is busy: it compacts immediately when idle, otherwise queues the request in that session and runs it at the session's next idle window, with a 2-second fallback tick beside the agent status event so the trigger is not missed, a 30-minute wait cap, and /compact_queue cancel to withdraw a queued request or abort a running one. Each session keeps its own queue state from a single command registration, completion and failure arrive as a collapsed notice that does not wake the model, and every ManualCompactionError code except busy is terminal so a failure is not retried. Host half only; the core /compact command is left untouched.
- [dongasai/running-sessions-float](https://github.com/dongasai/running-sessions-float) - Collects the sessions that need you into one dock at the bottom of the web GUI sidebar: running sessions, sessions waiting on an approval, plan review or answer, and finished runs whose result has not been opened yet. Rows are sorted by last update and clicking one switches the main view to that session; it reuses the shipped useSessions and useSessionStatus hooks rather than adding a data source, polls nothing, stores nothing and modifies no session. The header dot pulses while anything is running or waiting and settles to a static dot when every row is only a finished-but-unread reminder; with no such sessions the dock collapses to one quiet line, and a collapsed 56px sidebar shows a 36px badge with the count instead of the list. It registers in the sidebar footer slot, so it is part of the layout and does not overlay the conversation list, leaving the existing footer entries below it.
- [donghangxunlang-cmd/dsh-attention-health](https://github.com/donghangxunlang-cmd/dsh-attention-health) - Content-degradation detection (thinking loops, output repetition) for DeepSeek Harness, with a continue-vs-handoff cost verdict and zero-model handoff documents.
- [dongsheng123132/task-passport](https://github.com/dongsheng123132/task-passport) - Carry durable task state across DeepSeek Harness, WorkBuddy, Claude Code and Codex with machine-readable checkpoints and optimistic locking.
- [dotdance/dsh-title-prefix](https://github.com/dotdance/dsh-title-prefix) - Prefixes every session title with the name of its workspace or project, so a flat session list shows which project each conversation belongs to; titles you renamed yourself are left unchanged.
- [dpskk2/dsh-chatsync](https://github.com/dpskk2/dsh-chatsync) - Two-way sync of DSH sessions, workspace mappings, settings and patches between machines through your own private GitHub repo (API keys stay machine-local).
- [dream12347/dsh-session-manager](https://github.com/dream12347/dsh-session-manager) - DSH session manager: delete with trash/restore/purge, restore archived sessions, recent-activity stats, continue/pause, open log folder, unread markers, fork into a new chat, workspace grouping and sorting, context compaction threshold.
- [drscrewdriver/dsh-context-compression-improved](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-context-compression-improved) - Same-origin in mechanism with the two loudest lines in context compression. The code-skeleton gate follows the skeletonization approach of Headroom (Apache-2.0), whose published headline is 20% fewer tokens for coding agents and 60–95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. The estimator channel follows TokenPilot (arXiv:2606.17016), which reports up to 60% lower cost for long-session agents. Both figures are theirs, quoted as-is; this plugin ships no benchmark of its own and claims no reduction of its own. What it adds for DeepSeek Harness: choose a compression profile, set the Auto Compact trigger level and toggle code-skeleton compression from one settings section, with exact DeepSeek V4 tokenizer measurement, same-revision count verification, and fail-open behaviour that keeps the original tool results on unsupported models. Within a turn it supports skeletonized information compression with a low original-text retrieval rate; at the tail of a turn it supports a turn-tail intent summary implemented purely by content substitution; context content stays safe, and the whole process runs inside the official JSONL compression.
- [drscrewdriver/dsh-date-wrapper](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-date-wrapper) - Compresses DSH time-context from ~280 chars to 46 chars by injecting a compact date line into the runtime-context snapshot; zero runtime dependencies.
- [drscrewdriver/dsh-manage-session](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-manage-session) - Session Manager for DSH (formerly Session Steward): one console over active and archived sessions — grouped by workspace, domain and title filters, favorites, and batch archive / unarchive / purge archived files (destructive steps ask twice) — plus a four-gate health checkup (log integrity, projection cache, lossless JSON, cold read) that ends in a reversible, backup-first prescription. Search and indexing live in dsh-search-index; this plugin builds no index and never rewrites session logs.
- [drscrewdriver/dsh-reference-session-collector](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-reference-session-collector) - Read-only session-log projector (drsc) for DSH: scans ~/.dsh/sessions/**, decodes zstd/tiled-frame logs with a vendored leaf decoder and rewrites per-session projections into its own SQLite (node:sqlite, segments / replaces + FTS5), exposed through a single fenced HTTP route — surface ledger, recall/compression pair accounting and Chinese-capable full-text search. Token counts share the exact DeepSeek-V4 tokenizer and formula as CCI verify, falling back to a labelled chars/4 basis when assets are absent. Never writes session files; all output lands in its own data directory. Serves three consumer plugins: context-compression-improved (surface marking + recall reconciliation), session-steward (search-corpus switch), prime-memory (historical anchor backfill). Hosts 0.1.0-rc.2 .. 0.2.1-rc.2 (17-tag exact engines.dsh enum). npm: dsh-reference-session-collector.
- [drscrewdriver/dsh-search-index](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-search-index) - Sidebar session search that builds its own index instead of reusing DSH's full-text one: title to content toggle in one entry, results grouped per session with the strongest snippet and user/reply/tool tags, plus watermark-based incremental sync, archive-driven pruning of archived sessions, and a shadow rebuild that never blocks the live index.
- [drscrewdriver/dsh-session-guard](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-session-guard) - Peak-hour auto session gate: weekend mode + global peak auto-pause + session-level freeze/resume + backend auto-retry, auto-resume on off-peak.

- [Earnest02522/dsh-archive-manager](https://github.com/Earnest02522/dsh-archive-manager) - Archived-conversation manager for DeepSeek Harness: view archived conversations grouped by workspace, restore them, and reveal their transcript folders.
- [EarthPretender/dsh-session-delete](https://github.com/EarthPretender/dsh-session-delete) - Adds a red "Delete session" row beneath Archive in the sidebar session menu and permanently deletes that one session - its stored logs and its workspace account entry, written through the workspace registry itself. Capture is a whole-tree scan rather than a hook on write/edit tools, so edits made by shell commands, external editors or git leave a record too. Restoring the conversation forks it from that turn instead of cutting the original, and a restore can itself be undone. History sits in a shadow git repository under DSH_HOME and never touches your project .git. Requires Git >= 2.20 and Node.js >= 20.

- [erlingmijiang/dsh-lorebooklike-prompt-tool](https://github.com/erlingmijiang/dsh-lorebooklike-prompt-tool) - SillyTavern-style prompt rules for DSH: layered system-prompt anchors, constant/keyword entries, reproducible probability gates and regex rewriting.
- [EvilIrving/dsh-context-proxy](https://github.com/EvilIrving/dsh-context-proxy) - Thin on-demand context retrieval: context_query / context_slice / context_grep tools that read already-persisted history back with replay-safe citations.

- [flow2dream/dsh-msg-rewind](https://github.com/flow2dream/dsh-msg-rewind) - Conversation rewind for dsh web: /undo rolls back one turn, /rewind cuts to a past message, and hovering a user bubble offers a visual undo.

- [fredalxin/dsh-solo-thinking](https://github.com/fredalxin/dsh-solo-thinking) - Visual branch brainstorming that creates an isolated Session for each direction, automates parent, sibling, checkpoint, and return Handoffs, and provides a full tree tab with an optional Better Sidebar view.

- [FunnyDiodio/dsh-session-delete](https://github.com/FunnyDiodio/dsh-session-delete) - Adds a Delete Session row to every sidebar session '...' menu (the official harness has archive/pin/rename/fork only, no durable delete). - [GallenShao/dsh-faster-compress](https://github.com/GallenShao/dsh-faster-compress) - Prepares context summaries in the background and applies them at safe step boundaries, with native compaction fallback and a per-conversation history of summaries, application status, timings, and token usage.
- [GengDaPeng/dsh-agent-message](https://github.com/GengDaPeng/dsh-agent-message) - Cross-session agent messaging for DeepSeek Harness with session discovery, offline delivery, delivery receipts, and sender-session navigation.

- [gulagala001/dsh-btw](https://github.com/gulagala001/dsh-btw) - Ask side questions using the current conversation context, with independent streaming and cancellation.

The switch is remembered per conversation.
- [guokecloud/dsh-session-janitor](https://github.com/guokecloud/dsh-session-janitor) - Lists DSH session records and archive caches on a sidebar page, moves deletions into a restorable recycle bin, and refuses sessions written within the last 10 minutes.
- [hajimimaodie8/DSH-Session-Sync](https://github.com/hajimimaodie8/DSH-Session-Sync) - Bidirectionally synchronize sessions, workspaces, settings and plugins between the DSH web instance and the DSH Desktop instance.
- [Han-Yao94/dsh-session-toolkit](https://github.com/Han-Yao94/dsh-session-toolkit) - Consolidated toolkit for session identity, global & workspace prompts with referenced files, session auto-resume, UAC-free web restart, and peer-session messaging.
- [haoranwang0921/dsh-session-cleaner](https://github.com/haoranwang0921/dsh-session-cleaner) - Manage conversation records from the DSH web GUI settings page: delete a whole session (archive plus physical log removal) or a single message (deleting a user message cascades to its assistant replies and tool results). Running and current sessions are protected.
- [HarryHeYu/dsh-sessionflow](https://github.com/HarryHeYu/dsh-sessionflow) - Continues work across coding agents inside DeepSeek Harness: six sessionflow_* tools query a local session index built by sessionFlow to find past work, show where the current project left off, and hand the goal, files and open items to the next agent. Requires the separate sessionFlow core, installed from its GitHub repo. Everything stays local — no cloud, no telemetry.
- [Harzva/dsh-restart-autoresume](https://github.com/Harzva/dsh-restart-autoresume) - Adds confirmed DSH restart actions and durable automatic continuation for eligible top-level sessions through an existing compatible dsh-restart Host provider.
- [hasan-aghayev/dsh-session-resilience](https://github.com/hasan-aghayev/dsh-session-resilience) - Adds DSH restart and stop controls with token-aware reconnect and policy-based recovery for interrupted web sessions.
- [hbgdjb/dsh-session-shield](https://github.com/hbgdjb/dsh-session-shield) - Guards session logs from malformed model tool calls (empty id/name, non-string arguments) so a bad call can never make a session unloadable.
- [heartmove/dsh-session-bridge](https://github.com/heartmove/dsh-session-bridge) - Session bridge for DeepSeek Harness: drive other real DSH sessions straight from your prompt — create top-level sessions in any workspace, message or steer any session, wait for replies and stream them segment-by-segment (chain-of-thought included), resume offline sessions, find sessions across workspaces, run a background watchdog that monitors and schedules a main task (nudge when stalled, correct drift, cancel when stuck), and archive sessions with one command.
- [heartmove/dsh-side-chat](https://github.com/heartmove/dsh-side-chat) - Select part of a conversation and ask about it in a right-side side chat; bring AI replies back to the main chat directly or as a summary.
