- [heiheiha798/dsh-plugin-subagent-delete](https://github.com/heiheiha798/dsh-plugin-subagent-delete) - Ownership-checked tools and HTTP routes to list, release and permanently delete subagent sessions, with automatic web UI refresh after deletion.
- [hellodigua/dsh-share](https://github.com/hellodigua/dsh-share) - Share your conversations with one click.
- [helo060228/dsh-chat-search](https://github.com/helo060228/dsh-chat-search) - Cross-session and in-chat keyword search with context highlighting, keyboard navigation, and instant message jumping.
- [HERO476/dsh-conversation-recycle-bin](https://github.com/HERO476/dsh-conversation-recycle-bin) - Delete a DSH conversation from its sidebar menu or the conversation header, optionally cascading into that conversation's associated memory nodes when you tick the box (the confirmation dialog shows the hit count before you commit); deletes land in a plugin recycle bin with restore, every action is appended to an audit log, and batch deletes are rate-limited with per-conversation rollback.
- [HildebrandYu/dsh-session-chains](https://github.com/HildebrandYu/dsh-session-chains) - Groups the sessions that hand off to each other into one chain in the DSH sidebar — automatic chain detection from the handoff prompt, per-chain numbering, in-place rename, search, drag and multi-select to re-chain, pinning a chain to the top, archiving chains out of the sidebar into a panel-only archive, a per-session context/steps readout, and configurable handoff thresholds that can trigger an automatic handoff (write the next prompt, open a new session, paste it, switch over).
- [Hjdd14/dsh-toolong-warning](https://github.com/Hjdd14/dsh-toolong-warning) - Counts completed compactions per session in a floating window and warns only after repeated compactions plus extra token spend or high context occupancy, with all three thresholds adjustable in Settings.
- [hkkz9522/dsh-session-manager](https://github.com/hkkz9522/dsh-session-manager) - DeepSeek Harness session and workspace manager —— Workspaces: archive and visibility. Sessions: move, migrate presets, delete, favorite, review later, prioritize, tag, and annotate. Batch operations.
- [hoist-wen/dsh-trajectory-tool-insight](https://github.com/hoist-wen/dsh-trajectory-tool-insight) - Adds an Insight tab next to the conversation and trajectory tabs in DSH: calls a model to interpret tool calls turn by turn, and supports a custom prompt.
- [hongdougao111/dsh-power-switch](https://github.com/hongdougao111/dsh-power-switch) - Adds a power button to the session header with two actions, each requiring a second click to confirm. Restart terminates the Electron main process itself (taskkill /F without /T), so no crash dialog appears: the host then exits gracefully on its own once the IPC channel drops, and a detached helper relaunches the same executable after the single-instance lock is released, confirming the new instance by a real window handle. Shut down does the same without relaunching. Leftover GPU and renderer processes from the previous run are reaped best-effort. Windows desktop app.
- [hoshF/dsh-md-export](https://github.com/hoshF/dsh-md-export) - Export the current session to clean Markdown from a button in the session header, through the native save dialog, with a CLI and an HTTP route over the same renderer; reads session logs directly (formats v0, v3 and v4) and declares no @deepseek-ai peer dependencies.
- [hoyyang/dsh-concise](https://github.com/hoyyang/dsh-concise) - One-click Concise output style for DeepSeek Harness: results first, no filler, same work depth. Every final reply opens with a plain-language digest card (select text to copy), scoped per session, working in headless/CLI too, with /concise command, style.md overrides and a local API. Links and file paths inside the digest card render as clickable chips: URLs jump, local files open with the OS default app (v0.9+). A per-step pre-generation contract reminder (v0.11.2+) measurably fixes digest misses on audit-report/table-shaped replies.
- [hoyyang/dsh-manage-sessions](https://github.com/hoyyang/dsh-manage-sessions) - Native-feeling session manager: bulk archive/restore/hard-delete, two-stage force-stop with auto-resume, and instant copy-workspace-path.
- [hoyyang/dsh-smart-compact](https://github.com/hoyyang/dsh-smart-compact) - Codex-style context window auto-management for DeepSeek Harness: a lossless rollover engine with zero summarization model calls, task-oriented handoff anchors, working notes that survive compaction, verbatim recall of archived windows, and a stale-notes gate that downgrades to an explicit warning instead of vouching for outdated notes. One-click composer button plus /smart-compact command, three-band automatic rollover, mandatory anchor sanitization; works out of the box with zero configuration.
- [HrxSpace/dsh-session-sweeper](https://github.com/HrxSpace/dsh-session-sweeper) - Scan, view, and safely clean local AI terminal session histories (Claude Code, Codex CLI, WorkBuddy, DSH) from a settings card — quarantine-first with SHA-256 manifests, one-click restore, audit log, and phrase-confirmed hard delete.
- [ht719/dsh-session-categories](https://github.com/ht719/dsh-session-categories) - Adds per-Workspace category trees to the Web sidebar, with nested categories, drag-and-drop session assignment, category-scoped session creation, and category deletion that archives contained sessions.
- [huajuan2024/dsh-session-manager](https://github.com/huajuan2024/dsh-session-manager) - Session manager panel under Settings → Plugins: list all sessions with title, cwd, agent preset, updated time, turns and steps, expand a row to view message history, delete non-running sessions, and export a session as JSON or Markdown via a browser Blob URL.
- [huangxp12/dsh-recent-sessions](https://github.com/huangxp12/dsh-recent-sessions) - Lists recent sessions across every workspace in one panel, with time grouping, two sort orders, content search, reveal-in-file-manager, and local notes that offer to insert themselves into the draft.
- [Hugo16/dsh-session-rotate-on-compact](https://github.com/Hugo16/dsh-session-rotate-on-compact) - Rotate the outbound LLM session ID after each successful DSH compaction without creating a new DSH session.
- [huguangyu666/dsh-plugin-session-import](https://github.com/huguangyu666/dsh-plugin-session-import) - Import claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode chat history into dsh sessions: workspace binding, tool calls preserved, oversized-session protection, zcode compaction restore.
- [HuiHuitie-zhu/dsh-incognito](https://github.com/HuiHuitie-zhu/dsh-incognito) - Incognito sessions: a standalone ephemeral sub-agent with its own preset (no parent context) and full toolset, draggable floating window, burned to zero traces on close.
- [hunyu-feng/dsh-context-handoff](https://github.com/hunyu-feng/dsh-context-handoff) - Live context-pressure meter in the composer dock. When usage nears the limit it asks the current model for a handoff brief, starts that brief in a fresh session and switches you there, so long work can continue without hitting the window.
- [hwangjunjie/dsh-session-move](https://github.com/hwangjunjie/dsh-session-move) - Move a session to another folder, permanently delete it, or AI-rename it from the Web UI — by dragging a session row onto a folder title or from the session menu. Moving rewrites the session header cwd, relocates the persisted log and updates workspace accounting so history travels with it; deleting stops running agents and removes the log, projection-cache row and workspace accounting. The same three operations ship as agent tools: workbench_session_move, workbench_session_delete and workbench_session_rename_ai.
- [hyzyn/dsh-plugin-kit#search](https://github.com/hyzyn/dsh-plugin-kit/tree/main/packages/search) - Full-text global search for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar search box that searches history sessions (via the sessionQuery index, with a per-session scan fallback) and settings panels, highlights matches, and jumps to the matching session or settings card.
- [hzh5021/dsh-qq-voice](https://github.com/hzh5021/dsh-qq-voice) - Mounts a per-channel speaking-rules file into the QQ preset's system prompt only, so that channel answers in one or two lines while every other channel stays untouched. Does nothing until home points at a folder with the rules file (default QQ线口径.md); meant for the QQ preset, not the global plugin list.
- [i1j/context-assembler-DSH](https://github.com/i1j/context-assembler-DSH) - Context Assembler plugin for DeepSeek Harness: topic-block context assembly, water-pressure topic splitting, tool trace/rewrite, reality recall injection and handoff planning.
- [icanfinish11/dsh-context-mode](https://github.com/icanfinish11/dsh-context-mode) - DeepSeek Harness adapter for Context Mode: in-process ctx_* tools for sandboxed code execution and an FTS5 knowledge base, plus context-window routing guidance.
- [Icstick/dsh-context-maid](https://github.com/Icstick/dsh-context-maid) - Context curation for DeepSeek Harness: content-aware tool-output slimming, dead-log sweep, pinned user requirements and in-flight work, archive-then-compact with an audit trail.
- [idoall/dsh-session-colors](https://github.com/idoall/dsh-session-colors) - Give any Session a colour mark, shown as a chip in the sidebar and picked from the conversation header; marks are stored on the Host, so a colour chosen on one device is visible on every other one.
- [ijry/DeepSeek-Harness-Desktop-Ultra#dsh-plugin-canvas](https://github.com/ijry/DeepSeek-Harness-Desktop-Ultra/tree/main/plugins/dsh-plugin-canvas) - Infinite canvas for sessions, with regions bound to workspaces and agent presets, pinned session cards, sticky notes and alignment guides.
- [IKEASven69/dsh-takeover](https://github.com/IKEASven69/dsh-takeover) - Cross-agent session relay: a compact "Relay" chip in the composer toolbar unfolds a floating workbench to browse recent sessions of eight external agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, ZCode, Pi, WorkBuddy, Cursor, Grok); one click spawns a DSH session with the takeover command delivered and auto-switches to it. handoff: 1 protocol inbox cards are consume-once with a four-state evidence ledger; patches ride with cards; cross-machine relay via a synced folder. Settings keeps the command reference and reader toggles.
- [imlishiyuan/keep-reminder](https://github.com/imlishiyuan/keep-reminder) - Injects the contents of a .keep-reminder file from the session working directory as a system-reminder, with three modes: once per session, first step of every turn, or every request.
- [imrascal/dsh-archive](https://github.com/imrascal/dsh-archive) - DeepSeek Harness plugin that manages archived sessions and the trash from the settings panel.
- [imshz6669/dsh-split-chat](https://github.com/imshz6669/dsh-split-chat) - Opens any session as a second full chat tab in the right sidebar, with its own transcript and composer, while the main conversation stays put; a split right pane allows up to three concurrent conversations.
- [imtwa/dsh-recall-sessions](https://github.com/imtwa/dsh-recall-sessions) - A lightweight plugin that decompresses and reads past sessions, so a new session can read what an earlier conversation contained, in milliseconds per read. `/recall` lists the sessions of the current project with title, last activity, turn count and first prompt; `/recall <number>` reads back the turns of that session; `/recall all` covers every project; the model can also be asked in natural language to query with the `recall_sessions` tool.
- [Imzl-zl/dsh-redo](https://github.com/Imzl-zl/dsh-redo) - Adds Regenerate and Edit and resend to each message you already sent: Regenerate re-answers the same text in one click without going through the composer; Edit and resend retracts that message and everything after it in place — out of the transcript and out of the model context, in the same session with no new branch — then puts its text and images back into the composer, so the edited send rewrites the conversation from that point. Messages carrying files rather than images stay disabled.
- [ishuowang/dsh-rolehub-bridge](https://github.com/ishuowang/dsh-rolehub-bridge) - Discover and verify portable RoleHub roles, pin each exact bundle, then launch its prompt and bundled skills in an isolated, continuable DSH Session with Host-approved tool bindings and optional Agent Team Room attachment.
- [ishuowang/dsh-sideband](https://github.com/ishuowang/dsh-sideband) - Hand off focused context without waiting for or interrupting the active Agent: freeze a bounded Session snapshot, summarize it asynchronously with an isolated no-tool LLM, and deliver a provenance-bearing capsule to another Session or an authorized Room—quiet by default for Sessions, with explicit wakeup available.
- [iStarryDust/dsh-edit-regen](https://github.com/iStarryDust/dsh-edit-regen) - Edit and regenerate: adds an edit action to user message bubbles, regenerating from that message with images and files carried over and the original model inherited.
- [itchenshi/dsh-gui-last-session](https://github.com/itchenshi/dsh-gui-last-session) - Reopens the conversation you were last in after restarting DeepSeek Harness, by keeping a pointer file under the DSH home directory instead of patching engine files.
- [jackxiao17/dsh-session-cleaner](https://github.com/jackxiao17/dsh-session-cleaner) - Adds Delete to the DSH sidebar session menu, moving the session — and its whole descendant tree when it has subagents — into a recycle bin that relocates the directory on disk (an atomic rename, never a copy), plus a sidebar bin panel with title and full-text search, workspace filter, sorting, per-session chat-log viewer, restore and permanent delete. Deleting also clears the workspace slot, the pin, the archive flag and the projection-cache row, so a restore puts the session back at its original sidebar position; permanent deletion also clears the schedules bound to it and removes the emptied project directory. Verified on DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2, with a whole-profile residue scan coming back clean.
- [JanEickholt/dsh-asc](https://github.com/JanEickholt/dsh-asc) - Model-driven context compaction for DeepSeek Harness. The agent decides when and what to compress, commits durable session-log replacements, and ships reversible tool-result compression with byte-exact hash retrieval.
- [jarvisluk/dsh-projectless-session](https://github.com/jarvisluk/dsh-projectless-session) - Adds a Session without workspace entry to the DSH Workspace picker, creates isolated date-organized directories, and keeps started sessions resumable under Ungrouped.
- [Jason-skd/dsh-session-fork](https://github.com/Jason-skd/dsh-session-fork) - Git-style conversation branching that mirrors how real programmers collaborate: a secretary root branch dispatches tasks to child branches with their own contexts, merging back only compressed summaries via squash or rebase; ships /branch commands, a branch tab, branch-to-branch messaging, and a governance baseline pairing each session branch with a git worktree.
- [JasonQQ/dsh-btw-plugin](https://github.com/JasonQQ/dsh-btw-plugin) - Codex-style /btw command: answer side questions in a conversation-seeded subagent (fork provider), rendered in the UI without entering the main session history.
- [jasonrale/dsh-archive-manager](https://github.com/jasonrale/dsh-archive-manager) - Archived-session manager for DSH Web UI: reopen an archived session and keep chatting, unarchive it back in place, or hard-delete a session — grouped panel with message search and native view sync.
- [Jaylor-Wang/dsh-tool-result-trimmer](https://github.com/Jaylor-Wang/dsh-tool-result-trimmer) - Eager, tail-heavy, line-aware tool result trimmer plugin: hooks into post-execution pipeline to trim oversized command outputs with smart semantic reducers and ANSI stripping.
- [Jaylor-Wang/dsh-tool-session-delete](https://github.com/Jaylor-Wang/dsh-tool-session-delete) - Adds a Delete session action to the sidebar context menu behind a confirmation modal reporting log size and live activity, cleanly unlinking log files, projection checkpoints, and host memory registrations.
- [JayYuen666/dsh-session-rescue](https://github.com/JayYuen666/dsh-session-rescue) - Automatic recovery when a turn ends badly: resume after a transient failure, continue after output truncation, re-run after an unfinished todo list, plus a request-level 429 backstop and a client dock with edit-resend, manual retry and stop-and-re-ask.
- [jermaine123123/agent-context-editor#deepseek-harness](https://github.com/jermaine123123/agent-context-editor/tree/main/adapters/deepseek-harness) - Agent Context Editor is a cross-agent plugin for manually excluding, editing, and selectively compressing AI conversation context. It also supports searching, filtering, selecting, hiding, restoring, and undoing conversation changes while preserving the original Session.
- [Jesse-njx/dsh-crosstalk](https://github.com/Jesse-njx/dsh-crosstalk) - Cross-session messaging for DSH: any session on the machine can list and message any other, Claude Code-style, via a local heartbeat registry and inbox.
- [JessenReinhart/dsh-plugin-btw](https://github.com/JessenReinhart/dsh-plugin-btw) - Adds /btw and /side slash commands that answer ephemeral side questions in an isolated forked sub-session without polluting the main conversation context.
- [JessenReinhart/dsh-snapcompact](https://github.com/JessenReinhart/dsh-snapcompact) - Bitmap-frame context compression plugin for DeepSeek Harness: renders discarded conversation history into pixel-font PNG frames for vision-capable models.
- [JessenReinhart/dsh-time-context](https://github.com/JessenReinhart/dsh-time-context) - Injects the exact current local time and the timestamp, day relation and recency gap of the previous user message into every prompt, and adds a /time command that prints the injected block.
- [Jessicaisleep/dsh-wm-toolkit](https://github.com/Jessicaisleep/dsh-wm-toolkit) - Session and message surgery in one plugin: recall or edit prompts and replies (reasoning included), regenerate from the original prompt, delete any turn at the model-context level, and archive, delete, move or migrate sessions across workspaces. Targets DSH 0.1.5 and 0.2.x, verified on 0.2.1-rc.3. A combined fork of three MIT plugins (dsh-message-recall from Jipcon/DSH-plugins, dsh-session-manager from hkkz9522, dsh-delete-turn from DDDMUC) with added reply editing, regeneration and workspace migration. Do not enable it together with those plugins or other session movers or message deleters.
- [jianyuepei/dsh-session-mindmap](https://github.com/jianyuepei/dsh-session-mindmap) - Turns a DSH session into a self-contained interactive HTML mind map of its topics, conclusions, decisions, todos and open questions, and reports what changed since the previous run.
- [jingleboat/dsh-session-cleaner-host](https://github.com/jingleboat/dsh-session-cleaner-host) - Deletes a whole conversation from the sidebar session menu, and opens a right-click menu on a chat text selection with Copy, Quote (insert a Markdown quote block into the composer) and Ask: Ask sends the selection plus your question to one reused continuable subagent (label `ask`, found again through the subagent catalog after a restart) and streams the answer into the right sidebar.
- [JinYihang1011/dsh-plugins#dsh-session-ops](https://github.com/JinYihang1011/dsh-plugins/tree/main/dsh-session-ops) - Adds three actions to the sidebar session row menu: open the workspace location, move the session to another workspace, and delete the session to the Recycle Bin.
- [JoblessJoe/smart-compaction](https://github.com/JoblessJoe/smart-compaction) - Lets the model trigger compaction itself at a safe point via a compact_now tool (works mid-turn), plus a context_status tool reporting real token usage against the session's actual context window.
- [JochenYang/dsh-rewind-plugin](https://github.com/JochenYang/dsh-rewind-plugin) - Recall a message you already sent: the session log stays append-only and nothing is deleted, while the recalled turns leave the model context and the transcript, the text returns to the composer, and the files those turns changed wait in a quarantine you can review and clear from its own settings page.
- [Joe-0202/dsh-archive-manager](https://github.com/Joe-0202/dsh-archive-manager) - Two-tab archive panel (archived / active) where every row offers archive or unarchive next to permanent delete; each row shows its bound workspace folder as a clickable path, and queued archive-entry cleanup keeps a deleted session from resurfacing in the active list.
- [john-walks-slow/dsh-message-datetime](https://github.com/john-walks-slow/dsh-message-datetime) - One-line clock context for DeepSeek Harness: a Current time timestamp reading (weekday, date, time, UTC offset, IANA timezone) opens every conversation turn and a Turn ended reading closes it, so the model always knows the time, date and idle gap across turns without asking.
- [john-walks-slow/dsh-session-prefix](https://github.com/john-walks-slow/dsh-session-prefix) - Auto-classify DeepSeek Harness sessions via Jev decision models or Agent tools, displayed as title emoji prefixes (wip 🚧, blocked ⏸️, review 👀, done ✅, plan 💡, bug 🐛). Features seamless lifecycle recovery, optional Jev inference (needs a Jev API key), model tool maintenance, and a visual settings panel.
- [joyboy-yy/dsh-archive-purge](https://github.com/joyboy-yy/dsh-archive-purge) - Force-hides archived sessions from the DSH sidebar whatever the view filter is set to, and adds a panel that restores them or deletes them permanently - session log directory, archive and pin records, and projection cache.
- [JRJRJPRO/dsh-chat-tree](https://github.com/JRJRJPRO/dsh-chat-tree) - Draws every branch of a conversation as a clickable tree beside the chat, with favorites, custom icons and colors, branch merge and split, rewind-aware layout, and Claude Code branches that keep their memory.
- [jujiujiang222-cell/dsh-archive-sessions](https://github.com/jujiujiang222-cell/dsh-archive-sessions) - Archived-session manager: an "Archived Sessions" settings page that lists archived sessions and lets you restore or permanently delete each one (two-step confirmation).
- [Justin-Mai/dsh-role-prompts](https://github.com/Justin-Mai/dsh-role-prompts) - Adds job-role prompts to the DSH composer: type - at the start of the input to pick a role, which becomes a reference chip in the draft and is then injected as a system prompt section on every turn of that conversation, so the instruction keeps applying without showing up in the transcript. Roles are added and edited on a Settings page and stored in ~/.dsh/dsh-role-prompts.md.
- [Kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror](https://github.com/Kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror) - Per-conversation backup for DSH: incremental session mirroring, fuzzy restore (preview then confirm), and rule-based cleanup with a 7-day recycle bin.
- [kagurazakayashi/dsh-delete-session](https://github.com/kagurazakayashi/dsh-delete-session) - Adds a Delete session item to the sidebar session-row menu; the confirmation mode is configurable (click again, confirm in a dialog, or delete immediately) and a session that is running a task is refused.
- [kaieye/dsh-AIR](https://github.com/kaieye/dsh-AIR) - Web composer enhancement: recalls sent prompts across sessions with ArrowUp/ArrowDown, searches them with Ctrl+R, restores rich drafts, and opens a docked /btw or /side conversation.
- [kanchengw/dsh-assembly.resume](https://github.com/kanchengw/dsh-assembly.resume) - Import local Codex CLI/Desktop, Claude Code CLI, and Claude Desktop conversations into DSH with project grouping, semantic history, and tool activity; bind an existing or replacement workspace and continue with the DSH Agent.
- [keepermttl/dsh-archive-viewer](https://github.com/keepermttl/dsh-archive-viewer) - Archived-session manager for the DSH Web GUI: search titles and message content, tag/filter sessions, read logs, restore sessions, and export ZIP archives.
- [kevenliu3/dhs-plugins#dsh-session-monitor](https://github.com/kevenliu3/dhs-plugins/tree/main/dsh-session-monitor) - Sidebar badge and panel that aggregate per-session pending, running, and completed states across workspaces, with one click to open a session.
- [kiligzzz/dsh-session-archive](https://github.com/kiligzzz/dsh-session-archive) - Sidebar panel for archived sessions in DeepSeek Harness: group by workspace, search by title, preview user questions, one-click restore, or delete with confirmation.
- [kiligzzz/dsh-session-nav](https://github.com/kiligzzz/dsh-session-nav) - Piano-key style in-conversation navigation bar: one key per user message, hover preview tooltip, click-to-jump across full history. Official dual-face dsh plugin, no dsh source changes.
- [kinggod899/dsh-reply-forge-v3](https://github.com/kinggod899/dsh-reply-forge-v3) - Edits assistant replies and thinking chains in DSH sessions so the model sees the edited text, live via message projection or on disk.
- [kira905/dsh-butler-archive](https://github.com/kira905/dsh-butler-archive) - DSH web plugin that browses, previews, restores and deletes archived sessions that were moved out of the sessions directory.
- [kira905/dsh-session-title-live](https://github.com/kira905/dsh-session-title-live) - Live session-title provider for dsh that regenerates the title after every user message, summarizing the most recent messages within a byte budget.
- [kirkchinese/CiteCiter#citeciter](https://github.com/kirkchinese/CiteCiter/tree/main/packages/citeciter) - Select text in a committed DSH response to open an independent, persistent, read-only multi-turn Topic bound to source-session evidence and project files while the source Agent keeps running.
- [kirkchinese/claude2dsh](https://github.com/kirkchinese/claude2dsh) - Import Claude Code sessions, skills and plugin assets into DSH as native resumable sessions, and export or sync DSH sessions back to Claude Code JSONL.
- [kittimzhe/dsh-session-eval](https://github.com/kittimzhe/dsh-session-eval) - Retrospective agent-session evaluation: deterministic grade cards and cross-session regression diffs from persisted logs — no benchmark runs, no LLM judges.
- [kittimzhe/dsh-session-export](https://github.com/kittimzhe/dsh-session-export) - Session evidence reports: /transcript writes styled HTML / Markdown / JSON reports from canonical logs, /stats prints a terminal stats card, /archive writes per-session ZIPs.
- [kittimzhe/dsh-session-recall](https://github.com/kittimzhe/dsh-session-recall) - Deterministic cross-session transcript retrieval: the `recall` tool searches past session logs with explicit scope control.
- [Kyf-eng/dsh-threads](https://github.com/Kyf-eng/dsh-threads) - Claude-style projects and threads: a project's main conversation opens threads (real sessions you can open and talk to) for self-contained tasks, runs up to 3 at once by default, optionally each in its own git worktree, and gets each thread's report back.
- [kyle123740/dsh-message-recall](https://github.com/kyle123740/dsh-message-recall) - Adds hover Recall / Delete / Delete-onward actions to every message row: removes content from the model context and the transcript together via durable append-only tombstones, with an empty-content guard so old deletions can never break strict providers. Tested on the DSH 2.0 desktop.
- [lacemou/dsh-session-ref](https://github.com/lacemou/dsh-session-ref) - Cross-session reference (mention) plugin — paste @[label](dsh-session:…) into any session, including one in another workspace, and the host injects the referenced session snapshot for the model to read; includes a one-click copy-reference button.
- [lamost423/dsh-maze](https://github.com/lamost423/dsh-maze) - Execution maze for DSH sessions: the agent's real path — main advance, failed or dead-end detours, backtracks, request retries and subagent branches — drawn on one wall-clock timeline, with three tracks under each lane sharing that axis (tool-call density, token pulse, context pressure) and a deterministic analysis panel below it (tool result matrix, failure-recovery chains, duration distribution); watch it grow live in a session tab, or upload up to 5 session logs for a same-axis compare.
- [lanscer/dsh-workspace-drag](https://github.com/lanscer/dsh-workspace-drag) - Drag a conversation onto any workspace group in the sidebar to relocate it between DSH workspaces, updating its cwd, disk location and registry ownership.
- [Leawind/dsh-rice-on-a-stick](https://github.com/Leawind/dsh-rice-on-a-stick) - Rice on a Stick: Expose control over DeepSeek Harness (dsh) through MCP (Streamable HTTP) and dsh's native tools, with a configurable list of allowed models. Long-tail host endpoints can be invoked via a generic, audited bridge. By default, it listens only on 127.0.0.1, with an optional access token.
- [Leeminjing/dsh-messages-sanitizer](https://github.com/Leeminjing/dsh-messages-sanitizer) - Auto-repairs the messages array after a tool-dispatch crash (orphaned tool_calls / tool messages), preventing 400 INVALID_REQUEST session lock-ups.
- [leogottadothebest/dsh-plugin-archived-conversations](https://github.com/leogottadothebest/dsh-plugin-archived-conversations) - Manage archived conversations in the Settings UI: unarchive them back to the sidebar, or permanently delete them with confirmation.

IDs and history stay intact, with per-step backup and rollback.

- [po-et/dsh-session-guard](https://github.com/po-et/dsh-session-guard) - Prevents concurrent-write session corruption: takes a per-session advisory lock on session start and every step, so a second dsh process fails loudly instead of writing a duplicate-seq gap; dead owners are taken over automatically.
- [po-et/dsh-session-snapshot](https://github.com/po-et/dsh-session-snapshot) - Rolling, integrity-verified backups of each session at turn boundaries: verifies the log still loads before promoting a snapshot, never overwrites the last good one when a turn ends corrupt, and restores in one command even when dsh will not boot.
- [PolinniZhong/dsh-session-workbench](https://github.com/PolinniZhong/dsh-session-workbench) - Session Workbench: full-text search past sessions, recall up to 3 as @references, and manage conversation-view tabs (show/hide + drag reorder).
- [PolitaryMonicy/dsh-agent-clean](https://github.com/PolitaryMonicy/dsh-agent-clean) - Removes subagent entries and orphaned projection caches from DeepSeek Harness session logs after the app quits, always dry-run first and with a full backup.
- [popu2do/dsh-call-session](https://github.com/popu2do/dsh-call-session) - Run several DeepSeek Harness sessions side by side, hand work from one to another, and watch the whole collaboration on one read-only canvas.
- [praystring/dsh-send-debounce](https://github.com/praystring/dsh-send-debounce) - Buffers consecutive short messages from the composer and merges them into one turn: no model wake-up until the user stops for a configurable silence window; long messages and attachments bypass the buffer.
- [ptrel1/dsh-interrupted-resume](https://github.com/ptrel1/dsh-interrupted-resume) - Lightweight crash-recovery for dsh: after a restart, it detects sessions whose last turn was killed mid-flight and re-injects a continuation prompt that first demands the agent verify real-world state before acting, so side-effecting operations are not blindly repeated. It only reacts to the genuine crash marker (turn/end reason 'interrupted', synthesized on cold read by session repair), so it never misfires on user cancels, rate limits or model errors - which is why it needs no error classification, backoff or configuration UI. Unlike general-purpose auto-continue plugins, it also covers the case where a subagent was interrupted mid-run: the parent turn has already ended normally while it waits, so a naive check sees nothing to resume and the whole subagent tree dies silently; this plugin detects the interrupted child and wakes the parent instead. Single host file, zero external dependencies, seven config constants.
- [PwnKY/dsh-session-link](https://github.com/PwnKY/dsh-session-link) - Copy and open `dsh://` session deep links, or paste them into another conversation to inject a bounded, read-only snapshot of the referenced session.
- [qiangweiliu/dsh-context#agent-embodiment](https://github.com/qiangweiliu/dsh-context/tree/main/agent-embodiment) - Context observability and control for DeepSeek Harness: cross-session token analytics, session-level budget/prompt/tool controls, and optional agent scaffolds. It reuses the official tokenMeter, compaction, systemPrompt, and tools.restrict seams; monitoring is read-only.
- [qingmomo233/dsh-thinking-language](https://github.com/qingmomo233/dsh-thinking-language) - Switch the language of the agent's thinking/reasoning process (chain-of-thought): 简体中文, English, Русский, Français, Deutsch, Español, 日本語, 한국어 and more, or auto-follow the system locale. Adds a Settings → General row, a system-prompt instruction (per-prompt assembly, applies to new sessions), and the /thinking-language command.

- [qinu321/dsh-session-rename](https://github.com/qinu321/dsh-session-rename) - Adds a session_rename tool so an AI can retitle the DeepSeek Harness session it is running in.

- [qvsix/dsh-antigravity-bridge](https://github.com/qvsix/dsh-antigravity-bridge) - Read Google Antigravity SQLite conversations in DeepSeek Harness and import them as native sidebar sessions with list, read and import tools plus slash commands.

- [qwert702/dsh-continue-on-limit](https://github.com/qwert702/dsh-continue-on-limit) - Auto-continue for the dsh web GUI: when a local model hits its output-token cap and the max-tokens notice appears, the plugin automatically queues a short continue message so the reply keeps flowing — dual-source truncation detection, loop protection, and no UI.
- [ranxianglei/billion-context](https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context) - The official billion-context plugin: a context-compression plugin for small context windows (a 100K context is enough), token savings (5x fewer tokens), and month-long single sessions (billions of tokens).
- [regrevia/dsh-pause-resume](https://github.com/regrevia/dsh-pause-resume) - One header button stops running turns, goals and background jobs and writes the plan to disk; after a restart the same button picks the work up again.
- [Relethe/dsh-brief-session-title](https://github.com/Relethe/dsh-brief-session-title) - Condenses DSH session titles from a full sentence into a short verb-free phrase, aiming for under five words.
- [Renzic-Stone/DSH-EasyRewrite](https://github.com/Renzic-Stone/DSH-EasyRewrite) - Inline-edit and recall your own user messages in dsh web — lazily and seamlessly, with a version pager and per-session draft persistence.
- [reverse-PAI/dsh-minimal-session-delete](https://github.com/reverse-PAI/dsh-minimal-session-delete) - Permanently deletes a session from the sidebar, waiting for a running turn to stop and cascading to its subagent sessions.
- [RGarvel/dsh-channel-view](https://github.com/RGarvel/dsh-channel-view) - Channel-grouped session view injected into the sidebar — Workspace/Channels tabs with live-running dots, archived grouping, orphan tagging, built purely on official extension surfaces and serving as the RFC-0001 reference implementation.
- [rhl88/dsh-session-delete](https://github.com/rhl88/dsh-session-delete) - Deletes a session from the sidebar session menu after a confirmation dialog, removing its log directory, projection-cache record and workspace/pin/archive accounting; registry calls are timeout-guarded so a stuck workspace registry cannot block the removal.
- [Rice00/dsh-tree-view](https://github.com/Rice00/dsh-tree-view) - Tree view of a DSH conversation: editing an old message forks the thread, every version lives in one tree while the sidebar keeps a single entry, branches can be renamed, and a branch can be promoted to a session of its own.
- [Ricketts-Guo/dsh-off-peak-message#dsh-offpeak-send](https://github.com/Ricketts-Guo/dsh-off-peak-message/tree/main/dsh-offpeak-send) - Off-peak message scheduler: turn on valley mode and the composer queues your messages until DeepSeek off-peak hours (half price), then auto-injects them into the session and gets replies. Native-look composer, hotkeys (Enter queue / ⌘+Enter send now / Esc exit), per-session toggle persisted across restarts.
- [robbywang25/dsh-codex-pins](https://github.com/robbywang25/dsh-codex-pins) - Splits the DeepSeek Harness sidebar into independently scrollable Pinned and Recents panes, and hides pinned sessions from Recents.
- [rongxingda/dsh-prompt-enhance](https://github.com/rongxingda/dsh-prompt-enhance) - One-click prompt enhancement in the composer — rewrites the draft into a structured prompt (role and goal, executable steps, output format, acceptance criteria, edge cases) with before/after preview, fill-back, and undo. Never changes intent, never fabricates requirements.
- [ruisenbai/dsh-annotation](https://github.com/ruisenbai/dsh-annotation) - Annotate text in replies, diffs, or files and send notes with a message for ordered replies and source navigation; follows Host styling and automatically adapts to dsh-codex-ui.
- [RyanZeeee/dsh-chattree](https://github.com/RyanZeeee/dsh-chattree) - Shows a DSH session as a conversation canvas — every turn is a node, any turn forks a real child session, and a compacted context folds into one green node you can keep talking from; the left rail groups canvases by DSH workspace and renames them in step with the session titles.
- [RyensX/dsh-message-fold](https://github.com/RyensX/dsh-message-fold) - Provides Codex-style session message folding for DeepSeek Harness.
- [Ryuu-64/dsh-session-tools](https://github.com/Ryuu-64/dsh-session-tools) - Gives the agent four session tools: start a new session, send a message into another one, list sessions with their state, and wait for another session's turn to finish so its answer can be read back.
- [sailoumili/dsh-session-remover](https://github.com/sailoumili/dsh-session-remover) - Adds Delete conversation and Batch delete to the sidebar session menu; a deleted conversation and its subagent sessions are moved to the Windows recycle bin, from where they can be restored.
- [SaiSenBox/dsh-prompt-manager](https://github.com/SaiSenBox/dsh-prompt-manager) - Browser-local prompt library with a composer picker for injecting multiple session-scoped system prompts, branch inheritance, bilingual UI, favorites, and JSON backups.
- [sbearbug/dsh-highlightpin](https://github.com/sbearbug/dsh-highlightpin) - Pins a selected passage of a finished user or assistant message as source text and keeps it in the model input across context compaction: each pin is recall-on-demand by default, or can be moved to a neutral resident system-prompt section or an emphasised highlighted one. Selections are aligned back to the source text with source-exact, source-normalized or rendered fidelity, and each of the three levels has its own character budget.
- [scottzx/session-reader](https://github.com/scottzx/session-reader) - Search and read local Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Grok and DSH sessions from the 1session CLI or DSH Web history browser.
- [Seastar101/dsh-conversation-purge](https://github.com/Seastar101/dsh-conversation-purge) - Permanently delete one conversation (archived or not) from its sidebar row menu, including its log, projection cache, archive state, and reminders.
- [seeingrain/dsh-session-todos](https://github.com/seeingrain/dsh-session-todos) - Floating todo panel for DSH sessions with server-side cross-device persistence and pending-task badges in the session list.
- [Seetraum/harness-session-delete](https://github.com/Seetraum/harness-session-delete) - Recycle bin for DSH sessions: sidebar delete icons, multi-select restore and permanent delete, live-session protection.
- [Semidia/dsh-session-manager](https://github.com/Semidia/dsh-session-manager) - Right-click session menu and sidebar session manager: pin, rename, archive, fork, export, copy cwd/id/deep link, and open in explorer or a new window.
- [sensen-jo/dsh-conversation-search](https://github.com/sensen-jo/dsh-conversation-search) - Beta 0.2.0-beta.2 for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 only, for Host-owner use. Search original user and assistant text in the current session or same-directory workspace, with source coordinates and context. Non-owner session authorization is not supported.
- [sensen-jo/dsh-plugin-goal-map](https://github.com/sensen-jo/dsh-plugin-goal-map) - Goal Map shows a read-only goal-to-plan progress route, session mindmap and step list using reported plan progress, without starting tasks or model calls. Beta.2 supports DSH Web 0.2.0-rc.2 or 0.2.1-rc.2, with Node.js >=24.
- [senyayume/dsh-image-once](https://github.com/senyayume/dsh-image-once) - Inlines an image block as base64 only in the one request where it first appears, and marks that same block offloaded on every later request so DSH's own image-offload projection renders it as the placeholder text carrying the read-only local path. An occurrence is keyed by session id, message id, content-tree path and attachment id, and a request is only counted after it produces its first chunk, so retries do not count as sent. Requests carrying a purpose are neither rewritten nor counted, a later read_image of the same file is a new occurrence and inlines once more, and only that request's copy is rewritten, so nothing is written back to the session.
- [Setsuna-Kitahara/dsh-session-lock](https://github.com/Setsuna-Kitahara/dsh-session-lock) - A lock button on every sidebar session row; archiving a locked session through the client-side workspaces.archiveSession — the ⋮ menu, or another plugin calling the same client method — is refused with a notice, the lock list is persisted on the host, and a host route bulk-archives inactive sessions while always skipping locked ones. Calls that reach the host registry directly are not intercepted.
- [Sev7eEn7/sieve#dsh-sieve](https://github.com/Sev7eEn7/sieve/tree/main/packages/dsh-sieve) - Filters tool outputs, prunes stale context and discloses skills on demand for DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1.
- [sh1robana/dsh-plugin-message-edit](https://github.com/sh1robana/dsh-plugin-message-edit) - Message and attachment editing with save-only updates, forked regeneration, and a version timeline for DSH desktop.

- [shenhuanageshei/dsh-team-link](https://github.com/shenhuanageshei/dsh-team-link) - Session deep links, full session export (markdown/JSON), approved cross-session messaging with pairing, and team roster, rotation and recovery tools for multi-session work.
- [ShiTan-677/dsh-plugins#dsh-plugin-mark-unread](https://github.com/ShiTan-677/dsh-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-plugin-mark-unread) - Adds a manual "mark as unread" action to workspace session rows, and retires itself once the harness exposes the same capability.
- [shrekcg/dsh-turn-rail](https://github.com/shrekcg/dsh-turn-rail) - Turn rail on the left edge of the conversation: one tick per user message, hover to preview, click to jump (auto-loads earlier pages when the turn is unloaded), plus an active-turn highlight and a scroll-position indicator.
- [shuanzhe/dsh-turn-hard-delete](https://github.com/shuanzhe/dsh-turn-hard-delete) - Delete a complete closed turn (question + answer + tool calls) from a DeepSeek Harness session, without deleting the session.
- [shuiqian520/dsh-session-delete](https://github.com/shuiqian520/dsh-session-delete) - Permanently deletes one session from the sidebar session menu, or several at once from the "..." menu beside the sidebar section title: tick sessions in the list (running ones are refused), then confirm in a dialog — log directory, workspace membership, live Host instances and the client list row are all cleaned. The same "..." menu also collects the session search and view options. It also sweeps rows whose log is already gone, and retries a user message or an assistant reply from the button right of Copy.

Requires DSH >= 0.1.5-rc.3.

- [SkanderBog/dsh-context-manager](https://github.com/SkanderBog/dsh-context-manager) - Preview conversation context and selectively keep, summarize, or omit exchange groups before applying persistent compaction through Harness session services.

- [SLin-code/dsh-task-notice-board](https://github.com/SLin-code/dsh-task-notice-board) - Task-scoped Workspace to Task to Session control center for DSH Web, with Session boards, archived conversation viewing, and bounded long-term memory shared across linked Sessions.
- [sluminositys/dsh-nested-followups](https://github.com/sluminositys/dsh-nested-followups) - Keep branching from any completed answer at any depth while the main session stays untouched.
- [snow-The/dsh-session-handoff](https://github.com/snow-The/dsh-session-handoff) - Session handoff & context management: structured handoff documents (export/resume/status) so a fresh session can continue seamlessly, plus active context pruning (acp_* tools via the official compaction API with model-authored summaries).
- [SocFeng/dsh-query-jump](https://github.com/SocFeng/dsh-query-jump) - DSH WebUI session query navigation with a faint conversation-edge rail, a hover list of real user queries, and click-to-jump back to the matching bubble.

A session says which desk it belongs to by putting a number prefix in its title; a ticket names one desk and is taken by the first session of that desk to start working, so the desk is the address and a ticket is not delivered to a session that is just passing by.

- [SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-message-edit](https://github.com/SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-message-edit) - Edit a sent message to rewind and branch the conversation from that turn, switch versions with a counter under the bubble, and browse every branch in a turn-level version tree.

- [Sttrevens/dsh-linked-folders](https://github.com/Sttrevens/dsh-linked-folders) - Multi-folder workspace: a durable global linked-folders list plus per-session on-the-fly linking (link_folder/unlink_folder), managed from the Web sidebar with a native folder picker.

Adds a Compaction module sub-tab and a Settings card; toggling off always restores stock compaction.
- [SZMY-haruhi/dsh-session-plus](https://github.com/SZMY-haruhi/dsh-session-plus) - Sidebar archive directory for DSH Web: restore a session to its original workspace slot, delete the session log, or edit-and-branch a user message into a new conversation.

- [TetraSsky/dsh-hold](https://github.com/TetraSsky/dsh-hold) - Holds a drafted message until the main agent is idle, no subagent is running and no background job is live, then sends it. - [Theflippy978/dsh-auto-rename](https://github.com/Theflippy978/dsh-auto-rename) - Names a session from its first prompt, and streams AI title suggestions into the rename dialog.

- [tinyblckc0000al/dsh-deepworker](https://github.com/tinyblckc0000al/dsh-deepworker) - A DSH conversation workspace: turn actions, provenance quotes, local notes and summaries, in-conversation find, focus lock, and per-workspace command buttons.

- [tsingshitao-nuke/dsh-set-workspace](https://github.com/tsingshitao-nuke/dsh-set-workspace) - Adds a Windows Explorer right-click action to open a folder as a DSH workspace, launching DSH if needed.
- [tuogusa/dsh-session-nav](https://github.com/tuogusa/dsh-session-nav) - A floating button beside the chat that opens a searchable list of all questions in the session for quick jumps, with smooth hover-open/close behavior.
- [tuogusa/dsh-session-tags](https://github.com/tuogusa/dsh-session-tags) - Attach tags to sessions and search sessions by tag in the Web settings panel.
- [txlznbzsdj-collab/dsh-session-delete](https://github.com/txlznbzsdj-collab/dsh-session-delete) - Adds a "Delete" item to the sidebar session menu with a confirmation dialog, then hard-deletes the session.
- [Ultronen/dsh-archived-chats](https://github.com/Ultronen/dsh-archived-chats) - Search and manage archived and unarchived chats with read-only previews, tags and notes, workspace archiving, ZIP backups, origins and branches, manual residual-chat checks and automatic update checks. Retains legacy Recycle Bin recovery without automatic cleanup.
- [uwu9039/dsh-unarchive](https://github.com/uwu9039/dsh-unarchive) - Lists archived sessions, previews their content, restores them to the original workspace, and adds an optional archive confirmation.

- [Vast-Unhurried/dsh-toolkit#dsh-session-delete](https://github.com/Vast-Unhurried/dsh-toolkit/tree/main/packages/dsh-session-delete) - Adds a delete-session action that permanently removes session logs, workspace entries and archives.
- [Venshell/dsh-session-dm](https://github.com/Venshell/dsh-session-dm) - Cross-session messaging: sends text into another session in the same workspace, and creates new top-level sessions.
- [Very12345/dsh-archive-delete](https://github.com/Very12345/dsh-archive-delete) - Archived-session management with single and batch deletion, native workspace registry cleanup, and deferred file cleanup while the host holds session resources.
- [Voellin/dsh-deephub-share#dsh-deephub-share](https://github.com/Voellin/dsh-deephub-share/tree/main/packages/dsh-deephub-share) - Turns a dsh session into a redacted idea and delivers it end-to-end encrypted to friends on DeepHub; received ideas land as new sessions.
- [WangLemna/dsh-recycle-bin](https://github.com/WangLemna/dsh-recycle-bin) - Delete DSH sessions into a restorable recycle bin — subagent sessions follow their parent as one tree, batch archive, restore and purge are supported, and only purge destroys bytes.
- [weibaohui/dsh-continue](https://github.com/weibaohui/dsh-continue) - Auto-resume for interrupted agent sessions: an ordered rule table routes by failure type (rate limit, quota, auth, context overflow, crashed orphan) to automatic backoff retry, model switch, resume after context compaction, or a stop-loss notification, with a visual rule editor and a full activity log.
- [weibaohui/dsh-favorites](https://github.com/weibaohui/dsh-favorites) - Session favorites: bookmark any conversation into a browser-style favorites panel — one-click star from session rows, folders for organization, notes, custom display names, resume session, fork into a new session, basic session stats, plus a fork-relationship graph showing how conversations derive from one another.

- [WenhongPan/dsh-projects](https://github.com/WenhongPan/dsh-projects) - Project and session organization with multi-folder groups, attention summaries, grouped chat search, native folder picking, pinning, favorites, ordering, and an archive center.
- [whiteS18/dsh-handoff-button](https://github.com/whiteS18/dsh-handoff-button) - Adds a handoff button to every assistant message that writes an LLM-summarized handoff document of the current conversation into the workspace handoff/ directory.
- [whybebabo/dsh-recent-sessions](https://github.com/whybebabo/dsh-recent-sessions) - Flat list of recent sessions across every workspace, with last-question previews, time buckets, full-text search, and notes that resurface when you reopen a conversation. Fork of huangxp12/dsh-recent-sessions with a native-style UI rewrite; both register the same recent-sessions panel id, so do not install both.
- [whyihaveyou/dsh-suite#plugin-session-export](https://github.com/whyihaveyou/dsh-suite/tree/main/packages/plugins/plugin-session-export) - Export the append-only session log as human-readable Markdown or HTML, grouped by trajectory source.
- [wilsonchengassistant/dsh-session-clean-delete](https://github.com/wilsonchengassistant/dsh-session-clean-delete) - Adds a permanent Delete session action to the sidebar session menu, behind a confirmation dialog that reports the log size, running turns, subagents, background jobs and reminders bound to the session; the id is then released from the live, archive and workspace registries, so the row stays gone on refresh instead of folding back in.

- [WiseXin/dsh-session-intent-title](https://github.com/WiseXin/dsh-session-intent-title) - Zero-UI-overhead DeepSeek Harness plugin that automatically classifies conversation intents and names sessions with clean emoji prefixes (optimize, fix, feature, explore, etc.).
- [wjj-8283/dsh-temp-workspace](https://github.com/wjj-8283/dsh-temp-workspace) - Temporary workspace for DSH web — one click creates a throwaway workspace whose conversations are deleted at the next restart (immediately or after a delay, optionally behind a confirm dialog). - [WSNMM3/dsh-session-keeper](https://github.com/WSNMM3/dsh-session-keeper) - A session manager for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: per-workspace category trees with drag-and-drop ordering, pinned sessions hoisted above the categories (or kept inside them, switchable from the view options), an archive partition, and a delete bin where removed sessions keep their logs and can be restored or purged in batches. The host half owns the category and recycle data, the web half renders it; both ship as one plugin. Maintained fork of ht719/dsh-session-categories ported to current DSH, with pinning, archive partition and delete bin added; it cannot be installed together with the original.

- [wuxiangru915/dsh-session-manager](https://github.com/wuxiangru915/dsh-session-manager) - Session manager for the DSH Web UI: browse all and archived sessions, restore/unarchive, delete with two-step confirmation, and preview conversation content from the Settings panel.

- [xiguazhiPrince/dsh-session-map](https://github.com/xiguazhiPrince/dsh-session-map) - Session map: a fork-tree canvas over DSH sessions, and a Settings page that clones a Git repository into a new workspace. The clone page takes a repository address and a remembered parent directory with a native folder picker, offers a per-clone shallow switch (off by default), runs git clone on the host, and registers the cloned directory as a workspace.

- [xrn1997/dsh-session-delete](https://github.com/xrn1997/dsh-session-delete) - Adds a trash for DSH sessions: nothing expires automatically. Delete or batch delete moves sessions there, where you can read, restore, or permanently delete them.
- [XWIDE/dsh-xwide-handoff](https://github.com/XWIDE/dsh-xwide-handoff) - Generates a structured handoff card so a near-full conversation continues in a fresh zero-context session: /handoff writes the card with self-incrementing titles, pins it to the top of the sidebar and prepares the new session once the context nears its threshold.
- [XXXXXQ-0206/dsh-session-delete](https://github.com/XXXXXQ-0206/dsh-session-delete) - Fork of harness-session-delete that adds Delete to the native session action menu and a recycle-bin page with search, sort, workspace grouping, message preview, batch restore, and per-workspace permanent purge; active sessions are protected.
- [xypang33-sketch/dsh-save-chat](https://github.com/xypang33-sketch/dsh-save-chat) - Save whole turns — the question plus the full answer — as plain Markdown inside the session workspace, promote the good ones into a cross-project personal knowledge base, and let the model search it on demand. - [y2zyyr/smart-session-title](https://github.com/y2zyyr/smart-session-title) - Replacement session-title provider that compresses oversized or code-heavy first prompts before calling the model (in the tested DSH version the built-in provider rejects inputs above 4096 bytes without a model call) and waits for a real task instead of titling a greeting. Titles use the session’s own provider and model by default and manual titles are protected; title rules cover a character cap, an optional date affix, style, language and exclusion words, plus a per-session lock. Edits auto-stop the running agent (official cancel/whenIdle) so rewinds never corrupt the durable log or break /compact.

- [yangyizhu8/dsh-unread-mark](https://github.com/yangyizhu8/dsh-unread-mark) - Session-row unread mark for DeepSeek Harness: the session menu gains Mark unread and Unmark, pinning a red dot before the session title that survives reload and opening until cleared, both entries disabled while the built-in green finished-unopened dot is present.
- [yangyongzhen/dsh-session-export](https://github.com/yangyongzhen/dsh-session-export) - Export sessions to Markdown/JSON for review, replay, and per-session cost summaries.

- [YDT-china/dsh-web-search-session](https://github.com/YDT-china/dsh-web-search-session) - Routes DSH web search through the current session's model and a self-hosted retrieval backend.

An /anchor command re-anchors on demand without a model call; a settings page manages the paged preset library, injection order, re-anchor source and character limits.
- [YeqingTang/dsh-session-flow](https://github.com/YeqingTang/dsh-session-flow) - Cross-session archive: overview workbench, folded timeline, subagent lineage, full-text search, rule+LLM summaries, ZIP export, live tracking. Native session-page embeds: turn rail, docked right panel (live mode, pinned to original session on switch), rename (official-synced), conclusion digest, health monitoring + persistent header chip (idle / active / tool-wait / stalled). dsh v0.1.2+: fuses with the official TurnNavigatorRail — vector-icon info chips (duration, tool calls, errors, thinking) plus lazy tool distribution inside the official preview card, right-click opens the workbench; the classic piano-key strip is on by default and delegates unloaded-turn jumps to the official auto-load engine; the official rail can be hidden entirely. Settings dialog section with 10 tunable behavior params.

Verified on DSH 0.1.1 and 0.1.5.
- [yezitotempeace/dsh-big-compact](https://github.com/yezitotempeace/dsh-big-compact) - Chunked compaction for oversized sessions: takes over only when the live context exceeds 85% of the model window (or the request exceeds 4 MB), summarizes the history in 1.5 MB chunks and merges them; smaller sessions keep the built-in compaction.

- [yillkid/dsh-share-room](https://github.com/yillkid/dsh-share-room) - Invites people into one conversation through single-use links with no account: up to 20 guests discuss together and ask the AI, the shared fork runs read-only, and the owner can remove guests or end the share at any time.

Drag a workspace (folder) row instead and the draft gets that folder's path, so a whole directory can be handed to the model. The target session is matched by session id rather than by title, so duplicate or blank titles cannot insert the wrong conversation. The reference cap comes from the host (3 by default) and is read at runtime instead of being hard-coded, so a host-side raise is followed without changing the plugin. If the chip cannot be inserted, the plugin falls back to sending a reference-only message instead of failing silently.
- [yoza10635/dsh-argp](https://github.com/yoza10635/dsh-argp) - Guarded context compaction for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): the LLM proposes, deterministic guards dispose — eager per-atom shrink (extract/summary/false under verbatim guards) + lazy reference-graph eviction (0-LLM) + byte-exact recall from an append-only log.

- [yxv1203-collab/dsh-conversation-archive](https://github.com/yxv1203-collab/dsh-conversation-archive) - Manage archived DSH sessions on Windows with search, batch restore and deletion, AI-assisted file retention, and verified local or network-directory backups.
- [yyfdfsyyf-source/dsh-context-fold](https://github.com/yyfdfsyyf-source/dsh-context-fold) - Folds oversized tool results into on-disk spill files with deterministic head and tail markers, indexes compaction summaries in a searchable ledger, and extracts cross-session memories with per-project scoping. Any folded content is restored byte-for-byte on demand through one tool call.

- [zangxx66/dsh-prompt-setting#dsh-prompt-setting](https://github.com/zangxx66/dsh-prompt-setting/tree/main/packages/dsh-prompt-setting) - DeepSeek Harness Default System Prompt Management Plugin: Browse, search, and override the final system prompt assembled into each session round within the Web GUI "Settings".
- [zchuxi/dsh-restart-task](https://github.com/zchuxi/dsh-restart-task) - Recovers broken DSH turns: widens the product's own retry budget and renders the wait as a live countdown inside the same step, keeps a truncated output alive inside the same turn, and can open an opt-in continuation round when a turn has already ended; while the composer is empty it hands the send button to that continuation.
- [zenghang25/dsh-session-delete](https://github.com/zenghang25/dsh-session-delete) - Adds a one-click delete-session row to the DSH sidebar session menu: moves the session log and its per-conversation .dsh-sessions artifact directory to the Windows Recycle Bin, with no confirmation dialog.
