- [ZeroKingHao/dsh-cleaner#plugin](https://github.com/ZeroKingHao/dsh-cleaner/tree/main/plugin) - Session deletion for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar menu item, a workspace-grouped batch cleanup panel and a session_delete tool (dry-run by default). Deletes session logs, projection cache, workspace-registry references and derived search indexes, and cascades to all subagent sessions.
- [zf-666888/dsh-session-id-for-desktop](https://github.com/zf-666888/dsh-session-id-for-desktop) - Adds Copy session ID and permanent deletion of a Conversation's log, projection cache and workspace references to the session row's ⋯ menu, behind a two-step confirm.
- [zhangyy0423/dsh-veripipe](https://github.com/zhangyy0423/dsh-veripipe) - Keeps a per-turn receipt that later turns do not clear (final todo counts, goal id and phase, end reason, and a fail-closed pass/fail/inconclusive plan verdict), plus a read-only tool to read recent receipts. Stores counts and ids only.
- [zhaolianghz/dsh-turnscope](https://github.com/zhaolianghz/dsh-turnscope) - Per-turn file changes, per-file diffs and deterministic safety verdicts for DSH sessions, plus a preview-first rewind that refuses when the worktree has drifted since the preview.
- [zhengjy01/dsh-period-report](https://github.com/zhengjy01/dsh-period-report) - Free-interval session reports with AI-narrated daily/weekly digests over any date range, plus every-N-days scheduled reminders with system notifications (macOS / Linux).
- [zhou1736948757-cpu/dsh-auto-continue](https://github.com/zhou1736948757-cpu/dsh-auto-continue) - Automatically sends a "continue" prompt when a reply is cut off at the output token limit, resuming long answers without manual input; aimed at self-hosted Ollama deployments with small output caps.
- [zhuto666/dsh-compact-agents](https://github.com/zhuto666/dsh-compact-agents) - Model-callable compact_agents tool that force-compacts context in every live session (main session, ordinary sub-agents and AgentTeams members alike), queues busy targets and compacts them when the turn ends, reports the shadowed node count and estimated tokens per target, and ships a browser form for the trigger ratio, retained ratio, controlled-phase output budget, auto-continue budget and an end-of-turn pre-compaction ratio that compacts near the trigger line once a turn ends, so a reply no longer opens with a wait for the summarizer.
- [ZilongYang/dsh-session-mng](https://github.com/ZilongYang/dsh-session-mng) - One Settings page for every DeepSeek Harness session: browse active and archived sessions by workspace, generate a title from the whole conversation for live or archived sessions, archive or restore, move a cold session to another workspace, and permanently delete an archived session (with its subagent descendants after confirmation).
- [ZilongYang/dsh-session-titler](https://github.com/ZilongYang/dsh-session-titler) - Adds a manual, confirm-first title generator: a header button and a session-row menu entry ask a model to summarize the whole conversation, show the proposal in an editable dialog, and rename the session only after you confirm — without registering a title provider or changing automatic titling.
- [ZiYuan258/dsh-prompt-enhance](https://github.com/ZiYuan258/dsh-prompt-enhance) - Maintained fork of dsh-prompt-enhance, brought up to DSH 0.1.7 — the plugin would not even load on current hosts (InputState.imageIds became attachmentIds, so the composer button crashed the input box; settings.get() was removed; /enhance read a session id the agent no longer exposes). Rewrites default to reasoningEffort off, which measured 252 output tokens for a draft where the model default spent 2897, and a Settings page for all 17 fields is bundled. Verified on a real 0.1.7-rc.2 host: activation, a live HTTP enhancement request, /enhance in the GUI, and the Settings page reading and persisting configuration. 204 tests.
- [zljr/dsh-share](https://github.com/zljr/dsh-share) - Share the current session over the LAN as a read-only, token-guarded HTML snapshot with session stats and Markdown rendering.
- [Zn-Dk/dsh-session-explorer](https://github.com/Zn-Dk/dsh-session-explorer) - Message-level full-text search across DSH sessions via an FTS5 trigram index (user / assistant / steering / tool with per-kind filters), deduplicated results across fork/continued sessions, read-only context preview with auto-scroll to the focused message, one-click jump to the real session, and incremental/full index rebuild with health check; zh/en i18n follows the Host locale service.
- [Zn-Dk/dsh-session-repair](https://github.com/Zn-Dk/dsh-session-repair) - Diagnose and safely repair corrupted DSH session history: raw zstd/JSONL validation, tool-call ID repair, single-slot pre-repair backup, restore, and an audit trail.
- [zongyanbai/dsh-context-continuum](https://github.com/zongyanbai/dsh-context-continuum) - Replaces rolling narrative summaries with an append-only session index, so early facts survive compaction verbatim and shadowed text stays retrievable by anchor.
- [ZRui-C/dsh-minimal-first-turn](https://github.com/ZRui-C/dsh-minimal-first-turn) - Minimal-compatible first turn for Web root sessions: starts with persistent bash and str_replace_editor, removes automatic workspace and skill context, then restores the selected preset after the first tool call or reply; includes a persistent composer toggle.
- [zsjs110110-cpu/dsh-cross-session-approval](https://github.com/zsjs110110-cpu/dsh-cross-session-approval) - Cross-session task delegation for DeepSeek Harness: spawn durable top-level sessions and send them tasks, read or steer them by base62 session alias, and approve their sandbox escalation requests through an approval bridge that refuses destructive deletes.
- [zyd232/dsh-compaction-policy](https://github.com/zyd232/dsh-compaction-policy) - Stops DeepSeek Harness from compacting (summarizing) your conversation far too early. Without it, compaction fires around half-full on smaller context windows; with it, compaction waits until the window is as full as you want (80% by default), settable per provider/model. It only changes when compaction happens — what a summary keeps is still DSH’s decision.
- [ZZJQ678/dsh-global-context](https://github.com/ZZJQ678/dsh-global-context) - Adds a Global Prompt tab to the conversation view: text you write there is prepended to the top of every session system prompt, and saving takes effect on the next message without a restart.
- [ZZZZZZZ-ZZZZZ/dsh-attachment-library](https://github.com/ZZZZZZZ-ZZZZZ/dsh-attachment-library) - Read-only attachment library: lists every image and file attachment stored on this machine, its size, and which conversations (including those in the session trash) still use it, with Show in Finder and Open in Preview.
- [ZZZZZZZ-ZZZZZ/dsh-session-trash](https://github.com/ZZZZZZZ-ZZZZZ/dsh-session-trash) - Session trash: move conversations to a trash instead of deleting them, restore them, or delete them permanently after a second confirmation; a session opened in this run is hidden and moved at the next start.

### Memory

- [00080000/dsh-project-memory](https://github.com/00080000/dsh-project-memory) - Project memory for dsh with native task-system integration: session todos and file reads auto-condense into cross-session task records (task↔file links), so workflows are switchable and resumable without re-contextualizing. Read-time memory (no upfront scan): extracts code symbols, summarizes docs, and cross-links docs↔symbols; optional TS semantic enhancement (auto on when TS installed). Experience notes auto-dedup. Every recall includes a traceable citation. Pure JS, single dep, works out of the box, silent operation, zero overhead.
- [0Junze0/dsh-mem0](https://github.com/0Junze0/dsh-mem0) - Long-term memory on top of mem0 and a local Chroma store: user profile and recalled facts injected through the system prompt, capture at session end, a nightly pass that dedupes, merges paraphrases and resolves contradictions, a persistent topic graph written as Markdown cards, periodic export to a git repository, and a full-page memory UI with search, bulk merge, snapshots and undo. Needs a manual Python venv setup plus LLM and embedding API keys before use.
- [0x7A7A6572/dsh-forge-studio#plugin-memory](https://github.com/0x7A7A6572/dsh-forge-studio/tree/main/packages/plugin-memory) - Cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: agents save, search and update user preferences, facts and project decisions; important entries are injected into later sessions, and a Settings section lists, edits, archives or deletes them.
- [1014029855/dsh-codevault](https://github.com/1014029855/dsh-codevault) - Reading archive for dsh: after reading open-source code, capture quick notes or write full deep notes that group into one card per repo / file / symbol, stored as an append-only log of Markdown notes you can open in Obsidian; query your history, browse recent reads, or search your own Obsidian vault and link related notes to a reading record. Nine tools, a /codevault command, and a code-reading skill.
- [1015677515/dsh-prompt-ErrorNotes-desk](https://github.com/1015677515/dsh-prompt-ErrorNotes-desk) - Captures the agent's own self-reported mistakes into a categorised lesson library that is re-injected into the system prompt every turn (each captured draft is confirmed or edited by the user before it is recorded), and adds two conversation-header panels for editing the cross-conversation global prompt and a per-session prompt.
- [135642-163/dsh-knowledge-base](https://github.com/135642-163/dsh-knowledge-base) - Local-first knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: imports Word/PPT/Excel/PDF (text or scanned), EPUB and MOBI/AZW3, builds Markdown parts with page anchors, OCR quality/confidence and column-aware PDF reading order; adds an LLM-maintained wiki layer (schema.md rules, auto index.md, append-only log.md, typed notes with sources and backlinks), adds source-trust labels (high/medium/low) with trust-aware ranking and low-trust warnings, and supports ranked search, cross-KB query, precise reading/editing, and md/jsonl/zip export. MOBI/AZW3 need Calibre; legacy .doc/.ppt need Word/PowerPoint (Windows) or LibreOffice (Linux); scanned-PDF OCR downloads models on first use.
- [1420079678-ctrl/agent-body#dsh-cortex](https://github.com/1420079678-ctrl/agent-body/tree/main/workspace/plugins/dsh-cortex) - The memory organ of Agent-Body: after 2 minutes of silence it enters light sleep and after 5 minutes deep sleep, where deterministic rules distil real experience into memory cards (pitfalls, playbooks, hotspots, unresolved issues, facts). Incoming commands recall related cards by keyword and inject them into context; cards unused for long decay on a half-life and are archived rather than deleted. It also de-noises body-wide homeostasis warnings: repeats inside a window are counted instead of re-printed, and a warning that keeps recurring without ever healing converges into a known steady-state offset and goes quiet. Consolidation and recall make no model calls.
- [18477514055/dsh-ledger-memory](https://github.com/18477514055/dsh-ledger-memory) - Project-level memory built around a ledger whose structure the AI designs per project; the plugin only handles detection, injection, write-back, archiving and git. Memories are split by meaning: the active ledger holds current state, the turn journal is append-only, and decisions, the goal tree and lessons are one-card-per-file (with a multi-dimension index over the card folders); the fundamental principles file can be changed only by the user. There is a single compaction mode: before compacting, the AI sorts the work into three buckets - what must stay in context and is re-injected verbatim, what is written to the project's _stash/ for later lookup, and what is dropped. When a conversation is opened in a container workspace holding several projects, it can be locked to one sub-project (the lock lives in the plugin's own home and survives restarts; it leaves no marker in your project). Also an activity log with five levels, where L4 stores the user's own words verbatim (never injected, queryable on demand). Before each compaction a verbatim capsule (user quotes, raw errors, changed files) is written to disk, and both the capsule and its source material survive a restart; a handoff document lets a new conversation resume the previous one. 21 tools, 12 subcommands, 39 settings (one of them switches whether the settings panel or each project's manifest wins). Runs locally, no runtime dependencies.
- [398894496-arch/DSH-KRouter](https://github.com/398894496-arch/DSH-KRouter) - Local Obsidian vault as the agent knowledge store, with read-only DSH tools that route status, preference, correction, memory, project, search, and suggest to the matching page.
- [863683348/dsh-memory-setup](https://github.com/863683348/dsh-memory-setup) - Local, auditable personal memory for DeepSeek Harness: preferences, project conventions, workflows and error lessons persisted as a changelogged JSON file in the workspace, with onboarding, auto project-convention extraction and evidence-backed lessons.
- [863683348/dsh-plugin-focus](https://github.com/863683348/dsh-plugin-focus) - Focus board for DeepSeek Harness agents: durable, model-maintained notes in the session workspace that pin the objective, constraints, and decisions across compaction and sessions, with automatic context injection, archive on clear, and an optional web panel.
- [988hj7tczd-oss/harness-desktop#plugins/harness-memory](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/harness-desktop/tree/main/plugins/harness-memory) - Cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness via the official storage domain: memories persist through ctx.storage (storageDomain table) and are injected into the system prompt through a registered section (memory:recall), with memory_save / memory_forget tools so the agent reads and writes its own memory (maxMemories configurable).
- [a1141171521/dsh-plugin-memfuse](https://github.com/a1141171521/dsh-plugin-memfuse) - Long-term memory for DSH stored as plain Markdown. Real user/assistant exchanges are captured into daily session files without a model call; an LLM pass then distils them into memories that are injected into the system prompt each turn. Retrieval is local (CJK bigram + BM25) in three levels — index, summary, full text — so the model only pays for the detail it asks for. Memories carry priorities; P0 and user-written entries are never changed automatically, and forgetting marks an entry stale instead of deleting it, so the whole chain stays auditable in status.md. Six tools cover recall, write, status, extract, feedback and the skill library; when a cluster of memories is ready to become a skill, a card appears at the end of the turn, writes the SKILL.md on click, and installs it only after you approve. Learning is on by default and follows the conversation model; turning the master switch off stops the LLM entirely while capture keeps working. Failures are surfaced in the prompt and in status.md instead of being swallowed. Pure JavaScript, no third-party runtime dependencies beyond the harness packages.
- [adithyanraj03/dsh-memory-recall](https://github.com/adithyanraj03/dsh-memory-recall) - Persistent memory for dsh in the style of Hermes Agent: a memory tool that keeps a user profile and the model's own notes, delivered to every chat as a logged context message — at the start, after a change and after compaction — and a session_search tool that reads earlier chats only after the user approves, with a Memory panel to see and edit what is kept.
- [adoresever/graph-memory](https://github.com/adoresever/graph-memory) - Traceable, searchable cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness — conversation knowledge as typed graph nodes (TASK/SKILL/EVENT) and typed edges.
- [agentscope-ai/ReMe#dsh](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/ReMe/tree/main/integrations/dsh) - Connects DeepSeek Harness to ReMe's local-first, self-evolving personal knowledge base: automatically captures completed main-agent conversations as user-owned Markdown memory, searches conversations and source material through reme_search with BM25, optional embeddings, and wikilink expansion, and schedules daily memory consolidation.
- [ai-fu-cn/dsh-plugin-memos-code-retrospect](https://github.com/ai-fu-cn/dsh-plugin-memos-code-retrospect) - Coding retrospect distilled memory for DSH: distills rejected solutions, pitfalls and constraints from each turn via a local LLM, tags them into MemOS (type:rejected_solution), and boosts weighted recall on coding tasks via agent/pre-step.
- [Aik358/dsh-auto-memory](https://github.com/Aik358/dsh-auto-memory) - Proactive associative memory for DSH: zero-prompt recall injected at a fixed boundary, three-layer auto-consolidation, skill crystallization, and Astra-style context management - handoff ledgers and a PLAN whiteboard that survive context-window switches, water-level sensing with an auto-detected model window. Local Markdown storage, model-agnostic, zero deps; lexical 0GB floor with optional semantic tiers.
- [AirPineApplea/feiyu-memory](https://github.com/AirPineApplea/feiyu-memory) - Cross-session persona and diary for DeepSeek Harness: a local gate decides whether a turn is worth remembering, then one extra model call turns it into a first-person diary entry plus an impression of the user, where every impression carries the specific moment that produced it. Later conversations inject about 2000 tokens of that as a self-memory block in three registers: a persona core, a section for judgements the model wrote itself, and the diary. There is a tool for the model to record a judgement in its own words, and a plain markdown hand-note file the human can write into which the plugin only ever reads. A sidebar panel lets you read, forget or export the archive, and forgetting demotes an entry rather than deleting it, so an old one still surfaces on a strong topical match. Local-only, secrets are stripped before anything is sent, and the archive is a plain folder you can read, edit or carry to another account. Zero runtime dependencies, no build step.
- [akslcw/dsh-negative-ledger](https://github.com/akslcw/dsh-negative-ledger) - Evidence-bound negative-knowledge ledger: persists disproven paths (command_failed, file_missing) with their outcome and precondition evidence, then warns or blocks repeat attempts until the evidence changes.
- [AllenWES365/dsh-local-memory](https://github.com/AllenWES365/dsh-local-memory) - Project-isolated long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness that keeps one bank per project and adds a cross-project view; it can also seed a project's memory from its git history without opening a session there.
- [AndyYang12345/dsh-butler-memory](https://github.com/AndyYang12345/dsh-butler-memory) - PostgreSQL-backed durable memory for DSH agents: MCP memory tools plus a Web panel for reviewing memories and candidates.
- [annkun/dsh-memory](https://github.com/annkun/dsh-memory) - Hierarchical Claude Code-style memory: user + project scopes (project memories committed to git for the team), MEMORY.md index auto-injected at session start, context-window guards, pure files.
- [AntonyLang/dsh-memory-observer](https://github.com/AntonyLang/dsh-memory-observer) - Distills long sessions into background observations and reflections, injects them as a system-prompt section, and renders compaction summaries from prepared memory; includes a Settings page and source-backed recall.
- [aqsk-BLG/dsh-memory](https://github.com/aqsk-BLG/dsh-memory) - Layered file memory for DeepSeek Harness with workspace-scoped USER/MEMORY notes, background consolidation, and hybrid session recall.
- [Asher-2000/dsh-memory-connect](https://github.com/Asher-2000/dsh-memory-connect) - Cross-session memory plugin for DSH (v0.6.1, npm @asherliner/dsh-memory-connect): auto-extraction, SQLite FTS5 indexing, RRF semantic recall injected into the system prompt every turn, scheduled maintenance, LLM-powered consolidation via ctx.llm, context explosion prevention, and global Soul identity via ~/.dsh/soul.md. v0.5.0 added temporal context graph (valid_from/valid_until/supersedes, append-only corrections via reviseMemory), trust model (recalled history injected as untrusted reference, current instruction always wins), turn-end summarization. v0.6.0 added local semantic embeddings (BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5 via embed_server.py, cosine + RRF fusion with FTS5, no cloud calls, ~232 msgs/sec on CPU). v0.6.1 fixed ~ expansion in path config. Zero-config install.
- [AskTheWay/dsh-auto-memory](https://github.com/AskTheWay/dsh-auto-memory) - Claude Code-style auto-memory, natively: typed memory files (user/feedback/project/reference) with a MEMORY.md index auto-injected into the system prompt (zero footprint when empty); memory_write/read/list/delete follow Claude Code write rules (dedupe-and-update, absolute dates, cross-links); workspace-scoped and user-scoped layers, cross-process file locking with orphan-lock recovery, plain Markdown on disk, no external services, no embeddings.
- [AtinyFurina/dsh-memory-triage](https://github.com/AtinyFurina/dsh-memory-triage) - Memory triage for DeepSeek Harness: at the end of each turn it decides which entries to keep and which to archive, routes project-specific ones into a project bucket while global ones stay in the main store, merges near-duplicate entries, and falls back to an LLM when the rules are unsure — automatic actions are recoverable archives only, never deletions.
- [aujurd22/dsh-flymemory](https://github.com/aujurd22/dsh-flymemory) - Structural long-term memory for DSH: supersede, decay and entity-state tracking across 15 MCP tools, automatic recall and capture hooks, and a bounded pointer index published per request instead of filling the window. Requires Python 3.10+ with torch and sentence-transformers; the first run downloads a ~470 MB embedding model.
- [baaai123/dsh-memory-protocol](https://github.com/baaai123/dsh-memory-protocol) - Memory protocol enforcement plugin: bridges the opencode-memory MCP server, forces memory_weave before tool calls, auto-ingests turns, and injects memory context into agent steps.
- [BangBang-03/dsh-memory](https://github.com/BangBang-03/dsh-memory) - Long-term memory scoped to the DSH workspace. A session opens with a one-line-per-memory index - bodies are fetched on demand by the `memory` tool, so the same character budget holds about three times as many entries - and when a turn ends a purely local search over the last user message pulls the matching memories into the next briefing at no model cost. Optional auto-capture distils a stretch of conversation into structured memories; in draft mode they wait in an approval queue instead of landing directly. A portrait layer keeps a workspace and a global picture, rewritten from the journal and the records, with the same draft-or-direct choice. Settings → Memory holds the archive, list and timeline views, a health check (duplicate clusters, stale entries, broken links), the supersede version chain with rollback, and a read-only scan that imports existing WorkBuddy / Qoder memory files.
- [baosfeng/my-dsh-plugins#dsh-my-memory](https://github.com/baosfeng/my-dsh-plugins/tree/main/plugins/dsh-my-memory) - Memory in global and per-project scopes: memories are injected into the system prompt at session start, a settings panel edits them with confirmation on write, and the agent gets a read-only memory_query tool (npm: `dsh-my-memory`).
- [BaxterL/dsh-code-taste](https://github.com/BaxterL/dsh-code-taste) - Learns a user's coding conventions from instructions and corrections, stores them as confidence-scored rules in editable Markdown, and injects them as reference data into every session. Rules that decay out of range or contradict a newer rule stay visible for review instead of being applied.
- [bbqisbbq/dsh-tiddlywiki](https://github.com/bbqisbbq/dsh-tiddlywiki) - Runs TiddlyWiki 5 as the DSH persistent knowledge base: ten tiddlywiki_* agent tools (filtered search, read/write/batch/rename/delete, recent, tags, git sync with conflict resolve), a full TiddlyWiki editor embedded in the GUI center column over a same-origin proxy, a right-side wiki tab, a per-session tab summarizing the notes a session read or wrote, a quick-note card with draft auto-save, and an optional clip bookmarklet with image attachment — all backed by an auto-committing git repository.
- [bonerush/dsh-obsidian-mem](https://github.com/bonerush/dsh-obsidian-mem) - Project documents and long-term memory as plain Markdown in a dedicated Obsidian vault: six mem_* tools (search, read, write, log, brief, admin), one budgeted recall injection at the first step of a session, and automatic distillation of completed turns. Obsidian does not need to be running, and the vault stays readable with the plugin uninstalled.
- [boogoo619/dsh-noteboard](https://github.com/boogoo619/dsh-noteboard) - Workspace-wide sticky notes on an infinite canvas: notes are plain Markdown files, created manually, captured from conversations, or distilled by the AI, and can be handed back as context; ships 12 model tools and 5 bundled skills for creating, tagging, arranging, comparing and merging notes.
- [Breeze136/dsh-kb-rag#npm-package](https://github.com/Breeze136/dsh-kb-rag/tree/main/npm-package) - Local literature knowledge-base RAG: 10 tools (kb_ingest, kb_search, kb_rag, kb_zotero, kb_dedup, kb_clear, kb_fetch, kb_scope, kb_stats, kb_status), hybrid BM25+vector+reranker search, cited QA with clickable DOI links, all-local bge embeddings over a single-file SQLite index. Needs Python 3.9+ with pymupdf, faiss-cpu and sentence-transformers; the `npx dsh-kb-rag-install` installer sets those up and pre-downloads the model.
- [brunhildzhou/dsh-context-zip#dsh-context-zip](https://github.com/brunhildzhou/dsh-context-zip/tree/main/dsh-context-zip) - Replaces the built-in DSH compaction summarizer with a five-section handoff summary and keeps every shadowed message readable in a segment directory.
- [bufan528/dsh-longterm-memory](https://github.com/bufan528/dsh-longterm-memory) - Local Markdown long-term memory for DSH: an Obsidian-compatible vault, a sidebar management page, four memory tools, and budgeted per-turn recall.
- [busabase/busabase-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/busabase/busabase-dsh-plugin) - Connects DeepSeek Harness to Busabase: search workspace knowledge, work with structured records and apps, submit writes as reviewable ChangeRequests, and inspect results in live cards.
- [caimc21069065-prog/dsh-reflect](https://github.com/caimc21069065-prog/dsh-reflect) - Turns corrections into permanent rules: explicit remember: triggers and auto-detected corrections pass a confirm bar (save globally / per project / edit / skip) and are written into a marked AGENTS.md section. New rules take effect in the current session and load natively in future ones; writes are deduplicated and version-guarded, and secret-looking content is refused.
- [ccch713/deepddw#ddw-teams-panel](https://github.com/ccch713/deepddw/tree/main/plugins/ddw-teams-panel) - Adds a multi-user settings panel to the DSH web client: usage-mode selection, member management with online status and device binding, and switching or sharing of per-member memory and knowledge bases.
- [CDeZT/better-basicfun](https://github.com/CDeZT/better-basicfun) - Native DSH foundation bundle that registers a persistent default workspace, provides paged read-only inspection of plugins, skills, memory, sessions, storage, settings, credentials, and DSH_HOME files, and synchronizes rich CLIProxyAPI model capabilities into native provider settings.
- [CeilCelia/dsh-eli-mode#packages/eli-mode](https://github.com/CeilCelia/dsh-eli-mode/tree/main/packages/eli-mode) - Knowledge-base-driven agent preset: wiki long-term memory, a web KB UI, a management page and optional UI polish.
- [Chance722/dsh-inbox](https://github.com/Chance722/dsh-inbox) - Personal paste inbox for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): /inbox in the composer or the sidebar panel files links, images, text and credentials into a local vault, classifies them by local rules and then by a rate-capped model pass, and browses, searches and edits them from the panel; the assistant retrieves records on request in conversation, credential bodies stay encrypted at rest, and an optional WebDAV or S3 remote syncs records and attachment bytes. Windows only so far.
- [chaos-miku/dsh-error-atlas](https://github.com/chaos-miku/dsh-error-atlas) - Records DeepSeek Harness runtime errors and coding retrospectives as an interactive GPU graph, and feeds the recorded lessons back into the model's context.
- [cheeseRatRat/dsh-buwang](https://github.com/cheeseRatRat/dsh-buwang) - A private memory library for DSH with customizable personas that only records when you ask, storing everything locally in Markdown.
- [chenzheshushi-commits/dsh-evolve](https://github.com/chenzheshushi-commits/dsh-evolve) - Cross-session memory with zero-token deterministic recall (bigram-Jaccard fused with FTS5 BM25 via RRF, Chinese-aware tokenization), reinforcement that strengthens repeated observations, and procedures crystallized into SKILL.md files refined in place through an active-stale-archived lifecycle with reversible archive and rollback. Ingest and disposal each expose a user-chosen autonomy tier; conflicts and high-importance writes always go to human review, and nothing is ever auto-deleted. Requires Node 22.5+.
- [chinwe/dsh-compound-memory](https://github.com/chinwe/dsh-compound-memory) - Launches the local compound-memory MCP server through uvx and injects a short usage reminder once per session.
- [ciskonc/dsh-context-imports](https://github.com/ciskonc/dsh-context-imports) - Reads the files that AGENTS.md references with @path imports and injects their content into model context, with byte budgets, compaction re-seeding and a six-language settings card. v0.3.x expands the imports of every instruction file the harness loaded, including a project AGENTS.md picked up mid-session (needs DSH 0.2.0+); use 0.2.x on DSH 0.1.7.
- [Co-Engram/Co-Engram#dsh-plugin](https://github.com/Co-Engram/Co-Engram/tree/main/packages/dsh-plugin) - Self-evolving team memory as plain Markdown in git: a native Cordis plugin that registers 38 bare-name memory tools plus a prompt-signals section re-evaluated at every assembly, with RPE reinforcement, decay and sleep consolidation; shares one data repo with its Claude Code (MCP) and OpenClaw hosts; verified against DSH 0.1.0-rc.6.
- [crease123/dsh-journal-calendar](https://github.com/crease123/dsh-journal-calendar) - A daily journal the agent keeps: the journal_record tool appends dated todos and memories, with optional detail and tags, to one JSON file per day under the DSH home; the right sidebar draws those files as a month calendar marked per day by open todos, finished todos or memories, with checkable todos and the selected day's entries below; and the duty sentence it adds to the system prompt is editable from the calendar itself.
- [csyangwen/dsh-memory-evolve](https://github.com/csyangwen/dsh-memory-evolve) - A purely plugin-based implementation that brings "cross-session long-term memory + background self-evolution" capabilities to DeepSeek Harness: five-track memory · git branch awareness · in-turn self-review · skill self-evolution and skill manager · four-track to-do · COI scheduling · session broadcast · session search · prompt manager · temporary info notes—zero core modifications, zero runtime dependencies, ready to use upon installation and completely removable upon uninstallation.
- [DamonKoy/dsh-plugins#dsh-memories](https://github.com/DamonKoy/dsh-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-memories) - Project-scoped persistent key-value memories with set/get/list/delete/search model tools and JSON-file storage.
- [Dayi-Z/dsh-learn-wiki](https://github.com/Dayi-Z/dsh-learn-wiki) - Knowledge base with a corrective acquisition loop for DeepSeek Harness: when the agent keeps hitting the same failure, a background worker fetches the web under a rate limit, distills the result into a staging area, and only a two-stage commit makes it recallable — pages without sources are refused.
- [dearbld/dsh-living-memory](https://github.com/dearbld/dsh-living-memory) - Self-tending living memory in one local SQLite file — a nightly patrol dedupes, merges, decays and cross-links entries on its own, with seven-signal RRF hybrid recall (FTS5 + jieba Chinese-first tokenization, optional vector KNN, graph PPR), a typed knowledge graph, conflict detection instead of silent overwrites, and web telemetry panels.
- [dennisrongo/dsh-plugins#dsh-memory](https://github.com/dennisrongo/dsh-plugins/tree/main/plugins/dsh-memory) - A /remember command that writes facts into the AGENTS.md instruction hierarchy dsh already loads, plus a Memory tab showing which instructions the loader kept within its byte budget.
- [detongz/dsh-client-ui-obsidian-memory](https://github.com/detongz/dsh-client-ui-obsidian-memory) - Persistent AI memory backed by a local Obsidian/Codex vault: five obsidian_memory_* read/write/search tools plus a sidebar vault browser.
- [diqierjia/StrataGate-AgentMemory](https://github.com/diqierjia/StrataGate-AgentMemory) - Recent conversations stay vivid. Older ones fade into summaries, not oblivion. StrataGate gives DeepSeek Harness six-layer, time-decaying memory, while lasting events and relationships settle into a knowledge graph. Bring your memories from other AIs with you—no need to start over.
- [djasdh/interest-memory](https://github.com/djasdh/interest-memory) - Cross-session long-term memory backed by a local Go service (~50MB RAM, SQLite-vec + verify-augmented claims): zero-lag recall injection on every user message, session-end transcript ingest, and memory_search / memory_logs / memory_ingest tools. Install with `dsh plugin --profile web add @djasdh/interest-memory-dsh-bridge`. Protocol bridge only: the Go service is not installed by `dsh plugin add` — install and start it per the repository README first; until it runs, the tools silently return nothing.
- [drscrewdriver/dsh-prime-memory](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-prime-memory) - Layered memory for DSH whose agent-facing surface is 10 tools: high-privilege writes (memory_add, memory_delete, memory_import), rumination controls (memory_ruminate, _cancel, _status), and a memory graph (memory_search_graph, memory_expand_graph_node), built over an L0-L3 distillation pipeline that recalls and injects relevant memories before each model step.
- [duhuashan/dsh-annals](https://github.com/duhuashan/dsh-annals) - Memory that outlives the session, kept as plain daily log files: one markdown file per day plus a generated index the agent greps instead of re-reading. Registers the annals skill, injects the write-it-down rules into the system prompt, and exposes three tools — annals_init builds the log directory, the index generator and a separate Git repository in one call; annals_query full-text searches past entries and returns them with file and line anchors; annals_links resolves which entry cites which. Reminds the agent once per turn when it changed files but wrote no log that day, and once more when the log was updated but the index was not. Adds a settings page for the six switches.
- [dxxCaO/dsh-self-improvement](https://github.com/dxxCaO/dsh-self-improvement) - Cross-session memory as plain Markdown per workspace: weighted injection, bi-temporal invalidation, TTL review with stale markers, credential redaction, error and session retrospectives, SOP skills, and approval-gated self-improvement proposals.
- [ECNU/EduWork#dsh-memory](https://github.com/ECNU/EduWork/tree/main/packages/dsh-memory) - Local semantic memory and prior-chat retrieval with source references, editable memories, retention, forget controls, undo, and JSON import/export.
- [EPCN-fla/dsh-observational-memory](https://github.com/EPCN-fla/dsh-observational-memory) - Distills session work into background observations and reflections to preserve context across compaction.
- [eryucheng/dsh-suzu-memory](https://github.com/eryucheng/dsh-suzu-memory) - Per-session long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness, with memory management, persona settings, and compaction prompts.
- [EternalNight996/dsh-memory-eternal](https://github.com/EternalNight996/dsh-memory-eternal) - A self-contained second brain for DeepSeek Harness — auto-captures durable dialogue knowledge into a local Markdown vault (custom dedup, CJK search, git-friendly), with a graphical knowledge base and an interactive knowledge graph (legend filter, time-dimension coloring, box-select, merge, delete, PNG export/import).
- [EternalNight996/memory-eternal](https://github.com/EternalNight996/memory-eternal) - Self-built DSH memory plugin: SQLite persistent storage + database-level audit guard (enforceAudit) + audit log. Auto-captures knowledge after conversations, agents recall via memory_recall, supports Claude Code/Codex/Cursor multi-agent sharing. Zero external dependencies.
- [EvoMap/evolver-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/EvoMap/evolver-dsh-plugin) - A harness that gets smarter the more you use it, with no more goldfish memory. Before each prompt, Evolver recalls one proven strategy from your local history and the EvoMap network; after the turn it grades that strategy by the checks that ran, whether the edits were kept, and how you replied, then reports back to the network, which weighs it by evidence. Every success becomes a shortcut for next time, and every failure becomes a warning.
- [fangqiing/dsh-knowledge-lite](https://github.com/fangqiing/dsh-knowledge-lite) - Local knowledge base for DSH: one Markdown file per note, with tags, hierarchical folders, full-text search, attachment opening via the system default app, zero-dependency Office text extraction, and citation into the conversation. Built for host DSH 0.2.0-rc.2; on Windows the default root is E:/dsh-kb.

- [FleetingEcho/dsh-handoff](https://github.com/FleetingEcho/dsh-handoff) - Self-maintaining handoff memory per working directory and git branch: records turns, folds them into concise Markdown, and injects the result into future sessions from ~/.agent/agent-handoff, byte-compatible with pi-handoff.
- [flymysql/dsh-memory](https://github.com/flymysql/dsh-memory) - Cross-session memory vault: remember / recall / forget tools, per-turn prompt injection, and a settings-page entry browser.

- [Frog755/dsh-hybrid-memory](https://github.com/Frog755/dsh-hybrid-memory) - Three-layer local memory for DeepSeek Harness: L1 snapshot memory (MEMORY.md/USER.md) read on demand through the memory_* tools + L2 searchable knowledge base (facts + SQLite FTS5, Chinese search via sliding-window tokenization) + L3 import from Hermes/Claude Code/Codex/WorkBuddy and from approved Agent Hub documents (memory/global, memory/projects, accepted decisions) with content-hash dedup. v0.2.0 removed every automatic injection: memory enters the context only when the model calls one of the 12 memory_* tools, and data stays on the local drive.
- [gezi-wen/sage-mem](https://github.com/gezi-wen/sage-mem) - File-based cross-session memory: plain Markdown memory files with automatic retrieval injection, format-compatible with Claude Code's CLAUDE.md and memory files, so migrating is a manual file copy.
- [GIN0076/cross-session-memory](https://github.com/GIN0076/cross-session-memory) - Cross-session lesson book (the agent wrong-answer notebook) for DeepSeek Harness: injects a memory index capped at 2 KB verbatim into every turn, adds mem_recall and mem_save model tools whose write gate demands four sections, a locatable reference and explicit human approval before anything reaches disk, registers the /memory command, and keeps every lesson as a zero-dependency Markdown entry in the .memory/ directory.
- [GIT121995/dsh-memory-gate](https://github.com/GIT121995/dsh-memory-gate) - Bounded local memory with CBDC authority gating: SQLite + FTS5 claims, scoped recall with explainable use/verify/ignore decisions and a full audit trail, /memory commands, ≤3-claim/1200-char injection per call, no extra model call.
- [giter00/dsh-headroom](https://github.com/giter00/dsh-headroom) - Automatic context compression for DeepSeek Harness: compresses tool outputs before they reach the model and keeps every lossy compression reversible via CCR retrieval tools.
- [GodCC6/dsh-claude-memory](https://github.com/GodCC6/dsh-claude-memory) - Read-only bridge that surfaces Claude Code's existing project memory in DSH — git-root-aware resolution, credential redaction before injection, and an on-demand recall tool. Zero runtime dependencies.
- [GreatArrow-ai/dsh-greatarrow](https://github.com/GreatArrow-ai/dsh-greatarrow) - Connects dsh to the GreatArrow.ai MCP server over Streamable HTTP, so the agent can search and save workspace memories, tasks and decisions shared with your other AI clients; a config-only bundle that reads the token from great-arrow.token in the dsh home, never from the environment.
- [greyoak111/siyuan-codex-bridge](https://github.com/greyoak111/siyuan-codex-bridge) - Connects DeepSeek Harness to a local SiYuan (思源笔记) desktop app: registers its note tools as mcp__siyuan__<tool>, exposes the AI configured in SiYuan together with its agent loop as one more tool, ships a notes skill, and enforces a readonly/authoring/full profile on every call while keeping the tool list available when the app is closed.
- [guo6x/dsh-palate](https://github.com/guo6x/dsh-palate) - An accumulated design-taste corpus for DSH agents: feed good and bad examples, distill principles, and review new designs against learned judgment rather than a fixed ruleset.
- [hellosky983/dsh-qrcode](https://github.com/hellosky983/dsh-qrcode) - Offline QR code (SVG/PNG/ASCII) and barcode (Code128/EAN-13) generator for DeepSeek Harness, no network and no shell.
- [hellosky983/dsh-skillradar](https://github.com/hellosky983/dsh-skillradar) - Scans the skills visible to the current session and ranks them by relevance to the recent conversation.
- [HERO476/dsh-instruction-memory](https://github.com/HERO476/dsh-instruction-memory) - Standing instructions edited in the DSH settings UI and injected into the system prompt of every subsequent turn.
- [highland0971/dsh-native-memory](https://github.com/highland0971/dsh-native-memory) - Native per-workspace memory on the harness's own seams: facts and a bounded always-on profile on the storage-domain JSON unit, approval-gated writes with `(sessionId, seq)` citations, deterministic recall plus session-query FTS over past sessions — no external server, no custom SQLite.
- [hmlyx/dsh-memory](https://github.com/hmlyx/dsh-memory) - Persistent conversation memory for DeepSeek Harness: memory tab, automatic AI naming, per-AI privacy isolation, sidebar AI names, and automatic experience archiving. A static profile plugin available in every preset without disappearing on restart.
- [hr98w/dsh-memory](https://github.com/hr98w/dsh-memory) - Claude Code-inspired Auto Memory meets Codex-inspired Session consolidation, bringing simple, transparent, and context-efficient long-term memory to DeepSeek Harness.
- [htcqp802/dsh-knowledge-base](https://github.com/htcqp802/dsh-knowledge-base) - General-purpose knowledge base for DSH: import md/txt/json/yml/docx/pdf, folder management, FTS5 full-text search (BM25), and a Web management UI.
- [Hua1Q1nG/dsh-hindsight-local-optimize](https://github.com/Hua1Q1nG/dsh-hindsight-local-optimize) - Local-memory lifecycle for the official Hindsight plugin on DSH desktop: one-click start/stop of the hindsight-embed daemon, auto-start on boot, stop on exit, hides the uv.exe console window, and installs the vault/models to another drive.
- [Hua1Q1nG/dsh-prompt-self](https://github.com/Hua1Q1nG/dsh-prompt-self) - Rewrites each request against a learned prompt profile and automatically updates habits, anti-hallucination rules, and learning records.
- [hzh5021/dsh-memory-watch](https://github.com/hzh5021/dsh-memory-watch) - Warns the session to flush what matters before context compaction kicks in, and rolls a long-term ledger into a frozen archive with a digest of title plus up to three lines per moved section. The roll-up stays off until home is set.
- [hzh5021/dsh-wakeup](https://github.com/hzh5021/dsh-wakeup) - Injects your home folder — identity, house rules, recent diary and ledger — into every new session before anyone speaks, and keeps that home writable so the agent can amend its own persona. Does nothing until the home folder exists (default dsh-home under the user home, or set home in the config).
- [i11ustriouS/dsh-mnemosyne](https://github.com/i11ustriouS/dsh-mnemosyne) - Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: each turn injects a persona frame plus a relevance-ranked memory index while full transcripts stay on disk and are expanded on demand, so the vault never floods the context window. Facts are slot-keyed, so a changed mind retires the old value instead of recalling two contradictory answers. The persona frame is derived from memory by the model itself, behind three anti-pollution gates (rejecting development chatter, blocking echoes of its own injection, and merging restatements by shared content words). Periodic consolidation merges near-duplicates, rolls long topics into digests, and archives low-value old entries by tagging only — raw text is never deleted. The append-only store is compacted in place (measured 4.7 MB to 355 KB). Zero third-party dependencies, no build step. Note: per-turn injection inevitably lowers prompt-cache hit rates, so this plugin is not recommended for work scenarios.
- [IAMLieutenant/dsh-tool-user-memory](https://github.com/IAMLieutenant/dsh-tool-user-memory) - Local Markdown user and project memory for DSH: pinned preferences, keyword search, soft invalidation, history and archive, and JSON migration with preview, backup and rollback.
- [ICCuse/dsh-file-memory](https://github.com/ICCuse/dsh-file-memory) - File-backed working memory: memorize/recall key premises verbatim in a session notes file so they survive context compaction losslessly.
- [ICCuse/dsh-knowledge](https://github.com/ICCuse/dsh-knowledge) - Bridge into a global Markdown knowledge base shared with the Codex kb.cmd CLI: kb_add/kb_search/kb_show/kb_timeline tools with byte-compatible frontmatter.
- [ICCuse/dsh-premise-guard](https://github.com/ICCuse/dsh-premise-guard) - Post-compaction premise-drift guard: injects a one-shot notice when a compaction summary drops a critical literal anchor.
- [icearia0219/dsh-memory-spaces](https://github.com/icearia0219/dsh-memory-spaces) - Human-governed cross-session memory spaces with independent source and consumer relationships, provenance, versioning, and pre-send injection review.
- [Icstick/dsh-adaptive-context](https://github.com/Icstick/dsh-adaptive-context) - Governed long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: append-only evidence ledger with write guards, 7-tier authority claims, supersede chains, and budgeted pre-step injection with per-domain quotas.
- [Icstick/dsh-inject-scheduler](https://github.com/Icstick/dsh-inject-scheduler) - Injection scheduler for DeepSeek Harness injection planes: cross-plugin sections register/order/account on the official storageDomain, with conflict detection and per-session budget summaries (B10 panel data source).
- [Ikalus1988/MisakaNet](https://github.com/Ikalus1988/MisakaNet) - Failure-recovery memory: search and record failure-recovery lessons from real engineering sessions, with BM25 + semantic RAG retrieval and a lessons knowledge base.
- [imaused/dsh-kb-lite](https://github.com/imaused/dsh-kb-lite) - Local knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: five tools to ingest Markdown, plain text and PDF files, search them with BM25 or hybrid BM25 plus optional local embeddings, and answer with cited source passages. Runs offline with no database server. Requires Node.js 18+ and Python 3.9+; PDF ingest needs pymupdf.
- [isheng-eqi/dsh-hermes-memory](https://github.com/isheng-eqi/dsh-hermes-memory) - Faithful port of the hermes-agent MEMORY.md / USER.md mechanism for DSH: bounded dual-bank memory (2200/1375 chars), a single `memory` tool (add/replace/remove/batch), frozen-snapshot injection per session, nudge reminders, DSH-native JSON storage — zero external dependencies, zero LLM cost.
- [IStarFoxI/dsh-memory-calendar](https://github.com/IStarFoxI/dsh-memory-calendar) - Local-first long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: text packages, on-demand recall, raw event citation, multiple brains and workspace boundaries.
- [itr-del/dsh-cue-bank](https://github.com/itr-del/dsh-cue-bank) - Cross-session event-cue memory for DeepSeek Harness: auto-extracts task/conversation cues and user language habits from every turn into a persistent global cue bank, then re-injects remembered context on topic-switch detection (keyword or vector matching).
- [iwtown/dsh-llm-wiki](https://github.com/iwtown/dsh-llm-wiki) - Karpathy LLM Wiki pattern knowledge base for DSH: wiki-write/wiki-search skills, zero-dependency pipeline (lint/index/mnemon memory sync/quality feedback), minimal lifecycle plugin injecting schema + knowledge preview, SiliconFlow semantic recall via an Ollama-compatible proxy.
- [Jackbessaliuz/dsh-memory-semantic](https://github.com/Jackbessaliuz/dsh-memory-semantic) - Read-only semantic retrieval for meow-memory: a local bge-m3 vector index over memory entries and conversation turns, a knowledge graph, and verbatim turn recall. Never writes back to the memory store; requires meow-memory.
- [jackyytche/dsh-hindsight-memory](https://github.com/jackyytche/dsh-hindsight-memory) - Hindsight long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: injects relevant memories before each turn and retains finished turns to a Hindsight bank. Requires DSH ^0.2.0-rc.1 (verified on 0.2.0-rc.2).
- [JayYuen666/dsh-lesson-loop](https://github.com/JayYuen666/dsh-lesson-loop) - Turns guard denials, gate failures and human thumb-downs into project lessons, and injects only the rules a human has armed into each new session of that project; it registers no model tools and is reviewed through its settings card.
- [Jesse-njx/dsh-memory](https://github.com/Jesse-njx/dsh-memory) - Cited memory over DSH's lossless session log: distilled facts carry `(sessionId, eventRange)` citations that expand back to the exact original log excerpt.
- [jiayan-xu/dsh-memoria](https://github.com/jiayan-xu/dsh-memoria) - Vector + graph memory backend: observe/remember/search/recall tools against a local memoria server, fusing HNSW semantic recall, FTS5 keyword search, and knowledge-graph signals via RRF ranking, with automatic turn-end persistence and per-agent namespace isolation.
- [jiayan-xu/dsh-memoria-extra](https://github.com/jiayan-xu/dsh-memoria-extra) - Advanced memoria tools: session context injection (profile + recall), recent decisions, health report, namespace allowlist, memory relation graph, and entity search; companion to dsh-memoria.
- [JiewiW/dsh-derive-watcher](https://github.com/JiewiW/dsh-derive-watcher) - Semantic context watcher for DSH agents: maintains a journey ledger with flash summarization and MinHash novelty detection, folds milestones, and can inject long-term context with a three-level stall response; injection and the stall-2/3 responses are off by default.
- [jinguanghai/deepseek-harness-forge-plugins#forge-memory](https://github.com/jinguanghai/deepseek-harness-forge-plugins/tree/main/plugins/forge-memory) - BM25 keyword-based memory recall.
- [JingxuanC/causal-memory#dsh-plugin](https://github.com/JingxuanC/causal-memory/tree/main/dsh-plugin) - Causal memory for dsh: a zero-dependency MCP stdio bridge that mounts the 17 tools of the causal-memory server under clean names (no mcp__ prefix) — decision → outcome edges with typed relations (caused / enabled / prevented) in a local SQLite store that survives compaction — plus a pinned system-prompt section. Requires the causal-memory server binary on PATH (pip install causal-memory, or a prebuilt release).
- [jisi71/dsh-memories](https://github.com/jisi71/dsh-memories) - Dual-ledger cross-session memory: auto-extracts lasting facts from conversations into MEMORY.md and maintains a PROGRESS.md project ledger, recalling both into every new session.
- [john-walks-slow/dsh-clear-mind](https://github.com/john-walks-slow/dsh-clear-mind) - Model-autonomous context compaction for DeepSeek Harness: a mind_map tool surveys the agent context surface (stable seq ids, roles, token weights, clear-boundary markers, the clear-mind playbook), a clear_mind tool replaces a chosen conversation-history span with a model-written checkpoint through the native compaction transaction, call and result pairs self-collapse into one-line tombstones, and a proactive reminder nudges the model when the context grows long or a turn runs too many steps.
- [JOJO-Adam/dsh-memory](https://github.com/JOJO-Adam/dsh-memory) - Three-layer memory for DeepSeek Harness — a small always-on core block plus on-demand topic files (profile, preferences, decisions, lessons), with source-annotated writes and supersede-not-overwrite history, so preferences and project constraints stop drifting between sessions. Local-first: no vector DB, no server, no outbound calls.
- [jojoman2024/dsh-memj](https://github.com/jojoman2024/dsh-memj) - A project-scoped memory plugin for DSH. Knowledge authoring and the plugin's own prompts are open to editing, so users can redesign the library structure and how the model is driven without changing a line of code. By default the library is built on one core idea: a project document you design yourself (a handoff by default) is the project entity; the plugin detects which project a session belongs to, binds captured knowledge to that project, and promotes what generalizes into theme and global layers. The most natural logic there is does the pre-filtering of knowledge, with controllable compression and archiving of context.
- [JunNanLYS/dsh-layered-memory](https://github.com/JunNanLYS/dsh-layered-memory) - Long-term memory for DSH: conversations auto-distilled into atomic facts, scene summaries and a persona profile, with relevant memories injected before every model step. Zero-config out of the box — hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval, optional offline local embeddings, chat/work family separation.
- [Kagurazaka135/dsh-memory](https://github.com/Kagurazaka135/dsh-memory) - Layered cross-session memory kept as plain YAML: facts carry a version history instead of being overwritten, a briefing is injected at session start, and a nightly pass consolidates and shards by topic past a threshold. Zero runtime dependencies, so it also runs inside the dsh Android app (verified there).
- [kiefeng/dsh-lan-memory](https://github.com/kiefeng/dsh-lan-memory) - Local-first memory and persona plugin for DeepSeek Harness: four file-backed memory layers (pinned, memory, facts, experience), editable SOUL/MOOD persona, zero-LLM session capture, BM25 recall and a themed mood card; no standalone web panel, Python service, vector database, or API key.
- [kipozannaki/DSH-Headroom-Plugin#plugin](https://github.com/kipozannaki/DSH-Headroom-Plugin/tree/main/plugin) - Runs the upstream Headroom compression toolkit (headroom-ai, Apache-2.0) inside DeepSeek Harness over MCP: headroom_compress, headroom_retrieve and headroom_stats are exposed as mcp__headroom__* tools backed by the upstream server, installed on demand by uvx. Compression is lossy but reversible — originals are fetched back by hash from a local CCR store. Also ships a registrar that adds DeepSeek Harness to Headroom's own MCP registry, and a model-header sanitizer for the upstream proxy.
- [kkwings/dsh-super-memory](https://github.com/kkwings/dsh-super-memory) - Cross-compaction memory for a long session: on compaction it stores what is being dropped, and at question time it injects a few relevant passages (or nothing) so the model can recall what you decided before.
- [KLRSL/dsh-biomemory](https://github.com/KLRSL/dsh-biomemory) - Biomimetic memory system for DeepSeek Harness: a single SQLite store (node:sqlite, WAL) whose Markdown tree is kept as a read-only mirror; memory tools, frozen-snapshot injection at session start, graded approval gating, on-demand extraction of the current session, near-duplicate merging, an archive and supersede lifecycle, memory metabolism (dream), memory pins, semantic recall over local embeddings, and the /memory command.
- [knighthongyu/dsh-handoff-compaction](https://github.com/knighthongyu/dsh-handoff-compaction) - Context compression for small-context models: visually configure the compressed context budget, default to an 8k handoff + 16k recent context, and keep full history searchable.
- [kobubu/Rag-Coding](https://github.com/kobubu/Rag-Coding) - Local code memory with automatic source context, symbol lookup, vector search, and dependency graphs for JavaScript and TypeScript projects.
- [KouzakiUmi/dsh-hindsight-gui](https://github.com/KouzakiUmi/dsh-hindsight-gui) - Adds a Hindsight configuration and status dashboard to the DSH sidebar for connection, model, embedding and bank settings, with health checks and ownership-checked local service controls; memory tools are provided by the separate official integration. Hindsight itself is a separate service and is not installed by this plugin.
- [krodon998/dsh-get-memory](https://github.com/krodon998/dsh-get-memory) - Pulls GitHub repo content into DSH conversations at start and writes extracted long-term memory back with SHA-locked multi-file commits at conversation end; per-file read/write permissions, native settings page, turn indicators and global change notices.
- [lanyun077/dsh-project](https://github.com/lanyun077/dsh-project) - Organize folders and sessions into projects with shared PROJECT.md memory and AGENTS.md instructions injected into every session, plus a project tree sidebar.
- [LAYZR114/dsh-project-memory](https://github.com/LAYZR114/dsh-project-memory) - Polaris Memory: local-first project memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Uses per-project .dsh-memory.json; provides memory_read/recall/write/update/delete tools, /memory command and settings UI, with tiered injection (resident user profile + scene-triggered memories with P1/P2/P3 importance), semantic recall (IDF + synonym layer), and a hard-guard mechanism for bottom-line memories (detect deny-semantics -> authorize -> block AI deletion; user can confirm-override).
- [lcthe/dsh-hermes-memory](https://github.com/lcthe/dsh-hermes-memory) - Scoped persistent memory for DSH: memory_save/search/replace/remove/list across global, user, project and failure scopes, DSH storage-domain persistence with secret and prompt-injection scanning, session-scope search, retention cleanup, and optional session-start injection; standing context via memory_pin/memory_pins/memory_unpin.
- [leetom314/dsh-tiered-memory](https://github.com/leetom314/dsh-tiered-memory) - Tiered persistent memory (user/env/project) with per-tier char budgets and semantic query routing; full layers refuse writes instead of silently evicting.
- [lemoncat7/dsh-knowledge](https://github.com/lemoncat7/dsh-knowledge) - Provides local and remote knowledge bases with project- and session-scoped recall, controlled write-back, and an embedded Web management console.
- [levodoubt/project-node-memory](https://github.com/levodoubt/project-node-memory) - Markdown-as-database project knowledge base for DSH agents: ten kb_* tools (including kb_register for registering existing notes), stable TIDs, `[[node]]` links that never copy text, `[[tscl]]` definitions expanded in place, bounded reads, structural lint covering tscl, workspace-first library discovery, inline git snapshots, a node-graph panel, and a bundled prompt section plus skill that make the agent reach for kb_* instead of hand-written docs/.
- [LFM097384/Context-Prism](https://github.com/LFM097384/Context-Prism) - Project-level Local Context Engine for DeepSeek Harness: retrieval/compression/prioritization over history, code, files, user preferences and agent trajectories, producing a dynamic context window for any LLM.
- [lgquan/dsh-workspace-memory](https://github.com/lgquan/dsh-workspace-memory) - Workspace-isolated durable memory for DSH, with searchable, auditable, correctable, and removable workspace memories plus controlled global memory.
- [liancha22/dsh-puzzle-mode](https://github.com/liancha22/dsh-puzzle-mode) - Keeps project decisions in plain markdown instead of chat history: one main document plus per-module documents, every entry carrying a file:line citation. The agent interviews you to turn open questions into settled decisions, and a five-dimension score (task complexity, extensibility, maintainability, code quality, reusability) is derived from the documents and shown on a button beside the model picker. A session can bind several projects; projects are sized small/medium/large, which widens the entry limits, and a reusable-pipeline section in the main document is injected when its trigger words appear.
- [liangxiaobing520/dsh-local-vector-memory](https://github.com/liangxiaobing520/dsh-local-vector-memory) - Fully local vector memory for DSH: local embeddings, SQLite storage, automatic recall injection, dedup with conflict detection, soft-delete recycle bin, online backup, and optional LLM extraction.
- [Libraqg/dsh-workspace-memory](https://github.com/Libraqg/dsh-workspace-memory) - Explicit, project-scoped memory handoff: when you open a new conversation, one model call that you confirm curates the project's earlier conversations into a bounded brief and injects it into the conversation's first step. No silent background calls; a Memory panel shows the brief and lets you edit notes.
- [lightporta/dsh-knowledge-center](https://github.com/lightporta/dsh-knowledge-center) - Local knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: distills workspace and chat-attached PDF, Word, Excel, Markdown, TXT, CSV and HTML documents into Markdown notes, with a VS Code-style viewer, per-workspace access grants and agent tools to search, read and add notes.
- [linner1224/dsh-video-coursemap](https://github.com/linner1224/dsh-video-coursemap) - Watches the foreground browser window, recognizes video courses, classifies them by subject, fetches Bilibili metadata/danmaku/comments, and generates Markdown + Mermaid knowledge maps and Word study manuals.
- [LittleBlackTong/dsh-plugin-memory](https://github.com/LittleBlackTong/dsh-plugin-memory) - Long-term cross-session markdown memory with an LLM-Wiki structure and a SOUL.md persona, injected at session start (by default only after the first user message and only in the active session), plus remember/recall/consolidate/forget workflows, an embedded memory skill, pack/unpack migration tooling, and an idle-time first-person recall nudge that surfaces real memories in a companion voice. Also gives the store observability and upkeep it lacked: a per-file boot-block budget that keeps the index routing table from being truncated, automatic last_access stamping so salience decay actually works, a read-only memory health dashboard (size, freshness, lint-parity checks), a declarative index compiler (pages declare summary:, one command re-lines the index), an interactive memory graph (page links plus shared tags, draggable, wheel zoom), structured queries (tag/type/salience/hot/stale filters), cross-link suggestions for pages that have no relationship yet, and a `checkup` report that ends in a prioritised action list. The boot payload was also cut by ~23% by moving operational detail into the on-demand skill. Its settings section now carries its own navigation mark (a brain half wired to a node cluster, since the shell offers no icon slot to plugins) and a feedback entry that opens this repository. Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): injected messages declare the producer-owned source kind plugin:memory.
- [liuyuhao1122/dsh-hermes-memory](https://github.com/liuyuhao1122/dsh-hermes-memory) - Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness with automatic model distillation, source-linked encrypted session logs, and guarded compaction.
- [ljsysfurryACE/dsh-compaction](https://github.com/ljsysfurryACE/dsh-compaction) - Compaction backend replacing LLM summarization with a deterministic semantic extractor (keeps code/paths/commands, drops chatter) plus 28.4x KV-compression accounting.
- [ljsysfurryACE/dsh-memory-director](https://github.com/ljsysfurryACE/dsh-memory-director) - LLM-driven remember/forget memory: after each turn a model decides what to keep (MemoryDirector), injects relevant memories before each step, dedups, and persists cross-session.
- [LornBerry/dsh-memory-center](https://github.com/LornBerry/dsh-memory-center) - Local long-term memory for DSH: browse, search (BM25 + synonyms) and edit entries in a panel; folders, archive and a recycle bin; choose per session what to inject; model-written memories need your approval; import/export backups; optionally sync across devices via your own Git or WebDAV.
- [LoserFox/distill](https://github.com/LoserFox/distill) - Automatic conversation distillation: background subagent reflection + skill create/update.
- [LoveDoLove/Veyra](https://github.com/LoveDoLove/Veyra) - Engineering intelligence for coding agents — persistent, evidence-aware, project-isolated engineering memory with unified hybrid search (memory + RAG documentation) for DeepSeek Harness.
- [lovezi0/dsh-memory-palace](https://github.com/lovezi0/dsh-memory-palace) - Human-readable Markdown memory for DeepSeek Harness: user-level (~/.deepseek-harness/MEMORY.md) + workspace-level memory injected every turn, auto daily-log writing with distillation, bridges existing WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy memory dirs, memory_note / memory_note_user / memory_read tools with built-in dedup, and a bilingual settings page. Plain-text storage, no database.
- [lpf20200901/dsh-memory-delta](https://github.com/lpf20200901/dsh-memory-delta) - Layered cross-session memory for DSH that pushes only what changed - the first round injects every active entry, later rounds push only added / updated / removed ones, and nothing at all is injected when nothing changed, with keys that merely repeat an entry id left out of the text so the baseline is about 26% smaller. Facts and decisions carry semantic keys (one active truth per key), the model may only write to an inbox that a human promotes, an entry can carry a review date that raises a one-time reminder when due, and search is relevance-ranked with journal lines down-weighted and Chinese matched by bigram. A sidebar tab tells the lifecycle story instead of listing files - entries are grouped by stage (awaiting confirmation / in use / archived) along four axes (topic - one level, human-assigned, type, tag, date), each group can be ticked for batch promote / withdraw / archive / restore / delete / assign topic, and topics can be renamed store-wide or searched on their own. The archived stage reads in three levels - the category says why an entry left (distilled into the docs / useless for good / not needed right now, the first two being defaults you can add to), below it the entry topic stays collapsed until you click it, and entries with no topic sit right under the category. The tab also shows the global and workspace instruction files plus the current injection size. A zero-dependency CLI ships with it, so the store is usable without DSH.
- [ltl0312/my-dsh-plugins#tlmemory](https://github.com/ltl0312/my-dsh-plugins/tree/main/packages/tlmemory) - Cross-session and cross-project long-term memory: a non-blocking silent sedimentation dispatch on turn/end writes into a local SQLite store (FTS5 trigram full-text index with insert/update/delete sync triggers) that later turns recall from; entries are scoped per project alongside a global tree, and the plugin ships its own embedded web dashboard (it starts the HTTP server itself, no separate process) for browsing, graphing and controlled deletion.
- [Luisarg03/dsh-memory-vault#memory-auto](https://github.com/Luisarg03/dsh-memory-vault/tree/main/packages/memory-auto) - Session-memory autopilot: watches DSH sessions and extracts OKF entries in-process through the harness LLM (ctx.llm, deepseek-official by default) at idle, commit, compaction and end checkpoints, storing them via the vault MCP server.
- [Luisarg03/dsh-memory-vault#memory-mcp](https://github.com/Luisarg03/dsh-memory-vault/tree/main/packages/memory-mcp) - Bridges the agent to a persistent OKF memory vault over MCP stdio: a Python server (SQLite FTS5 + Markdown) with 10 tools for searching and storing decisions, facts, learnings, conventions, profiles and sources.
- [luxiwusuobuneng/dsh-plugin-context-manager](https://github.com/luxiwusuobuneng/dsh-plugin-context-manager) - Context manager for DeepSeek Harness: auto-summarizes every turn into priority-sorted records, injects them plus pinned cross-session notes and custom text into each model request, and folds any-size real conversation ranges into summaries to save tokens. Persistent and restart-safe. NOTE: manual multi-step install — copy the three package folders into profiles/node_modules and add the provided cordis.patch.yml rows, then restart DSH; not a standard one-command install.
- [M1r0er/dsh-inkvault](https://github.com/M1r0er/dsh-inkvault) - Turns a local Markdown vault into two folders the user picks in Settings: a knowledge folder DSH writes notes into, and a memory folder used as the agent's long-term memory with per-turn recall and end-of-turn capture. Pure Markdown with frontmatter, BM25 search, reversible archive, and path isolation that rejects traversal, absolute paths and symlink escapes.
- [Ma354/dsh-limit-break](https://github.com/Ma354/dsh-limit-break) - Durable cross-session memory plus a fetch ladder that survives hostname-keyed blocking. Four tools: memory_recall, memory_save and memory_stats over a plain-JSON fact store at $DSH_HOME/memory/facts.json, plus resilient_fetch which tries plain fetch, then a same-service alias host (Wikipedia only for now), then curl over IPv6 and IPv4 (needs curl on PATH). No daemon, no npm dependency, no network at import time. (1.3.0 shipped a fifth tool, memory_prune; it was withdrawn in 1.4.0 because adding a tool to a running plugin breaks sessions that were opened before it.)
- [madage/dsh-self-improved](https://github.com/madage/dsh-self-improved) - Long-term memory & self-evolving plugin for DSH: L0 capture → L1 memory extraction → L2 scene grouping → L3 user persona, auto recall injection, skill synthesis, fully local (SQLite FTS5 + jieba, optional vector recall).
- [Marquez807/dsh-experience-memory](https://github.com/Marquez807/dsh-experience-memory) - Cross-session experience memory for DSH. Lessons are evidence-graded, injected when the turn is about the same thing, and shown just before an action only when the record declares which call it applies to. A rule that holds whatever the turn is about — "always answer in Chinese" — can be marked **standing** and is then carried every turn: measured on 24 isolated real-model turns, a standing rule is followed 6/6 against 0/18 for the controls (empty store, same record unmarked, unrelated standing record). A guess still cannot become always-on: a standing record needs a verified passage like any other. What nobody looks up is retired, reversibly. Five tools, seven slash commands, zero runtime dependencies.
- [Max-Null/dsh-memory](https://github.com/Max-Null/dsh-memory) - Cross-session plaintext memory: deterministic BM25 keyword recall (no embeddings), memory_save/list/search/confirm/forget tools behind a human-confirm gate, and global + project-scoped JSON stores that follow your git repo.
- [meisijiya/dsh-hindsight-memory](https://github.com/meisijiya/dsh-hindsight-memory) - Bridges DeepSeek Harness to a Hindsight memory service using the same conventions as omp: one shared bank, automatic project-tag stamping, project plus global recall, plus tools for mental models, duplicate detection and retrying failed background operations. Requires a running Hindsight server (default http://127.0.0.1:8888).
- [melandlabs/opencontext#dsh-opencontext](https://github.com/melandlabs/opencontext/tree/main/plugins/dsh-opencontext) - DeepSeek Harness integration for OpenContext with durable cross-session memory, automatic prompt capture and recall, session summaries, structured insights, and document retrieval.
- [memorax-ai/dsh-patchouli](https://github.com/memorax-ai/dsh-patchouli) - DeepSeek Harness memory and knowledge hub that routes update, retrieve, and subscribe calls across compatible plugins, with an optional transactional Rust backend.
- [memorylake-ai/memorylake-harness#dsh-plugin](https://github.com/memorylake-ai/memorylake-harness/tree/main/dsh-plugin) - Memory Lake as a persistent memory layer for dsh: memory_search, memory_remember, and memory_forget tools over the memorylake CLI, a session status line, and guided setup/diagnostic skills, sharing one ~/.memorylake identity and memory set with the Claude Code and Codex plugins.
- [MemTensor/MemOS#memos-local-plugin](https://github.com/MemTensor/MemOS/tree/main/apps/memos-local-plugin) - Local-first memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: layered L1/L2/L3 memory with automatic capture, manual memos_* retrieval tools, and a built-in memory viewer.
- [mengxiaoxian/lookover#dsh-expmem](https://github.com/mengxiaoxian/lookover/tree/main/dsh-expmem) - Personal-experience memory for DSH: turns solved tasks into sourced problem cases with condition-scoped claims, recalls them into new tasks via hidden pre-step injection, and makes corrections/deletes cascade to future recall.
- [menotbobbybrown/dsh-plugin-memory](https://github.com/menotbobbybrown/dsh-plugin-memory) - Persistent long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: a JSON store of typed entries (fact, preference, entity, rule, episodic) exposed as the memory_remember and memory_recall agent tools, with recall ranked by keyword overlap, importance and access frequency.
- [mess1103/dsh-inner-life](https://github.com/mess1103/dsh-inner-life) - A private diary for your agent: eight zero-dependency tools to write, amend, search and export daily entries kept on date-hashed paths the index never records (inner_find returns a day's path on request).
- [meyaomiao/dsh-graphmemory](https://github.com/meyaomiao/dsh-graphmemory) - DSH knowledge-graph memory with a better-sidebar tab and a standalone /graph-memory/app dashboard: extracts TASK/SKILL/EVENT nodes, recalls across sessions, and ships as the npm package dsh-graphmemory.
- [MiHjy12138/dsh-memory-lite](https://github.com/MiHjy12138/dsh-memory-lite) - On-demand memory for DeepSeek Harness: session logs are distilled into layered markdown (a summary, an index and per-topic files), and a mem_query tool returns only the matched entries rather than the whole index. - [mihomooo/dsh-persona-panel](https://github.com/mihomooo/dsh-persona-panel) - A memory panel for DeepSeek Harness with one store per workspace: persona traits, notes about you, dated events, and a first-person diary the model writes and cannot edit. Every entry keeps the quote it came from and can be retracted; workspaces can share one memory and be split apart again; optional per-person profiles for group chats; a capped event list with ★ marks. Local only, no network, zero dependencies.
- [minedalang/dsh-dafeiyu-life](https://github.com/minedalang/dsh-dafeiyu-life) - A persistent AI companion for DSH that explores Bilibili, interacts with permission controls, and grows through evidence-backed life memories, evolving interests, simulated emotions, social relationships, and autonomous to-dos.
- [MineRPi/dsh-trilium](https://github.com/MineRPi/dsh-trilium) - Connect Trilium notes to the DSH agent via ETAPI with 20 agent tools: durable memory (remember/recall + auto-injected index), note management (CRUD/clone/attributes/revisions), full-text search, weekly-report workflow, attachments, calendar notes, backup/import, and a settings card.
- [MingHuanYue/dsh-iter-memory](https://github.com/MingHuanYue/dsh-iter-memory) - Iter Memory: it remembers my own state, not the facts. A level that drifts back to baseline by itself, plus an occasional line I choose to say only when that level allows it. When it stays quiet, nothing is spent.
- [MingHuanYue/dsh-tide-memory](https://github.com/MingHuanYue/dsh-tide-memory) - Tide Memory: a long-term memory that forgets on purpose. It keeps what matters and lets the rest fade. Whether an entry enters the context is decided by an evidence score C = s/(s+2): below the threshold (0.35 by default) it never enters. Events decay by half-life (30 days, or 7 days when they carry emotion); facts never decay; superseded entries are kept and marked stale instead of deleted. Recalled lines do enter the context and therefore do consume tokens — small, but real. No embeddings, no network calls, no cloud.

- [nowledge-co/nowledge-mem-deepseek-harness](https://github.com/nowledge-co/nowledge-mem-deepseek-harness) - One memory layer for every AI tool and agent: Context Bundle injection, prompt-time recall, MCP tools, and turn-end DSH thread capture.
- [NoxTyrannus/dsh-cipher](https://github.com/NoxTyrannus/dsh-cipher) - Cipher memory platform as a DSH bundle: four memory types (attention, experience, preference, cognitive) sedimented per turn by four memory agents, cross-session deterministic recall injected via systemPrompt.context, insight review kept out of user-facing output, per-session UNNI/LOOP modes with memory-driven auto-continuation, memory search/ingest tools, plus a settings page (SOUL editor) and an AgentPool panel.
- [NyaaCaster/dsh-yuque-kb](https://github.com/NyaaCaster/dsh-yuque-kb) - Yuque knowledge base as external memory for dsh — auto-injects matching document fragments into conversation, with catalogue search, cloud full-text search and online reading.
- [OldManDing/dsh-ledger-watch](https://github.com/OldManDing/dsh-ledger-watch) - Session-level lesson-ledger watch for DeepSeek Harness: shows whether a session actually consulted the ledger and recorded the pitfalls it hit, keeps the rule base's health visible (rules needing rework, rules already revised), and can inject the most relevant rules into the step as a system-reminder (high-confidence mode, off by default).
