- [skepsun/dsh-engram](https://github.com/skepsun/dsh-engram) - Zero-LLM auto-capture and a symbolic \[ENGRAM\] index with progressive disclosure, an ESR-lite task/evidence protocol (esr_task / esr_node / esr_close / esr_link), and per-workspace usage telemetry with an offline recall benchmark (npm run eval).
- [slow-stack/mneme#dsh-mneme](https://github.com/slow-stack/mneme/tree/main/dsh-mneme) - The memory that dreams — cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: recalls you and your projects across sessions, consolidates memories while idle (autoDream), freezes conflicting memories for your review, and keeps a replayable audit trail. Memory stays on your machine as SQLite with human-editable Markdown mirrors; four-way recall (keyword, vector, BM25, entity graph) and an interactive memory panel ship with it, plus 10 model tools, an MCP server, an external API and a CLI. Summarization and consolidation run on the host model you already configured; with a local embedder, semantic search runs fully offline.
- [snakejohn/dsh-hindsight-local](https://github.com/snakejohn/dsh-hindsight-local) - Long-term memory for dsh via a local Hindsight service: each turn is retained with local timestamps and relevant memories (time-aware, reranked) are recalled into context before replies; each workspace binds to one memory bank, several workspaces can share a bank, and banks can have Chinese names; what gets retained is configurable (default: user messages and AI replies); history is imported only when you choose to; includes a three-step setup page with one-click local deployment (uv + Python 3.12), a sidebar status card and a panel to browse and search memories. Needs a SiliconFlow API key for the default embedding and reranker models; only Linux is verified so far.
- [SodaMem/dsh-plugin-sodamem](https://github.com/SodaMem/dsh-plugin-sodamem) - Bi-temporal memory backed by a SodaMem daemon: recall is contributed to the prompt while each turn is assembled and every closed turn is ingested, with no tool call and no model call on the read path; each recalled fact cites the turn it came from and carries validity dates, so superseded facts stop being retrieved.
- [SQHLnb666/mindsea](https://github.com/SQHLnb666/mindsea) - A long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Every turn is judged and stored into a local SQLite (utterance / event / version / stage / decision), with a browsable panel.
- [sqzw-x/dsh-notes-context](https://github.com/sqzw-x/dsh-notes-context) - Notes-backed context compression for DeepSeek Harness: replaces LLM-summarized compaction with a model-written persistent notebook plus recoverable raw history, so the rollover boundary itself costs zero model calls.
- [stas130286-blip/dsh-brainagent](https://github.com/stas130286-blip/dsh-brainagent) - Brain-inspired cognitive plugin: episodic, semantic, procedural and emotional memory with reinforcement-learning signals, a goal stack with time triggers, curiosity-driven autonomous web research and proactive initiatives.
- [suomir1995/dsh-notes](https://github.com/suomir1995/dsh-notes) - Keeps notes as local Markdown files grouped by directory under a root folder you choose, with a sidebar page, AGENTS-style rule files surfaced as writing context, and six agent tools.
- [super3ben/agent-feedback-loop#agent-feedback-loop-dsh](https://github.com/super3ben/agent-feedback-loop/tree/main/templates/dsh-plugin) - Feeds every dsh prompt into the local agent-feedback-loop feedback-memory pipeline — captures dissatisfaction, reviews it offline into reflections, and attaches the compiled recurrence-rule context back to the turn, never blocking a prompt. Requires the agent-feedback-loop runtime; running agent-feedback-loop install afterwards wires existing dsh profiles automatically.
- [Swd146296/dsh-memos-bridge](https://github.com/Swd146296/dsh-memos-bridge) - Bridges the MemOS memory service over MCP: the agent gets add/search/update/delete memory, multi-cube sharing, and a memory scheduler as mcp__memos__* tools.
- [sxwer001/dsh-context-control](https://github.com/sxwer001/dsh-context-control) - A context usage ring with configurable character-based automatic compaction, manual compaction, protected user requirements and recoverable original history for DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.
- [symmetryseeker/dsh-akn-plugin](https://github.com/symmetryseeker/dsh-akn-plugin) - Local-first Agent Experience Network for DeepSeek Harness, distilling task-level experiences from traces and live manifests, grading by H0-H4 evidence, discovering by compatibility, and promoting only after explicit review.
- [syyr1987/dsh-linghun-memory](https://github.com/syyr1987/dsh-linghun-memory) - A memory subsystem for DeepSeek Harness: full ontological memory (event/fact/rule three-ontology) plus a goal system (goal.js) — belief values written via Bridge trigger words, goal activation scored at read time (0.25 domain + 0.35 bridge + 0.40 sim) to recover goal/value long-range associations, journal ledger, episodic archive, low-confidence decay, memory_append/read/consolidate plus linghun_goal_update/get/state closed loop. Independent of the original dsh-linghun line. 16/16 on LoCoMo-Plus.
- [tabilet/tabilet-skills](https://github.com/tabilet/tabilet-skills) - Seven shared engineering skills, a read-only project dashboard with amendments, options, stages and SQLite audit browsing, and workflow request previews for DSH.
- [tancheng33/dsh-yogacara](https://github.com/tancheng33/dsh-yogacara) - Tracks the agent's state as Yogācāra mental factors over a durable seed store, and feeds it back into the prompt as first-person inclination.
- [Tangcuyu4/dsh-long-memory](https://github.com/Tangcuyu4/dsh-long-memory) - Cross-session long-term memory: a hybrid-retrieval memory store (BM25 plus CJK bigrams), chunked long-document search, chat-log extraction and distillation, and context-summary archiving and browsing, with important memories and the latest summaries auto-injected into the prompt.
- [text2future/flowix#dsh-flowix-memory](https://github.com/text2future/flowix/tree/main/dsh-flowix-memory) - Registers the local flowix-cli MCP server so the agent can search, read, create, and edit Flowix memos and mind-map artifacts.
- [timestatic/dsh-session-notebook](https://github.com/timestatic/dsh-session-notebook) - Notes taken from DeepSeek Harness conversations: quotes whole replies or selected passages, keeps highlights rendered at their original position in the session, attaches editable Markdown notes, tags them, filters by workspace or session, and exports Markdown or a full JSON backup stored as local JSON files.
- [tinqiao-oss/engramory#plugin](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/tree/master/adapters/dsh/plugin) - Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness kept as plain markdown, one fact per file, readable in any editor. The `MEMORY.md` index has a hard 200-line / 25 KB cap enforced by `ctx.tools.guard()`: a write that would grow an over-cap index is denied, while a rewrite that shrinks it always passes, so an oversized index can be compacted step by step. The plugin never writes memories on its own — what is kept is decided by you and the model. The same store is also used by Claude Code, Codex, Kiro and OpenClaw.
- [TodayJin/dsh-trilogy](https://github.com/TodayJin/dsh-trilogy) - Per-project memory for DeepSeek Harness. Three Markdown files per workspace — PROJECT.md, DECISIONS.md and SESSIONS.md — are auto-created on the first step of any session in that workspace, re-read from disk and re-injected only when they change (and re-injected if compaction dropped them), and written back by classification through a memory_checkpoint tool, with a bounded end-of-turn nudge when a turn did work but recorded nothing. memory_read and memory_search read the live log and the archive, the latter over a zero-dependency BM25 index. The session log is capped at 200 entries with the overflow moved to SESSIONS-archive.md — never injected, but visible, readable and searchable, and restorable one entry at a time. Settings page: a workspace list with a path filter, read-only tabs for the three memory files plus the archive, reload, export/import of one workspace's memory as a JSON bundle, a two-step clear, a panel that rewrites or removes the AGENTS.md instruction block, and a PROJECT.md staleness reminder. A composer status chip shows that workspace's sync state and creates the files on click. Zero dependencies — no vector store, no embeddings, and no model calls.
- [Tommy00748/dsh-self-evolution](https://github.com/Tommy00748/dsh-self-evolution) - Bounded self-managed long-term memory (Hermes-style MEMORY.md / USER.md with hard character limits and a safety scan), a review that runs after every turn and writes plain-language notes or refines an existing skill instead of adding a near-duplicate, a curator that finds and surgically repairs skills the loader would silently discard, cross-session search over past messages, and a learning card above the composer that appears only when there is news and asks before it deletes or rewords a memory.
- [topkie/dsh-lattice](https://github.com/topkie/dsh-lattice) - Local memory for DeepSeek Harness: what you write is filed under a topic and linked to related entries, recall ranks results by embedding similarity (word matching when no model is installed), and the data stays in a local SQLite database.
- [tr1v3r/dsh-ltm](https://github.com/tr1v3r/dsh-ltm) - Local SQLite long-term memory with CJK-aware search, BM25 and character n-gram cosine reranking, deduplication, and lifecycle management.
- [truelove-dreamer/dsh-plugin-recall](https://github.com/truelove-dreamer/dsh-plugin-recall) - Cross-session memory for the model: full-text search all past sessions (SQLite FTS5 via ctx.sessionQuery) and bring the strongest matching excerpts back into the current context.
- [TuringCorp-net/mosaic-memory-compress](https://github.com/TuringCorp-net/mosaic-memory-compress) - Forgetting-curve in-place dialogue compression for DeepSeek Harness: recent turns stay verbatim, middle turns are structurally dehydrated (zero-LLM), ancient turns fold into a bounded summary pair — unbounded conversations on a bounded memory budget.
- [Tyan66666/billion-context-dsh](https://github.com/Tyan66666/billion-context-dsh) - Model-driven context compression (Active Context Pruning) for DeepSeek Harness: the model decides when and what to compress.
- [tynr426/dsh-relationship](https://github.com/tynr426/dsh-relationship) - Local relationship-memory workbench with a confirmation gate: every AI write — extracted memories and newly created contacts alike — lands in a pending queue until the user confirms it in the GUI; materials are archived verbatim with quote-level provenance checks on AI extraction, and confirmed memories aggregate into per-contact timelines, gift occasions and reciprocity views. Ships a native relationship agent preset for conversation capture; JSON storage by default with an optional SQLite backend, zero production dependencies.
- [vectorize-io/hindsight#coding-agents](https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/tree/main/hindsight-integrations/coding-agents) - Hindsight, agent memory that learns: long-term project memory with auto recall and retain, knowledge pages, deep reflection, and per-repo memory banks.
- [Vesna-Strivozha/DSH-LLM-wiki-plugin#dsh-llm-wiki](https://github.com/Vesna-Strivozha/DSH-LLM-wiki-plugin/tree/main/packages/dsh-llm-wiki) - An Obsidian-style knowledge base: ingest sources, let the LLM build and maintain an interlinked wiki, and ask questions grounded in it.
- [vibe-any/dsh-plugin-save-token](https://github.com/vibe-any/dsh-plugin-save-token) - Reversible context slimming for DeepSeek Harness: TOON-style lossless tabular re-encoding of uniform JSON arrays, stride-sampled table windows with line numbers, and cross-turn dedup for repeated tool output; every replacement passes a byte-plus-token gate (≤72% bytes, strictly fewer estimated tokens) and the original is spilled to disk behind a `[save-token #id]` notice retrievable in one call via the `save_token_expand` tool, with billed and avoided token metering on a settings dashboard.
- [volcengine/OpenViking#examples/dsh-memory-plugin](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/tree/main/examples/dsh-memory-plugin) - OpenViking memory and context bundle for DeepSeek Harness: pre-step auto-recall and profile injection, session capture, `viking://` URI guarding, and recall/write memory tools backed by an OpenViking server.
- [vshulcz/deja-vu#extensions/dsh](https://github.com/vshulcz/deja-vu/tree/main/extensions/dsh) - Reads the session files forty-two other coding agents on this machine already wrote (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code Copilot Chat, opencode, OpenClaw, Hermes, Kimi, Cline, Zed and more), including sessions from before it was installed: six tools (deja_recall, deja_session, deja_blame, deja_fix, deja_how, deja_remember), a /deja command, and optional automatic recall added to the runtime context. Local BM25 index, no LLM, no embeddings, no network (dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-deja).
- [vv5v5/dsh-anima-rag](https://github.com/vv5v5/dsh-anima-rag) - Anima-style vector memory for DSH: injects retrieved historical summaries into the system prompt each turn, exposes an anima_query semantic-search tool, and isolates the vector store per playthrough. SiliconFlow embeddings sent as array-shaped requests; timeouts and provider errors surface as honest, classified notes in the injection slot — never silent.
- [vv5v5/dsh-memory-archive](https://github.com/vv5v5/dsh-memory-archive) - RP memory built on pmp tavern: RP history summaries ride the native compaction pipeline, with plain tool sessions kept out of the way. Full recall requires the downstream anima plugin. Requires the plugin-provided roleplay preset to be enabled.
- [w4xxx/dsh-xia-plugins#packages/gameassist-memory](https://github.com/w4xxx/dsh-xia-plugins/tree/main/packages/gameassist-memory) - Single-file persistent companion memory: interests, preferences, tasks, and past works summarized into the system prompt, with read/update tools.
- [wafernm-crypto/dsh-memory-library](https://github.com/wafernm-crypto/dsh-memory-library) - Per-workspace memory library with manual per-chat opt-in, editable rules, three sharing modes, and continuous forgetting; cards stay readable Markdown.
- [webkubor/dsh-mirror](https://github.com/webkubor/dsh-mirror) - Make the AI remember how you think, not what you said: actively captures your principles, redlines, and working habits across sessions — with memory capacity, graceful decay, and human-readable reasoning for every entry. 0.7.0 brings an intuitive persona portrait with evidence tracing.
- [weibaohui/context-razor](https://github.com/weibaohui/context-razor) - Context trimmer: lists the current session's context entries with role, preview and ≈token estimate (cl100k), highlights over-threshold items, and removes selected entries exactly without LLM summarization.
- [weibaohui/hermes-loop](https://github.com/weibaohui/hermes-loop) - Automatic session retrospective: after a conversation wraps up, distills useful experience into reusable skills stored in the skill library for the model to call, with signal-accelerated triggers, manual runs, an approval mode, and skill-library governance (archive/restore, never deletes directly).
- [weirwei/dsh-logseq](https://github.com/weirwei/dsh-logseq) - Syncs Logseq 2.0 DB graphs (including E2EE) with a Logseq sync server via the headless Logseq CLI, adds 11 logseq_* tools to search, query and edit them, and a Settings section to log in and configure sync.
- [whding110/dsh-dev-progress-memory](https://github.com/whding110/dsh-dev-progress-memory) - Per-turn development progress memory: completed turns are classified into date-indexed Markdown files under doc/progress/ with a maintained INDEX.md, system-level bugs are kept in a cross-project SYSTEM_MEMORY.md and re-injected on error keywords, and a progress_read tool loads full documents on demand.
- [Windsander/Mebular#packages/dsh-plugin](https://github.com/Windsander/Mebular/tree/main/packages/dsh-plugin) - Decentralized, offline-first graph memory and task graph for DSH, with signed facts, multi-device sync, and the shared Mebular Console embedded in a sidebar panel. Requires a running Mebular daemon (the Mebular desktop app, or mebular serve from @mebular/core); this plugin only attaches its memory tools and Console panel to it.
- [wojiao42/dsh-memory-file](https://github.com/wojiao42/dsh-memory-file) - File-backed memory: injects your own Markdown memory file at each session start, adds read/write tools with backup and undo, and reports DSH_HOME drift. Reads no conversations by default; an opt-in autoScan switch surfaces your own recent lines from local session logs. Never opens a network connection.
- [woshishadowhunter/dsh-seed-society](https://github.com/woshishadowhunter/dsh-seed-society) - Memory consolidation tuning for dsh-mneme (autoDream enabled, schema-max output budget, deepseek-chat route) plus the llm-deepseek reasoning-effort fix, an MCP bridge to the auditable seed-society agent runtime, and six yogacara seed skills.
- [WsTe47/mylife](https://github.com/WsTe47/mylife) - A local-first personal state record and decision engine for dsh: keeps every input byte-for-byte with line-level provenance, argues against its own conclusions by generating defeaters first, ages each stored fact with its own TTL, and reports where a decision rests on nothing at all.
- [WU079/dsh-memory-keeper](https://github.com/WU079/dsh-memory-keeper) - Cross-session memory for DSH: export every session to readable Markdown transcripts, keep one long-term MEMORY.md, and get a wake-up summary in a fresh window.
- [wu81313-lab/dsh-company-kb](https://github.com/wu81313-lab/dsh-company-kb) - Local-folder knowledge base for DSH: builds a SQLite FTS5 index over Office, text, PDF and scanned files, ships five tools (kb_search / kb_read / kb_list / kb_status / kb_session) plus a Web panel, and retrieves or syncs only when the user explicitly asks.
- [wuwen837/dsh-companion](https://github.com/wuwen837/dsh-companion) - Adds a Chat mode beside Work with a user-defined persona, long-term memory extracted after each turn and recalled by topic, and stickers it can save and send.
- [WYR-233/dsh-memory-lite](https://github.com/WYR-233/dsh-memory-lite) - Read-only enhancer for a file-based long-term memory library (markdown cards in git): a memory_find search tool, a small budgeted memory digest injected into the system prompt, and a settings page with library overview, health-check status and toggles.
- [xbzbing/dsh-openviking-manager](https://github.com/xbzbing/dsh-openviking-manager) - Configuration UI for the official OpenViking memory plugin: connection and user-key setup, local connection diagnostics, a per-session memory toggle in the composer, memory isolation that keeps recall inside the current topic, and recall tuning for score threshold, injected item count, query expansion and excluded URIs.
- [Xieddenv/dsh-memory-kit](https://github.com/Xieddenv/dsh-memory-kit) - Gives a DSH agent five layers of persistent memory kept as plain Markdown files — persona, speaking-style rules, daily diary, session archive and open loops — rebuilds a system-prompt section from them within a minute of a file change, and adds three tools (memory_read, memory_write, memory_search) plus an importer for migrating an existing memory directory.
- [XieZongChen/dsh-md-notes](https://github.com/XieZongChen/dsh-md-notes) - A markdown notes manager for DSH: full **MD notes manager** and **MD notes editor**, quickly capture conversations into notes, maintain notes by **syncing to Git repositories**, and **bring notes into the conversation context**.
- [xinchen03/minta#dsh-plugin](https://github.com/xinchen03/minta/tree/main/dsh-plugin) - DSH-native integration layer for the Minta memory engine: composes the official dsh-mcp-client row, registers the minta-memory-governance skill plus a session-start memory prewarm, and ships a Minta agent preset; requires the separately deployed Minta engine (Python/Docker) to provide the 19 MCP tools - not usable without it.
- [xingyueDanYang/dsh-puppet-memory](https://github.com/xingyueDanYang/dsh-puppet-memory) - Cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: a three-tier store (behavior notes, deep details, session archive) plus a 600-character core card injected every step, work/companion/learning state lines, multi-person and multi-group records with visibility partitions, session-scoped suppression or deletion of memory fragments, summaries and fact candidates that can route to a separate model, and backup plus self-check tools. Data is plain text under the home directory, and entries can carry images and audio stored by content hash.
- [XinzeQing/dsh-user-memory](https://github.com/XinzeQing/dsh-user-memory) - White-box memory in two parts: four user-authored long-term tiers (must-follow rules, behavior settings, user profile, optional rules) injected as one system-prompt section, plus a separate temporary working set (cross-session handoffs, stage goals, waiting items) with its own 1200-character budget that stops being injected once an entry is done. The long-term tiers are plain Markdown files the user can read and edit; the agent can only propose them, and nothing is written until the user accepts in the Chinese panel. Temporary entries are written only when the user explicitly asks, and live in <DSH_HOME>/temp-memory.json (created on first write), not in the memory directory. No auto-capture, no background writes, no network.
- [xiyunSacire/dsh-skill-manager](https://github.com/xiyunSacire/dsh-skill-manager) - View and delete persistent skill memory from the DSH sidebar.
- [Xplore-LAB/dsh-plugin-asmemory](https://github.com/Xplore-LAB/dsh-plugin-asmemory) - Action-state time memory: record typed states and actions, then analyze trends, anomalies, and causality.
- [xs1023/dsh-memory-vault](https://github.com/xs1023/dsh-memory-vault) - SQLite-backed long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: add, search, update and archive entries with categories and tags, automatic conversation logging, tiered compression, and a project dimension that scopes retrieval to the current workspace plus global facts.
- [xying-lm/dsh-memory-vault](https://github.com/xying-lm/dsh-memory-vault) - Disk-backed long-term memory for DSH: a SQLite FTS5 vault that captures every conversation turn, injects relevant past turns into new sessions within a per-turn character budget, groups sessions into resumable conversation files, and ships a web panel for search, paging and capacity.
- [dsh-long-term-memory](https://github.com/Yang-Yin734/dsh-long-term-memory) - Adds a long-term memory box to the DSH Settings page. The saved text is injected into the system prompt of every new session and is kept in the profile patch, so it can be edited again at any time.
- [yangdongzhen590/dsh-knj-obsidian](https://github.com/yangdongzhen590/dsh-knj-obsidian) - Built-in Obsidian-style knowledge base for DSH: agents distill conversations, documents and web sources into a structured .wiki graph, with retrieval, graph export, note editing, incremental builds and multi-vault management.
- [yangyizhu8/dsh-powercontext](https://github.com/yangyizhu8/dsh-powercontext) - PowerContext for DeepSeek Harness: WorkBuddy-style project memory and inspectable handoff workflows - bounded context recall before each model step, 19 pc_* tools for memory, handoff, experience and skills, with a Windows server watchdog for resident operation.
- [yangyongzhen/dsh-memory](https://github.com/yangyongzhen/dsh-memory) - Long-term memory injected at session start: preferences/facts/summaries/knowledge in global and per-project scopes, budgeted recall via `agent/pre-step`, durable JSON store.
- [Yansera/dsh-living-memoir](https://github.com/Yansera/dsh-living-memoir) - Cross-session memory kept as a short Markdown living document that is rewritten in full at the end of every turn, written to by model tools, the page, and automatic rewriting alike.
- [yffo/dsh-engramory-recall](https://github.com/yffo/dsh-engramory-recall) - Local BM25 auto-recall, a fail-closed write guard, a static doctor and a memory panel for an Engramory markdown store. No network, no daemon and no model calls unless you opt in; recall quality is measured by a reproducible benchmark in the repository.
- [yihefeikong-rgb/dsh-cc-haha-dream](https://github.com/yihefeikong-rgb/dsh-cc-haha-dream) - Background memory consolidation (auto dream) for DeepSeek Harness: periodically reviews recent sessions and existing memories to dedupe, refresh stale entries, remove contradictions and rebuild the MEMORY.md index, with hybrid/volume auto triggers, /dream command and a settings-panel config card.
- [yihefeikong-rgb/dsh-cc-haha-memory](https://github.com/yihefeikong-rgb/dsh-cc-haha-memory) - Persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness: memory read/write/retrieve tools, per-turn auto-recording, project-scoped recall injection and a management UI, with non-destructive Claude Code memory import.
- [Yiipu/dsh-agentmemory](https://github.com/Yiipu/dsh-agentmemory) - DSH ↔ agentmemory session-memory bridge: mirrors session lifecycle into a local agentmemory daemon (REST), exposes memory_recall / memory_remember tools, and injects a per-session memory context window via agent/pre-step.
- [Yixianqzm/deepseek-plastic-memory](https://github.com/Yixianqzm/deepseek-plastic-memory) - Partitioned long-term memory for agents, with folders as memory zones, a one-line index first, and a forgetting curve.
- [yiyunet/dsh-learn-skills](https://github.com/yiyunet/dsh-learn-skills) - DSH plugin: a four-entry learning flow in the session input bar — scaffold a preset, collect candidates, merge reviewed changes, and run a read-only workspace audit.
- [youchen-yc/dsh-heartprint](https://github.com/youchen-yc/dsh-heartprint) - AI persona, emotion and fading memory for DeepSeek Harness: layered compression keeps personality, emotion and turning-point nodes, painful feelings fade while the facts stay. One memory document is auto-delivered after three months and then monthly; long absences freeze the forgetting clock instead of mass-forgetting on return.
- [ys118/harnmem#dsh-harnmem](https://github.com/ys118/harnmem/tree/master/packages/dsh-harnmem) - Cross-harness agent memory for DSH: one plain-file store shared by the DSH and pi adapters and the harnmem CLI, so a memory written in one harness is available in another; injected as a byte-stable hot index, with five harnmem_* tools, session-end extraction, and a read-only memory browser panel.
- [yushenghai1106/dsh-memory-plugin](https://github.com/yushenghai1106/dsh-memory-plugin) - Persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness with curated facts, automatic turn retention, and graph- and vector-ranked recall.
- [Yuuyuko-uu/dsh-fish-memory](https://github.com/Yuuyuko-uu/dsh-fish-memory) - Per-session long-term memory that fades over time, recalls by evidence score and injects a few entries into the system prompt each turn.
- [yuyolin/dsh-decision-log](https://github.com/yuyolin/dsh-decision-log) - Decision log for DeepSeek Harness: record key decisions (chosen option + why) into a versionable DECISIONS.md via decision_log / decision_list / decision_audit tools, and auto-inject the summary into future sessions so decisions stay traceable and are never re-litigated.
- [Yvesgao/dsh-env-profile](https://github.com/Yvesgao/dsh-env-profile) - Global experience archive for DeepSeek Harness on Windows: probes local tools (with versions and PATH-first hits), convenient paths, network latency and disk speed; folds per-session stats from session/event; LLM-extracts durable facts; env_profile tool with remember; byte-stable summary injected every turn to speed up sessions and cut token use.
- [yzx4036/dsh-memory-snapshot](https://github.com/yzx4036/dsh-memory-snapshot) - Injects your existing markdown documents (notes, rules, knowledge-base files) into every dsh session's system prompt as read-only memory — list file or directory paths in `files`; no database, no service, no write path; UTF-8 byte-budgeted truncation with line-boundary fallback, total budget, YAML front-matter stripping, and freshness timestamps.
- [zhang66633/dsh-memvault](https://github.com/zhang66633/dsh-memvault) - Bridges DSH to a local MemVault store: core memory blocks injected into the system prompt, finished turns extracted through MemVault's own pipeline, and a panel to browse, trace, review and replay what was stored.
- [zhangj1164/dsh-mega-plugins#dsh-memo](https://github.com/zhangj1164/dsh-mega-plugins/tree/main/packages/memo/dsh-memo) - Week-keyed personal memo service: stores entries in ISO-week tables, resolves week/month/quarter/year navigation from one period calendar, archives quarters, runs AI analysis and Markdown report export, requires an explicit force flag to edit a past week, and turns one suite-wide telemetry failure analysis into a GitHub issue report.
- [zhangzhenwen1/qmd-autosearch](https://github.com/zhangzhenwen1/qmd-autosearch) - Auto-supplement QMD semantic search when the model greps/globs a knowledge-base directory: zero-dependency DSH plugin, async injection via next-step, no manual invocation.

Ten tools, no driver, no extra runtime.

- [1497105876/dsh-media-studio](https://github.com/1497105876/dsh-media-studio) - Generate images and videos directly in chat and deliver them to the conversation: generate_image / generate_video / send_media tools, a built-in Agnes free tier plus any OpenAI-compatible backend, background jobs that auto-push finished media, and inline gallery and video cards with download, lightbox, and native open.
- [19north/dsh-redstone-music](https://github.com/19north/dsh-redstone-music) - Minecraft redstone music: rm_render renders instrument samples from a SoundFont and aligns every onset to within 3 ms, and rm_build compiles a song plus lane table into a datapack of scheduled mcfunction shards (optionally deployed over RCON).
- [1byteone/dsh-plugin-nlbi](https://github.com/1byteone/dsh-plugin-nlbi) - Natural-language data queries + BI reports: Text2SQL, charts, report saving, schema/data grid panel, and a sidebar workbench — all behind DSH's MySQL connection layer.
- [1jiegejiayouxuewangan1/dsh-desktop-uia](https://github.com/1jiegejiayouxuewangan1/dsh-desktop-uia) - Windows desktop control through UI Automation: nine tools that read a window control tree and drive elements by id through their own UI Automation patterns, with every write gated by an approval policy, an append-only action log and a settings panel.
- [1na-ko/dsh-hdc-bridge](https://github.com/1na-ko/dsh-hdc-bridge) - HarmonyOS device bridge: hdc screenshot/install/log/crash/UI automation loop with read_image, official-first versioned API knowledge (SDK .d.ts + offline bundled docs), and a DevEco CLI build/sign/lint lane.
- [2026heshao/dsh-armory](https://github.com/2026heshao/dsh-armory) - Unified MCP, skill and expert management board for DeepSeek Harness: connection status, tool schemas, enable/disable and reconnect for MCP servers across global and per-project scopes, enable/disable of SKILL.md skills, attach/switch/detach WorkBuddy expert personas in any conversation at any time (429 experts) with no mid-session preset lock, a tool tailor that scans local session logs for per-tool call counts, error rates and context-token cost with one-click disabling, and three install markets (SkillHub 190k+ skills, WorkBuddy connectors, 47 verified built-in services).
- [2026heshao/dsh-obsidian-board](https://github.com/2026heshao/dsh-obsidian-board) - Turns a local Obsidian vault into a dedicated RAG chat panel: a sidebar page with the note browser, the retrieval-augmented chat and the cited source side by side, answering from fully local BM25 plus CJK-bigram retrieval over your notes and streaming through the DSH model channel, with clickable \[n] citations and mtime-based incremental indexing.
- [2048lr/dsh-feishu](https://github.com/2048lr/dsh-feishu) - Creates and edits Feishu and Lark cloud content through ten tools - Bitable databases and their records, documents with Markdown converted to native blocks, spreadsheets, wikis, drive files and messages - plus Base V3 dashboard charts and server-side aggregate queries.
- [2286893544/feishu-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/2286893544/feishu-dsh-plugin) - Feishu (Lark) integration for DeepSeek Harness: 25 tools for chat messages and history, cloud documents (including knowledge-base pages, generated charts and images), bitable records, spreadsheet ranges and drive permissions, using your own enterprise self-built Feishu app.

Windows only, Python 3.11+; the pinned upstream servers install themselves on first load, and only the sides whose CAD application is registered get a row. Each server advertises two meta-tools instead of its full catalog (a discovery shim here for SolidWorks, upstream DISCOVERY_MODE=search for AutoCAD), taking the schemas loaded before the first request from 23,404 to 256 tokens and from 83,732 to 365 respectively.
- [379385796-sys/dsh-environment-packer](https://github.com/379385796-sys/dsh-environment-packer) - Create verified local cold-backup ZIPs of a Windows DSH Profile and selected home data after DSH exits; restore only to a fresh target with a matching runtime, without certified cross-machine recovery.
- [3ChatAI-NCT/3chatai-deepseek-harness-plugin](https://github.com/3ChatAI-NCT/3chatai-deepseek-harness-plugin) - Connect DeepSeek Harness to 3Chat via OAuth for customer and conversation search, context retrieval, confirmed messaging, and batch-send tracking.
- [439436269-ctrl/dsh-search](https://github.com/439436269-ctrl/dsh-search) - Web search, page fetch and one-call research through DeepSeek's official Search and Fetch API; needs a DeepSeek API key.
- [439436269-ctrl/dsh-zspace](https://github.com/439436269-ctrl/dsh-zspace) - Turns a ZSpace (极空间) NAS into native agent tools: list, stat, search, read, download, upload, write, create folders, rename, move, copy and delete files on the NAS. Works across networks through the desktop client relay — no LAN, no WebDAV, no SSH — and switches to the faster direct WebDAV transport automatically when the NAS is on the same network. Deletes require an explicit confirm: true; write, upload, create-folder, rename, move and copy run directly, and zspace_write overwrites a same-named file unless overwrite is false.
- [4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope) - Release gate for AI answer quality. Two channels: replay an existing VeriScope archive through the original Python quality gate, or run a threshold gate over a Ragas per-row export with Node only — no VeriScope, Python or pandas. Returns PASS, FAIL or REVIEW with source evidence and a re-checkable receipt; supports per-row thresholds and exact decimal comparison. It never re-evaluates and never calls a model, and REVIEW never becomes PASS.

Ships four always-on tools (mcd_status, mcd_test, mcd_tools, mcd_call) for self-checks and direct fallback calls, plus a settings page with a one-click connection test. The token is stored only on this machine in ~/.dsh/dsh-mcd-mcp.json (mode 600); it never enters the repository or the conversation context.
- [58catmiao/dsh-sciwork](https://github.com/58catmiao/dsh-sciwork) - A research library panel and skill set for DSH: project folders, figures with registered provenance, drafts, references, data tables, journal profiles and submissions, plus writing, citation and Origin-plotting discipline for research agents.

- [AAAlenwow/dsh-weknora-archive](https://github.com/AAAlenwow/dsh-weknora-archive) - Archive DeepSeek Harness sessions into a self-hosted WeKnora knowledge base with extraction, summarization and incremental dedup.
- [aba3345/dsh-bili-see](https://github.com/aba3345/dsh-bili-see) - Bilibili autopilot run by a local Ollama model: it picks videos within per-topic quota, reads subtitles, hot comments and keyframes, decides whether a reply is warranted, then writes and posts one comment through a five-level safety gate. Triggered by dsh-schedule; write tools are not registered while commenting is disabled. v1.1 hardens the write path: revoking write access is a runtime state checked before every send, publishing is atomic, risk-control errors persist as a pause, and the final post re-checks persona style. Needs Python 3.10+ with the repo's requirements.txt installed.
- [AbcdefgXW/dsh-toolbox-web](https://github.com/AbcdefgXW/dsh-toolbox-web) - Toolbox plugin for the Web UI: session/trash/subdirectory/search/preset/config management, tag grouping, long-message collapse, and a scheduled heartbeat with optional IM channel push.
- [AbnerAI/dsh-monitor](https://github.com/AbnerAI/dsh-monitor) - Persistent background watchers that wake the agent on new messages (file inbox or command-output delta) — the harness analog of Claude Code's Monitor tool.
- [acebang0303/dsh-quick-launch](https://github.com/acebang0303/dsh-quick-launch) - One-click create, update or remove the DeepSeek Harness desktop shortcut with switchable custom icons and a draggable whale button.
- [activeing123/dsh-mcptoon](https://github.com/activeing123/dsh-mcptoon) - Mounts the mcptoon MCP gateway as one stdio server, so the agent discovers the tools of every MCP server you have configured through mcptoon's compressed view instead of full JSON schemas on each turn. Ships a doctor CLI that checks the mcptoon executable resolves and prints the exact command/args override when it does not.
- [acttk/dsh-bili-interactor](https://github.com/acttk/dsh-bili-interactor) - Browses Bilibili on your behalf and actually takes part: search videos, like, coin, send danmaku, post comments, reply to other people, and keep replying when someone answers back. Reads the video's Bilibili AI subtitle (or transcribes the audio locally when there is none) so its comments talk about what the video really says, and it reads that same content before choosing whom to reply to. Instead of copying other people's sentences, it distills rules about how to sound like a person and gets less AI-ish the more it runs. Skips videos it already browsed, de-duplicates replies per thread, and after too many rounds with the same person in one comment section it reviews whether the exchange has any substance -- if it looks like two bots complimenting each other, it says one last line and stops replying to that person there. Checks whether each comment is genuinely public or only visible to your own account, can scan any time window (last hour / day / 3 days / all) and lists the ones others cannot see, warning you on the overview when replies got folded. Six-tab settings panel where every change takes effect immediately with no restart, a manual run that queues behind the background listener instead of being refused, and an environment self-check that tells you exactly what to install. Requires Python 3 for the Bilibili actions; the built-in check lists any missing packages.
- [AdenXie/dsh-vercel](https://github.com/AdenXie/dsh-vercel) - Connects DeepSeek Harness to the official Vercel MCP server over OAuth, with per-Agent on-demand tool loading, slimmed tool schemas, paged long results and 34 bundled Vercel skills.
- [adithyanraj03/dsh-graft-plugin](https://github.com/adithyanraj03/dsh-graft-plugin) - Shows which graft index a dsh session is serving and whether it still matches the code, and gives the model graft_ask, graft_grep, graft_callers, graft_skeleton and graft_map as native tools.
- [adwhispr/dsh-plugin-adwhispr](https://github.com/adwhispr/dsh-plugin-adwhispr) - Connects DeepSeek Harness to the AdWhispr remote MCP server through mcp-remote with browser OAuth sign-in, adding tools for competitor ad research, ad creative cloning, and launching and managing Meta, Google and TikTok campaigns. Requires an AdWhispr account.
- [agentmail-to/dsh-agentmail](https://github.com/agentmail-to/dsh-agentmail) - Gives an agent its own email inbox through AgentMail — eleven tools for sending, reading and labelling mail, plus inbound mail delivered into one harness session per email thread, with an approval gate and recipient allowlist on everything outbound.
- [ai-tools-mtl/Aurify#bundle-patent](https://github.com/ai-tools-mtl/Aurify/tree/main/packages/bundle-patent) - Patent-writing gatekeeper for dsh - screens the idea against Chinese prior art first, then runs five-party alignment interviews, eight-chapter disclosure drafting, figures and simulation runs, seven-dimension review and docx/PDF export. Skills work out of the box; the search, export and experiment tools come from a bundled Python MCP service that ships disabled - one line in ~/.dsh/patent-services.yaml enables it, and uvx fetches the wheel from PyPI.
- [AIcivilization/dsh-tingdong](https://github.com/AIcivilization/dsh-tingdong) - Turn English audiobooks (MP3) and documents into listening lessons: transcribe every sentence locally with the speech model DSH voice input already downloaded (about 241 MB, fetched on first use if missing; ffmpeg required), proofread and explain each sentence with your DSH model, then drill with blind listening, intensive listening and spaced repetition, with Chinese-dubbing export and offline Kokoro voices; ships a sidebar panel and four AI tools.
- [Aik358/dsh-ark9canvas](https://github.com/Aik358/dsh-ark9canvas) - Image generation workbench and agent tool for DSH: one tool (ark9_generate_image) paints text-to-image and image-to-image via any OpenAI-compatible API. Channels are entirely user-configured - no bundled endpoint, you bring your own baseURL, key and model name (manual input supported). Agent-initiated generations are approval-gated by default: requests queue in the floating panel and nothing bills until you approve; approval is non-blocking (the agent replies "awaiting your approval" immediately, and results, denials or timeouts are injected back so the agent reports them in the next turn). Floating glass workbench with five tabs (Generate / Approvals / Prompts / History / About), aspect-ratio grid with quality-budget + 16px-alignment sizing, transparent background, batch up to 10 images as aggregated sub-tasks, prompt library with custom JSON sources fetched through a host proxy, persistent generation logs with one-click retry, multi-channel aggregation with per-channel model fetching, bilingual UI (zh/en), stroke-SVG icon set, config import/export. Registers as a Better Sidebar tab when dsh-better-sidebar is installed; stacks above the dsh-cua FAB when both are present.
- [Aik358/dsh-cua-pre](https://github.com/Aik358/dsh-cua-pre) - Windows desktop automation for DeepSeek Harness: accessibility-first observe/act loop with 30 standard tools (element/coordinate targets, auto/a11y/event strategy routing), superseded-observations and no-replay safety semantics, persistent kill switch, RuntimeId/rect-drift stale protection, chat cards and a floating panel (live ops, frame wall, env auto-detect settings), tiled vision describe for low-res models, JSONL audit trail and a pid allowlist. Requires Windows 10+ and Python 3.9+ with uiautomation and pillow (installable from the settings page).
- [Aik358/dsh-literature](https://github.com/Aik358/dsh-literature) - Self-contained literature library for DSH with optional Zotero export: full-text PDF fetching (Unpaywall/arXiv/custom URL templates), loose Crossref-backed search, APA/GB-T 7714/MLA/Chicago citation generation, a side-panel PDF reader with highlights and notes, and AI-assisted Q&A/translation steered into the current conversation.
- [Airisey/dsh-model-failover](https://github.com/Airisey/dsh-model-failover) - Model failover router that queues all connected DSH models, retries with continue text on failure, switches to next model, and quarantines failing models for the day.
- [aix-plugin/ai-courses#package](https://github.com/aix-plugin/ai-courses/tree/main/package) - Turns a learning request and local materials into a structured, locally stored AI course with outline, lessons, diagrams and learning progress.
- [aiyacharley/dsh-pubmed](https://github.com/aiyacharley/dsh-pubmed) - Literature research toolset registering 26 model tools over PubMed, Europe PMC, OpenAlex, PubTator3 and Semantic Scholar: field-syntax search, ID conversion, bibliographic lookup, citation formatting, MeSH and related-article walking, PubTator bioconcept resolution and relation queries, Europe PMC and Semantic Scholar paging, full-text retrieval, and open-access PDF discovery with optional download. A unified search deduplicates hits across sources and orders results by cross-source hits, then relevance, then citation count; a session knowledge graph with PubTator concept enrichment commits to a persistent user graph and renders as Mermaid. Most sources need no key.

- [chiang21fcb/cn-linebreak](https://github.com/chiang21fcb/cn-linebreak) - Static HTML auditor for Chinese line-breaking: checks explicit-`<br>` orphan lines, keep-all CSS coverage, CJK line-start/line-end punctuation rules, and protected-phrase splits, then inserts <wbr> at natural breakpoints; exposes a cn_linebreak_audit tool for agents.

- [ciky20171114/dsh-plugin-midscene](https://github.com/ciky20171114/dsh-plugin-midscene) - AI UI automation via Midscene — android_ui and web_ui tools that tap, type, query, and assert on a real Android device or an already-running Chrome through the ctx.midscene seam.
- [Cjrrrrrrrr/dsh-plugins#dsh-hiddify](https://github.com/Cjrrrrrrrr/dsh-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-hiddify) - Drives a local Hiddify installation from DeepSeek Harness without its GUI: seven tools to start and stop the core, switch split-tunnel modes (rebuilds the config and restarts the core), rotate exit nodes through the Clash control plane, and search or fetch pages through the proxy. Windows only.
- [Cjrrrrrrrr/dsh-plugins#dsh-scholar](https://github.com/Cjrrrrrrrr/dsh-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-scholar) - Literature search tools for DeepSeek Harness: four model-facing tools — paper_search, paper_get, paper_citations and book_search — over OpenAlex, arXiv, Crossref, Semantic Scholar and PubMed, with open-access PDF resolution through Unpaywall.
- [ClaireXi99/dsh-data-insight](https://github.com/ClaireXi99/dsh-data-insight) - Data analysis toolkit: CSV/TSV/JSON profiling, IQR and z-score anomaly detection, structured summarization with quality issues, and code-free filter/group/aggregate queries.
- [cndn/dsh-d1](https://github.com/cndn/dsh-d1) - Cloudflare D1 tools for agents: d1_list/query/exec/schema/stats/health over the D1 HTTP API, read-only by default with a SQLite-accurate lexical guard, LIMIT row cap, CSV/JSON query output and an approval-gated write path.
- [cny919191/dsh-123pan](https://github.com/cny919191/dsh-123pan) - 123 Cloud Drive (123pan) client: signs in with a phone number or email plus password, or a pasted token, browses and drag-drop uploads and downloads through a sidebar panel, backs up a workspace incrementally while keeping its directory tree, and exposes 15 tools for an agent to list, upload, download, rename, move and delete files. Network, MD5, 16MB multipart upload and token encryption run in a bundled statically linked C++ core, so it needs no Python or other runtime. Windows 10/11 x64 only.
- [CodeIntegrity/dsh-semble](https://github.com/CodeIntegrity/dsh-semble) - Semantic code search for DeepSeek Harness: registers two native tools, semble_search (find code by describing its behaviour, returning ranked file:line hits) and semble_find_related (neighbours of a known location), which run the Semble CLI via uvx, plus one bundled routing skill. Requires uv on PATH; the first query on a repository builds its index.
- [codingayice/dsh-interview](https://github.com/codingayice/dsh-interview) - AI interview practice for DeepSeek Harness Web: generates questions across four modes (concept review, mock interview, scenario, LeetCode Hot 100), scores answers, and provides explanations.
- [cogito0823/dsh-motion](https://github.com/cogito0823/dsh-motion) - Code-generated math and science animation for DSH: six tools cover environment checks and dependency self-repair, Manim/manimgx scene rendering to storyboard frames or MP4, contact-sheet probing of finished clips for black or overexposed frames, and formula identity checks with SymPy, together with three skills (topic routing, design spec, QA rubric), a project scaffold with timeline and narration, requirement approvals before rendering, and five animation styles.
- [coolbreezecoin/dsh-wechat-mp](https://github.com/coolbreezecoin/dsh-wechat-mp) - Turns markdown into a WeChat Official Account (微信公众号) draft: inlines every CSS rule onto its element because the editor discards `<style>` blocks and class names, uploads each local image through WeChat's own endpoint so it is not filtered out, and creates the draft; it never broadcasts.

- [copylee711/dsh-computer-use](https://github.com/copylee711/dsh-computer-use) - Computer use for Windows: screenshot, mouse, keyboard, clipboard and window tools with per-app access that goes through DSH approval; while the agent is in control the screen shows an orange glow and a status bar, and Esc pauses or resumes.

- [curtainsmall/dsh-reckoner](https://github.com/curtainsmall/dsh-reckoner) - A deterministic calculation engine for DeepSeek Harness, including a preset that guides the LLM to calculate through the engine rather than by text generation.
- [czcdr/dsh-plugin-rea](https://github.com/czcdr/dsh-plugin-rea) - Third-party adapter that registers the upstream REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) MCP server into DeepSeek Harness as mcp__rea__* tools. 2.x provisions its own runtime (Node, the REA CLI, a JDK, Ghidra) under <DSH_HOME>/plugins/rea-bundle and launches REA through a shim, so a machine with nothing pre-installed works after one setup run; 1.x (branch v1, npm 1.0.6) is configuration-only and expects REA and Ghidra to be installed already. - [CZX2244/dsh-bilibili](https://github.com/CZX2244/dsh-bilibili) - Bilibili video analysis: metadata, transcript (ASR fallback via Bijian/sherpa-onnx/whisper.cpp), comments, danmaku, and sharp keyframes with optional local vision descriptions.
- [daimingxing/dsh-codegraph-project](https://github.com/daimingxing/dsh-codegraph-project) - Connects an existing local CodeGraph CLI to each session's indexed project, shares one MCP process per project, and updates session-scoped tools when the working directory or index changes.
- [DamonKoy/dsh-plugins#dsh-mcp-client-v2](https://github.com/DamonKoy/dsh-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-mcp-client-v2) - Enhanced MCP client: paginated tool discovery, non-blocking startup, mcp_tool_search, hand-rolled stdio/streamable-http transports.
- [danieldu168/dsh-stash](https://github.com/danieldu168/dsh-stash) - Registers external databases and document corpora as callable model tools: a per-source access boundary, a credential reference ledger that never stores values, and a fetch ledger that keeps fingerprints and content hashes instead of payloads.
- [Deanyu148/dsh-balance-inquiry](https://github.com/Deanyu148/dsh-balance-inquiry) - Balance dashboard, allowing the addition of multiple pay-as-you-go/Token plans, while simultaneously checking balances.

- [dff652/deepseek-harness-community-plugins#dsh-ai-asset-hub](https://github.com/dff652/deepseek-harness-community-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-ai-asset-hub) - Connects DeepSeek Harness to a deployment-owned AI Asset Hub MCP server and exposes eight reviewed read-only asset tools.
- [dfycaly98931680/dsh-trajectory-governance](https://github.com/dfycaly98931680/dsh-trajectory-governance) - Agent trajectory governance and anomaly diagnosis: rebuilds flat session logs into multi-branch trajectory trees, detects loop deadlock, invalid retry, and goal drift, alerts with cost attribution, one-click interrupt and breakpoint fork via official APIs, independent GUI tab.
- [dhicoc/dsh-codex-web-search-mcp](https://github.com/dhicoc/dsh-codex-web-search-mcp) - Registers codex-web-search-mcp as native DSH MCP tools (mcp__codex-web-search__codex_web_search / codex_web_research / web_fetch) for model-independent Codex and Grok web search and deep research.
- [ding112/MoneyPal#dsh-moneypal](https://github.com/ding112/MoneyPal/tree/main/packages/dsh-moneypal) - Personal finance plugin for DSH with structured Beancount ledger tools.
- [dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-adaptive](https://github.com/dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-adaptive) - Version-adaptive tooling for DeepSeek Harness: it reads the running DSH version from the plugin manager, mirrors app-boot plugin-compatibility rules (engines.dsh first, then @deepseek-ai/dsh* peers, prerelease-inclusive comparison, exact-version exemptions) to score every installed plugin, and statically flags source still using APIs renamed or deprecated between v0.1.6 and v0.2.1. Ships a conversation-view panel, an agent tool and HTTP state/scan/report routes. Read-only, offline.
- [dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-cost-ledger](https://github.com/dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-cost-ledger) - Auditable token-cost ledger for DeepSeek Harness: wraps the llm/stream waterfall and records every call with provider, model, input/output/cache-hit/cache-write tokens, usage source and integer nano-CNY cost from an explicit price table. Aggregates by hour, day and session; exports JSON or CSV with a no-write dry-run preview; keeps a manually entered official platform bill in a parallel column with actual-minus-estimate diff. Unknown provider/model routes stay explicitly unpriced. Zero runtime dependencies; no balance query, notifications or animations.
- [dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-delivery-receipt](https://github.com/dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-delivery-receipt) - A delivery receipt panel for a project hand-off. One trigger collects the branch and commit, the test and build results, screenshot dimensions with sha256, and the secret-scan verdict, then assigns every line to one of three zones by evidence alone — verified, local-only, or unverified. A claim in the unverified zone keeps its label and prints an explicitly empty slot instead of the claim itself, because a confidently worded sentence with nothing behind it is the exact thing the receipt exists to catch. Test failures and secret-scan hits are still evidence, so they land in the verified zone with a red tone rather than being quietly dropped.
- [dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-mp-catalog-guard](https://github.com/dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-mp-catalog-guard) - Content-catalog guard for WeChat mini-programs: validates catalog.json so every activity price is an integer amountFen, every template renders prices through money(), required fields / duplicate copy / image paths are checked, and the result is an issue list plus a unified diff that can be applied with patch -p1. 29 rules over five groups (catalog shape, required fields and uniqueness, amounts, rendering, images). Three fixes are automatic (legacy yuan amount, string Fen, absolute image path) and preserve the file's own indent, EOL and trailing newline; everything else is reported with a hint instead of being guessed. Dry-run by default; apply re-checks the written file so the report describes what remains. One implementation serves a tool, a conversation panel and a CLI with exit codes 0/1/2. Zero runtime dependencies, no model call, no network.
- [dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-ship-receipt](https://github.com/dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-ship-receipt) - A shareable delivery receipt for a project hand-off. The `ship_receipt` tool measures what it can and records what it was told, then sorts every line into three zones: verified (evidence this run produced and that reproduces elsewhere — a command that actually ran with its exit code, a file hash for a file that is under version control, a scan that found files, a git ref present in the recorded remote), local-only (true on this machine alone — uncommitted changes, unpushed commits, an artifact no one else can see), and unverified (no evidence, including every sentence a human typed). A claim with no evidence keeps its label and leaves the body blank rather than printing the claim; declares the commit and branch, artifact byte sizes and sha256 with PNG dimensions, and the three pre-push checks.
- [dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-tab-complete](https://github.com/dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-tab-complete) - The composer predicts what you are about to type. Inline ghost text sits on the caret, measured against the editor's own font and line box, and Tab turns it into real text (Esc ignores it). The prediction is one short call through the session's own model router, seeded with your draft and the last few turns of the conversation, so an empty composer also gets a next-prompt guess written in the user's voice; suggestions that merely restate the assistant are dropped. Host side is one HTTP route with sub-path endpoints (loopback-only, 64 KB body cap, 2-minute result cache, 20-second miss cache, one in-flight call per session); client side is one 0-height overlay registered on conversation.input.overlay, with insertion guarded by the composer's draftRev CAS and a setDraft fallback. IME composition and slash commands are skipped. 16 node:test cases, zero runtime dependencies, real screenshots in docs/.
- [disantosmyha-cloud/tempguard#dsh-plugin-tempguard](https://github.com/disantosmyha-cloud/tempguard/tree/main/dsh-plugin-tempguard) - Two DeepSeek Harness tools for the local tempguard watchdog: read temperatures and alertd health, and send alerts through alertd; it does not start or stop the watchdog. Needs the separate tempguard Python watchdog and its alertd service running locally, with projectDir and alertdToken set in the profile patch; there is no npm package, so install from a local clone of the repository subfolder.

- [Dobo233/dsh-codex-pilot](https://github.com/Dobo233/dsh-codex-pilot) - Runs the local Codex CLI from DSH as four tools (codex_run, codex_resume, codex_queue, codex_probe), and ships a standalone loopback bridge with an HTTP API and a file mailbox.
- [docsor1212/dsh-aesthete-agent](https://github.com/docsor1212/dsh-aesthete-agent) - Frontend aesthetics engine as 17 native tools — a 118-palette evidence library matched by register, cross-register whole-page design directions, four mechanical gates (WCAG contrast, color-blind simulation, AI-slop detection, scorecard) with digest-bound verdicts, plus semantic design tokens, existing-page audit, CVD-checked chart palettes, CJK type scale, render-vs-tokens reconciliation and measured-numbers rationale. Fully local, zero network. Requires Python 3.8+.
- [Dongze502/dsh-session-to-doc](https://github.com/Dongze502/dsh-session-to-doc) - Reorganizes a DeepSeek Harness session transcript into a structured Markdown document with an outline and a table of contents instead of exporting the chat in chronological order. Exposed three ways: a model tool session_to_doc, a composer button, and a loopback-only Web endpoint.
- [donyue7/dsh-aoci-bind](https://github.com/donyue7/dsh-aoci-bind) - AOCI binding toolkit for DSH hosts: discover workspaces that have an AOCI index, diagnose and repair their MCP bindings, initialize unbound repos, and expose status and doctor tools.
- [drscrewdriver/dsh-bash-terminal-ts](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-bash-terminal-ts) - Shell tool with four Windows backends (PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL / MSYS2) plus an interactive PTY terminal; the MSYS2 backend starts bash.exe with -lc so /etc/profile puts /usr/bin and /mingw64/bin on PATH, and injects MSYSTEM=MINGW64 into the PTY environment. - [drscrewdriver/dsh-patch-edit-plus](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-patch-edit-plus) - Patch-style file editing: one apply_patch tool accepting git/unified diff (default) and Codex apply_patch syntax (opt-in), applying every change all-or-nothing after a full read-only verification pass, with sandbox-aware delete and move and a dry-run mode.
- [drshy-org/lightroom-py](https://github.com/drshy-org/lightroom-py) - Adobe Lightroom Classic as native dsh tools through the lightroom-py MCP server: read the catalog, apply develop settings and presets, export JPEG/TIFF/PSD/DNG, and write ratings, labels, keywords and IPTC — 15 tools driving the Lightroom Classic installed on the local machine, no cloud round-trip; the Python package is on PyPI and the Lightroom plugin installs with one command.
- [dsh-plugin-lab/dsh-ds-balance](https://github.com/dsh-plugin-lab/dsh-ds-balance) - Shows the DeepSeek account balance at the bottom of the sidebar, with a configuration card on the Plugins page.
- [dsh-plugin-lab/dsh-zhihu-search](https://github.com/dsh-plugin-lab/dsh-zhihu-search) - Three Zhihu tools for DSH — in-site search, Zhihu's global web index with domain and date filters, and Zhida answers — with a native settings card and source-cited results.
- [dsh-plugins/dsh-auxiliary](https://github.com/dsh-plugins/dsh-auxiliary) - Dedicated model routes, tools, and system guidance for vision, compaction, reviews, subagents, titles, and image generation.

- [duhu2000/dsh-form-fill-agent#dsh-form-fill-agent](https://github.com/duhu2000/dsh-form-fill-agent/tree/main/packages/dsh-form-fill-agent) - AI form filling and spreadsheet autofill for XLSX in DeepSeek Harness, using authorized Qichacha MCP facts with cell previews, user confirmation and export to a new copy.
- [duhu2000/dsh-mcp-connector](https://github.com/duhu2000/dsh-mcp-connector) - MCP Connector for DeepSeek Harness: an MCP manager with one panel to connect servers, configure authorization, search tools across connections, and troubleshoot failures. - [duhu2000/qcc-mcp-legal-oauth](https://github.com/duhu2000/qcc-mcp-legal-oauth) - One-click OAuth (PKCE) connect to Qichacha (qcc.com) legal-data MCP services — regulation search and case search — with dynamic client registration, token auto-refresh, and dynamic mcp-client configuration.
- [duhu2000/qcc-mcp-oauth](https://github.com/duhu2000/qcc-mcp-oauth) - One-click OAuth (PKCE) connect to Qichacha (qcc.com) MCP services in DeepSeek Harness: dynamic client registration, token auto-refresh, and dynamic mcp-client configuration.
- [Duoasa/DSH-to-Figma](https://github.com/Duoasa/DSH-to-Figma) - Read, create and edit Figma designs through natural language in DSH, including batch layer edits, components, variables, screenshots and asset exports. Local mode does not use the official Figma MCP call quota.
- [dxxCaO/wincu](https://github.com/dxxCaO/wincu) - Windows computer use for DeepSeek Harness: a persistent PowerShell UIA backend behind 16 merged MCP entries (read/click/type/observe/verify), a hardened policy layer (red lines, approvals, observation binding, point-ownership and focus guards) and a performance pass (prewarm, caching, pixel-hash stability probe). - [DYF-zs/dsh-qboson-ising-solver](https://github.com/DYF-zs/dsh-qboson-ising-solver) - DeepSeek Harness plugin that exposes QBoson Kaiwu Ising solving as an agent-callable solve_ising tool.

- [eghrhegpe/dsh-connect-atomcode](https://github.com/eghrhegpe/dsh-connect-atomcode) - Use the free AtomGit quota already signed in on this machine to have AtomCode run an independent code review: the model calls the atomcode_ask tool on its own, and you can also use the /atomcode-review command to review uncommitted changes, a branch or a PR in one click. - [Eileenes/dsh-reel](https://github.com/Eileenes/dsh-reel) - A working Remotion prototype that turns a DSH plugin repository into a 16:9 promo video and a 3:4 promo image locally; its DSH bundle is scaffolded but has not yet been loaded into a real DSH profile. Requires Node.js 22+ and Chrome or Chromium for rendering.
- [Electricitysheep/dsh-tool-turbo](https://github.com/Electricitysheep/dsh-tool-turbo) - Per-round reasoning_effort optimizer for dsh — auto-downgrades reasoning for simple tool calls and lifts back for heavy work, cutting thinking time between tool calls.
- [Emilia-awa/hermes-dsh-bridge](https://github.com/Emilia-awa/hermes-dsh-bridge) - Embedded MCP server letting external agents (Hermes, Claude Code, etc.) drive DeepSeek Harness over StreamableHTTP: sync/async task execution, a three-tier file sandbox, a Web-backed approval bridge, session management and search, and path-jailed file tools.

- [everclear077/dsh-progressive-tools](https://github.com/everclear077/dsh-progressive-tools) - Cache-stable progressive tool discovery: a fixed tool_search and tool_dispatch surface on every request, in-memory catalog search, nested dispatch through the Harness pipeline, and a byte-stable native tool list across discovery.
- [exoticknight/dsh-system1](https://github.com/exoticknight/dsh-system1) - Connects TypeSafe/Jev, Cloudflare/Clef, Nace/Drex, self-hosted Laya, and custom decision providers through one interface for agent and plugin classification, filtering, scoring, and image-object localization with structured results.

- [Fantasality/dsh-origin-plugin](https://github.com/Fantasality/dsh-origin-plugin) - Drive OriginLab Origin scientific plotting from AI chat via MCP: 62 tools. - [feng-yifan/dsh-plugins#dsh-enter-plan-mode](https://github.com/feng-yifan/dsh-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-enter-plan-mode) - Enter-plan-mode tool: gives the model a callable `dsh_enter_plan_mode_enter_plan_mode` that switches the current session into plan mode, pairing with the built-in `exit_plan_mode` for a plan-then-review loop.
- [fire-disposal/dsh-mojibake-interceptor](https://github.com/fire-disposal/dsh-mojibake-interceptor) - Mojibake guard bundle for DSH: feature-based garbled-text detection before writes with review-then-release (an identical retry passes), plus pre-execution pwsh encoding audit (ANSI/GBK/UTF-16/Default), Windows and Chinese first.

- [Flan246/dsh-lit-search](https://github.com/Flan246/dsh-lit-search) - Academic literature search and citation tools for DeepSeek Harness: paper search via Crossref and OpenAlex with no API key, related-works discovery, and citation formatting in GB/T 7714, APA and BibTeX.

- [FNOSP/fnos-dsh#dsh-failover-search-plugin](https://github.com/FNOSP/fnos-dsh/tree/main/plugins/dsh-failover-search-plugin) - Multi-source web search and fetch failover for DeepSeek Harness sessions: takes over the session searchProvider and fetchProvider seams and tries configured sources in a chosen order — TinyFish, Tavily and the official search as a fallback that always participates and can be repositioned but not removed. Multiple API keys per platform are spread round-robin, usage snapshots drive pre-flight exclusion of exhausted accounts, and per-request timeouts plus same-platform retry control failover granularity. Web fetching runs local HTTP first, then falls back to TinyFish Fetch server-side rendering and Tavily Extract, so pages still load when local egress is blocked by proxy or DNS policies. A per-platform panel shows key usage and plan limits. Install from npm with `dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-failover-search`.

A `/v1/midscene-env` endpoint generates the four MIDSCENE_MODEL_* environment lines with the model family inferred, and seven built-in skills — browser, desktop, Android, iOS and HarmonyOS automation plus a Vitest E2E skill and a Midscene knowledge reference — appear in the session skill catalog without `npx skills add`. Install from npm with `dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-midscene`.

- [guhanfei-ai/dsh-grafana](https://github.com/guhanfei-ai/dsh-grafana) - Conversational Grafana operations: inspect live dashboard data across named sources, then make safe, reviewable dashboard changes with approval and version checks.
- [guomi6450/dsh-folder-timemachine](https://github.com/guomi6450/dsh-folder-timemachine) - Folder time machine for DeepSeek Harness: snapshot any folder, browse its timeline, roll back with one click — Git-like history without needing Git, for folders that never had a repo (game saves, app config dirs, loose documents). Snapshots are content-addressed and deduplicated, and unchanged files are not re-hashed. Automatic snapshots come in two modes: realtime (fs.watch — one version ~8s after the last change, so a save-all or a build counts once) and timed (checks every N minutes, stores only when something actually changed; identical content never adds an empty version). Empty folders are recorded and recreated on restore. Every restore takes a safety snapshot first, so a rollback is itself undoable, and exact-mode cleanup only removes files and empty folders — a non-empty folder is never deleted. Ships a folder_timemachine model tool (status/history/diff need no approval; writes ask first) plus a floating panel with the timeline, one-click restore and mode switching. Pure JS, zero runtime dependencies, 110 tests included.
