- [HildebrandYu/dsh-open-with](https://github.com/HildebrandYu/dsh-open-with) - Gives DSH its own per-extension "open with" map: delivery cards, the sidebar preview and change review launch the app you pick, while macOS keeps its own default for Finder double-click. Rules are edited in a Settings tab and stored in ~/.dsh/open-with.json; "show file location" still reveals in Finder.
- [Hongcheng-LI/dsh-zotero](https://github.com/Hongcheng-LI/dsh-zotero) - Zotero library tools via the local API (no API key, Zotero 7+): search items and collections, read metadata, abstracts and PDF full text (on-the-fly parsing when the cache misses), download attachments, and manage notes; API endpoint, target library and limits are configurable.
- [HorusJiang/dsh-jev-tools](https://github.com/HorusJiang/dsh-jev-tools) - DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns Jev judgments into three automatic actions — pruning oversized tool output to the segments relevant to the request, screening fetched pages for instructions aimed at the model, and picking which skill fits the next step — plus the jev_ask and jev_gate tools, a judgment ledger that survives restarts, and a /jev-status report. Needs a TypeSafe API key; without one it is inert and sends nothing.
- [HorusJiang/dsh-map-tools](https://github.com/HorusJiang/dsh-map-tools) - Map and routing tools: driving/transit/walking/bicycling route planning, geocoding and POI search via free OSM/OSRM data by default, with an optional Amap (高德) key for better China coverage.
- [hotheat/dsh-claude-codex-mode](https://github.com/hotheat/dsh-claude-codex-mode) - Keeps discussion read-only and hands every repository code edit to the Codex CLI through a bundled MCP server; switches between the DSH model and the Claude Code CLI in the plugin form, with preflight checks and a write guard that blocks structured edits to repo files.
- [howpy/dragonfly_chatbot](https://github.com/howpy/dragonfly_chatbot) - Built for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 (engines.dsh pins it exactly). Technical support for Dragonfly 3D World using 2027.1 help documents and read-only searches of a detected local installation, with an explicit help-only fallback.
- [hoyyang/dsh-android-pane](https://github.com/hoyyang/dsh-android-pane) - Live Android device pane next to your DSH conversation: scrcpy-server H.264 streaming (WebCodecs, 30-60 fps), agent tap/swipe/text with auto-screenshot verification, uiautomator element tree with tap coordinates, host-managed recording + logcat debug sessions. FLAG_SECURE pages are detected automatically with a mitigation chain and a tappable text-view fallback. Emulators and USB real phones, human+agent co-operation, session-isolated, loopback-only.
- [hualuo520-h/dsh-proteus-bridge](https://github.com/hualuo520-h/dsh-proteus-bridge) - Drives Proteus 8/9 interactive simulation from the agent through eleven proteus_* tools: connect, simulation start/stop/status, probe readings, a project save that checks the file hash and mtime actually changed, and layout suggestions computed locally; on machines that register the Labcenter.InteractiveSimulation COM server it also places devices from a whitelist and queries and connects pins, while without COM it falls back to a keyboard-driven UI transport covering the simulation lifecycle and saving. Requires Windows with a local Proteus 8/9 installation.
- [Huang-zhishi/dsh-plugin-call-trace](https://github.com/Huang-zhishi/dsh-plugin-call-trace) - Persistent model tool-call trace recorder: every tool call is durably written to a JSONL file that survives restarts, queryable via a structured call_trace tool and a callTraceHistory service, with size rotation and an optional floating canvas UI add-on.
- [huangfuren/dsh-localsend](https://github.com/huangfuren/dsh-localsend) - Send files or folders over the local network via the LocalSend v2 protocol, or generate a temporary browser download link that the receiver opens with no software installed.
- [HUANGjiale123-bit/dsh-desktop-control#dsh-desktop-control](https://github.com/HUANGjiale123-bit/dsh-desktop-control/tree/main/plugin) - Windows desktop observation and control: accessibility tree, screenshots, OCR fallback, mouse and keyboard, with session-scoped approvals and an ESC halt gate. Computer use and desktop automation for DSH, including GUI automation fallbacks.
- [huaxiren6/DSH-EmailReader](https://github.com/huaxiren6/DSH-EmailReader) - OAuth2-capable IMAP email reader for accounts where password authentication is disabled. Microsoft disabled Basic Auth for personal Outlook IMAP in 2024, so this plugin authenticates via refresh-token OAuth2 (XOAUTH2) with automatic token refresh, plus app-password login for Gmail through an optional local HTTP/SOCKS proxy. Registers list/read/search as ol_email_* so it can coexist with the market dsh-email plugin without tool-name clashes.
- [huaxiren6/DSH-SmsWebhook](https://github.com/huaxiren6/DSH-SmsWebhook) - SMS forwarding webhook for DeepSeek Harness. Phone apps (SMS Forwarder, Tasker, or any HTTP POST) push messages to a local HTTP endpoint; the plugin stores them as JSONL and exposes sms_recent / sms_search tools so the agent can read SMS verification codes during tasks. Auto-extracts the first 4-8 digit OTP from each message, supports keyword filtering, and works over LAN or Tailscale.
- [hui-xu-ai/wensu#dsh-wensu](https://github.com/hui-xu-ai/wensu/tree/main/packages/dsh-wensu) - Read-only CNKI bibliographic search for DSH: four MCP tools (search, detail, export, status) drive your own Edge/Chrome through a native-messaging bridge, with no PDF downloads, a 3-second minimum interval and a 300-action daily cap. Requires pip install wensu plus wensu setup and loading the browser extension before the four tools appear.
- [HwFee/HwFee-dsh#git-bash](https://github.com/HwFee/HwFee-dsh/tree/master/plugins/git-bash) - Git Bash as the default shell on Windows. Resolves bash.exe from git --exec-path (never the WSL stub), exposes a run_shell tool, and degrades visibly instead of disappearing when Git Bash is missing.
- [hxlog/dsh-mcp-tools](https://github.com/hxlog/dsh-mcp-tools) - MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness settings: add streamable-http or stdio servers, paste Postman-style headers, test connectivity, and toggle each tool so disabled ones never reach the model.
- [hyzyn/dsh-plugin-kit#codegraph](https://github.com/hyzyn/dsh-plugin-kit/tree/main/packages/codegraph) - Code-graph integration for the DSH Web GUI: a "Codegraph" card in Settings → Plugins with index status, symbol search, callers / callees / impact views, and one-click sync / index; hosts the codegraph MCP server and injects a CodeGraph usage guideline into the system prompt. Requires the codegraph CLI.
- [hyzyn/dsh-plugin-kit#docker](https://github.com/hyzyn/dsh-plugin-kit/tree/main/packages/docker) - Docker container panel for the DSH Web GUI: containers (optionally including stopped), docker inspect details, logs, stats snapshots, image list and one-shot exec on the local machine or SSH hosts — read-only by default (mutations and exec are permission-gated), with a per-container terminal drawer embedded via the tty plugin.
- [hyzyn/dsh-plugin-kit#loglens](https://github.com/hyzyn/dsh-plugin-kit/tree/main/packages/loglens) - Log query card for the DSH Web GUI over Elasticsearch / OpenSearch: one query surface with per-dialect query strings and clickable examples, field-name completion, filter chips, a time histogram whose bars zoom into that window, field facets that turn a bucket into a filter, and a result list with level colors, stack-continuation rows, columns and paging; Docker container logs are a collection source that reuses the docker plugin. Ships five read-only loglens_* tools (sources / search / fields / facets / context) sharing the same execution layer as the panel. Outbound requests only reach configured sources, judged on the resolved IP, without following redirects and with size and timeout caps.
- [hyzyn/dsh-plugin-kit#mcp](https://github.com/hyzyn/dsh-plugin-kit/tree/main/packages/mcp) - MCP server configuration card for the DSH Web GUI: add / edit / enable / disable MCP servers over stdio (local subprocess) or streamable-http (remote), with js: prefixed expressions for env / header values, status badges, and hot-reload on save.
- [hyzyn/dsh-plugin-kit#rss](https://github.com/hyzyn/dsh-plugin-kit/tree/main/packages/rss) - Daily RSS/Atom news digest for DSH: built-in channels plus a curated awesome-rsshub-routes catalog and custom feeds (validated on save), aggregated into one "今日值得读" Markdown digest each day and injected into the system prompt; Web GUI settings card and sidebar reader.
- [Hzlin7/dsh-database-preview](https://github.com/Hzlin7/dsh-database-preview) - Read-only preview of SQLite files and MySQL / MariaDB / PostgreSQL / SQL Server connections in the right sidebar, with tables, paged rows, columns, indexes and draggable column widths, never writing to the database.
- [ikta2010/dsh-loop-breaker](https://github.com/ikta2010/dsh-loop-breaker) - Hard stop for runaway turns: blocks repeated identical tool calls and ends the turn when per-turn step or time budgets are exceeded.
- [ikta2010/dsh-tool-error-hints](https://github.com/ikta2010/dsh-tool-error-hints) - Appends actionable hints to failed tool results, such as the nearest existing directory when a path does not exist.
- [ilps2/dsh-video-understand](https://github.com/ilps2/dsh-video-understand) - Low-cost video understanding tool: a video_understand tool turns a Bilibili link / BV / local video into an AVIS info layer (ASR + scene structure + object tracks + YOLO labels) and returns summary + Q&A. Question-driven dynamic routing across layers (L0 ASR / L1 object tracks / L2 key-frame VLM), semantic-layer reuse for repeat questions, per-question budget cap. Python engine: core layer needs faster-whisper / opencv / yt-dlp (~200-300MB); the optional semantic layer adds ~2GB of torch / transformers / ultralytics. A bundled doctor --fix sets up the venv and installs both.
- [imaused/dsh-mcp-bridge](https://github.com/imaused/dsh-mcp-bridge) - Exposes a stdio MCP server as native DeepSeek Harness tools. Ships with the official Microsoft Playwright MCP preset, so the agent browses through the Edge or Chrome you already have open, with your logins intact; any other stdio MCP command can be configured instead. Host-only, no client bundle, no npm dependencies. To drive your own browser, start Edge/Chrome with remote debugging and allow npx to fetch @playwright/mcp.
- [imMamdouhaboammar/dsh-codex-subscription](https://github.com/imMamdouhaboammar/dsh-codex-subscription) - Use ChatGPT and Codex subscriptions in DeepSeek Harness with OAuth, quota runway forecast, safe resets, web search, image generation, and Fast mode.
- [Imzl-zl/dsh-toolbox-ui](https://github.com/Imzl-zl/dsh-toolbox-ui) - Floating panel for the DSH web UI managing MCP servers and skills: per-server deferred tool loading (ToolSearch, off by default) keeps a server's tools out of every turn's context — the prompt lists tool names only, and a tool's full schema enters the list once the model finds it with the built-in tool_search, so a turn stops paying for schemas it never calls. MCP servers live in a global scope or a project's own .dsh/mcp.json, with per-server enable/disable, a 47-service market and import from ten other clients; skills are auto-discovered across their real scopes with shadowing, and model auto-invocation versus manual-only is a switch per skill.
- [infileap/Inimerse#tools/dsh-inimerse](https://github.com/infileap/Inimerse/tree/main/tools/dsh-inimerse) - Five tools that build, test and run the Inimerse engine, and drive its Verse layers over the server's line protocol. Needs a local Inimerse checkout built with CMake; point the bundle's repoRoot at it (the shipped default is the author's path).
- [initial-d/dsh-plugin-mlquant-benchmark](https://github.com/initial-d/dsh-plugin-mlquant-benchmark) - DSH tools for reproducing and validating the ml-quant-trading protocol v1 CPU benchmark, then drafting an issue-ready report. Requires a local clone of initial-d/ml-quant-trading (set as the workspace or repoPath) plus Python and PyTorch; this plugin does not fetch the repository or install its dependencies.
- [insideyou-0501/dsh-mech-workbench](https://github.com/insideyou-0501/dsh-mech-workbench) - A workbench for engineering and math problems, with nine tools for reading images, solving, plotting and verifying answers, plus four bundled skills. Needs Python with numpy and Pillow. Image reading, figure checking and formula typesetting rely on a vision provider you have configured a key for, so those images are sent to it, and without a key they fail while the other tools still work.
- [Instant-KING/dsh-ai-library](https://github.com/Instant-KING/dsh-ai-library) - Local library panel for DSH: indexes files and artifacts into a searchable card tree with PDF, Office and image preview, plus paper search across arXiv/OpenAlex/Crossref and others, web-page archiving to markdown snapshots, a plugin-market tab, and one-click switching for resources found in installed plugins (personas, meme packs, whale widget assets). Ships 18 tools and 22 host routes.
- [intsig-textin/dsh-plugin-xparse](https://github.com/intsig-textin/dsh-plugin-xparse) - Adds a structured TextIn xParse tool and document parsing skill to DeepSeek Harness, supporting document parsing, cached-content navigation and durable multi-document tasks, with AppKey or Device OAuth authentication, paid-operation approval and bundled cross-platform CLI binaries.
- [iqingyoung/429-throttle-mcp#dsh-throttle](https://github.com/iqingyoung/429-throttle-mcp/tree/main/packages/dsh-throttle) - DeepSeek Harness rate-limiting plugin that prevents API 429 errors during long-running tasks, with task retrospectives.
- [Isanti2016/dsh-console](https://github.com/Isanti2016/dsh-console) - Slash-command console for dsh: /web start|stop|restart|status, /tunnel SSH forward management, one-shot /ask, and a console TUI launcher.
- [isheng-eqi/dsh-educoder](https://github.com/isheng-eqi/dsh-educoder) - Finishes 头歌 (EduCoder) homework over the platform JSON API, with no browser automation. educoder_sweep scans every course for homeworks that still have unfinished challenges — complete homeworks are skipped without reading a single challenge, so a full-account scan costs no model tokens — and can finish them; multiple-choice challenges also cost no model tokens, because the platform returns the answer key in any submission response, while code challenges are generated by the model, uploaded with evaluate:0 and graded once per challenge, then retried using the error report the platform returns. Three tools: educoder_sweep, educoder_homework, educoder_account.
- [ising-tech/isingq-toolkit#dsh-plugin](https://github.com/ising-tech/isingq-toolkit/tree/main/packages/dsh-plugin) - Native DeepSeek Harness plugin for IsingQ: guided QUBO modeling and validation on-device, then user-confirmed remote solving.
- [Islulua/dsh-code-navigator#code-navigator](https://github.com/Islulua/dsh-code-navigator/tree/main/packages/code-navigator) - Persistent C/C++, Python, and TypeScript definition navigation with a standalone workspace UI for DeepSeek Harness.
- [iStarryDust/dsh-prompt-enhance](https://github.com/iStarryDust/dsh-prompt-enhance) - Prompt enhancement: click the star button in the composer to have the current model rewrite the draft more clearly, with one click back to the original; the template is editable.
- [it-glen/dsh-mcp-manager](https://github.com/it-glen/dsh-mcp-manager) - MCP server manager for DSH: add, edit, enable and disable Model Context Protocol servers from a panel, with stdio and streamable-HTTP transports, per-server tool-call timeouts, live connection and tool-count status, and persistence to a project- or home-level mcp.json. Maintained fork of @wingsky-1/dsh-mcp-manager.
- [izwarm195/dsh-net-tools](https://github.com/izwarm195/dsh-net-tools) - Lets sandboxed agents reach the web through your local proxy: net_fetch fetches pages, net_proxy_status reports proxy status.
- [Jamailar/beav-deepseek-harness](https://github.com/Jamailar/beav-deepseek-harness) - Connects DSH to local Beav for Xiaohongshu (RED/RedNote) and social-media AI operations: topic research, knowledge, copywriting, image, audio, and short-video workflows with approval and artifact tracking.
- [James-web11/dsh-matlab-mcp](https://github.com/James-web11/dsh-matlab-mcp) - Registers the MathWorks MATLAB/Simulink MCP server into a dsh profile, so agent sessions get mcp__matlab__* tools for running MATLAB code and reading, editing and testing Simulink models.
- [Jaylor-Wang/dsh-tool-ast-grep](https://github.com/Jaylor-Wang/dsh-tool-ast-grep) - AST-based structural code search and syntax outline tool powered by ast-grep.
- [Jaylor-Wang/dsh-tool-lsp](https://github.com/Jaylor-Wang/dsh-tool-lsp) - LSP action surface for DeepSeek Harness providing diagnostics, formatting, rename, code actions, and symbols over real language servers.
- [JayYuen666/dsh-zvec-grep](https://github.com/JayYuen666/dsh-zvec-grep) - Semantic workspace search: three model tools (`zg_search`, `zg_index`, `zg_status`) drive the `zg` CLI for hybrid BM25 + vector + RRF retrieval, with a search-first guard that makes `grep`/`rg` require a prior successful search in an indexed workspace.
- [jcaiagent7143-ui/linkdigest-mcp](https://github.com/jcaiagent7143-ui/linkdigest-mcp) - Turns a Xiaohongshu, Douyin, TikTok, YouTube or X link into text: transcript with timecodes, on-screen text, a description and OCR of every image, caption and metadata. Mounts the hosted MCP server over streamable HTTP.
- [jean3690/dsh-devtoolbox](https://github.com/jean3690/dsh-devtoolbox) - Local toolbox for the DSH web GUI: 35 pure-client tools (text, encoding, hashing, extraction, conversion, reference tables) in a sidebar view, plus the /toolbox command and config-driven agent tool exposure.
- [jean3690/dsh-drawio](https://github.com/jean3690/dsh-drawio) - AI-driven drawio: four agent tools (validate, render to SVG/PNG, edit, template) plus a sidebar live board — zero-dependency mxfile-to-SVG preview, embedded diagrams.net editor with save bridge, and auto-open whenever the agent draws.
- [JeremyWangCY/dsh-rea](https://github.com/JeremyWangCY/dsh-rea) - Full upstream REA 6.4.0 integration over the official DSH MCP bridge: all 170 tools, the version-matched reverse-engineering skill, and the six original MCP prompts with argument completions reachable from the composer / menu, all sharing one REA process and complete structured Evidence. External analysis engines are bring-your-own.
- [JeremyWangCY/win-pilot](https://github.com/JeremyWangCY/win-pilot) - Windows computer-use plugin for AI agents with reusable window targets, UI Automation, window-bound screenshots, background-first verified input, isolated Chromium automation, MCP, CLI, and installable skills.
- [JerryLiu369/agent-web-search](https://github.com/JerryLiu369/agent-web-search) - Aggregated multi-upstream web search for DeepSeek Harness: replaces native web_search with model-native grounding and agent search APIs, source attribution, and rich citation cards.
- [Jesse-njx/dsh-docker](https://github.com/Jesse-njx/dsh-docker) - Typed, guarded container control: ps/logs/inspect/exec/start/stop and compose up/down with JSON output, project-aware targeting, and approval-gated destructive ops.
- [Jesse-njx/dsh-skillport](https://github.com/Jesse-njx/dsh-skillport) - Bring your existing Agent Skills (SKILL.md) library to DSH: discover skills across Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini paths, inject a progressive-disclosure index, and load bodies on demand.
- [jiangzhenguo/dsh-codegraph](https://github.com/jiangzhenguo/dsh-codegraph) - DSH bundle that registers 13 native codegraph_* tools wrapping the codegraph CLI, so agents bootstrap, maintain, and query a pre-indexed code knowledge graph (symbol query, explore, node trail, callers/callees, impact, affected tests) instead of grepping files.
- [jiayan-xu/dsh-codebase-memory](https://github.com/jiayan-xu/dsh-codebase-memory) - Code knowledge graph bridge for codebase-memory-mcp: semantic symbol search (BM25), source snippets, architecture overview with Leiden communities, call/data-flow/cross-service traces, graph-augmented grep.
- [jiayan-xu/dsh-nuphus-mcp](https://github.com/jiayan-xu/dsh-nuphus-mcp) - Desktop and browser automation bridge (36 tools): window/screen/mouse/keyboard control with PaddleOCR element perception, Chrome CDP browsing with accessibility snapshots.
- [jidekaixin2dian/dsh-context-budget](https://github.com/jidekaixin2dian/dsh-context-budget) - Manage MCP servers and skills in DeepSeek Harness, and hide tool groups from the next prompt with token-cost estimates.
- [jidekaixin2dian/dsh-toolgate](https://github.com/jidekaixin2dian/dsh-toolgate) - Manage MCP servers and skills in DeepSeek Harness, and control which tools enter the next prompt.
- [jiekesu967/dsh-markitdown](https://github.com/jiekesu967/dsh-markitdown) - Adds a markitdown tool that converts PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML, CSV, EPUB and URLs to Markdown, using a real Microsoft MarkItDown installation when one is reachable and a bundled dependency-free converter otherwise.
- [jiel521125/dsh-anlayzer](https://github.com/jiel521125/dsh-anlayzer) - This plugin locates the root cause of a failed DeepSeek Harness agent session and produces a shareable diagnostic report.
- [jihongboo/dsh-apple-mode](https://github.com/jihongboo/dsh-apple-mode) - Xcode AI integration for DSH: 26 Xcode MCP tools (mcpbridge) + Apple platform skills + Xcode Intelligence-style persona (agent preset or global bundle).
- [jing-hy/computer-user](https://github.com/jing-hy/computer-user) - Windows-only computer use for DeepSeek Harness: captures the virtual screen and drives mouse & keyboard through 9 tools built on PowerShell and Win32 SendInput; pairs with picturereader so text-only models can complete the screenshot-analyze-act-verify loop fully locally.
- [jing-hy/dsh-task-runner](https://github.com/jing-hy/dsh-task-runner) - Project/task dual-mode workspaces for DSH: a task skips the workspace picker and gets a fresh scratch directory (D:\dsh_working\<name>-<timestamp>) per conversation, Codex-style; no-workspace sessions are grouped under a persistent Tasks section in the sidebar with empty states, and the new-session workspace picker gains a "no workspace (task)" option.
- [jinguanghai/deepseek-harness-forge-plugins#forge-gates](https://github.com/jinguanghai/deepseek-harness-forge-plugins/tree/main/plugins/forge-gates) - Real-compute verification gates: math simplification, logic proofs, regex validation, E-prover FOL, state-machine checks, and code repair, backed by Go-compiled binaries with prebuilt Windows executables.
- [jinguanghai/deepseek-harness-forge-plugins#forge-tcm](https://github.com/jinguanghai/deepseek-harness-forge-plugins/tree/main/plugins/forge-tcm) - Traditional Chinese Medicine toolkit: eight-axes diagnosis and herb-pair lookup.
- [jinhuoooo/dsh-prompt-polish](https://github.com/jinhuoooo/dsh-prompt-polish) - One-click ✨ polish button for the composer: rewrites prompts and drafts with WorkBuddy humanizer-style rules (kills AI-flavored phrasing, varies rhythm, mode-aware for instructions/questions/prose) via free Zhipu GLM-4.5-Flash or any OpenAI-compatible API, falling back to offline local rules.
- [jinsiyu/dsh-auto-open-web](https://github.com/jinsiyu/dsh-auto-open-web) - DeepSeek Harness automatically opens browser plugins and includes a built-in WebView2 program to achieve a lightweight desktop experience.
- [jinsiyu/dsh-safemode-profile](https://github.com/jinsiyu/dsh-safemode-profile) - The dsh security mode plugin achieves a zero third-party plugin startup by constructing a blank profile.
- [JinSuperOfficial/dsh-proxy-switcher](https://github.com/JinSuperOfficial/dsh-proxy-switcher) - Hot-swap the outbound proxy in dsh between direct, system, and saved proxies without restarting.
- [jinwendijv/dsh-applauncher](https://github.com/jinwendijv/dsh-applauncher) - Scan installed Windows apps and launch them from a sidebar launcher above the settings icon.
- [jockiller/dsh-translator](https://github.com/jockiller/dsh-translator) - Input-box floating translation widget for DSH: translate drafts via session model, Zhipu GLM, or custom endpoints, with preview/replace/append, connectivity testing, and recent history.
- [joeseesun/qiaomu-rss-dsh](https://github.com/joeseesun/qiaomu-rss-dsh) - Read RSS feeds, retrieve podcast transcripts, collect web links for rewrites, and discuss articles in native Harness conversations.
- [JoFe2/kaleidosphere-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/JoFe2/kaleidosphere-dsh-plugin) - Registers six native DeepSeek Harness tools for deterministic fixture-based or read-only Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle database analysis, planning, preview, and readback.
- [john-walks-slow/dsh-cd](https://github.com/john-walks-slow/dsh-cd) - In-session cd for DeepSeek Harness: re-base relative paths on the fly (the file tools and the bash/pwsh default workdir follow) or move the session to another workspace for real — a `cd {"workspace": true, "confirmed": true}` call the user has agreed to, or the user's own `/cd <directory>` command, relocates the session's stored log, sandbox root, AGENTS.md and skill discovery and sidebar grouping. Per-session, persisted across restarts, without moving the session for a plain re-base.
- [john-walks-slow/dsh-wait-subagent](https://github.com/john-walks-slow/dsh-wait-subagent) - Active wait for background subagents in DeepSeek Harness: registers a wait_subagent model tool that blocks until a named background continuable subagent settles, then returns its stop reason and closing message — optional timeout, membership gate rejects unknown ids, event-driven with zero polling. Closes the gap between run_in_background fire-and-return and the async settlement notice; wait for a background subagent without polling list_agents.
- [Johnny-xuan/dsh-paste-to-path](https://github.com/Johnny-xuan/dsh-paste-to-path) - A lightweight, general-purpose attachment Dock for DSH: paste, drop, or choose images, PDFs, documents, archives, code, and other files, review and manage them before sending, then pass them to the Agent as local paths. It gives non-image files a consistent attachment entry point.
- [JohnXu22786/apply-patch](https://github.com/JohnXu22786/apply-patch) - Applies structured unified diffs (git format) to the real filesystem: multi-file/hunk parsing, fuzzy hunk location with line-offset correction, all-or-nothing application with typed conflict reports, reverse-patch undo journal and dry-run - four patch_* dsh tools plus a CLI.
- [JohnXu22786/bookkeeping](https://github.com/JohnXu22786/bookkeeping) - Conversational bookkeeping bundle for dsh: record expenses/income by chat with strict amount validation and natural-language dates, then query, report, export CSV/HTML, and track monthly budgets against a local SQLite ledger.
- [JohnXu22786/calendar](https://github.com/JohnXu22786/calendar) - CalDAV + iCalendar + RRULE calendar integration bundle for dsh with Chinese-bias support (lunar calendar / holidays), conflict detection and reminder tools.
- [JohnXu22786/codegraph](https://github.com/JohnXu22786/codegraph) - Local code knowledge graph for agents: parse a codebase (Python/JS/TS/Go/Java/Rust) into a SQLite index and answer callers, callees, deps, dependents, impact and full-text questions over it.
- [JohnXu22786/computer-control](https://github.com/JohnXu22786/computer-control) - Desktop (native) control for dsh as a stdio JSON-RPC bridge over a Python core: capture the screen, inject pointer/keyboard input, drive accessibility-tree actions, and gate high-risk operations behind required confirmations.
- [JohnXu22786/db-connector](https://github.com/JohnXu22786/db-connector) - Safe, audited SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL access for dsh agents: schema introspection, enforced read-only queries, a write approval gate, and a durable JSONL SQL audit trail.

- [momasiku/dsh-pilot](https://github.com/momasiku/dsh-pilot) - Let DeepSeek Harness see and operate any program on Windows. The model looks at the real screen and drives the mouse, keyboard and windows itself. It is fast: several steps run in a single round trip, and a window can be focused before input lands, so the click hits the right one. It can do anything you would do on a desktop, including but not limited to CAD drawing, circuit simulation, and sending messages.
- [moon16u/dsh-pouch#dsh-mcp-console](https://github.com/moon16u/dsh-pouch/tree/main/packages/dsh-mcp-console) - MCP server console under Plugins: manage the official @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client at runtime — add/edit/delete servers, enable/disable/reconnect, per-tool switches, live status and tool lists over SSE, mcpServers JSON import, and auto-migration of profile-YAML MCP entries; an uninstall leaves a native fallback block that keeps the same servers loadable.
- [moononnn/DeepSeek-Harness-biaoqingbao](https://github.com/moononnn/DeepSeek-Harness-biaoqingbao) - Sticker/emoji expression for assistants: emotion-driven auto-matching, library management, AI image tagging, dialects, style mimicry, and chat-based tag refinement.
- [mr-mihu/dsh-dbhub-live](https://github.com/mr-mihu/dsh-dbhub-live) - Database access for DeepSeek Harness through the DBHub MCP server: configure MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQLite and SQL Server connections per workspace and environment, then let the agent configure, list, query and search SQLite objects through four fixed tools. Passwords and full connection strings are entered in the settings UI and never accepted as tool arguments, so the model only sees metadata such as mysql://host:3306/db; each environment can be read-only (the model may enable it but not clear it) or reached through a manual SSH tunnel. Every call runs its own short-lived dbhub process and dbhub installs itself when missing.
- [Mr-Neutr0n/dsh-medseek](https://github.com/Mr-Neutr0n/dsh-medseek) - Clinical documentation and reference bundle for healthcare professionals: SOAP/APSO progress notes, admission H&P, SBAR/I-PASS handover, discharge summaries, Safe Harbor de-identification, patient-instruction readability, completeness checks, and cited lookups against FDA labels, MedlinePlus, PubMed, and ClinicalTrials.gov. Draft-only with a PHI egress guard; not a medical device.
- [mrpulor-gh/dsh-nuphus-mcp](https://github.com/mrpulor-gh/dsh-nuphus-mcp) - Official DSH plugin for nuphus-mcp (by the nuphus-mcp maintainers): desktop and browser automation (38 tools) with PaddleOCR element perception and Chrome CDP browsing, via a persistent stdio MCP child process.
- [MrWeiCodes/dsh-fs-encoding](https://github.com/MrWeiCodes/dsh-fs-encoding) - File encoding guard: byte-exact read/write/edit for GBK, Big5, Shift-JIS, EUC-KR, Windows-125x, UTF-16 and UTF-32 files, so editing a legacy file leaves it in its original encoding instead of silently rewriting it as UTF-8; UTF-8 BOM preserved exactly as it was, line endings (CRLF/LF/CR) kept, characters the encoding cannot represent refused rather than written as "?", and non-UTF-8 files listed with candidate encodings so the model can re-read them explicitly.
- [MuyuYanran/dsh-rea-mcp-lite#dsh-plugin](https://github.com/MuyuYanran/dsh-rea-mcp-lite/tree/main/dsh-plugin) - Settings page for the REA reverse-engineering tool gateway (rea-mcp-lite) that lives in the same repository: pick which tool bundles load into context, see the tool count and token cost of each bundle, save and recall named presets of your loading setup, hot-swap them without restarting DSH, and check this repository and REA for updates, including classifying the tools a new REA release added. The page is split into sections with sub-menus, filters and pagination. Requires REA (rea-agents) and the gateway registered as the rea MCP server (see repo README).
- [MuzeWinter/dscomputer-control](https://github.com/MuzeWinter/dscomputer-control) - Windows desktop automation for dsh: 14 tools that enumerate apps and windows, capture window screenshots that still work when the window is covered by other windows, read the accessibility tree, and perform real input — click, type text (CJK included), press key combinations, scroll and drag. Loads the official computer-use runtime (@oai/sky) already installed on the machine, discovering it by enumerating vendor directories, so vendor upgrades that change hash directories do not break it.
- [nabehkh-source/primesync-ai-studio](https://github.com/nabehkh-source/primesync-ai-studio) - Hosted PrimeSync AI Studio strategy-research MCP configuration bundle using the official MCP client and mcp-remote OAuth bridge; eligible Studio access required. Experimental: OAuth consent and tool calls are not yet verified end-to-end. Complete manual CLI sign-in on the same computer before starting Harness; otherwise tools may be absent after startup. Targets DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 only; mcp-remote 0.15.2 is downloaded through npx on first launch.
- [nanami-0713/dsh-jev-decide](https://github.com/nanami-0713/dsh-jev-decide) - TypeSafe Jev (System One decision model) as the jev_decide tool for DeepSeek Harness: noul, choice and score questions return calibrated probabilities; credentials reuse the DSH credential seam; 429/529 backoff retry built in.
- [NattoCB/dsh-web-search-session-follow](https://github.com/NattoCB/dsh-web-search-session-follow) - Drop-in web_search provider that follows the session's routed model: a runtime-editable priority chain with three wire dialects (Anthropic web search, OpenRouter online, Zhipu bigmodel), per-route endpoints and credentials, a Settings UI panel, local JSONL call audit, and built-in official fallback.
- [Negulons/dsh-freecad](https://github.com/Negulons/dsh-freecad) - Reads and edits STEP models through FreeCAD, measures geometry (distance, angle, diameter), and generates first-angle 2D machining drawings with a hole table as SVG, DXF, PDF or PNG.
- [nicecx/insta360-ai-content-studio](https://github.com/nicecx/insta360-ai-content-studio) - Automated daily content pipeline for Insta360 GO 3S: BLE/WiFi remote capture of aquarium footage, wireless import, ffmpeg quality evaluation with decision log, Auto editing (segment selection, TTS narration, music, subtitles), and Bilibili upload via biliup (dry-run by default).
- [ninetyhe-90/dsh-decision-review](https://github.com/ninetyhe-90/dsh-decision-review) - Lets the primary model ask an independent reviewer model to review a decision it has already made, with off, shadow and advisory modes. Requires your own service implementing POST /v1/decision.
- [NingYuanLee/dsh-tavily-mcp](https://github.com/NingYuanLee/dsh-tavily-mcp) - Connects the Tavily hosted MCP server and registers the tools it publishes. The API key is read from the TAVILY_API_KEY credential and is not stored in plugin config.
- [nisew2/dsh-whale-dive](https://github.com/nisew2/dsh-whale-dive) - Read Bilibili and Douyin from a session: WBI-signed Bilibili API calls behind one shared pacer (4 req/s, per-host cooldown after a 412) for video, feed, search, author, comments, danmaku and subtitles, plus Douyin hot list, video, feed and search rendered in a locally launched Edge over CDP.
- [NoneadChina/dsh-nonead-universal-robots](https://github.com/NoneadChina/dsh-nonead-universal-robots) - A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that lets you control Universal Robots (UR) collaborative arms directly from natural language, developed by Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd. based on the same logic as the company's own nUR MCP Server. (Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd.)
- [NoneadChina/dsh-nonead-ursim](https://github.com/NoneadChina/dsh-nonead-ursim) - A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that lets you control Universal Robots (UR) collaborative arms directly from natural language — by default an offline, kinematics-level simulated arm, with a real-robot channel that stays off until it is explicitly enabled. Needs a Python install with numpy and paramiko (pip install -r requirements.txt). Developed by Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd. based on the same logic as the company's own nUR MCP Server. (Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd.)
- [nononononofish/dsh-region](https://github.com/nononononofish/dsh-region) - Switches DSH's package download source between the npmmirror China mirror and the official npm registry on timeout or failure, with a Web UI to inspect and switch manually.
- [Noob-stupid/dsh-breadboard](https://github.com/Noob-stupid/dsh-breadboard) - DSH hardware sandbox plugin: assemble a 3D scene of ESP32 / BME280 / PIR / LED components with protocol- and voltage-checked port wiring, run real Python project code in the loop against simulated I2C/GPIO hardware with fault injection, let networked device simulators report over HTTP to a real backend (validated end-to-end against a live seat-reservation system), observe a real device read-only and map its state onto the scene, and add support for new boards through data-driven pin definitions. Ships 16 hw_* agent tools plus a bundled SKILL.md.
- [Noob-stupid/dsh-plugin-gating-hub](https://github.com/Noob-stupid/dsh-plugin-gating-hub) - Framework-upgrade safety and plugin gating for DSH: a pre-upgrade session-format contract preflight that adapts incompatible plugins and agent presets before you upgrade, automatic rollback on failure, auto-quarantine of plugins that broke a boot, plus environment fingerprinting and a public contract-rule pack. The built-in multi-source marketplace is a discovery layer only.
- [Nrxous/dsh-context7](https://github.com/Nrxous/dsh-context7) - Fetches up-to-date, version-pinned library documentation and code examples from context7.com for DSH agents via context7_search and context7_get_docs tools.
- [nyantused-cpun/gewu-tools](https://github.com/nyantused-cpun/gewu-tools) - Model-agnostic visual-inspection pipeline for text-only agents: page-by-page HTML screenshots plus a ready-made vision-subagent briefing contract (gewu_prep), then source-code truth verification of every finding (gewu_locate); validated on mimo-v2.5 & qwen3.7-plus.
- [dsh-agent-picker](https://github.com/Ok541151/cwk) - Agent mode picker for DSH: pick an external Agent CLI (Claude Code, Codex, Qwen Code, Gemini CLI, Aider, Goose, Hermes…) as the session's default executor from a control next to the input box, instead of editing configuration files. The agent roster is data-driven, and installed CLIs are discovered automatically from PATH, the managed CLI directory and a drop-in convention directory. Agents that are installed but still missing credentials or a required background service are shown as "needs setup" rather than silently hidden.
- [oldHan2423/dsh-everything-find](https://github.com/oldHan2423/dsh-everything-find) - Everything (voidtools) file-name search: everything_find queries the local Everything index to locate files and folders on any indexed drive in milliseconds, and adds a configuration card to the Plugins page.
- [Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel](https://github.com/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel) - Reads Claude Code and Codex plugin configurations to discover and preflight MCP servers and slash commands, with opt-in registration in DeepSeek Harness.
- [omdsh-dev/dsh-custom-tool](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-custom-tool) - Create and manage sandboxed JavaScript tools with a Monaco editor and model-driven tool lifecycle.
- [omdsh-dev/dsh-data-agent](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-data-agent) - Let the AI connect to databases and write SQL for you.
- [omdsh-dev/dsh-tool-calculator](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-tool-calculator) - Safe math expression evaluator, zero-dependency recursive-descent parser.
- [omdsh-dev/dsh-tool-csv](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-tool-csv) - Parse/query/aggregate/convert CSV (RFC 4180) with a zero-dependency state-machine parser.
- [omdsh-dev/dsh-tool-diff](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-tool-diff) - Structured comparison and unified diffs for text/JSON/CSV/Markdown.
- [omdsh-dev/dsh-tool-encoding](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-tool-encoding) - base64/url/hex encoding, common hashes, and UUID generation.
- [omdsh-dev/dsh-tool-json](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-tool-json) - JSON queries with a JMESPath subset.
- [omdsh-dev/dsh-tool-regex](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-tool-regex) - Test/extract/safe-replace/statically explain regexes without executing code.
- [omdsh-dev/dsh-tool-schema](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-tool-schema) - JSON Schema validation: validate/paths/explain/normalize.
- [omdsh-dev/dsh-tool-stat](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-tool-stat) - Descriptive statistics, percentiles, frequency distributions, and correlation.
- [omdsh-dev/dsh-tool-time](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-tool-time) - Strict ISO 8601 parsing, IANA timezone conversion, and UTC calendar arithmetic.
- [omdsh-dev/dsh-toolkit](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-toolkit) - Zero-dependency toolkit: time / encoding / json / calculator / csv / regex / markdown / diff / stat / schema — ten deterministic tools in one install.
- [omicverse/dsh-omicos](https://github.com/omicverse/dsh-omicos) - Runs OmicVerse/OmicOS bioinformatics analyses in a persistent Python kernel, with capability-catalog search, kernel inspection and an account tab.
- [oomol-lab/dsh-oomol](https://github.com/oomol-lab/dsh-oomol) - Connects DeepSeek Harness to OOMOL-managed apps and services, with progressive Connector Action discovery and execution plus an in-app panel for managing Provider connections.
- [opdsh/unity-plugin](https://github.com/opdsh/unity-plugin) - Drive the Unity Editor from DSH through the official unity CLI: live-Editor scene commands, in-Editor C# eval and runtime command discovery over a warm unity shell session, plus a raw CLI escape hatch for project creation, tests and builds. Mounts Unity's official skill collection alongside its own Unity workflow and Asset Store skills.
- [openbkn-ai/bkn-dsh#openbkn-business-context](https://github.com/openbkn-ai/bkn-dsh/tree/main/packages/openbkn-business-context) - Business knowledge-network context for DeepSeek Harness: bind a session to an OpenBKN knowledge network, query its objects and metrics through managed MCP tools, and open trace-backed provenance (execution facts and a business graph) for each answer. Ships with the OpenBKN Runtime; the provenance views need an OpenBKN enterprise license.
- [opencamel/dsh-wb-archive](https://github.com/opencamel/dsh-wb-archive) - A wb_archive tool that turns a single Weibo post link (m.weibo.cn/status/...) into a permanent Markdown snapshot via the 2100laike archive service: long posts are fetched in full, images are re-hosted so they never break, snapshots survive post deletion, and resubmits dedup-hit and return the latest version without spending quota. Needs the third-party 2100laike service; anonymous use is limited to 8 archives per day per plugin instance and a registered PAT raises that to 100 per day.
- [opencamel/dsh-wx-archive](https://github.com/opencamel/dsh-wx-archive) - A wx_archive tool that turns a WeChat Official Account article link into a permanent Markdown snapshot via the 2100laike archive service: images are re-hosted so they never break, snapshots survive article deletion, resubmits dedup-hit and return the latest version without spending quota, a content_kind field tells text articles from sticker (image-post) messages, and refresh forces a refetch with a PAT. Needs the third-party 2100laike service; anonymous use is limited to 8 archives per day per plugin instance and a registered PAT raises that to 100 per day.
- [opencamel/dsh-x-archive](https://github.com/opencamel/dsh-x-archive) - An x_archive tool that turns an X (Twitter) post link into a permanent Markdown snapshot via the 2100laike archive service: images are re-hosted so they never break, snapshots survive post deletion, resubmits dedup-hit and return the latest version without spending quota, and refresh forces a refetch with a PAT. Needs the third-party 2100laike service; anonymous use is limited to 8 archives per day per plugin instance and a registered PAT raises that to 100 per day.
- [OrderG-X/dsh-mac-computer-use#plugin](https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-mac-computer-use/tree/main/plugin) - Vision-first Mac computer use, for when the accessibility tree is unavailable. Ships 11 desktop_* tools - window list, screenshots, OCR text targeting, numbered elements, coordinate clicks, typing, scrolling, drag - plus a Codex-style cursor overlay with spring animation. Clicks are delivered to the target process, so the real pointer never moves and nothing steals focus. In DSH it shows up as Mac Desktop Control with a settings page that checks the engine and the Screen Recording / Accessibility permissions, with a button that opens the matching System Settings pane. Works out of the box: the tarball bundles the dsh-cu engine and the overlay as prebuilt universal binaries (Apple silicon + Intel, macOS 11+, ad-hoc signed), compiled from the repo's Swift sources by the release workflow - no clone, no Xcode, no install.sh. The only setup is granting DeepSeek Harness Screen Recording and Accessibility once. macOS only; on Windows and Linux the plugin loads without registering the desktop tools.
- [OtterMind/sqlx#sqlx-dsh](https://github.com/OtterMind/sqlx/tree/main/integrations/dsh) - SQLX database tools: list saved datasources, show or test a connection, execute SQL and open a local result page, with the sqlx CLI installed on first use.
- [ouli-1242/dsh-plugin-tool-management](https://github.com/ouli-1242/dsh-plugin-tool-management) - One settings panel managing MCP, skills, memory, subagents, prompts and sessions; customize scene combos to switch the whole environment; the Agent can also operate this plugin for you.
- [ownduck/dsh-custom-env](https://github.com/ownduck/dsh-custom-env) - Manage $DSH_HOME/.env from Settings and sync Host plus Windows/macOS user environment.
- [pan17/dsh-tool-manager](https://github.com/pan17/dsh-tool-manager) - Manage tool availability and groups for each Agent Preset, load tools on demand like Skills, and reduce model context usage.
- [pangxie985/dsh-desktop-yida](https://github.com/pangxie985/dsh-desktop-yida) - Gives the agent 14 tools to create and edit DingTalk Yida apps (apps, forms, pages, schema, data) through the OpenYida CLI, plus a right-sidebar workbench that opens them in the built-in browser.
- [Pappet/dsh-tool-imagegen](https://github.com/Pappet/dsh-tool-imagegen) - Text-to-image and image-to-image generation via OpenRouter's unified Image API: configurable model aliases with parameters gated against the live model capability listing, reference-image inputs, a settings card, and inline chat display of results.
- [patrykorwat/open-dream-rsi#deepseek_harness](https://github.com/patrykorwat/open-dream-rsi/tree/main/plugins/deepseek_harness) - Not another memory plugin: ODR is an evolving-worlds self-improvement loop (Dream-RSI) — attempts are recorded into a Discovery Tree, and between runs thousands of strategy variants are replayed against that recorded world; a strategy, recipe or lesson is promoted only after surviving counterfactual replay, never on the model's word alone, and Sentinel gates tool calls before the budget burns; the LLM stays frozen, installable from npm as dsh-open-dream-rsi.
- [pearjelly/deep-blend#bundle](https://github.com/pearjelly/deep-blend/tree/main/packages/deepblend/bundle) - Create editable Blender product scenes in DSH. Start from speaker, cup and lamp recipes or imported models; view saved results on the Lighttable, compare revisions, and adjust dimensions, materials, cameras and lights. Place static models on actual mesh surfaces in one saved operation, then save a complete static view while preserving existing cameras and animation. Repair repeating texture coordinates on planar custom mesh faces while preserving geometry. Render images or saved-shot videos and export an editable revision with its assets. Native geometry inspections, immutable revisions and an approval gate help preserve existing work. Supports DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 and the legacy host, with 20 tools for modeling, review and delivery.
- [peijiping/dsh-plugin-zotero](https://github.com/peijiping/dsh-plugin-zotero) - Connect the Zotero library on your computer to DSH: browse and search your own papers in the right sidebar, read metadata, notes and PDF full text, and bring a citation, an excerpt or a whole collection into the conversation with one click, so the model can answer from your own literature.
- [pengpengyi92/dsh-quant](https://github.com/pengpengyi92/dsh-quant) - Quantitative R&D toolkit for DeepSeek Harness — 59 tools across six domains covering market data, indicators, factor evaluation, walk-forward ML validation, risk (VaR/CVaR/drawdown/Beta with Kupiec POF), options, bonds, FICC and fund simulation, with an end-to-end PDAT→PET research pipeline.
- [pengzhou267-ai/dsh-shop-assistant](https://github.com/pengzhou267-ai/dsh-shop-assistant) - Ecommerce operator workbench: CSV batch preview with marketplace column adapters, reproducible profit/six-dimension scoring, public product-page snapshots, Chinese skills, and a replaceable store-policy KB.
- [PerryLink/dsh-aqua-input-check](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-aqua-input-check) - Aquaculture input register completeness and withdrawal-period date check: deterministic findings with rule IDs.
- [PerryLink/dsh-bid-health-check](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-bid-health-check) - Checks a bid requirement by requirement against a tender requirements pack and reports which requirements appear answered, weakly matched or not located. It reports differences; it does not judge substantive compliance.
- [PerryLink/dsh-canteen-retention-check](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-canteen-retention-check) - Checks a canteen food-retention ledger for the four required record elements, the 125 g minimum, the 48-hour cold-storage window and template placeholders left in a cell.
- [PerryLink/dsh-checkpoint-rewind](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-checkpoint-rewind) - Claude Code /rewind for DeepSeek Harness: git-first workspace snapshots before every mutating tool execution, turn-boundary session forks, and a one-shot /rewind command that restores files and forks the session back to a checkpoint.
- [PerryLink/dsh-click](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-click) - Windows desktop computer-use tools (click, type, key, screenshot) with freshness checks, approval gating, process-identity verification around every action, and a sanitized audit trail.
- [PerryLink/dsh-construction-doc-check](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-construction-doc-check) - Checks a project document archive for missing required document types, stale revisions and empty files, using folder and file names rather than document contents.
- [PerryLink/dsh-customs-doc-check](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-customs-doc-check) - Customs declaration document consistency check: field-level findings with rule IDs.
- [PerryLink/dsh-data-quality](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-data-quality) - Data quality checking for DeepSeek Harness — profiling, cleaning, and verification pipelines with structured reports.
- [PerryLink/dsh-evidence-check](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-evidence-check) - Evidence-list completeness check: maps facts to evidence and reports gaps with rule IDs.
- [PerryLink/dsh-excel-reconcile](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-excel-reconcile) - Joins two spreadsheets on a declared key and compares declared fields within declared tolerances, producing a Markdown report, a JSON result and a diff workbook. It reports differences; it does not adjudicate them.
- [PerryLink/dsh-fmea-table-check](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-fmea-table-check) - Checks an FMEA worksheet for element completeness and for the arithmetic that follows from it - severity, occurrence and detection against the resulting risk priority number - following published FMEA method standards. Reports inconsistencies; it does not judge whether the ratings themselves are appropriate.
- [PerryLink/dsh-fund-research](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-fund-research) - Deterministic research reports for Chinese public mutual funds built from public-source data (Tiantian Fund and Eastmoney), pure-function metrics (performance decomposition, holdings penetration, style attribution, manager profile), and versioned reports with a per-number snapshot traceability appendix.
- [PerryLink/dsh-gongwen-word-check](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-gongwen-word-check) - Checks an official document's type and reference number against the published party and government document format standard - including the bracket form the year is written in and the numbering pattern. Reports what does not match the format; it does not judge the document's content.
- [PerryLink/dsh-hazchem-check](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-hazchem-check) - Checks a hazardous-chemical register for internal consistency: that each substance names its hazard class, that stored quantities parse, that a threshold is recorded, that the major-hazard-source verdict agrees with how the stored quantity compares to the threshold the register states, that safety data sheet numbers are present and CAS numbers are not duplicated. Reports differences for a human to review; it does not decide whether a unit constitutes a major hazard source.
- [PerryLink/dsh-icd-rule-check](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-icd-rule-check) - Flags ICD coding pairs that need a coder's attention - dagger and asterisk combinations, combination codes - against GB/T 14396-2016 and published ICD usage notes. Reports the pairs it finds rather than resolving them; the coding decision stays with the coder.
- [PerryLink/dsh-invoice-ledger](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-invoice-ledger) - Checks an invoice ledger for duplicates keyed on code + number, arithmetic consistency, payer mismatch, date anomalies and template placeholders, and emits an anomaly list plus a workbook.
- [PerryLink/dsh-laya](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-laya) - Laya typed decisions (`noul` yes/no, `choice`, `score`) as a first-class Cordis service (`ctx.laya`) plus the model-visible `laya_ask` and `laya_plan` tools. The plugin itself installs and downloads nothing: it is a client of a `laya-mcp serve` sidecar you start yourself, and it reports that the sidecar is not running instead of failing obscurely at the first tool call.
- [PerryLink/dsh-lsp-actions](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-lsp-actions) - LSP action surface for DSH: diagnostics, formatting, completion, code actions, symbols, signature help, inlay hints and rename, all backed by real language servers.
- [PerryLink/dsh-medrec-qc](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-medrec-qc) - Checks a medical-record front sheet for field completeness and for internal logical contradictions between its fields, against 国卫办医发〔2016〕24号 and other published documents. Lists what is missing or inconsistent for a human to review; it does not assess clinical correctness.
- [PerryLink/dsh-nurse-record-check](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-nurse-record-check) - Checks nursing records for entry timing, signatures and assessment-form completeness, against 《病历书写基本规范》 and other published documents. Reports what is missing or out of sequence for a human to review.
- [PerryLink/dsh-payroll-audit](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-payroll-audit) - Checks a payroll sheet against published social-insurance, housing-fund and individual-income-tax parameters, with pass, pass_with_gaps, review and fail outcomes and parameters that carry their own review date.
- [PerryLink/dsh-phocinae](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-phocinae) - Local non-generative decision layer: phocinae_ask and phocinae_gate return typed verdicts with calibrated confidence from a small decision model, with fail-closed escalation. Needs a local phocinae-server (pip install phocinae-server) with the Phocinae-Largha-150M-v1 model on loopback port 8155.
- [PerryLink/dsh-power-ticket-check](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-power-ticket-check) - Checks an electrical work permit for the elements it must carry and for the issue and permission sequence the current electrical safety regulations require. Reports the differences it finds; it does not judge whether the work was safe or whether the permit was validly authorised.
- [PerryLink/dsh-safety-ledger-check](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-safety-ledger-check) - Checks a site safety-qualification ledger for training hours, the four required record elements, and special-operation certificate validity against the dates the person worked.
- [PerryLink/dsh-site-log-check](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-site-log-check) - Checks supervision logs for cross-day continuity and for on-site supervision coverage, against GB/T 50319-2013 and other published documents. Reports gaps and coverage differences for a human to review.

Driven by a persistent JavaScript REPL — the agent gets two tools (`js`, `js_reset`) and calls an `sky` API inside them, so state survives between calls and the tool schema stays fixed as capabilities grow.
