- [TwinsEarth/NewAgentUniverseByDeepSeek#dsh](https://github.com/TwinsEarth/NewAgentUniverseByDeepSeek/tree/main/integrations/dsh) - NewAgentUniverseByDeepSeek nodes inside DSH: five read-only tools covering provenance (both upstream releases this build names), a data directory's restored state and ledger audit, the conformance vectors, exact decimal conversion, and node reachability. Driving the node -- starting or stopping a daemon, depositing funds, sending bus messages -- is deliberately not exposed, because those are audited privileged operations in this project.
- [TYEclipse/dsh-units](https://github.com/TYEclipse/dsh-units) - Unit conversion toolbox covering 20 categories — length, mass, temperature, area, volume (incl. US cooking units), speed, time, data sizes (decimal MB vs binary MiB), data transfer rates (Mbps vs MB/s), acceleration incl. g-force, illumination (lux / foot-candle), pressure, energy, angle, frequency, power incl. three horsepower definitions, force, torque, typography (px/pt/em/rem), and fuel economy (mpg ↔ L/100km). Two tools — convert_unit and list_units — zero runtime dependencies, pure arithmetic; each result includes the formula applied.
- [TYEclipse/dsh-webfetch](https://github.com/TYEclipse/dsh-webfetch) - Web reading tools for text-only agents. Five read-only tools: web_fetch (any URL rendered as clean Markdown or plain text), web_links (inventory of a page's links), web_feed (RSS 2.0 / Atom entries), web_headers (HTTP status, response headers and redirect chain without downloading the body, HEAD with automatic GET fallback), and web_table (HTML tables extracted as structured rows with header detection and colspan/rowspan grid expansion). Transport is Node fetch plus a zero-dependency HTTP proxy implementation (CONNECT tunnelling, absolute-URI requests, NO_PROXY with suffix/wildcard/IPv4-CIDR matching, Proxy-Authorization). Zero runtime dependencies.
- [tyjean428/ccreach-dsh-web-search](https://github.com/tyjean428/ccreach-dsh-web-search) - CCReach capability-search provider for DeepSeek Harness, letting agents discover data sources, tools, APIs, MCP servers, skills and workflows.
- [uckkk/dsh-live-data](https://github.com/uckkk/dsh-live-data) - Ten live-data tools over eight keyless public APIs: FX rates, weather, npm/PyPI versions, GitHub repo stats, Bilibili video stats, A-share/index/gold quotes, and IP geolocation. Tool defaults are configurable in settings.
- [uckkk/dsh-pace-calc](https://github.com/uckkk/dsh-pace-calc) - Running pace calculator: converts distance and time to min/km pace and km/h speed.
- [unclecode/toolshrink](https://github.com/unclecode/toolshrink) - Content-aware tool-result reducer: 13 reducers cut oversized output by meaning at tools/post-execute (failing tests kept, diff context dropped, JSON and CSV sampled, lint problems grouped by rule, dependency stack frames collapsed, crowded directories counted), with full originals spilled to disk behind a locator.
- [universe-st/dsh-game-material-master](https://github.com/universe-st/dsh-game-material-master) - Generates game art from reference images via Seedream image generation and MiniMax image-to-video, assembling eight-direction sprites, sequence frames, and skeleton animations with local green-screen keying.
- [uos1231234/dsh-plugin-virtuoso-layout#dsh-plugin-virtuoso-layout](https://github.com/uos1231234/dsh-plugin-virtuoso-layout/tree/main/dsh-plugin-virtuoso-layout) - Drives Cadence Virtuoso from the host: VM lifecycle, SKILL execution through the bridge, window capture, Calibre DRC parsing and a write-confirmation gate, in 12 host-only tools.
- [uptoheart/dsh-file-bookmark](https://github.com/uptoheart/dsh-file-bookmark) - Manage frequently used file bookmarks in DeepSeek Harness, supporting bookmark saving, listing and navigation. It also allows creation of frequently used projects, including management projects, code projects and more.
- [uriekang1211-bot/dsh-ssq-plugin](https://github.com/uriekang1211-bot/dsh-ssq-plugin) - SSQ (China Welfare Lottery Double Color Ball) helper for DeepSeek Harness: 1000-draw trend tracking, six prediction models with ensemble voting, structure analysis and dan-tuo/random generation via the ssq tool.
- [uss7118/dsh-win-control](https://github.com/uss7118/dsh-win-control) - Windows desktop control for DeepSeek Harness agents: window and UI Automation automation, local Windows OCR, direct browser reads over the Chrome DevTools Protocol (DOM text, JavaScript, selector clicks), humanised mouse and keyboard input, browser tab management, and a live control panel. It probes the machine on first run, writes its own config, and degrades gracefully when a capability is missing. Windows 10/11 only.
- [v587d/capital-generation](https://github.com/v587d/capital-generation) - China A-share financial data MCP server for the harness: 11 fin_data__* tools (quotes/K-lines/financials/calendar/special-data/announcements/EDB/reconcile/funds/indices) over THS free official REST (primary) + AKShare (fallback) + Wind (exclusive domains), with observable degradation, context-budget compression (result-side -72.2% measured), and an offline 10-year market-data lake; BYOK.
- [VermilionPasvikin/dsh-coderag](https://github.com/VermilionPasvikin/dsh-coderag) - Code retrieval engine exposed as an MCP server: four tools (code_search, code_outline, code_index, index_status) over a SQLite FTS5 index with BM25 ranking, CJK bigram indexing, declaration-aware tree-sitter chunking, incremental reindexing, and a three-layer secret filter. The bigram index matches Chinese-language queries against English code, and the default path needs no vector store or embedding model. Requires a local Python 3.10-3.12 engine installed by scripts/install.sh, and CODERAG_ROOT set in the profile patch.
- [Very12345/dsh-bash-windows](https://github.com/Very12345/dsh-bash-windows) - Windows settings switch that replaces PowerShell with Git Bash across the four built-in presets, including a persistent terminal in minimal mode.
- [Very12345/dsh-computer-use-windows](https://github.com/Very12345/dsh-computer-use-windows) - Windows desktop control with window-bound screenshots and accessibility state, text readback, DSH approvals, and activity overlays.
- [vibeinging/dsh-tool-search](https://github.com/vibeinging/dsh-tool-search) - Per-agent on-demand tool discovery and progressive schema disclosure.
- [Viger1/dsh-design](https://github.com/Viger1/dsh-design) - Measures design rules on the rendered page rather than in the CSS — type-scale count, WCAG AA contrast against the real composited backdrop, spacing-grid drift, palette size, tap targets, and the tells of generated UI such as violet gradients caught by hue angle; ships a design-system skill.
- [vikasranax/dsh-plugin-cats](https://github.com/vikasranax/dsh-plugin-cats) - Fetches random cat facts and images from public APIs for AI agents.
- [VioletEverGarden-zc/dsh-rea-mcp-toggle](https://github.com/VioletEverGarden-zc/dsh-rea-mcp-toggle) - Toggles the rea-mcp server on and off from the DSH Web UI session header or through the rea_mcp_toggle agent tool, so the 170 mcp__rea__* tool schemas stop being sent with every request while REA is off (the tools payload drops from about 722 KB to about 95 KB) and the REA child process exits; the choice is kept in a profile-scoped state file and restored at startup by a row-level disabled expression.
- [Vncntvx/dsh-zotero](https://github.com/Vncntvx/dsh-zotero) - Zotero as an evidence store for agents: search your library, inspect metadata and notes, retrieve evidence passages, open source PDFs, and generate citations and bibliographies.
- [Void-LifeStream/dsh-cuda](https://github.com/Void-LifeStream/dsh-cuda) - Run Python on the local NVIDIA CUDA GPU from DeepSeek Harness: device status, foreground and detached jobs, durable logs, and a measured peak-VRAM figure per run.
- [Void-LifeStream/dsh-phone-butler](https://github.com/Void-LifeStream/dsh-phone-butler) - Inspect and tidy a real Android phone over adb: storage surveys, per-app data sizes read from dumpsys diskstats without root, cache clearing that preserves app data, directory measurements and screenshots — five tools; reads never modify anything, writes require explicit confirmation.
- [volcengine/ark-cli#ark-managed-agents](https://github.com/volcengine/ark-cli/tree/main/dsh-plugins/ark-managed-agents) - Adds a Managed Agents settings tab and MCP tools to dispatch long-running agent tasks to Ark cloud Managed Agents.
- [Voyager77Twt/dsh-folder-search](https://github.com/Voyager77Twt/dsh-folder-search) - Search local Word, PDF, PPT, and Excel folders for exam questions and export selected questions to a Word paper.
- [w4xxx/dsh-xia-plugins#packages/global-proxy](https://github.com/w4xxx/dsh-xia-plugins/tree/main/packages/global-proxy) - Route every host-process undici fetch through a local HTTP(S) proxy while keeping localhost and China-reachable APIs direct.
- [wackyju2-beep/dsh-better](https://github.com/wackyju2-beep/dsh-better) - Archived-session management, task-stop notifications, an update checker, model routing (keyword rules + allowlist-gated model_route), multi-task scheduled triggers (heartbeats and fixed-time tasks), and a DeepSeek-style message scroll nav for the dsh web GUI.
- [wade20250715/dsh-pubmed](https://github.com/wade20250715/dsh-pubmed) - PubMed deep-research toolset: literature search, author investigation, same-name disambiguation, institution statistics and mentor-student matching.
- [Walvez/dsh-codex-sync](https://github.com/Walvez/dsh-codex-sync) - Two-way Codex↔DSH bridge: skills from ~/.codex/skills, session import with workspace attach, live MCP mirroring of mcp_servers, and a Codex-side reverse MCP installer.
- [Walvez/dsh-search-failover](https://github.com/Walvez/dsh-search-failover) - Web search pool for the native web_search tool: fails over across 8 free/paid backends with quota-aware circuit breaking, settings-page API key management, custom SearXNG instances, failover/rotate strategy switching and live SerpApi quota.
- [WanchunLian/dsh-draft-polish](https://github.com/WanchunLian/dsh-draft-polish) - One-click draft polish for the DSH composer: rewrites your spoken draft into professional wording, sends only the draft snapshot (never conversation context), and never blocks sending if the LLM is unavailable.
- [wangbobo-coder/dsh-mcp-manager](https://github.com/wangbobo-coder/dsh-mcp-manager) - One settings page for every MCP server on your machine. It reads the real config file of 17 other AI tools (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, OpenCode, Trae, Trae CN, Qoder, Gemini CLI, Qwen, Zed, Roo Code, Copilot CLI, Kiro, CodeBuddy, Continue) plus DeepSeek Harness itself, groups servers by the file that declares them, probes each one over JSON-RPC to see whether it starts and which tools it exposes, and gives every server a switch that mounts or unmounts it in DeepSeek Harness without editing the other tools' own files.
- [wangbodbs/dsh-plugins#dsh-mcp-davinci-resolve](https://github.com/wangbodbs/dsh-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-mcp-davinci-resolve) - Registers the MCP server built into DaVinci Resolve 21.1+ as an MCP server in DSH, so an agent can drive Resolve through its scripting API.
- [wangbodbs/dsh-plugins#dsh-mcp-flapi](https://github.com/wangbodbs/dsh-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-mcp-flapi) - Registers FilmLight's official FLAPI MCP assistant (flapi-dev-mcp) as an MCP server in DSH, so an agent can write and run Baselight / Daylight FLAPI scripts.
- [wangcong1137-hash/dsh-geoserver](https://github.com/wangcong1137-hash/dsh-geoserver) - Read GeoServer WMS services and render map images in the dsh web GUI, with a settings card for server, username, and password.
- [wangxuewangxue98/dsh-daoyi-yijing](https://github.com/wangxuewangxue98/dsh-daoyi-yijing) - Yijing-based decision review plugin for DSH: six-layer weighted aggregation engine (384 yao to taiji) with strong-association veto rules, pure JS with zero solver dependencies. Free tier is capped at 9 runs per day and activation codes raise it; the stock-trend scenario pulls live quotes from Tencent for the stock codes in the request.
- [wangxuewangxue98/dsh-motor-ai](https://github.com/wangxuewangxue98/dsh-motor-ai) - Full edition of the motor-design AI plugin for DeepSeek Harness: adds the L1 (Ansys RMxprt) and L2 (Motor-CAD) precision layers on top of the L0 millisecond-level broad filter, completing an end-to-end chain from requirement parsing to parameter identification, candidate matrix, L0 pre-screening and L1/L2 verification. Mutually exclusive with dsh-motor-ai-l0 (uninstall l0 first); the shared core @wangxue98/dsh-motor-ai-core installs automatically. L1 needs Ansys AEDT (RMxprt) and L2 needs Motor-CAD installed locally. Distributed under the PolyForm Noncommercial licence; L1/L2 require an activation code. Telemetry is on by default: per-tool usage counts and design-experience samples that the author describes as desensitized are sent to the author's server at wangxuewangxue98.deno.net, and fault assistance can upload fault reports; switch them off with telemetryEnabled, designExperienceUpload and faultAssistEnabled in the plugin config.
- [wangxuewangxue98/dsh-motor-ai-l0](https://github.com/wangxuewangxue98/dsh-motor-ai-l0) - Motor-design AI assistant plugin: requirement parsing → parameter identification → candidate matrix → Top10 verification. L0 is a millisecond-level broad filter (pure JS, zero solver dependency) that ranks candidates and emits the handoff payload for the L1/L2 precision tools; usable as a local agent preset and Cordis plugin. L1 (RMxprt) and L2 (Motor-CAD) are reserved in this version — the level gate fails fast above l0.
- [wangzhanchao883/dsh-disk-manager](https://github.com/wangzhanchao883/dsh-disk-manager) - Scans the whole C drive and classifies every large folder into A/B/C/D/E/P (safe cache / relocatable / junction-movable / abandoned software / config-memory redline / personal files), then deletes, moves, or redirects on demand — with strong redline protection, dry-run preview and undo. Unknown software decided by LLM fallback + human confirmation. Works on DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7 through 0.2.x, tested on 0.2.0-rc.1.
- [wangzhanchao883/dsh-lost-and-found](https://github.com/wangzhanchao883/dsh-lost-and-found) - Local file recall: indexes the folders you choose into one local SQLite database, so 'where did I put that file?' is one query instead of a disk walk. Caches, VCS and program folders are pruned per directory; each folder keeps its own incremental anchor, so a folder added later is backfilled in full. Read-only: it never modifies, moves or deletes your files. Works on DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7 through 0.2.x, tested on 0.2.0-rc.1.
- [wangzhanchao883/dsh-resume-screening](https://github.com/wangzhanchao883/dsh-resume-screening) - Resume screening plugin for HR in DeepSeek Harness: ingest up to 100k Word/PDF/Excel resumes into one searchable library with skills / coarse categories / ingest time, auto-ingest & de-dupe new resumes, then screen by plain-language criteria — rule pre-filter in the database plus LLM fine-judge on the shortlisted few, CSV export. Works on DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7 through 0.2.x, tested on 0.2.0-rc.1.
- [wangzhanchao883/dsh-screenshot-capture](https://github.com/wangzhanchao883/dsh-screenshot-capture) - Point-and-shoot screenshot capture: a system floating window turns a new screenshot (or copied image) into an Obsidian note with comments and key-point marking, instant OCR through the host DSH multimodal model (no extra API key needed, Tongyi Qianwen as fallback), a duplicate-screen guard, per-day merging, and an optional evening AI organization pass.
- [wangzhanchao883/dsh-word-vault](https://github.com/wangzhanchao883/dsh-word-vault) - English word bank for one or more children, built for DSH 0.2 and newer (0.2.0-rc.1 and 0.2.0-rc.2 verified, including the desktop shell; 0.1.7 through 0.2.x all work). 1.10 added pronunciation: in the memory cards and in the online quiz every word and every example sentence has a speaker button that reads it aloud with the built-in Windows voice - offline, with no network call and no model call - and the whole batch of audio is pre-rendered in the background whenever cards or an exam are generated, so a click starts instantly. 1.11 adds: pick words in bulk straight from the library (10 at a time, top-down, up to 50 selected, with a live counter); turn the words a child got wrong in a quiz into a one-click review set - an online card page that speaks plus a printable PDF; and every card example sentence now carries its Chinese translation underneath. Words marked on textbook or workbook photos (highlighter, red pen) are found by their marks, then translated and stored in a local SQLite bank with an occurrence count; the clipboard picker, the photo route and dictation all land in the same bank. High-frequency words surface by count, three correct answers in a row flag a word as learned, and any selection prints as a memory card set (a word split into chunks, real IPA per chunk, a grade-7 example sentence, a mnemonic hook, an A4 sheet of eight) in HTML, PDF or Word, with a print-and-answer exam page whose four options are set against each other for meaning. On 0.1.5 the settings panel does not appear - install dsh-word-vault@1.0.2 instead.
- [DeepSeekLauncher](https://github.com/wangzhuoyuan229-source/DeepSeekLauncher) - macOS desktop launcher with an installation skill: starts or reuses the local DeepSeek Harness web service and opens it in Google Chrome, with a transparent character and thought bubble icon.
- [waning-sun/dsh-napcat-keeper](https://github.com/waning-sun/dsh-napcat-keeper) - Keeps the NapCat QQ backend alive next to DSH: probes the OneBot 11 HTTP port at startup, launches NapCat when the port does not answer, then rechecks every 45 seconds, kills duplicate process chains, hides the console window, can create a logon scheduled task when a task name is set, and adds a settings page plus napcat_status, napcat_restart and napcat_dedupe tools. Optionally remembers the QQ password, behind a risk confirmation, so an expired fast-login token can be renewed without scanning a QR code. Windows only; without that scheduled task the launched QQ exits together with DSH.
- [wanwulizhi/dsh-claude-code-sdk](https://github.com/wanwulizhi/dsh-claude-code-sdk) - Requires Claude Code installed and signed in on this machine. Delegates coding tasks to the local Claude Code agent through the Claude Agent SDK, reports which files changed, supports one-command revert, and adds a Claude Mode toggle to the composer.
- [Wanyi424/dsh-quick-translate](https://github.com/Wanyi424/dsh-quick-translate) - Quick translation using DSH models: streaming output, token usage details, and local history.
- [warmwine/dsh-memoryleak](https://github.com/warmwine/dsh-memoryleak) - Notes and todos as plain Markdown files in your workspace: type /ml plus a sentence to jot into today's journal; todos come in three flavors — deadline, sleep-until-a-date (auto-wakes when due), and anytime; /ml view fuzzy-opens any file with a few keystrokes. Zero tokens throughout — nothing goes through the model, and your notes stay ordinary local files that git and any editor can read.
- [wbb316/dsh-novel](https://github.com/wbb316/dsh-novel) - Novel-writing console for DSH: five novel_* tools for the agent (list, read, context, save chapter, cast) plus a side panel with a book wizard, a cast/relation view and streaming chapter continuation.
- [wbin0001/dsh-comfyui-canvas](https://github.com/wbin0001/dsh-comfyui-canvas) - From chat to canvas to artwork — drive ComfyUI as a visual workflow IDE inside DSH. Embed ComfyUI (local or cloud) as a split-screen canvas in DeepSeek Harness Web: the agent sparks ideas, writes prompts and scripts right in the chat, applies them live to the canvas in front of you, and produces images, music, video, and 3D. From idea to finished output without ever leaving the conversation or switching front-ends: Canvas ops — compose and arrange pipelines, read/write workflows, edit nodes, wire links, run, tune parameters, and debug errors, all live and WYSIWYG on the exact canvas you are looking at; Production tasks — batch parameter sweeps (batch_run) and automatic output-image retrieval back into the chat (get_outputs), powering multi-modal creative and batch generation across images, music, video, and 3D; Environment upkeep — one-click launch of ComfyUI and one-click upgrade of the core plus every custom node (upgrade), keeping the stack healthy without interruption. This package is the DSH-side plugin, and it ships the ComfyUI-side bridge node too.
- [webkubor/dsh-env-inspector](https://github.com/webkubor/dsh-env-inspector) - PC environment diagnostics & port control board: zero-dependency inspection of system, CLI toolchains, active listening ports with hover-to-kill release, and model key readiness. No external calls, zero plaintext secrets.
- [wee-b/disk-sentinel](https://github.com/wee-b/disk-sentinel) - Analyze Windows disk usage, compare scans, and manage cache cleanup and developer environment migration in DSH Web.
- [weibaohui/dsh-file-share](https://github.com/weibaohui/dsh-file-share) - Session workspace file manager: adds a "Files" tab to the conversation area to browse the current session workspace directory tree and manage it in place (upload, download, mkdir, rename, delete, search), with files mentionable into the composer for the agent to process.
- [weibaohui/dsh-webdav-server](https://github.com/weibaohui/dsh-webdav-server) - WebDAV server: turns a shared directory into a WebDAV service that Windows, macOS and Linux can mount as a local disk, with token authentication, optional read-only mode, configurable directory/port/token, and per-platform mounting guides built into the settings page.
- [weike-zhang/dsh-svg-motion](https://github.com/weike-zhang/dsh-svg-motion) - Turn any SVG logo into a motion video inside DSH: an `animate_svg` tool renders a transparent 30fps assembly animation (parts fly in, or the whole mark settles) and synthesizes an MP4 with ffmpeg.
- [weisiren000/dsh-remote-ssh-ops](https://github.com/weisiren000/dsh-remote-ssh-ops) - SSH remote ops for DSH: pair servers over SSH or a one-time-code remote-hostd, then run commands, manage background jobs, and read or write remote files with reviewable changes (host_pair/host_bash/host_jobs/host_read_file/host_write_file/host_review_changes).
- [weisofns/dsh-print3d](https://github.com/weisofns/dsh-print3d) - 3D printing & additive manufacturing plugin for DeepSeek Harness: parametric STL generation, calibration G-code, STL/G-code analysis, toolpath rendering and PrusaSlicer bridge, plus 5 skills and a concise persona optimized for local models.
- [weixshaw/dsh-rss](https://github.com/weixshaw/dsh-rss) - RSS/Atom reader with grouped subscriptions and unread/total counts, FreshRSS account sync over the Google Reader API with read/star written back, local image proxy, optional BYOK AI summary/translate/Q&A, podcast audio playback and full-text fetch.
- [welsione/dsh-mmx-bridge](https://github.com/welsione/dsh-mmx-bridge) - MiniMax multimodal bridge: one `mmx_bridge` tool covers image understanding/generation, video, TTS, music, cover, web search and quota; optional `web_search`/`read_image` takeover; inline players/image previews right in the Web GUI (npm: `dsh-mmx-bridge`).
- [Where227-arch/dsh-booth-search](https://github.com/Where227-arch/dsh-booth-search) - Search BOOTH for VRChat avatar assets — clothing, shaders, base models, accessories, textures, animations and props — from a dedicated BOOTH tab beside the conversation or via two read-only tools, with Chinese keywords translated to Japanese before the request.
- [whitefirer/dsh-browser-fs](https://github.com/whitefirer/dsh-browser-fs) - Give agents access to files on the machine where the browser runs: user authorizes a local directory via File System Access, tool calls relay over the plugin's own WebSocket; read-only compat mode for mobile/insecure contexts.
- [whyzsm/dsh-clipfile](https://github.com/whyzsm/dsh-clipfile) - Attach files and folders in the composer via clipboard paste, a native file/folder picker, and @-mention path search; folders are converted to paged Markdown for the agent to read page by page. macOS only (clipboard and picker go through osascript).
- [wilianyichen/dsh-deepseek-web](https://github.com/wilianyichen/dsh-deepseek-web) - Read-only DeepSeek web archive tools for DSH: list/download/search sessions, share-list, and a digest tool that compresses the 100-session history into one high-density page with activity bars and topic clusters. Write operations are intentionally not exposed (the web client rate-limits them). Requires the separately installed deepseek-ops Python client (github.com/Panniantong/deepseek-ops, by another author) with QR-code login; set scriptDir to its path.
- [windrover/dsh-plugin-update-checker](https://github.com/windrover/dsh-plugin-update-checker) - Adds a "Check updates" tab to the Built-in plugins settings: one row per installed bundle, with its latest npm version and an update button. Each row also reports DSH-runtime compatibility. The registry is read through the .npmrc chain (environment, then profile, then user, first hit wins); with nothing configured it races a mirror against the public registry, and a private registry is never raced against a public one. A version is installed from the registry it was read from.
- [WindyPro-rourou/dsh-logcat](https://github.com/WindyPro-rourou/dsh-logcat) - Android real-device debugging workbench for the DSH Web GUI: auto-attached logcat with severity/keyword filters and crash snapshots, live on-device screen casting with remote tap/swipe/text control, memory/proc/frida reverse-engineering toolset, 30 agent tools.
- [wing-tn/astro-ph-researcher](https://github.com/wing-tn/astro-ph-researcher) - Astronomy research workbench for DSH and Codex: NADC terms, reference library, writing, scoring, author confirmation, recommended books, FITS/XML formats, and analysis guides.
- [wingsky-1/dsh-plugin-hub#packages/dsh-mcp-manager](https://github.com/wingsky-1/dsh-plugin-hub/tree/main/packages/dsh-mcp-manager) - MCP server manager (stdio / streamable-http): per-working-directory project and global config tiers; project-level MCP collapsed into 4 atomic tools through a middleware layer by default (`middleware: all` folds in global servers too, hot-switchable in the settings page); workspace isolation prevents cross-project interference; configs keep `${ENV}` references only, with no plaintext secrets on disk; runtime registration API for other plugins to inject MCP servers.
- [wjf1/dsh-portable](https://github.com/wjf1/dsh-portable) - Export a whole working DSH home — profile, installed plugins with their node_modules, skills, hooks and task boards — into one .dshpkg tar and import it on another machine without network or pnpm; also streams over HTTP or a one-shot LAN link.
- [wjt0321/dsh-git-proxy](https://github.com/wjt0321/dsh-git-proxy) - On-demand GitHub proxy for the Web UI: one-click git/SSH proxy toggle with connectivity tests.
- [wlc114514/dsh-upload-origin](https://github.com/wlc114514/dsh-upload-origin) - Resolves the original local path of files uploaded to .dsh-uploads by matching file name, size, and sha256.
- [wly8691-jpg/dsh-office-com](https://github.com/wly8691-jpg/dsh-office-com) - COM-driven real Microsoft Office automation for DeepSeek Harness: drives a running Excel/Word instance through OfficeMCP — VBA macros, pivot tables, live formula recalculation, and deep document layout; plus an accounting suite (double-entry journal posting with debit/credit balance check, and SUMIF general ledger).
- [wly8691-jpg/knowlp-rag](https://github.com/wly8691-jpg/knowlp-rag) - Dual knowledge-graph RAG for Markdown notes with half-life memory decay: prerequisite + similarity graphs (P/S-Agent traversal), paragraph chunking, n-gram/embedding hybrid search, and an explicit weight-feedback loop — a native Cordis plugin, npm-installable as @eqman00003/knowlp-rag.
- [WODE25500/dsh-ip-info](https://github.com/WODE25500/dsh-ip-info) - IP/domain intelligence for DeepSeek Harness: ip_lookup, dns_lookup and whois_lookup tools via free no-key APIs (ipwho.is, Google DNS-over-HTTPS, RDAP).

- [xienda/dsh-jev-verify](https://github.com/xienda/dsh-jev-verify) - 0.8.6 fixes a startup crash: the host runtime package is an optional peer, never an installed dependency. TypeSafe Jev (System One decision model) wired end to end into DeepSeek Harness (0.8.6). Seven tools: jev_decision (1-25 parallel atomic verdicts in one call; noul/choice/score; typed answers with calibrated confidence; measured median 266-484 ms; verdicts only, never prose), jev_choose (rank 2-10 candidate approaches - fit 0-3 and risk - into an explicit composite with a recommended pick), jev_batch (NEW in 0.8.6: one set of 1-5 judgments over 1-20 texts, one real call per text at bounded concurrency, returning a paste-ready markdown table sortable by a judged dimension; built-in sentiment/priority/intent/pii/spam presets; a failed row is reported as failed with the raw error, never guessed), jev_usage (locally measured usage: calls, tokens, estimated cost, latency median and p95, per-tool mix, rolling windows, projected burn rate, optional local hard budgets, and a declared-balance remainder), jev_overview (session ledger), jev_guard_status (guard counters plus a registrations block that surfaces per-surface registration failures) and jev_verify (frozen 27-question live benchmark at concurrency 6: 96.3%, 26/27). WHAT IS NEW IN 0.8.6 - the ledger survives a restart, the remainder is derived instead of invented, and the plugin can now do batch paperwork. (1) The local ledger persists to $DSH_HOME/jev-usage.json BY DEFAULT, so the cumulative total no longer resets when the host restarts. Two real bugs behind the old silent zero were found and fixed: the ledger path only honoured DSH_HOME (absent inside the host process, so persistence was silently disabled and the file name was null), and save() wrote the still-empty in-memory ring over the history file because it ran before the first load while the debounce window swallowed the follow-up write. (2) Remaining is derived, never invented: TypeSafe exposes no balance endpoint - /v1/usage, /v1/quota, /v1/account, /v1/account/balance, /v1/balance, /v1/credits, /v1/billing, /v1/me, /v1/limits and a dozen more all return 404, and only /v1/models answers, with no balance headers - so the panel shows the remainder as your declared balance (quota.declaredBalanceUsd) minus locally measured spend since quota.balanceSince, and says plainly that it cannot be fetched instead of printing a number. (3) The composer pill re-reads every 20 s instead of every 60 s, so a call you just made shows up while you are still looking at it. (4) The collapsed pill leads with the remainder once you declare a balance, and the cumulative row is renamed when the ledger is on disk. Every tool has an in-conversation structured view; the Settings > Plugins card covers credentials, tool switches, the auto-guard, the dashboard, the prompt section, usage/quota and auto-triage. Honest by design: no API key means an explicit error, never fabricated results; every registration is quarantined so a failure degrades one surface. Tests 38/38 (npm test, ~2.5 s). Client half applies on refresh; server half needs a host restart.

- [Yubickari/dsh-semantic-drift](https://github.com/Yubickari/dsh-semantic-drift) - One versioned vocabulary of a project's business concepts, a read-only drift scan, and the same naming rules in every agent prompt.
- [YUEEEEY/dsh-desktop-tools](https://github.com/YUEEEEY/dsh-desktop-tools) - DSH environment management: auto-installs a Rust/Tauri desktop host (downloaded per-OS from dsh-desktop-host releases, source build as fallback), one-click runtime updates, Windows platform compatibility, official DeepSeek billing, and a built-in code editor for the workspace.
- [yuehancn/dsh-tool-archive](https://github.com/yuehancn/dsh-tool-archive) - Pack a directory into a deterministic tar, read an archive's contents without extracting it, unpack while refusing every member that could reach outside the destination, and verify what came out against what went in by SHA-256. No external dependency — the tar format is written and read in this plugin. Extraction is deliberately more permissive on reading than on writing, because a reader's job is to report what an archive says, while a writer must never emit what it cannot read back. A tar has no central index, so the walk tracks whether it reached the end-of-archive marker: without that, a half-file checksums fine and reads as complete.
- [yuehancn/dsh-tool-browser](https://github.com/yuehancn/dsh-tool-browser) - Open a page, wait for it the way it actually needs, extract the readable article, and take a screenshot. Playwright is optional: when it is absent the tools fall back to a static fetch and say so in the result, because a page whose JavaScript never ran means something different from one that rendered. Content is chosen by scoring candidate subtrees on prose density rather than on tag names, so a container loses to the article inside it instead of winning by containing more of the document.
- [yuehancn/dsh-tool-comfyui](https://github.com/yuehancn/dsh-tool-comfyui) - Generate images from chat by calling a fleet of local or LAN ComfyUI workers, with workflow templates, worker health checks and queue control.
- [yuehancn/dsh-tool-epub](https://github.com/yuehancn/dsh-tool-epub) - Read, build and take apart EPUB 3 books with no external dependency — the ZIP reader/writer and the XML scanner are both built in. Inspect metadata, reading order and TOC for structural problems, assemble a book from chapters, or split one back into per-chapter HTML.
- [yuehancn/dsh-tool-gzh-publisher](https://github.com/yuehancn/dsh-tool-gzh-publisher) - WeChat Official Account pipeline: validate a draft against a publish gate, then push it into the draft box.
- [yuehancn/dsh-tool-invoice](https://github.com/yuehancn/dsh-tool-invoice) - Pull invoice number, date, parties, tax IDs and the amount/tax/total triplet out of text, then verify that amount plus tax really equals the total and flag documents that do not reconcile.
- [yuehancn/dsh-tool-media](https://github.com/yuehancn/dsh-tool-media) - Drive a local ffmpeg as six structured tools: probe a file's streams, transcode or trim it, pull evenly-spaced frames or the audio track, and compress video to a byte budget with two-pass encoding.
- [yuehancn/dsh-tool-mining](https://github.com/yuehancn/dsh-tool-mining) - Turn a GitHub repository's raw counts into a defensible judgement — contributor concentration and bus factor with single-author files, merge time reported as a median beside the mean so an outlier is visible rather than hidden, and an issue backlog with pull requests and drafts filtered out. Reads the public REST API with no SDK, and never claims a truncated page is the whole answer.
- [yuehancn/dsh-tool-notion](https://github.com/yuehancn/dsh-tool-notion) - Convert Notion blocks and Markdown in both directions, with no API client and no external dependency. A Notion paragraph is an array of rich-text runs while Markdown says one string, so the two directions are a split and a merge rather than a pair of inverses — rich-text runs are cut at every annotation boundary one way and re-merged the other, with fences widened when the content already contains backticks. Reports every lossy step instead of swallowing it.
- [yuehancn/dsh-tool-ocr](https://github.com/yuehancn/dsh-tool-ocr) - Extract text from an image or PDF, reading a born-digital text layer directly and falling through to a configured OCR engine for scans.
- [yuehancn/dsh-tool-podcast](https://github.com/yuehancn/dsh-tool-podcast) - Turn a raw recording into a published podcast with a local ffmpeg — detect chapter boundaries from silence, cut at those boundaries, normalise loudness to a broadcast target in two passes, and write an iTunes-compatible RSS feed whose enclosure byte lengths are measured from disk.
- [yuehancn/dsh-tool-protobuf](https://github.com/yuehancn/dsh-tool-protobuf) - Read, audit and diff Protocol Buffer definitions without installing protoc: a zero-dependency .proto parser exposing six tools (status, outline, describe, diff, audit, next_number). diff classifies every change as breaking, risky or additive and names the wire-format consequence; audit catches what protoc accepts but a reviewer should not — duplicated or illegal field numbers, reserved-range collisions, unresolved types, and unreserved gaps below the high-water mark.
- [yuehancn/dsh-tool-qrcode](https://github.com/yuehancn/dsh-tool-qrcode) - Generate QR codes from a from-scratch ISO/IEC 18004 encoder with no external tools, plan symbol version and error-correction headroom before producing anything, and decode an existing symbol back to text.
- [yuehancn/dsh-tool-subtitle](https://github.com/yuehancn/dsh-tool-subtitle) - Read, write, convert and retime a subtitle track across SRT, WebVTT and ASS, audit it for over-long or unreadable cues, and transcribe audio through a configured speech recogniser.
- [yuezhiye/dsh-closet](https://github.com/yuezhiye/dsh-closet) - Per-workspace closet for temporary scripts and their run logs, kept in a .dsh-fix directory inside each project. Registers a script with its language and purpose, scans a project for leftover scratch scripts, backups and log files, runs registered scripts with a timeout and writes each run to a timestamped log, and sweeps chosen files into a reversible trash with per-batch restore. Scanning only lists and never deletes; cleanup moves files instead of deleting them; files already tracked by git are refused unless forced. Ships 7 agent tools and a settings panel.
- [yugejixian/vm-blackbox](https://github.com/yugejixian/vm-blackbox) - Black-box GUI testing for DeepSeek Harness: an AI tester drives a real Windows virtual machine using only screenshots and mouse/keyboard, so its verdicts rest on pixels instead of logs or source code. Ships the dsh-vm-tester plugin with twelve vm_* tools (status, UI tree, screenshot, click, type, type-secret, key, basic key, wait, snapshot, upload, download), a reverse-tunnel guest agent for Windows, and run verification scripts. Needs Windows, VirtualBox 7 and a Windows guest VM with the bundled agent before any vm tool works.
- [yuioi666/dsh-conversation-nav-dots](https://github.com/yuioi666/dsh-conversation-nav-dots) - Navigation dots for DSH Web conversations — quickly jump between user messages.
- [yuloong07-star/dsh-prompt-system](https://github.com/yuloong07-star/dsh-prompt-system) - Prompt optimizer in the composer: rewrites the draft into an eleven-section analytical prompt using the conversation, workspace files and the session's selected model, with one-click undo.
- [yunxiyang/dsh-web-search-litellm](https://github.com/yunxiyang/dsh-web-search-litellm) - Web search provider for the ctx.web seam that routes the DeepSeek web_search tool through a LiteLLM proxy using the OpenAI Responses API, reusing LITELLM_API_KEY.
- [YunzhouLi-hub/dsh-overall-mcp](https://github.com/YunzhouLi-hub/dsh-overall-mcp) - Host-wide MCP server panel: imports the servers declared in Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor and Codex CLI configs, searches six upstream catalogs and installs from whichever of them declares an install plan, asks only for the fields a server actually declares, and checks each row for whether the mount, the handshake and its tool list really work.
- [Yur0918/dsh-user-addons](https://github.com/Yur0918/dsh-user-addons) - Drag-and-drop file upload into the conversation composer, token usage pill with quota tracking, and session archive management — a three-in-one daily-driver addon.
- [Yurzi/dsh-pdf-mineru](https://github.com/Yurzi/dsh-pdf-mineru) - Provider-independent DSH document parsing powered by MinerU, with native background jobs, immutable results, and safe request coalescing.
- [Yurzi/dsh-tool-web-enhanced#profile](https://github.com/Yurzi/dsh-tool-web-enhanced/tree/main/packages/profile) - Switchable backends behind the native web_search and web_fetch, chosen per session from a composer menu or /setup-search and /setup-fetch: DeepSeek, Exa, Firecrawl, Tavily, Tinyfish, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar and server-side model search for search; local HTTP with a private-network allowlist, the DeepSeek Fetch API, Exa, Firecrawl, Tavily and Tinyfish for fetch.
- [Yuuyuko-uu/dsh-bili-subagent](https://github.com/Yuuyuko-uu/dsh-bili-subagent) - Lets the agent scan Bilibili through a subagent and report what is worth watching, with per-video notes, a card wall, and an inbox for mentions, replies and shared videos.
- [YV3507/dsh-webui-launcher](https://github.com/YV3507/dsh-webui-launcher) - Cross-platform Web UI launcher for DeepSeek Harness: webui_start/stop/status/open model tools, a /webui start|stop|status|open slash command, a Settings-page launch card, and an optional desktop shortcut that starts the Web UI hidden and opens the browser once it is fully ready (dsh default icon).
- [Yvesgao/dsh-shortcut-creator](https://github.com/Yvesgao/dsh-shortcut-creator) - Create a one-click Windows desktop shortcut from the Settings page: a .cmd launcher + desktop icon for DeepSeek Harness or any local server, auto-opens the browser, with taskbar pin hints.
- [ywgATustcbbs/dsh-human-task#dsh-human-task](https://github.com/ywgATustcbbs/dsh-human-task/tree/main/packages/dsh-human-task) - Human-in-the-loop tools (`human_task` / `human_task_ready_check`): pause the agent until the user performs a real-world action or returns an observation (GUI operation, game testing, visual verification, hardware checks), gated by session consent and an AFK presence check, returning a structured JSON result via a web task dialog.
- [yxy050208/multisim-mcp#deepseek-harness](https://github.com/yxy050208/multisim-mcp/tree/main/integrations/deepseek-harness) - Connects DeepSeek Harness to Multisim MCP for circuit generation, simulation, diagnostics, design optimization, and experiment report export.
- [yybukn/dsh-table-attach](https://github.com/yybukn/dsh-table-attach) - Attach tables and documents (xlsx, csv, pdf, zip…) to the DSH composer via paste or drag-and-drop: files are saved into the session workspace and an @reference is inserted.
- [yyfabab1/dsh-gpt-image](https://github.com/yyfabab1/dsh-gpt-image) - Game asset production pipeline: generate images, video and audio, turn a video into a coherent sprite animation, derive recoloured variants, adapt assets to an engine schema, install them into the project and verify the code actually references them. Requires ffmpeg for the video-to-sprite path, and an image/video API key (Agnes AI / OpenAI / fal) for generation.
- [YYK0402/dsh-siyuan-archive](https://github.com/YYK0402/dsh-siyuan-archive) - Archives DSH conversation output into SiYuan notes: a single siyuan_archive call files content under `<archive path>/<year-month>/<type>/<date>_<time>_<topic>_<content>` with a metadata table and auto-maintains an index document at the notebook root; 6 siyuan_* host tools (list notebooks, full-text search, read document, archive, delete block, remove document) and a Web settings page for base URL with connection test, API token in the host credential store, archive target and title template, plus notebook/document-level read/write/delete permissions with default deny and child levels able to only tighten.
- [YZz-S/dsh-bili-summary](https://github.com/YZz-S/dsh-bili-summary) - Provides the bili_summary tool: Bilibili video metadata, subtitle timeline, and sharp-based frame capture with built-in error handling and graceful degradation.

- [zdkcomeon/dsh-mcp-link](https://github.com/zdkcomeon/dsh-mcp-link) - Scans MCP configurations from local AI clients and project workspaces, imports selected servers into the active DSH profile, and provides JSON import and visual add, edit and removal controls.

- [zhujiuyi/dsh-mcpserver-manager](https://github.com/zhujiuyi/dsh-mcpserver-manager) - Manages the MCP servers of a DeepSeek Harness profile: lists each server with its connection state and the tools it registers, preflights a configuration before saving it (a missing executable, an npm package name used as a command, an unexpanded variable that would reach the child literally, a URL with no path), and adds servers by pasting a dsh patch fragment or a Claude Code mcpServers block, converted to the dsh shape.
- [zhuzhaoyun/Molio#dsh-plugin-molio](https://github.com/zhuzhaoyun/Molio/tree/main/packages/dsh-plugin-molio) - Read-only Molio knowledge base tools: list vaults, browse the file tree, full-text search and read documents, served over the local Molio daemon HTTP API, which must be running. Published on npm as dsh-plugin-molio.
- [zhuziddl/my](https://github.com/zhuziddl/my) - Windows NapCat deployment guide and read-only loopback port checks for DSH, with a user-initiated administrator launcher.

- [zi7tian/dsh-deepseek-billing-period](https://github.com/zi7tian/dsh-deepseek-billing-period) - DeepSeek API billing-period chip in the composer dock: shows whether the current time is peak or off-peak with a countdown to the next rate switch, opens the peak/off-peak window rules on click, and during peak hours intercepts sending to ask for confirmation first.
- [zi7tian/dsh-keep-awake](https://github.com/zi7tian/dsh-keep-awake) - Keeps the DSH host awake during active tasks using native power assertions and releases them when tasks finish.

- [zimai233/dsh-exam-countdown](https://github.com/zimai233/dsh-exam-countdown) - Query 64 Chinese exams (高考/考研/四六级/CPA/法考…) with rule-aware date math (2nd-Saturday, 1st-Sunday) and countdowns.
- [zimai233/dsh-figma-to-lottie](https://github.com/zimai233/dsh-figma-to-lottie) - Compile SVG paths and keyframe specs into self-contained Lottie JSON animation files.
- [zimai233/dsh-wash-calendar](https://github.com/zimai233/dsh-wash-calendar) - Recurring-habit scheduling from pure date math: next occurrence, range schedules, and overdue advice.
- [zirscard/dsh-context-extract](https://github.com/zirscard/dsh-context-extract) - Registers one `context_extract` tool for DeepSeek Harness: it compresses a long raw document (financial report, contract, ledger) into dense structured Markdown plus JSON — key metrics, tables, numbered clauses, entities and cross-check alerts — so a downstream pipeline can work from the compressed form instead of re-reading the raw document. Financial statements, legal contracts and business ledgers are detected and handled differently; balance-sheet and cash tie-outs are run and mismatches are flagged as alerts rather than silently fixed. Read-only; never modifies the source file. Requires Python with openpyxl and python-docx.
- [zirscard/dsh-office-audit](https://github.com/zirscard/dsh-office-audit) - Registers one `office_audit` tool for DeepSeek Harness: it recalculates formulas with the bundled LibreOffice Kit and then audits the recalculated values — formula errors, broken sheet references, formula-consistency, hardcoded constants, number-format and unit mismatches, balance-sheet balance, retained-earnings roll-forward, cash tie-out, cash-flow subtotals, ratio-table conventions and data-cleaning issues. Findings are severity-ranked with the offending cell, and an optional findings sheet can be written into a copy. The source workbook is never modified. Requires Python with openpyxl and the bundled LibreOffice Kit.
- [zirscard/dsh-principles-audit](https://github.com/zirscard/dsh-principles-audit) - Registers one `principles_audit` tool for DeepSeek Harness: it reviews a principle library for principle_id collisions and legacy ids, missing causal statements, boundaries, counter-examples or evidence, duplicate and near-duplicate principles, status-versus-confidence inconsistencies, long-stale entries and dimension-coverage gaps. Findings are severity-ranked and a hard gate turns them into pass, warn or fail, where every critical finding must be covered by a valid, unexpired exemption. The library is only read.
- [zirscard/dsh-valuation-service](https://github.com/zirscard/dsh-valuation-service) - Registers one `valuation_service` tool that reads a workpaper tree of 01/02/04 JSON and returns one unified schema: six ratio groups, forecast ratios, DCF input slots with explicit missing markers, comparable PS/PE and IRR. Deterministic and local: missing WACC, growth, capex, D&A or working-capital inputs stay blank instead of being guessed, and assumption differences are flagged for review.
- [zirscard/dsh-workpaper-gate](https://github.com/zirscard/dsh-workpaper-gate) - Registers one `workpaper_gate` tool for DeepSeek Harness: it audits a workpaper set for completeness, covering both the target design or template itself and the instance-versus-template structure, with the rule list, template list and core-table list all configurable in one spec file. Findings come back as blocker, warning and info, and the workpapers are only read, never modified. Requires Python with openpyxl.
- [ZiYuan258/dsh-mcp-control](https://github.com/ZiYuan258/dsh-mcp-control) - Panel for MCP servers registered by @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client: toggle each server on or off with live effect, see the registered tool count and estimated context-token cost of each server, and persist the choice to the home cordis.patch.yml with a timestamped backup before every write. The panel itself can sit either as a page inside Settings or as an icon row in the left sidebar, one seat at a time, with the switcher on the plugin page in Settings. Maintained fork of dsh-mcp-toggle.
- [zjl1989-li/dsh-harness-zh-cn](https://github.com/zjl1989-li/dsh-harness-zh-cn) - Chinese localization for DeepSeek Harness: translates all system prompts, tool descriptions, and runtime contexts into Chinese at runtime via the system-prompt/assemble waterfall (1788 entries, zero source modification, uninstall restores English).
- [ZK-Andy/dsh-frecency](https://github.com/ZK-Andy/dsh-frecency) - Resident-index grep for DeepSeek Harness that shadows the built-in grep/glob tools under the same names: repeated content searches hit an in-memory index ranked by access/modification frecency, and glob serves the built-in ripgrep semantics when available, falling back to the index otherwise.
- [zmh2000829/dsh-web-search-multi](https://github.com/zmh2000829/dsh-web-search-multi) - Selectable SearXNG, Brave, Tavily, Gemini Search Grounding, or Wikipedia backend for the native web_search tool, with Web settings and no implicit fallback.
- [zoahdev/dsh-artifacts](https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-artifacts) - Render Markdown + JSON into self-contained HTML documents, cards, dashboards, and galleries (CLI + artifact_render tool).
- [zoahdev/dsh-browser-use](https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-browser-use) - Browser Use cloud bridge for dsh: run real web tasks — open pages, click, type, fill forms, and extract data — through the Browser Use API.
- [zoahdev/dsh-firecrawl](https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-firecrawl) - Scrape URLs to LLM-ready Markdown and search the web via the Firecrawl Cloud API.
- [Zoria-Lind/dsh-behavior-enhancer](https://github.com/Zoria-Lind/dsh-behavior-enhancer) - Tool-call discipline for DeepSeek Harness: injects a static behavior-constraint prompt section, drops the parallel pool to 1 after a tool failure (restoring after 3 consecutive successes), nudges the model to stop retrying after repeated failures, verifies writes with .bak rollback, gates high-risk commands, and tracks compliance stats via /behavior-status.
- [zp-home/dsh-recommend](https://github.com/zp-home/dsh-recommend) - Transparent rankings and recommendations for the DSH plugin ecosystem: daily auto-fetched topic data, an open scoring model, and rank/search/recommend tools with a settings-page leaderboard.
- [ZRui-C/dsh-computer-use](https://github.com/ZRui-C/dsh-computer-use) - Text-first computer use for DSH: background Chromium control via Playwright/CDP plus accessibility-first macOS control; actions stay pinned to the right process and window without taking the user's pointer, ships a Developer ID signed, notarized Universal 2 DMG.
- [zuihouye/dsh-agnes-tools](https://github.com/zuihouye/dsh-agnes-tools) - Agnes AI image and video generation tools for DeepSeek Harness, where long video jobs can be resumed in a later call. Requires an Agnes API key (AGNES_API_KEY).
- [zxmqq1234/dsh-auto-retry](https://github.com/zxmqq1234/dsh-auto-retry) - Adds supplemental request retries, turn auto-continue and a no-response watchdog on top of built-in dsh retries, with a live countdown banner, toast notifications and a usage dashboard.
- [zz12hui/dsh-bili-video-summary](https://github.com/zz12hui/dsh-bili-video-summary) - Windows only. Bilibili video summarizer: downloads the audio track, transcribes it locally with faster-whisper (Python + faster-whisper, about 725 MB of models on first run), then writes the analysis markdown and renders a one-page infographic PNG.
- [zz12hui/dsh-deai-audit](https://github.com/zz12hui/dsh-deai-audit) - Audits Chinese copy for AI-sounding phrasing: a 0-100 score over six dimensions, sentence-level flags with rewrite hints, and per-genre weights adjustable in conversation.
- [zzy6-a/vision-use](https://github.com/zzy6-a/vision-use) - Desktop computer-use for DSH: captures the Windows screen into the agent vision channel and drives mouse/keyboard through a Codex-style overlay with Esc abort; auto-detects Windows native or WSL hosts.

- [173787247/dsh-wsl-distro](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-distro) - Reports the current WSL distro and warns about multi-distro setups.

- [173787247/dsh-wsl-download](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-download) - Lists or copies files from the Windows Downloads folder into the WSL workspace.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-editor](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-editor) - Opens a WSL Linux path in Windows Cursor, VS Code, or Notepad (optional line/column; win_editor_status).
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-encoding](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-encoding) - Reports PowerShell, cmd, and LANG encoding for UTF-8 versus code-page issues.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-env](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-env) - Injects WSL distro, Linux path mapping, /mnt/c CRLF and git caveats, and NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY into the system prompt.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-eventlog](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-eventlog) - Read recent Windows event log entries from WSL, filtered by log name, level, provider and time window.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-expose](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-expose) - Advises or applies allowlisted Windows portproxy for a WSL listen port, preferring the kit :3081 relay and launch token for local dsh UI.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-fetch](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-fetch) - Registers a wsl-proxy ctx.web fetch provider so official web_fetch uses undici ProxyAgent through HTTP(S)_PROXY instead of connecting from WSL to a DNS-pinned public IP (the official path that produces TypeError: fetch failed behind a Windows proxy).
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-git](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-git) - Capped Git status / diff --stat / log --oneline (no full patches).
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-github](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-github) - Uses a GitHub App to report open PRs and the latest Actions run for the current repo without returning secrets.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-glab](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-glab) - Read-only glab MR / issue / ci status.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-gpu](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-gpu) - Probes nvidia-smi and GPU visibility inside WSL.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-helm](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-helm) - Read-only Helm list / status / history.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-hostsvc](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-hostsvc) - Probes Windows-host Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, and llama-server from WSL, compares ctx, and reports /v1/models apiReady versus TCP.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-im](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-im) - Bridges Feishu, WeCom, DingTalk, QQ, Slack, Discord, Telegram and Mattermost into dsh agents (outbound WS/Stream/Gateway/long-poll/webhook), with im_status, optional local Whisper ASR, plain-text outbound for QQ/DingTalk/Telegram/Mattermost, and env CSV allowlists (DSH_IM_*_ALLOWED_USER_IDS). Empty allowedUserIds means EVERYONE can drive your agent — set a whitelist before exposing a bot.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-jev](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-jev) - Call TypeSafe Jev / OpenRouter System One for noul, choice, and score (jev_ask / jev_check / jev_rank).
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-k8s](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-k8s) - Read-only kubectl get / describe / logs / contexts for dsh on WSL (configurable log tail).
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-launch](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-launch) - Launches allowlisted Windows apps such as VS Code, Explorer, and browsers from WSL.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-llamacpp](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-llamacpp) - OpenAI-compatible client for llama.cpp / Unsloth Desktop (default :8080).
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-mail](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-mail) - Mail list/search via himalaya / notmuch (no send).
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-media](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-media) - Local media/doc pipeline: ffprobe, extract, thumbnail, PDF, ASR, pandoc, OCR, exif (allowRoots include IM inbox).
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-mnt](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-mnt) - Warns when the workspace path sits on slow /mnt/c.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-net](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-net) - Adds a net_doctor tool that reports proxy environment, NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY, and reachability of the DeepSeek API and the npm registry, and sets NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY on bash and npm child processes.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-notify](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-notify) - Shows a short Windows MessageBox or toast (BalloonTip) from WSL when a long task finishes.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-obscura](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-obscura) - Optional Obscura headless-browser tools from WSL (obscura_status / obscura_fetch / obscura_mcp_hint). Not the same as dsh-wsl-browser win_open_url (Windows GUI browser), and not a replacement for dsh-wsl-fetch web_fetch.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-obsidian](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-obsidian) - Bridges a WSL dsh agent to a Windows Obsidian vault on NTFS: status/list/search/read/write/append, wikilink resolve, write/append require confirm=true, plus obsidian:// open. Keep the vault under /mnt/<drive>/; Linux-disk vaults via \\wsl$ are unreliable.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-ollama](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-ollama) - Local Ollama status / list / chat / embed for dsh on WSL (unreachable status includes Windows/WSL gateway hints).
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-open](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-open) - Opens WSL Linux paths from DeepSeek Harness chat in the Windows default app or Explorer.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-path](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-path) - Converts Linux and Windows paths with /mnt/c caveats for WSL.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-perf](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-perf) - Windows host performance from WSL: CPU, memory, disk and top processes.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-picker](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-picker) - Browse WSL directories under / and /mnt for workspace picking (start/filter; im-workspace shortcuts).
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-pkg](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-pkg) - Dependency tree summaries: npm / pip / cargo.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-playwright](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-playwright) - Headless Playwright fetch (title + body text) in WSL.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-port](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-port) - Diagnoses WSL port listening and Windows localhost forwarding, with a 3080/3081 uiPlaybook for the dsh web relay and launch token.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-power](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-power) - Windows power state from WSL: active power plan, all schemes, battery, sleep timeout and hibernation availability.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-rclone](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-rclone) - Read-only rclone listremotes / lsf / about.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-registry](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-registry) - Read-only Windows registry access from WSL, restricted to an allowlist of key prefixes; list a key's values or its child keys.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-search](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-search) - Sandboxed ripgrep / fd / ast-grep under allowRoots (defaults include ~/.dsh/im-workspace).
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-secret](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-secret) - Read-only pass / age secrets with allowPrefixes; reveal defaults to false.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-service](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-service) - Read Windows service state from WSL: list services, or inspect one by name with its dependencies, logon account and binary path.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-shot](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-shot) - Saves a Windows clipboard image into a WSL file (clear ok:false + hint when clipboard has no image).
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-ssh-agent](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-ssh-agent) - Hints how to forward the Windows OpenSSH agent into WSL without dumping keys.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-struct](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-struct) - Sandboxed jq / yq / read-only sqlite3.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-systemd](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-systemd) - Read-only systemd --user list / show / journal.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-terraform](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-terraform) - Terraform/OpenTofu plan summary + state list (never apply).
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-tmux](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-tmux) - Read-only tmux list + capture-pane.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-tray](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-tray) - Writes a Windows shortcut and tray launcher to start dsh web in WSL, with Health/Restart and the :3081 launch-token URL.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-uia](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-uia) - Windows UI Automation from WSL: enumerate top-level windows, read a bounded element tree, and wait for or trace the path to a named element.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-vecmem](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-vecmem) - Tiny local vector memory via Ollama embeddings and ~/.dsh/vecmem (workspace namespaces; optional IM crumb via vecmemOnReply).
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-vllm](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-vllm) - OpenAI-compatible vLLM client (default :8000).
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-winctl](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-winctl) - Enumerate and control Windows top-level windows from WSL: activate, minimize, maximize, restore, move, resize, set always-on-top, close.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-wininput](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-wininput) - Targeted Windows input from WSL: invoke a UI Automation element by name, or send keys, clicks and mouse wheel to a chosen window.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-winshot](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-winshot) - Capture a Windows window to a WSL file, whole or cropped to a region or to a named UI element.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-workspace](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-workspace) - Lists WSL distros and validates a Linux workspace path for DSH.
- [173787247/dsh-wsl-wslconfig](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-wslconfig) - Gives read-only advice for Windows .wslconfig memory and mirrored networking.
- [6Mikao9/dsh-wsl-workspace](https://github.com/6Mikao9/dsh-wsl-workspace) - Add a WSL workspace from the web GUI without needing to install dsh or related tools again inside WSL. Bash commands and file read/write operations run within the local WSL distribution on the host machine, while Windows files remain accessible.
- [Edge-Echo/dsh-win-toolkit](https://github.com/Edge-Echo/dsh-win-toolkit) - Windows-native tools for DSH agents: clipboard read and write, system notifications, hosts file inspection and network diagnostics, each returning structured data with UI cards from injection-safe PowerShell.
- [Han-1413141/dsh-wsl-native](https://github.com/Han-1413141/dsh-wsl-native) - Use Windows and native Linux DSH sessions in one Windows window, with WSL environment switching and bidirectional system tools.
- [jack-ranbo/dsh-wsl-expose](https://github.com/jack-ranbo/dsh-wsl-expose) - Expose the DSH Web GUI over IPv6 or IPv4 from WSL2 through a reverse proxy (Lucky): /wan up sets up the socat relay, Windows portproxy, firewall, and trusted-host fence, with a Settings card plus commands to configure the domain and ports.
- [Jumqyc/dsh-wsl-gpufix](https://github.com/Jumqyc/dsh-wsl-gpufix) - Adds /dev/dxg and /proc read-write grants to the DSH Landlock sandbox on WSL2, so CUDA is available inside a confined agent bash session.
- [King20260919/dsh-open-folder-visible](https://github.com/King20260919/dsh-open-folder-visible) - Fixes the Windows workspace-open action: the shipped opener spawns explorer.exe with windowsHide, so the File Explorer window is created invisible and the click reports success without appearing.
- [liyu34/dsh-wsl-tray](https://github.com/liyu34/dsh-wsl-tray) - Windows desktop shortcut and system-tray launcher for DSH running in WSL, with fully hidden startup, tray open/restart/exit menu, and a plugin-configuration card to manage the shortcut.
- [lucifergzsz414/dsh-windows-native](https://github.com/lucifergzsz414/dsh-windows-native) - Injects native-Windows (non-WSL) PowerShell, encoding, filesystem, and cross-platform-build gotchas into the system prompt.
- [QiYunqv-jxd/dsh-desktop-autostart](https://github.com/QiYunqv-jxd/dsh-desktop-autostart) - Adds a logon autostart switch for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app on Windows. It manages a single shortcut in the user Startup folder: no registry writes, no admin rights, no extra background process.
- [road-kid/dsh-terminal-shell](https://github.com/road-kid/dsh-terminal-shell) - Choose which shell backs the Windows terminal tool: PowerShell, the local Git Bash, or cmd.exe.
- [TGWgulugu/dsh-wsl-bridge](https://github.com/TGWgulugu/dsh-wsl-bridge) - Runs persistent bash and Linux-path file and search tools inside the current WSL distribution. A new conversation that selects WSL mode asks which of that distribution's folders to use as the workspace, and nothing is installed inside the distribution.
- [WilliamShi666/dsh-wsl-workspace-picker](https://github.com/WilliamShi666/dsh-wsl-workspace-picker) - Enhanced workspace directory browser for the web UI: one-click access to /mnt Windows drives under WSL, full breadcrumb ancestry and an always-visible path input.
- [XINY11451/dsh-wsl](https://github.com/XINY11451/dsh-wsl) - Extends the working range of DSH into WSL. Files in the distribution can be read, written, edited and searched by DSH directly. Depending on the task, the AI chooses for itself: run a one-off command, or open its own terminal and run several commands there to finish the job. Typing `dsh` in a WSL terminal calls DSH (type `dsh help` there for details), fusing WSL and DSH deeply. Every terminal you open can collaborate visually with the AI.
- [yishuiliufang/dsh-wsl-first](https://github.com/yishuiliufang/dsh-wsl-first) - Publishes an ordered system prompt section that names wsl as the command executor to reach for first, so the agent prefers WSL over PowerShell on Windows. Registers no tools, and only advertises executors the agent can actually call.

### Browser & Web

- [131CDA1/dsh-scrape-webpage](https://github.com/131CDA1/dsh-scrape-webpage) - Fetches any http/https page and returns title, description, main text, heading outline and links, with stats (char/word counts, reading time, language) and top keywords; can download content images to the session workspace for vision analysis and dispatch them to registered analyzers via the scrape.imageAnalyzer service.
- [1624318455/dsh-plugin-tavily](https://github.com/1624318455/dsh-plugin-tavily) - Tavily-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key, result count, and recency window.
- [16601134718/dsh-codex-cua](https://github.com/16601134718/dsh-codex-cua) - Installs the codex-cua skill so DeepSeek Harness can use Codex computer use: drives Chrome and native macOS apps through the runtime bundled with the ChatGPT/Codex desktop app, ships a persistent session client and a doctor self-check. Requires the ChatGPT/Codex desktop app with its Chrome extension, Python 3.9+, and macOS.
- [240xu/dsh-websearch](https://github.com/240xu/dsh-websearch) - Aggregated web search provider that fans one query out to 11 engines (Exa, Parallel, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG, Brave, Tavily, Serper, Mojeek, DeepSeek, Anthropic, OpenAI) concurrently, URL-dedupes and merges the results. Ships a settings card for toggling backends, storing API keys in the credential store, and tuning concurrency and timeouts.
- [263311487-ux/dsh-verify](https://github.com/263311487-ux/dsh-verify) - Independent browser acceptance testing for agent deliverables: JSON spec in, real-Chromium verdict out.
- [2672243194/dsh-read-url](https://github.com/2672243194/dsh-read-url) - Read any page as clean main content: charset auto-detect (GBK/GB2312/UTF-8/Big5), noise stripping, compact text/Markdown, offset continuation, optional SPA rendering, batch reads and site crawling.
- [27painter/dsh-moli](https://github.com/27painter/dsh-moli) - Drives a locally installed Moli headless browser from DeepSeek Harness: rendered fetch, JavaScript evaluation, Markdown, semantic trees, screenshots and PDFs. A CSS selector returns one container rather than the whole page (measured 40-80x fewer tokens on listing pages) and scroll triggers lazy loading. Installs Moli when it is missing; verified with a real engine on Windows, Linux and macOS.
- [dsh-inpage-translator](https://github.com/7gzgn/dsh-inpage-translator) - A persistent translate button lives in every page the browser opens: click it and every visible text node is replaced in place, click again to restore. Hold to drag, drop it near an edge and it tucks into a small handle; it is re-injected automatically after navigation. The host LLM service does the translation — the plugin holds no API key.
- [A3Boy/dsh-web-tools](https://github.com/A3Boy/dsh-web-tools) - Unified multi-provider web search and fetch: BYOK key pools, health monitoring, and deterministic fallback.
- [aa2246740/dsh-firecrawl](https://github.com/aa2246740/dsh-firecrawl) - Adds a Firecrawl search provider with multi-account API-key settings.
- [alllllinnrann/dsh-inapp-browser](https://github.com/alllllinnrann/dsh-inapp-browser) - Shared browser panel for DeepSeek Harness via Better Sidebar, with local Chromium, human and agent mouse and keyboard control, page snapshots, screenshots, and per-chat persistent profiles.
- [angelky7/dsh-browser-control](https://github.com/angelky7/dsh-browser-control) - Controls your real Chrome from DSH over a local WebSocket bridge: tab management, navigation, DOM snapshots, page JS evaluation, clicks, typing, screenshots, waits and dialog handling behind a Settings toggle.
- [ankye/dsh_use_browser#use-browser](https://github.com/ankye/dsh_use_browser/tree/main/packages/use-browser) - Generic browser automation with six tools (browser_open, browser_click, browser_type, browser_extract, browser_screenshot, browser_eval), @e element references, and dual Playwright-headless / CDP (connect to your own Chrome) backends.
- [anweat/dsh-browser](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-browser) - Self-contained browser runtime: Playwright (chromium) + OpenCLI as plugin-local dependencies (global reuse fallback), exposes a `browser` service and 9 interactive browser tools.
- [anweat/dsh-web-search-pro](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-web-search-pro) - Persistent enhanced web search: multi-engine routing (DeepSeek/Exa/DDG/Bing/Jina + GitHub/Bilibili/YouTube/V2EX/Xiaohongshu/Twitter/Reddit/RSS), SQLite+LRU cache, userscript-style extraction, Playwright rendering.
- [ArcaneOrion/dsh-tavily-web](https://github.com/ArcaneOrion/dsh-tavily-web) - Tavily search and page fetch: tavily_search queries with a rotating pool of up to eight API keys that backs off per key on 401/403/429 so one exhausted account does not take the tool down, and web_fetch retrieves a single page through curl, returning its HTTP status with de-tagged text.
- [Azhe0306/dsh-connectors#browser-connector](https://github.com/Azhe0306/dsh-connectors/tree/main/packages/browser-connector) - Browser automation connector: drives the local Edge or Chrome over the DevTools Protocol with zero runtime dependencies — launch a headless throwaway-profile browser or attach to one started with --remote-debugging-port, then navigate, read page text and interactive elements, click, type, and screenshot through 11 agent tools.
- [Baisbt/dsh-plugin-webrelay](https://github.com/Baisbt/dsh-plugin-webrelay) - Embeds external AI chat sites in a DSH side panel through the same-origin reverse proxy with per-site DOM adapters, and adds a composer button that either rewrites the draft with the host model or runs a two-round loop: compress the conversation, optimize, send to the embedded site, capture the reply, then finalize it into the composer.
- [Barry-1212/dsh-webscout](https://github.com/Barry-1212/dsh-webscout) - Tavily-backed web search and page fetch for DeepSeek Harness: a Search provider, a Fetch provider with Tavily Extract, Firecrawl and direct HTTP modes, and a settings card. Needs a Tavily API key; Firecrawl is optional.
- [BeatAPI/beatapi-agent-plugin#dsh-browser](https://github.com/BeatAPI/beatapi-agent-plugin/tree/main/packages/dsh-browser) - Connects Harness to the published BeatBrowser runtime with namespaced MCP tools and a TaskSpace Skill; requires the Chrome extension and preserves manual takeover.
- [big0lives/dsh-web-window-companion](https://github.com/big0lives/dsh-web-window-companion) - Opens the dsh web GUI in a dedicated Edge/Chrome app-mode window on its own browser profile and gracefully stops the server when that window is closed.
- [BitDG/dsh-plugins#reference-library](https://github.com/BitDG/dsh-plugins/tree/main/plugins/reference-library) - Adds CodePen, Pinterest, Z-Library, and GitHub data cards to the native @ reference menu, with Pinterest pagination and Z-Library sorting.
- [bpc-oss/chrome-faithful#dsh-plugin-chrome-faithful](https://github.com/bpc-oss/chrome-faithful/tree/main/packages/dsh-plugin-chrome-faithful) - Exact-profile control of your real logged-in Chrome browser: an MCP server plus MV3 extension and authenticated localhost bridge for tabs, locators, file injection, media export, and durable scroll capture, with no debug profile or remote-debugging port.
- [BrambleXu/dsh-annotate](https://github.com/BrambleXu/dsh-annotate) - Select browser elements directly during Vibe Coding and send structured visual feedback to the DeepSeek Harness Agent.
- [bug-huntter/web-search-advanced](https://github.com/bug-huntter/web-search-advanced) - Switchable web-search provider for DSH: native DeepSeek web search or an OpenAI-compatible custom backend. Installation automatically routes DSH web searches to the plugin; only provider, API key and model are required. Published on npm as @lp181818/web-search-advanced@0.1.3.
- [cfanmaoli/kimi-webbridge-dsh](https://github.com/cfanmaoli/kimi-webbridge-dsh) - Provisions the kimi-webbridge bridge daemon (auto-install with SHA-256 verification, auto-start) and registers a 25-action skill that drives the user's real browser through the local bridge.
- [chendefine/dsh-web-fetch-playwright](https://github.com/chendefine/dsh-web-fetch-playwright) - Playwright/CDP web-fetch provider for the built-in web_fetch tool: renders pages in a real browser, denoises them (Readability + DOMPurify) and returns markdown.
- [chendefine/dsh-web-search-aggregation](https://github.com/chendefine/dsh-web-search-aggregation) - Aggregated web-search provider for the built-in web_search tool: one prioritized queue over nine providers (AnySearch, TinyFish, Tavily, Brave, Exa, Firecrawl, Jina, SerpApi, Serper), with multi-key rotation per provider, ordered fallback on failed attempts, and a live settings card.
- [CJYLZS/dsh-browser](https://github.com/CJYLZS/dsh-browser) - Give the dsh agent a real browser: each conversation gets its own Chrome or Edge process with its own profile and CDP port, driven by six tools and mirrored live in the right sidebar, where you can watch the work and take over by clicking or typing on the picture. Nothing else to install — it uses the Chrome or Edge already on the machine, downloads no browser, needs no companion app or extension, and keeps its tabs and sign-ins between tool calls.
- [copylee711/dsh-free-search](https://github.com/copylee711/dsh-free-search) - Web search provider with switchable engines, several usable without an API key (Bing, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG and others) and a fallback order between them; adds multi_search, platform_search, image_search with an in-chat image wall, page_images and save_images, plus a settings page for engines, keys and per-engine proxy.
- [CREAIT-nl/dsh-plugins#web-fetch](https://github.com/CREAIT-nl/dsh-plugins/tree/main/web-fetch) - A guarded local fetch provider for the ctx.web seam — the backend dsh does not ship for its own web_fetch tool. Every redirect hop is re-resolved and checked against the non-routable ranges, with a streamed size cap and a content-type allowlist.
- [CREAIT-nl/dsh-plugins#web-search-searxng](https://github.com/CREAIT-nl/dsh-plugins/tree/main/web-search-searxng) - Points web_search at a self-hosted SearXNG instance instead of the native route: pages until maxResults is satisfied, and reports degraded coverage when engines fail so a thin result set is not read as a thin web.
- [cslkkl/dsh-web-annotator](https://github.com/cslkkl/dsh-web-annotator) - Annotate pages inside the existing Harness Browser: click or drag to select, comment or ask, then send marked screenshots or DOM location details to the current session. While enabled it replaces the official Browser, Chat and Layout providers; targets Harness 0.2.1-alpha.2.
- [d342784178/dsh-opencli](https://github.com/d342784178/dsh-opencli) - Browser tools for DSH that POST to the local OpenCLI daemon instead of spawning the opencli CLI per command, avoiding its cold start: oc_status, oc_exec, oc_navigate, oc_snapshot and oc_tabs, with one persistent automation tab per session.
- [DDDMUC/dsh-free-search](https://github.com/DDDMUC/dsh-free-search) - Free, keyless web search for DSH: 7 engines (DuckDuckGo/Bing/SearXNG free + Exa/Perplexity/DeepSeek paid), auto-failover, settings-page UI with API key inputs and official links, web_fetch, and an engine test tool.
- [Decodo/dsh-web-fetch](https://github.com/Decodo/dsh-web-fetch) - Decodo Web Data API as the fetch provider behind the built-in web_fetch tool: returns Markdown by default, pins fetchProvider to decodo, and enforces a configurable per-process fetch cap. Requires a Decodo API key; web_search is unchanged.
- [delef/dsh-free-web-search](https://github.com/delef/dsh-free-web-search) - Free web search with 10 engines (Bing/DuckDuckGo/SearXNG/AnySearch free + Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Perplexity/DeepSeek paid), automatic fallback chain, time-filtered advanced search, platform search (GitHub/Reddit), web page fetching, LRU caching, and a settings UI. No API keys required for basic use.
