- [dengpeihua/dsh-browser-use](https://github.com/dengpeihua/dsh-browser-use) - Real browser tools for DeepSeek Harness: browse and extract web content, fill forms, manage multiple tabs, and execute multi-step tasks, with incremental DOM, session isolation, screenshots, action-result checks, and archived evidence recall.
- [deqingLv/dsh-chrome-attach](https://github.com/deqingLv/dsh-chrome-attach) - Attaches the current Chrome tab to a DSH draft: one pick screenshots the page (falling back to a macOS window shot) and writes its title and URL into the composer as one line.
- [DightEndless/dsh-browser#packages/browser/bridge-browser](https://github.com/DightEndless/dsh-browser/tree/main/packages/browser/bridge-browser) - Open the extension side panel and it takes over the page you are browsing right now. On top of upstream it adds: hover, coordinate clicks, drag, batched action chains, whole-page screenshots, local file upload, image listing, and switching between several connected browsers. Pages reach the model as structured text with a numbered element list; actions wait for your approval and sensitive fields stay masked. Ships as the bridge plugin, with the extension in the same release. This project is a fork of omdsh-dev/dsh-browser: https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser
- [dougen/dsh-cdp](https://github.com/dougen/dsh-cdp) - Drives a Chromium browser you are already running — Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Opera, Chromium, Arc or Thorium — over one long-lived CDP connection, so the remote-debugging approval is asked once instead of per command. Commands for tabs, navigation, JS evaluation, DOM snapshots, clicks, typing, screenshots and CSS/DOM/pixel assertions go over a loopback HTTP route that the agent calls with the shell tool it already has, so no new tools are registered, and the plugin registers its own usage skill with no runtime dependencies.
- [drscrewdriver/dsh-browser-cdp](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-browser-cdp) - Visible agent browser over CDP: 30+ bcdp_* automation tools, realtime SSE watch panel with direct click/scroll/IME input, element picking quoted into the composer as balanced @"picks/*.json" references, and human-verification notices.
- [drscrewdriver/dsh-union-search](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-union-search) - Union web search for DSH (consolidated successor of DDDMUC/dsh-free-search, which it credits): 28 engines across three tiers — keyless free (Bing/DuckDuckGo/AnySearch/SearXNG multi-instance union, plus Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Firecrawl/Parallel keyless modes), paid-with-key (Zhihu/Perplexity/Serply/DeepSeek official/You.com/Baidu/Kimi/Aliyun/Doubao/Zhipu/Bocha/Metaso), and model built-in search (OpenAI/Gemini/Claude/Grok, explicit opt-in only) — with auto smart routing, per-engine enable/disable & fallback priority, parallel top-3 merge, multi_search, failure-aware fallback, a toggle to block the system built-in search, time filtering, platform search, web_fetch and a web settings UI. Experimental free advance_fetch: whole-page GFM-Markdown or CSS-selector/fields structured extraction with no API key and no per-call billing; fetch identity configurable (custom User-Agent, Referer, per-domain cookies attached only on domain match, never leaked across cross-domain redirects). Hosts 0.1.0-rc.2 through 0.2.1-rc.2 (17-tag exact engines.dsh enum; the rc.2 search-provider takeover goes through volatile config pinning after capability probing, never version branches). Paid engines need your own API keys (optional; free engines work keyless). npm: @drscrewdriver/dsh-union-search and bare dsh-union-search.
- [EdwinDigital/dsh-web-search-microsoft-webiq](https://github.com/EdwinDigital/dsh-web-search-microsoft-webiq) - Microsoft Web IQ search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key, endpoint, language, region, passage length and SafeSearch.
- [elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl](https://github.com/elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl) - Firecrawl-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key and result limits.
- [fno2010/dsh-web-search-ext](https://github.com/fno2010/dsh-web-search-ext) - Multi-backend web_search provider (Exa + Firecrawl) for the built-in web_search tool, with automatic failover, per-backend 429 cooldowns, and key-free anonymous access.
- [Geighlord007/qp-exa-dynamic](https://github.com/Geighlord007/qp-exa-dynamic) - Exa-backed web search provider for the ctx.web seam, with Exa Dynamic Highlights on by default and the Exa-Beta header that setting requires; exposes all eight Exa retrieval types, adds an /exa command to change highlights, search type and result count at runtime, and registers an exa_search tool that takes its own result count.
- [godchen520/dsh-web-search-bing](https://github.com/godchen520/dsh-web-search-bing) - Bing-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: prefers Bing's RSS feed with the public cn.bing.com HTML page as fallback, no API key, reachable from mainland China, and keeps searches off the model's own search quota. Endpoint, result count and result language configurable; targets DSH 0.2.x (also works on 0.1.7+).
- [graydovee/dsh-browser#packages/browser/bridge-browser](https://github.com/graydovee/dsh-browser/tree/main/packages/browser/bridge-browser) - Side-panel Chrome and Firefox extension that lets DSH drive the tab you are on: pages reach the model as structured text with a numbered element list, and clicks, typing and navigation wait for your approval. Beyond upstream it adds viewport screenshots, opening a URL in a new window, scrolling inside nested scroll containers (chat transcripts, side panes, modal bodies), permission-mode, model and slash-command controls in the composer, and an opt-in developer-tools group (elements and CSS, page JavaScript, network requests) that is off by default and approved per call. The install is two halves: the bridge plugin comes from the prebuilt release tarball, and the companion extension ships as a tgz in the same release and is loaded unpacked, which is the only way Chrome accepts it. This project is a fork of omdsh-dev/dsh-browser: https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser
- [GreyRaphael/dsh-web-fetch-moli](https://github.com/GreyRaphael/dsh-web-fetch-moli) - Ultra-lightweight Moli (Rust headless browser) web-fetch provider for DeepSeek Harness: renders complex SPAs, micro-frontends, and dynamic pages with ~60MB memory.
- [gulagala001/opencu](https://github.com/gulagala001/opencu) - Browser and desktop application control with live previews, annotations and native Hyprland support.
- [guo6x/dsh-pilot](https://github.com/guo6x/dsh-pilot) - Zero-dependency browser control: drive a real headless Edge/Chrome over CDP with 8 `pilot_*` tools (navigate/click/type/keys/eval/screenshot) plus a live draggable cockpit panel in the Web GUI - text-first snapshots for text-only models, no Playwright, no API key.
- [hermes-ai-2026/dsh-browser-agent](https://github.com/hermes-ai-2026/dsh-browser-agent) - 19 browser_* tools that let agents drive DeepSeek Harness's built-in sidebar browser over a loopback bridge: accessibility-tree reads with stable refs, real CDP clicks and keys, screenshots, network interception, device emulation, a cookie vault, document-start script injection, multiple browser instances, and raw CDP passthrough. Requires DSH launched with --remote-debugging-port=9222.
- [htcqp802/dsh-web-search-openai](https://github.com/htcqp802/dsh-web-search-openai) - OpenAI-compatible web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: one baseURL/apiKey/model config powers Qwen Token Plan, OpenAI and any Responses API gateway.
- [HXwHSJS/dsh-web-annotation](https://github.com/HXwHSJS/dsh-web-annotation) - Annotate elements, blank positions or dragged regions in the DSH right-Sidebar Browser tab; each batch is saved as screenshots plus report files and attached to the next message as text. Does not replace the official Browser, Chat or Layout providers.
- [IKEASven69/dsh-opencli](https://github.com/IKEASven69/dsh-opencli) - Logged-in browser automation with 170+ site adapters as deterministic one-shot commands (requires the OpenCLI CLI, npm i -g @jackwener/opencli, and its BrowserBridge browser extension) — action-evidence verification (no silent failures), site knowledge & health cards, watch monitoring, trace replay, provenance reports, and a write-approval gate.
- [iStarryDust/dsh-browser](https://github.com/iStarryDust/dsh-browser) - Built-in browser: gives the agent a real headed Chromium it can open, click, type and scroll in, keeping page state across calls.
- [jaibhasin/dsh-browser-agent#dsh-plugin](https://github.com/jaibhasin/dsh-browser-agent/tree/main/dsh-plugin) - Chrome side-panel browser agent for DeepSeek Harness with tools to inspect pages, navigate, click, type, scroll, and capture screenshots through a local bridge.
- [Jakcet/dsh-dschat](https://github.com/Jakcet/dsh-dschat) - Embeds the DeepSeek web chat (chat.deepseek.com) in a DSH Desktop main panel through an Electron webview guest, with a back/forward/reload toolbar and a local snapshot of login-related localStorage restored on the next open.
- [jaychang1989/dsh-webchat](https://github.com/jaychang1989/dsh-webchat) - Opens the official DeepSeek web app (chat.deepseek.com) inside DeepSeek Harness: one sidebar entry renders the real page in the center column through the desktop shell's native browser guest, and keeps you signed in across restarts. The official client keeps its model picker, deep think, smart search, history and attachments. Falls back to opening a window where no guest bridge exists.
- [JayYuen666/dsh-scrapling](https://github.com/JayYuen666/dsh-scrapling) - Wraps the Scrapling Python library in up to nineteen model tools, registered by probed capability: real-browser rendering for JavaScript-only pages, CSS/XPath extraction that returns data instead of Markdown, self-healing selectors, reusable login-state sessions, XHR capture, page screenshots, gated browser actions and a domain-scoped crawler with content/sitemap/feed/Shopify modes on the official job backend. It can also replace the built-in web_fetch / web_search, and serve the same tool table over MCP. Requires Python 3.14+ with Scrapling installed; the browser tools also need a Chromium engine for patchright, which an optional CLI installs on macOS arm64 only.
- [jiaererw/dsh-plugin-chrome](https://github.com/jiaererw/dsh-plugin-chrome) - A visible Chrome window per DSH session: 16 chrome_* tools (open/status/close/navigate/tabs/snapshot/screenshot/click/click_at/fill/type/press_key/hover/scroll/evaluate/wait), a Chrome tab in the Web GUI with a live screencast view (screenshot-heartbeat fallback for idle pages), tab management, window controls and a screenshot history.
- [jiewaigongxing/dsh-jiey-browser](https://github.com/jiewaigongxing/dsh-jiey-browser) - Drive Jiey Browser from DeepSeek Harness over MCP: navigate, snapshot, act, read, screenshot, and manage tabs in a real Chromium profile.
- [JohnXu22786/browser-automation](https://github.com/JohnXu22786/browser-automation) - Real-browser automation for dsh via an MCP server (Playwright core): navigate, click, fill, type, screenshot, and act on accessibility snapshots with numbered references - all 22 web_* tools re-exposed to the harness over stdio.
- [kakajun/dsh-web-recorder](https://github.com/kakajun/dsh-web-recorder) - Records real clicks, inputs, navigation and network traffic in a user-guided browser session for DSH, then generates a Markdown timeline report (report.md + events.jsonl) to build API-level skills.
- [kaminn/dsh-web-fetch-fakeip](https://github.com/kaminn/dsh-web-fetch-fakeip) - A fake-ip-aware ctx.web fetch provider that takes over the stock http provider id: a hostname is accepted when every DNS answer is a placeholder inside the proxy's fake-ip block (198.18.0.0/15 by default), so web_fetch works under mihomo/Clash TUN mode without disabling fake-ip or setting proxy environment variables. IP literals and private, loopback and reserved destinations stay blocked.
- [KasenRi/dsh-browser](https://github.com/KasenRi/dsh-browser) - Controlled browser automation for DeepSeek Harness: the agent_browser tool and BrowserAutomationService drive a real Chromium or Chrome page (or an explicit CDP endpoint) through the agent-browser CLI, with allowedDomains containment and per-call output limits.
- [keenableai/dsh-keenable](https://github.com/keenableai/dsh-keenable) - Keenable web search and page fetch for the built-in web_search and web_fetch tools, working with any model and no API key.
- [kenny2077/dsh-web-kimi](https://github.com/kenny2077/dsh-web-kimi) - Kimi Coding web search and web fetch providers for the DeepSeek Harness — one coding-plan key fills both ctx.web seams (POST /v1/search and /v1/fetch), a settings card in the GUI stores it via the credentials service, and the fallback chain reads the Kimi CLI config for zero-setup installs.
- [kenny2077/dsh-web-search-doubao](https://github.com/kenny2077/dsh-web-search-doubao) - Doubao Search (Volcengine 豆包搜索) web search provider for the DeepSeek Harness — swaps the active web_search backend to the standalone Doubao Search API with its own key and billing (500 free searches per month), and ships a dedicated settings card that stores the key via the credentials service.
- [KNLCXY/dsh-websift](https://github.com/KNLCXY/dsh-websift) - Token-efficient web reading for DeepSeek Harness: one call fetches several pages through a real Chrome/Edge over CDP, gates them by relevance and returns a single digest, cutting context tokens by 80-98%. Real search URLs, login flow, screenshots, three proxy modes.
- [kyo615/dsh-browser-control](https://github.com/kyo615/dsh-browser-control) - Playwright MCP browser control for AI agents: drive a real, visible Chrome (navigate/click/type/snapshot + ~80 browser_* tools), with a live screenshot panel embedded in the GUI that refreshes after every action.
- [lemoncat7/dsh-web-search](https://github.com/lemoncat7/dsh-web-search) - Configurable web search for DeepSeek Harness using SearXNG, Wikipedia, Tavily, Brave, or Gemini, with per-client engine selection and bounded retries.
- [limingyao-xx/dsh-sidebar-mobile-browser](https://github.com/limingyao-xx/dsh-sidebar-mobile-browser) - Mobile-viewport preview tab for the right sidebar, with nine preset sizes covering phones, tablets and a laptop plus a custom width/height, one-click URL copy, and the page URL inserted into the composer through an @ button or the /url command.
- [lirui1024k/dsh-browser-ops](https://github.com/lirui1024k/dsh-browser-ops) - Browser automation for DeepSeek Harness: agent-driven real-browser control (managed Chrome with an isolated persistent profile, or attach to your daily Chrome over CDP) with snapshot, click, fill and page-reading tools; records manual operation flows and replays them with variable slots to create test data on demand; ships 27 browser_* tools plus a Settings panel.
- [liustack/modsearch](https://github.com/liustack/modsearch) - Web search bridge for text-only agents: ask the web or X, get structured JSON evidence (search, fetch, citations).
- [LockyBee/dsh-douyin-agent](https://github.com/LockyBee/dsh-douyin-agent) - Browses Douyin in a dedicated browser with daily viewing limits, shared local persona and interests, native settings, diagnostics, usage tracking, and reports. Replies and shares use selected conversations; group replies require a mention or configured name. Public comments require separate opt-in.
- [longmiaoo/dsh-native-browser](https://github.com/longmiaoo/dsh-native-browser) - Controls user-authorized Chrome tabs from DeepSeek Harness through a local native-messaging broker, with semantic page reads, actions, screenshots, and explicit handoff.
- [Luca4Don3/dsh-web-search](https://github.com/Luca4Don3/dsh-web-search) - Web search and fetch provider for DeepSeek Harness and Pi: anonymous-first routing across Exa, Tavily, Parallel, Firecrawl and TinyFish, with opt-in billing, quota preflight and bounded cancellation.
- [LWJ007/dsh-browser-tabs](https://github.com/LWJ007/dsh-browser-tabs) - Type /tabs to pick a browser tab (via chrome-devtools-mcp) and auto-fill its URL into the composer.
- [lyd123qw2008/pi-control-chrome#dsh-tool-control-chrome](https://github.com/lyd123qw2008/pi-control-chrome/tree/main/dsh-tool-control-chrome) - Chrome and Edge browser control that drives the real logged-in profile, tabs and cookies through an MV3 extension and a loopback Bridge, exposing browser_* tools, a Skill and /chrome commands.
- [lyp88997/dsh-browser-service](https://github.com/lyp88997/dsh-browser-service) - Gives DSH the full 33-tool browser surface (ctx.browser seam -> a self-hosted headless Chromium over CDP: one 127.0.0.1 daemon with Bearer-token auth, request-path whitelist and WebSocket rewriting, no root/GUI/Electron needed), plus a web panel — a real page you can click, scroll and type in, operation/console/network logs with one-click cleanup, a customizable window (border color, transparency, glass, fit-to-picture with no black bars, top-inset and self-centering) and an adjustable page size (1920x1080 by default) — plus a collapsed pill that can be dragged to any spot on the screen (free position), a live view that auto-resumes when you switch back to the web tab, and a 1920px default max edge for the live frame — and two bundled skills (browser, browser-runtime) served through the plugin built-in skill provider, so the skill centre lists them as system-level by default without writing into $DSH_HOME/skills.
- [lyp88997/dsh-moli-browser](https://github.com/lyp88997/dsh-moli-browser) - Gives DSH the full 33-tool browser surface (ctx.browser seam -> a self-hosted headless moli browser over CDP: one 127.0.0.1 daemon with Bearer-token auth, request-path whitelist and WebSocket rewriting, no root/GUI/Electron needed; single-engine moli serve with auto LD_LIBRARY_PATH/FONTCONFIG_FILE injection and a persistent profile dir for logins), plus a web panel — a real page you can click, scroll and type in, operation/console/network logs with one-click cleanup, a customizable window (border color, transparency, glass, fit-to-picture with no black bars, top-inset and self-centering) and an adjustable page size (1920x1080 by default) — plus a collapsed pill that can be dragged to any spot on the screen (free position), a live view that auto-resumes when you switch back to the web tab, and a 1920px default max edge for the live frame — and two bundled skills (browser, browser-runtime) served through the plugin built-in skill provider, so the skill centre lists them as system-level by default without writing into $DSH_HOME/skills.
- [Lzh3070/dsh-search-hub](https://github.com/Lzh3070/dsh-search-hub) - Configurable web search hub for the built-in web_search tool: switch the active entry between DeepSeek official native search and Zhipu GLM web_search, with entry and credential management on a Settings page tab.
- [magian1127/deepseek-harness-zhipu_plan_tools](https://github.com/magian1127/deepseek-harness-zhipu_plan_tools) - Zhipu (GLM Coding Plan) web suite as native DSH providers and tools: rebinds the built-in web_search and web_fetch to Zhipu web search and Markdown page reading, optionally registers github_search_doc / github_get_repo_structure / github_read_file repo tools, and adds a settings card with toggles and a credential-ref field.
- [maxiaovivi/dsh-cloak-browser](https://github.com/maxiaovivi/dsh-cloak-browser) - CloakBrowser-powered native browser tools with per-agent isolated sessions, bounded snapshots, ref-based interaction, screenshots, and safe routing.
- [maxwell-feng/dsh-tinyfish-search](https://github.com/maxwell-feng/dsh-tinyfish-search) - TinyFish-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: each search is one GET to the TinyFish Search API, no model call.
- [menotbobbybrown/dsh-plugin-browser](https://github.com/menotbobbybrown/dsh-plugin-browser) - Native headless and visible Chromium browser automation agent for DeepSeek Harness with DOM tree extraction, screenshot capture, and built-in SSRF protection.
- [MicroHEROX/dsh-exa-mcp](https://github.com/MicroHEROX/dsh-exa-mcp) - Mounts the hosted Exa search MCP endpoint (https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp) through the in-box @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client bridge: web_search_exa and web_fetch_exa tools, anonymous on the free tier or with your own EXA_API_KEY.
- [MicroHEROX/dsh-Kimi-WebBridge](https://github.com/MicroHEROX/dsh-Kimi-WebBridge) - Drive the user's real browser through the local Kimi WebBridge daemon: navigate, find-tab, snapshot, click, fill, evaluate, CDP, screenshot, network, upload, PDF export and tab-management tools that reuse existing login sessions.
- [miqian-nomad/dsh-browser-playwright-codex](https://github.com/miqian-nomad/dsh-browser-playwright-codex) - Browser automation for DSH: the agent fills in forms, scrapes lists and works across tabs in real pages, using the logins you already have. It drives its own visible window on your desktop — minimise it and it keeps working without stealing focus — and a sign-in, CAPTCHA or native dialog stops the run and hands the page back to you: it never confirms on your behalf. Login state persists (own profile plus session-cookie re-injection). 23 Playwright tools (20 always on, 3 gated and off by default), with a URL allowlist, dialog suspension and a CDP method allowlist that are mechanism-level and pinned by tests.
- [moguiyu/dsh-tavily#packages/dsh-tavily](https://github.com/moguiyu/dsh-tavily/tree/main/packages/dsh-tavily) - Tavily search, extract, map and crawl tools with multi-key rotation, failover on HTTP 401/429/432/433, and a load-balance mode that caps in-flight requests per Tavily account, plus a key and usage card on the Plugins page. The built-in web_search is never replaced.
- [newbeebnb/hermes-web-mcp](https://github.com/newbeebnb/hermes-web-mcp) - Keyless web powers for any MCP client: web_search, JS-rendered web_extract over dual CDP Chrome with proxy failover, and 7 real-browser page_* tools in an isolated context.
- [NingYuanLee/dsh-gui-auth-url](https://github.com/NingYuanLee/dsh-gui-auth-url) - Agent tool that returns the running DSH Web GUI URL including its per-process launch token, so browser automation can open the GUI instead of getting a 401.
- [Noemm/dsh-web-search-glm](https://github.com/Noemm/dsh-web-search-glm) - Zhipu GLM web search provider: registers as `glm` on the ctx.web seam and runs the native web_search server tool through GLM's Anthropic-compatible API (Coding Plan billing).
- [Nono-neko/dsh-browser](https://github.com/Nono-neko/dsh-browser) - An AI-native browser workspace for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), combining multi-tab browsing, live page annotations, lightweight code editing, workspace previews, and Agent-assisted iteration across Web and Desktop.
- [omdsh-dev/dsh-browser#packages/browser/bridge-browser](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser/tree/main/packages/browser/bridge-browser) - Chrome sidebar extension that lets DSH operate your browser directly, no vision capabilities required.
- [OrderG-X/dsh-chrome-bridge#plugin](https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-chrome-bridge/tree/main/plugin) - Controls the Chrome you are already logged into: the model clicks, types, fills in forms, reads pages, takes screenshots and downloads files in your real tabs, including inside same-origin iframes. Runs on macOS, Windows and Linux; needs Chrome 116+ and Node 18+. Works over native messaging and chrome.debugger instead of a listening port. Ships 12 browser_* tools and a cb CLI, dispatches real CDP input events, draws an on-page cursor that also appears in screenshots, and adds a toolbar panel with live status, the controlled tabs and a pause switch. browser_download saves a link, an element's target or a URL with the site's login cookies (following redirects, keeping the server's file name) to the Downloads folder or the session's working directory; cross-origin iframes are named in the snapshot but not entered. The native host and the MV3 extension travel inside this tarball: on first load the plugin copies them into place and writes the native-messaging registration itself, so there is no clone, no install.sh and no python3 - the one step left is adding the extension to Chrome: install DSH Bridge from the Chrome Web Store (https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/bippcbbbipppmhjkjomgdnjbooecbimo, no Developer mode), or load the bundled unpacked copy at chrome://extensions (the plugin opens that page and puts the folder on the clipboard for you). Until then the tools fail loudly with those steps. On Windows the registration goes into the registry (for Chrome and Edge) and the host talks over a named pipe. A daily CI run on GitHub's macOS, Windows and Linux machines installs the plugin, loads the extension into a real Chrome and reads a page through the browser_* tools.
- [Oxygen640/dsh-plugin-nuaa-search](https://github.com/Oxygen640/dsh-plugin-nuaa-search) - Zero-key web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: scrapes Bing China, 360 and SearXNG through a backend fallback chain and returns real URLs with snippets and publish dates. No API key and no settings card are required. SearXNG is used only when you set your own instance URL, and installing this plugin switches web_search to it and turns off the official DeepSeek search row.
- [OzzyDeng-JunDeng/dsh-keyless-search](https://github.com/OzzyDeng-JunDeng/dsh-keyless-search) - Registers a keyless search provider for the built-in web_search tool so it works without an API key, failing over between the documented no-key tiers of Tavily and Firecrawl; a TAVILY_API_KEY or FIRECRAWL_API_KEY is picked up automatically when present. Two Bing scrape backends are included but off by default.
- [ParticleLight/dsh-browser-plus](https://github.com/ParticleLight/dsh-browser-plus) - Visible Electron browser for DSH with one shared BrowserWindow, isolated task views, explicit human-Agent handoff, snapshot-reference and native navigation tools, operation trails, demand-driven page thumbnails, keyed session recovery for reliable tab switching and closing, and site-scoped cookie clearing for login maintenance.
- [PartinGQAQ/dsh-web-search-zhipu](https://github.com/PartinGQAQ/dsh-web-search-zhipu) - GLM (Zhipu bigmodel) web search provider - routes ctx.web search through Zhipu's Anthropic-compatible endpoint with the native web_search server tool, billing your existing GLM quota or Coding Plan instead of the DeepSeek platform. Includes a translation layer for Zhipu's non-standard tool_result response layout.
- [PILIHU2022/dsh-proxy-failover](https://github.com/PILIHU2022/dsh-proxy-failover) - Loopback relay as DSH's process-wide proxy route: web_fetch works under TUN fake-ip; a dead proxy gets same-request direct fallback, and a probe switches back.
- [platonai/dsh-browser4](https://github.com/platonai/dsh-browser4) - Installs the browser4-cli runtime and registers the Browser4 skills (browser4-cli, browser4-experience, browser4-plugin, scent-miner) into the DSH skill registry, providing an AI-native browser engine for autonomous agents, intelligent extraction, and large-scale web automation.
- [PyModel/dsh-research-plugins#dsh-mcp-firecrawl](https://github.com/PyModel/dsh-research-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-mcp-firecrawl) - Firecrawl MCP bridge: hosted Firecrawl MCP server with keyless search, scrape and parse; an API key unlocks the full tool surface including crawl and map.
- [PyModel/dsh-research-plugins#dsh-tavily](https://github.com/PyModel/dsh-research-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-tavily) - Tavily Search API as a web search provider (settings toggle with DeepSeek fallback, keyless search) plus a Tavily MCP bridge: keyless search and extract tools, crawl and map with an API key.
- [qikairo7/dsh-web-search-fetch](https://github.com/qikairo7/dsh-web-search-fetch) - Aggregated web_search and web_fetch providers for DeepSeek Harness, sitting behind the built-in tools. Search fans one query out to AnySearch, Zhipu and Zhihu concurrently, dedupes URLs, fuses ranks with Reciprocal Rank Fusion and optionally reranks through SiliconFlow. Fetch is URL-aware: static pages pass through the built-in HTTP fetcher, dynamic ones fan out to Firecrawl and AnySearch extract and pick one body by quality. One shared circuit breaker skips an engine for the day after a quota or 429 signal, and a settings card keeps each engine API key in the credential store without ever showing its value.
- [QuantumKuba/dsh-webstack](https://github.com/QuantumKuba/dsh-webstack) - SearXNG search and Scrapling multi-tier fetch provider bundle for DeepSeek Harness ctx.web with SSRF protection and markdown conversion.
- [regrevia/dsh-inner-browser-use](https://github.com/regrevia/dsh-inner-browser-use) - Drives the sidebar browser already open on the right: same cookies and same sign-in, a pointer you can watch, no second window.
- [regrevia/Envoy#envoy-dsh](https://github.com/regrevia/Envoy/tree/main/integrations/dsh/envoy-dsh) - Paste a link and the agent reads it for you. Douyin, Xiaohongshu and Bilibili videos parse automatically; articles, PDFs and audio become citable Markdown. Same 60 turns with vs without: finishes reading 22% → 92%, times out 68% → 0%, answer quotes a real source fact 23% → 82% (the A/B is exploratory: different time caps, no human correctness review). On 123 live links 80% came back usable (93% of the pages that answered), and an unreachable link reports in 26 s instead of 77. Codex, Claude Code, DSH.
- [renchengxiang/dsh-web-search-tavily](https://github.com/renchengxiang/dsh-web-search-tavily) - Tavily-backed search provider for native web_search, with a Settings → Plugins card for API key management and toggling DeepSeek replacement.
- [ricardochen1996/dsh-browser-use](https://github.com/ricardochen1996/dsh-browser-use) - Browser provider for DeepSeek Harness: hand it a web task — open a page, click, type, fill a form, read what is on it — and it drives a real browser step by step, seeing an indexed table of what can be done on the current page instead of raw HTML or screenshots. Each step is one bundled-Jev decision rather than a full model turn (1.1 s median per step versus 2.8–3.6 s for chat-model turns in the repo benchmark), and the main conversation receives only the conclusion, so its context does not grow with the page. Targets come from the page it just read and a changed page is re-read rather than clicked blind, and it runs in the browser that Session owns, leaving your everyday Chrome untouched unless you switch to attach mode.
- [robin421/dsh-html-inspector](https://github.com/robin421/dsh-html-inspector) - Selection mode for HTML preview and browser tabs: click any element in a locally served demo page and its locator (selector, text, HTML snippet) is written into the chat input for precise AI editing.
- [rogerdigital/dsh-searxng](https://github.com/rogerdigital/dsh-searxng) - SearXNG-backed web_search provider for the web seam: free, self-hosted, key-less metasearch through your own instance's JSON API, with a bundled loopback-only docker-compose example.
- [SciF-Lin/dsh-browsercontrol-mcp](https://github.com/SciF-Lin/dsh-browsercontrol-mcp) - Mounts Microsoft's Playwright MCP through the official dsh-mcp-client so the agent gets its browser tools over stdio; the one-time CDP authorization is guided by a prompt note, a call guard and the /bw-setup command.
- [Shad0wwa1ker/dsh-browser-mode](https://github.com/Shad0wwa1ker/dsh-browser-mode) - Adds a visible-browser Agent preset (persona and toolset for navigating, filling forms, clicking and screenshotting through the Playwright MCP toolset) plus a gate that refuses every browser tool call in other presets until the user approves that Session through the bundled browser_access tool. The bundle mounts the Playwright MCP provider itself, and both a settings page in the Plugins view and the browser_source tool switch the browser at runtime between Microsoft Edge (default), the Chromium shipped with Playwright, and a CDP endpoint. Requires keeping the shared browser-use registration row in the profile (one provider per process).
- [ShallBay/dsh-bridge-browser](https://github.com/ShallBay/dsh-bridge-browser) - Lets DSH drive the Chrome tab you are already browsing, no vision needed: the page reaches the model as structured text with a numbered element list, and clicks, typing, key presses, scrolling, tab handling and navigation wait for your confirmation in the extension side panel while password and payment-card fields stay masked. Fifteen browser_* tools cover snapshot, text, tab list, open, follow, click, type, press, scroll, wait, navigate, back, close, forward and reload. A repack of the bridge plugin from omdsh-dev/dsh-browser, published to npm so it installs with `dsh plugin add`: the peer ranges the host checks are widened so the install is not refused as incompatible, the bundled extension also probes the DSH Desktop host port 19387 so no bridge address has to be typed, and a script copies the extension to a fixed directory so a profile switch or reinstall cannot break it. The prebuilt release tarball carries the plugin and the built MV3 extension. Upstream: https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser.
- [SheepofSheep/dsh-doyourweb](https://github.com/SheepofSheep/dsh-doyourweb) - Reference logged-in Chrome/Edge tabs and authorized local HTML with @ for reading, batched actions, screenshots and WebMCP; collect annotations in chat drafts with a draggable toolbar. Select running Windows apps with icons, prefer a matching installed MCP or approve installation, then fall back to Cua Driver. Supports text and key chords, paged control handles, minimized-window checks and optional action readback. Includes guided browser pairing and refreshed annotation controls; background input depends on the app.
- [shinjiyu/dsh-plugin-search](https://github.com/shinjiyu/dsh-plugin-search) - Keep the built-in web_search tool without an official DeepSeek API key: disable web-search-deepseek and use Tavily keyless by default.
- [sryimnoob123/dsh-web-search-ollama](https://github.com/sryimnoob123/dsh-web-search-ollama) - Routes the DSH web_search tool through Ollama's web search API, reusing OLLAMA_API_KEY. No DeepSeek official key needed.
- [Starp1ume/dsh-chat-mode](https://github.com/Starp1ume/dsh-chat-mode) - Adds a Chat/Work switch in the DSH Desktop titlebar: Chat embeds the DeepSeek web chat (chat.deepseek.com) in a native webview with no DSH API calls from the plugin and is the default on first launch, Work keeps the native agent UI, the page stays mounted across switches, and a confirm-first dialog can copy chat text into a work-mode draft without sending it.
- [stormbuf/dsh-tavily-pool](https://github.com/stormbuf/dsh-tavily-pool) - Takes over the built-in web_search and web_fetch providers with Tavily, each behind its own toggle: a key pool with balance-aware scheduling that reads real credit balances from /usage, failover with hard exclusion of cooling or exhausted keys, and call history with a 14-day credit chart.
- [stuarthu/dsh-chrome](https://github.com/stuarthu/dsh-chrome) - Chrome side panel that embeds the dsh web UI and lets the agent read the current page, capture HTTP traffic, and drive the browser.
- [superagents-lab/dsh-s1](https://github.com/superagents-lab/dsh-s1) - Native Search1API (s1) web research tools: search, news, page crawling, sitemap discovery, and trending topics as first-class `s1_*` tools, with a bundled s1 skill.
- [SZMY-haruhi/dsh-tavily](https://github.com/SZMY-haruhi/dsh-tavily) - Tavily web search for DSH with a settings toggle, keyless by default, and a connection test.
- [T-Markus-Liang/dsh-webmcp](https://github.com/T-Markus-Liang/dsh-webmcp) - WebMCP bridge: your agent discovers & calls site tools exposed over the W3C WebMCP protocol via a built-in headless Chromium.
- [Tabbit-Browser/dsh-tabbit](https://github.com/Tabbit-Browser/dsh-tabbit) - Gives DeepSeek Harness control of the Tabbit Browser: auto-loads the tabbit-browser skill on install, detects official Tabbit and Tabbit Browser releases (>= 1.9.0), checks the tabbit-cli persistent runtime, diagnoses the per-platform DSH sandbox mode needed to call the CLI, and downloads the region-matched official installer via a background job when no qualifying version is present.
- [TC635807/better-crawler4agent](https://github.com/TC635807/better-crawler4agent) - Registers a real-browser URL-to-text MCP server in a DSH profile: fetch_url and fetch_urls render JavaScript-heavy and anti-bot Chinese pages (Zhihu, CSDN, Juejin, cnblogs) and return clean article text as JSON with per-tier diagnostics, and crawler_status reports whether the browser is available. Needs a one-time Python dependency setup after install.
- [Tencent/BrowserSkill#dsh-plugin-browserskill](https://github.com/Tencent/BrowserSkill/tree/main/packages/dsh-plugin-browserskill) - BrowserSkill bridge for controlling visible Chrome and Edge Agent Windows from DeepSeek Harness, with native browser tools, accessibility and VOM observations, screenshots, owned multi-session control, and a live Web UI overlay.
- [Tests4gptplay/dsh-dots](https://github.com/Tests4gptplay/dsh-dots) - Open ChatGPT Dots in a native DSH page: Desktop preloads it in the background and keeps the same page alive across panel switches, with a theme-aware toolbar, reload and external-browser controls.
- [TonyDua/dsh-web-search-exa](https://github.com/TonyDua/dsh-web-search-exa) - Zero-config Exa web search provider for the ctx.web seam: anonymous MCP fallback without an API key, plus keyed REST search.
- [TZHR-invest/dsh-plugins#dsh-web-search-metaso](https://github.com/TZHR-invest/dsh-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-web-search-metaso) - Metaso (秘塔AI搜索) search & reader providers for the web seam: web_search returns page summaries, web_fetch reads full-page markdown, multi-scope search (webpage/document/paper/image/video/podcast).
- [umineko987/dsh-search-enhance](https://github.com/umineko987/dsh-search-enhance) - Grok-compatible web search with retained source pagination, Context7 and Exa documentation lookup, bounded page extraction, site mapping, offline research planning, and read-only diagnostics.
- [uugvkbvkdjbsdbvwxxl/dsh-plugin-web-annotate](https://github.com/uugvkbvkdjbsdbvwxxl/dsh-plugin-web-annotate) - Annotate elements in the built-in browser — click one, write a comment, then send the whole batch to the session in one message so the model can find and edit the matching source.
- [Viger1/dsh-pilot](https://github.com/Viger1/dsh-pilot) - Browser operation by accessibility refs: navigate, snapshot the page as a ref tree, act on elements, and wait for conditions; the origin policy follows the session approval stance and is enforced by request interception.
- [Viger1/dsh-preview](https://github.com/Viger1/dsh-preview) - Headless-browser verification tools so the agent opens the page it just built, reads the rendered DOM and computed styles, checks the console, and screenshots the result; ships a frontend-verify skill.
- [vitas/dsh-web-search-openrouter](https://github.com/vitas/dsh-web-search-openrouter) - The built-in web_search bills a full model turn against DeepSeek's own endpoint; this runs it on an OpenRouter-compatible gateway instead, so search is billed where your chat already is, at the model and price you pick.
- [WalterYOO/dsh-web-search-yuanbao](https://github.com/WalterYOO/dsh-web-search-yuanbao) - Tencent Yuanbao Search provider for the ctx.web seam: one direct Search API request per query returns portable title, URL, snippet and ISO-8601 date, with credentials resolved per search and no auxiliary model turn. Requires a Tencent Cloud WSA API key.
- [wangtheme-coder/dsh-dragon-control](https://github.com/wangtheme-coder/dsh-dragon-control) - Windows x64 only, 0.5.4 preview: two scoped tools (dragon_browser and dragon_desktop) that drive a visible browser through the DOM or CDP and Windows apps through UI Automation, with per-origin and per-executable read/control scopes, batch steps, a physical-Esc emergency stop and a redacted action log. 0.5.4 only widens the DSH compatibility range to 0.2.0-rc.2 through 0.2.1.x, because 0.5.3 pinned it to an exact DSH version and was silently skipped on DSH Desktop 0.2.1. Two long-lived native processes remove the per-action process spawn, so a single key step takes about 0.7 s on the same machine; when another window steals the foreground the step is aborted instead of typing into the wrong place. The browser side ships its own Edge/Chrome launcher and CDP client, so it no longer needs another browser plugin or the Electron runtime. It is not an OS sandbox; logins, admin windows and secure desktops stay with the user.
- [whiteS18/dsh-bing-search](https://github.com/whiteS18/dsh-bing-search) - Maintained fork of godchen520/dsh-web-search-bing adapted to DSH 0.1.5-rc.1: Bing-backed provider for the built-in web_search tool, scraping the public cn.bing.com HTML results page with no API key, reachable from mainland China, and keeping searches off the model's own search quota. Endpoint and result count configurable.
- [wjj-8283/dsh-web-fetch-fakeip-plugin](https://github.com/wjj-8283/dsh-web-fetch-fakeip-plugin) - Makes the built-in web_fetch tool work when Clash / mihomo runs in TUN mode with fake-ip: it lets the fake-ip address ranges (198.18.0.0/15, fdfe:dcba:9876::/64, 2001:2::/48) past the public-address check that otherwise rejects them, while loopback, private and link-local addresses stay blocked as before. Works with no proxy environment variables and no Clash changes.
- [wqty123/dsh-browser](https://github.com/wqty123/dsh-browser) - Shared real browser for DSH: a native Electron window the human can watch and take over, driven by the agent over CDP with 20 browser_* tools (open/snapshot/execute/fill/screenshot/download/auth), per-task session isolation, cookie persistence, CAPTCHA detection; self-hosts on plain dsh web without a desktop shell.
- [xiaobai2017666/dsh-chrome-cdp](https://github.com/xiaobai2017666/dsh-chrome-cdp) - Chrome DevTools Protocol Plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Use chrome-remote-interface to connect to and control Chrome via CDP. The connection includes a graphical interface.
- [xingzhen199186/dsh-jev-ultrafast](https://github.com/xingzhen199186/dsh-jev-ultrafast) - Drive a browser from one natural-language goal: a decision service picks the next operation and target from an indexed element table, so a DSH session spends one tool call instead of one turn per click.
- [yangyunsong023/dsh-sxs-anti-bot-http](https://github.com/yangyunsong023/dsh-sxs-anti-bot-http) - Anti-bot HTTP fetch tools hardened by SXS's production scraping stack (millions of requests/day): UA-pool rotation, retry with exponential backoff, anti-bot wall detection (captcha / verification challenges) and adaptive rate limiting — tools: `sxs_fetch` / `sxs_fetch_json` / `sxs_rate_status`.
- [Yingmoon0715/yingmoon-plugins#plugins/rightbar-driver](https://github.com/Yingmoon0715/yingmoon-plugins/tree/main/plugins/rightbar-driver) - Drives the DSH right-sidebar built-in browser from the agent side with 38 tools (open, navigate, read page text and interactive elements, accessibility tree, click, fill, select, check, key press, scroll, resize the browser frame by dragging its corner, with the page inside reflowing responsively so a narrowed frame shows the mobile layout, screenshot, full-page screenshot, PDF, markdown export, scrape to JSON, download, cookies, per-step operation records with replay and action whitelisting), serves the built-in web_search from a self-hosted SearXNG over an SSH tunnel with Tavily and a real-browser fallback, and registers a fetch provider that retries blocked GitHub URLs through measured mirrors and sniffs charset from the response header so GBK and GB2312 pages decode correctly.
- [yinnho/aginxbrowser#dsh-aginxbrowser](https://github.com/yinnho/aginxbrowser/tree/main/dsh-aginxbrowser) - Web access for DSH agents: fetch JS-rendered or protected pages as clean markdown, aggregated search across 14 engines, and stateful interactive sessions (click, type, scroll, eval, screenshot) against a hosted or self-hosted Rust browser engine. Every session returns a live view URL so a human can watch the agent browse and take over with the mouse.
- [Yokhong/dsh_academic_web_proxy](https://github.com/Yokhong/dsh_academic_web_proxy) - Opens academic sites through institutional proxy rules and optionally renames eligible new PDFs using matched article metadata, with Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and US English settings.
- [YokiMohan/dsh-webview](https://github.com/YokiMohan/dsh-webview) - Opens chat.deepseek.com inside DSH Desktop from a conversation view tab (next to Chat / Trajectory / Context, scoped to the open conversation) and from a left-rail globe button — all entries share one embedded page, so switching between them never reloads it. Keeps you signed in across restarts by replaying a localStorage plus readable-cookie snapshot before the page's own scripts run, strips only the Electron/<version> token from the user agent, and keeps navigation inside deepseek.com while sending everything else to the system browser. Pure client code: no host-side script, no file access, no credential service, no server route.
- [youbaiyun/dsh-browser-crossplatform#bridge](https://github.com/youbaiyun/dsh-browser-crossplatform/tree/main/packages/bridge) - Desktop half of the dsh browser extension: mounts a token-authenticated WebSocket bridge on the dsh webserver and exposes the browser_* tools that let the model read the tab you are on as text and act on it, with image recognition off until the user enables it.
- [yugasun/dsh-plugins#dsh-web-search](https://github.com/yugasun/dsh-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-web-search) - Registers Baidu, Doubao, Tavily, and Exa backends into ctx.web so official web_search can use them, and routes web_fetch through Tavily Extract or Exa Contents when that backend is active.
- [ywleeo/browser-mcp](https://github.com/ywleeo/browser-mcp) - Drives a real Chrome through a local MCP server so the agent can search Google/Bing/Sogou, read any page including JS-rendered and login-only content, automate click/scroll/type/key-press/select in a background window, and run platform search/detail/comment/download for Zhihu, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Bilibili, X and Reddit; resumable comments, SHA-256-verified downloads, cookies never returned, localhost only.
- [zaiwenJ/dsh-cdp-browser](https://github.com/zaiwenJ/dsh-cdp-browser) - CDP bridge to an already-running Chrome/Edge for DSH: screenshots, pixel assertions, DOM/CSS checks, and page JS evaluation over HTTP + WebSocket, with zero child processes, zero npm dependencies, and zero per-use approval.
- [zengxiaolou/dsh-annotate-browser](https://github.com/zengxiaolou/dsh-annotate-browser) - Annotation browser in the DSH sidebar: a real Chrome page streamed over CDP with input forwarded, where picking an element or selecting text attaches its source location, component stack, styles and a crop to the chat input. Needs a local Chrome (on Windows set chromePath).
- [zhiqiangme/dsh-plugins#dsh-tavily-search](https://github.com/zhiqiangme/dsh-plugins/tree/main/dsh-tavily-search) - Tavily backend for the built-in web search: an in-process endpoint at 127.0.0.1:8787/v1 turns its requests into Tavily searches; up to 10 API keys stay in the DSH credential store, rotate per request and switch on auth, rate-limit or quota errors; a settings card manages keys, runs a test search and points web search at the endpoint.
- [zimai233/dsh-image-search](https://github.com/zimai233/dsh-image-search) - Multi-engine reverse image search aggregator: Google Lens, Baidu, Yandex, TinEye, SauceNAO, IQDB, Ascii2d.
- [zimai233/dsh-video-downloader](https://github.com/zimai233/dsh-video-downloader) - Detect and download media from Bilibili/YouTube/Douyin/Xiaohongshu with quality and format analysis.
- [zoe1nan/windowseat](https://github.com/zoe1nan/windowseat) - Windowseat bridge for DeepSeek Harness: a local host plugin exposing a loopback HTTP/SSE endpoint so the bundled Microsoft Edge side-panel extension can read the current page, search local files and talk to DSH; the Edge extension lives in the same repo and must be loaded separately. Windows 10/11 with desktop Edge required.
- [zyfgood/dsh-web-search-tavily](https://github.com/zyfgood/dsh-web-search-tavily) - Registers a Tavily search provider for the ctx.web seam and switches web_search to it, with a comma-separated apiKey list that rotates on 401/403/429/5xx and transport errors.

### Vision & Multimodal

- [1HelloMan1/dsh-vision-fallback](https://github.com/1HelloMan1/dsh-vision-fallback) - Routes chat images to a fixed OpenAI-compatible vision model, returns factual observations to the selected main model, and reuses session-scoped observations across replay, compaction, and restarts.
- [314857493/dsh-vision#vision-route](https://github.com/314857493/dsh-vision/tree/main/packages/vision-route) - Registers a `deepseek-vision` provider route: the Web GUI accepts pasted images and transcribes them to text via the free Zhipu GLM vision API before delegating to the DeepSeek adapter.
- [314857493/dsh-vision#vision-tool](https://github.com/314857493/dsh-vision/tree/main/packages/vision-tool) - Model-facing `vision` tool for DeepSeek Harness: describe and OCR image files by calling the free Zhipu GLM vision API directly (glm-4v-flash fallback chain), no external CLI required.
- [544244857/dsh-image2-plugin](https://github.com/544244857/dsh-image2-plugin) - Registers an `image2_generate` tool that calls your own OpenAI-compatible image relay to generate or edit pictures (text-to-image via POST /images/generations, image-to-image via POST /images/edits with a local PNG/JPEG/WebP reference, accepting b64_json or image URLs), saves them in the session working directory, and renders them inline in the conversation through its `@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer` dependency.
- [54xkeee/dsh-vision](https://github.com/54xkeee/dsh-vision) - Vision for text-only DeepSeek via Doubao Web by default (zero-cost, no API key — drives your logged-in Chrome through a Windows CDP bridge), with Antigravity IDE quota (flash/pro) or Gemini fallback; auto detail escalation, vision evidence memory with compaction rehydration, content-hash cache, and a bilingual client panel.
- [54xkeee/dsh-youreyes](https://github.com/54xkeee/dsh-youreyes) - Vision toolkit for text-only DeepSeek: model-invokable `vision` tool, wrapper adapters for deepseek/opencode-go (v4 flash/pro), Antigravity IDE quota (default, flash/pro) / any OpenAI-compatible VLM / Gemini / local Ollama channels, evidence memory with compaction rehydration, content-hash cache, and a bilingual client panel.
- [710765989/dsh-sticker-dict](https://github.com/710765989/dsh-sticker-dict) - Keeps a local sticker dictionary keyed by content hash so an image already described is recalled instead of re-read, and splits a GIF into evenly sampled frames laid out as one contact sheet so the whole animation is visible.
- [aa2246740/dsh-image-conatiner](https://github.com/aa2246740/dsh-image-conatiner) - Displays generated images in a conversation gallery with a lightbox viewer.
- [alaxrpg/dsh-vision-bridge](https://github.com/alaxrpg/dsh-vision-bridge) - Adds image input and recognition through configured DSH providers or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
- [algerkong/dsh-image-preview](https://github.com/algerkong/dsh-image-preview) - Image previews for DSH sessions: read_image thumbnails plus user, assistant, Markdown and present images in a lightbox with zoom, rotate, pan, download, sidebar and native file actions.
- [AngelosZou/dsh-pdf-reader](https://github.com/AngelosZou/dsh-pdf-reader) - A content-aware PDF reading plugin for vision models: profiles each page for figures (vector and raster), tables, formula risk and double-column layout, then applies content-aware hybrid extraction, rendering figure/table/formula pages as high-DPI region crops. Provides a low-resolution preview to understand the page layout, and renders a specified region at high resolution. Packaged as multiple tools for agents.
- [Anionex/dsh-vision-toolkit](https://github.com/Anionex/dsh-vision-toolkit) - Vision for text-only models: paste an image and the model switches to a Vision Toolkit variant for image Q&A, multi-image comparison, long-screenshot OCR, screenshot-to-UI reproduction, element grounding, and pixel diff. No API key by default — images are processed by the author-hosted free service, 100 per machine per day; configurable to your own provider.
- [ankye/dsh-client-vision#tool-vision](https://github.com/ankye/dsh-client-vision/tree/main/packages/tool-vision) - Screen capture and external vision recognition: take_screenshot, list_windows, analyze_image and view_image tools with a configurable GPT vision channel (gpt-5.5 / gpt-5.6-sol / gpt-5.6-terra), API key via the credentials service, and a settings card; view_image shows the screenshot in the Web UI while the model context keeps text only.
- [ankye/dsh-image-generation#tool-image-generation](https://github.com/ankye/dsh-image-generation/tree/main/packages/tool-image-generation) - Model-facing image-generation tool with a configurable channel and normalized image parameters.
- [AtropinolTT/dsh-guide-dog](https://github.com/AtropinolTT/dsh-guide-dog) - MiniMax-powered multimodal plugin: real-time voice call mode (streaming conversation, floating dock UI), voice mode and mic voice input, plus image/video/music/speech generation and vision inspection tools.
- [azwosile/dsh-highres-vision](https://github.com/azwosile/dsh-highres-vision) - For the DeepSeek Harness native vision model deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp, raises image admission limits to 32 MiB / 8192 px / 600 images and adds a highres_read tool that tiles large images, then returns the whole image plus 800x800 tiles through the host read_image tool.
- [balue8246-maker/dseyesopen](https://github.com/balue8246-maker/dseyesopen) - Vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek: send images (alone or mixed with text) and a fast tiny vision model describes them behind the scenes — the chat keeps the picture, DeepSeek sees only text. Pure plugin: uninstall restores everything.
- [bauerelizabeth07139/opencode-eyes](https://github.com/bauerelizabeth07139/opencode-eyes) - Eyes for text-only models: mounts the bundled stdio MCP server as mcp__opencode_eyes__describe_image, which sends an image file to StepFun step-3.7-flash and returns a detailed description.
- [bauerelizabeth07139/opencode-eyes-nvidia](https://github.com/bauerelizabeth07139/opencode-eyes-nvidia) - Vision through NVIDIA NIM: mounts the bundled stdio MCP server as mcp__opencode_eyes_nvidia__describe_image, which describes an image with any of seven hosted vision models (MiniMax-M3 by default) and rotates several API keys.
- [bauerelizabeth07139/opencode-ppocr-mcp](https://github.com/bauerelizabeth07139/opencode-ppocr-mcp) - Local OCR with nothing sent to a cloud: mounts the PP-OCRv6 Medium stdio MCP server (PaddleOCR on ONNX Runtime, CPU) as mcp__ppocr__ocr_image and mcp__ppocr__ocr_pdf for images and multi-page PDFs.
- [BeatAPI/beatapi-agent-plugin#dsh-media](https://github.com/BeatAPI/beatapi-agent-plugin/tree/main/packages/dsh-media) - Four native tools for image/video model discovery, contract inspection, pricing previews, approved generation and resumable task status through BeatAPI.
- [boheastill/phone-eye](https://github.com/boheastill/phone-eye) - Let your AI agent see and operate a real Android phone: phone_look (vision + UI-tree fusion), tap/swipe/type, screenshot — over adb, for any MCP client.
- [br1nosense/dsh-vision-solution](https://github.com/br1nosense/dsh-vision-solution) - Give DSH text-only models vision: an image/OCR/document recognition skill (race pool → custom channels → local) plus an idempotent host patch so image messages reach the model.
- [bug-huntter/dsh-vision-plugin](https://github.com/bug-huntter/dsh-vision-plugin) - Configurable image recognition for text-only DSH models: attached images are preserved through the DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 adapter pipeline, transcribed by an OpenAI-compatible vision model, and passed to the main model as text. Supports selectable OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or Azure auth headers and reports a missing API key before sending a request.
- [BW741/dsh-video-eyes](https://github.com/BW741/dsh-video-eyes) - Lets the model actually see a video: local ffmpeg samples timestamped stills and faster-whisper transcribes the audio track, so the agent reads real pixels frame by frame instead of trusting a text summary. Fully local, nothing uploaded; reports honestly when the audio has no speech. Windows only; needs Python 3.10+ and ffmpeg installed, and the first video_eyes_setup run downloads about 700 MB (faster-whisper and its model).
- [CAI-MH/dsh-gpt-image](https://github.com/CAI-MH/dsh-gpt-image) - Generate images through a logged-in web ChatGPT session and download them to a local directory.
- [cctv2333/dsh-vidlens](https://github.com/cctv2333/dsh-vidlens) - Samples a video the way a person does instead of downloading it: metadata and chapters first, then timestamped frames as images, subtitle-first transcripts (local ASR only when the platform carries no subtitles), AudioSet 527-class sound tags and top comments — 21 tools sharing one on-disk cache behind a cross-process lock. Needs Python 3.10+, ffmpeg and the vidlens package (pip install vidlens-mcp); a missing install comes back with the two ways to fix it instead of a bare ImportError.
- [charovo0059/dsh-model-vision](https://github.com/charovo0059/dsh-model-vision) - Fills in the vision capability that DSH's "fetch models" step drops, so image-capable models stop being declared text-only, and marks them in the model name.
- [Cheng-cheng9669/dsh-deepseek-vision](https://github.com/Cheng-cheng9669/dsh-deepseek-vision) - Reuses DeepSeek web's built-in vision mode for text-only models: the deepseek_vision tool drives the local deepseek-vision-cli browser automation (manual login helper, deep-think enabled, auto-closes browser) and returns image descriptions as text.
- [ChordXD/dsh-image-compare](https://github.com/ChordXD/dsh-image-compare) - Adds a right-column panel that compares a set of images the user picks from the workspace — 1/2/3/4/6 per page, per-image zoom and pan, the zoom and viewed position of one image synced onto the whole set, and a reorderable filmstrip. The browser loads every image, so none of it reaches the model.
- [Ck-epsilon/aura-vision](https://github.com/Ck-epsilon/aura-vision) - Free vision OCR with adaptive tile recognition for long documents and Markdown/Word/PNG/Excel export.
- [ck99998888/dsh-video-reader](https://github.com/ck99998888/dsh-video-reader) - Reads a video or audio file into metadata, sampled stills, subtitles and a multilingual speech transcript with speaker labels, captures the live desktop as frames or a recording, and installs its ffmpeg/whisper.cpp/sherpa-onnx toolchain on first use with per-file sha256 checks; all processing stays local. Automatic toolchain install and desktop capture currently support Windows x64 only, so elsewhere ffmpeg and model paths must be set manually.
- [ConsoleSun/Gemini-Eyes](https://github.com/ConsoleSun/Gemini-Eyes) - MCP bridge to gemini.google.com: vision analysis of images and videos, Imagen image and Veo video generation, and conversation management using the logged-in browser session with no API key.
- [copylee711/dsh-image-gen](https://github.com/copylee711/dsh-image-gen) - Image generation with a sidebar gallery page and three agent tools (paint_image, paint_images, edit_painting); preset providers include ModelScope, Google Gemini, OpenAI, SiliconFlow, Volcengine Seedream, Alibaba DashScope, xAI and Zhipu, plus any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, each with its own proxy setting.
- [corrinehu/dsh-chat-imagine](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-chat-imagine) - Automatically generates and displays images in the DSH chat via API channels or local CLIs (mmx / codex / agy), and can also recognize images using the corresponding CLI.
- [Daive1119/local-ocr](https://github.com/Daive1119/local-ocr) - Registers one `ocr` tool for text-only models: it runs the offline script bundled in the repo over a single image or PDF and returns the recognized text — Windows native OCR first, then RapidOCR, then Tesseract. Recognition runs locally with no network request and no API key. Needs Python 3.11 on PATH plus `pip install winocr pillow` (winocr is the preferred engine; RapidOCR and Tesseract are fallbacks). Per-line results for images, per-page results for PDFs.
- [dami9527/dsh-image-pathify](https://github.com/dami9527/dsh-image-pathify) - Lets text-only models handle pasted chat images, with a native vision experience, batch image viewing, and a built-in OpenAI-compatible analyze_image tool; vision-capable models are unaffected.
- [DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-tool-describe-image](https://github.com/DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui/tree/main/packages/dsh-tool-describe-image) - Gives a text-only model image understanding via a vision-language model, exposed as a `describe_image` tool.
- [dickpy/dsh-imagegen](https://github.com/dickpy/dsh-imagegen) - AI image generation for the DSH Web GUI: text-to-image and image-to-image through a configurable OpenAI-compatible endpoint (gpt-image-2 / gpt-image-1 / dall-e-3), with an api_url/api_key settings card and a sidebar split-pane generation studio.
- [dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-mask-pixel-lock](https://github.com/dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-mask-pixel-lock) - Prove that a local image edit left every pixel outside its mask untouched. Original, generated and mask PNGs go in; a greppable `MASK_PIXEL_LOCK=PASS|FAIL|EMPTY` verdict, a difference heatmap, per-channel statistics, a bounding box and the largest changed pixels come out, plus a self-contained HTML report and `report.json` with a SHA-256 file hash, a canonical protected-pixel digest and a proof digest binding both to the policy. Supports edit and lock mask polarities, a mask threshold, tolerance and alpha-ignoring; PNG color types 0/2/3/4/6, bit depths 1-16, all five filters and Adam7. Zero dependencies, local only — no model call, no network, no upload.
- [dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-vision-diff](https://github.com/dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-vision-diff) - Pixel-level screenshot diff for visual regression. Two local PNGs in; a machine-readable first line (`PIXEL_CHANGED=true|false`, greppable as an assertion), then the difference ratio, per-region bounding boxes, maximum channel delta and mean absolute error, plus a self-contained HTML comparison page. An ignore-region list with absolute or fractional coordinates excludes clocks, cursors and other per-render noise. It deliberately does no content recognition: it answers only "did this change", which is the part that can be made deterministic. Entirely local — no model call, no network, no upload.
- [dmscode/dsh-cloudflare-media](https://github.com/dmscode/dsh-cloudflare-media) - Cloudflare Workers AI media tools for dsh - text-to-image, text-to-speech and speech-to-text. Per-model price badges, a native settings card, reuse of an existing Cloudflare account, and output files named after the model that made them.
- [drscrewdriver/dsh-media-lens](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-media-lens) - All-media (video/audio/image) sibling of liustack/modlens: turns local media into structured evidence (timeline / transcript / layout regions) injected into the conversation so text-only models can cite concrete frames, seconds and speakers — Evidence, not imagination. One failover chain per media, recorded hop-by-hop in meta.attempts (a fallback is never silent): host-registered multimodal models first, then a configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint (comma-separated multi-key rotation), then local ffmpeg frame-sampling / a local ASR CLI, degrading to metadata-only as a last resort. Absorbs modlens battle-tested rules — cooldown keyed only on auth/quota failures and softened to chain-tail (never dropped), redact-before-clip error text, magic-byte sniff that never trusts file extensions. Optional vision-bridge registers a media-lens wrapper into the host model selector so a pure-text model gains image/audio/video sight. Registering / authenticating multimodal models and true inline audio-video upload lean on two companion plugins, declared as optional peers (absence auto-degrades, never errors): dsh-thinking-levels fronts the model config / registration surface, dsh-llm-openai-completions takes over the OpenAI-compatible transport that serializes file blocks into video_url / input_audio. Privacy: media goes to remote providers by default; strictLocalOnly keeps content on-machine. Prerequisites not shipped with the package: ffmpeg/ffprobe on PATH (frame sampling / reencode / duration probe; degrades to metadata when missing) and a user-configured local ASR CLI for the audio fallback. Hosts 0.1.7 / 0.2.0 / 0.2.1 (6 rc, exact engines.dsh enum). npm: dsh-media-lens.
- [dttGitHu/dsh-video-android](https://github.com/dttGitHu/dsh-video-android) - Video studio for DeepSeek Harness on Android: storyboard editing, multi-provider image/video generation with automatic failover, FFmpeg MP4 export, prompt optimization, and a mobile-first workbench.
- [Einskyle/dsh-llm-vision-bridge](https://github.com/Einskyle/dsh-llm-vision-bridge) - Native LLM-provider vision bridge: images pasted in the chat are described by a vision model (Qwen3-VL via pi-ai/llama.cpp) and the text description is fed to text-only DeepSeek for the reply — image admission, routing and compaction all run through harness-native mechanisms, with an LRU description cache and 503 retry.
- [Elohia/dsh-plugin-image-input](https://github.com/Elohia/dsh-plugin-image-input) - Image-to-text input for the Web UI: paste or drag an image and it is transcribed into structured text and sent, giving text-only LLMs image-input takeover (OpenAI-compatible vision API).
- [Elohia/dsh-plugin-mm-vision](https://github.com/Elohia/dsh-plugin-mm-vision) - Synesthesia Encoder for DSH: a vision model translates images into compact structured spatial text (canvas/elements/percentage coordinates), giving text-only LLMs pixel-level image understanding via the `mm_vision` tool.
- [ethanweave/dsh-vision-better](https://github.com/ethanweave/dsh-vision-better) - Vision relay for text-only models: a configurable GLM-compatible vision endpoint analyzes the images you attach in the background and the original model keeps answering in the same session, leaving your message, image, model and history untouched. Requires applying patches/0001-session-image-admission.patch to a stock DSH install (images are rejected before storage otherwise); the repo ships an apply/restore script.
- [exoticknight/dsh-labnana](https://github.com/exoticknight/dsh-labnana) - Labnana image generation for DeepSeek Harness: text-to-image / image-to-image / precise editing with credits estimation, subscription balance and web settings UI.
- [fandc520/dsh-comfyui](https://github.com/fandc520/dsh-comfyui) - Drive a local or remote ComfyUI server from DeepSeek Harness: comfyui_run / comfyui_object_info / comfyui_workflow tools generate and edit images and videos, with a workflow library (graph extraction: per component / main flow / all), a load area with resolution auto-match, a live queue, SDXL and Wan 2.1 templates, a companion skill, and a same-origin media proxy.
- [Flyvhidbwo/dsh-vision-proxy](https://github.com/Flyvhidbwo/dsh-vision-proxy) - DeepSeek brain + automatic image transcription: attach images in the GUI and each one is transcribed via the official deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp by default (a pure-text V4-Pro brain can see images), with any OpenAI-compatible VLM or local Ollama as alternatives.
- [fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin](https://github.com/fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin) - Generate images and videos, edit images, remove backgrounds, upscale images, upload reference media, and check Fotor credits.
- [FuzzySoul/dsh-free-vision](https://github.com/FuzzySoul/dsh-free-vision) - Free vision bridge for text-only models: image understanding, OCR, UI and debug analysis via free-tier providers (Qwen3-VL-Flash, Doubao, DeepSeek-OCR) with a settings GUI.
- [gloryxpnv/dsh-tool-vision](https://github.com/gloryxpnv/dsh-tool-vision) - Local-first structured vision for text-only agents: images go to a local OpenAI-compatible VLM and come back as JSON evidence (summary, verbatim OCR, layout regions, entities/relations, colors, explicit uncertainty), with anti-hallucination fallback and an optional paste/upload bridge; zero cloud cost, images never leave the machine.
- [good-boy4069/dsh-vision-guard](https://github.com/good-boy4069/dsh-vision-guard) - Transparent image guard for text-only routes: paste images without the 400 session deadlock, plus a vision_analyze tool for OCR/PDF/docx/pptx/video.
- [GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-vision-bridge](https://github.com/GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-vision-bridge) - Routes images to a vision model of your choice - auto-rewrite, explicit tools, or hybrid - so a text-only chat model does not fail a turn that contains a picture.
- [GOU-GEE/deepseek-vision#plugins/dsh-plugin-deepseek-vision](https://github.com/GOU-GEE/deepseek-vision/tree/main/plugins/dsh-plugin-deepseek-vision) - Vision MCP and DSH bundle for text-only DeepSeek: analyze_image, analyze_clipboard, compare_images and vision_status tools, a visual settings page, free GLM-4.6V-Flash by default, result caching and rate-limit tolerance; keys stay out of logs.
- [grelvan/dsh-ocr-local](https://github.com/grelvan/dsh-ocr-local) - Local OCR fallback for text-only routes: when the session model declares it cannot accept images, the attached image is cached locally and its path injected so the model can call ocr_image — PP-OCRv5 + ONNX Runtime on CPU, no API key, images never leave the machine. Silent when the model can see images.
- [GXX182/dsh-vision-bridge](https://github.com/GXX182/dsh-vision-bridge) - Bridges session images to configurable vision providers and returns text-only analysis to eligible DeepSeek Harness model routes.
- [haiziyao/dsh-vision-mix](https://github.com/haiziyao/dsh-vision-mix) - Combine text, vision, and image-generation APIs into one Mix model with automatic routing: text-only requests go to the chat model, user images and agent screenshots go to the vision model, follow-ups keep using the same session image, and agents can generate or edit images with session-scoped call history.
- [Harvey-Will/dsh-vision-analysis](https://github.com/Harvey-Will/dsh-vision-analysis) - DeepSeek Harness vision plugin: 8 analysis modes (describe, OCR, chart data, UI review, object detection, compare, code-gen, debug), any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible vision API, with a built-in free vision model and automatic rate-limit failover.
- [Harzva/dsh-maclens](https://github.com/Harzva/dsh-maclens) - Apple on-device Vision tools for text-only dsh models: local OCR (zh-Hans + 30 langs), image classification, face detection, document layout, and a combined describe — 100% offline, no API key, tall-screenshot slicing.
- [hawkhai/wechat-ocr](https://github.com/hawkhai/wechat-ocr) - Local WeChat OCR tool for DSH: `wechat_ocr_recognize` returns recognized text and the engine structured result for a local image path.
- [hawkhai/win11-oneocr](https://github.com/hawkhai/win11-oneocr) - Local Windows 11 OneOCR tool for DSH: `oneocr_recognize` returns OCR text and structured line/word polygons, confidence, rotation, and handwriting style.
- [hige6/imgpost](https://github.com/hige6/imgpost) - Let the DSH assistant send local, web, and AI-generated images directly to users in chat, with external vision support for text-only models. On Windows it runs through PowerShell.
- [hiocobueno653-pixel/dsh-image-gen](https://github.com/hiocobueno653-pixel/dsh-image-gen) - Image-generation tool with automatic prompt enhancement, switchable API profiles, and a Turn-tail image card that survives chat folding. Requires a user-supplied image API endpoint and key; none are bundled.
- [huashenglian/dsh-omni-workstation](https://github.com/huashenglian/dsh-omni-workstation) - Omni-modal workstation for DSH: analyze_image over an ordered multi-card VLM failover chain, a six-tool vision toolkit (zoom, colour sampling, pixel diff, OCR, element detection, inline display) sharing the same image resolver, generate_image over OpenAI/DashScope/ComfyUI protocols, multi-card async generate_video with a /build-video-tool builder, and speak/clone_voice TTS over seven providers, all driven by one auto-saving settings page.
- [hyper-dsh-plugins/dsh-open-eyes](https://github.com/hyper-dsh-plugins/dsh-open-eyes) - Vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek routes that analyzes attached and local images through configurable OpenAI Responses, Chat Completions, or Anthropic Messages endpoints while leaving image-capable routes native.
- [InkshadeWoods/dsh-tool-visual-primitives](https://github.com/InkshadeWoods/dsh-tool-visual-primitives) - Analyzes conversation images through mode-specific prompts (caption, UI, document, grounding, topology, etc.) and injects structured evidence with coordinate primitives (boxes, points, refs) as text, with session-level caching for reuse across replay and compaction.
- [Isanti2016/dsh-quicksight](https://github.com/Isanti2016/dsh-quicksight) - Two-tier image reading for text-only models: fast local OCR (RapidOCR, offline) first, vision-model fallback (modlens).
- [jing-hy/picturereader](https://github.com/jing-hy/picturereader) - Image "reading" for text-only models: downscale + reduce color depth + structure/color fingerprints into text grids fed back to the conversation, letting the model zoom, sample and OCR autonomously like a multimodal model; fully local with zero external model dependency, ships an image-reading methodology skill and optional PaddleOCR.
- [jmxsxwyzjdwl/dsh-mmroute](https://github.com/jmxsxwyzjdwl/dsh-mmroute) - Transparent multimodal routing for text-only models: every image in every model call is fully transcribed (verbatim OCR, data, uncertainty zones, injection-hardened) by your own multimodal understander, with focused re-look via vision_relook and automatic retry on image-related failures. No bundled endpoints, no borrowed logins.
- [Junkrat9527/dsh-autovision](https://github.com/Junkrat9527/dsh-autovision) - Vision for text-only dsh models: paste an image and a configured multimodal model transcribes it to text automatically — transparent twin routing, an agent-callable read-image tool, no built-in keys or relay.
- [jyh20030112/dsh-visual-plugin](https://github.com/jyh20030112/dsh-visual-plugin) - Gives text-only models vision: forwards user images to an OpenAI-compatible vision model and shows the descriptions in a Web UI right panel.
- [k2d5rqjpkg-art/dsh-auto-vision](https://github.com/k2d5rqjpkg-art/dsh-auto-vision) - Auto-switch the DeepSeek route to the vision model on demand: flash main session switches (A), pro keeps deep reasoning and delegates image reading to a vision subagent (B), subagents always switch, with fatal-failure fallback. No manual model switching.
- [Kagurazaka135/dsh-video-frames](https://github.com/Kagurazaka135/dsh-video-frames) - Give a text-only agent video understanding: extract timestamped frame files, sample only on scene changes, export GIF clips, probe metadata, and run a one-shot analyse over the frames. Five tools that shell out to a local ffmpeg through argv arrays rather than a shell string.
- [kaixinbaba/dsh-vision-recognizer](https://github.com/kaixinbaba/dsh-vision-recognizer) - Vision provider route that transcribes attached images to text through a configurable model (15+ OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic vendors) while DeepSeek keeps answering.
- [kanchengw/dsh-mindseye](https://github.com/kanchengw/dsh-mindseye) - Plug-in vision for text-only models on DSH, with native interaction for image understanding and generation, GUI automation, through layered evidence memory and cache.
- [kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-qwen-studio](https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-qwen-studio) - Qwen Image 2.1 workspace for DSH: Apple Silicon MLX or your own NVIDIA server, native reference editing, LoRA, ControlNet, inpainting, shared presets, gallery and live agent progress. Includes verified updates and an agent setup guide.
- [klingai-dev/deepseek-plugin](https://github.com/klingai-dev/deepseek-plugin) - Turn every idea into an image or video with Kling AI. In DeepSeek Harness, use natural language for text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-image creation, task tracking, and result previews.
- [ld-1101/dsh-vision-plugin](https://github.com/ld-1101/dsh-vision-plugin) - Give your text-only model eyes - chat image attachments are auto-described via a vision model (default prompt), with iterative re-parsing through model-generated prompts when details are missing; system/custom model modes + GUI config panel, key-safe secret handling, and a small host patch for DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 (see repo README).
- [LeemanCheung/dsh-image-gen](https://github.com/LeemanCheung/dsh-image-gen) - GPT Image 2 `image_gen` with Codex subscription OAuth by default or explicit API-key mode: developing card, up to three live API partials, durable attachment replay/lightbox/download, text-only model output, and bounded credential-safe requests.
- [Leeminjing/dsh-eyes](https://github.com/Leeminjing/dsh-eyes) - On-demand vision for text-only DeepSeek models: upload images, and the model calls a view_image tool backed by any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint (Qwen/DashScope by default).
- [lhbsaa/dsh-visibridge](https://github.com/lhbsaa/dsh-visibridge) - Structured vision evidence (OCR/layout/semantics) plus a USB camera capture tool for a "shoot-look-adjust" debug loop; backends: Ollama, DeepSeek, Xiaomi.
- [linenxi-ctrl/dsh-vision](https://github.com/linenxi-ctrl/dsh-vision) - External vision plugin for DeepSeek Harness: whale-button config panel, image recognition with auto-reply, and agent screenshot/recognize tools.
- [LINinLIN-0079/godot-imagegen](https://github.com/LINinLIN-0079/godot-imagegen) - Local art pipeline for DSH: drives the locally installed SD WebUI and ComfyUI backends through ten image_* tools and an Art Studio sidebar panel with an embedded ComfyUI canvas, post-processes with the Python shipped with those installs (rembg cutout, Real-ESRGAN upscale, seamless tiling), and writes Godot-ready assets with res:// paths once a project root is set.
- [linxuhao/Deepseek-Continuity](https://github.com/linxuhao/Deepseek-Continuity) - Local image, voice, music and SFX generation plus transcription, with pinned identity: characters, animals, objects and actor voices are defined once and reused on every later call, degenerate output (a near-flat image, silent audio) is rejected instead of returned as success, and a generated line can be read back as text so a clone that swallowed its ending becomes visible. The engines unload when idle, and image generation and transcription can each be pointed at an OpenAI-shaped API instead of the local Vulkan backend.
- [liustack/modlens](https://github.com/liustack/modlens) - Vision bridge for text-only models: paste an image, get structured JSON evidence (OCR, layout, semantics).
