- [lkh081231/screenshot-feedback-hook-mcp#dsh-screenshot-feedback-hook-mcp](https://github.com/lkh081231/screenshot-feedback-hook-mcp/tree/main/dsh-plugin) - Adds a take screenshot tool plus two optional automatic capture points, putting the screen into the conversation as an image block; requires an image-capable model.
- [LR611415/visionforge](https://github.com/LR611415/visionforge) - Vision understanding + image generation/editing for DeepSeek Harness (read images with Qwen/OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini, generate and edit with Qwen-Image). A rework of liustack/modlens (MIT). Remove @liustack/modlens first — both register the same vision providers and image interception hooks, so co-installation breaks image reading.
- [lsjspl/dsh-plugin-grok2api-media-tool](https://github.com/lsjspl/dsh-plugin-grok2api-media-tool) - Gives dsh the ability to generate images and videos through the grok2api API.
- [mafeis/dsh-image-guard](https://github.com/mafeis/dsh-image-guard) - Trims historical images in outgoing chat requests down to a recent-image count, learns the provider per-prompt image cap from HTTP 400 responses, and retries with fewer images so image-heavy sessions keep working.
- [Max-Null/dsh-capture](https://github.com/Max-Null/dsh-capture) - Dual-engine screen capture for DSH: inside the SSiD desktop shell, a global hotkey or tray opens a fullscreen box-select overlay (all monitors, per-display pixel-perfect frames) with in-place red-box annotation and a WeChat-style toolbar; in plain DSH (browser), the composer camera button captures the display via getDisplayMedia and reuses the same single-phase box-select + annotation overlay in-page. The cropped image lands in the current conversation composer through the official attachment intake.
- [mengxiaoxian/lookover#dsh-look](https://github.com/mengxiaoxian/lookover/tree/main/dsh-look) - Scene-awareness probe for DSH on macOS: a privacy-first, pull-model `look` tool that reads the frontmost non-self window (app info, AX title/selection, gated local OCR), plus a summon-hotkey snapshot captured the instant you press.
- [MicroHEROX/dsh-koboldcpp-hands](https://github.com/MicroHEROX/dsh-koboldcpp-hands) - Hands repetitive text and vision labor (OCR, image analysis, comparison) to a local KoboldCpp (llama.cpp) server through koboldcpp_run and koboldcpp_vision tools, with on-demand server lifecycle management.
- [MicroHEROX/dsh-unsloth-hands](https://github.com/MicroHEROX/dsh-unsloth-hands) - Hands repetitive text and vision labor (OCR, image analysis, comparison) to a locally running Unsloth Desktop (Unsloth Studio) server through unsloth_run and unsloth_vision tools; pure HTTP client, never spawns or owns processes.
- [MJorgin/dsh-media-skills](https://github.com/MJorgin/dsh-media-skills) - Free vision bridge and image generation for text-only models: paste-image reading, GLM-4V-Flash and Gemini engine failover, ModLens-style structured evidence, and a seeded free vision model route.
- [Monter-code/dsh-image-insight](https://github.com/Monter-code/dsh-image-insight) - Structured image recognition: local sharp measurements plus a cloud vision model return description, OCR with coordinates, object locations and fine-grained attributes in one call; a fingerprint cache makes repeated images return in milliseconds without spending model quota.
- [moon09300731/dsh-vision-tools](https://github.com/moon09300731/dsh-vision-tools) - Full vision-capability bundle for DeepSeek Harness: a vision_understand tool (OpenAI-compatible vision APIs, free Zhipu GLM-4V-Flash by default) plus paste/drag-and-drop/button entry points for image recognition.
- [NagasakiSoyo-ui/dsh-llm-deepseek-vision](https://github.com/NagasakiSoyo-ui/dsh-llm-deepseek-vision) - Vision-augmented DeepSeek adapter: a vision-capable model describes image input, then a text-only DeepSeek model reasons over the description.
- [NeoHotaru/dsh-read-animation](https://github.com/NeoHotaru/dsh-read-animation) - Reads animated GIF and WebP as animations: a pasted one keeps playing in the UI while the model gets a labelled sheet of frames sampled across it, and the read_animation tool samples a file on demand.
- [niuniuaba/dsh-subagent-vision](https://github.com/niuniuaba/dsh-subagent-vision) - Lets a text-only DeepSeek agent read images in the same session by delegating to a vision-capable subagent, with send-time image-to-path conversion.
- [niyongsheng/free-vision-skill](https://github.com/niyongsheng/free-vision-skill) - Fully-local image understanding & OCR via macOS Vision Framework: `ocr_image` (text, table layout + coordinates) and `view_image` (scene, faces, QR) — paste multiple images into the web input box or pass path/URL/base64; images never leave your Mac.
- [NormanFxxkingRockwell/dsh-auto-vision](https://github.com/NormanFxxkingRockwell/dsh-auto-vision) - Auto-discovery vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek Harness agents: automatically finds an image-capable model from your configured providers and returns picture descriptions as plain text via a vision tool.
- [ns-zzj/dsh-hos-scrcpy](https://github.com/ns-zzj/dsh-hos-scrcpy) - Control a HarmonyOS phone from the DSH web UI with AI: live H.264 screen mirroring, mouse touch and system keys, hilog streaming, and agentic tools that let the model read the screen, locate UI controls, then tap, long-press, press keys, or type.
- [ntesicn/dsh-screenshot-xn](https://github.com/ntesicn/dsh-screenshot-xn) - Full-screen screenshot panel for the DSH composer: marquee selection with rectangle, ellipse, arrow, pen, mosaic and text annotation, then insert into the conversation, copy or save. The selected region can also be recognized offline — PP-OCRv6 through onnxruntime-node, falling back to the built-in Windows OCR engine — and translated into nine languages with the model already configured in DSH. On Windows the marquee covers the whole screen including the taskbar and hides the DSH window first, so the capture is of the real desktop. The panel runs in an Edge or Chrome kiosk window, and falls back to an in-DSH capture flow when no browser can be launched. Note that DSH Desktop denies ordinary browser access by default, so the full-screen panel also needs "Allow opening this Profile in a browser" (compatibility mode) enabled in the profile settings; without it every capture goes through the in-DSH fallback. Windows only (DSH Desktop); the PP-OCRv6 models are downloaded from ModelScope on first recognition.
- [Okkay712/DSH-dseyes](https://github.com/Okkay712/DSH-dseyes) - Native image attachments for text-only DeepSeek in the Web GUI: pasted or dropped images appear as thumbnails in the session, and before dispatch the host reads them with the free Zhipu GLM-4V-Flash vision API (glm-4v-flash fallback chain) and substitutes the description, so DeepSeek answers about the image while the original is kept in history.
- [paicat1/dsh-screenshot](https://github.com/paicat1/dsh-screenshot) - Zero-dependency screen capture for DSH: Lightweight — zero deps, zero binaries; Stage & shoot — one-click full screen, window layout, hover-snap capture of occluded windows; Agent self-service — path-only delivery; paths are universal, pair with modlens (optional) for one-call structured evidence.
- [PerryLink/dsh-draw](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-draw) - Multi-engine text-to-image generation (OpenAI Images and Zhipu CogView presets) with per-session quota tracking, engine failover, credential-safe config, and a result card with regenerate.
- [poiuyjie/dsh-vision-opencode](https://github.com/poiuyjie/dsh-vision-opencode) - Adds a configurable vision model to text-only main models: a vision_read_image tool, a composer-bar vision-model selector, and automatic image-to-text conversion for text-only routes.
- [q253595422/dsh-imagegen-video](https://github.com/q253595422/dsh-imagegen-video) - AI image and video generation for the DSH Web GUI: text-to-image and image-to-image over per-channel model catalogs with per-family request shaping (gpt-image, Grok Imagine, Nano Banana, Seedream, GLM-Image, Qwen-Image, MiniMax image-01, DALL-E 3), a sidebar generation studio, an infinite canvas with node workflows, files preview and canvas skills, and a prompt template library; the video side adds text-to-video, image-to-video, first/last-keyframe and multi-reference modes on an async submit/poll/download pipeline, host-side video tools, video nodes on the canvas, and clip stitching of two or more video nodes into one MP4 with the local ffmpeg.
- [QXingYShu/dsh-comfyui-image](https://github.com/QXingYShu/dsh-comfyui-image) - Generate images from the agent on the user's own GPU by queueing a workflow on a local ComfyUI install over its HTTP API: Z-Image-Turbo for fast drafts and Qwen-Image-2.1 for final assets and legible in-image text. Registers comfyui_generate and comfyui_status plus a skill covering model selection and prompt craft, has no runtime dependencies, and starts ComfyUI headless when no server is listening.
- [Rainnnnnnny/lumina-dsh](https://github.com/Rainnnnnnny/lumina-dsh) - Drive local Adobe Photoshop for game screenshots and photos: layered HDR, multi-zone colour/person masks, SUPIR/Real-ESRGAN super-resolution, native 1:1 vision inspection. Requires Windows 10/11 and Adobe Photoshop 2025; the grading tools do not run on macOS or on earlier Photoshop versions.
- [Renji004/dsh-omni-vision](https://github.com/Renji004/dsh-omni-vision) - Local eyes for text-only models: eyes_render draws text/shapes/Mermaid onto a canvas in the Web GUI, eyes_paste captures pasted images, eyes_ocr reads text via the built-in Windows OCR (offline), and eyes_analyze inspects pixels as structured data — no vision model required.
- [ruby1304/dsh-vision-subagent](https://github.com/ruby1304/dsh-vision-subagent) - Vision for any DSH route: paste images in the Web composer with intent-aware auto-analysis, delegate workspace image reads to a Kimi/MiniMax vision subagent, and materialize pasted originals for editing.
- [s3yf1337/dsh-easyvision](https://github.com/s3yf1337/dsh-easyvision) - Give text-only models vision: a describe_image tool that delegates images to a vision model from your dsh model list over the harness's own LLM runtime.
- [SAOS-3624/dsh-video-storyboard](https://github.com/SAOS-3624/dsh-video-storyboard) - Turns a video (a local file, or a Bilibili/yt-dlp link) into one addressable storyboard grid — numbered cells with exact timestamps, per-cell transcript and an audio envelope on the same timeline — and video_zoom re-reads any window at higher resolution, so a text-only model can look at the video instead of reading a summary.
- [say007go/dsh-imagegen](https://github.com/say007go/dsh-imagegen) - DSH text-to-image/image-to-image plugin: compatible with OpenAI-style image generation APIs, with 多米API as the default; standard OpenAI endpoints may require protocol, image-to-image mode and size adjustments; text-to-image and URL reference images do not use COS, while local reference images can be compressed and stored in COS; custom prompt suffixes are supported.
- [Scorp1o117/dsh-tool-vision](https://github.com/Scorp1o117/dsh-tool-vision) - Send local images or HTTP(S) image URLs to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint with the inspect_image tool and return its text response to the conversation.
- [ShaineDemo/dsh-vision-pro-bridge](https://github.com/ShaineDemo/dsh-vision-pro-bridge) - Vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek models: transcribes attached images with deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp before they reach deepseek-v4-pro, with no third-party dependencies.
- [shinjiyu/dsh-plugin-multimodal](https://github.com/shinjiyu/dsh-plugin-multimodal) - Advertise image paste on text-only DeepSeek routes, describe attachments with a vision sidecar, and leave native vision models untouched.
- [shisuiqingqian/dsh-video-kit](https://github.com/shisuiqingqian/dsh-video-kit) - Reads a local video or page link with ffmpeg and Paraformer ASR, returning a timestamped transcript plus key-frame images the agent can open; finds candidate videos by keyword and installs its own runtime dependencies on first use. Requires Python 3.8+ on PATH; video_discover also needs a one-time douyin/xiaohongshu login.
- [siegfly/dsh-deepseek-vision](https://github.com/siegfly/dsh-deepseek-vision) - A vision-language gateway provider route: pasted images are described by a configurable VL model (Qwen-VL by default) before the DeepSeek wire.
- [Ssrs-Pro-Max/dsh-image-tiler](https://github.com/Ssrs-Pro-Max/dsh-image-tiler) - Shows oversized images to the model at readable resolution instead of one downscaled copy: before admission, a large upload is split into as many tiles as the attachment store allows (an 8000x8000 screenshot becomes 20 tiles of 2000x1600), so small text survives. Replaces the local attachment store; adds no settings of its own.
- [sunxin-ai/dsh-design-qa](https://github.com/sunxin-ai/dsh-design-qa) - Design-fidelity QA for text-only models: a `deepseek_vision` tool borrows an eye from any OpenAI-compatible vision route, so the model can judge whether an implementation matches its mock — shipped with the benchmark behind that judgement (four fixtures, 23 injected defects, raw transcripts) and the questioning discipline it depends on.
- [TaurusWood/dsh-plugin-appshot](https://github.com/TaurusWood/dsh-plugin-appshot) - Codex Appshots for DSH: capture the frontmost active window via global shortcut and seamlessly mount it into the composer for agent queries.
- [taxueseek/taxue-dsh-artisan](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxue-dsh-artisan) - Integrated visual creation toolchain for DSH: prompt reverse-engineering and audit optimization plus multi-provider image generation with async background rendering.
- [tenglongbohai/dsh-paddle-ocr](https://github.com/tenglongbohai/dsh-paddle-ocr) - Add PaddleOCR vision to text-only LLMs like Agnes, DeepSeek, MiniMax, GLM and Mimo. Supports local files and URLs. Free tier of 20,000 pages/day; needs a PaddleOCR API token you apply for (free, 1-3 business days).
- [Tests4gptplay/dsh-video-vision](https://github.com/Tests4gptplay/dsh-video-vision) - Give DSH AI timestamped video frames, audio and lyric analysis for Bilibili, YouTube and local files, with browser-session import, optional built-in browser sync, continued viewing, saved site resolvers and native cache management. Requires FFmpeg and ffprobe on PATH or configured in the plugin settings.
- [TZHR-invest/dsh-plugins#dsh-vision-tool](https://github.com/TZHR-invest/dsh-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-vision) - Agent-callable vision tool that describes local images via any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint you configure, with an optional multi-model cross-check and no built-in keys.
- [vitas/dsh-ocr-free](https://github.com/vitas/dsh-ocr-free) - Local OCR using Apple Vision on macOS: text from screenshots, photos, and scans, with no install, no network and no API key.
- [wang-bool/visual-review](https://github.com/wang-bool/visual-review) - Renders pasted/uploaded images inline in the DSH Web chat and gives text-only models vision: the model-invokable visual_review tool calls any OpenAI-compatible multimodal API first, falling back to a local Qwen3-VL worker.
- [wanshichenguang/dsh-tool-vision](https://github.com/wanshichenguang/dsh-tool-vision) - Model-facing image_describe (识图) tool over the DashScope OpenAI-compatible API (qwen3.7-flash), plus a paste bridge: on text-only sessions, pasted images auto-convert to file paths at send time and render back in the transcript, so they never trip image admission. Bring your own DASHSCOPE_API_KEY; endpoint/model/budgets configurable, redirect-proof HTTP client, works in every agent preset.
- [wbb316/dsh-comfyui-image](https://github.com/wbb316/dsh-comfyui-image) - Image generation through a local ComfyUI server: one generate_image tool covering text2img, img2img, inpaint and background removal.
- [whiteS18/dsh-image-generation](https://github.com/whiteS18/dsh-image-generation) - Configure multiple image providers in Settings and call image_generate with the one selected model; images save under generate/image and show inline in the conversation.
- [wmk66ds/dsh-vision-unlock](https://github.com/wmk66ds/dsh-vision-unlock) - Removes the model-capability gate that blocks image prompts: patches llm.resolveModelInfo results and adapter model tables to declare image input, so routes with no declared input modality can send and read images. No app.asar or config-tree edits.
- [WongYuYe/dsh-appshots](https://github.com/WongYuYe/dsh-appshots) - Codex-style window capture for DSH Desktop on macOS and Windows: press both Command keys (macOS) or both Ctrl keys (Windows), or the camera button, to grab the frontmost window, attach it to the current chat, and inject a VoiceOver-style accessibility tree as hidden context.
- [WSL043/dsh-image-viewer](https://github.com/WSL043/dsh-image-viewer) - Upgrades DSH image viewing with pointer-centered zoom, pan, galleries, downloads, keyboard support, and inline region notes.
- [wulusai2333/mimo-vision](https://github.com/wulusai2333/mimo-vision) - `describe_image` tool: a vision bridge that sends images to mimo-v2.5 through the opencode Zen API (credential `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`, free route first with paid fallback) and returns text descriptions for text-only models, with native passthrough and ImageMagick transcoding of SVG/TIFF/HEIC formats.
- [xiaoshihou514/dsh-vision](https://github.com/xiaoshihou514/dsh-vision) - Native vision capability extension, using either Zhipu (free) or Qwen-VL (local).
- [xiaoyuink/dsh-image-vision](https://github.com/xiaoyuink/dsh-image-vision) - Image understanding for any DSH model: vision, OCR, grounding, and crop tools with domain presets for histopathology, cell biology, anatomy, clinical images and scientific figures.
- [xiaozhe7772222/dsh-draw-router](https://github.com/xiaozhe7772222/dsh-draw-router) - Unified image generation router for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): auto-discovers image models from any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, provides draw_image and draw_list_sources tools, supports SenseNova, StepFun, Agnes, Qwen, Flux, SD, Imagen and more.
- [ximengxiaolan/dsh-vision-bridge](https://github.com/ximengxiaolan/dsh-vision-bridge) - Composer-attached images are transcribed to text by an OpenAI-compatible vision model before reaching text-only DeepSeek models.
- [xing666173/dsh-vision-hub#tool-vision](https://github.com/xing666173/dsh-vision-hub/tree/main/tool-vision) - Enhanced vision toolbox: 14 pixel-level vision tools (describe, ground, detect, crop, pixel-diff, OCR, long-screenshot OCR, vectorize, colors, cutout, screenshot, present, materialize, html-screenshot) driven by one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with clean \[图片: path] bridge markers, content-safety classification and rate-limit auto-retry.
- [xsoc1/dsh-image-vision](https://github.com/xsoc1/dsh-image-vision) - Chat image-attachment bridge with a `view_image` tool for any OpenAI-compatible VLM (local Ollama or cloud): pasted/dropped images become `view_image` path markers before reaching text-only DeepSeek models.
- [xuanyuanluoxue/computer-use-vision](https://github.com/xuanyuanluoxue/computer-use-vision) - Windows computer-use capability for DSH: screenshot → vision model → simulated mouse/keyboard with self-evolving knowledge base. Dual-mode plugin tools + skill-only pwsh fallback.
- [Yinxe/deepseek-harness-plugins#vision-bridge](https://github.com/Yinxe/deepseek-harness-plugins/tree/main/plugins/vision-bridge) - Let text-only models see images: when a picture arrives with a placeholder like \[image omitted because this model accepts text only], the model calls the vision_describe tool and the plugin forwards the image reference plus the question to a multimodal model, retrying with a fallback model on failure. Configured in the settings page and persisted via the official settings API.
- [ysr666/dsh-vision-router](https://github.com/ysr666/dsh-vision-router) - Free vision for text-only agents: built-in keyless vision chain plus pixel tools (Q&A, grounding, crop, pixel diff, colors, OCR, SVG trace, cutout, screenshots); paste an image to use it.
- [yupaoa/dsh-image-lite](https://github.com/yupaoa/dsh-image-lite) - Image generation for DSH in two modes — an image_generate_lite tool the model calls from chat, and a right-sidebar studio for manual runs; up to five reference images, the OpenAI images API format, keys kept in the DSH credential service.
- [yxqfg/phone-lens#phone-lens](https://github.com/yxqfg/phone-lens/tree/main/packages/phone-lens) - Turn a phone camera into a live viewfinder and photo input for your dsh session, over LAN or USB.
- [yzhclcl/dsh-omni-modal](https://github.com/yzhclcl/dsh-omni-modal) - Adds an Omni-modal settings section to DeepSeek Harness that points the harness at any OpenAI-compatible image and video endpoint: switchable config profiles with separate endpoint, API key, model, path and size for each side, free-form extra request parameters, a connectivity test that does not spend generation quota, and three model-visible tools — generate_image, generate_video and check_video — with async video tasks that survive restarts.
- [zhiwuli0228/dsh-image-router](https://github.com/zhiwuli0228/dsh-image-router) - Digests the images in a prompt with a vision model before admission, so any model — a text-only one included — can read them without the session ever switching models, and adds a describe_image tool for image paths.
- [zirscard/dsh-ocr](https://github.com/zirscard/dsh-ocr) - Registers two tools for DeepSeek Harness. `doc_ocr` turns scanned PDFs and images into structured text (per-page text, financial tables with a balance-sheet tie-out check, contract-clause hits) through a local RapidOCR engine or a Zhipu GLM-OCR cloud engine, and `doc_preprocess` turns a directory of raw files into an Obsidian-ready knowledge base through a seven-stage pipeline with backend routing and sha256-based incremental skipping. Numbers that fail the tie-out are reported, not invented. The local engine needs Python 3 with rapidocr-onnxruntime, pypdfium2 and Pillow (pip install -r requirements.txt); the GLM engine needs ZHIPU_API_KEY.
- [zmm863-commits/dsh-agnes-studio](https://github.com/zmm863-commits/dsh-agnes-studio) - AI image and video studio as a floating DSH panel, so creation runs alongside the conversation instead of replacing it: text-to-image, image-to-image and multi-image composition at 1K-4K across eight aspect ratios; text-to-video and image-to-video with first-frame control at 4-12 seconds; short-drama mode that imports a script (.txt/.md/.json), breaks it into storyboard shots for preview and batch generation; and a prompt-expert workspace. Zero runtime dependencies.
- [zzsszz1122/dsh-agnes-media](https://github.com/zzsszz1122/dsh-agnes-media) - Sidebar panel for Agnes image and video generation that also ships a node canvas and a short-drama mode. Canvas nodes are chained by extracting the previous shot's tail frame with ffmpeg and submitting it as the next shot's first frame; short-drama mode turns an imported script into storyboard shots. Generation and polling run in the Host process, so tasks survive a page reload or a closed panel, and results plus an 80-entry history are stored on disk.

### Voice & Audio

- [0nt-one/dsh-voice-input](https://github.com/0nt-one/dsh-voice-input) - Mic button in the composer tool row: Web Speech API speech-to-text (Chrome/Edge), language switching, and optional auto-send, zero dependencies.
- [117BS/dsh-perlica-ding](https://github.com/117BS/dsh-perlica-ding) - Perlica (Arknights: Endfield) themed tiered sound notifications: plan-ready, task-done, needs-your-input, and error tones; silent for plain chat, system-level playback (works in background), cross-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux), custom TTS sounds.
- [1497105876/dsh-mimotts](https://github.com/1497105876/dsh-mimotts) - MiMo TTS speech synthesis for DeepSeek Harness: a speak button on finalized assistant messages with an inline player (draggable progress bar), a plugin-page configuration card with preview playback, and a voice-history settings page.
- [1624318455/dsh-plugin-tts](https://github.com/1624318455/dsh-plugin-tts) - Reads assistant replies aloud via free Edge TTS or your own RVC voice models: read-aloud buttons + auto-read, adaptive chunked progressive playback (gapless long reads), one-click voice-pack installs from a registry, and a portable RVC runtime.
- [2021Heei/dsh-tts-flash](https://github.com/2021Heei/dsh-tts-flash) - Reads AI replies aloud as they stream, with voiced waiting phrases while the model thinks. Edge TTS built in, any OpenAI-compatible cloud engine supported.
- [3274375092/dsh-voice](https://github.com/3274375092/dsh-voice) - Voice input for DeepSeek Harness: speak into the microphone and the recognized text is submitted as a normal chat message, via local or browser speech recognition.
- [aa2246740/dsh-livevoice](https://github.com/aa2246740/dsh-livevoice) - Realtime WebRTC voice using Codex OAuth, with task delegation to a DSH session.
- [abbccdd/dsh-localtts](https://github.com/abbccdd/dsh-localtts) - Connects existing IndexTTS 2.5 and GPT-SoVITS installations for sentence-level assistant reading in Harness web, with local process launch and playback controls.
- [AI-Galaxy-GPU/dsh-sound](https://github.com/AI-Galaxy-GPU/dsh-sound) - Per-event sound notifications: turn completion, approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, and task-failure each get their own sound and volume, configurable in the Web UI (built-in synth, mute, or local audio file).
- [AIcivilization/dsh-audiobook](https://github.com/AIcivilization/dsh-audiobook) - Search public-domain libraries (Project Gutenberg, Wikisource, Internet Archive, Standard Ebooks) by title, author, character or half-remembered plot, or import EPUB / PDF / TXT / DOCX / Markdown, and listen in the sidebar with Microsoft Edge neural voices, offline Kokoro or the device voices; keeps your position, takes voice notes anchored to what you just heard, and discusses the book with your DSH model.
- [Alan2Z/dsh-speak](https://github.com/Alan2Z/dsh-speak) - Zero-dependency, event-driven voice announcement plugin: no extra model, no token cost. Speaks with the system's built-in natural voice, supporting both Windows and macOS; final-reply announcements, approval & question alerts, optional event announcements (turn end, command done, goal change, tool errors, todo updates), replayable final replies, and a bilingual visual settings page.
- [ALittleLov/dsh-soundcheck](https://github.com/ALittleLov/dsh-soundcheck) - Turns a local audio file into a short plain-language verdict on tempo, key, dynamics, clipping and arrangement shape, and keeps the raw measurements in a separate block; audio never leaves the machine.
- [AndyYang12345/dsh-dictation-hotkey](https://github.com/AndyYang12345/dsh-dictation-hotkey) - Push-to-talk dictation for the Web composer: hold a hotkey to record and the transcript is written into the draft through DSH's own speech Remote (local SenseVoice), with an optional auto-send.
- [anweat/dsh-voice-webspeech](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-voice-webspeech) - Browser Web Speech API voice input: zero server, zero keys, zero model downloads (Edge=Azure, Chrome=Google speech).
- [baisama-cloud/dsh-stt-input](https://github.com/baisama-cloud/dsh-stt-input) - Speech-to-text voice input for the web UI: a mic button in the composer transcribes speech into the draft via the browser Web Speech API (zero-config) or an OpenAI-compatible Whisper API (OpenAI / Groq), with a selectable model and language in Settings.
- [beiyege-01/dsh-voice-ai-girlfriend-plugin](https://github.com/beiyege-01/dsh-voice-ai-girlfriend-plugin) - Voice AI girlfriend for the Web UI: FunASR mic input, Qwen3-TTS spoken replies, companion animation window, and two-way QQ chat (text/voice/image push) via NapCat.
- [berserk0501/dsh-soundscape](https://github.com/berserk0501/dsh-soundscape) - Dual-MediaPlayer daemon ($think loop + $fx one-shots) with volume ducking, mood-aware sounds (smooth/struggle/deep_think triggered by consecutive success/failure streaks and prolonged agent runtime), 15 built-in PCM WAV synthesised from sine/square waveforms, per-tool sound mapping with 51 categorised tools, custom WAV/MP3 drop-in with auto-conversion, and a full settings UI with dark-mode fix.
- [biliye/dsh-voice-call](https://github.com/biliye/dsh-voice-call) - Voice call assistant for the DSH desktop app and the Web GUI (the same plugin, only the profile name differs): a draggable floating call ball, browser-side VAD that sends each utterance after a pause, speech recognition through the local SenseVoice model already downloaded by the official voice-input plugin (no second model), FunASR HTTP or streaming, or a cloud-compatible API, MiniMax / MiMo-V2.5-TTS (director mode and voice clone) / OpenAI-compatible TTS replies, an optional wake-word mode with auto-sleep, and task dispatch to separate sessions with progress, stop, and spoken completion reports.
- [CAOGGL/dsh-ding](https://github.com/CAOGGL/dsh-ding) - Notifies you when a conversation finishes: plays a sound and shows a Windows notification when the agent goes idle (configurable sound file, volume, debounce/throttle).
- [cccc12138/dsh-read-aloud](https://github.com/cccc12138/dsh-read-aloud) - Adds a speaker button immediately right of the Like button on every finalized assistant reply; click it to hear the reply through the browser speech engine, and hover it for a speed and voice panel. Text is sent to an unofficial Edge TTS endpoint.
- [chaoge762/dsh-ears-prosody](https://github.com/chaoge762/dsh-ears-prosody) - Local offline prosody analysis for DeepSeek Harness: reports how something was said — speed, pitch, pauses, energy — alongside the transcript.
- [dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-voice-memo](https://github.com/dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-voice-memo) - Dictation that ends up in the repository instead of the chat log: hold the button (or import a WAV), and the plugin archives voice-memos/<id>/ with audio.wav, a rendered waveform.png, memo.md (frontmatter, per-segment timestamps, ready-to-paste quote blocks) and meta.json. Audio is resampled to 16 kHz mono in the browser before it is sent. Transcription stays local — the harness speechToText service with silence-split windows, or a command worker such as faster-whisper — and when no engine is available the memo is still filed with an explicit status and reason rather than a fabricated transcript. Ships a conversation-view 口述 tab with click-to-seek playback and per-segment quote copy, three agent tools (voice_memo_save / voice_memo_list / voice_memo_read) and HTTP routes. Zero runtime dependencies, 52 node:test cases, real screenshots in docs/.
- [duoduoqian708/dsh-voice-talk](https://github.com/duoduoqian708/dsh-voice-talk) - Voice conversation mode for the DSH Web GUI: tap the mic to start a full-screen call, talk hands-free, and hear each reply read aloud as it streams. Bilingual (Chinese/English) UI, light and dark themes, adjustable speech rate, and switchable voices.
- [fangqian616/dsh-say](https://github.com/fangqian616/dsh-say) - Speaks your agent's reports in a voice you choose, compressing long reports before speaking. Character voices need no training - a 3-10 second reference clip clones one, and community-trained models work too - and no 6.4 GB GPT-SoVITS install: the plugin installs its own runtime and voice. An existing GPT-SoVITS can be used instead, and it is the same voice model.
- [february2015/dsh-dingo](https://github.com/february2015/dsh-dingo) - Sound reminders with one-click jump for concurrent sessions: the current session gets crisp dang/dang-dang tones, other sessions a soft ding/ding-ding plus a top-right card that jumps straight to the replying conversation.
- [fenglin-ai/dsh-funasr-voice](https://github.com/fenglin-ai/dsh-funasr-voice) - Offline voice input for the DSH Web UI: mic to local FunASR (SenseVoiceSmall), one-click install, no cloud.
- [fishcg/dsh-airpod-control](https://github.com/fishcg/dsh-airpod-control) - Requires macOS and AirPods with head tracking. Answer DSH permission prompts and questions with AirPods head gestures — nod to allow or confirm, shake to reject or shift the selected option — and install the companion macOS menu-bar app from a card inside the session.
- [flashyiyi/dsh-voice-announcer](https://github.com/flashyiyi/dsh-voice-announcer) - Voice announcements when a conversation ends (session title, round, outcome) plus live sentence-by-sentence reading of replies, via built-in edge-tts with zero third-party dependencies.
- [FuzzySoul/dsh-chatvoice](https://github.com/FuzzySoul/dsh-chatvoice) - Free voice closed loop for the Web UI: browser SpeechRecognition mic input with live interim results plus read-aloud speaker buttons and auto-read for assistant replies, zero configuration and no API key.
- [FYZB2020/dsh-voice-doubao](https://github.com/FYZB2020/dsh-voice-doubao) - Adds two Volcengine Doubao cloud speech recognizers to the DeepSeek Harness voice-input picker, optionally rewriting the transcript with an LLM.
- [GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-tts](https://github.com/GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-tts) - Speaks agent replies in the DeepSeek Harness web UI through a provider fallback chain (OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Google, Azure, Groq, Deepgram, OpenRouter, Edge, Piper, eSpeak), so a failing or rate-limited provider falls through to the next instead of going silent.
- [GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-voice](https://github.com/GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-voice) - Voice input for the web UI: dictation chunked by pauses and voice messages, each with its own provider fallback chain (Deepgram, Groq, HuggingFace, local whisper.cpp, or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint).
- [haoku123/dsh-voice](https://github.com/haoku123/dsh-voice) - Full-duplex voice mode for the Web UI: tap-to-toggle or hold-to-talk dictation (send key or `Ctrl`) with a live caption, host-side SenseVoice ASR via sherpa-onnx, sentence-by-sentence spoken replies, and speaking interrupts playback and the running turn (true barge-in). No API key.
- [honwee/dsh-plugin-mynah](https://github.com/honwee/dsh-plugin-mynah) - Give the agent a talking face: seven tools that drive a self-hosted Mynah realtime digital human — speak (queued or interrupting), play a gesture clip, interrupt, list live sessions and channels, check health, add text to its knowledge base.
- [huguangyu666/dsh-plugin-notify](https://github.com/huguangyu666/dsh-plugin-notify) - Notification outbox: agent proactively notifies via toast / Chinese TTS voice / sound effects (explosion, victory, alarm), 60s confirmation window voice-calls you back, volume boost, settings panel.
- [huliux/dsh-asr-plugin](https://github.com/huliux/dsh-asr-plugin) - Local meeting transcription with microphone and system audio recording, speaker labels, and transcript export for DeepSeek Harness on Apple Silicon macOS.
- [jerryqx/dsh-ximalaya](https://github.com/jerryqx/dsh-ximalaya) - Listen to Ximalaya podcasts and audiobooks inside the DSH web UI: search albums, browse paginated tracks, and play through a now-playing bar (prev/play/next, seek, volume, rate). After QR login the "Mine" page lists your liked tracks (click to play), subscribed albums with latest-episode hints, and followed anchors with their public albums; the host relays audio streams with Range support and registers an `ximalaya_play` tool so the agent can search and play on request.
- [Jesse-njx/dsh-voice](https://github.com/Jesse-njx/dsh-voice) - Voice notes in, spoken answers out: dictate audio that becomes user messages (transcribe), have the agent read replies aloud (speak), local-first under ~/.dsh/voice.
- [jryang1997/dsh-hold-to-dictate](https://github.com/jryang1997/dsh-hold-to-dictate) - Hold-to-talk dictation in the composer that ships no recognizer of its own and reuses the speech service the official voice-input bundle already mounts - long-press the input box with mouse or touch, release to write the transcript into the draft, slide up to cancel, and it never sends.
- [Jstn-1g/dsh-live-voice](https://github.com/Jstn-1g/dsh-live-voice) - Consent-bound one-turn voice preview for DSH Web with a credential-free local synthetic demo, optional Qwen Audio, exact Session isolation, and explicit transcript-to-draft handoff without automatic submission.
- [junarch/voice_for_dsh#dsh-plugin-voice](https://github.com/junarch/voice_for_dsh/tree/main/packages/dsh-plugin-voice) - Reads each reply aloud after rewriting it into spoken style: system TTS, Doubao speech synthesis, or an optional local Kokoro model.
- [jypjypjypjyp/dsh-music-studio](https://github.com/jypjypjypjyp/dsh-music-studio) - Music composition inside the conversation: the model writes a score against a bundled composing skill, and a play_score tool renders it as an inline card with a piano roll, Web Audio playback and WAV/JSON export.
- [KeinsteinNUS/dsh-speech-polish](https://github.com/KeinsteinNUS/dsh-speech-polish) - Adds a terminology-aware correction pass to the built-in local speech-to-text: keeps DSH's own microphone and SenseVoice engine (audio never leaves the machine) and fixes homophones, domain terms and malformed numbers in the finished transcript.
- [kekydream/dsh-meeting-room](https://github.com/kekydream/dsh-meeting-room) - Meeting notes for dsh: one meeting per conversation, transcribed and speaker-separated on the machine itself, with points, assignments, handwritten notes, reviews and monthly scores in the same panel. Exports SRT/Markdown/Word and packs a meeting into a portable zip another dsh can import; confirmed assignments go to DingTalk/WeCom in one click, following your robot settings. Recognition models are swappable (a stronger local model can be imported from a file), and cloud recognition is off by default with no request made before consent. Word export needs Python and python-docx; the first run downloads a recognition model (28 or 77 MB).
- [Laplace-bit/dsh-pianist](https://github.com/Laplace-bit/dsh-pianist) - Piano performance plugin: ask the agent to play a piece and it renders on a Canvas2D grand piano with real Salamander Grand samples, an immersive stage, and an interactive 88-key keyboard.
- [ldchaowin/dsh-plugin-notify-sound](https://github.com/ldchaowin/dsh-plugin-notify-sound) - Per-workspace completion ringtones plus attention sounds for approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, and task-failure events, with built-in synth, voice (TTS), and custom audio.
- [lengmodkx/dsh-mimo-tts](https://github.com/lengmodkx/dsh-mimo-tts) - MiMo voice for DeepSeek Harness — reads each finished answer aloud, turns composer dictation into text, and offers nine built-in voices plus a cloned-voice slot.
- [lgquan/dsh-voco](https://github.com/lgquan/dsh-voco) - Continuous voice conversations for DSH with hands-free listening, push-to-talk, speech recognition, TTS replies, and background Agent delegation.
- [lihua12345670-jpg/dsh-bili-audio](https://github.com/lihua12345670-jpg/dsh-bili-audio) - Plays the audio of a Bilibili video from a floating bar in the DSH Web UI, with a queue, seek and speed controls, and a host-side reverse proxy for the CDN Referer check.
- [ljz970803/dsh-voice-wake](https://github.com/ljz970803/dsh-voice-wake) - Local wake-word voice input for DSH. Say the wake word, wait for the chime, then speak; text is sent to a DSH session. Audio is processed locally by default and not stored. Requires the DSH speech input service (speechToText) to be available.
- [loyalchiiina/dsh-voice-alert](https://github.com/loyalchiiina/dsh-voice-alert) - Plays a voice line or a sound when a turn finishes and a failure cue when a tool call or a turn errors — user aborts stay silent by default and subagent sessions are skipped, both configurable. Three alert modes: voice, effects, or off. Effects is the default and ships 20 built-in sounds (10 alert chimes + 10 nature), each assignable to the done, fail or approval event with per-row preview, so it needs no API key and no audio files; the voice route uses Volcengine TTS with cloned or preset voices, batch-imported voice IDs and fingerprint reuse that skips re-synthesis when text, voice and parameters are unchanged. A third approval slot exists but has no automatic trigger — it only plays when called manually. Playback goes through winmm/waveOut as-is, never changing the system volume or mute state, and the player is spawned detached so session teardown cannot silence it. Windows only.
- [Making-acid/dsh-synthv-studio](https://github.com/Making-acid/dsh-synthv-studio) - Connects a local Synthesizer V Studio 2 Pro to the agent through its own Lua script API, with five tools for discovery, a persistent bridge, voice composition, note editing and DAW (VST3/ARA + MIDI) integration. Windows 10/11 only; requires Synthesizer V Studio 2 Pro 2.1.2+ with a project open.
- [maoyuching/dsh-voice-chat](https://github.com/maoyuching/dsh-voice-chat) - Doubao-style voice chat for DSH: press-and-hold mic in the composer converts speech to text and auto-sends, and AI replies are read aloud. Optional LLM condensing (long replies summarized into short spoken lines, following the current conversation model), TTS-friendly text cleaning, selectable Edge TTS voices, adjustable silence auto-stop, and settings embedded in DSH settings dialog.
- [MaRi23333/dsh-fish-tts](https://github.com/MaRi23333/dsh-fish-tts) - Reads assistant replies aloud via Fish Audio API only (bring your own key): per-message read-aloud, auto-read toggle, and a settings page for model, voice reference_id, encrypted API key, and proxy.
- [martindye/dsh-voice](https://github.com/martindye/dsh-voice) - Two-way voice for the DSH web app: dictate with the unified composer, hear replies with speaker buttons and auto-read, on any device. Needs DSH 0.1.7+, Node 22+, Python 3 with numpy and requests, a TTS model, and a microphone.
- [mhlywxl/dsh-coding-sound](https://github.com/mhlywxl/dsh-coding-sound) - Generative background music while the model streams, plus completion, approval and attention chimes: hear whether the agent is thinking, still working, or waiting for you without watching the screen.
- [naili0712/dsh-gsv-local](https://github.com/naili0712/dsh-gsv-local) - Local GPT-SoVITS voice for DeepSeek Harness: boots the engine with DSH and kills it on exit, speaks only the line marked for voice, and ships a default voice, so you only need to point runtimeDir at a local GPT-SoVITS install.
- [NewDaNew/dsh-voice-input](https://github.com/NewDaNew/dsh-voice-input) - Voice input for the web UI: a mic button in the composer that transcribes speech into the draft via the Web Speech API, with an optional auto-send toggle.
- [Nothree-code/voco-input-sh](https://github.com/Nothree-code/voco-input-sh) - Voice input for the Web UI: a mic button that drives local VocoType offline speech recognition and auto-inserts recognized text into the composer (auto-deploy, dedupe, continuous dictation).
- [nsswkj/dsh-typewriter-blip](https://github.com/nsswkj/dsh-typewriter-blip) - Turns a streaming assistant reply into short blips, one per character at a configurable minimum spacing, for the reply text only, and keeps sounding when the window is minimized, covered, or in a background tab. Two built-in voices, or a custom one shaped by waveform, or loaded from an audio file.
- [Nuoyi207/dsh-gptsovits-tts](https://github.com/Nuoyi207/dsh-gptsovits-tts) - Local GPT-SoVITS text-to-speech for DSH: reads replies aloud, switches voices from the right sidebar, and trains a new voice from a dropped audio sample. First run downloads an 11.4 GB engine and needs an NVIDIA CUDA GPU.
- [OMSociety/dsh-xiaoai-bridge](https://github.com/OMSociety/dsh-xiaoai-bridge) - Plugin that turns a XiaoAI (Xiaomi) smart speaker into a voice assistant: hosts the local bridge process, listens for the wake word, runs speech recognition (ASR / STT) on what you say, keeps the conversation in the host session, and speaks the answer back through the speaker with text-to-speech (TTS) playback.
- [PandaPolo/dsh-voice-call](https://github.com/PandaPolo/dsh-voice-call) - Agent-initiated voice calls: `offer_call` rings the human (接听/拒接/稍后再说); accepted calls synthesize and play locally via CrispASR + Qwen3-TTS (9 speakers, 2 Chinese dialects), rejected calls return the decision to the agent.
- [PensiveFei/dsh-voice-scribe](https://github.com/PensiveFei/dsh-voice-scribe) - Voice input for the web UI: tap Alt (or Alt+Space) to start/stop dictation, browser Web Speech (zero-config) or OpenAI-compatible cloud ASR, optional polish through DSH-configured LLM, settings UI.
- [PerryLink/dsh-talk](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-talk) - Voice I/O for DeepSeek Harness — speech-to-text and text-to-speech over the microphone and audio output.
- [PolinniZhong/dsh-omi-voice](https://github.com/PolinniZhong/dsh-omi-voice) - In-chat read-aloud for DeepSeek Harness: tap to read, pause and resume AI replies with natural Doubao TTS voices (BYOK), reading only the final answer with code, tables and diagrams filtered; local engine, plugin keeps no API key.
- [ppy-web/dsh-plugin-xiaomi-mimo-tts](https://github.com/ppy-web/dsh-plugin-xiaomi-mimo-tts) - Adds Xiaomi MiMo, Doubao, and browser text-to-speech to DSH, with automatic read-aloud, custom voices, and optional UI sound effects.
- [qishuilalala/dsh-voice-mode#dsh-voice-mode](https://github.com/qishuilalala/dsh-voice-mode/tree/main/plugin/dsh-voice-mode) - Full-duplex voice mode for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: toggle (2s-pause auto-send) or hold-to-talk dictation into an editable draft with zipformer2 streaming ASR, optional wake word; sentence-by-sentence Edge TTS read-aloud with live captions, and speaking interrupts playback and the running turn (true barge-in). On-device ASR, no API key.
- [QT-Chen/dsh-mic-input](https://github.com/QT-Chen/dsh-mic-input) - Microphone voice input for the composer: browser Web Speech API live transcription, dedupe/auto-continue, smart punctuation, language and auto-send settings.
- [radres/dsh-plugin-call-me](https://github.com/radres/dsh-plugin-call-me) - Rings your phone over CallKit: `call_me` and `text_me` tools, plus optional turn-end and approval calls whose spoken answer is transcribed back into the session.
- [regrevia/dsh-pet-voice#dsh-pet-voice](https://github.com/regrevia/dsh-pet-voice/tree/main/plugins/dsh-pet-voice) - The DSH app also doubles as a desktop pet: wake it with your voice, talk out loud, and give orders by speaking. Reach the DeepSeek Harness running on your own computer over LAN, your own domain, or a relay server — and chat with the little whale working in your project to put it to work. Travelling without your laptop is no longer a problem.
- [rootryanlau-art/dsh-voice-transcribe](https://github.com/rootryanlau-art/dsh-voice-transcribe) - Transcribe local audio and video files offline with a composer panel, a CLI, and an agent skill, powered by SenseVoice int8.
- [scarf1985566475-cloud/dsh-voice](https://github.com/scarf1985566475-cloud/dsh-voice) - Local English-to-Chinese simultaneous interpretation: on-device Qwen3-ASR bilingual captions with automatic language detection, crash-safe meeting records with minutes, and Obsidian export.
- [Schumchanvi/dsh-voice-input-cn](https://github.com/Schumchanvi/dsh-voice-input-cn) - China-ready voice input for the composer. Requires a local Python bridge (pip install dashscope websockets, run bridge/voice-bridge.py) — the plugin alone does not work. Browser mic streams 16 kHz PCM to the bridge, which runs Alibaba Cloud DashScope ASR (paraformer-realtime-v2); interim text fills the draft at the cursor, silence auto-stop, optional auto-send.
- [shimingming520/dsh-audiogen](https://github.com/shimingming520/dsh-audiogen) - AI audio generation for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI — multi-vendor TTS, music, sound effects and voice design with a sidebar panel, model comparison, resource library and Agent tools.
- [STARDUSTLC666/dsh-voice](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-voice) - Voice tools: free edge-tts neural speech synthesis, OpenAI-compatible ASR transcription, voice list, batch voice preview and health self-check.
- [SuCriss/dsh-voice-control](https://github.com/SuCriss/dsh-voice-control) - Voice control for the DSH web composer: push-to-talk speech-to-text into the input box (with optional auto-send), spoken playback of assistant replies via the Web Speech API, right-click settings popover, and a global Ctrl+M hotkey.
- [supersyh-sss/dsh-voice-assistant](https://github.com/supersyh-sss/dsh-voice-assistant) - Voice assistant for dsh web: say the wake phrase (e.g. "小鲸") to activate hands-free dictation — what you say is transcribed and typed into the chat box automatically. Supports spoken edit commands (send, clear, new line, stop reading) and reads assistant replies aloud in Chinese. Speech recognition runs locally in-browser via sherpa-onnx WASM, so it works offline without an API key.
- [tangzheng202202/dsh-voice-live](https://github.com/tangzheng202202/dsh-voice-live) - Real-time duplex voice over Volcengine streaming ASR/TTS: agent reply narration, barge-in, wake word, live captions, 30 Chinese voices and a reply-first acknowledgment; builds in the DSH monorepo.
- [TaoruiLiu19/dsh-gsv](https://github.com/TaoruiLiu19/dsh-gsv) - Real-time local TTS for DeepSeek Harness: voice presets, auto-read, engine setup assistant, a read-aloud button, and a settings panel for the GSV-TTS-Lite engine.
- [toddpan/dsh-xiaozhi](https://github.com/toddpan/dsh-xiaozhi) - Connects the Xiaozhi voice assistant to DSH Web over MCP: DSH is the tool provider, weaving 35 DSH Web endpoints into 16 voice-friendly tools for workspaces, sessions, chat, models, settings and files — outbound WebSocket to the Xiaozhi MCP access point by default (no public IP or port forwarding needed), several devices bound at once, plus a DSH settings page with live status.
- [underworld-oddball/dsh-volume-knob](https://github.com/underworld-oddball/dsh-volume-knob) - Speaker button left of the model selector in the composer tool row — one click scrolls to the start of your newest question, marks it with a blinking caret and reads from there through the newest agent reply (dsh-tts, browser voice as fallback); press-and-hold the icon and then click anywhere on the page to pick another reading start position; press-and-drag-up opens a vertical mixer for in-page media volume and system output volume.
- [wangzhanchao883/dsh-hold-to-talk](https://github.com/wangzhanchao883/dsh-hold-to-talk) - One-handed, keyboard-free input for the composer: press and hold the mouse on the input box, speak, release — the text lands in the draft, and sliding up cancels without leaving a half sentence behind. No mic button to aim at and no shortcut to remember; the hand never has to leave the input area, which is the point when the other hand is busy. Recognition runs fully offline (SenseVoice via sherpa-onnx, no API key, audio never leaves the machine).
- [WayneYu430/dsh-voice-agent#voice-app](https://github.com/WayneYu430/dsh-voice-agent/tree/master/packages/voice-app) - A conversational voice frontend Agent for dsh: speak naturally over ByteDance Duplex, delegate requests to background tasks, and hear their asynchronous results reported by voice.
- [WizisCool/dsh-ears](https://github.com/WizisCool/dsh-ears) - Voice input plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a microphone button in the composer turns speech into a draft transcript, with a choice of speech-recognition backends, optional polish through dsh own LLM routes, and a native settings page.
- [wwweljf/dsh-plugins#dsh-ding-sound](https://github.com/wwweljf/dsh-plugins/tree/master/plugins/dsh-ding-sound) - Turn-end notification sound for DSH: built-in internet meme voices (ni gan ma ai yo, ji ni tai mei, shen ying ge, etc.), Settings panel with preview/switch/random, custom audio folder support.
- [WYR-233/dsh-multi-tts](https://github.com/WYR-233/dsh-multi-tts) - Per-reply read-aloud with a multi-provider settings page — MiniMax or any OpenAI-compatible /audio/speech endpoint, with voice, emotion, speed and model selection plus an auto-read toggle.
- [XanthanL/dsh-plugin-uisfx](https://github.com/XanthanL/dsh-plugin-uisfx) - Semantic UI sound effects powered by uisfx: task start/success/failure and per-button cues, settings UI with instant preview, 12 sound packs, Host-persisted preferences, and `ctx.uisfx` service for other plugins.
- [xcw520/dsh-dania-voice](https://github.com/xcw520/dsh-dania-voice) - Local GPT-SoVITS text-to-speech that reads DeepSeek Harness assistant replies aloud, with a draggable mascot toggle and a one-click installer. Requires Python 3.10–3.12 preinstalled (the installer only locates it, it does not install Python); about 5 GB of disk and a GPU are recommended.
- [yu-wenchao/dsh-tool-lipsync](https://github.com/yu-wenchao/dsh-tool-lipsync) - Free lip-sync video generation plugin for DSH with 3000+ voices and 500+ languages.
- [YuMS/dsh-duet](https://github.com/YuMS/dsh-duet) - Full-duplex Chinese voice interaction for DSH Web: dictate and edit tasks, submit requests, manage sessions, answer DSH questions, and hear concise task-completion announcements.
- [Yuuyuko-uu/dsh-tts-bridge](https://github.com/Yuuyuko-uu/dsh-tts-bridge) - Reads DSH conversations aloud using the DeepSeek web page's built-in read-aloud, driven by a small browser extension.
- [dsh-watch-video](https://github.com/zeshuochen/dsh-watch-video) - Subtitle-first video transcription with SRT export, cancellable job controls, and a faster-whisper large-v3 fallback when subtitles are unavailable.
- [Zhangbo-cn/dsh-voice-input-plugin](https://github.com/Zhangbo-cn/dsh-voice-input-plugin) - Composer mic for the Web UI: tap-to-monitor live transcription and hold-to-talk, with host Edge TTS reply reading that streams while the model generates, echo-pause during reading, and tap-to-stop.
- [ziyouti/dsh-read-aloud](https://github.com/ziyouti/dsh-read-aloud) - Reads assistant replies aloud with Microsoft Edge neural voices and highlights the sentence being spoken, so you can follow along while listening. The highlight is yours to style: background colour, text colour and opacity are each adjustable in settings. Also adds a sound-wave play button to every reply, pause plus previous and next sentence, adjustable speed, and an auto-read toggle.
- [zsenpro/creating#plugin](https://github.com/zsenpro/creating/tree/main/plugin) - GPT-SoVITS voice output for DSH: a speak tool and /voice command, a read-aloud speaker button under each reply, and a settings tab to switch voices, tune synthesis, manage the local service and one-click install a voice pack. Windows only; needs a local GPT-SoVITS checkout with trained weights and its Python environment.

### Docs & Rendering

- [1741505640/capmap-skills#dsh-capmap-viz](https://github.com/1741505640/capmap-skills/tree/main/dsh-capmap-viz) - CapMap docs visualization with Obsidian-style semantic graph and capability panel.
- [3361805598-gif/dsh-md-annotator](https://github.com/3361805598-gif/dsh-md-annotator) - Markdown sidebar preview and source editor for dsh-better-sidebar, with block- and text-range annotations that can be sent to the conversation as structured revision requests.
- [addie-ace/dsh-fullwidth-punctuation](https://github.com/addie-ace/dsh-fullwidth-punctuation) - Converts half-width punctuation in AI replies to full-width Chinese punctuation, so copied answers stay publication-ready.
- [adithyanraj03/dsh-cite-lens](https://github.com/adithyanraj03/dsh-cite-lens) - Cite Lens for dsh: select text in a PDF in the Files tab to quote or ask about it in the current chat, and turn the model's \[main.pdf p.7 "exact words"] citations into links that open the PDF and highlight the passage; /cite-links makes a chat cite every claim.
- [aduo-111/second-brain#dsh-client-ui-second-brain](https://github.com/aduo-111/second-brain/tree/main/dsh-client-ui-second-brain) - Distills daily AI conversations (Doubao, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Kimi) into structured Markdown notes in your Obsidian vault.
- [AKS1st/dsh-mermaid](https://github.com/AKS1st/dsh-mermaid) - Render Mermaid code fences in DSH Web chat messages as lazy-loaded SVG diagrams with strict sanitization and light/dark theme follow.
- [Alex-yuanli/babeldoc-on-dsh](https://github.com/Alex-yuanli/babeldoc-on-dsh) - Translates PDFs with BabelDOC through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint while keeping the original layout, and returns both a bilingual and a translated-only PDF. Requires a one-time runtime setup and an OpenAI-compatible API key.
- [baconbao/dsh-mermaid-image-preview](https://github.com/baconbao/dsh-mermaid-image-preview) - Preview Mermaid diagrams as images via local rendering in DSH Web when the chat message contains a Mermaid fenced code block, and also allow integration with external rendering servers.
- [bannerchi/dsh-yiyide-pdf](https://github.com/bannerchi/dsh-yiyide-pdf) - PDF translation for DeepSeek Harness through a yiyide.cc connector account: 12 tools covering authorization, upload with page-level pre-flight, a three-page preview, quote, a confirmation that freezes translation points, job polling, quality confirmation, and download of the translated or bilingual PDF to the local machine.
- [baosfeng/my-dsh-plugins#dsh-md-render](https://github.com/baosfeng/my-dsh-plugins/tree/main/plugins/dsh-md-render) - Conversation rendering: every fenced block is rendered by the plugin itself (markdown for text fences, language-banner code blocks with highlight.js for others), mermaid fences become zoomable diagram cards, plus context-body rendering, whole-content copy and a MarkdownView export (npm: `dsh-md-render`).
- [bigricedumpling/deepseek-reader#reader-workspace](https://github.com/bigricedumpling/deepseek-reader/tree/main/plugins/reader-workspace) - Typocket reads, edits and organizes local documents in DSH and previews workspace Markdown.
- [bill9109/dsh-101](https://github.com/bill9109/dsh-101) - Document reading mode for DSH.
- [BioAIEvolu/dsh-md-studio](https://github.com/BioAIEvolu/dsh-md-studio) - Native right-sidebar Markdown preview with Mermaid diagrams, KaTeX math, GFM tables and syntax highlighting — rendering engine bundled, fully offline.
- [Bob-Bo1/obsidian-workbench](https://github.com/Bob-Bo1/obsidian-workbench) - Obsidian-style Markdown workbench for DSH: browse, edit, preview, create, move, and delete notes inside the selected local vault.
- [dsh-consistency-guard](https://github.com/bycall/dsh-consistency-guard) - Consistency guard for long-form writing: scans conversation prose for character, timeline and numeric setting conflicts across chapters, then jumps straight to the conflicting message.
- [caihua8669/dsh-doc-review](https://github.com/caihua8669/dsh-doc-review) - Document review workbench: select text in a Markdown file, leave comments saved as MRSF sidecar files next to it, and let the agent read them with doc_review_* tools and propose edits you accept or reject.
- [carlclouder/dsh-image-serve](https://github.com/carlclouder/dsh-image-serve) - Serve any local file in DSH web sessions - /ws/<absolute-path> maps disk files to same-origin http URLs that session markdown can render. Any drive, no staging directory.
- [chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book](https://github.com/chengzhao-dev/dsh-quarto-book) - Write, check, and publish a Chinese Quarto Book: nine-step chapter writing, structure/link/figure checks, a consistent theme, and render acceptance. Loads only in type: book repositories; requires Quarto CLI and Python 3.
- [ciceroyang/dsh-report-studio](https://github.com/ciceroyang/dsh-report-studio) - Turn DeepSeek Harness sessions into daily, weekly, handoff and article reports, with a verifiable HTML export and a receipt that re-checks the saved file.
- [ColdMagicchess/PTT-Studio](https://github.com/ColdMagicchess/PTT-Studio) - Design-first PowerPoint builder: six pptx_* tools turn a deck.json design draft into an editable .pptx with AI backgrounds, cutout illustrations and decoration pieces, run layout and contrast checks, render slide previews, and review pages with a configurable vision model; chat cards and a settings page in the Web UI. Requires DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2+ (pptx_render uses its bundled LibreOffice Kit) and an Agnes or ModelScope API key for image generation.
- [copylee711/dsh-office](https://github.com/copylee711/dsh-office) - Windows only: the agent edits documents inside the Word, Excel and PowerPoint (Microsoft Office or WPS Office) windows you have open, through the applications' automation interface, so changes appear live and you can edit alongside; it reads structure, applies batches of edits, renders pages to images to check layout, and saves or exports PDF.
- [csukingzq/dsh-pdf-translator](https://github.com/csukingzq/dsh-pdf-translator) - Windows PDF translator for DeepSeek Harness: a vision model locates and translates text, tables, figures and formulas; output is a Chinese PDF and a LaTeX source zip. Requires a vision-capable OpenAI-compatible API.
- [D2Moqi/dsh-openwiki](https://github.com/D2Moqi/dsh-openwiki) - Brings the codebase knowledge-base capability of langchain-ai/openwiki into DSH — one-click generate/read/update of the repository Wiki, Grounded Claims (source-traced knowledge cards) and a project knowledge base built from uploaded local files, reusing the model DSH already has configured, with no second API key.
- [Dantwz7/dsh-doc-router](https://github.com/Dantwz7/dsh-doc-router) - Document intake for agents: doc_route sniffs a file's real format by magic bytes and measures a PDF's text layer and page column layout before any conversion, and pdf_markdown converts PDFs to Markdown in column reading order with PyMuPDF. The PDF path needs a Python 3 interpreter with PyMuPDF.
- [didclawapp-ai/DSH-Office](https://github.com/didclawapp-ai/DSH-Office) - Create, read, and edit PPTX, DOCX, XLSX, and PDF via the local zagens-office CLI as office_schema / office_write / office_edit / office_read tools.
- [dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-launch-card](https://github.com/dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-launch-card) - Generates release material from what a local repository can actually support: a hero image, a feature grid and bilingual copy rendered as SVG and HTML from `README.md`, `package.json` and optional screenshots. Facts are quoted from those files — name, version, license, summary, features, install snippet — and a field that is missing is left unrendered rather than filled with placeholder text. Every feature carries a source citation such as `README.md#L42`, and a claim the repository cannot substantiate is linted out before anything is written, with the reasoning left in `lint-report.json`. `manifest.json` records a sha256 for each input and output, and `--now` or `SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH` makes a run byte-identical. Also ships a GUI panel that regenerates from inside a session.
- [dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-readme-reel](https://github.com/dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-readme-reel) - Turns a plugin repository's existing screenshots into a 6-second silent looping hero reel: a VP9 webm that keeps real alpha, a matted gif, and a cover frame, plus a manifest with per-scene holds and sha256s. The timeline is exact by construction (integer holds plus transitions sum to durationMs, and the last scene transitions back into the first so t=0 equals t=duration). Zero runtime dependencies: PNG decode/encode on node:zlib, an SDF card compositor, and ffmpeg as the only external binary, discovered at runtime. Ships a conversation-view panel (pick, reorder, generate, copy the README markdown) and a CLI with a storyboard.json contract.
- [dream-num/dsh-univer-office](https://github.com/dream-num/dsh-univer-office) - Give DeepSeek Harness a real office environment. Univer Office Plugin brings spreadsheets, docs, slides, canvases, relational tables, and more into one runtime — with connected data, validation, versioned changes, and isolated worktrees for multi-agent collaboration.
- [drscrewdriver/dsh-docx-sidebar](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-docx-sidebar) - A dsh-better-sidebar reading view for .docx files: headings from the style map, paragraphs, lists, real table cells, inline pictures and header notes. Ceilings on archive size, per-part inflated bytes and rendered blocks keep a document from freezing the tab.
- [drscrewdriver/dsh-opensheet-sidebar](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-opensheet-sidebar) - A dsh-better-sidebar reader for CSV/TSV/PSV files and xlsx/xlsm workbooks: a sortable, filterable table with sheet tabs. Ceilings on rows, columns and cells, plus two zip-container gates, keep an input from freezing the tab.
- [drscrewdriver/dsh-pptx-sidebar](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-pptx-sidebar) - A dsh-better-sidebar reading view for .pptx decks: slides in deck order, bullet levels, speaker notes and inline pictures. Ceilings on archive size, per-part inflated bytes and slide count keep a deck from freezing the tab.
- [duyanta123/arch-doc](https://github.com/duyanta123/arch-doc) - Analyze a codebase and generate architecture documentation: module responsibilities, dependencies, entry points and run methods.
- [duyanta123/dsh-data-insight](https://github.com/duyanta123/dsh-data-insight) - Turn raw data (CSV / pasted table / SQL results / DuckDB) into a structured Markdown report with business conclusions, metrics and charts.
- [DynaMyhome/dsh-notes](https://github.com/DynaMyhome/dsh-notes) - Notes workspace in the right sidebar: a notes tree beside a live-preview Markdown editor with tabs, split panes, outline and trash, over plain .md files plus a thin per-workspace index that agents organize through one `knowledge` tool.
- [ECNU/EduWork#dsh-knowledge-studio](https://github.com/ECNU/EduWork/tree/main/packages/dsh-knowledge-studio) - A workspace-based Studio for source-grounded reports, slides, tables, mind maps, quizzes, flashcards, audio and video, using DSH models and shared artifact services. Office generation requires Python 3.12+ with its dependencies and DSH_OFFICE_PYTHON configured; media rendering requires Chromium, and local ASR additionally requires whisper.cpp and a model.
- [fangchenghao/latex-look](https://github.com/fangchenghao/latex-look) - Lets the agent see the compiled page: renders any page to an image, resolves a PDF point or a text anchor to the exact source line through SyncTeX (and says when a rule is drawn by a package rather than by the body, which is where naive locating is wrong), diffs a page against the previous build so an edit is visible, audits every page for holes the edit introduced, and checks that numbered labels still read in order.
- [Flan246/dsh-latex-guard](https://github.com/Flan246/dsh-latex-guard) - LaTeX and BibTeX guardrails for DeepSeek Harness: compile checks with automatic xelatex/lualatex detection, BibTeX entry deduplication and field filling from Crossref, and \cite key audits against the .bib file.
- [fly233338/dsh-overleaf](https://github.com/fly233338/dsh-overleaf) - Connect multiple Overleaf projects to DSH through OverleafMCP for browsing, analysis, and Git-based file updates.
- [genius-alray/dsh-mermaid-render](https://github.com/genius-alray/dsh-mermaid-render) - Mermaid diagram renderer for the Web UI conversation: renders mermaid code blocks into interactive cards (zoom, fit-width, fullscreen viewer, preview/code toggle) with official UI primitives, and keeps the original code block with an inline error banner when rendering fails.
- [GGboya/dsh-paper-reader](https://github.com/GGboya/dsh-paper-reader) - Paper reading workbench: library + PDF reader + tutor-style companion. Answers cite clickable page numbers that jump back and flash the exact passage; select-to-ask without leaving the paper; bundled strict-tutor preset (reading plan, section coaching, graded quizzes tracked across sessions). With MinerU configured (self-hosted, no signup / mineru.net cloud token): scanned PDFs become readable, formulas become click-citable (one click sends the LaTeX source into the chat) and searchable (QK^T hits directly), plus a per-page formula panel; optional embeddings endpoint adds semantic recall for plain-language questions. Rename/delete topics and papers — deletes go to a recoverable .trash with a batch-clear flow for non-empty topics; reader with scroll/single-page modes, rightbar-fullscreen safe, one-click path copy and translated-PDF export; in-place original ↔ Chinese toggle (babeldoc, zero preinstall). Transcription and search run locally by default — documents never leave your machine; only when cloud MinerU, an embeddings endpoint, or a translation endpoint is enabled does the corresponding text go to the service you configure.
- [gitByteFree/dsh-mermaid-smooth](https://github.com/gitByteFree/dsh-mermaid-smooth) - Renders mermaid fences in dsh web chat as SVG diagrams by default, with cursor-anchored smooth zoom and pan, a per-fence diagram/code toggle persisted in localStorage, dark-mode follow, and a bundled offline engine.
- [GitHubJiKe/dsh-markdown-preview](https://github.com/GitHubJiKe/dsh-markdown-preview) - In-chat preview for produced files: click a produced-file chip to render Markdown (server-side markdown-it + highlight.js), images, or plain text right in the conversation; system-app open and reveal-in-folder stay one click away.
- [gychen-NJU/dsh-overleaf](https://github.com/gychen-NJU/dsh-overleaf) - Embeds an Overleaf site (overleaf.com or a self-hosted instance) into a conversation tab through a same-origin reverse proxy, with cookie or popup login, selection quoting, caret insertion, compile-log driven fixes, outline navigation, and .bib / .tex synchronization.

Python 3.10-3.13 required.
- [hanzhangzzz/dsh-diagram](https://github.com/hanzhangzzz/dsh-diagram) - Turns an article in the DSH conversation into an Excalidraw canvas in a session tab: the Agent drafts the structure with diagram_create, you edit labels, nodes and layout with autosave, export PNG, SVG or .excalidraw, and the Agent reads your edited canvas back with diagram_read. 0.6 adds an editable classification overview plus a complete detail index for large three-level trees.
- [HaoKuo/dsh-notebook-studio](https://github.com/HaoKuo/dsh-notebook-studio) - Turns up to 30 uploaded PDF papers into prompt-driven literature reviews, key findings, research ideas and study designs, exported as page-cited reports (DOCX/PDF) or slide decks (PPTX/PDF).

- [jessehoo89/markdown_monitor](https://github.com/jessehoo89/markdown_monitor) - Bridge to the local doc2md (markdown_monitor) CLI — one doc2md tool with convert, read, scan and status actions over docx, doc, xls, xlsx, pdf and image files.
- [jetformat/dsh-plugin](https://github.com/jetformat/dsh-plugin) - Tools over the local jetformat CLI: convert DOCX, XLSX, and PPTX to PDF, extract text, validate files, and inspect, merge, extract pages from, or render PDFs. Requires the jetformat CLI.

- [JuntaoXiao/PDF-electronic-signature](https://github.com/JuntaoXiao/PDF-electronic-signature) - PDF electronic signing: generate a handwritten-style signature image, stamp images and typed blocks onto PDF pages, and apply a PKCS#7/CMS digital signature with a PKCS#12 certificate you supply. Stamping first keys an opaque background out to transparency - un-compositing each pixel so the ink keeps its original colour - and trims to the ink, so a seal stamped over a signature does not erase it.

- [LeslieWylie/dsh-md-preview](https://github.com/LeslieWylie/dsh-md-preview) - Render Markdown to a standalone, self-contained HTML page: an `md_html_render` tool that works in a headless profile, plus a web drawer to browse, preview, edit and export local `.md` files; both share one renderer, with no runtime dependencies.

- [Libraqg/ultra-documents](https://github.com/Libraqg/ultra-documents) - Artifacts-like documents in the sidebar: the agent writes a self-contained HTML document, you comment on any part, send the comments back for the next version, or edit text and formatting yourself.
