- [Limbo-137/dsh-typst-preview](https://github.com/Limbo-137/dsh-typst-preview) - Typst live preview as a native right-Sidebar tab: clicking a .typ file opens a tab whose toolbar switches between the tinymist-rendered page and the highlighted source, with the preview page and its WebSocket served through the app's own origin.
- [linkingoscar/dsh-attachment-formats](https://github.com/linkingoscar/dsh-attachment-formats) - DeepSeek Harness Web plugin — PDF text-layer and scanned-PDF OCR, Office docx/xlsx/pptx to Markdown, TIFF/epub and long-document index cards.
- [logb-1/dsh-course-assistant](https://github.com/logb-1/dsh-course-assistant) - Turns course files (PPTX, PDF, DOCX, Markdown) into an outline, per-chapter key points with quoted evidence, Bilibili video picks, syllabus coverage, and Anki/JSON exports.
- [Lry722/dsh-humanize](https://github.com/Lry722/dsh-humanize) - Prose review for human-facing writes. The write and edit tools require a human_facing flag; the plugin reviews the text against layered PROSE.md rules in the background, stages annotations, reconciles them against the full file, and merges them through /humanize, /humanize-loop or post-compaction while the main session keeps working. /humanize-review runs a batch over git-tracked files on demand.
- [maple-pwn/paperlab](https://github.com/maple-pwn/paperlab) - Overleaf-style LaTeX paper workbench: annotate any text in the rendered PDF and let a dsh agent revise the sources with compile checks and git history.
- [MrmoLabs/dsh-mermaid](https://github.com/MrmoLabs/dsh-mermaid) - Render Mermaid code fences as SVG diagrams with streaming support, diagram/code switching, fullscreen zoom and pan, SVG export, and a bundled same-origin runtime.
- [omdsh-dev/dsh-tool-markdown](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-tool-markdown) - HTML↔Markdown conversion, GFM table normalization, and TOC generation.
- [OMSociety/dsh-fishpai](https://github.com/OMSociety/dsh-fishpai) - WeChat Official Account typesetting workbench: renders Markdown into inline-styled HTML you paste straight into the WeChat editor, with a sidebar panel, 11 themes and five model tools for block-level revision.
- [OMSociety/dsh-ppt-maker](https://github.com/OMSociety/dsh-ppt-maker) - PPT workbench: eleven ppt_* tools create, edit, reverse-engineer, QA-check and export slides from a plain-text PPTD project; five design-system families, themes, animations, posters and infographics.
- [opdsh/dsh-gh-pages-artifacts](https://github.com/opdsh/dsh-gh-pages-artifacts) - Publishes HTML pages and Markdown documents written by the agent to GitHub Pages as shareable links, with tools to update them in place, list, read back, and delete them; adds an Artifacts sidebar panel and a bundled page-design skill.
- [Pasumao/dsh-plugin-dev-kb](https://github.com/Pasumao/dsh-plugin-dev-kb) - Offline mirror of the official DeepSeek Harness documentation as a dsh skill: 168 site pages (EN/zh) plus 52 repository-only reference docs, with topic navigation and a full-text search index for plugin development.
- [pawpress/office-ppt](https://github.com/pawpress/office-ppt) - Builds presentations by driving the LibreOffice installed on the machine over UNO instead of writing OOXML in JavaScript: `lo_build` opens a real Impress document from structured slides and lets LibreOffice export editable PPTX/ODP plus PDF and per-slide PNG, `lo_render` re-renders an existing PPTX/PPT/ODP, `lo_convert` converts between Office formats, `lo_probe` reports the detected soffice path, version and UNO bridge, and `lo_config` edits the stored settings. Needs a local LibreOffice (verified on 26.8.1.1); it uses the bundled Python, so no system Python is needed, and it keeps one warm soffice process between calls. Fully verified on Windows only; on Linux it falls back to the system python3, which needs python3-uno.
- [PerryLink/dsh-industry-research](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-industry-research) - Deterministic industry research reports for DeepSeek Harness — company and industry research flows produce structured, verifiable reports from staged evidence.
- [PhysicalAI-0/dsh-paperforge](https://github.com/PhysicalAI-0/dsh-paperforge) - Paper reading workbench: a paper library, the PDF beside Markdown notes and one dedicated AI session per paper. Highlights and region screenshots go straight into notes; select-to-ask sends the passage with its page; notes are editable in place with autosave; sessions can be combined into a Summary.
- [piaomiaozhilei/dsh-sacc-translator#dsh-sacc-translator-cpu](https://github.com/piaomiaozhilei/dsh-sacc-translator/tree/main/packages/cpu) - Windows x64 translator with a dedicated sidebar entry and Workbench / Chat interface, side-by-side text and document translation, screen-region translation, recent history, and host model selection, voice input and preview. CPU OCR without NVIDIA dependencies. Do not enable the CPU and CUDA packages at the same time.
- [piaomiaozhilei/dsh-sacc-translator#dsh-sacc-translator-cuda](https://github.com/piaomiaozhilei/dsh-sacc-translator/tree/main/packages/cuda) - Windows x64 translator with a dedicated sidebar entry and Workbench / Chat interface, side-by-side text and document translation, screen-region translation, recent history, and host model selection, voice input and preview. CUDA document OCR with CPU fallback; screen OCR uses CPU. Do not enable the CPU and CUDA packages at the same time.
- [poiuyjie/dsh-md-preview](https://github.com/poiuyjie/dsh-md-preview) - Dockable Markdown preview for the DSH Web UI: side-by-side with the conversation, a per-session recently-read .md list, local relative-path images render in place, and clicking an in-chat .md reference previews it instead of launching the system editor; follows the shell light/dark theme.
- [PolinniZhong/dsh-knit](https://github.com/PolinniZhong/dsh-knit) - Puts the Markdown documents, source files, images and video that already exist anywhere in the session workspace into the DSH sidebar, ranked by relevance to the current conversation. The default lexical mode matches your recent messages against title, summary and body locally with IDF weighting (BM25) — no model calls, no network, nothing leaves the machine. The list comes from scanning the workspace rather than from a recent-files list, so restarting DSH or opening a new session does not empty it. Results are organised into a three-tier reading order (primary / supporting / related) with a verifiable reason on every row — which field matched, which document cites this one — and one click opens an in-place preview: Markdown as rendered text, relative-path images actually drawn, source code with the host's own syntax highlighting, video streamed over HTTP Range. The same Context Pack is exposed to the agent as a knit_docs tool. Later versions added read evidence and lifecycle tracking (attribution is frozen at the moment of reading), pin / exclude (exclusion applies before retrieval, and is undoable), relation evidence (references / imports / tests, with line numbers) and an incremental index reused across restarts. Since v0.23 there is also an optional hybrid mode: it is off by default and only runs once you configure an Ollama or OpenAI-compatible embedding provider yourself. When it runs, what leaves the machine is your query text plus each candidate file's title and summary — a Markdown summary is an excerpt of the body's first paragraph (at most 60 characters), a code file's summary is its workspace-relative directory, and an image or video contributes its file name; full bodies and absolute paths are not sent, and a loopback provider keeps everything on this machine. Since v0.24 it also associates uncommitted changes: a read-only git status (fixed argv, no shell, whitelisted child-process environment) combined with the same reference / import / test / mention evidence shows which files a change is likely to drag along, and it is off by default. The benefit of semantic retrieval still awaits a real-provider run, so no recall improvement is claimed.
- [PyModel/dsh-research-plugins#dsh-mcp-context7](https://github.com/PyModel/dsh-research-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-mcp-context7) - Context7 MCP bridge: gives the model up-to-date, version-specific library documentation and code examples through the Context7 MCP server, keyless by default.
- [QinpanWan/dsh-doc-quick](https://github.com/QinpanWan/dsh-doc-quick) - Drag documents into the dsh web chat; the agent reads them directly from the local filesystem and the right sidebar lists the outputs and file paths.
- [reg4916/dsh-doc-reader](https://github.com/reg4916/dsh-doc-reader) - Read PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX and text documents as agent tools, and OCR scanned PDFs or images locally with tesseract.js. Exposes doc_read, pdf_read, xlsx_read, doc_meta and doc_ocr.
- [s1lencewill/dsh-markdown-reader](https://github.com/s1lencewill/dsh-markdown-reader) - Renders workspace Markdown files in a standalone full-screen reader with GFM, KaTeX, Mermaid, outline navigation, live file reload, and browser printing/PDF export.
- [scientificmaniac/dsh-code-highlight](https://github.com/scientificmaniac/dsh-code-highlight) - Syntax-highlighted code for reports via one highlight_code tool: 68 languages, 15 themes, 11 output formats (inline HTML, Word-ready SVG/PNG, LaTeX), incl. the classic SyntaxHighlighter themes. PNG output needs Python 3 with Pillow; other formats need no external runtime.
- [sd0426301x-dotcom/dsh-knowledge-base](https://github.com/sd0426301x-dotcom/dsh-knowledge-base) - A local-first sidebar knowledge base for a DSH workspace: indexes projects, documents and plugins, classifies entries automatically, and provides search, file previews and editable notes. Data stays in the workspace.
- [simikangtao/dsh-storyboard](https://github.com/simikangtao/dsh-storyboard) - End-of-chat visual storyboard: a storyboard tool renders a self-contained HTML card (inline SVG diagram, numbered flow, facts grid, timeline) from a JSON spec, writes it under ~/.dsh/storyboard/<session>/ and opens it in the sidebar; a system-prompt section and a /storyboard command trigger generation. Server-only, zero runtime dependencies.
- [SkanderBog/dsh-pdf-reader](https://github.com/SkanderBog/dsh-pdf-reader) - Read and search local PDFs with page citations, render pages as images, and use optional Tesseract OCR for scanned or mixed pages; requires Poppler.
- [STARDUSTLC666/dsh-ppt](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-ppt) - Presentation skill and tools: one sentence or one document to an HTML slideshow plus editable PPTX, seven layouts (incl. quote and native PPTX tables), speaker notes (HTML S-key panel and native notes slides), five built-in themes, default theme/language config and bilingual support. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.

- [01NGVI-QINGYI/no-ai-style](https://github.com/01NGVI-QINGYI/no-ai-style) - Prose-editing skill for academic and professional writing. All code and documentation written by an AI agent (DeepSeek Harness).

Ships skills and scripts only, so a runnable pipeline still needs ffmpeg, Python 3 + Pillow, Node.js and playwright installed locally, your own Bilibili biliup credential and WeChat Channels / Douyin / Xiaohongshu login states, and the placeholder values under skills/*/scripts/ filled in with your own. Three factual judgements can be routed to a TypeSafe Jev (System One) decision model when a key is configured, falling back to the skill's deterministic rules when it is not; a model verdict can only lower a confidence tier.

- [PolinniZhong/dsh-skill-intelligence](https://github.com/PolinniZhong/dsh-skill-intelligence) - Read-only Skill inspector for DeepSeek Harness. It shows which Skills a conversation actually loaded — from observed loading evidence only — and which Skills the current environment can discover, and gives each Skill a detail page whose left column switches between the framework, the evidence, validation, evaluation, step evidence, run logic, the before/after of a modification when there is one, the definition facts and the raw SKILL.md. Declaration and run stay apart: the body is split into structure, declared workflow and progressive disclosure, the run logic is read from local receipts, and every declared step carries its own evidence — no observed evidence is reported as exactly that, not as executed or not executed, and the run's instruction hash sits beside the current definition as match, mismatch or unavailable. The evidence view gives each subject one of three states (declared, observed, unavailable), walks definition → load → use → outcome, names what each stage cannot reach, declines to attribute an outcome to the Skill, and can copy the snapshot out as byte-stable JSON. Validation checks the Agent Skills open standard and the platform profiles separately, each finding on a rule id and labelled standard compliance or platform compatibility. Evaluation keeps repeatable cases with the conditions each run was recorded under and the four stages of runtime evidence, comparing two runs of one case item by item without scoring them. The trigger boundary keeps should-trigger and should-not-trigger prompts, has you run them in a real new session, then records what was observed — whether a load record appeared and whether it was model-invoked or user-explicit; a typed /name is not a natural trigger, and an absent load record is reported as not observed, not as not triggered. The same projections are exposed to the agent as a read-only skill_review tool, which returns a structured review packet and says what it omitted when the packet will not fit whole. The inspector, the evidence chain and these reviews are computed on this machine from the definition and the session receipts; the Chinese reading version sends the body through the host's model when you ask for it, keeping code fences, paths and frontmatter verbatim and storing the result on this machine. A Skill can also be cloned into a local copy. It does not write back to the source Skill and does not run its scripts.

- [PPZ-ART/dsh-ponytail](https://github.com/PPZ-ART/dsh-ponytail) - Ponytail port: a DeepSeek Harness agent preset that makes the model finish tasks with the least tokens, with lite / full / ultra levels.

No passage of the book's prose is reproduced; about 77 defects in the source (misprints, OCR damage, internal contradictions) are documented in the cards. A study aid, not a substitute for the book.

- [Stephen-pc/publish-size-check](https://github.com/Stephen-pc/publish-size-check) - Publish size check skill: verifies a deliverable's geometric specs against a target platform before publishing - pixel dimensions, aspect ratio, dpi, file size, format, physical print width and colour mode. Geometry only: it does not review content compliance (QR codes, text-to-image ratio, copyright and prohibited content are out of scope). Pure Python standard library, no third-party packages, and inputs are never modified. Python 3.8+. Covers 10 platforms and 20 slots with per-platform confidence labels - WeChat MP, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, Zhihu, Weibo, Douyin, WeChat Channels, journal submission, print and client delivery - and resolves a platform by id, Chinese name or alias with fuzzy matching. Two trigger modes: asked directly, or as a parasitic self-check that runs by itself once an image, poster, chart or export workflow has written a file and the user mentioned a publishing target, reporting in one line when everything passes and only expanding when something is wrong. For journal submission and print it judges by physical width (pixels / dpi), which catches files whose dpi metadata passes but whose actual printed size is too small; for multi-image posts it checks whether the whole set is consistent and names the odd one out rather than listing every file.

Claude Code and Codex) in one page and import them into the DSH skill library; built-in market of 6600+ skills, per-skill token-overhead stats, and model visibility control.
- [Wenaixi/dsh-ponytail](https://github.com/Wenaixi/dsh-ponytail) - DeepSeek Harness plugin: DietrichGebert/ponytail lazy senior mode & 7-rung ladder port, 6 skills with bilingual descriptions & per-skill toggles, zero tools, zero-cache-miss.

- [WilShi/dsh-skill-station](https://github.com/WilShi/dsh-skill-station) - Sidebar skill hub: scan Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini skill directories for one-click import, manage global/project skills (toggle, trash), and install from dropped folders, zip archives, or local paths of any size.

Vendors the upstream answer-me-with-html skill verbatim as a skill-only DSH bundle with no Host code.
- [WLX2007/DSH-SkillsHub](https://github.com/WLX2007/DSH-SkillsHub) - Skill center panel for the DSH web GUI - search online skill registries (SkillHub, skills.sh, GitHub), install skills to user or project roots, and manage local skills with enable, create, edit, delete and preview.
- [wmengxiang/dsh-any-skills](https://github.com/wmengxiang/dsh-any-skills) - Import, install and invoke Agent Skills in DeepSeek Harness from Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, GitHub or npm — composer-side ⚡ picker inserts /skill-name into the draft, and a Skill 管理 settings page offers per-source/per-skill import, expandable source paths with skill counts, uninstall and one-click restore from .trash.
- [WODE25500/dsh-google-skills](https://github.com/WODE25500/dsh-google-skills) - Google's Agent Skills (google/skills) for DeepSeek Harness: 128 bundled SKILL.md skills for Google Cloud, BigQuery, GKE, Gemini, Firebase, ads and analytics.
- [WODE25500/dsh-skillopt](https://github.com/WODE25500/dsh-skillopt) - Nightly self-improvement for your DeepSeek Harness agent: harvest past sessions offline, replay recurring tasks on your own API budget, and consolidate validated skills behind a held-out gate. - [WODE25500/dsh-token-caveman](https://github.com/WODE25500/dsh-token-caveman) - Terse prose for DeepSeek Harness — compress the agent's own output so every reply costs fewer tokens (layer 4). Style, never substance.
- [WODE25500/dsh-token-handoff](https://github.com/WODE25500/dsh-token-handoff) - Session context handoff for DeepSeek Harness — stop re-reading and re-deriving context every session. A single skill (layer ①) that keeps the next session warm.
- [WODE25500/dsh-token-headroom](https://github.com/WODE25500/dsh-token-headroom) - Context compaction / headroom for DeepSeek Harness — compress the live context so the prompt stays small without losing the state that matters (layer 3).
- [WODE25500/dsh-token-rtk](https://github.com/WODE25500/dsh-token-rtk) - Input redundancy pruning for DeepSeek Harness — drop repeated/redundant tokens before they reach the model (layer ②).
- [WODE25500/dsh-token-skills](https://github.com/WODE25500/dsh-token-skills) - Cut token cost in 4 layers without cutting model intelligence: handoff, rtk, headroom, caveman token-saving skills — each also available as a standalone installable plugin.
- [woshipixiu1234/dsh-invest-bundle](https://github.com/woshipixiu1234/dsh-invest-bundle) - Investment research bundle: 10 tools (search, page fetch, source audit, claim verification, numeric rigor, channel health, workflow loader, chart engine, PDF renderer, PDF gate) and 23 skills adapted from ai-berkshire. Runs a six-phase workflow where four parallel agents (Duan Yongping, Buffett, Munger, Li Lu) research a company, cross-examine each other, and ship a chart-rich PDF with cover, tables, captions and page numbers. Requires Python 3.10+; the chart and PDF tools also need python-docx and matplotlib.
- [wyzh0117/dsh-skill-select](https://github.com/wyzh0117/dsh-skill-select) - Sidebar skill picker: lists installed skills with Global and repo badges, session checks plus persistent auto-start, optional Guard, Codex/Grok/Hermes user skills, and /skill injection.
- [xi-kari/dsh-amphoreus](https://github.com/xi-kari/dsh-amphoreus) - Turns the 13 δ-me13 (Amphoreus) role skill cards into seat workspaces: per-seat theme and wallpaper, first-turn skill injection, chat stickers, per-seat memory notes and presets, Alt+digit seat switching, and an overview canvas for dispatch and handoff; the skill suite itself is read from a configurable local directory and is not bundled.
- [xiaohai-78/dsh-mode-skills](https://github.com/xiaohai-78/dsh-mode-skills) - Skill manager page for dsh: set each skill to on, manual only, model only, or off per agent mode; count how often each skill is loaded per mode from the session history; search skills.sh and install from GitHub; import from Codex, Claude Code, or a folder; create, edit, and version skills, with a trash for deleted ones; modes keep working after an uninstall.
- [xiatian-wuhan/dsh-skills-hub](https://github.com/xiatian-wuhan/dsh-skills-hub) - Shows what each installed skill costs in the model context and hides a skill from the catalog without deleting it. Lists every skill found on disk with the exact catalog line the model receives (description normalized and truncated at the catalog cap), its body size and token estimate; previews the catalog message byte-for-byte as the agent will receive it, compares that with the copy already published in the current session, and reports skills on disk that never reach the catalog (invalid frontmatter, or shadowed by a higher-priority root). Hiding writes disable-model-invocation into frontmatter and keeps the file, so the skill still works via /name. Also imports skills from ClawHub, Skills.sh and GitHub URLs and uninstalls user-owned ones.
- [xiaxi626/dsh-skills-nexus](https://github.com/xiaxi626/dsh-skills-nexus) - Universal skill adapter that registers any GitHub repo containing a SKILL.md as a DSH skill by cloning and symlinking into the official skills root.
- [xiex16070-jpg/dsh-learn](https://github.com/xiex16070-jpg/dsh-learn) - Reads the session event stream, with no extra model calls, and turns corrections, failures and fixes into pending lesson candidates. Every candidate is judged against written criteria and carries the reason it passed or was refused; only confirmation writes a skill, and only through the single validated writer `learn_skill_manage`. An idle curator marks unused skills stale and archives them by moving rather than deleting, and spares any skill that is still being loaded. Five tools: `learn`, `learn_review`, `learn_curator`, `learn_skill_manage`, `learn_skills`. Registers a prompt section stating the criteria, and a tool guard that refuses direct edits to skill files so the writer cannot be bypassed.
- [xsoc1/math-research-dsh](https://github.com/xsoc1/math-research-dsh) - Rigorous open mathematics research suite: four agent skills (rigorous-open-math-research, manage-math-research-program, math-research-workflow, lean-verify) for theorem solving with adversarial audit, research program management, pipeline orchestration, and Lean 4 formalization audit; CI-verified tests and mechanical upstream sync.

Installs with `dsh plugin add lunheng-article-pipeline` (package.json#dsh.bundle.patch plus a lib/index.js entry that registers the skill); ships role cards for T1-T9, templates and 36 zero-dependency verification scripts, with five-language READMEs.

Do not install with the older dsh-deai-audit from the same author, which registers the same tool names.

### Workflow & Automation

- [0x7A7A6572/dsh-forge-studio#plugin-daily-log](https://github.com/0x7A7A6572/dsh-forge-studio/tree/main/packages/plugin-daily-log) - Work reports for DeepSeek Harness: gathers Git commits and local agent conversations (DeepSeek/Claude/Codex) and renders daily, weekly or monthly reports from your own templates; the agent tool is injected on demand.
- [1052326311/dsh-plan-lattice](https://github.com/1052326311/dsh-plan-lattice) - Adds persistent execution contracts, recursive work graphs, critical clarification, and evidence gates for long or underspecified Harness tasks.
- [11111353535/dsh-folderwatch](https://github.com/11111353535/dsh-folderwatch) - Arms a watch on a directory and delivers a batched, deduplicated diff when the tree goes quiet, filtering out the writes the session made itself; delivery is per watch, either waking a new turn or queueing for the next step.
- [121212165/dsh-plugin-ide-hub](https://github.com/121212165/dsh-plugin-ide-hub) - One hub over every coding IDE you run — dsh, Claude Code, Codex, ZCode, Qoder, CatPaw, Trae, OpenCode. Zero-API: it reads each tool's own on-disk state and gives a session inventory, per-IDE usage with cache-hit rates, one-line resume commands, and a single .hub/ rule body wired into all eight via marker-delimited pointer files. The domestic-IDE adapters (Trae/Qoder/CatPaw) were verified against the installed binaries — a gap no overseas tool covers.
- [121212165/dsh-plugin-task-forge](https://github.com/121212165/dsh-plugin-task-forge) - Compiles a rough need into a versioned task book (goal / context / constraints / acceptance / decisions / open gaps, all numbered) and hands it to any AI window losslessly: the receiver must pass a read-back handshake — restate, list gaps, declare READY — before work starts; /answer closes gaps with an automatic version bump, /forge-list tracks which window holds which version.
- [1225Sakura/oh-my-deepseekharness](https://github.com/1225Sakura/oh-my-deepseekharness) - Multi-agent orchestration layer for DeepSeek Harness — autopilot/ralph/team execution modes, 19 role cards, 40 bilingual skills, and a bundled MCP state server, ported from oh-my-claudecode.
- [1264459640/dsh-trellis](https://github.com/1264459640/dsh-trellis) - Trellis-style workflow for DeepSeek Harness: per-turn phase breadcrumbs via agent/pre-step, bundled skill provider, and DSH-native task/phase state with git-cleanliness guardrails.
- [1344738825/ai-look-up](https://github.com/1344738825/ai-look-up) - AI Look-Up: detects aimless grinding (repeated commands, failure loops, long runs with no output) and injects mid-run self-review nudges, plus a real local-clock anchor so the agent stops estimating elapsed time.
- [240xu/verdict-engine#dsh-tech-lead](https://github.com/240xu/verdict-engine/tree/main/packages/dsh-tech-lead) - 21 read-only lifecycle governance tools in one self-contained DSH plugin: task tiering, state/plan/evidence validation, gate precheck and aggregation, release/install audits, context and progress analysis, critical path, resume reconciliation, and a mutation preview that always denies execution. Installs from npm as @240xu/dsh-tech-lead.
- [2507483326/dsh-eteams](https://github.com/2507483326/dsh-eteams) - Captain-led multi-agent teams that split a goal into tasks and dispatch them along an execution chain to members running in their own sub-sessions, each with its own model.
- [3082838272n-max/dsh-mailbox](https://github.com/3082838272n-max/dsh-mailbox) - Mailbox for DeepSeek Harness: sessions pass letters through a shared folder, and an hourly randomized scheduler can wake a session on its own (mutual letters between two sessions, or a gentle nudge to the owner). Per-recipient hourly rate limit and a UTF-8 log.
- [534119219/chicheng-cron](https://github.com/534119219/chicheng-cron) - Cron scheduler with a sidebar UI: run shell, Python or Node scripts, skills, or agent tasks on a schedule, with push notifications and session archiving.
- [544244857/dsh-work-assistant](https://github.com/544244857/dsh-work-assistant) - A work assistant for WeChat: it records what you tell it into a SQLite task ledger, ranks items by urgency, reminds you on schedule, extracts people and their relations from your notes, and hands tasks to separate assistant sessions. Ships its own WeChat bot channel (scan to log in; private chat only) and a full-page dashboard.
- [7bder/dsh-plugin-orchd](https://github.com/7bder/dsh-plugin-orchd) - Read-only orchd panel for the DSH right sidebar: task board, ideas board, dependency graph, review timeline and an install entry for the project of the current session.
- [82c86b8z86-stack/dsh-engineering-workflow](https://github.com/82c86b8z86-stack/dsh-engineering-workflow) - Engineering workflow agent preset for dsh: five gated phases (requirements clarification, plan approval, TDD, parallel subagents, verified finishing) with six workflow skills adapted from obra/superpowers.
- [873360545/dsh-auto-shutdown](https://github.com/873360545/dsh-auto-shutdown) - Windows-only: adds a switch to Settings → General that powers the computer off when the finished conversation ends (default delay 60 s, configurable 5–86400 s), behind a native countdown dialog that cancels the pending shutdown in one click (shutdown /a).

- [9931666/dsh-plugin-crossfire](https://github.com/9931666/dsh-plugin-crossfire) - Adversarial review for DeepSeek Harness: put one settled plan on the stand, send read-only red-team experts at it by dimension, then split their findings into single defects you endorse or reject one by one. - [9931666/dsh-plugin-roundtable](https://github.com/9931666/dsh-plugin-roundtable) - Visual round-table meetings for DeepSeek Harness — expert nodes on a ring with directed edges, an aggregation gateway, proxy thinking for black-box worker models, and adversarial review (red-team) of settled plans with per-viewpoint endorse/reject.
- [a792883583/dsh-cron-panel](https://github.com/a792883583/dsh-cron-panel) - Scheduled tasks panel for managing DSH agent and system crontabs with natural language input and execution logs.

Every day at a fixed hour it ranks the plugin market by real install counts and stars, cross-checks it against your own agent memory and working conventions, and proposes two kinds of item: concrete deltas on the plugins people actually use (original does A, the proposal does B) and directions nobody has built yet. The popularity numbers come from the catalog the market itself publishes and are quoted into the prompt rather than guessed; an entry the market has not measured is shown as unmeasured, never as zero. Approving an item opens a new session named after it and hands that session a fixed delivery contract — implement independently, never fork, test green before publishing. Rejected sources are remembered so they stop coming back.
- [dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-den](https://github.com/dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-den) - A resident assistant for DeepSeek Harness that is deliberately not another chat box: one floating window plus one standing conversation, both independent of every other session. The heartbeat is held back by four gates — an authority grant, a daily turn budget, quiet hours and a pacing cooldown — and it keeps working across restarts through a lease it has to hold. Each wake is decided by a model that must answer SKIP or a short message, so silence is a decision rather than a failure. The window shows the standing conversation's real message flow, read from the host session store, or from the on-disk session log when the host does not publish that session, and it can send into that conversation directly. den carries the same reach as the person it stands in for, with one limit: read-only. It may read every session, this machine and work channels such as GitHub, but it does not write, send or publish, it never asks anyone for permission, and it never gates another session's tool calls. `npm run digest:github` turns GitHub notifications and your own open pull requests into three Chinese sections — waiting on you, waiting on your review, and yours — with reply drafts that are explicitly marked as unsent.

When the batch finishes a 60 s cancellable countdown starts (configurable 10–600 s) with the remaining seconds on the button and a matching banner: clicking Cancel runs shutdown /a and disarms the mode, and any new session starting during the countdown aborts it. - [wuuuuu123-32/dsh-tandem](https://github.com/wuuuuu123-32/dsh-tandem) - Runs a second agent: hands independent subtasks to a local Codex CLI in parallel (up to three at a time), and asks it to review a design or a plan before the user sees it, returning conclusion, evidence, counterexamples and a verification step. A dispatch missing its timeout or its acceptance check is rejected by the plugin, not by the model remembering to check.
- [wwwangzilin/dsh-character-presets](https://github.com/wwwangzilin/dsh-character-presets) - Luna preset for DeepSeek Harness — a little-demon persona on the full standard tool set, composed by six deterministic rule layers (perception, understanding, state, style, regulation, memory) plus a derived vitals layer, with a gated, suppressible cross-session memory file.
- [wwweljf/dsh-plugins#dsh-wx-push](https://github.com/wwweljf/dsh-plugins/tree/master/plugins/dsh-wx-push) - Auto-send every DSH turn result to WeChat: listens for task completion, extracts the final assistant message and pushes it raw via the WeChat iLink bot (real delivery check, never fake success). Requires the wechat-acp daemon, a separately installed process you log into WeChat with.
- [wxlei2004/dsh-plugins#dsh-thesis-workbench](https://github.com/wxlei2004/dsh-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-thesis-workbench) - Thesis and empirical-analysis workbench that drives IBM SPSS from the conversation: spss_check (environment self-check), spss_variables (list .sav variables with labels, types, measurement levels, case counts), spss_data (sample case rows to inspect missing and outlying values), spss_run / spss_run_file (execute SPSS syntax or an .sps file, relative CD and GET FILE paths auto-rebased), and spss_analyze (one-shot frequencies, descriptives, crosstabs with chi-square, t-tests, one-way ANOVA, correlation, linear regression). Results come back as structured tables extracted through OMS. SPSS 25-31 is auto-detected; the bundled MCP server is zero-dependency stdio.
- [wxlei2004/dsh-plugins#dsh-todo-guard](https://github.com/wxlei2004/dsh-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-todo-guard) - Task-list staleness guard for DeepSeek Harness: watches the session event stream and counts tool calls since the last todo_write; past a configurable threshold it appends one short notice before the next step, quoting the current list, so the model writes it back to the real progress instead of leaving a stale snapshot on screen. Pure prompt injection, no blocking and no data mutation.
- [xiagaogaozi/dsh-subagent-pool](https://github.com/xiagaogaozi/dsh-subagent-pool) - Maintains reusable named subagent profiles for DeepSeek Harness and runs them with per-profile model, reasoning effort, and agent-preset settings.
- [xiaohai-78/dsh-modes](https://github.com/xiaohai-78/dsh-modes) - Settings page for agent modes (presets): switch up to 15 capabilities per mode (commands, files or read-only files, web, subagents, and more) or individual plugin rows; edit each mode's system prompt with variable checks, a full preview, version history, optional live updates for running sessions, and an approval-gated mode_prompt chat tool; create modes from four starter templates or copies; merge built-in updates after a dsh upgrade while keeping your changes, and turn off rows that fail to load.
- [XiaoOu2024/dsh-root-planner-preset](https://github.com/XiaoOu2024/dsh-root-planner-preset) - Recursive delegation for dsh agent trees: a preset plus Host limits bound what each subagent may do, subagents work in separate _agents/ workspaces, and the parent decides which results to integrate.
- [WhaleMaid](https://github.com/Xiaxin1235/WhaleMaid/tree/master/packages/host) - Project autopilot for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.3, with scoped authorization, independent verification, editable memories and companion chat, including automatic installation of the compatible desktop pet fork. The bundled pet is a fork of takboo/dsh-coopanion (AGPL-3.0-or-later); do not install the upstream pet alongside it.
- [XMoon/dsh-subagent-router](https://github.com/XMoon/dsh-subagent-router) - Adds subagent_route and subagent_fork_route delegation tools where the model itself picks the provider/model route for each child; the deployment only sets the spawn/fork backend, background policy and allowedProviders allowlist, while continuable children and background jobs reuse the official send_message / job_output tools.
- [xt765/dsh-context-window](https://github.com/xt765/dsh-context-window) - Extends the composer model selector menu with a third Context window row, preset capacities (64K–2M), custom input, provider-wide sync, and adaptive compaction guard.
- [xt765/dsh-doubao-image](https://github.com/xt765/dsh-doubao-image) - Registers native doubao_generate_image and doubao_image_status Agent tools to automate Doubao Web (doubao.com) via Tabbit Browser, automatically extracting watermark-free 2.7K wm0 original images into local files and multimodal chat attachments.
- [xt765/dsh-milestone-guard](https://github.com/xt765/dsh-milestone-guard) - Milestone progress soft-enforcement guard: injects persistent system-prompt rules and post-execute notices when tool calls omit visible progress text, with a Web settings form.
- [yakoylp/dsh-md-convert](https://github.com/yakoylp/dsh-md-convert) - Convert Office documents and PDFs (including scanned ones) to structurally formatted Markdown via a CPU-first routing OCR pipeline (RapidOCR/SLANet/FormulaNet).
- [yangdcm/dsh-expert-team](https://github.com/yangdcm/dsh-expert-team) - Role-based multi-agent team for DeepSeek Harness — your digital workforce. Zero runtime dependencies, no build step.
- [yangdongzhen590/dsh-knj-scheduler](https://github.com/yangdongzhen590/dsh-knj-scheduler) - Cron task scheduler for DSH: on schedule, automatically creates a new session and injects your prompt as its first message, with task history and manual run/stop controls. Also runs KNJ workflows: pick files directly (stored as persistent snapshots, re-handed to the workflow on every fire) or reference them by path. Its sidebar entry is provided by dsh-knj-menu; install together: dsh plugin add dsh-scheduler dsh-knj-menu.
- [yangdongzhen590/dsh-knj-workflow](https://github.com/yangdongzhen590/dsh-knj-workflow) - Config-driven development-task orchestration for DSH: graph workflows (task/gateway/human nodes) with per-stage persistence, plus an in-editor AI assistant that configures workflows through conversation with live validation. Hand documents to nodes as generic attachments (no declaration needed): files land in the task workspace and ${inputs.附件} gives the newline-joined absolute paths, so a node parses them with its own prompt.
- [yangyongzhen/dsh-article-publish](https://github.com/yangyongzhen/dsh-article-publish) - Publish articles to CSDN / Juejin / CNBlog directly from the session, no external server.
- [yangyongzhen/dsh-scheduler](https://github.com/yangyongzhen/dsh-scheduler) - Cron/one-shot scheduled tasks: run shell commands or fire webhooks on a schedule, with optional ServerChan/DingTalk/Feishu/webhook delivery of results.
- [yaopushen/dsh-plugin-background-tasks](https://github.com/yaopushen/dsh-plugin-background-tasks) - Antigravity-style run_command for DSH: short commands return inline within a configurable wait window (default 10s) while longer ones auto-promote into ctx.jobs for later collection and completion notices — executed via ctx.shell under the session sandbox and approval pipeline.
- [yezitotempeace/dsh-agent-team-roster](https://github.com/yezitotempeace/dsh-agent-team-roster) - Agent Teams roster plugin: newest-first ordering for the roster, task board and subagent catalog, plus bulk cleanup and teammate rename/delete.
- [ygcdsj/dsh-home-migrate](https://github.com/ygcdsj/dsh-home-migrate) - Export and import DeepSeek Harness configuration across machines as same-OS .dshmig archives, with credential redaction, verification and rollback.
- [Yisan0429/dsh-itranslation#bundle](https://github.com/Yisan0429/dsh-itranslation/tree/main/packages/itranslation/bundle) - Whole-book translation production line for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic chapter detection and segmentation, per-chapter subagent translation, glossary control, full-book review, targeted revision, and auditable meta.json evidence.
- [yixing233/dsh-crabtodo](https://github.com/yixing233/dsh-crabtodo) - A shared todo list for DeepSeek Harness: you and your agent manage the same tasks from a sidebar page or todo tools, with per-project and global todos, and one-click task references into the composer.
- [yuqiguang/dsh-nexus](https://github.com/yuqiguang/dsh-nexus) - Personal coding assistant that schedules, follows up on and verifies local Codex or Claude Code tasks from DSH, with WeChat, WeCom and Feishu remote channels.
- [Yuuyuko-uu/dsh-speak-up](https://github.com/Yuuyuko-uu/dsh-speak-up) - Lets the agent start a conversation on its own, using a local dice roll on a set interval to decide whether to speak into a chosen session, with quiet hours and a dry-run mode.
- [yx222yx/DSH-Feedback-Bridge](https://github.com/yx222yx/DSH-Feedback-Bridge) - Turns DSH conversations into reviewable community feedback and, after confirmation, submits it to the official DeepSeek Harness Discussions.
- [yyyy231209/ai-company-framework](https://github.com/yyyy231209/ai-company-framework) - AI Company Framework: turn one sentence into a multi-agent company — 15 flat Skills (boss/pipeline/role-template/11 roles/generic customer-memory), 7 workflow templates, AgentTeams runtime + activity panel, employee sidebar with per-session isolation, Feishu bot bridge (boss and per-employee bots, group routing, autonomous push, human decision gate, external-contact guide), per-customer SQLite memory with three-layer memory (cross-group merge), /company mode switch; no RAG.
- [Z-Asset/alpharsi](https://github.com/Z-Asset/alpharsi) - AlphaRSI — three-role self-improvement loop that evolves the training recipe of alpha sequence models. Operator runs walk-forward, Evaluator grades with OOS RankIC, Refiner proposes hyperparameters via TPE Bayesian search; only strictly-better recipes are kept. Offline one-command run, data bundle shipped with sha1 reconciliation, GPU auto-detect. Ships one skill.
- [Z-Asset/attest](https://github.com/Z-Asset/attest) - Training attestation — reproducible, attributable, auditable off-site standardized training for asset pricing. Hard-gates four failure modes (half-refresh, hash mismatch, unknown-read-as-pass, master pollution). Ships one skill.
- [Z-Asset/ZA_analysis](https://github.com/Z-Asset/ZA_analysis) - Model training stage — end-to-end analysis, model training, and estimation for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.
- [Z-Asset/ZA_data](https://github.com/Z-Asset/ZA_data) - Data stage — data discovery and quality assessment for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.
- [Z-Asset/ZA_literature](https://github.com/Z-Asset/ZA_literature) - Literature review stage — search, synthesis, and citation-chain tracking for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.
- [Z-Asset/ZA_ppt](https://github.com/Z-Asset/ZA_ppt) - PPT stage — presentation generation (Beamer/Quarto) from the paper for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.
- [Z-Asset/ZA_report](https://github.com/Z-Asset/ZA_report) - Report stage — academic paper writing for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.

Data-RSI (daily cross-sectional cleaning: winsorize → cross-sectional standardization → median fill, plus experience extraction), Harness-RSI (evolves system prompt / memory / skills), and Model-RSI (evolves alpha training recipes via framework-native walk-forward with 2-day gap and multi-seed). Offline one-command run, GPU auto-detect. Ships one skill.

- [zenghaili0901/dsh-bot-mode](https://github.com/zenghaili0901/dsh-bot-mode) - Bot Mode for DeepSeek Harness: a roster of named bots with avatars, personas and per-bot chats, each backed by one durable continuable subagent session that keeps memory across turns.
- [zhairy/dsh-agent-swarm](https://github.com/zhairy/dsh-agent-swarm) - Chinese multi-agent workflow with per-role model fallback, versioned Mermaid task plans, independent Agent and Jev reviews, persistent expert collaboration, and pure-function calculation tools.
- [zhaochengbiao005/dsh-gcua](https://github.com/zhaochengbiao005/dsh-gcua) - Agent state machine plugin with a todo ledger, stall guard, phase trails and a process-isolated per-step Python worker with GUI automation lanes. Windows only; needs Python 3.10+ on PATH, and pyautogui, mss and pywinauto for the GUI lanes.
- [ZhenHuangLab/dsh-sync](https://github.com/ZhenHuangLab/dsh-sync) - Policy-driven Git sync for DSH settings and profile configuration, with secret-aware projections, conflict review, and per-line apply controls.
- [ziduup/dsh-programming-mode](https://github.com/ziduup/dsh-programming-mode) - Programming Mode agent preset bundle: the standard coding agent with its persona mandating the Superpowers discipline (skills first, brainstorming before building, plans before code, TDD, systematic debugging, verification before completion) plus an always-on Ponytail code-volume discipline (7-rung minimal-code ladder, default full); ships all twenty skills bundled (14 superpowers + 6 ponytail) and mechanically injects the full using-superpowers skill into every new session's first request.
- [Zilong6666/dsh-task-workspace](https://github.com/Zilong6666/dsh-task-workspace) - Task workspace convention: one folder per session, one PROGRESS.md per task overwritten on each update, and per-task git once the task runs long.
- [ZSeven-W/dsh-crew](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/dsh-crew) - Dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code or Codex: native subagent progress, in-host worker sessions with per-tier presets, and a multimodal bridge for vision and image generation.
- [zsspub/dsh-personal-todo](https://github.com/zsspub/dsh-personal-todo) - Persistent personal todos shared across DeepSeek Harness sessions and projects: SQLite storage, Agent tools, a native sidebar and turn-tail cards, with user-managed workflows or optional dispatch of individual todos to Agent sessions.
- [ztan4706/dsh-whale-waker](https://github.com/ztan4706/dsh-whale-waker) - Per-target scheduled wake-ups for a DSH workspace: interval, quiet hours, daily cap and a prompt per target; each wake-up waits for the turn it started and records the outcome, and a turn that never finished is not counted as done.
- [ztl34245881-commits/dsh-task-planner](https://github.com/ztl34245881-commits/dsh-task-planner) - Task planning with experience muscle-memory: condition-reflex recall of past solutions, LLM capability matching, and auto-persisted lessons.
- [zuiyouli/dsh-workflow-ui](https://github.com/zuiyouli/dsh-workflow-ui) - In-conversation workflow run timeline for DSH Web: a horizontal rail with phase stations, agent pills, loop arcs and parallel bands replaces the stock workflow tool card and workflow-run chat node. Planned stations render before the run starts via client-side script scanning; status dots and icons follow DSH official primitives.
- [zuosus/dsh-decision-engine](https://github.com/zuosus/dsh-decision-engine) - System-1 decision guard for DeepSeek Harness, 4 questions asked before tool calling (risk reversible, relevance, injection suspension) and allow/ask/reject action. Needs an API key for a system-one compatible provider; decision requests are sent there.
- [zzd1990/dsh-parallel-dev](https://github.com/zzd1990/dsh-parallel-dev) - By default, blocks marking a team task complete without a passed independent verification record whose commit matches the worktree HEAD, and adds a dependency DAG board and a settings page.
- [zzhzz/dsh-ask-peer](https://github.com/zzhzz/dsh-ask-peer) - Peer-to-peer colleague-agent consultation for DSH: ask one or several configured peers, queue asynchronous questions, discover peers through signed friend cards, and review inbound requests in the Web UI.

### Git & Code Review

- [135ty/dsh-git-commit-panel](https://github.com/135ty/dsh-git-commit-panel) - Floating commit panel for the DSH web UI: it appears when the current session workspace has unstaged or untracked changes, takes a hand-written or AI-drafted commit message (AI drafts follow Conventional Commit), and commits or commits and pushes. Works in the DSH web UI and CLI only; the desktop app cannot install it.
- [7dgroup-ai/dsh-skill-7d-git-commit](https://github.com/7dgroup-ai/dsh-skill-7d-git-commit) - Checks git commit messages against the 7DGroup convention (Chinese type tags, length and punctuation rules) before committing, as a client-side guard before GitLab pre-receive hooks.
- [9087/dsh-diff-approval](https://github.com/9087/dsh-diff-approval) - Pending-change review for DeepSeek Harness: every `edit`, `write` and `str_replace_editor` change is collected automatically into the file list, where a single change block, the blocks within a selection, or the whole file can be kept or reverted, and undo/redo is supported. It imports the workspace's version-control changes, shows the diff in a single-column or side-by-side view, and provides a Markdown preview in which changes can also be kept or reverted, in-file search, block jumping and copyable line references; the diff data is stored persistently, so the review continues after a restart.
- [988hj7tczd-oss/harness-github](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/harness-github) - DSH GitHub connector: review PRs, triage issues, debug CI, prepare changes (18 tools, gh-first + REST fallback, approval-gated writes).
- [a792883583/dsh-git-panel](https://github.com/a792883583/dsh-git-panel) - Git sidebar panel with commit graphs, ahead/behind tracking, branch operations, and one-click chat context injection.
- [AFunDog/dsh-sidebar-git-graph](https://github.com/AFunDog/dsh-sidebar-git-graph) - Right-sidebar page for DSH that draws the current session's repository as a VS Code-style commit graph - colored branch/merge lanes, ref chips and per-commit details - with a working-tree Changes area above it (staged/unstaged sections with inline diffs) for every working tree of the repository; read-only, works with or without dsh-better-sidebar, and follows the session's worktree label when dsh-session-worktree is installed.
- [Akimiya-z/codex-guard#dsh](https://github.com/Akimiya-z/codex-guard/tree/main/dsh) - Pre-submit pull-request hygiene checks inside DeepSeek Harness: scans the current diff for TODO leftovers, hardcoded secrets, and non-conventional commit subjects.
- [alanhaskey/dsh-gitmate](https://github.com/alanhaskey/dsh-gitmate) - Git panel in the right sidebar plus fifteen agent tools: editor-style diffs, a commit graph across every branch, staging and committing, branch, stash and remote operations, and model-assisted commit messages, pre-commit review and commit splitting.
- [alpacachen/dsh-worktree](https://github.com/alpacachen/dsh-worktree) - A minimal worktree management solution with only one button and one dialog.
- [andyfan1094/dsh-github](https://github.com/andyfan1094/dsh-github) - GitHub account management plus a local Git workflow for the web GUI with clone, fast-forward pull, status, commit, push, and host-side push guards.
- [AngelosZou/dsh-github-router](https://github.com/AngelosZou/dsh-github-router) - Read-only GitHub access for agents, wrapping several tools. Inside the tool it automatically probes and selects whichever GitHub access method works locally, and tries network proxies on its own. That cuts down the network and parsing problems an agent may hit when accessing GitHub, and the overhead of it repeatedly trying different approaches.
- [apcamargo/dsh-review](https://github.com/apcamargo/dsh-review) - A code review workflow that reviews uncommitted changes, changes against a base branch, a single commit, a GitHub pull request, or a file.
- [ashllll/dsh-open-code-review](https://github.com/ashllll/dsh-open-code-review) - Review code with Open Code Review: deterministic scope and rule resolution, judged by your own DSH model, no API key.
- [Athosoo/dsh-git-graph-sidebar](https://github.com/Athosoo/dsh-git-graph-sidebar) - Built on dsh-better-sidebar: the repository graph is a tab inside that sidebar, and this plugin still loads without it - install dsh-better-sidebar to see the tab. Forked from @linxin666/dsh-client-ui-git-graph 0.4.8, which linxin666 develops in zhu1090093659/dsh-web. Both halves own the /git route prefix, so this plugin and the upstream one cannot be installed at the same time - pick one. It discovers the Git repositories up to three levels below the workspace directory (at most 200, skipping node_modules, dist, build, out, coverage, target, vendor and dot-directories), lists them as a tree with branch, head, dirty-file and conflict counts, and draws the selected repository commit graph as an SVG lane canvas with curved cross-lane edges, merge diamonds, ref badges, row zoom and a pinned commit card. The tab writes to the repository: the Initialize Git repository button runs git init, and the conventions picker writes a GIT_CONVENTIONS.md document into the repository (or a workspace-wide .dsh/GIT_CONVENTIONS.md that nested repositories inherit) from six frameworks - Conventional Commits, GitHub Flow, Git Flow, Trunk-based, Conventional Branch, GitLab Flow. The host injects that document into the system prompt before every model step and flags the last 20 commit messages that break the rules the document states - subject length, type prefix, Chinese, English or mixed language, lowercase, trailing period and imperative mood, plus an optional AI attribution policy (ai: required / optional / forbidden) that reads the message trailers, so Assisted-by and Co-authored-by count as attribution while ai: forbidden only rejects AI-specific trailers. When the workspace document, the document of the checked repository and the documents of its parent directories disagree, the panel and the injected prompt both name every disagreement and the agent is told to ask before changing anything; one click then merges them into the workspace .dsh/GIT_CONVENTIONS.md, keeps the union of the machine-checkable rules, leaves a timestamped .bak copy of every rewritten file and replaces the absorbed repository documents with pointers to the workspace one. With the agentTool option enabled the host also registers a git_conventions tool, so a model step can run the same check and stage the same merge. The same graph can also open as a page in the main area of the conversation, opt-in and closable from the tab, beside the views the host ships. The composer branch chip, interactive graph dialog and worktree manager of the upstream plugin are carried over unchanged.
- [Bainianzzz/dsh-fork-worktree](https://github.com/Bainianzzz/dsh-fork-worktree) - Fork and delete buttons on each workspace row of the Harness sidebar, plus a /fork-worktree command: fork creates a git worktree and registers it as a new workspace, delete removes the workspace folder through git worktree remove (asking again before discarding uncommitted work) and drops the registration.
- [Binaryinject/dsh-review-checkout](https://github.com/Binaryinject/dsh-review-checkout) - Codex-style review of session file changes: per-turn cards (optionally taking over the shell edited cards) whose totals are the turn net diff, a review tab with syntax-highlighted diffs that never wrap, real line numbers, open-at-line and a draggable split, a hover preview of the whole file with three lines of context around each change, one-click per-turn revert, and the on-disk record size with a clear button in the review toolbar. Records are sharded per session, with content-addressed snapshot blobs that dedupe and are garbage collected. Light/dark presets follow the DSH theme, typography follows DSH and installed skins (or any font on the machine, with a px stepper), and a settings switch injects a think-in-Simplified-Chinese rule into the global AGENTS.md.
- [bitxeno/dsh-git-plus](https://github.com/bitxeno/dsh-git-plus) - Sidebar Git panel for the DSH web GUI: Local Changes and All Commits views, branch, tag and stash management with fetch, pull and push dialogs, merge with conflict handling, and a zsh-style branch marker in the input bar.
- [BrambleXu/dsh-revdiff](https://github.com/BrambleXu/dsh-revdiff) - Native interactive Git diff review for DeepSeek Harness with structured annotations sent back to the current Agent session.
- [caozeal/dsh-plugins#dsh-next-git](https://github.com/caozeal/dsh-plugins/tree/main/dsh-next-git) - Git tab in the DSH web UI right sidebar for the current session repository — switches branches from a dropdown of local and remote branches (with ahead/behind counts), stages files in staged/unstaged/untracked/conflicted groups, commits, fetches, pulls and pushes with automatic upstream setup, drafts a Conventional Commits message from the staged diff with the default model and falls back to a plain chore message when none is available, and renders git log --graph with per-branch colors plus a word-level highlighted diff.
- [Cerbur/clutch-dsh#clutch-dsh-worktree](https://github.com/Cerbur/clutch-dsh/tree/main/packages/clutch-dsh-worktree) - Adds a Worktree view to DSH Web UI that groups Sessions by Git worktree while keeping DSH as the source of truth.
- [cherrchen/dsh-plugin-git](https://github.com/cherrchen/dsh-plugin-git) - Git service plus right-sidebar UI — a Changes tab (stage/unstage, per-file diffs, commit/amend, push and rebase-then-push sync, confirmed discard), a paged canvas commit-graph tab, a Worktrees tab to list, enter and create checkouts, a composer branch selector, and opt-in LLM commit-message generation.
- [cirelir/dsh-change-review](https://github.com/cirelir/dsh-change-review) - Session change-review plugin for DeepSeek Harness: tracks write/edit tool calls per session and renders line-level diffs with customizable colors, with session isolation, subagent aggregation, and SSE live updates.
- [CoolTea001/dsh-cool-git](https://github.com/CoolTea001/dsh-cool-git) - Git plugin — adds Git management to the session tab bar, covering the basics: commit | pull | push | branch | diff.
- [crystal-hang/dsh-branch-flow](https://github.com/crystal-hang/dsh-branch-flow) - Branch panel for the composer: creates rule-checked branches from production6, validates commit messages against a type(scope) convention, and commits, pushes, or merges into stage in one click.
- [cyrusgogogo/dsh-git](https://github.com/cyrusgogogo/dsh-git) - Git panel with commit graphs, file diffs, branch and worktree management, and AI-assisted commit message previews.
- [DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-git-graph](https://github.com/DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui/tree/main/packages/dsh-git-graph) - Git branch selector and Git graph in the conversation header of the dsh web GUI.
- [Dayi-Z/dsh-git-manager](https://github.com/Dayi-Z/dsh-git-manager) - A GitHub-connected visual git manager for DeepSeek Harness: guided GitHub-Flow steps, commit graph with PR/CI badges, one-click GitHub login, PR and issue management, and structured git tools for the agent. Renamed from gitcompass in 2.0.0.
- [dd2673/dsh-wending-git-workbench](https://github.com/dd2673/dsh-wending-git-workbench) - Codex-style Git workbench: workspace-scoped changes, diff, stage, commit, guarded branch operations, graph history, fetch, fast-forward pull, and upstream push through official plugin APIs.
