- [WhitePlusMS/dsh-git-graph](https://github.com/WhitePlusMS/dsh-git-graph) - Read-only Git Graph in the native DSH Web sidebar, with commit history, branch and tag refs, file diffs, two-commit comparison, and full historical source.
- [whybebabo/dsh-file-review-tab](https://github.com/whybebabo/dsh-file-review-tab) - Sidebar tab that lists a session's file changes by turn, expands line-level diffs and undoes them, with a matching review card at the end of each chat turn. Needs dsh-better-sidebar installed separately. DSH 0.2.x port of Lzh3070/dsh-file-review-tab; do not install both.
- [wloops/dsh-git-worktree](https://github.com/wloops/dsh-git-worktree) - Git worktree Session Targets with isolated task sessions, Ready for Review, reversible Local Preview, human-confirmed delivery, environment retention and recovery, and same-session iteration.
- [Wongzexu/dsh-git-status](https://github.com/Wongzexu/dsh-git-status) - Specialized in Git branch and status handling: a Git status drawer on the right edge of the DSH web UI with a commit DAG lane graph, uncommitted changes and stash rows, inline diffs, right-click branch/tag actions, and one-click fetch from all remotes.
- [wuxiangru915/dsh-review-loop](https://github.com/wuxiangru915/dsh-review-loop) - Incremental diff reviewer for DSH: after approving a batch, only new changes since the checkpoint are shown, with a Web review panel and `/review` command that inject feedback back to the agent.
- [wzciczw/dsh-jj-panel](https://github.com/wzciczw/dsh-jj-panel) - Jujutsu (jj) version-control panel in the DSH web GUI: a Jujutsu tab renders the jj log change graph with change details, changed files and file diffs, a revset input, and jj-native history edits (drag-to-rebase, split by file, describe, squash, abandon, undo, push); it reads jj directly rather than through git, and every command runs as an argv array through a whitelisted host service with confirmations, timeouts and output caps.
- [wzw4429-crypto/dsh-github-sync](https://github.com/wzw4429-crypto/dsh-github-sync) - Bidirectional GitHub repository sync for DSH: git sync with conflict rollback and pre-push checks, Actions/CI monitoring with per-step run detail, repository add/remove/rename, a web panel with local and remote file browsers, scheduled automation, and six agent tools.
- [xbzbing/dsh-git-panel](https://github.com/xbzbing/dsh-git-panel) - IDE-style Git panel in the DSH Web GUI: a resident tab with a three-column overview (branch/tag list, searchable commit-history graph, commit detail with changed-file tree and message) and a changes page (stats bar, uncommitted list with per-file stage/unstage/discard, commit box with amend); side-by-side diffs carry lazy highlight.js syntax highlighting, on-demand between-hunk context expansion and word-level intra-line emphasis, with image files shown as before/after panes; plus a zsh-style branch marker in the input bar. Every git command runs as an argv array through the host subprocess service, cwd locked to the repo root.
- [xiaoksio/dsh-solution-explorer](https://github.com/xiaoksio/dsh-solution-explorer) - DSH Web GUI right sidebar: VS Code-style file explorer plus source control (git status, stage/unstage/discard, commit, diff, commit graph, fetch/pull/push sync, branch and remote management, git init, multi-repo switch, color-coded file status, file-type icons), an editor view that opens every file reached from the chat, the file tree or source control (Markdown/HTML/PDF/image previews, 15-language syntax highlighting, hunk-level diff editing, Ctrl+S save), file operations (new/move/copy/delete, reveal in file explorer), a collapsible icon rail, a multi-tab bottom terminal (ConPTY), and commit messages generated from the staged diff by a host-configured model.
- [xiongjiamu/dsh-atomgit](https://github.com/xiongjiamu/dsh-atomgit) - AtomGit plugin bundle for DeepSeek Harness: six built-in AtomGit skills (plan issues, implement issues, review PRs, merge PRs, publish CLI releases, mirror to GitHub) plus ag CLI integration and platform-hosted MCP tools for repos, branches, issues, PRs, and search.
- [xzy-nine/dsh-source-control](https://github.com/xzy-nine/dsh-source-control) - VSCode-style Source Control page in the DSH Web right sidebar: a paged commit lane graph with ref markers and per-commit diffs, grouped working-tree changes with stage/discard/unstage, a commit box with amend and AI-generated messages, a side-by-side and unified diff page, GitHub repository and pull request creation through the gh CLI, and bidirectional HTTPS/SSH remote switching.
- [yaanlaan/dsh-gitui](https://github.com/yaanlaan/dsh-gitui) - Visual Git graph, interactive branch management, and commit diff inspector in DeepSeek Harness right sidebar.
- [yangdongzhen590/dsh-knj-version-control](https://github.com/yangdongzhen590/dsh-knj-version-control) - Version-control workbench for the DSH Web sidebar: local changes grouped by type, per-file and multi-file staging, preview-confirmed commit / update / push, and a failure dialog that shows the raw Git output instead of a four-second toast.
- [Yangi-252410/dsh-import-repositories](https://github.com/Yangi-252410/dsh-import-repositories) - Runs git in the Host process so push, pull and fetch work inside the agent sandbox; exposes 8 agent tools (status, diff, log, stage, commit, push, fetch, pull) and 11 slash commands including /git-status, /git-commit, /git-tag and /git-name-set.
- [yangyongzhen/dsh-git-workflow](https://github.com/yangyongzhen/dsh-git-workflow) - Conventional-commit enforcement, changelog generation, PR summaries and branch pushes through the plain git CLI.
- [yangzhe1991/dsh-code-review](https://github.com/yangzhe1991/dsh-code-review) - One-click standalone two-column code review page for Git diffs in the conversation: line numbers, add/delete coloring, character-level highlight, hunk-aware per-file sections, a file nav sidebar and a stats bar; line comments submit back to the DSH composer, and the UI follows the DSH locale.
- [yann9/dsh-git-workbench](https://github.com/yann9/dsh-git-workbench) - JetBrains-style Git workbench for DSH: hunk and line-level staging, side-by-side diff with word-level highlighting, commit graph and branch operations, three-way conflict merge, and commit messages drafted with the host model.
- [Yaronluo/dsh-plugin-git-workbench](https://github.com/Yaronluo/dsh-plugin-git-workbench) - Local Git workbench for DeepSeek Harness: branch search and switching, hunk-level staging, commit graph, file history and blame, stash and worktree management, conflict resolution, and eight git tools for the agent.
- [yingtianlan/dsh-tauri-turnrewind](https://github.com/yingtianlan/dsh-tauri-turnrewind) - Turn-level workspace undo for Git worktrees: every agent turn gets a private snapshot, /undo previews a red/green diff card that is confirmed in place, files changed after the turn are refused with a conflict diff unless --force or --skip-conflicts is passed, and HEAD, index, stash and commit history of the user repository are never written.
- [yongshuai0314/dsh-turnsnap](https://github.com/yongshuai0314/dsh-turnsnap) - Zero-config per-turn git checkpoints: after every completed agent turn in a git workspace, stages all changes into one tagged \[turnsnap] commit (serialized queue, sandbox-policy aware), so any turn is a rollback point.
- [yutingzhao1991/dsh-review](https://github.com/yutingzhao1991/dsh-review) - Runs a diff past several reviewers at once — a CLI coding agent such as codex or claude, or a DSH subagent — and merges their separate sections into one report; reviewers and named review modes are configured in the settings UI.
- [zengweicheng666/dsh-svn-tools](https://github.com/zengweicheng666/dsh-svn-tools) - SVN (Subversion) toolset for DeepSeek Harness: 33 agent tools (status, diff, log, blame, commit, merge, props, lock, changelist...) plus a sidebar panel with side-by-side BASE/working-copy diff, conflict resolution and AI commit logs.
- [zengxiaolou/dsh-github-link](https://github.com/zengxiaolou/dsh-github-link) - Turns GitHub, GitLab and Gitee URLs in the transcript into hover cards with cached repository metadata, and opens them in the DSH sidebar browser on click; plain URLs and GenUI blocks are covered without patching GenUI itself.
- [zengxiaolou/dsh-pr-panel](https://github.com/zengxiaolou/dsh-pr-panel) - Trimmed fork of ItQianChen/dsh-github-flow: a floating panel plus a right-column review pane for the pull requests raised in a session, showing CI state, review comments and merge status. It also registers the github_* agent tools (PR merge and review, secrets, raw API), so do not install both.
- [Zeppeli777/idea-git](https://github.com/Zeppeli777/idea-git) - IDEA-style Git workbench for the Web UI: commit graph with lanes and ref labels, log filters, commit details, split and unified diffs with per-hunk staging, a fine-grained zero-context mode, local changes with amend and sign-off, rename-following file history, per-line annotate, stash, branch operations, compare, tags, an interactive rebase planner and conflict resolution. Records which model produced a commit by stamping an Assisted-by trailer from the live session, and renders any existing commit trailers as chips, so AI-authored history stays traceable.
- [zhitiaojun/dsh-auto-git](https://github.com/zhitiaojun/dsh-auto-git) - Runs git init in each newly registered DSH workspace, with an empty initial commit by default, so git-aware plugins have a repository to attach to; directories already inside a work tree are skipped.
- [zhu1090093659/dsh-web#packages/dsh-git-graph](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/tree/main/packages/dsh-git-graph) - Git branch selector and Git graph for the dsh web GUI: switch branches and explore branch-lane and commit history from the conversation header.
- [Zhucy123/dsh-update](https://github.com/Zhucy123/dsh-update) - One-click update for the local DeepSeek Harness checkout — compare versions, pull and rebuild, then restart, and roll back to any past release, all from a sidebar panel with live progress.
- [Zhucy123/source-code-mgmt](https://github.com/Zhucy123/source-code-mgmt) - Code management panel for the DSH web UI that handles everyday Git in five steps: ① env check auto-detects git/gh/ssh and one-click installs missing tools (gh mirror download sources speed up installs, Windows included) with check-update; ② SSH ed25519 key generation / connection tests plus one-click 443 config to bypass blocked port 22, with the Gitee personal token configured here; ③ repo status, side-by-side diffs, stage/commit, branch switching, history with revert/cherry-pick, one-click repo creation and push, auto-ignoring >100MB files; ④ lists all repos of your account for one-click clone; ⑤ five-step npm publish wizard. GitHub / Gitee dual-platform, with the UI switching between 中文 and English live.
- [ZIye1208/dsh-github-mcp](https://github.com/ZIye1208/dsh-github-mcp) - Connects GitHub's official remote MCP server as a DSH plugin: stores the PAT in DSH's credential center (.credentials.yaml) via github_set_token, and exposes GitHub tools as mcp__github__*.
- [ZIye1208/dsh-github-mcp-hint](https://github.com/ZIye1208/dsh-github-mcp-hint) - GitHub MCP helper panel: shows copyable example prompts at Settings → Plugins → GitHub MCP (random 4 from a 30-example pool), visualizes a public user's repo star/fork/language, and adds the gh_repo_stats and gh_current_user model tools.
- [zsxh1990/pr-genius](https://github.com/zsxh1990/pr-genius) - PR evaluation and improvement consultant: assesses PR success probability based on historical anti-patterns and success patterns, with one-click scoring and actionable suggestions.

### Notifications & Integrations

- [0QwQ0/dsh-discord-richpresence](https://github.com/0QwQ0/dsh-discord-richpresence) - Push vague or rich, user-configurable DSH interaction states to the local Discord client as Rich Presence — real-time, content-free, with a user-editable status list and an optional rich-mode toggle in Settings.
- [3150481853/molly-qq-whale#dsh-qq-whale](https://github.com/3150481853/molly-qq-whale/tree/main/plugin/dsh-qq-whale) - QQ channel for DeepSeek Harness over OneBot 11 / NapCat: keeps one fixed persona across sessions with long-term memory, answers in group and private chats, sends stickers and voice replies, and ships a local web console that shows what the bot is doing. Persona and memory files are yours to write — the repository only ships examples.
- [534119219/chicheng-push](https://github.com/534119219/chicheng-push) - Multi-channel push for DeepSeek Harness: Server酱, PushPlus, Bark, DingTalk, WeCom, Telegram, Feishu, ntfy, custom webhooks and more, configurable from the settings panel and callable by other plugins via the pushNotifier service.
- [534119219/dsh-messaging#messaging-core](https://github.com/534119219/dsh-messaging/tree/main/packages/messaging-core) - Unified messaging gateway for DeepSeek Harness: 27 IM platforms (Telegram, QQ, WeChat, Discord, WhatsApp, Feishu and more) in one plugin, with QR scan-to-authorize, per-platform workspaces, slash commands, and a web setup dialog.
- [988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-im-qq](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-im-qq) - QQ official bot (q.qq.com) integration for DeepSeek Harness: chat with the full agent from private chats, groups and channels — WS long connection (heartbeat / reconnect / RESUME), per-chat session isolation, standard agent preset, approval inline buttons with /revoke, slash commands, whitelist fail-closed, credentials via the credentials domain.
- [a23842/dsh-notifier](https://github.com/a23842/dsh-notifier) - Multi-channel notifications for DeepSeek Harness: registers a send_notification tool and a settings page fanning out to NotifyX, WeCom app webhook, WeCom group robot, email (Resend), SMTP, DingTalk, Feishu robot; plus browser notifications and automatic notification on task completion and blocking events.
- [a792883583/dsh-message-gateway](https://github.com/a792883583/dsh-message-gateway) - Multi-platform message gateway and WeCom AI bot bridge with session context compression and smartsheet creation.
- [a792883583/dsh-smart-reminder](https://github.com/a792883583/dsh-smart-reminder) - Smart calendar and checklist assistant with lunar dates, macOS/Windows native notifications, and WeCom push.
- [aa2246740/dsh-gateway](https://github.com/aa2246740/dsh-gateway) - Connects a DSH Host to Slack and Feishu using your own bot applications.
- [aa2246740/dsh-notch](https://github.com/aa2246740/dsh-notch) - Connects DSH session status, approvals and questions to a native macOS notch app; requires the native app and Focus companion.
- [aa2246740/dsh-notch#dsh-notch-focus](https://github.com/aa2246740/dsh-notch/tree/main/companions/dsh-notch-focus) - Companion for DSH Notch that synchronizes session navigation and read state with DSH Desktop and Web.
- [AAAAaron/dsh-feishu-board](https://github.com/AAAAaron/dsh-feishu-board) - Host-side Feishu board for DeepSeek Harness: pushes a session's ask_user_question to Feishu DM as plain text and sends a quoted reply back to the exact session that asked, archiving unmatched replies instead of guessing. Its lark-cli wrapper also suppresses an identical notification resent within three minutes.
- [aawef/dsh-time-watchdog](https://github.com/aawef/dsh-time-watchdog) - Turn timer for DSH: reports how long the current turn has been running, injects wrap-up prompts on a /set-time schedule so the agent starts finishing instead of running on, and shows run-time cards above the composer.
- [AbcdefgXW/dsh-msg-hub](https://github.com/AbcdefgXW/dsh-msg-hub) - IM channel bridge: WeChat (ilinkai) / QQ / Feishu with proactive push — wake the channel bot from scheduled tasks and deliver AI replies to your phone.
- [Adingo001/dsh-notification-desktop](https://github.com/Adingo001/dsh-notification-desktop) - Turn-end reminders for DSH 0.2.x — the host folds each session's last completed turn into a projection and the desktop shell shows it as a real Windows toast, with per-outcome filters, background-only gating and a settings page. The Windows desktop shell must register its AUMID once before toasts appear.
- [ahian-lee/dsh-attention-notifier](https://github.com/ahian-lee/dsh-attention-notifier) - Sounds and notifications when a task completes or waits for your approval or answer; notification sounds are configurable in the settings page (synth styles or your own audio file), with built-in cat hachimi sounds, just for fun. An optional Windows patch adds a taskbar digit, flashing and native toasts.
- [AhYi8/dsh-gotify-notify](https://github.com/AhYi8/dsh-gotify-notify) - Push a Gotify notification when each conversation turn ends, with configurable templates, priority and per-cause titles.
- [AIcivilization/dsh-mishu](https://github.com/AIcivilization/dsh-mishu) - DSH secretary: triages your unread GitHub notifications by their real state every 15 minutes (closing what is already resolved), remembers dated things you tell it (bills, renewals, document expiries, birthdays) and reminds you when due, and watches your inbox read-only; secrets live in the system keychain only.
- [AK-blank/dsh-plugin-mac-notify](https://github.com/AK-blank/dsh-plugin-mac-notify) - Sends a macOS Notification Center alert when a session finishes or the agent is blocked on an answer, an approval, or an error. The banner carries the last reply and plays your system alert sound, and clicking it returns you to the DSH page.
- [amlyczz/dsh-lark-link](https://github.com/amlyczz/dsh-lark-link) - High-reliability Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness: QR one-click auth, card-based commands and intent-confirmation cards, at-least-once zero-loss outbox, media in/out, /doctor session-log ZIP, and a reusable DSH Web GUI that lands sessions in the right workspace.
- [andyfan1094/dsh-feishu](https://github.com/andyfan1094/dsh-feishu) - Connects a Feishu self-built app over WebSocket, routes each chat to an independent DSH agent session, and streams replies through a Card JSON 2.0 card with plain-text fallback.
- [aokamoaki/dsh-notify](https://github.com/aokamoaki/dsh-notify) - Conversation-completion notifications for DeepSeek Harness: Windows toast + sound on turn done / error / goal, plus ask & approval alerts - background-only, with a volume-adjustable bell in the conversation header.
- [Archaofan/dsh-notify-relay](https://github.com/Archaofan/dsh-notify-relay) - Routes eight DSH lifecycle events through dedup, quiet hours and digest batching into seven channels. Severity maps to the fields Bark, ntfy, Telegram and webhooks actually support; failed deliveries retry with jittered backoff and survive a restart; per-channel circuit breakers stop hammering a dead endpoint; and a self-check reports a degraded relay instead of going silent.
- [baisama-cloud/dsh-omni-bridge](https://github.com/baisama-cloud/dsh-omni-bridge) - Multi-channel IM bridge for DeepSeek Harness: route WeChat (ClawBot/iLink), QQ, and Feishu (Lark) chat messages to a DSH agent and relay its replies back, with per-channel sessions and reply dedup.
- [baosfeng/my-dsh-plugins#dsh-my-notify](https://github.com/baosfeng/my-dsh-plugins/tree/main/plugins/dsh-my-notify) - Browser notifications and a beep when a session turn ends, the agent asks a question or approval is pending; clicking the notification jumps to the session; remote trigger endpoint and SSE channel (npm: `dsh-my-notify`).
- [better-er/dsh-notify-ding](https://github.com/better-er/dsh-notify-ding) - Browser system notification, sounded by the OS notification itself, when a session needs a reply or a run goes idle; no page-focus check, at most one notification per session with a newer one replacing the old, and an idle notice reports how many background tasks are still running.
- [BiBoyang/dsh-im-bridge](https://github.com/BiBoyang/dsh-im-bridge) - Two-way WeChat (iLink) bridge: turn-end and approval-request push, in-chat approve/reject and message injection, persistent dedup and convergent long-reply chunking; channel layer extensible to other IMs.
- [bill9109/dsh-web-ui-notify](https://github.com/bill9109/dsh-web-ui-notify) - Desktop notification reminders.
- [bill9109/dsh-webbridge](https://github.com/bill9109/dsh-webbridge) - DSH meets Kimi WebBridge.
- [BillCx330/dsh-plugin-notify-sounds](https://github.com/BillCx330/dsh-plugin-notify-sounds) - Native-style notification sounds for DeepSeek Harness: a chime when the agent needs your decision or finishes a task, clickable system notifications that jump back to the window, repeat reminders, quiet hours, and goal-mode alerts that wait for the final round.
- [Bing-Bryan/dsh-unread-dot](https://github.com/Bing-Bryan/dsh-unread-dot) - macOS Dock badge and bubble chime: shows an unread badge on the Dock (dot while running, count when done) and plays a chime while the app is hidden; clears on return, built on the Badging API.
- [bitterSmilezzz/dsh-notify](https://github.com/bitterSmilezzz/dsh-notify) - Native desktop notifications for DSH — approvals, questions, turn completion, session end and errors — with click-to-session, per-event toggles, quiet hours, a privacy switch that keeps message text off the banner, and a Web Audio tone per event type.
- [bobleer/dsh-acp-for-bitfun](https://github.com/bobleer/dsh-acp-for-bitfun) - ACP bridge between BitFun and DSH.
- [BolunHan/cc-monitor#dsh-cc-monitor](https://github.com/BolunHan/cc-monitor/tree/main/dsh-cc-monitor) - Reports DeepSeek Harness session activity to a self-hosted cc-monitor server, which surfaces Claude Code and DSH sessions as color-coded state cards in one web dashboard and pings your browser and Android app when a session needs attention.
- [br1nosense/dsh-wxauto-plugin](https://github.com/br1nosense/dsh-wxauto-plugin) - WeChat automation for DSH: push task progress to WeChat, listen for messages with keyword auto-reply, and a WeChat ↔ DSH two-way bridge controllable from the settings page, built on wxauto4.
- [bululuburuarua666/dsh-herald](https://github.com/bululuburuarua666/dsh-herald) - Tri-channel task notifications: in-page toasts with chimes, browser OS banners, and host-direct OS toasts that keep working with the browser closed, plus a bell panel with persistent history.
- [c1overzz/dsh-bili-scroll](https://github.com/c1overzz/dsh-bili-scroll) - Let your DSH agent browse Bilibili on its own, read subtitles, write a daily digest, and @ you when it finds something worth your attention.
- [CAI-MH/dsh-agent-bridge](https://github.com/CAI-MH/dsh-agent-bridge) - Bridge a Feishu bot to a DSH session: open a real session in a workspace, run tasks with the existing model and plugins, and report results back.
- [CAI-MH/dsh-feishu-task-recorder](https://github.com/CAI-MH/dsh-feishu-task-recorder) - Poll Feishu (Lark) group and direct chats through lark-cli, extract candidate tasks with a review workflow, and two-way sync them with the task-board plugin, with a floating browser panel and one-click device-flow authorization.
- [caoxiaohu7745-bot/kongmu-im-bridge](https://github.com/caoxiaohu7745-bot/kongmu-im-bridge) - Feishu bridge for DeepSeek Harness (derived from dsh-im-bridge): WebSocket long connection, approval cards, group @-mention-only replies, streaming card updates, /stop command.
- [cdxiaodong/dsh-island](https://github.com/cdxiaodong/dsh-island) - Bridge DSH agent sessions, tool calls, and approvals to the CodeIsland macOS notch panel over a Unix socket, with in-panel allow/deny.
- [cheesehaqi/dsh-qq-onebot-bridge](https://github.com/cheesehaqi/dsh-qq-onebot-bridge) - Bidirectional QQ bridge over OneBot v11 (reverse WebSocket): per-group and per-private-chat sessions, @-quoted voice speech-to-text, private image/animated-sticker viewing, face and sticker tools.
- [chendaleiQ/dsh-plugin-desktop-notify](https://github.com/chendaleiQ/dsh-plugin-desktop-notify) - Desktop notifications and an app-icon unread badge for DeepSeek Harness. A banner fires when a turn finishes, when an approval, question or plan confirmation is waiting, and when a turn fails; the badge shows how many sessions need you and clears once viewed, and clicking a banner switches to that session. Follows the DSH interface language, subagent sessions stay quiet by default, titles and body length are configurable, and a loopback HTTP interface lets scripts and other tools post notifications.
- [chenvinc/dsh-2-atoll-notice](https://github.com/chenvinc/dsh-2-atoll-notice) - Mirrors DeepSeek Harness task state (failed, waiting for your answer, finished) into the macOS Atoll Dynamic Island as one status light with three counts.
- [chenweigao/dsh-perch-notify](https://github.com/chenweigao/dsh-perch-notify) - Webhook notifications for dsh sessions: a POST when an approval is requested or a turn ends, to ntfy, Bark, a Slack/DingTalk/WeCom bot URL, or any HTTPS endpoint.
- [chidaic/dsh-agent-notify](https://github.com/chidaic/dsh-agent-notify) - Windows system-level notifications when the agent finishes a task or needs your input: task-done, question, approval and plan-review alerts via the browser Notification API, click-to-open the session, background-only mode, and a first-level settings page (Settings → 任务提示).
- [chintoleung/dsh-ping](https://github.com/chintoleung/dsh-ping) - Telegram notifications for DeepSeek Harness questions, approval requests, and completed turns. Notification-only: one runtime file, zero runtime dependencies, no custom question cards.
- [chromoany/dsh-notify-me](https://github.com/chromoany/dsh-notify-me) - Notification reminders, message alerts and desktop notification for DSH — a desktop notifier that raises a system toast, a sound and a tab-title marker when the agent needs your input (approval, plan review, question) or a reply is finished in the background (task complete / completion alerts, notify when done); the Settings page holds the master switch, sound and volume, the per-case toggles and the zh/en notification language.
- [Cloudto1/dsh-approval-chime](https://github.com/Cloudto1/dsh-approval-chime) - Plays a chime when DeepSeek Harness asks for approval; tone, volume and on/off are set in Settings → Notifications.
- [cmfok/dsh-feishucard](https://github.com/cmfok/dsh-feishucard) - Bridge DeepSeek Harness agent sessions into Feishu (Lark) chats over the official SDK long connection, with a streaming reply card, many bots per instance, and mention-gated group replies.
- [CNranger1124/dsh-lane-bridge#dsh-lane-bridge](https://github.com/CNranger1124/dsh-lane-bridge/tree/main/packages/dsh-lane-bridge) - Multi-channel IM bridge for DeepSeek Harness: each QQ (SnowLuma / OneBot v11, official QQ Bot) or Discord group and private chat becomes its own agent session, bound to a role card whose domain carries knowledge bases with draft approval, shared memory, a read-only GitHub reader and group trigger rules; two built-in personas (customer support, group chat), unified push with broadcast, and human hand-off.
- [CoCoCoDeDeDe/dsh-session-notifier](https://github.com/CoCoCoDeDeDe/dsh-session-notifier) - Desktop notifications for DSH Web sessions: browser notifications plus Windows toast when a session finishes, fails, needs an approval, or asks a question. Clicking one opens the session; browser notifications focus an open tab, Windows toasts open a new tab.
- [dAI-aigc/dsh-wechat](https://github.com/dAI-aigc/dsh-wechat) - WeChat bridge for DeepSeek Harness over Tencent's iLink bot channel: one session per contact, inbound text/images/files, and WeChat's native typing indicator while a turn runs.
- [DeepseekHarnessPlugins/Notification](https://github.com/DeepseekHarnessPlugins/Notification) - Task-completion notifications: desktop alerts via macOS Notification Center and Windows Toast, plus mobile push through Bark, ntfy, ServerChan or any webhook when an agent run goes idle, errors or blocks.
- [dingyi222666/dsh-session-notification](https://github.com/dingyi222666/dsh-session-notification) - Notifications for four session states, with browser alerts and prompts.

- [ramwin/dsh-turn-music](https://github.com/ramwin/dsh-turn-music) - Turn-finished music reminder: when an agent turn ends, play a ringtone or any local audio file (bundled synthesised telephone ring, custom absolute path, or an in-page upload), with a floating chip to pause, resume or dismiss it and loop-until-paused playback; configured in Settings, defaults overridable per deployment.

- [SciF-Lin/dsh-notify-sound-plus](https://github.com/SciF-Lin/dsh-notify-sound-plus) - Per-event sound alerts and system notifications for DeepSeek Harness. Four events — turn complete, question, approval and error — each get a switch, a sound picker with instant preview and a system-notification master switch. Twelve built-in tones plus a silent option are synthesized at runtime with the Web Audio API, so no audio files ship with the package; the four per-event defaults differ in register, timbre and rhythm (a high sine strike, a rising triangle pair, a repeated square pulse and a low sawtooth descent) so they are distinguishable without comparing pitches. A mode dropdown in General settings offers on, off and a smart mode that defers to the whale widget so the two never double up; the same row has a preview button and a gear opening a full settings dialog with volume, a skip-while-focused option and upload of your own audio up to 2 MB. A speaker button in the composer mutes sound without touching notifications. Works in the web GUI and the Electron desktop app.

Collectors run in-process, so nothing dies silently in a stray daemon. The weather collector is on by default and sends your IP to ip-api.com over plain HTTP unless a city is configured.

- [wangzhanchao883/dsh-no-long-sit](https://github.com/wangzhanchao883/dsh-no-long-sit) - Sit-and-water reminder for DeepSeek Harness, with a cat that sits in the corner of the Web GUI. A focus cycle of 30-90 minutes ends in a centered overlay plus a triple chime that gets you up to walk and drink; the later button answers with one real sourced case about prolonged sitting and one about dehydration (built-in library of 17 entries, each with publisher, date and a link to the original); stopping produces a session report with worked time, completed rounds, successful interruptions, snoozes, suggested drinks and a good/mid/bad grade. - [Whale-Zhang/dsh-complete-chime](https://github.com/Whale-Zhang/dsh-complete-chime) - Plays a short chime when a conversation turn finishes, with three built-in tones or one custom upload, configured in Settings → Plugins.
- [whyihaveyou/dsh-suite#plugin-notify](https://github.com/whyihaveyou/dsh-suite/tree/main/packages/plugins/plugin-notify) - IM webhook and local notifications on turn completion, errors, or approval (Feishu/WeCom/DingTalk/Slack/Discord/custom).
- [wingsky-1/dsh-plugin-hub#packages/dsh-notifier](https://github.com/wingsky-1/dsh-plugin-hub/tree/main/packages/dsh-notifier) - Task-event notification center: 6 event kinds (ask / approval / completion / subagent completion / error / turn end), dual channels (browser Notification + host system toast) plus Bark/Webhook push channels (ntfy, Gotify, self-hosted gateways); quiet hours with urgent exceptions, approval-timeout re-reminders, completion-storm aggregation, and notification text redaction.
- [wjh-ux/dsh-wechat-media](https://github.com/wjh-ux/dsh-wechat-media) - Personal WeChat and WeCom (企业微信) bridge: QR pairing, one DSH conversation per chat, two-way text/image/video/document/archive transfer, chat commands (/help, /status, /new, /stop, /friends) answered by the bridge itself without spending a model turn, a switch that restricts the bot to 1:1 chats (group messages are dropped silently and counted), remote approval by replying 1 or 2 in the chat, and a two-way WeCom intelligent robot over its long connection (no public URL needed) that also receives and sends images, files and videos.
- [Wlaeg/dsh-notify-linux](https://github.com/Wlaeg/dsh-notify-linux) - Linux desktop notifications and a chime for DeepSeek Harness, sent by the host process so they still arrive with the browser page closed: turn completion, pending questions, tool approvals and turn errors, delivered through notify-send and paplay with a canberra-gtk-play fallback. A browser half adds an in-page toast, a Web Notification and a synthesized Web Audio chime as fallback; every switch lives in a Settings page or a JSON file.
- [wodongx123/dsh-qq-notify](https://github.com/wodongx123/dsh-qq-notify) - Send QQ private-message notifications via a local NapCat bot: qq_send / qq_status / qq_napcat / qq_deploy native tools plus one-click deployment scripts.
- [wsxwj123/dsh-plugins#dsh-pet-bridge](https://github.com/wsxwj123/dsh-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-pet-bridge) - Bridge dsh session status to the cc-pet desktop pet bubble: thinking, tool calls, and completion in real time. Ships on npm as `dsh-pet-bridge`.
- [wsz987/dsh-channels#channels](https://github.com/wsz987/dsh-channels/tree/main/packages/channels) - Connects WeChat, QQ, DingTalk, Lark, and Telegram to DeepSeek Harness with unified configuration, private-chat and group access controls, and channel-side Agent chat and session commands.
- [wuuuuu123-32/dsh-mailbox-notify](https://github.com/wuuuuu123-32/dsh-mailbox-notify) - Emails you when a long turn finishes or errors, when a goal completes or blocks, and when an approval or a question has waited past a timeout; each new notification deletes the previous one from the inbox over IMAP, so the inbox holds at most one.
- [wz-heng/dsh-feishu-bridge](https://github.com/wz-heng/dsh-feishu-bridge) - Fail-closed Feishu (Lark) channel bridge: chat with a bot, get dsh agent turns back — with opt-in human-in-the-loop tool approval (Allow/Deny cards before every bash call, fail-closed timeout). Official-Python-SDK-only integration (exact-pinned); deny-by-default allowlist, webhook signature/timestamp/replay verification, per-chat sticky sessions; daily latest-SDK compatibility canary; bilingual docs.
- [X-Xyy/dsh-auto-email](https://github.com/X-Xyy/dsh-auto-email) - Daily AI digest by email: fetches ten sources (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Hugging Face, arXiv, Hacker News and others), clusters near-duplicate stories, scores them in code and with an LLM, then emails the top three on a daily schedule with a four-part reading (facts, why it matters, impact, open questions). Adds four conversation tools and a sidebar panel for previewing the digest, sending it now and changing the schedule.
- [XA-anjiu/dsh-notify-sfx](https://github.com/XA-anjiu/dsh-notify-sfx) - Windows desktop notifications with selectable sounds: five bundled sound packs (45 clips) plus imported audio, one sound per event, and clicking a notification opens the matching session.
- [xain/ui-beep](https://github.com/xain/ui-beep) - Web Audio agent-heartbeat cues for the DSH web GUI: a low working hum while an agent is busy, ticks on streaming output, and a chime when a session awaits input or work finishes, with per-voice volume, mute toggle, and optional local audio files.
- [xchannel1987/dsh-notify-xc](https://github.com/xchannel1987/dsh-notify-xc) - Browser notification plugin for DeepSeek Harness - system toasts when a task finishes, a run errors, or your input is needed (question / approval / plan review), click to open the session, per-type toggles, and no false 'done' while the main session waits on its subagents.
- [xiaoshihou514/dsh-weixin](https://github.com/xiaoshihou514/dsh-weixin) - Connects dsh to Weixin, with arbitrary file sending support.
- [xiaxingtianxia2-glitch/dsh-chime](https://github.com/xiaxingtianxia2-glitch/dsh-chime) - Task-completion chime for DeepSeek Harness, playing the original opencode sounds for done, question, plan-review and error events with zero external dependencies.
- [xinyang920/dsh-caps-beacon](https://github.com/xinyang920/dsh-caps-beacon) - Turns the MacBook keyboard Caps Lock light into an agent status light: on while the agent works, flashing when it waits for your approval or answer, off when idle.
- [xmanrui/dsh-feishu](https://github.com/xmanrui/dsh-feishu) - Connect a Feishu bot to DeepSeek Harness by scanning a QR code.
- [xmanrui/dsh-im](https://github.com/xmanrui/dsh-im) - Connect IM bots to DeepSeek Harness via QR codes or bot credentials (9 channels: Feishu, WeChat, DingTalk, WeCom, QQ, Slack, Telegram, Discord, and WhatsApp).
- [xmanrui/dsh-weixin](https://github.com/xmanrui/dsh-weixin) - Connect a Weixin bot to DeepSeek Harness by scanning a QR code.
- [xueyingneko/qqbridge-plus](https://github.com/xueyingneko/qqbridge-plus) - Diving-Fish score lookup for MaimaiDX inside QQ, plus qq-bridge chat extensions. #查分 renders a B50 with song artwork from an OAuth authorisation that any member can use, and works without the bridge running; the extensions cover balance and auto-shutdown, reasoning tier switching by billing peak hours, holiday-table coverage, start/shutdown greetings, and an in-QQ feature toggle.
- [xwzkj/dsh-audio-alert](https://github.com/xwzkj/dsh-audio-alert) - Host-side session alerts for DSH Web on Linux: tones played through the server's audio device when a turn ends, fails, or waits for approval or an answer — no browser needed.
- [yakoylp/dsh-localnotify](https://github.com/yakoylp/dsh-localnotify) - In-app local notification center for DSH: a sidebar Notifications entry with unread badge, full-screen center with level color coding (info/success/warn/error), time/source filters, sorting, title/content search, read/unread, delete, detail popup with one-click copy, and pagination; written by the notify_add agent tool or the dsh-localnotify CLI (with auto-cleanup retention), page refreshes live, UI follows dsh web language (zh/en).
- [yangyongzhen/dsh-notify](https://github.com/yangyongzhen/dsh-notify) - Task-completion notifications via ServerChan / DingTalk / Feishu / generic webhooks.
- [YE-ZINAN/dsh-quiet](https://github.com/YE-ZINAN/dsh-quiet) - Attention gate for DeepSeek Harness: sorts run events into blocked / terminal / progress and alerts only on the first two, holding everything non-blocking during a /focus block and delivering it when the block ends. Alerts flash the taskbar button only - no toast, no sound, no focus steal. Windows only.
- [YeqingTang/dsh-task-watcher-plugin](https://github.com/YeqingTang/dsh-task-watcher-plugin) - Windows-only tray monitor for DeepSeek Harness: deploys and manages the standalone DshTaskWatcher tray app - four-state tray icon (gray=disconnected, green=idle, amber=running, red=attention), a per-task panel with live duration/tps/tokens, and completion & outcome notifications. Start/stop switch in Settings > Plugins; the watcher is an independent process that survives DSH restarts.
- [yeruizhi/dsh-lark-meeting-notifier](https://github.com/yeruizhi/dsh-lark-meeting-notifier) - Feishu meeting reminder: a dsh-plugin which has only side effect: reminding you, mid-flow with AI, that you "have to go meet carbon-based lifeforms".
- [YiMlT/dsh-notify-yimit](https://github.com/YiMlT/dsh-notify-yimit) - Windows system and custom desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness events: task completed, failed, running, awaiting approval, and awaiting answer. Click-to-jump to the session.
- [yjrqz777/dsh-qqbot-lite](https://github.com/yjrqz777/dsh-qqbot-lite) - Connects QQ Bot private and group chats to DeepSeek Harness Desktop, with per-chat personas, interactive questions, and optional image understanding.
- [YOYOLnFu/dsh-bili-pond](https://github.com/YOYOLnFu/dsh-bili-pond) - Let the Blue Big Fat Fish browse Bilibili for you: it comments on your behalf, DMs you interesting finds, writes a diary, and keeps a memory for long-term summaries. It filters videos to your taste, creates Markdown digests, and can watch comments and reply for you. In Circle Mode, it replies only inside threads explicitly invited by the video uploader in a top-level comment — ordinary viewer requests do not count, and it never starts a new top-level comment. Commenting, DMs, auto-run, and comment watch are off by default. Needs Node 22, DSH 0.1.7-rc.1+, a signed-in Bilibili account, a model route and Python.
- [YoyuDev/dsh-ping](https://github.com/YoyuDev/dsh-ping) - Sounds a chime and raises a desktop notification when the agent needs you — stage completion, approval requests, awaiting input, task completion, and errors, each with its own tone.
- [YuMo226/dsh-task-notify](https://github.com/YuMo226/dsh-task-notify) - Native Windows system notification (Notification Center toast) when a task completes: goal completion or agent turn end.

Custom audio folders are supported.
- [Yuuyuko-uu/dsh-qq-bridge](https://github.com/Yuuyuko-uu/dsh-qq-bridge) - Bridges a DSH session and QQ over NapCat HTTP, forwarding agent replies to QQ and feeding messages you send in QQ back into the session.
- [yxiaoy6/dsh-taskbar-alert](https://github.com/yxiaoy6/dsh-taskbar-alert) - Flashes the DeepSeek Harness taskbar button on Windows when an approval, a question or a plan review is waiting, or when a turn finishes.
- [YZz-S/dsh-notifier](https://github.com/YZz-S/dsh-notifier) - System-native notifications when a task finishes or needs your confirmation: Windows toast, macOS osascript, and Linux notify-send.
- [zaofan-make/dsh-qqbot](https://github.com/zaofan-make/dsh-qqbot) - QQ official bot channel for DeepSeek Harness (feature-rich fork of tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot): group and private chat with the full agent, sticker library with auto-tagging and AI meme replies, group management (join approval and mute), botplay interactive card events with paginated catalogs, user extension registry (custom slash commands and QQ tools), scheduled wakeups, remote approvals over QQ, and a floating dock web UI.
- [zepeng-jin/dsh-completion-notifier](https://github.com/zepeng-jin/dsh-completion-notifier) - Native macOS completion notifications and user approval alerts with Settings UI for DeepSeek Harness.

The notification logic runs in the DSH host process, so toasts still arrive with the tab or the browser closed; a Win32 foreground probe suppresses them while you are looking at DSH. Windows only.
- [zhangjie-2007/dsh-voice](https://github.com/zhangjie-2007/dsh-voice) - Speaks a cue for DeepSeek Harness on Windows: a configurable phrase when an agent turn completes normally, a second phrase when the agent needs you to choose — a question, a plan approval, or a permission request — and a time-of-day greeting when a new conversation starts. A small bubble in the lower-left corner mutes and unmutes every cue with one click, with its own toggle chime. Phrases are synthesized with a Microsoft Edge neural voice (skipping aborted and errored turns, subagent turns, and rounds that a goal is still driving), cached under the DSH home directory and replayed locally, with the desktop SAPI voice as the offline fallback.
- [zhengjy01/dsh-notify](https://github.com/zhengjy01/dsh-notify) - System-level desktop notifications: turn-completion and workflow-end banners, plus a modal alert when an approval is needed (macOS osascript / Linux notify-send).
- [zhengjy01/dsh-task-dispatcher](https://github.com/zhengjy01/dsh-task-dispatcher) - TickTick (滴答清单) daily task dispatcher: an interval timer pulls due tasks from a chosen list into a Markdown task file and notifies only when the task set changes (WeChat via ClawBot / flomo / macOS); it can also auto-execute each task in its own headless DSH session under a configurable timeout, optionally gated to DeepSeek's off-peak hours so peak-time work queues to the next off-peak window instead of starting, plus a settings panel for the deferred write-back queue and dispatcher_status / dispatcher_config / dispatcher_run / dispatcher_report tools.
- [zhengjy01/dsh-ticktick](https://github.com/zhengjy01/dsh-ticktick) - Two-way TickTick/Dida365 (滴答清单) task sync via the official OAuth Open API: pull tasks across lists, create/update/complete/delete tasks, and one-shot title-deduped sync, with a web settings panel.
- [ZIye1208/dsh-approval-voice](https://github.com/ZIye1208/dsh-approval-voice) - Plays a chime and speaks a Chinese voice alert when an approval, question, or plan-review popup appears in the DSH web GUI, so you never miss a request.
- [zjbc2000/attention-plugins](https://github.com/zjbc2000/attention-plugins) - Task-priority session notifications for DSH: main-line sessions alert immediately on completion or failure, side-line completions can be batched into one alert, and questions or permission requests alert as they arrive; supports multiple main-line markers and a balanced mode that treats every session as main-line while nothing is marked.
- [zjhaaa042-cloud/dsh-mobile-notify](https://github.com/zjhaaa042-cloud/dsh-mobile-notify) - Mobile push when a DSH task goes idle, over 10 channels: ntfy, Bark, DingTalk, WeCom, Feishu, ServerChan, PushPlus, Telegram, Qmsg and generic webhooks. The message carries the session, workspace, elapsed time, turn number and a reply excerpt, and it runs host-side rather than in the browser page.
- [ztl0001/dsh-notify](https://github.com/ztl0001/dsh-notify) - Windows toast notifications when a DeepSeek Harness task finishes: the session title, the outcome, and a summary of the final reply, sent once when the agent really stops rather than once per round of a running goal.
- [zy12342/dsh-approval-toast](https://github.com/zy12342/dsh-approval-toast) - Windows toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness: approve or reject from the notification while DSH is in the background, with an in-app fallback; foreground only skips the current conversation, while other conversations still notify. Also reports turn completion and errors; subagent sessions stay silent.
- [zzx-dear/dsh-capybara-notify](https://github.com/zzx-dear/dsh-capybara-notify) - Capybara secretary for DSH: desktop pet notifications with ding sound, alert inbox API, session-aware alerts (turn done / approval needed / turn blocked), check scripts, and daily high-star plugin recommendations.

### Development & Runtime

- [11111353535/dsh-reaper](https://github.com/11111353535/dsh-reaper) - Inventory every listening TCP endpoint and grade each holder as agent-spawned, workspace, dev-server, unattributed, system or protected; only the first two can be auto-selected, and a reap previews its descendant-closure plan unless confirmed.
- [11111353535/dsh-which](https://github.com/11111353535/dsh-which) - Command resolution forensics: which file a command actually runs, which PATH entry won, what it shadows, how many entries are duplicates or dead, and whether the copies behind one name report the same version.
- [1123762794/dsh-web-restart](https://github.com/1123762794/dsh-web-restart) - One-click restart button for the DSH Web UI: a sidebar footer button that restarts the dsh web process with a single click and persists across the restart it triggers.
- [1420079678-ctrl/agent-body#dsh-organism](https://github.com/1420079678-ctrl/agent-body/tree/main/workspace/plugins/dsh-organism) - The organ kernel of Agent-Body: plugins organized as one body. Each command is turned into a nerve impulse that deterministically innervates the organ which should handle it and names the capability to use; a heartbeat with a variable interval (faster on alerts, slower when idle) pumps operator directives, proprioception and homeostasis warnings system-wide; reflex arcs fire with zero model calls; failures go through deterministic attribution (missing tool / arguments / permission / timeout / network), a prescription, and a re-check loop, with argument errors never auto-retried. A missing organ is compensated by the one with the highest capability overlap, and tool schemas are gated by the current intent (84.7% measured reduction, reproducible in-repo). This entry is the kernel plugin package inside the agent-body repository.
- [1624318455/dsh-plugin-proxy](https://github.com/1624318455/dsh-plugin-proxy) - Runtime-switchable outbound HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy for DSH with a web settings card.
- [2008924/dsh-progress-viz#plugin](https://github.com/2008924/dsh-progress-viz/tree/main/plugin) - Real-time stage, ETA & cost dashboard for headless dsh tasks: turns the black-box session event stream into a live multi-task grid (cordis plugin + standalone local dashboard, no API calls).
- [566001/dsh-wrapup-guard](https://github.com/566001/dsh-wrapup-guard) - Enforces a check-fix-recheck loop when a task is wrapping up: it auto-runs your tests/lint/audit, blocks any round that still has unfixed problems, and only calls the task done after three consecutive clean full checks, then notifies the user.
- [777-Zen/dsh-capability-index](https://github.com/777-Zen/dsh-capability-index) - Pre-flight plugin-library index for DSH agents: injects per-step trigger-table hints into the runtime context so suitable installed plugins get used predictably instead of opportunistically.
- [dsh-restart-dock](https://github.com/7gzgn/dsh-restart-dock) - A small dock in the DSH Web UI: restart the host or reload the page in one click. Restart asks first (now / 30s / 60s / 2min / cancel); the dock drags to any edge only after a 320ms hold, and stays anchored when the window resizes. Refresh refuses to run unless the plugin bundle is verifiably loadable (timestamp baseline + real bundle fetch + syntax compile), so a reload can never brick the app. Restart is Windows-only (PowerShell 5.1); the UI and page refresh work on all platforms.
- [7starsseeker/MCModsDevBridge](https://github.com/7starsseeker/MCModsDevBridge) - Development tooling for Minecraft 26.3 mods: starts a real dedicated server and a real client from JSON instance registrations, drives both through an authenticated HTTP probe, and asserts on world, UI and log state across Fabric, Forge and NeoForge, writing per-run evidence and shipping no game or loader files. Requires JDK 25 and a Minecraft 26.3 instance.
- [863683348/dsh-plugin-verify](https://github.com/863683348/dsh-plugin-verify) - Verification toolkit for DSH agents: evidence-based claim checking against workspace files with line citations, config validation (JSON/YAML), and read-only URL/npm/GitHub submission-readiness probes.
- [863683348/dsh-trend-radar](https://github.com/863683348/dsh-trend-radar) - Ecosystem trend dashboard (行情面板): snapshot the dsh-plugin topic and the awesome list into local history, then report weekly trends — new plugins, star gainers, category heat, awesome coverage — plus a keyword radar for new plugins and star surges.
- [962599627/agent-development-constraints](https://github.com/962599627/agent-development-constraints) - Installs a self-evolving development-constraints rule library, exposes it to the agent through a constraints tool and a once-per-session reminder, and audits AI token cost and context usage.
- [9840333w/dsh-file-tracker](https://github.com/9840333w/dsh-file-tracker) - Records the files and folders an AI agent creates, modifies, deletes, renames or moves, shows them in a draggable floating panel with unread counts, and persists the records as per-workspace JSONL logs.
- [988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs#dsh-lsp-cpp](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/tree/main/dsh-lsp-cpp) - C/C++ LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using clangd.

- [988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs#dsh-lsp-lua](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/tree/main/dsh-lsp-lua) - Lua LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using lua-language-server.
