- [988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs#dsh-lsp-rust](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/tree/main/dsh-lsp-rust) - Rust LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using rust-analyzer.
- [988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs#dsh-lsp-swift](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/tree/main/dsh-lsp-swift) - Swift LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using sourcekit-lsp.
- [988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs#dsh-lsp-ts](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/tree/main/dsh-lsp-ts) - TypeScript and JavaScript LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using typescript-language-server.
- [a1113622001/dsh-auto-update](https://github.com/a1113622001/dsh-auto-update) - Self-update for the harness launcher; checks npm for a newer @deepseek-ai/dsh, stages the tarball, and applies it on harness exit or via update-and-restart from the web panel.
- [a179-sanae/dsh-code-check](https://github.com/a179-sanae/dsh-code-check) - Automatic type-check diagnostics: after the model edits or creates TS files, runs `tsc --noEmit` in the background (debounced per project) and reports errors via the `code_check` tool — grouped by file with line/column, severity and TS error codes, closing the "edit → check → fix" loop.
- [aa2246740/dsh-creator-mode-plus](https://github.com/aa2246740/dsh-creator-mode-plus) - Creates, activates, checks and removes external DSH plugins from a conversation through fixed tools; requires the external DSHX devkit.
- [aa2246740/dsh-opendesigner](https://github.com/aa2246740/dsh-opendesigner) - Local visual React and Tailwind designer with project-scoped file tools; documented for DSH 0.1.5-rc.2.
- [AaronandWork/dsh-evidence-gate](https://github.com/AaronandWork/dsh-evidence-gate) - Evidence-first conclusion gate that cross-checks first-hand claims against a durable per-session tool-activity index, blocks unverified guesses and tracks blocked-versus-converted metrics.
- [AgentDebugX/AgentDebugX#dsh-agentdebugx](https://github.com/AgentDebugX/AgentDebugX/tree/main/integrations/dsh-agentdebugx) - Diagnoses current and saved DeepSeek Harness trajectories with AgentDebugX and opens structured reports in its dashboard.
- [Airmetro/dsh-update-checker](https://github.com/Airmetro/dsh-update-checker) - Update management for DeepSeek Harness and its plugins: semver-aware dual-source (npm/GitHub) checks for the main program and every installed plugin, a locale-aware banner (zh/en) listing updatable items, one-click updates (the main program is backed up, integrity-checked and rolled back on failure; plugins install via a temp directory without touching other packages), and a watchdog-guarded restart after updating. The settings page adds per-plugin version lamps, live update progress, and banner/notification toggles.
- [ajia1206/dsh-restart](https://github.com/ajia1206/dsh-restart) - Restarts the running DSH process from a model tool or a bottom-right GUI control, with launchd KeepAlive detection, a detached-supervisor fallback that aborts the exit when its handshake fails, a macOS desktop restart path, and JSONL restart records correlated by arm id, pid and profile so a restart stays distinguishable from unrelated log activity.
- [AKS1st/dsh-skill-manager](https://github.com/AKS1st/dsh-skill-manager) - Skill Manager page in the DSH settings panel: browse system / user / workspace / preset skills, expand a skill to its file tree, view and edit files, import skills from a zip, and export or delete them (system skills read-only).
- [All3nCN/dsh-qa-suite-N23](https://github.com/All3nCN/dsh-qa-suite-N23) - Quality suite: background tsc --noEmit diagnostics fed back after the agent edits TypeScript, plus a /code-review command running five parallel review lenses with confidence scoring; absorbs dsh-code-check and dsh-command-code-review.
- [AmethystLuna/dsh-model-everything](https://github.com/AmethystLuna/dsh-model-everything) - Turns what a design, plan or document claims into a model and decides it: UML diagrams rendered, read and reviewed; state machines, protocols and data models checked as models; migrations tested for coverage and rollback symmetry; concurrency claims mined and routed to the checker that can decide them; dependency graphs audited; reports diffed.
- [andyfan1094/dsh-codebase-memory](https://github.com/andyfan1094/dsh-codebase-memory) - Bridges the Codebase Memory MCP code knowledge graph into DSH and keeps indexed repositories fresh with a debounced filesystem watcher. Windows-only MCP bridge (the watcher half is cross-platform); auto-installs its npm CLI via npx on first start.
- [andyfan1094/dsh-devforge](https://github.com/andyfan1094/dsh-devforge) - Spec-driven service forge and integrated operations workspace for DeepSeek Harness.
- [AngelosZou/dsh-python-env](https://github.com/AngelosZou/dsh-python-env) - Wraps Python virtual environment management commands: reduces the network and permission problems agents hit when managing environments through terminal commands, works across operating systems, and routes installs automatically through mirrors and local proxies. The tools are strictly confined by the granted read/write permissions.
- [AngelosZou/graphlint#integrations/dsh](https://github.com/AngelosZou/graphlint/tree/main/integrations/dsh) - Dead-code detection for AI-generated codebases: graphlint builds a dependency graph, finds code unreachable from any entry point to enable codebase cleanup and functional‑effectiveness understanding, and exposes graphlint_query / graphlint_build / graphlint_config tools plus a graphlint skill to DSH agents.
- [Ankali-Aylina/code-rag#dsh-code-rag-index-panel](https://github.com/Ankali-Aylina/code-rag/tree/main/plugins/dsh-code-rag-index-panel) - Code RAG semantic index panel and settings card: live index bar with start/rebuild/cancel, plus one-click detection and configuration.
- [anweat/dsh-restart](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-restart) - Restart DSH: configurable restart method (Node native / legacy PowerShell), post-restart continue prompt, optional watchdog auto-relaunch.
- [anweat/dsh-substrate#plugin](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-substrate/tree/master/plugin) - Diagnose duplicate DSH loader entry IDs before startup, report version-locked repair status in a read-only settings card, and apply or revert audited loader repairs through an external CLI.
- [aokamoaki/dsh-startup-guard](https://github.com/aokamoaki/dsh-startup-guard) - Boot-time guard that repairs corrupt session logs, preflights plugin composition, vm-checks client artifacts, smoke-tests host apply() and quarantines crash-causing bundles, so a broken plugin can never brick startup.
- [AphyTOT/dsh-plugin-preflight](https://github.com/AphyTOT/dsh-plugin-preflight) - Preflight checks for a DeepSeek Harness plugin before submitting it to the community list: verifies the dsh.bundle manifest, cordis.patch.yml wiring, client bundle shape, and peer ranges that silently exclude prerelease harness builds. CLI plus one read-only agent tool.
- [Areium/dsh-fail-logger](https://github.com/Areium/dsh-fail-logger) - Auto-log failed tool calls across native tools, PTC run_code, and inline invocations: dedup and count root causes into a skill so repeated mistakes fade.
- [Arlenman/dsh-backup-sync](https://github.com/Arlenman/dsh-backup-sync) - Backup, restore and machine-migration for DSH: packs skills (which live outside ~/.dsh, in ~/.agents/skills), plugin manifests, core config, memories, todos and optionally sessions into a tar.gz with a sha256 sidecar, then imports it on another machine as a three-way merge against a baseline, listing per-file differences instead of overwriting changes made there. Credentials never enter an archive (filename deny-list of 27 names plus 7 private-key suffixes plus a content gate, enforced again on the import side), every import writes a pre-restore snapshot first, and an archive can be uploaded to any WebDAV server and pulled back on the new machine. Also includes scheduled backups, a read-only viewer for individual files, and an in-panel cloud card; no npm runtime dependencies (packing uses the system tar).
- [asdf17128/dsh-doctor](https://github.com/asdf17128/dsh-doctor) - Registers a `config_doctor` tool that checks the harness's own configuration for problems that boot silently: fields a patch dropped by whole-config replacement, patches targeting missing entry ids, and tool-name collisions. Read-only.
- [asdf17128/dshp](https://github.com/asdf17128/dshp) - Registers `list_profiles` and `export_profile`, so the agent can show what setups exist and hand back a whole profile — bundle order, plugin versions and patch — as one portable file to share. Read-only.
- [ayahunter/dsh-plugin-clinic](https://github.com/ayahunter/dsh-plugin-clinic) - Read-only health clinic for the installed DSH plugin set: loader health, dependency integrity, version compatibility, install-script risk, duplicates and patch integrity, delivered as a model tool, a Settings dashboard and JSON reports.
- [b1inkie/dsh-rtk-bridge](https://github.com/b1inkie/dsh-rtk-bridge) - Rewrites pwsh and bash tool commands through `rtk rewrite` and executes the compact equivalent; falls back to the original command when rtk is missing or has no equivalent, and ships a checksum-verified `/rtk install` downloader.
- [badai147/dsh-global-rules](https://github.com/badai147/dsh-global-rules) - Edit the global ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md rules from the web settings panel, live on save.
- [bainianlaoyao/bash-on-windows](https://github.com/bainianlaoyao/bash-on-windows) - On Windows, the available bash tool is limited to Git Bash and PowerShell is disabled.
- [baisama-cloud/dsh-conflict-guardian](https://github.com/baisama-cloud/dsh-conflict-guardian) - Scans the DSH loader tree at startup for plugin conflicts (duplicate mounts, failed or pending plugins, duplicate config row ids), auto-stops or restores the affected plugins, and shows a conflict report popup in the web UI.
- [baosfeng/my-dsh-plugins#dsh-file-activity](https://github.com/baosfeng/my-dsh-plugins/tree/main/plugins/dsh-file-activity) - DSH sidebar file-activity tab: records file reads/creates/modifies by the agent and the sidebar (including file ops hidden inside bash commands), per-session isolation, survives restarts, click a file for a floating preview (npm: `dsh-file-activity`).
- [baosfeng/my-dsh-plugins#dsh-my-guardian](https://github.com/baosfeng/my-dsh-plugins/tree/main/plugins/dsh-my-guardian) - Plugin governance: new/updated plugins stage in a candidate area first, then hot-mount after startup — success promotes, failure auto-disables, repeated failures freeze, one-click safe mode, sidebar diagnostics panel (npm: `dsh-my-guardian`).
- [baosfeng/my-dsh-plugins#dsh-my-observability](https://github.com/baosfeng/my-dsh-plugins/tree/main/plugins/dsh-my-observability) - Observability and git tooling: a persistent cross-session event audit log with a query API, a resource watchdog sidebar panel, structured Conventional Commits and pre-commit incremental diff review (npm: `dsh-my-observability`).
- [Bcy2020/dsh-cc-ecosystem](https://github.com/Bcy2020/dsh-cc-ecosystem) - Load Claude Code assets into DSH at runtime — skills, slash commands, rules, permission rules (deny/ask/allow), subagents and hooks from .claude/, plus Claude Code plugins (plugin.json / marketplace / skills / agents / MCP), via an in-memory IR that keeps .claude as the source of truth and writes back only when you opt in. Also surfaces Claude Code auto-memory in the system prompt, read-only by default, with a write-back switch in the /cc-memory panel. Eight packages: one bundle that installs the whole set, plus the loader and six adapters (skills, permissions, agents, hooks, mcp, memory).
- [better-er/dsh-write-create-only](https://github.com/better-er/dsh-write-create-only) - Host-side guard that lets the write tool only create new files: when the target already exists it denies the call before execution and tells the model to use edit instead, applied to all sessions.
- [better-er/dsh-write-rule-guard](https://github.com/better-er/dsh-write-rule-guard) - Blocks edit/write writes that contain characters matching configurable regex rules, executed before the tool runs, with configurable messages and same-turn pwsh propagation; default rule matches full-width parentheses.
- [BiBoyang/dsh-eval-harness](https://github.com/BiBoyang/dsh-eval-harness) - Evaluation harness for DSH plugins: YAML cases drive real headless agent runs, assert on tool calls, args, results and token usage, with a baseline gate for CI regression.
- [biedongbin/dsh-claude-compat](https://github.com/biedongbin/dsh-claude-compat) - Bridge Claude Code's .claude/ directories into DSH with zero migration: project and user-level skills, commands, rules (one system-reminder envelope), agent files, hooks (PreToolUse/PostToolUse/UserPromptSubmit/ SessionStart/SessionEnd) and .mcp.json servers, plus Claude Code plugin marketplaces. Ships /cc-plugin for full plugin/marketplace management (claude CLI first, self-implemented fallback), /cc-resume to list and import Claude Code sessions into DSH as native event-sourced logs, and /cc-export to write DSH skills back as Claude Code skills. Two-way Claude Code <-> DSH bridge, versioned and released as dsh-claude-compat.
- [BigBlueBaby/codex2dsh](https://github.com/BigBlueBaby/codex2dsh) - Migrate Codex (OpenAI Codex CLI / Desktop) MCP servers, skills, instructions, memory and session history into DeepSeek Harness with a visual panel or CLI, with dry-run previews and secrets migrated as-is.
- [BotonJ/dsh-windtunnel](https://github.com/BotonJ/dsh-windtunnel) - Contract regression harness for plugin authors: a scripted LLM adapter drives the real pipeline in isolated child processes with session-event assertions (load/contract/behavior/fault layers); zero API key, CI-ready.
- [br1nosense/dsh-project-manager](https://github.com/br1nosense/dsh-project-manager) - Manage development projects from the DSH web UI in a draggable floating window: add/remove, one-click start/stop/restart, hot-reload restart on file changes, and real-time persistent logs.
- [BrambleXu/dsh-prompt-profile](https://github.com/BrambleXu/dsh-prompt-profile) - Reusable Markdown prompt profiles for DeepSeek Harness with per-turn model selection, argument substitution, and state restoration.
- [bujue600-arch/dsh-testgen](https://github.com/bujue600-arch/dsh-testgen) - Automated unit-test generation: a /testgen command and generate_tests tool that scaffold, run, and fix tests until they pass (LLM + offline template generators; vitest/jest/mocha/node:test).
- [bushizhanghan/dsh-compaction-audit](https://github.com/bushizhanghan/dsh-compaction-audit) - Audit what context compaction actually lost. Reads the raw session event log and checks session-constraint survival (the standing instructions the user gave — do-not-X, must-Y, only-in-Z — and whether the summary still carries them; arXiv 2608.11242 measured ~17% survival across compactors), summary hallucination (paths, versions, ports and identifiers the summary invents that were never in the history it replaced), ghost references ("see above" pointing at removed text), token accounting (a summary nearly as large as what it claims to free), and unaccounted prunes. Four agent tools including a cross-session sweep that ranks conversations by how much compaction hurt them. Deterministic — no LLM, so a wrong answer is a rule bug with a name.
- [bushizhanghan/dsh-context-budget](https://github.com/bushizhanghan/dsh-context-budget) - Audit how each turn's context budget is spent. Breaks down what a turn pays for AGENTS.md, the skill catalog, tool schemas and runtime context; flags repeated injection of unchanged content as pure waste; ranks skill-catalog bloat (with 60+ skills installed, how many tokens of descriptions does the model read every turn) and tool-schema inflation per plugin. Deterministic — no LLM, so a wrong answer is a rule bug with a name. Four tools including a cross-session sweep.
- [bushizhanghan/dsh-openfoam-doctor](https://github.com/bushizhanghan/dsh-openfoam-doctor) - OpenFOAM case doctor for DeepSeek-Harness. Six agent tools: audit a case for 25 classes of silent failure (steadyState paired with timeStep writes, limiters set to 1 that let k/epsilon go negative, unbounded advection of transport scalars, nNonOrthogonalCorrectors 0 on a skewed mesh, loose solver tolerances, blockMesh vertex/block mismatch, stray time directories, purgeWrite 0); read any dictionary as JSON; survey a sweep of cases; run checkMesh/blockMesh/snappyHexMesh/foamRun inside WSL with log parsing; parse logs into the metrics that matter (aspect ratio, non-orthogonality, skewness, residual floor, fatal errors). Deterministic text analysis — no LLM — validated against a real 82k-cell street-canyon snappy case.
- [bushizhanghan/dsh-profile-doctor](https://github.com/bushizhanghan/dsh-profile-doctor) - Read-only DSH profile doctor: the seven config-tree checks (config-clobber, dead-patch, tool-collision, plugin-not-mounted, plugin-stale, entry diff, explain) plus eight ecosystem checks learned from real failures — pnpm store version conflicts that break `dsh plugin add`, patch insert names node_modules cannot resolve, broken junctions, duplicate-capability plugins, orphan backup dirs, GitHub-source deps, npm publish-scope hints, and the minimumReleaseAgeExclude gap. Four agent tools; every finding carries its fix.
- [bushizhanghan/dsh-publish-gate](https://github.com/bushizhanghan/dsh-publish-gate) - For DSH plugin AUTHORS: run this after you finish writing a plugin and it audits the entire publish path, then hands you the exact GitHub + npm + market commands. Pre-publish gate for DSH plugins. Turns every silent failure in the publish path into a deterministic check: package.json completeness (missing exports\["."], files omitting lib/ so the tarball is empty, no "type": "module", client declared without a ./client export), UTF-8 BOM, JSON/YAML parse errors, cordis.patch.yml insert rows written at the wrong indent (the bug that makes a plugin install and never mount), insert name mismatches, missing entry exports, require() inside ESM, missing LICENSE or README install line, missing tests, unscoped npm names that return a 403 no granular token can diagnose, versions already on the registry, and missing GitHub repos. Six agent tools; every finding carries its fix. Read-only, no LLM.
- [CAI-MH/dsh-plugin-forge](https://github.com/CAI-MH/dsh-plugin-forge) - Scaffold DSH local bundles in the dph format from any workspace and keep a pitfall experience library to steer later development.
- [caizhihaoczh/dsh-profile-multica](https://github.com/caizhihaoczh/dsh-profile-multica) - Bridges Multica to DeepSeek Harness through a versioned JSONL process protocol.
- [Cavan-Ou/dsh-observation-journal](https://github.com/Cavan-Ou/dsh-observation-journal) - Zero-touch runtime telemetry for DSH: every session auto-writes task, model tier, tools, failures, duration, status into a human-readable journal with a stats section (pure observer — no tools, no LLM calls, no injection).
- [ccneedb/dsh-information-environment-governance](https://github.com/ccneedb/dsh-information-environment-governance) - Governs the persistent information and project constraints an agent works with - project orientation and scope, information and document lifecycle, and persistent workspace mutation - through one additive system-prompt section plus deterministic runtime checks.
- [cdxiaodong/dsh-llm-inspector](https://github.com/cdxiaodong/dsh-llm-inspector) - Unified LLM request/response inspector: reasoning-effort tuning, external-think export, traffic & bundle analysis.
- [CH4ACKO3/dsh-render-engine#code-render](https://github.com/CH4ACKO3/dsh-render-engine/tree/main/packages/code-render) - Escaped, theme-aware HTML code-block rendering service for DSH Web plugins, built on structured syntax-highlight tokens with source line-ending preservation.
- [CH4ACKO3/the-binding-of-dsh](https://github.com/CH4ACKO3/the-binding-of-dsh) - Bidirectional RPC between DSH Host and Client through the native Connection and Typert Gateway, with targeted peer calls, cancellation, and connection lifecycle handling.
- [chai-yinfeng/dsh-macos-restart](https://github.com/chai-yinfeng/dsh-macos-restart) - macOS Desktop only: one-click restart of the DeepSeek Harness Electron app. Confirms before interrupting running turns, blocks during plugin install/update, and records restart phases/logs.
- [chenkai2/dsh-daemon](https://github.com/chenkai2/dsh-daemon) - Registers the DeepSeek Harness web server (dsh web) as an auto-start, self-healing background service — LaunchAgent / systemd / cron plus a 30s health-check watchdog — with seven dsh_daemon_* tools (install/uninstall/reinstall/status/start/stop/update).
- [chenkui-luo/dsh-plugin-restart](https://github.com/chenkui-luo/dsh-plugin-restart) - Adds a Restart card to the harness settings: one click hands the restart to the DeepSeek Harness launcher (`Launch-DeepSeekHarness.ps1`), which replaces the running web process, and the page reconnects itself once the new instance answers. Windows only; without that launcher the button reports an error instead of restarting.
- [chouyong/dsh-effect-doctor](https://github.com/chouyong/dsh-effect-doctor) - Verifies that Cordis-managed runtime resources return to baseline after isolated plugin teardown, with deterministic cleanup receipts.
- [chunfenxiazhi-collab/dsh-stability-audit](https://github.com/chunfenxiazhi-collab/dsh-stability-audit) - Stability audit for installed dsh plugins: static risk grading (hook surface, startup work, inject, entry, dep ranges) plus optional isolated install verification.
- [cilis/dsh-tauri-launcher](https://github.com/cilis/dsh-tauri-launcher) - Tauri 2 desktop application for Windows that detects (or installs) the global @deepseek-ai/dsh package, launches the DSH Web server and embeds it in its own window, with system tray management, login autostart, a global hotkey and desktop shortcuts.
- [CK-Rebi/dsh-preset-reload](https://github.com/CK-Rebi/dsh-preset-reload) - Rebind running sessions onto a rebuilt agent-preset revision, so preset changes apply without restarting dsh.
- [ckk-09/dsh-refix#dsh-refix](https://github.com/ckk-09/dsh-refix/tree/main/packages/dsh-refix) - Self-diagnosing, self-repairing watchdog for DSH plugins: 15s health patrol, version-switch repair with observe window and auto rollback, unknown symptoms escalated to human.
- [comer2031/dsh-desktop-auto-restart](https://github.com/comer2031/dsh-desktop-auto-restart) - Restarts the DSH desktop app on Windows and wakes the sessions listed for it afterwards. The agent-facing restart tool is off by default and refuses while the host is busy.
- [cq-guojia/rulemux#dsh-plugin](https://github.com/cq-guojia/rulemux/tree/master/dsh-plugin) - DeepSeek Harness plugin for rulemux: asks the local rulemux CLI for the rules rendered for this workspace (rulemux inject --agent dsh) and injects the output into the session at the first user turn, once per session. Nothing is written into the workspace for rules; skills are the only part that lands on disk.
- [cyrusgogogo/dsh-codeeek](https://github.com/cyrusgogogo/dsh-codeeek) - Read-only code-reading workspace with multi-repository projects, source-linked notes, code maps and Mermaid diagrams.
- [CZ-ZL/duo#dsh-plugin](https://github.com/CZ-ZL/duo/tree/main/dsh-plugin) - DSH plugin for bounded agent evaluation: compare an original with candidate prompt or supported configuration changes against user-supplied checks, record evidence and costs, and leave adoption to the user.
- [daimingxing/dsh-reload](https://github.com/daimingxing/dsh-reload) - Hot reload and one-click restart for DSH plugin development. Reload uses DSH's built-in reload instead of a private reimplementation, so it behaves the way the host expects: only changed plugins refresh, the rest keep running. Restart is the safe one - it runs outside the client, so it still brings the client back when the client is what changed; it refuses while a session or job runs; it confirms the client reopened. Lightweight: one tool, no arguments, nothing added to the model's context, buttons off by default.
- [DaJiang07/dsh-plugin-backup](https://github.com/DaJiang07/dsh-plugin-backup) - Moves a DSH profile to another machine with its plugins, not only its files: packs the plugin bundle selection and the whole settings layer into one JSON file, then on restore writes the configuration back, restores local plugin sources and plugin-owned data, and installs the plugin bundles the backup recorded that the new machine is missing (plugin manager first, pnpm as a fallback).
- [DamonKoy/dsh-plugin-toggle](https://github.com/DamonKoy/dsh-plugin-toggle) - Settings -> Plugins switchboard: every loaded plugin card shows its package description and runtime phase, with fuzzy search and start/stop toggles that never rewrite config files.
- [DamonKoy/dsh-plugins#dsh-system-proxy](https://github.com/DamonKoy/dsh-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-system-proxy) - System proxy detection (scutil/env/PAC) with a status tool and a proxy_export bash snippet tool.
- [Dclef/dsh-cursor-dev](https://github.com/Dclef/dsh-cursor-dev) - Runs the local Cursor CLI as a child coding agent from DSH - a `cursor_code` tool plus the native one-shot `cursor_subagent` tool, one mirrored DSH sub-session per run, per-task model choice, resumable conversations, a step timeline with real file diffs, and a usage, model and session panel.
- [DeLightor/dsh-depguard](https://github.com/DeLightor/dsh-depguard) - Dependency-topology guard: pre-install conflict prediction and post-install detection of duplicate @deepseek-ai/dsh-* copies, version drift, and vendored core services that cause Symbol-key crashes like "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')".
- [dennisrongo/dsh-plugins#dsh-headless-plus](https://github.com/dennisrongo/dsh-plugins/tree/main/plugins/dsh-headless-plus) - Replaces the headless startup to add --model provider/model, --resume <id|latest>, --continue and --session-info flags to dsh headless runs.
- [disyli/dsh-tool-call-stats](https://github.com/disyli/dsh-tool-call-stats) - Per-process tool-call statistics: a `tool_stats` tool reporting per-tool call counts, error counts, and average durations.
- [dphmoblie/dsh-error-tell#client-tell](https://github.com/dphmoblie/dsh-error-tell/tree/main/packages/client-tell) - Boot-time watchdog for DSH web: detects broken plugins, disables them persistently so the UI opens, with quarantine audit, automatic probe recovery, and one-click restore.
- [drliuhuan/dsh-plugin-pwsh7](https://github.com/drliuhuan/dsh-plugin-pwsh7) - Replaces the Windows pwsh executor row so the model-facing pwsh tool runs PowerShell 7, with a shell_router tool for status, diagnosis, and per-user portable installation.
- [drscrewdriver/dsh-mcp-registry](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-mcp-registry) - A governed registry for MCP connectors (stdio and streamable-http): four-level fail-closed authorization, mcpServers JSON import that rejects malformed args, credential redaction at every output boundary, an agent bridge that returns an honest review verdict instead of a fake approval, and a /mcp-reg operator console plus a settings page.
- [drscrewdriver/dsh-preset-doctor](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-preset-doctor) - Preset doctor for agent presets: scans home/profile `cordis.patch.yml` declarations and legacy `.agent-presets/` dirs across host lines 0.1.0→0.2.0, shows every detected preset as an official-style card (source/era badges, broken red border, per-finding details, current DSH version + era catalog), and syncs a preset to the current syntax per-card behind an explicit confirm dialog (.bak backup + atomic write; report-level findings are never written — startup scans are report-only). npm: `dsh-preset-doctor`.
- [dsh-plugin-lab/dsh-plugin-debugging](https://github.com/dsh-plugin-lab/dsh-plugin-debugging) - Runtime diagnostics for DSH plugins: live, restart, or hot reload.
- [duyanta123/dsh-change-impact](https://github.com/duyanta123/dsh-change-impact) - Change impact analysis plugin that lifts a code change into an evidence-backed impact and verification plan (CHANGE-IMPACT.md + change-impact.json): affected modules, entry points and public exports, risk levels with factors and confidence, and recommended verification commands (read-only, never runs repository commands). Only read-only git queries (rev-parse, diff, status) are run; suggested verification commands are never executed.
- [duyanta123/dsh-refactor-insight](https://github.com/duyanta123/dsh-refactor-insight) - Turn codebase smells into an executable, priority-ordered refactoring plan: file-length / deep-nesting / function-length / god-object heuristics plus a staged runbook (read-only, no auto-rewrite).
- [duyanta123/dsh-repo-scanner](https://github.com/duyanta123/dsh-repo-scanner) - Read-only repository fact scanner kernel for DSH analysis plugins: deterministic probe / file index / modules / dependencies / entry points / symbols / graphs and git facts over a stable JSON schema (CLI + library + skill runbook).
- [duyanta123/dsh-test-insight](https://github.com/duyanta123/dsh-test-insight) - Test-insight plugin that turns repository facts and change risk into evidence-backed test plans and isolated, reviewable test drafts.
- [dxsdyhm/dsh-adb-logcat](https://github.com/dxsdyhm/dsh-adb-logcat) - Android Studio-style ADB logcat viewer with live filtering and level colors.
- [EasonMWS/dsh-plugin-health](https://github.com/EasonMWS/dsh-plugin-health) - Multi-host compatibility matrix, official format-1 market index builder, and a read-only plugin_health tool for DeepSeek Harness plugins.
- [edusrez/dsh-smart-restart](https://github.com/edusrez/dsh-smart-restart) - Wakes the main agent after any DSH restart so interrupted work resumes automatically — adds a restart tool and an optional canary that validates the boot and aborts with an alert before a broken restart.
- [EIGHTfs/dsh-useful-tools](https://github.com/EIGHTfs/dsh-useful-tools) - Plugin development toolset: mark files read by shell commands, sync code into a profile, mock a plugin backend, preview a plugin frontend, verify plugin loading, spin up an isolated test instance, run named shell shortcuts, and list the plugin's tools.
- [elegant01/agent-acta](https://github.com/elegant01/agent-acta) - Local AI-agent request-log panel: aggregates local logs from atomcode, codebuddy, workbuddy, claude, codex, codearts, gemini, cursor, kimi and dsh, and shows per-round latency, tokens, cache, context and tool calls.
- [elegant01/dsh-memory-watchdog](https://github.com/elegant01/dsh-memory-watchdog) - Windows commit-charge watchdog for DSH Desktop: samples committed memory every 5 seconds, attributes it to the DSH process tree and the largest consumers, blocks automatic restart when DSH is not the main committer, and adds read-only pagefile advice, a 7-day crash timeline and an event export; automatic restart and crash resume are both off by default.
- [elk-9527/dsh-vscode#dsh-door](https://github.com/elk-9527/dsh-vscode/tree/main/packages/dsh-door) - Loopback-only ACP door for DeepSeek Harness: connect VS Code and other local clients to a running kernel over the local loopback address, sharing its models, tools, memory and sessions. Browse history, change permission modes and call capabilities registered by DSH plugins.
- [Elohia/dsh-genome](https://github.com/Elohia/dsh-genome) - Capability transform & assembly engine (Qian Xuesen cybernetics/systems framework): static resident layer manages the skill/MCP/plugin registries, auto-absorbs skills and tool metrics, and drives a negative-feedback evolution loop (scan Sick/Weak → mutate → select promote/reject → 30s rollback); includes a Web UI panel and a GitHub dsh-plugin store bridge.

On trip it injects a continue instruction that requires the next action to be a tool call, and ships 11 regression cases plus per-gate tuning.
- [Evhye38496/dsh-perfscope](https://github.com/Evhye38496/dsh-perfscope) - One-click health check for DeepSeek Harness: 0-100 score, plain-language issue list, and safe reversible fixes via the profile's cordis.patch.yml.
- [EvilIrving/dsh-repro](https://github.com/EvilIrving/dsh-repro) - /repro exports a minimal, secret-scrubbed, replayable problem bundle: the session log, failed commands, and Git diff.
- [EvilJoker/dsh-experimental-computer-use-linux-nde-mcp](https://github.com/EvilJoker/dsh-experimental-computer-use-linux-nde-mcp) - DSH Cordis computer-use provider for the ZTE Nde desktop. npm install auto-fetches the musl binary built by computer-use-linux-zte-nde (v0.7.7-nde.3) into the package's own bin/ via postinstall; resolveCommand() resolves the cordis command path against import.meta.url so the mount works regardless of dsh web's cwd. - [fakechris/dsh-harness-ops#dsh-restart-recover](https://github.com/fakechris/dsh-harness-ops/tree/main/plugins/dsh-restart-recover) - Restart recovery for DeepSeek Harness web: after a crash or restart, an interrupted agent turn continues automatically (host-side agent/created listener, no browser timing races).
- [fancr-code/dsh-tray-launcher](https://github.com/fancr-code/dsh-tray-launcher) - Windows system-tray launcher for dsh web: console-free background start (VBS/powershell chain), a tray menu with open UI / logs / icon presets / launch-at-login / restart Harness, one-click install and update of the bundled dsh-plugin-usage-meter, and a dsh plugin half that starts the tray together with the harness.

- [fu827707013/dsh-concurrency-guard](https://github.com/fu827707013/dsh-concurrency-guard) - Concurrency guard and monitor for DeepSeek Harness: FIFO queue when concurrent model requests reach the limit, per-day persisted stats with error-kind classification, and interruption detection for abandoned streams.
- [fu827707013/dsh-model-health-probe](https://github.com/fu827707013/dsh-model-health-probe) - Manual model probe for DeepSeek Harness: a session-view tab where you pick provider, API type, model and route, then send one real raw HTTP request over openai-completions, openai-responses or anthropic-messages — streaming or not — and read latency, TTFT, HTTP status, token usage and a three-layer diagnosis chain (API request / model response / strict check) on one screen, with errors in plain language.
- [FuriousKinght/dsh-fk-rollback](https://github.com/FuriousKinght/dsh-fk-rollback) - Config snapshot and rollback for DSH: auto-captures before risky changes, ships a standalone restore script that works even when DSH won't boot. Windows only; the restore script is a .bat and needs Node.js.

- [G57651/dsh-one-click-restart](https://github.com/G57651/dsh-one-click-restart) - One-click restart for DeepSeek Harness via a sidebar button, a model tool, and a detached watchdog.
- [GaoHu1997/dsh-webdav](https://github.com/GaoHu1997/dsh-webdav) - Keep a DSH profile identical across machines through any WebDAV server. The plugin collects the five parts that make up a setup — models (the llm-pi-ai line of cordis.patch.yml), defaults (the agent-default-model line), patch (the remaining loader lines), plugins (package.json dependencies plus dsh.profile.bundles) and dirs (extra absolute-path directories picked in the panel, carried whole and restored to the same path, add-only, at most 5 with 2000 files / 8 MiB each) — encrypts them on this machine with a passphrase (AES-256-GCM, PBKDF2-SHA256 at 600000 iterations) and uploads one ciphertext file to <address>/dsh-webdav/dsh-profile.prop, so the server only ever holds the sealed copy (the older dsh-profile.dshsync name is still read). Merging is per part and three-way against the last synced baseline; a conflict keeps the newer copy and archives the losing one under sync/ (latest 5 per tag), every overwrite is sealed beforehand, and deletions propagate except in the plugins part, on the first sync, and in the dirs part, where dropping a directory on one machine only stops syncing it there and never deletes its files. Uploads carry ETag If-Match and If-None-Match so a concurrent change is refused instead of being clobbered. Sync runs on demand or on a 3/15/30/60 minute timer from a settings panel, and an optional local forwarder (off by default, loopback-only) re-serves the same target with locally generated credentials, rewritten PROPFIND hrefs and .prop aliases for extensionless resources. The local state lives in <profileDir>/.dsh-webdav-sync/ (sync.json is written 0600 and holds the WebDAV password and the passphrase).
- [GeekRicardo/dsh-cordis-mcp](https://github.com/GeekRicardo/dsh-cordis-mcp) - Exposes the DSH dynamic-Cordis toolset to Claude Code over MCP (streamable HTTP on the existing web port, no new listener): ten tools to list, inspect, define, run, stop and permanently remove dynamic plugins in a live DSH session, with the same approval flow the GUI uses for packages that ship a client half. Bearer auth is mandatory — the token is configured on a DSH settings page, the endpoint answers 503 rather than serve without one, accepts loopback only and never emits CORS headers.

- [PerryLink/dsh-score](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-score) - Multi-dimensional quality scoring for DeepSeek Harness plugins that scores a repo or npm package across install success, maintenance activity, documentation completeness, security scan, and protocol compliance using real CLI evidence, and produces a JSON or Markdown leaderboard report.
- [PerryLink/dsh-test-drive](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-test-drive) - Runs isolated install-and-smoke test drives for DSH plugins in throwaway profiles, returning structured pass/fail records and batch matrices without touching your real profile.
- [pgmi-builds/better-dsh#better-dsh](https://github.com/pgmi-builds/better-dsh/tree/main/better-dsh) - Make your dsh ready for serious coding. (Tools x Schemas)^REPL. `skill://`, `ctx://`, `agent://`, `dvc://`, `dsh://`, IPython REPL, Context as Variables, cross compactions recallable, full context revive. `hash-edit`, `dvc://browser`, subagent as function, workflow as function.
- [Phocinae/dsh-context-verdict](https://github.com/Phocinae/dsh-context-verdict) - Session-level verdict on whether compaction would lose unlanded state; structurally refuses per-block screening.
- [pzc2004/dsh-frostfin](https://github.com/pzc2004/dsh-frostfin) - Use Kimi Code as the DSH agent loop over ACP, with approvals, slash commands, and local/remote (ssh+tmux) session attach.
- [q862877400-ux/dsh-fuhuobi](https://github.com/q862877400-ux/dsh-fuhuobi) - Backs up DSH profiles and mints a desktop "revival coin" that restores the harness after a failed boot or install: a boot guard runs a two-phase health check (HTTP 200 plus client render), marks good boots, isolates or rolls back bad ones, and keeps 3 rotating snapshots. - [songrui111/dsh-agent-bench](https://github.com/songrui111/dsh-agent-bench) - Runs a fixed set of agent benchmark cases in isolated sandboxes, scores each case with deterministic assertions, and diffs two runs to show which cases regressed after a model, prompt or DSH upgrade.

- [stayhpjinng/dsh-provider-proxy](https://github.com/stayhpjinng/dsh-provider-proxy) - Provider-scoped HTTP/HTTPS forward proxy for DeepSeek Harness: configure independent proxy URLs and enable/disable switches per LLM provider, with environment-variable references for proxy credentials and model discovery routing.

- [stuarthu/dsh-hot-reload](https://github.com/stuarthu/dsh-hot-reload) - Reloads an upgraded plugin inside the running dsh process instead of restarting it, and rolls back to the old version when a reload fails.
- [SuCriss/dsh-version-update](https://github.com/SuCriss/dsh-version-update) - Version management for dsh: inspect the installed version against every npm channel or version line, install or downgrade in one click, stream the install log live (rollback-snapshot copy progress, npm extraction progress, elapsed time), roll back instantly from local snapshots, and automate the cycle with a policy engine (silent auto-update, execution windows, daily checks). Never stops npm mid-install — a wedged run is only stopped after an hour, and a half-committed global tree is detected and repaired from the pre-install snapshot automatically. Confirms before installing a found update, auto-restarts the host after install, and falls back to a mirror when the primary registry is unreachable.
- [sumingwang233/dsh-code-review-graph](https://github.com/sumingwang233/dsh-code-review-graph) - Graph-based code context, impact analysis, review workflows, interactive graphs, and permission-controlled refactoring for DSH using the code-review-graph engine.
- [swaylq/dsh-genie](https://github.com/swaylq/dsh-genie) - Keeps what the agent builds at runtime: turns a `cordis_define` dynamic package into a real installed plugin that survives restart, writing the bundle and registering the profile layer with no pnpm, no network, and no build authorization.
- [swyaoguai/dsh-taptap-maker-dev](https://github.com/swyaoguai/dsh-taptap-maker-dev) - TapTap Maker game-dev workbench with 150+ bundled skills, custom image lane, ChatGPT web with account rotation, CC0 SFX, web BGM, and a forced no-Maker-credit-burn policy.
- [tancheng33/dsh-spill-s3](https://github.com/tancheng33/dsh-spill-s3) - S3-compatible backend for the spill seam: oversized tool output goes to object storage (S3, MinIO, R2) with hashed session prefixes and unguessable keys, instead of the agent's local disk.

- [taptap/instant-games-open-mcp#packages/dsh-maker](https://github.com/taptap/instant-games-open-mcp/tree/main/packages/dsh-maker) - TapTap Maker integration for DeepSeek Harness: bundled MCP tools, Maker workflow and feature skills, plus a packaged CLI path for project initialization and diagnostics.
- [taxueseek/dsh-healthcheck](https://github.com/taxueseek/dsh-healthcheck) - Read-only DSH environment health check: disk, memory, latency, ~/.dsh bloat and outdated-plugin detection with graded reports and baseline trend comparison. Deletes nothing.
- [tengyinan1994/dsh-project-runner](https://github.com/tengyinan1994/dsh-project-runner) - Grouped run panel for DeepSeek Harness: one click starts a project's services in a real PTY, streams live colored output, and keeps every run's log on disk where the agent can read it.
- [TGYD-helige/dsh-plugins#dsh-langfuse](https://github.com/TGYD-helige/dsh-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-langfuse) - Send dsh turn traces, LLM generations, tool spans, and subagent activity to Langfuse.
- [Tianbuyu-wwx/dsh-hermes-link#dsh-hermes-link](https://github.com/Tianbuyu-wwx/dsh-hermes-link/tree/main/packages/dsh-hermes-link) - Bidirectional Hermes ↔ DSH bridge: import Hermes sessions into DSH, consult Hermes, and receive Hermes-dispatched tasks as a single Cordis plugin.
- [tianyaZTY/dsh-hot-plugin-host](https://github.com/tianyaZTY/dsh-hot-plugin-host) - Runtime plugin loading for the Web UI: a watched hot directory installs/updates client-plugin bundles live on every open page, no restart. Includes a right-column subagent dashboard example.
- [tuogusa/dsh-skill-manager](https://github.com/tuogusa/dsh-skill-manager) - Browse, search, delete, undo-delete, and update user skills from the Web settings panel; checks GitHub/Gitee Releases for newer skill versions.
- [ven314/dsh-conflict-doctor](https://github.com/ven314/dsh-conflict-doctor) - Conflict diagnosis and repair for DeepSeek Harness plugins. Builds a capability graph of the running Loader profile and of the on-disk cordis.patch.yml layers, comparing imports, peer ranges and config against the host that is ACTUALLY running rather than the profile's possibly-stale copies, and reports the conflicts that fail silently: a fiber stuck PENDING on a service no plugin provides, a browser half injecting a client module nothing provides, a tool id two plugins both register, duplicate Loader entry ids, a row disabled by one layer and re-inserted by another, an import of a host subpath the running host does not export, and a cycle among inject declarations. Every finding carries its evidence, a confidence grade for who owns a name, and a repair with a risk grade — verify it with a dry-run difference table, or take the individual .patch.yml files that --fix-out writes (never auto-loaded, so picking wrong breaks nothing).
- [vibeinging/dsh-trace](https://github.com/vibeinging/dsh-trace) - Telemetry backend exporting turns, model steps, and tool calls to yiTrace.
- [viogus/dsh-rtk](https://github.com/viogus/dsh-rtk) - Routes eligible bash commands through rtk (Rust Token Killer) so tool output is compressed before it reaches the model, by asking the installed rtk to rewrite each command and adopting what it prints; when rtk is absent the executor behaves exactly like the stock one.
- [wangtie-010101/wangtie-os](https://github.com/wangtie-010101/wangtie-os) - Fullscreen business-app framework for DeepSeek Harness Web with a dark-sidebar workbench bundling a database connectivity tester and SQL query panel, a two-level knowledge base (bill and accounting) with local search and Word document ingestion, metadata environment comparison with alter-SQL generation, a data dictionary, agent log-search report demos, a system test-case runner, Evernote-style notes, developer utilities, and mini-games.
- [Wanyi424/dsh-performance](https://github.com/Wanyi424/dsh-performance) - Monitor CPU, memory, and UI responsiveness in DSH on Windows x64, inspect processes and sampled backend plugin resource usage, and copy diagnostic reports.
- [wbb316/dsh-profile-sync](https://github.com/wbb316/dsh-profile-sync) - Moves a plugin set between DSH profiles (web to desktop by default): diff, pre-checks, an offline script for CLI-owned profiles, and a post-restart verification. It installs nothing itself.
- [we39/dsh-pve](https://github.com/we39/dsh-pve) - Manage Proxmox VE through conversation: 116 read + 116 write tools covering VMs, containers, storage, nodes, clusters, backups and firewalls, with API-token or username/password (ticket) auth.
- [weibaohui/dsh-fde-tools](https://github.com/weibaohui/dsh-fde-tools) - FDE toolbox bundle: installing this one plugin pulls in a curated set of common dsh plugins (git server, WebDAV mount, knowledge base, scheduled tasks, auto-resume, UI tweaks, auto-retrospection, file manager, smart titles, task board, plugin market, context trimmer, IM bridge, sidebar enhancements), with a panel showing install status and one-click gap-filling.
- [weibaohui/dsh-sync](https://github.com/weibaohui/dsh-sync) - Multi-machine sync: keeps multiple dsh replicas consistent through one private GitCode repository — skills, sessions, settings and plugin manifests each with an independent switch; changes go through branch, PR and merge, remote-only additions are pulled back before every push so nothing is deleted, and an AI smart-align step semantically merges files both sides changed (plus one-click conflict resolution); private repos enforced, pull never overwrites local edits.
- [weijiafu14/pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh) - Pi Host ABI compatibility engine: after one install, unmodified Pi extensions from npm mount as native DSH plugins with `dsh plugin add <pi-package>`. Verified end to end on stock DSH with pi-mcp-adapter (full MCP manager: OAuth, resources, prompts, MCP Apps, elicitation, sampling), @tintinweb/pi-subagents, pi-code, pi-hermes-memory and pi-background-tasks; `pi2dsh inspect` reports a package's compatibility before installing.
- [william-jin-cmu/dsh-evolve](https://github.com/william-jin-cmu/dsh-evolve) - Self-evolution: the agent hot-mounts/removes persistent plugins on itself mid-session.
- [wiyi/dsh-web-service-manager](https://github.com/wiyi/dsh-web-service-manager) - Manage the DSH web service from a settings panel: status, version, restart, stop, and one-click updates.
- [wjvalue/dsh-mac-keep-awake](https://github.com/wjvalue/dsh-mac-keep-awake) - macOS only: holds a PreventUserIdleSystemSleep assertion (caffeinate -i -w <host pid>) while any DSH session runs, and releases it when the last one stops, so a long turn is not cut off by idle sleep. The display may still turn off. It keeps holding through the maintenance phase, where Agent.status reports idle and a long manual /compact runs, via the compaction/start and compaction/end events. It reconciles against ctx.agents.list() every 60s, so a session already running when the plugin is hot-reloaded is picked up at once instead of at the next turn boundary. A failed hold retries with exponential backoff capped at 60s and never gives up; release escalates from SIGTERM to SIGKILL after 2s, and -w lets caffeinate exit by itself if the host dies. No browser half — configured through the profile patch. 51 tests, including two that read pmset -g assertions on real hardware.
- [wjw99830/dsh-plugin-noema](https://github.com/wjw99830/dsh-plugin-noema) - Shows per-turn changes in cyclomatic complexity, cognitive complexity, and maximum nesting depth for TypeScript, Python, and Go in the Web UI, with expandable file and function summaries for code review.
- [WM-CODER/custom-first-control-prompt](https://github.com/WM-CODER/custom-first-control-prompt) - Inject deployment-configured system-prompt sections and reference exchanges into every conversation request via stream interception, with a web settings panel.
- [WODE25500/dsh-az](https://github.com/WODE25500/dsh-az) - Azure resource management: query and show resources, deploy Bicep/ARM templates, and check the activity log.
- [WODE25500/dsh-codex](https://github.com/WODE25500/dsh-codex) - OpenAI Codex CLI wrapper: one-shot exec, repo review and session resume with a default read-only sandbox.
- [WODE25500/dsh-k6](https://github.com/WODE25500/dsh-k6) - Load testing with Grafana k6: smoke-test first, then run scripts and read percentiles from the JSON summary.
- [WODE25500/dsh-kubectl](https://github.com/WODE25500/dsh-kubectl) - Kubernetes ops for the agent: get resources with structured JSON output, describe, logs, exec, apply/delete (user-confirmed) and port-forward.
- [WODE25500/dsh-maf](https://github.com/WODE25500/dsh-maf) - Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF) plugin for DeepSeek Harness: validate, run, and scaffold declarative agents and workflows (YAML).
- [WODE25500/dsh-terraform](https://github.com/WODE25500/dsh-terraform) - Infrastructure as code: gated plan/apply, state and output inspection, and configuration validation via the terraform CLI.
- [WODE25500/dsh-winget](https://github.com/WODE25500/dsh-winget) - Windows Package Manager: search, install, upgrade, uninstall, import/export and pin software through native tools.
- [WODE25500/dsh-wsl](https://github.com/WODE25500/dsh-wsl) - WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux) bridge for DeepSeek Harness: run Linux commands, manage distros, convert paths, and copy across the Windows/Linux boundary.
- [Wonderow666/dsh-auto-update](https://github.com/Wonderow666/dsh-auto-update) - Windows only; the upgrade path needs DSH_AUTO_UPDATE_LAUNCH_CMD configured. Checks, installs and rolls back DeepSeek Harness CLI updates from the web settings page, switching the launcher pointer only after the new version passes a config-tree check and a health-checked restart, and reverting automatically when it does not boot.
- [worksAssistant/dsh-quickref](https://github.com/worksAssistant/dsh-quickref) - Developer quick-reference toolbox for DSH: 12 themed categories (195 entries) plus zero-dependency tools — regex tester, JSON formatter, timestamp converter, Base64/URL codec, cron generator and line diff, in a searchable settings panel.
- [wpeng77/dsh-llm-trace](https://github.com/wpeng77/dsh-llm-trace) - Wire-level LLM inspector: captures the raw HTTP request and response bodies of model provider calls and attributes each capture to the session that caused it through the llm/stream waterfall. The request pane renders the body as a collapsible tree with per-node sizes — one measured request was 98.6% a single 973-entry array — and the response pane reassembles the OpenAI-style SSE chunk stream into reasoning, content, tool calls and usage. Shown in a Conversation View tab and a loopback viewer page.
- [wweir/dsh-advisor](https://github.com/wweir/dsh-advisor) - Automatic second-opinion review: a restricted child session re-reads the agent's recent work with read-only tools and delivers at most one evidence-backed note, or stays silent. Requires a model route in the config; the plugin stays disabled until one is set.
- [WwW7olFWwW/dsh-codebase-watcher](https://github.com/WwW7olFWwW/dsh-codebase-watcher) - Staleness keeper for the Codebase Memory knowledge graph: it compares the graph Branch node head_sha with git rev-parse HEAD and reports an exact behindBy, rebuilds only the stale projects through the codebase-memory-mcp CLI so the MCP tool 60-second cap does not apply, watches each project for edits, and mirrors the same state into a settings card and a REST control surface.
- [wyzh0117/dsh-port-manager](https://github.com/wyzh0117/dsh-port-manager) - Native DSH right-sidebar tab that lists the ports this machine is listening on together with the process behind each one, and offers per-port actions to open it, copy its address, reveal its working directory or end the process.
- [x2802490130-prog/dsh-guard](https://github.com/x2802490130-prog/dsh-guard) - A development safety kit: rolling config snapshots, automatic rollback on plugin failures, boot-failure rescue, and an in-settings management panel.
- [x2802490130-prog/dsh-shield](https://github.com/x2802490130-prog/dsh-shield) - A hands-off safety net: directories the agent deletes go to a trash folder first and symlinks are never followed, with zero approvals.
- [x3416067-bit/dsh-plugin-restart-prompt](https://github.com/x3416067-bit/dsh-plugin-restart-prompt) - Windows only. Prompts to restart DSH after a plugin install, update or uninstall, restarts it in one click without any console window, and shows a per-file diff of what changed.
- [xiaocxiaohai666/dsh-plugin-selfcheck](https://github.com/xiaocxiaohai666/dsh-plugin-selfcheck) - Prints every plugin in the DeepSeek Harness loader tree at boot, with the exception text for anything that failed, and checks dependency version drift, profile config validity, web port reachability and registered tools.
- [xiaolu511/dsh-hot-restart](https://github.com/xiaolu511/dsh-hot-restart) - One fixed button inside the DSH window that restarts DSH and reopens it automatically, with no console window; right-click it for a built-in self check that writes a single diagnostic report.
- [xiaoso456/dsh-run-config](https://github.com/xiaoso456/dsh-run-config) - IDE-style run configurations for DSH: save LLM prompts and shell commands as reusable run configs (global or per-workspace), run them from the session header or the new-session page, and manage them via the task_run_config tool with approval-gated writes.
- [xiaoyuyu6420/dsh-backup](https://github.com/xiaoyuyu6420/dsh-backup) - One-command backup, restore & migration for all DSH user data (~/.dsh) with a visual Settings panel: scheduled auto-backup with tiered retention, sha256 verification, hardened restore with auto-rollback and a result receipt, typed sub-backups (--types), credential redaction into a local vault, private-repo GitHub sync for moving to a new machine, and an out-of-process rescue console (zero-dependency rescue web UI in the backup dir) that works even when the host won't boot. /backup doctor checks and repairs corrupt session logs from a known-good backup and quarantines them before rotation; migrate-check statically predicts which sessions a host upgrade would break (frozen event-list rules, filename/generation mismatch, hardlink support, legacy credentials); the credential sentinel preserves pre-migration copies before the host rewrites them; smart backup snapshots before host upgrades; /backup check-update and /backup update report and install new releases (snapshotting first). Restore handles attachment hard links and arbitrarily large archives (streamed listing). Current npm version 0.13.4; spans DSH 0.1.1-rc.2 through 0.2.0-rc.1, including 0.2.0's install-time peer gate. macOS/Linux/Windows.
- [xiaxingtianxia2-glitch/dsh-auto-exit](https://github.com/xiaxingtianxia2-glitch/dsh-auto-exit) - Exits the dsh CLI process automatically when the Web UI closes, with a configurable grace period and dry-run mode.
- [xingyingyuzhui/dsh-updater-ui](https://github.com/xingyingyuzhui/dsh-updater-ui) - DSH self-updater in the settings page: one-click check/pull (`git pull --ff-only`), auto background checks, version diff and changelog preview with a red-dot reminder.
- [xingzhen199186/dsh-insight-tree](https://github.com/xingzhen199186/dsh-insight-tree) - Runtime observability and plugin operations panel for DeepSeek Harness: shows the profile plugin tree, real Loader fiber state, capabilities/dependencies/compatibility, current-session plugin activity and upstream source/version checks, with one-click enable/disable/update/uninstall plus a standalone startup-failure diagnostics page that works while DSH is not running.
- [xinspark/dsh-win-pwsh7](https://github.com/xinspark/dsh-win-pwsh7) - Reports which PowerShell the DSH pwsh executor actually runs (enabled rows only; version-numbered Store paths are never recommended as pins), and installs a Store-managed PowerShell 7 through a scripted Store-page click or the manual Store path. Allows the pwsh tool only when the live executor resolves PowerShell 7+, and when dsh-ops is installed keeps the native pwsh beside ops_bash by enabling Compatibility and hiding duplicate official tools. Native status card and configuration switch in the Web UI; Windows only, no runtime dependencies.
- [xswt442-cmd/dsh-ballast](https://github.com/xswt442-cmd/dsh-ballast) - Context-window attribution for DSH Web: a Mini Utility Dock panel that ranks the user messages, assistant turns, reasoning blocks and tool results of a session by the tokens each one occupies, so it is clear which entries hold the window. It also shows the share by entry type, the heaviest entries across the live sessions of the host, and, where the host provides them, provider usage and the estimated system/tools/messages composition. The panel is read-only: it does not estimate cost, modify a session, or trigger compaction.
- [xswt442-cmd/dsh-instance-manager](https://github.com/xswt442-cmd/dsh-instance-manager) - Instance manager for DSH Web: a Mini Utility Dock panel that lists every local dsh web instance the machine can see (port, PID, uptime, live session count, resident memory, version), starts a new instance on an automatically picked free port in 3080-3129 or on a port you name, opens a row in a new tab, and stops one or all of them through that instance’s own graceful shutdown (appExit). Rows also show what each instance is serving, and read-only instance logs and session summaries are one click away. Where a peer is configured, the same panel lists and queries instances on other machines over a bearer-authenticated link. Every route is loopback-guarded, and a browser-facing action must additionally pass the host’s own browser authentication.
- [xswt442-cmd/dsh-treekeeper](https://github.com/xswt442-cmd/dsh-treekeeper) - Windows process-tree reconciler for the DSH host: samples the host process tree and the job ledger, attributes each process to the job that created it, flags unattributed and orphaned processes with a confidence level, and offers guarded termination of a whole tree. Termination is refused unless the target belongs to the DSH host tree, is re-sampled and re-checked immediately before the kill (creation time included), and contains no protected descendant, so an allowlisted PID cannot widen the kill scope.
- [xxiaoxiong/dsh-prometheus](https://github.com/xxiaoxiong/dsh-prometheus) - Exposes bounded Prometheus metrics for DSH sessions, agents, LLM calls, tools, approvals, subagents, and jobs, with a Grafana dashboard and a loopback-only endpoint by default.
- [xyrrrrr-r/dsh-eval-control](https://github.com/xyrrrrr-r/dsh-eval-control) - Host-side DSH evaluation control plugin: injects one evaluation trial's variables, budget limits, session root and fork lineage into the agent process, routes its model calls through a host broker under a gateway lease, and writes a schema-versioned bundle descriptor for evidence attribution.
- [yanzhaohui1999/dsh-perf-hud](https://github.com/yanzhaohui1999/dsh-perf-hud) - Client-side performance HUD and always-on recorder for DeepSeek Harness: FPS and worst frame, long tasks with four-leg attribution (React fiber / subtree / DOM writes / scheduler), per-plugin callback rate and sync time, DOM growth and writers, JS heap, host event loop and link RTT, plus a night-watch recorder that keeps the worst stalls and exports incident packs for replay.
- [yishuiliufang/dsh-relaunch](https://github.com/yishuiliufang/dsh-relaunch) - Restart button for the Harness desktop app: one sidebar entry that closes every Harness process and starts the application again, launched without a console window and without a close-confirmation dialog. Windows only.
- [yizhixiaokong/dsh-compose-panel](https://github.com/yizhixiaokong/dsh-compose-panel) - Lists the Docker Compose projects of your DSH workspaces in the right sidebar, one group per project directory, with container status, project- and service-level up/stop/restart, and streamed per-service logs.
- [yizhixiaokong/dsh-simple-restart](https://github.com/yizhixiaokong/dsh-simple-restart) - Adds a restart row to Settings → General that relaunches dsh web with the same invocation through a detached helper, refuses under a detected systemd supervisor unless allowRestart is true, and tests whether the listening port is free by connecting to it rather than binding it.
- [yjh051108/dsh-routing-suite](https://github.com/yjh051108/dsh-routing-suite) - One repository, three parts: a runtime injector for DSH plugin packages (inject, hot-reload, unload, promote a dev staging tool to the front, route self-heal, plus a settings-page plugin manager that lists, unloads and drags folders in to internalize), a task-aware reasoning-mode router agent preset (router-standard / router-spec / router-react), and a graded two-level task protocol whose six tools (commit_star, lock_stage, revise_do, edit_plan, mark_task, redteam_verdict) pin task state to disk. The injector implementation ships in-tree, so the install carries its own behaviour rather than a dependency list.
- [yminghua/dsh-plugin-compare](https://github.com/yminghua/dsh-plugin-compare) - Compares existing DSH sessions or runs controlled A/B trials between agent presets, showing aligned timelines, paired metric deltas, explicit success checks, and exportable reports.
- [yongshuai0314/dsh-readcache](https://github.com/yongshuai0314/dsh-readcache) - Version-token-validated in-process result cache for the DSH read tool: repeated reads of unchanged files skip file I/O and line rendering, with a readcache tool for stats and clearing.
- [young-tim/dsh-profile-lab](https://github.com/young-tim/dsh-profile-lab) - Runs reproducible DSH profile and patch experiments with guided case authoring, assertions, Web comparison reports, recovery, and policy gates.
- [YTxue/dsh-skill-manager-ytxue](https://github.com/YTxue/dsh-skill-manager-ytxue) - Skill pool manager in the Settings sidebar: enable/disable, folder batch import with rename-conflict prompts, state-driven one-click DSH-spec check & auto-fix, system/project scope labels.
- [YZz-S/dsh-update-checker](https://github.com/YZz-S/dsh-update-checker) - Conversation header badge showing the DeepSeek Harness version, checking npm for the latest release and prompting upgrades.
- [zampie/request-frame-preview](https://github.com/zampie/request-frame-preview) - Session-header button that previews and downloads the exact request frame DeepSeek Harness sends to the model: the full system prompt, the declared tools array, and the wire message array (system/user/assistant/tool-result) rebuilt from the session log via the same folds the agent loop reads.
- [zebbkira/dsh-skills-mcp-manager](https://github.com/zebbkira/dsh-skills-mcp-manager) - Skills & MCP manager in the DSH web settings: browse/enable/import/delete skills across project and user roots, and manage stdio/streamable-http MCP servers with a real connection (tools registered as mcp__<server>__<tool>, config in ~/.dsh/mcp.json).
- [zehuan-huang/dsh-codex-runs](https://github.com/zehuan-huang/dsh-codex-runs) - Read-only panel listing recent Codex CLI runs parsed from the local ~/.codex/sessions rollout files, showing status, duration, token usage and the last assistant message, with no bridge or extra daemon.
- [zengxiaolou/dsh-device-mirror](https://github.com/zengxiaolou/dsh-device-mirror) - Mirror an iOS Simulator or Android emulator into DSH as floating overlay windows, several at once, and tap, drag or type on the mirrored screen with the input forwarded back to the device.
- [Zenjibad/dsh-plugin-toggle](https://github.com/Zenjibad/dsh-plugin-toggle) - Enables or disables DSH plugins from Settings → Plugins: each toggle stops or starts the plugin immediately without a restart and the change persists across restarts.
- [zeroed-07/dsh-memory-guard](https://github.com/zeroed-07/dsh-memory-guard) - Local-only memory guard for the DeepSeek Harness: host heap and session-log monitoring, oversized tool-argument interception, and dry-run by default session vacuum.
- [zhangj1164/dsh-mega-plugins#dsh-github-issue](https://github.com/zhangj1164/dsh-mega-plugins/tree/main/packages/github-issue/dsh-github-issue) - GitHub issue service for DSH: turns a telemetry failure analysis into a uniform issue report, builds a pre-filled new-issue URL that is shortened when it would exceed a configured length budget, and rewrites a plain description into a structured issue with the deployment's model.
- [zhangj1164/dsh-mega-plugins#dsh-telemetry](https://github.com/zhangj1164/dsh-mega-plugins/tree/main/packages/telemetry/dsh-telemetry) - Local-only telemetry service for DSH plugins: records operation trails and error events into a storage-domain KV table, applies a configurable redaction rule set before the write and again when the analysis reads back a record stored before a rule existed, and groups one plugin's failures by feature-code anchor, reporting the window it read, the route each group ran on, and the attempts recorded after its last failure in write order.
- [zhangzhenwen1/dsh-task-effort](https://github.com/zhangzhenwen1/dsh-task-effort) - Auto-adjust model reasoning effort per task (off/low/high/max): task classification, \[effort=...] markers, in-turn error escalation, DeepSeek peak-pricing-period capping with countdown notices, and manual-selection priority.
- [ZhaoZiyangShaanxi/dsh-server-monitor](https://github.com/ZhaoZiyangShaanxi/dsh-server-monitor) - In-app server monitor window for DSH that tunnels to a lightweight agent on your server: memory, swap, load, disk, per-container usage and QQ status, cache purge and container restarts, plus an embedded VNC desktop for manual QQ QR login and sign-out. The agent ships in the repository (server/monitor.py) and you deploy it yourself.
- [zhengjy01/dsh-start](https://github.com/zhengjy01/dsh-start) - One-click start/stop launcher for DSH Web on macOS — start (foreground/daemon), stop, status, duplicate-launch guard, auto browser open, plus a Dock-able DSH.app built by script.
- [zhengjy01/dsh-updater](https://github.com/zhengjy01/dsh-updater) - Track DeepSeek Harness's own releases and update in one click: reads the npm dist-tags and the GitHub changelog, shows every change between the running build and the target, grades the risk, then hands the install to a detached helper that backs the current install up with an atomic rename, runs npm, verifies what landed, relaunches, and rolls back when the new build does not come up.
- [zhengqiuyang/dsh-janitor](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-janitor) - Registers a janitor_scan tool that returns a deterministic, reviewable cleanup plan for session debris (plan docs, scratch scripts) with per-file verdicts and evidence; scan-only, never deletes.
- [Zhenyu98/dsh-context-doctor](https://github.com/Zhenyu98/dsh-context-doctor) - Context injection audit: token costs of instruction chains / skill catalogs / tool schemas, duplicate and conflict detection.
- [Zhr65/dsh-skill-auditor#npm](https://github.com/Zhr65/dsh-skill-auditor/tree/main/npm) - Audits the skills and plugins you already installed: routes a task description to the tool it needs, flags version drift against the npm registry and runtime faults from host logs, and reports which of a plugin's tools you never call. Registers 9 tools: can, find, status, recommend, check, scan, probe, run and suggest. Runs on Python 3.8+ with no third-party dependencies. Registered tool ids all carry the skill_audit_ prefix, for example skill_audit_can and skill_audit_find.
- [zhxnix/dsh-wx-preview](https://github.com/zhxnix/dsh-wx-preview) - Preview native WeChat Mini Programs in the DSH sidebar with a local runtime and WXML source locations.
- [zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper](https://github.com/zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper) - Android development toolchain inside DeepSeek Harness: 23 android_* tools that find the SDK, create and manage AVDs, start and stop emulators, scaffold a Kotlin/Compose project, build and run it with Gradle, then install, launch, screenshot, tail logcat and drive the UI. A settings page holds the SDK, emulator, API-level, build and output parameters.
- [zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper](https://github.com/zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper) - The official ZCode ios-simulator plugin ported to native DSH tools: the original 20 ios_* tools keep their names and arguments, plus ios_shutdown_simulator, covering Xcode project discovery and scaffolding, simulator boot and shutdown, build, install, launch and terminate, screenshots, log reading, an in-app settings page and optional idb UI automation. macOS only.
- [zirscard/dsh-macos-signfix](https://github.com/zirscard/dsh-macos-signfix) - Registers one `doc_ocr_sign_fix` tool for DeepSeek Harness: on macOS it diagnoses and repairs the condition where the bundled Python cannot load native extensions (onnxruntime, cv2, pypdfium2) because of the hardened runtime and library validation, by injecting the disable-library-validation entitlement and re-signing the interpreter, then verifying the imports. Operations are idempotent and the original binary is backed up first. It never touches the enclosing application bundle.
- [zjukop/dsh-time-machine](https://github.com/zjukop/dsh-time-machine) - Creates local, content-addressed workspace checkpoints with diff previews and two-phase restore confirmation.
- [ZK-Andy/dsh-continual-evolve](https://github.com/ZK-Andy/dsh-continual-evolve) - Continual self-evolution: versioned, auditable, rollback-safe harness state (prompts, memory, skills, subagent specs) refined from session trajectories, with review gates and hot-reloaded skills.
- [Zlyraz/dsh-ballute](https://github.com/Zlyraz/dsh-ballute) - Crash protection for installed plugins: crash cards with one-click disable, static pre-flight inspection, black-box crash telemetry, and a safe-mode rescue profile for a broken UI.
- [zoahdev/dsh-quality-score](https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-quality-score) - Plugin quality scorecard for DeepSeek Harness: 0-100 with grade, 6 components, fix suggestions per deduction, batch leaderboard - CLI plus an agent-callable quality_score tool.
- [zoahdev/dsh-unplug](https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-unplug) - Plug/unplug any DeepSeek Harness plugin cleanly — list every mounted layer (bundles + patch rows), remove with full cleanup, disable/enable without deleting, and audit for orphaned/dangling state. CLI + agent-callable unplug tool. Read-only by default; destructive operations require explicit confirmation.
- [zqh260619/dsh-dupguard](https://github.com/zqh260619/dsh-dupguard) - Stops a streaming model call when the same string repeats ten times in a row (threshold configurable), keeps the partial answer as a normal assistant message, and shows a stop notice with the workspace, session name and the repeated string. Repeat counts can vary by unit length through a piecewise table or a JavaScript module, and code regions (fenced, inline, indented) use a relaxed threshold.
- [zudazhuang/dsh-update-safe](https://github.com/zudazhuang/dsh-update-safe) - Source-install updater for DeepSeek Harness: checks the official GitHub release and the npm record, builds the target tag in an isolated directory, smoke-starts it, then switches through a supervisor process with rollback, with scheduled checks and a daily idle-only install window. Source install only (macOS/Linux); requires Node.js 22.19+, pnpm and Git.
- [zzy6-a/dsh-upgrade-guard](https://github.com/zzy6-a/dsh-upgrade-guard) - Audits installed plugin compatibility after a DeepSeek Harness upgrade, repairs or disables incompatible plugins, and keeps an out-of-host supervisor that rescues boot failures or rolls back to the previous host snapshot.

### Security & Permissions

- [030611/dsh-telemetry-redactor](https://github.com/030611/dsh-telemetry-redactor) - Redacts supported secret patterns from the `session-telemetry/record` export copy before configured telemetry backends receive it.
- [030611/dsh-verification-receipt](https://github.com/030611/dsh-verification-receipt) - Writes local JSONL summaries of per-turn tool counts and coarse verification signals without storing prompts, tool arguments, or result text.
