- [0QwQ0/dsh-ui-auth](https://github.com/0QwQ0/dsh-ui-auth) - Authentication gateway for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: the login gate covers pages, /api, /plugins and WebSocket upgrades; PBKDF2 password hashing with per-user salts, HttpOnly SameSite session cookies named per DSH_HOME and IP-based login lockout; invite-code registration; two-factor login with TOTP or passkeys (WebAuthn: several keys per account, phone enrolment by QR, username-less sign-in, and a step-up before any login factor is added or removed); a user-management settings panel (users edit their own profile and manage their own TOTP and passkeys, admins add or remove users, reset passwords, manage invites and clear the passkeys of a lost device); per-user model and API-key configuration whose private entries are encrypted with a key derived from the login password and stay unreadable by any admin, with admin sharing to selected users (usable, balance visible, key never shown, revocation immediate) and unconfigured users blocked rather than falling back to the deployment configuration; per-user isolation on the REST and list APIs and per-frame ownership filtering on the WebSocket mux; session persistence across restarts; a JSONL audit log; and a fail-closed gateway. Requires the DSH 0.2.0 line (the 0.1.1-rc.2 transport line was removed in 0.7.0); passkey login needs a localhost or HTTPS origin because browsers require a secure context.
- [173787247/dsh-repeat-stop](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-repeat-stop) - Hard-stop consecutive identical tool calls after a configurable streak so the agent cannot spin in place.
- [173787247/dsh-tool-budget](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-tool-budget) - Hard-stops further tool calls after a configurable per-session budget is reached.
- [7gzgn/dsh-leak-guard](https://github.com/7gzgn/dsh-leak-guard) - Pre-publish credential audit: walks a directory tree and flags API keys, tokens, private keys, database connection strings and hard-coded passwords before you commit, publish or ship. Zero dependencies, fully offline, findings are redacted to the first six characters.
- [7starsseeker/dsh-jev-guard](https://github.com/7starsseeker/dsh-jev-guard) - Pre-execution safety valve for DSH that judges with TypeSafe Jev: it hooks tools/pre-execute and decides every bash/pwsh call by first applying offline static rules, then by asking the Jev model — the System One model from TypeSafe, which returns a structured decision instead of prose — one yes-no question ("will this command irreversibly delete or overwrite real data?"), turning the answer into allow, revise, block or escalate; revise hands the model a safer rewrite, escalate offers a one-shot human token; exhausted credit or a missing API key degrades loudly instead of failing silent, and a missing key is requested in the conversation itself (`guard key set`, read from stdin); every verdict is appended to a shared audit log and the text people read is bilingual zh-CN/en.
- [863683348/dsh-gov](https://github.com/863683348/dsh-gov) - Agent governance suite: policy-based tool gating (allow/deny/ask with wildcards and priorities), a structured JSONL audit trail, and per-agent token quotas against the host token meter, with state under $DSH_HOME/gov.
- [863683348/dsh-plugin-gate](https://github.com/863683348/dsh-plugin-gate) - Installation safety gate for DSH plugins: antivirus-style scan of install scripts, permissions, secrets and network callbacks on local directories or npm tarballs, returning a BLOCK/WARN/PASS verdict before "dsh plugin add".
- [940842546/dsh-permissions](https://github.com/940842546/dsh-permissions) - Claude Code-style permission rules engine: hard/deny/ask/allow tiers with a hard tier above full access, workspace-scoped rules, wildcard path protection, and a visual staged editor; rules persist in settings.yaml.
- [a903067276-rgb/dsh-perm-guard](https://github.com/a903067276-rgb/dsh-perm-guard) - Auto-approval permission guard: a middle tier between workspace-write and danger-full-access — auto-allows safe operations inside trust directories, always asks a human for destructive ones, with 11 per-category switches and an audit trail.
- [aa2246740/dsh-auto-review](https://github.com/aa2246740/dsh-auto-review) - Adds Auto-review and Approve for me modes for DSH tool calls.
- [accpowered/dsh-auto-review](https://github.com/accpowered/dsh-auto-review) - LLM approval answerer for sandbox escalations beyond workspace-write: a deterministic regex filter first, then a clean-context reviewer model; humans are asked only when it is unsure. Requires the bundled core patches.
- [accpowered/dsh-credential-manager](https://github.com/accpowered/dsh-credential-manager) - Named user credentials the model uses by reference: values are entered on a Settings → Credentials page and injected into each shell execution as DSH_CM_* variables instead of being printed into the transcript, with credential_read as the documented last resort.
- [ADWMC/helm-d#helmd](https://github.com/ADWMC/helm-d/tree/main/packages/helmd) - Security-analysis plugin for DeepSeek Harness: 33 tools spanning six security domains, evidence/reporting and toolbox, plus the case lifecycle, routing and tool ledger; a session-bound case workflow with an evidence chain, E-id validation and reproducible findings; 362 on-demand references; three hot-swappable persona profiles; and a four-tab workbench (armor / case / intercept / about) with case-state recovery after context compaction.
- [AHIOSUZ/dsh-workspace-tools](https://github.com/AHIOSUZ/dsh-workspace-tools) - Applies per-workspace default Agent and permission presets to new root sessions automatically (Settings - Workspace defaults), using only official extension points.
- [AhYi8/dsh-agent-recycle-guard](https://github.com/AhYi8/dsh-agent-recycle-guard) - Rewrites agent-issued delete commands (PowerShell `Remove-Item` and its aliases, Bash `rm`/`unlink`/`rmdir`, CMD `del`/`erase`/`rd`/`rmdir`) into system recycle-bin operations on Windows, Linux and macOS, best-effort checks scripts for the same operations before they run, and keeps no permanent-delete fallback.
- [alaxrpg/dsh-llm-approve-for-me](https://github.com/alaxrpg/dsh-llm-approve-for-me) - Uses an isolated LLM review to approve or reject DSH sandbox permission requests.
- [almazom/dsh-almazom-approve-escalate](https://github.com/almazom/dsh-almazom-approve-escalate) - One-click Approve & escalate on the approval card: answers the pending request and switches the live session to a permission preset.
- [Alnita-M/dsh-Almost_Full_Access](https://github.com/Alnita-M/dsh-Almost_Full_Access) - Permission mode between workspace-write and full access: shell commands are checked by deterministic rules and a subagent review; irreversible or system-level actions require explicit approval.
- [amwangfan/dsh-privacy-guard](https://github.com/amwangfan/dsh-privacy-guard) - Control panel for a local credential-redaction gateway in DeepSeek Harness: gateway and model health, audit metrics, a dry-run leak tester, an exemption whitelist, encrypted key management, credential-protected model entries and deployment controls.
- [Anguis-L/dsh-plugin-trust-audit](https://github.com/Anguis-L/dsh-plugin-trust-audit) - Read-only audit of whether a DSH plugin's HTTP routes are actually fenced, discovering the registered routes by reading plugin code and probing loopback only.
- [AntaresCorn/dsh-auto-reviewer](https://github.com/AntaresCorn/dsh-auto-reviewer) - Codex-style auto-review permission mode: adds an auto-review preset that auto-approves safe sandbox escalations, asks on risky or ambiguous ones, and rejects critical unconfirmed operations.
- [apex-mochen/dsh-sandbox-arg-guard](https://github.com/apex-mochen/dsh-sandbox-arg-guard) - Keeps a redundant sandbox-escalation argument from failing a tool call. Escalating tools (pwsh, bash, write, edit) advertise the full sandbox_permissions enum, but DSH only accepts a level strictly wider than the one already in effect — a check its own source calls 'deliberately not a schema constraint'. A model that reflexively passes the argument therefore picks the level it is already at and the call dies before running with 'sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "workspace-write" mode', costing some models a whole turn of retries. This plugin registers one tools/execute waterfall listener and, only on that documented rejection and only when the arguments really carried an escalation field, re-issues the identical call once without it. Safe by DSH's own documentation: the rejection precedes any execution ('nothing has run'), and the corrected call cannot match again, so the retry is loop-free. Reproduced and verified end to end — before: isError true, the command never ran; after: the command's real output, isError false, one tool/call and one tool/result. Zero dependencies.
- [ArisuYuuko/dsh-approval-explainer](https://github.com/ArisuYuuko/dsh-approval-explainer) - Writes a model-generated annotation into every DSH escalation approval prompt — what the command does, what the model intends, how risky it is and why, and what each choice means — and keeps a searchable history of past approvals at /dsh-approval/history, with a diagnostics page at /dsh-approval/diag.
- [arrow949/dsh-turn-approval](https://github.com/arrow949/dsh-turn-approval) - Turn-scoped “Allow for this task” approvals: automatically allow matching `danger-full-access` escalations only for the current task, then expire.
- [AskTheWay/dsh-jev-interceptor](https://github.com/AskTheWay/dsh-jev-interceptor) - Classifies pending tool calls with Jev (TypeSafe AI's non-generative decision model) on tools/pre-execute — confident high-risk calls are denied, ambiguous ones escalated to approval — and auto-approves clearly-granted reversible calls on approval/request behind argument-evidence gating. Also subclasses the session-reference resolver so snapshots keep Jev-scored messages instead of dropping oldest-first. Degrades to stock behavior on any provider failure; shadow mode with a /jev-stats command; TypeSafe or OpenRouter endpoints; 64 tests.
- [ateen18/dsh-plugin-security-review](https://github.com/ateen18/dsh-plugin-security-review) - Pre-install static security review and runtime guard for dsh plugins: deobfuscation decoding, supply-chain checks, web one-click review/install/uninstall, and optional runtime tool-call guard.
- [azazo1/dsh-write-protect](https://github.com/azazo1/dsh-write-protect) - Keep declared workspace subpaths (e.g. .git) read-only, honor a read-only rules file at the workspace root, grant extra writable roots under workspace-write, and let the model request session-scoped write access; enforced for sandboxed CLI commands and the write/edit tools.
- [Baiiduu/dsh-semgrep-sast#semgrep-sast](https://github.com/Baiiduu/dsh-semgrep-sast/tree/main/packages/bundle) - Workspace-scoped Semgrep SAST tool for DeepSeek Harness with a managed Windows x64 runtime, structured bounded findings, cancellation and timeout controls, and user-approved sandbox escalation. Installs from npm as @aaub-software/dsh-semgrep-sast.
- [BaqiF2/dsh-plugin-precheck](https://github.com/BaqiF2/dsh-plugin-precheck) - Pre-install compatibility gate for DSH plugins: locks the resolved version, checks peer/engines declarations, dry-installs into an isolated DSH_HOME and boots it with a timeout, blocks on any failure, and restores the profile if the real install fails. Optionally intercepts dsh-market install/update clicks. Compatible with DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x.
- [BeyondandSharp/dsh-plugin-notoken](https://github.com/BeyondandSharp/dsh-plugin-notoken) - \!WARNING\! this removes the authentication step !WARNING! Exchanges the process launch token for the browser-session cookie, so a first visit needs no ?token=... in the URL.
- [bigclawd/dsh-security-guard](https://github.com/bigclawd/dsh-security-guard) - Static and runtime security guard for dsh: rule-based scans for malicious code, prompt injection and token waste, runtime interception of dangerous tool calls, /scan command, plugin_scan tool, web panel, and allowlist.
- [BotonJ/dsh-plugin-sentinel](https://github.com/BotonJ/dsh-plugin-sentinel) - Static pre-install security auditor for plugin bundles: lifecycle scripts, dynamic execution, credential-exfiltration combos, and patch-layer hazards, with zero dependencies and in-memory tar parsing.
- [BuvkB/dsh-vaultwarden](https://github.com/BuvkB/dsh-vaultwarden) - Reads and writes a self-hosted Bitwarden/Vaultwarden vault from any session: eleven bitwarden_* tools, real-time WebSocket sync with a polling fallback, a settings panel with readonly, ask and auto write modes, and optional local masking — with masking on, passwords surface as stable placeholders unless revealed one field at a time, and on-disk session logs are swept for bitwarden secrets. Masking and log sweeping are separate switches.
- [cdxiaodong/dsh-guardian](https://github.com/cdxiaodong/dsh-guardian) - Agent security guardrail: intercepts and audits every tool call, requiring human confirmation on sensitive operations.
- [ChaoJie0/dsh-tm-guard](https://github.com/ChaoJie0/dsh-tm-guard) - Zero-intervention permission gate for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) agents on macOS — active on install. Writes that can be undone via a local git baseline or macOS Time Machine are auto-approved and automatically snapshotted; network access, package installs, process/system management, and reads of sensitive credential paths are blocked; every decision is audited — the audit log keeps everything by default, with optional automatic cleanup of the oldest records.
- [ChenLaoshiYF/dsh-mcpguard](https://github.com/ChenLaoshiYF/dsh-mcpguard) - Scans skills and MCP configs for prompt injection, homoglyphs, hidden Unicode, dangerous shell, and credential leaks.

- [couldbeme/dsh-write-gate](https://github.com/couldbeme/dsh-write-gate) - Commitment write-gate: operator-authored rules enforced before a tool call runs — a deterministic guard tier plus an LLM-judge tier, fail-closed by default, every block written to a contradictions log.
- [cuddly-guacamole/dsh-auto-approval-llm](https://github.com/cuddly-guacamole/dsh-auto-approval-llm) - LLM-assisted auto approval with countdown fallback for the Auto permission preset: static rules, risk tiers, breaker and file audit.
- [DamonKoy/dsh-plugins#dsh-approve-for-me](https://github.com/DamonKoy/dsh-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-approve-for-me) - Automated approval review: auto-approve read-only tools, auto-deny dangerous commands, fail-closed policy engine.
- [DamonKoy/dsh-plugins#dsh-secret-redactor](https://github.com/DamonKoy/dsh-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-secret-redactor) - Automatic secret redaction in tool results: masks API keys, tokens, JWTs, private keys and configured secrets before the model sees them.
- [Darren-Tang/dsh-provenance](https://github.com/Darren-Tang/dsh-provenance) - Pre-install supply-chain checks for DeepSeek Harness plugins: verify the tarball you are about to install matches the source you read, before any code runs.
- [deepsleepAquarium/dsh-whale-post#verify](https://github.com/deepsleepAquarium/dsh-whale-post/tree/main/packages/verify) - Verifies letters signed by other agents: a canonical field order, digest and HMAC checks, and fail-closed handling of missing or unregistered fields. - [devil233-ui/dsh-auto-review-default](https://github.com/devil233-ui/dsh-auto-review-default) - Puts sessions into the built-in Auto review permission preset: new sessions at creation, existing root sessions when they are restored.
- [DevilSpiderX/dsh-workspace-only-plugin](https://github.com/DevilSpiderX/dsh-workspace-only-plugin) - Restrict the file access of agents in any sandbox mode (read-only / workspace-write / danger-full-access / auto) to the session workspace, and ask the user to rule on cross-border access. - [dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-warden](https://github.com/dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-warden) - Adversarial review gate for tool calls. - [DNAlec/dsh-auto-approve](https://github.com/DNAlec/dsh-auto-approve) - Automatic approval and review for tool calls that need approval: keyword buckets match red lines without context, then a judge model classifies what was requested and sends it to allow, reject or a human according to the matching row and risk level; a judgment that never ran always goes to a human, and rejections tell the model why.
- [drscrewdriver/dsh-perm-gate](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-perm-gate) - Shipped with cc-safety-net-style mechanical safety-net rules appended; supports both no-model and model-assisted security review, in modes such as 自动审查 (auto-review) and 机械直通 (mechanical pass-through). P0–P4 deterministic-first permission gate with permissive tier, learning sedimentation and approval-history UI; hard-deny credentials and protected paths, auto-allow internal read-only tools.
- [DWJZ/dsh-allow](https://github.com/DWJZ/dsh-allow) - Filesystem permissions for shell calls, granted per path and capability rather than per command name. An Approvals tab in the conversation reads the audit log back and shows which rule, automatic reviewer or person answered each call.
- [elegant01/dsh-honey-guard](https://github.com/elegant01/dsh-honey-guard) - Replaces detected secrets (OpenAI, AWS, GitHub, PEM, Bearer) with deterministic, structurally valid honey tokens before they reach the model or the session file; adds manual marking for values the detectors miss, explicit user-visible restore, a cross-session canary alarm, and an opt-in JSONL log of substitution counts that never records the underlying values.
- [Eligahyu/dsh-sentinel-scanner](https://github.com/Eligahyu/dsh-sentinel-scanner) - Static security scanner for DSH plugins: read-only audit (exec, credentials, exfiltration, obfuscation, install scripts, bundle manifest) with a 0-100 risk score.
- [ethanrise/dsh-privacy-gateway](https://github.com/ethanrise/dsh-privacy-gateway) - Replaces personal data in conversation messages with placeholders before they reach the model (Chinese names found by context, mainland-China mobile and ID numbers, emails, bank card numbers, and terms from a user word list), shows the originals only in the local UI, and creates redacted copies of CSV/XLSX files.

- [gengwg/dsh-kubectl-guard](https://github.com/gengwg/dsh-kubectl-guard) - Policy plugin that gates kubectl by kubeconfig context: hard-deny irreversible verbs outside local clusters, ask for the rest.
- [GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-agent-loop-guard](https://github.com/GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-agent-loop-guard) - Fail-closed runtime tool-call loop guard for DeepSeek Harness.
- [GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-dsml-artifact-guard](https://github.com/GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-dsml-artifact-guard) - Sanitizes leaked DeepSeek DSML closing tags from model text streams.
- [GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-shadow-auditor](https://github.com/GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-shadow-auditor) - Background security auditor for DeepSeek Harness: scans agent outputs for secret leakage, checks command safety before execution, and surfaces findings in a persistent audit log.
- [GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-time-machine](https://github.com/GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-time-machine) - Smart checkpoints, workspace safety guards and instant rollback for DeepSeek Harness.
- [GreenLv/dsh-completion-guard](https://github.com/GreenLv/dsh-completion-guard) - Keeps DSH agents from forgetting your requirements during long tasks. It saves important conditions and completion evidence locally, brings them back after context compaction or session resume, and stops partial work from being reported as the whole task done.
- [heyuanliu3-byte/dsh-auto-preset](https://github.com/heyuanliu3-byte/dsh-auto-preset) - Restores the permission preset a session was last set to when that session is reopened; a session opened for the first time is left untouched. Load it after dsh-experimental-auto-review to restore the auto preset.
- [hhl123hhl/dsh-privacy-shield](https://github.com/hhl123hhl/dsh-privacy-shield) - Rewrites the model-visible copy of system, developer, user, assistant and tool messages into stable HMAC placeholders before a request leaves the machine, while local session logs, the chat transcript and restored tool calls keep real values.
- [howmp/dsh-pentest](https://github.com/howmp/dsh-pentest) - Authorized pentest mode for DeepSeek Harness — exploration chain, assets and findings with a Web view.
- [huanlin-labs/dsh-isolation-gate](https://github.com/huanlin-labs/dsh-isolation-gate) - Per-directory access gate for DSH: deny / read / full levels for names and paths, roster groups, per-session overrides and an audit log, plus seven model-facing `gate_*` tools whose widening requests must be approved by the owner in the panel. Installs with `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-isolation-gate`; MIT, no network calls, state stays on disk.
- [hxy91819/dsh-auth](https://github.com/hxy91819/dsh-auth) - Caddy forward_auth administrator login for DeepSeek Harness Web, with Argon2id passwords, revocable sessions, bilingual UI, and a native sidebar sign-out action.
- [IamNewHands/dsh-approval-gate](https://github.com/IamNewHands/dsh-approval-gate) - Maintained fork of dsh-approval-gate. A neutral operation whose confirmation count has reached the threshold auto-approves when the judge is unavailable, instead of prompting a human again; approver-facing explanations are generated in Chinese from the real sandbox mode, command and paths. Also carries deterministic hard-deny for credential exfiltration and system-path destruction, judge-input redaction, a judge model candidate chain, fingerprint-scoped allow rules, and an approval view with unified diff and one-click revert.
- [iasiv5/dsh-skip-browser-auth](https://github.com/iasiv5/dsh-skip-browser-auth) - Replaces the DSH Web connection provider to skip BrowserAuth entirely so the Web UI opens directly without pasting the random startup token, gated to nine verified DSH version pairs with strict host/client matching that sleeps automatically on unknown or mixed versions, and reverts fully on uninstall; web profiles only.
- [iiiweiii/dsh-guardwall](https://github.com/iiiweiii/dsh-guardwall) - Vets local, npm, and GitHub plugin source before installation, blocks configured high-risk tool calls at runtime, audits output secret patterns, and writes HMAC-chained local audit logs.
- [ilharp/dsh-tool-approval](https://github.com/ilharp/dsh-tool-approval) - Manual approval mode ("Manual Mode" / "Ask Mode").
- [irisblackwood/focus-guard#core](https://github.com/irisblackwood/focus-guard/tree/main/packages/core) - Blocks AI coding agents from editing files without evidence and from running unapproved high-risk commands, and tells quoted dangerous strings apart from commands actually being executed.
- [islibaodong/dsh-login](https://github.com/islibaodong/dsh-login) - Multi-user login gateway for the DSH web UI: the first visit creates the admin account, admins add and manage users in the GUI settings panel, ordinary users see only their own conversations, and unauthenticated visitors are redirected to /login.
- [JayYuen666/dsh-danger-guard](https://github.com/JayYuen666/dsh-danger-guard) - Pre-execution guard: a `tools.guard` predicate decides allow, ask or refuse per permission preset for dangerous shell commands (git hook bypass, catastrophic `rm`, download-and-run, git history rewrites) and for edits to credential paths or to files the turn never read, and hands the model the reason plus a working alternative.
- [Jiao-XXX/dsh-auto-approve](https://github.com/Jiao-XXX/dsh-auto-approve) - Adds an `auto` permission preset between workspace-write and danger-full-access: a classifier grants routine sandbox escalations once, while dangerous or uncertain requests still go to a human.
- [jilian-dsh/dsh-rule-engine](https://github.com/jilian-dsh/dsh-rule-engine) - Rules execution engine for dsh: parses AGENTS.md, hard-blocks rule-violating tool calls, text-based B/D rule auditing, /guard command, version-guard for versioned files, and free-zone support (engine skips free-zone sections).
- [JimChen-g/dsh-action-outbox](https://github.com/JimChen-g/dsh-action-outbox) - Stages exact DSH tool calls without dispatch, presents complete canonical arguments in a durable Batch Review Inbox, invalidates approvals after edits or restarts, and commits only a matching SHA-256 digest plus single-use nonce through the normal DSH tool pipeline.
- [jkt-check/dsh-secret-scrub](https://github.com/jkt-check/dsh-secret-scrub) - Irreversible secret-scrubbing guard: rewrites access keys, bearer tokens, and private key blocks into `[REDACTED:<category>]` placeholders before they reach the session log and the model.
- [JohnXu22786/safety-net](https://github.com/JohnXu22786/safety-net) - Destructive-command interception gate for dsh: parses shell semantics, judges risk against 41 built-in rules, and holds irreversible rm -rf, git reset --hard, and git push --force style commands at a confirmation gate.
- [JohnXu22786/secret-guard](https://github.com/JohnXu22786/secret-guard) - Blocks agents from reading or writing sensitive files (.env, credentials, key material), masks leaked secret-shaped values in tool results, keeps an audit journal, and exposes safe sg_* inspection tools that never print raw values.
- [Jueze-2019/dsh-redteam-mode#packages/redteam-bundle](https://github.com/Jueze-2019/dsh-redteam-mode/tree/main/packages/redteam-bundle) - Red-team engagement mode: send one target organization name; a planner session runs five execution roles (recon, asset triage, vulnerability discovery, exploitation, internal pivot) with configurable concurrency; preflight checks skills/resources; scoring uses four stages (recon, internet, boundary, internal) with server-side caps and privilege-wins dedup; findings stay in a local SQLite fact base. The persistent right-side console has nine pages and includes asset mapping, agents, sessions/tunnels, findings, score targets, reports, POC knowledge base and skill library. v0.15.2 adds automatic HTTP evidence/action records, batch ingest, scope check, tunnel pivot probe, data proof, cleanup ledger and T0-T3 asset admission to prevent scope drift. 59 redteam_* tools; 38 bundled skills.
- [JW53222/faultseed#dsh](https://github.com/JW53222/faultseed/tree/main/adapters/dsh) - Honesty guardrails on the tool pipeline: blocks a coding agent from weakening tests, swallowing errors, stubbing type checks, or deleting tests through the shell — nine deterministic hooks, each backed by a planted-failure test proving the guard can fail.
- [jypjypjypjyp/dsh-guardrail](https://github.com/jypjypjypjyp/dsh-guardrail) - String-matches tool-call input arguments, blocks dangerous tool calls (deny) or allows them with an injected warning (warn), and ships a full rules-management panel.
- [kenryu42/cc-safety-net](https://github.com/kenryu42/cc-safety-net) - Pre-execution guard that blocks destructive Git and filesystem commands and access to secrets such as SSH keys and .env files before a tool call runs.
- [kipozannaki/DSH-PDR-Plugin](https://github.com/kipozannaki/DSH-PDR-Plugin) - Runtime plugin firewall for sessions started through its launcher (the DSH Desktop app cannot be injected and is not covered): filesystem, network and subprocess calls plugins make are attributed to the plugin that made them and judged against what that plugin declares, so a plugin doing its declared job stays silent and leaving it is recorded. Attribution is best-effort, not a guarantee - uncovered calls fall back to host, never to another plugin. Also adds a pre-install health card (capability surface, red-line combinations, PASS/WARN/BLOCK), boundary judging, opt-in pre-execution blocking with a credential-exfil rule, update diff with a trial install in an isolated child process, SARIF/CSV audit export, and multi-source aggregation. Local-only storage, no telemetry; the optional webhook is off by default.
- [KongFangXun/sofagent#cordis-plugin-sofagent-audit](https://github.com/KongFangXun/sofagent/tree/main/engine/dsh-plugins/cordis-plugin-sofagent-audit) - Commit-time audit harness for AI coding agents: 28 git-diff rules (secrets, out-of-scope edits, prompt injection), HMAC-signed audit trail, snapshot rollback, and a full MCP toolset. Installable via dsh plugin add.
- [L-ingqin12/dsh-redaction#dsh-plugin-content-policy](https://github.com/L-ingqin12/dsh-redaction/tree/main/packages/dsh-plugin-content-policy) - Preventive content policy for tool results: rewrites matched text, and drops or truncates whole fields by path before a result is normalised, rendered or persisted, so an unreviewed payload never enters it. Ships inert with no built-in category or domain blocklist.
- [L-ingqin12/dsh-redaction#dsh-plugin-redact](https://github.com/L-ingqin12/dsh-redaction/tree/main/packages/dsh-plugin-redact) - In-place redaction and row-level rollback for session logs, preserving the seq-equals-row-index invariant that makes deleting a middle row corrupt the entire log. Originals are copied to a quarantine sibling before any write, and the reader's own semantics are replayed as a pre-write gate.
- [LAwLi3tCoding/dsh-approval-review](https://github.com/LAwLi3tCoding/dsh-approval-review) - Adds an "approve for me" access mode whose approval requests are answered by an independent reviewer model instead of a person: the reviewer can read the workspace read-only, a reviewer that cannot run hands the request back to the human, and every decision is recorded with its rationale in an Approvals tab.
- [Ledas-as/-deep-seek-harness](https://github.com/Ledas-as/-deep-seek-harness) - Chinese progress guidance and user-confirmed project or global memory, respecting DSH Full access and reusing host Auto review to reduce repeated prompts.
- [leetom314/dsh-risk-gate](https://github.com/leetom314/dsh-risk-gate) - Semantic risk grading and progressive authorization: classifies tool calls into safe/risky/redline, asks before irreversible actions, auto-allows only approved-and-succeeded signatures.
- [LeslieWylie/dsh-fleet-audit](https://github.com/LeslieWylie/dsh-fleet-audit) - Read-only agent-fleet credential hygiene audit: credential-file permissions, embedded credentials in git remotes (masked in output), and provider token literal counts; zero-dependency and deterministic.
- [Letter2025/dsh-approval-llm](https://github.com/Letter2025/dsh-approval-llm) - Model-based permission approval: an approval-request answerer backed by a separate reviewer model.
- [liuqingman/dsh-hawkeye-scan#npm](https://github.com/liuqingman/dsh-hawkeye-scan/tree/main/npm) - AI-driven source-code security scanning workbench: 5 model tools (start/finding/status/report/list) plus a /hawkeye web UI and JSON/Markdown/HTML vulnerability reports; zero-dependency Cordis plugin, installable as agent preset or npm package.
- [liuwenji007/dsh-trust-check](https://github.com/liuwenji007/dsh-trust-check) - Static capability disclosure for DeepSeek Harness plugins: a Settings page and CLI that list installed plugins' capabilities, literal destinations, install scripts, and injection shapes (prompt registrations, shipped skill text, bundle patch), each with file:line evidence. Code-determined, reproducible, zero-token. Disclosure only — not a security verdict, never a safety claim.
- [lloydzhou/dsh-bash-guard](https://github.com/lloydzhou/dsh-bash-guard) - Permission guard for DSH: four scopes with read/write/execute bits in the native permission menu, plus an optional Jev semantic classifier for bash commands.
- [log-li/dsh-automode](https://github.com/log-li/dsh-automode) - CC-style auto-approval for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic deny/allow rules plus a two-stage allow/reject classifier with a circuit breaker and denial guidance.
- [lone-wolf-akela/dsh-sandboxie-redirect](https://github.com/lone-wolf-akela/dsh-sandboxie-redirect) - Copy-on-write permission preset: shell commands run inside a per-workspace Sandboxie box, so writes outside the workspace land in the box copy while the real disk stays untouched (Windows only, requires Sandboxie-Plus).
- [lonelymoon87/dsh-guardian](https://github.com/lonelymoon87/dsh-guardian) - Adds dangerous-operation policy checks, output redaction, and a security-review workflow.
- [lovezi0/dsh-workspace-acl-allow](https://github.com/lovezi0/dsh-workspace-acl-allow) - Windows workspace pre-authorization: adds an explicit full-control DACL ACE (including WRITE_OWNER, required by dsh >=0.1.7 sandbox startup) to user-declared workspace directories, removing the repeated full-access escalation prompt. Grants only on explicit intent — new workspace records or paths added in the plugin settings page; system directories are hard-blocked. Windows only.
- [Luawig/dsh-cloudflare-access](https://github.com/Luawig/dsh-cloudflare-access) - Re-validates Cloudflare Access JWTs at the DSH origin so Settings, Credentials, Agent Preset management, and model discovery work from a remote hostname.
- [LWLAymh/dsh-edit-guardian](https://github.com/LWLAymh/dsh-edit-guardian) - File-change diff bar with keep/undo summary, plus dangerous-command approval and red highlighting for bash/pwsh.
- [Martlet-Tech/dsh-approval-explain](https://github.com/Martlet-Tech/dsh-approval-explain) - Adds an Explain button to the approval card: one model call returns exactly three lines reading the pending operation, covering what it does, which files or system state it reads, writes, modifies or executes, and a risky/attention/safe verdict with a one-sentence justification. It also renders the detail area for `write` and `edit` calls, which the shipped renderer leaves blank because it only reads a `command` field.
- [maxmilian/dsh-sonarqube](https://github.com/maxmilian/dsh-sonarqube) - Read-only SonarQube Community Build tools: instance status, project Quality Gate for a branch or pull request, issue and Security Hotspot search, single hotspot detail, and coverage, duplication or caller-selected measures. Issue and hotspot results carry a normalized location with component key, file path, line and text range.
- [Mengshang-spec/dsh-plugin-trustlens](https://github.com/Mengshang-spec/dsh-plugin-trustlens) - Read-only DSH plugin auditor with static scanning, current-session model review, and confirmation gates.
- [MicroMilo/upstream-radar](https://github.com/MicroMilo/upstream-radar) - Watches DSH and plugin releases, retests exact published artifacts in disposable runners, publishes machine-readable compatibility evidence, and reconciles managed issues after fixes.
- [agent-guard-for-dsh](https://github.com/mokuyoaxis/agent-guard) - Recoverable file and Git operations for coding agents, with shared recovery and redaction tools, a DSH shell adapter and audit records; optional native text-read protection is off by default.
- [moon09300731/dsh-approval-gate](https://github.com/moon09300731/dsh-approval-gate) - Risk-gated approval automation for DeepSeek Harness: flash pre-classifies whether a write/command is irreversible — safe operations are auto-approved, dangerous ones are escalated to human approval (fail-safe). File-diff review with one-click revert and session-scoped snapshots (v0.5.1: precise snapshots via tool-call parameter tracing, incl. human-approval cases).
- [moon16u/dsh-pouch#dsh-hooks](https://github.com/moon16u/dsh-pouch/tree/main/packages/dsh-hooks) - File-defined command hooks across the session, prompt, tool, permission, Stop and PostCompact seams, with an approval-only GUI: no unapproved command runs, and approval binds the exact definition, canonical working directory and pinned watchFiles. Commands run as the DSH OS user without a hook sandbox, so the trust ledger is explicit.
- [MoonlitDropOfBlood/dsh-agent-approval](https://github.com/MoonlitDropOfBlood/dsh-agent-approval) - An independent approval subagent judges every sandbox escalation, with a configurable model and an audit log.
- [MoruTeaven/dsh-key-panel](https://github.com/MoruTeaven/dsh-key-panel) - A secret store for DSH Desktop that keeps API keys in one place and injects them into the assistant's shell as $DSH_* variables.
- [MrWeiCodes/dsh-permgate](https://github.com/MrWeiCodes/dsh-permgate) - Fine-grained permission gateway: per-category tool-call review (outside-workspace directories, commands, file read/write, subagents, repeated actions) with global & per-project allow/deny exceptions, quick-tool defaults, custom rules, a bilingual approval modal with inline diff details, custom rejection reasons and a sandbox-upgrade flow.
- [MyRemme/dsh-computer-use-guard](https://github.com/MyRemme/dsh-computer-use-guard) - Three-tier deny/ask/auto gate for the computer-use (cua-driver) tool family: each tool category gets one segmented control in Settings, and an allow list or deny list overrides the tiers per tool name.
- [NanmiCoder/dsh-auto-mode](https://github.com/NanmiCoder/dsh-auto-mode) - Adds an Auto permission preset between Workspace Write and Full access: routine work stays in the official workspace-write sandbox while the current session model reviews escalation and destructive calls, granting one exact wider access once, asking when the intent is ambiguous, and denying critical paths.
- [NattoCB/dsh-safe-delete](https://github.com/NattoCB/dsh-safe-delete) - Tools guard that moves agent-issued `rm` targets to the macOS Trash instead of deleting, with a shell-aware lexer covering compound and disguised commands; a switch in Settings → General turns it off.
- [nengong-ai/dsh-keychain-credentials](https://github.com/nengong-ai/dsh-keychain-credentials) - Pure JavaScript macOS Keychain credentials provider for DeepSeek Harness, replacing plaintext .credentials.yaml storage and fully supporting both refs and records without native builds, signing, or Xcode.
- [NEVSTOP-LAB/dsh-approval-mode](https://github.com/NEVSTOP-LAB/dsh-approval-mode) - Adds an approval-mode toggle next to the permission selector: default approval keeps per-call confirmation, bypass approval auto-approves every tool call while staying in Workspace Write.
- [omdsh-dev/dsh-security-audit](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-security-audit) - Local security audit: config, plugin origins, sessions, network exposure — read-only redacted risk report.
- [omdsh-dev/sandbox-micro](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/sandbox-micro) - Support for the microsandbox backend.

- [omdsh-dev/sandbox-nono](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/sandbox-nono) - Support for the nono sandbox backend.
- [onlyqzq/dsh-riskproof](https://github.com/onlyqzq/dsh-riskproof) - Live security beacon for DSH that follows tool activity. Click to view call statistics, risk provenance chains and blocked actions, with read-only task restrictions and tool metadata change detection.
- [Ox0400/dsh-vault](https://github.com/Ox0400/dsh-vault) - Encrypted local credentials vault for the Harness: a web settings page and vault_* tools to store, search and copy passwords, API keys, TOTP secrets and card data, with health audits, expiry rotation, imports/exports and read-only/ask access modes.
- [PAKIKNOWLEDGE/dsh-auto-classifier](https://github.com/PAKIKNOWLEDGE/dsh-auto-classifier) - Autonomous permission classifier for the auto preset: tool-scoped allow/deny rules, an LLM semantic judge, and git checkpointing for unattended sessions.
- [pengxuding/dsh-plugin-judge](https://github.com/pengxuding/dsh-plugin-judge) - Plugin value auditor: pre-install review (source scan + LLM judge) and post-install audit of installed bundles, with model-switch re-audit reminders.
- [PensiveFei/dsh-secure-audit](https://github.com/PensiveFei/dsh-secure-audit) - Read-only security and compliance plugin for DeepSeek Harness: prompt-injection detection, Chinese-PII redaction, and a local configuration audit with redacted, reproducible reports.
- [PerryLink/dsh-auto-review](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-auto-review) - Second-model auto-review on the approval answerer chain: a read-only reviewer subagent returns structured allow/deny verdicts with reasons, fail-closed by default.
- [PerryLink/dsh-defend](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-defend) - Detects prompt-injection, jailbreak, and secret-leak patterns on the agent/pre-step, tools/pre-execute, and tools/post-execute seams with allow/ask/block tiers, sanitized defend/detection audit events, a defend_report tool, and a destructive-delete command guard.
- [PerryLink/dsh-mask](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-mask) - PII masking for DeepSeek Harness — anonymizes names, phones, emails, ids, and keys before requests and restores them at the display layer, keeping plaintext out of session logs.
- [PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules) - Claude Code-style declarative permission rules: ordered allow/deny/ask YAML rules matching tool names, arguments, workspace paths, and agent identity on the tools/pre-execute waterfall, with full session-log audit, dry-run mode, and hot reload.
- [PerryLink/dsh-skill-pack-security](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-skill-pack-security) - Security-audit methodology skill pack plus the plugin_vet supply-chain gate: eight agent skills (secret scan, dependency audit, supply-chain review, prompt-injection review, audit orchestration, threat modeling, vuln intel, incident response) in Chinese and English editions, with an npm provider bundle that mounts the skills and registers the automated plugin_vet pre-install scanner.
- [Phocinae/dsh-evidence](https://github.com/Phocinae/dsh-evidence) - Pre-claim gate: a commit, push or tag claim like "tests pass" is checked against the session evidence ledger before it is written.
- [Phocinae/dsh-phocinae](https://github.com/Phocinae/dsh-phocinae) - Local decision-layer plugin for DSH: a fail-closed command approval gate and ask/gate tools backed by a 144.3M on-device model.
