- [Qcsj777/dsh-stop-that-shit](https://github.com/Qcsj777/dsh-stop-that-shit) - Arms an explicit per-session scope contract from a `$stop-that-shit` directive and audits every tool call against it; unarmed it is inert. A DSH bundle wrapping lennney/stop-that-shit (MIT). Do not install it alongside the upstream lennney/stop-that-shit DSH bundle.
- [QinpanWan/dsh-prompt-antivirus](https://github.com/QinpanWan/dsh-prompt-antivirus) - Global prompt-injection / context-virus defense for DeepSeek Harness: scans tool arguments, tool results, pre-model messages and the outbound stream; quarantine/block/monitor modes, canary trap, and an evolvable on-disk signature library with learn/import/export.
- [ruanhaodong-tt/dsh-security-guard](https://github.com/ruanhaodong-tt/dsh-security-guard) - Runtime security guard for DSH: loader import confinement, HTTP Host header validation, and source patch for VM sandbox escapes (4 CVEs). AI-assisted.
- [RyeSama/dsh-plugin-guard#dsh-guard-tool](https://github.com/RyeSama/dsh-plugin-guard/tree/main/plugins/dsh-guard-tool) - Registers one agent tool, plugin_guard, that statically scans a DSH plugin package before it is installed and reports a verdict with the reasons: a missing or broken dsh.bundle.patch, a missing dsh.permissions block, install scripts, dangerous APIs and obfuscation, dependency risk, and source that is not indexed and therefore cannot be verified. Read-only: the scanned code is never imported, installed, evaluated or run.
- [SARTHAK2511/dsh-cve-audit](https://github.com/SARTHAK2511/dsh-cve-audit) - Live CVE/supply-chain audit for your workspace's own project dependencies (npm/pip/go), backed by OSV.dev, with a `cve_audit` tool plus optional automatic re-scan on lockfile changes.
- [sashankh/dsh-taintguard](https://github.com/sashankh/dsh-taintguard) - Taints the agent when tool results carry untrusted content, gates the privileged calls that follow, and refuses credentials passed to network-capable tools in every mode.
- [SeaOf0/dsh-redteam-model](https://github.com/SeaOf0/dsh-redteam-model) - Authorized-security DSH collection: nine work modes (redteam coordinator, pentest, code audit, binary analysis, attack-defense, AV evasion, incident response, cloud security, CTF solving) and fifteen runtime plugins, managed from a settings page with one-click deploy, install, update and uninstall.
- [sensedeal/cue-skills#cue-omni-reader-guard](https://github.com/sensedeal/cue-skills/tree/main/dsh/cue-omni-reader-guard) - Hardening guard for mcp__omni__parse in DeepSeek Harness: a tools/pre-execute listener that denies private/reserved host URLs (SSRF), enforces an allow-list or ask (consent), and is fail-closed when allowedRoots is empty.
- [SeverusZh/dsh-yolo-mode](https://github.com/SeverusZh/dsh-yolo-mode) - LLM auto-approval for sandbox escalation requests, with presets and a fail-closed fallback.
- [sgzeng/pbfuzz#dsh-pbfuzz](https://github.com/sgzeng/pbfuzz/tree/master/packages/dsh-pbfuzz) - Directed fuzzing driven by an LLM agent: from a target repository and a bug (CVE description, patch, crash trace, or file:line), it runs a PLAN, IMPLEMENT, EXECUTE, REFLECT loop in which the model writes Python input generators, until an input triggers the campaign's stderr-pattern oracle or the campaign stops.
- [Shaky77/KISS_Law-DSH](https://github.com/Shaky77/KISS_Law-DSH) - English edition of Weiwen's Law (KISS's Law): the first and only domain-agnostic white-box causal adjudication middleware for AI agents. Unlike domain-specific causal-inference tooling (statistics/economics/ML) or evidence-gated agent firewalls, it adjudicates *every* tool call along a deterministic structural causal chain (R->S->D->H->M) before execution - across any domain, with no training or per-domain tuning. It blocks destructive and credential-file operations, escalates repeated boundary violations, cuts faulting links until verified-fixed, and gives risk verdicts on un-auditable execution; runs fully local with zero API cost.
- [Shaky77/weiwen-law-dsh](https://github.com/Shaky77/weiwen-law-dsh) - White-box causal guardrail for dsh: every tool call is adjudicated before execution along a deterministic causal logic chain — blocks destructive and credential-file operations, escalates repeated boundary violations, cuts faulting links until verified-fixed, and gives risk verdicts on un-auditable execution; runs fully local with zero API cost, plus 6 white-box self-check tools.
- [shaoshi20/dshscan](https://github.com/shaoshi20/dshscan) - Security scanner for DSH plugins: static and semantic passes over plugin source, DSH-specific attack-surface rules, npm audit, batch scanning, and an HTML report with per-finding severity and evidence.
- [Shiyuedong-Jade/DM-security](https://github.com/Shiyuedong-Jade/DM-security) - Run a read-only security assessment of a Dameng DM8 database with 60 checks and produce an HTML report with GB/T 22239-2019 control mapping. Needs Java 8+ and a DmJdbcDriver jar you provide yourself.
- [shuxue6662-a11y/dsh-risk-guard](https://github.com/shuxue6662-a11y/dsh-risk-guard) - Zero-interruption audit and fuse blocking for DeepSeek Harness: silently records every tool call with deterministic risk scoring, cumulative-risk bonuses, risk-level breakdowns and retention-based cleanup; blocks irreversible catastrophes (protected-path deletion, disk wipe, force-push to protected branches/refs, credential exfiltration), and renders a redacted /risk-guard operation bill with --since filtering.
- [simon300000/dsh-auto](https://github.com/simon300000/dsh-auto) - Adds an Auto Approve permission preset to the Web UI, using a fresh restricted Reviewer Agent to allow or deny each approval request.
- [sjh9714/dsh-movein#plugin](https://github.com/sjh9714/dsh-movein/tree/main/plugin) - Fine grained per tool permission rules for DSH at the tools/pre-execute gate, deny and ask lists in Claude Code rule syntax (`Bash(rm -rf:*), Read(_secrets_), mcp__server__tool`), works standalone without migrating.
- [slow-stack/euthyna](https://github.com/slow-stack/euthyna) - Security-audit facts AI coding agents cannot compute, plus a verdict gate: euthyna history attributes deleted lines to commits and flags those from security fixes (--origins finds the first introducer), euthyna coverage reports which changed symbols no test ever invoked, and euthyna gate checks each finding against six gates, downgrading any without evidence to an observation.
- [slywalker2006/dsh-passwords](https://github.com/slywalker2006/dsh-passwords) - Turns DeepSeek Harness into a server-grade multi-tenant platform: remote access + auto HTTPS, subuser permissions & token/daily quotas, sandbox enforcement, encrypted auth & audit log.
- [SodaZheng/dsh-totp](https://github.com/SodaZheng/dsh-totp) - TOTP-only access control for personal DeepSeek Harness Web instances, with in-app QR enrollment, single-use recovery codes, live protection controls and lock-all revocation of page access.
- [STARDUSTLC666/dsh-code-security](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-code-security) - Deterministic code security review: 40+ rules, secret entropy detection, staged-diff review, SARIF export, baseline acceptance, SBOM-lite dependency inventory and health self-check. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
- [SteelUnion/dsh-confirm-gate](https://github.com/SteelUnion/dsh-confirm-gate) - Counts persistent operations within a turn and escalates on the total: a reminder first, then an explicit stop instruction, then an approval prompt. Reads the session sandbox mode on every call, and stays silent under read-only and workspace-write.
- [sujingkpo/dsh-auto-pass](https://github.com/sujingkpo/dsh-auto-pass) - A continuation of simon300000/dsh-auto: the Auto Approve permission preset for the DSH Web UI reviews each approval with one single-shot model call instead of a reviewer subagent, auto-approves only the actions that pass and hands the rest to human approval, and remembers confirmed decisions as project- and global-scope allow/deny lists, with an approval timeline in the right sidebar.
- [SummerSec/dsh-web-auth](https://github.com/SummerSec/dsh-web-auth) - Transport-level authentication gate for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with server-side sessions, HttpOnly cookies, IP-based login throttling, and an scrypt password CLI.
- [tancheng33/dsh-code-runtime-container](https://github.com/tancheng33/dsh-code-runtime-container) - Container-isolated backend for the `ctx.codeRuntime` seam: each Code Mode program runs in a fresh container with no network, a read-only rootfs, dropped capabilities, and kernel-enforced memory, CPU and pid ceilings.
- [tancheng33/dsh-credentials-vault](https://github.com/tancheng33/dsh-credentials-vault) - HashiCorp Vault backend for the credential seam: KV v2/v1, AppRole machine auth, per-operation reads so rotation needs no restart, and compare-and-swap writes.
- [tancheng33/dsh-egress-guard](https://github.com/tancheng33/dsh-egress-guard) - Runtime security gate on the tool pipeline: denies calls naming hosts outside an egress allowlist, redacts credentials from results at the canonical value rather than only the rendered content, and appends every decision to a JSONL audit log; ships in monitor-only mode.
- [taxueseek/dsh-plugin-guard](https://github.com/taxueseek/dsh-plugin-guard) - Static-only plugin gate and clinic for DSH: audit before install, hash-and-capability lock after install, local fingerprint peer search over GitHub topic:dsh-plugin, and mechanical detox. Never executes the target plugin.
- [TecFancy/dsh-auth-gate](https://github.com/TecFancy/dsh-auth-gate) - Login gate for the dsh web surface: password or shared-token authentication, session cookies, rate limiting, and a user-management CLI (dsh.bundle manifest since 0.4.1, one-command `dsh plugin add` mounting).
- [TGYD-helige/dsh-plugins#dsh-policy](https://github.com/TGYD-helige/dsh-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-policy) - Apply configurable allow, deny, and approval rules to dsh tool calls, including shell command patterns.
- [toby-bridges/api-relay-audit](https://github.com/toby-bridges/api-relay-audit) - Runs local security audits of AI API relays and LLM proxies from DeepSeek Harness, producing Markdown reports for prompt injection, model substitution signals, tool-call rewriting, error leakage, stream integrity, and profile-gated Web3 risks.
- [Top-Celestial-Company-Ltd/dsh-dros-vajraclaw](https://github.com/Top-Celestial-Company-Ltd/dsh-dros-vajraclaw) - Local tool-call failsafe for DSH: blocks a fixed list of high-risk shell patterns and credential-file reads before execution, with a per-session hash-linked JSONL audit log, and an optional external Gateway for centralized policy.
- [truelove-dreamer/dsh-plugin-vetting](https://github.com/truelove-dreamer/dsh-plugin-vetting) - Vets third-party plugins before you trust them: static scan for malicious patterns (exfiltration, credential access, obfuscation, persistence) and over-privileged path use, transitive-dependency coverage, official-package hash baseline for supply-chain tamper detection, and an optional plugin-tool call gate.
- [uwu9039/dsh-airbag](https://github.com/uwu9039/dsh-airbag) - Blocks API keys pasted into the composer or written by tools, logs leak events, and scans the workspace for exposed secrets.
- [Vladimir-Kryshchenko/dsh-route-fence-linter](https://github.com/Vladimir-Kryshchenko/dsh-route-fence-linter) - Audits every plugin HTTP route in a profile for a browser-trust fence: plugin routes win the web server's longest-prefix match ahead of the /api gateway, so they never see its trust check and must pin the Host to loopback themselves. Grades PASS/WARN/FAIL per route and fails a fence that compares Origin to Host without pinning it (bypassable by DNS rebinding). Ships as a CLI for CI and a route_fence_scan tool.
- [we39/dsh-jumpserver](https://github.com/we39/dsh-jumpserver) - Query and manage JumpServer through conversation: assets, users, accounts, permissions, sessions, command audit logs, command filters, and RBAC roles, authenticated with an AccessKeyID/AccessKeySecret pair (HTTP Signature).
- [weibaohui/user-management](https://github.com/weibaohui/user-management) - Login gate for the dsh web UI: unauthenticated visitors get a login/register page and the first registrant becomes admin; includes user and role management plus login and access audit logs.
- [weisofns/dsh-security-guard](https://github.com/weisofns/dsh-security-guard) - DSH plugin security guard: 28-rule static scanner, risk scoring, whitelist/blacklist policy, local web dashboard and in-DSH risk popups.
- [wulun811/dsh-plugin-vet](https://github.com/wulun811/dsh-plugin-vet) - Plugin trust pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic static scan with verdicts, opt-in runtime guard with honeypot lures, agent audit-protocol skill, and a browser shield status light. Alarm-only, never an enforcer.
- [wxlei2004/dsh-plugins#dsh-re-workbench](https://github.com/wxlei2004/dsh-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-re-workbench) - Reverse-engineering workbench: bridges a local IDA Pro into DeepSeek Harness through @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client, exposing the ida-pro-mcp toolset (decompile, xref, rename, comment) as mcp__ida__* tools. Auto-selects idalib headless mode (analyses a binary in-process, no IDA GUI) or GUI mode (connects to the IDA plugin RPC on port 13337). Adds re_check, re_open and re_status; the bundled MCP server is a zero-dependency stdio proxy usable from any MCP client.
- [WyattJHayes/dsh-feishu-channel](https://github.com/WyattJHayes/dsh-feishu-channel) - Security-focused Feishu (Lark) channel for DeepSeek Harness: allowlisted remote-agent access with workspace-scoped paths, symlink checks, risk-based approvals, session isolation, redacted logs, and bounded message queues.
- [WYR-233/dsh-whale-guard](https://github.com/WYR-233/dsh-whale-guard) - Safety guard that makes self-killing commands impossible: a safe_kill tool that always excludes the caller and every ancestor process, a bash pre-execute check for pkill self-matches, sudo -S stdin grabs, rm -rf / and similar patterns, and an extensible rule library with block / warn / hint severities.
- [wzn16/dsh-fs-allowlist](https://github.com/wzn16/dsh-fs-allowlist) - Approval-free writes into whitelisted directories — wraps the filesystem fence for write/edit tools and auto-answers bash sandbox escalations that touch whitelisted paths, with a settings GUI.
- [x2802490130-prog/dsh-lan-pass](https://github.com/x2802490130-prog/dsh-lan-pass) - A LAN password gate for the Web UI: phones and tablets on the same network log in with a shared key and see the same sessions in real time, with a built-in randomUUID polyfill for plain-HTTP origins.
- [xbzbing/dsh-auth-gateway](https://github.com/xbzbing/dsh-auth-gateway) - Password + TOTP two-factor authentication gateway for the dsh web UI: every HTTP request and WebSocket upgrade is refused until login, with per-source lockout, global rate limits and one-time backup codes.
- [xevil3301/dsh-chatlock](https://github.com/xevil3301/dsh-chatlock) - Session password lock plus an encrypted directory vault for DeepSeek Harness.
- [xgone/dsh-remote](https://github.com/xgone/dsh-remote) - Secure remote access for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a login gate, MFA/TOTP, signed session cookies, optional admin/user/guest roles, in-browser workspace selection, and allowlisted remote file previews.
- [XiaoSHang05/dsh-rice-guard](https://github.com/XiaoSHang05/dsh-rice-guard) - Watches a turn's thinking and output streams and cancels the turn when the model starts repeating itself. Four detectors: a verbatim cycle, a counting loop whose lines differ only by a number, repeated lines separated by other text, and a user-supplied phrase list. A catch raises a manual-dismiss alarm card in the global overlay with an optional tone, and a Monitor tab holds the switches, thresholds and hit history. Detection is local string comparison with no model calls, so it costs no tokens.
- [xiezouqu12/dsh-info-records](https://github.com/xiezouqu12/dsh-info-records) - Encrypted local credential vault for DeepSeek Harness: sidebar record management, an info_records tool for pre-sign-in lookups, opt-in chat capture, per-record manual-only mode, and AES-256-GCM storage protected by Windows DPAPI, the macOS Keychain, or the Linux Secret Service.
- [xlennart/dsh-auto-review-jev](https://github.com/xlennart/dsh-auto-review-jev) - DeepSeek Harness approval guardian: a reviewer model decides permission requests before they reach you, with a System One decision-API backend (TypeSafe Jev, SiliconFlow, self-hosted Laya), a configurable low-confidence policy and an allow-rule whitelist.
- [xtd1145/dsh-full-access-switch](https://github.com/xtd1145/dsh-full-access-switch) - One-time Full access switch for DeepSeek Harness: new sessions (workspaces and conversations) start with danger-full-access and skip the per-session Full access confirmation; installable as a dsh bundle or via patch scripts.
- [Yazzyk/dsh-file-shield](https://github.com/Yazzyk/dsh-file-shield) - Blocks an agent from reading, searching, writing, or editing chosen files and directories, keeping their contents out of the conversation — including sensitive-word files whose text can make later provider requests fail with a 400. Rules are picked from a file/directory browser on the plugin page.
- [ylwl1997/noatmark-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/ylwl1997/noatmark-dsh-plugin) - Text hygiene as a dsh plugin: sanitize untrusted text, scan invisible characters, clean LLM formatting, and escape CSV formula injection.
- [yuloop/dsh-secret-vault](https://github.com/yuloop/dsh-secret-vault) - Hands secrets and PII to the agent without them entering its context, with checksum-validated extraction and masked content classification.
- [Yuuz12/dsh-webui-auth](https://github.com/Yuuz12/dsh-webui-auth) - WebUI authentication enforced at the HTTP/transport layer: four-layer login gate (resources, plugin bundles, /api, WebSocket), server-side sessions with HttpOnly cookies.
- [yyfdfsyyf-source/dsh-hard-gate](https://github.com/yyfdfsyyf-source/dsh-hard-gate) - An independent permission gate above the built-in sandbox. It blocks writes outside the workspace and to protected paths even under danger-full-access, refuses whole-file overwrites without a complete fresh read, and keeps ZIP restore points plus Recycle Bin copies before destructive actions.
- [yzxxy010/dsh-workspace-write-plus](https://github.com/yzxxy010/dsh-workspace-write-plus) - Adds a workspace-write++ permission that keeps file tools inside the workspace while skipping the Windows process sandbox for wildcard-allowlisted executables such as Git Bash.
- [ZeroClave/zeroclave-dsh-privacy](https://github.com/ZeroClave/zeroclave-dsh-privacy) - Detect and redact sensitive message text before sending it to models, with local regex, browser BERT, or ZeroClave API detection and manual review.
- [zhang8019/dsh-permission-matrix](https://github.com/zhang8019/dsh-permission-matrix) - Turns DSH permissions into 9 selectable presets (3 sandbox modes x 4 approval tiers), with rule plus LLM risk classification across four risk levels, password-gated approval for high-risk operations, and a JSONL audit log.
- [zhangmiao03/cloakpack#dsh-cloak](https://github.com/zhangmiao03/cloakpack/tree/main/packages/dsh-cloak) - Context firewall for DeepSeek Harness: credentials in successful plain-text tool results become opaque ⟦cloak:category:n⟧ placeholders before they reach the model, with originals kept only in a process-memory, agent-scoped vault. 36 built-in signature families (shared with the cloakpack git pre-push guard), key-name rules for unknown formats, custom regex rules, dry-run mode, an audit log, and the /cloak command.
- [zhengqiuyang/dsh-attest-chain](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-attest-chain) - Signed chain-of-custody for sessions: every watched tool result appends a hash-chained, ed25519-signed record, with commits bound into the chain — tampering with any line or truncating the tail fails deterministic replay verification.
- [zhengqiuyang/dsh-compaction-guard](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-compaction-guard) - Compaction integrity: directive lines (never/must/必须 style markers) extracted from the compacted range are verified against the summary — verbatim or by content-word coverage — and every constraint the session silently forgot is reported and written to a JSONL ledger; pinned constraints from config are checked on every compaction.
- [zhengqiuyang/dsh-egress-gate](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-egress-gate) - Deterministic network egress gate: web fetches and searches are checked against a destination allowlist in tools/pre-execute and denied before they run; shell fetch-verbs are observed (enforcement opt-in).
- [zhengqiuyang/dsh-freeze](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-freeze) - Hermetic composition lock: fingerprints the profile's dependencies, bundle order, lockfile and patch layer; booting a drifted composition warns, or fails under strict mode (the --frozen posture for CI).
- [zhengqiuyang/dsh-mcp-test](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-mcp-test) - Tool-surface snapshot and drift gate: baselines the full visible tool registry (name/description/parameters, MCP tools included) into a committable JSON file and warns loudly when an upgrade adds, removes or reshapes a tool.
- [zhengqiuyang/dsh-pr-gate](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-pr-gate) - Deterministic write gate: scope policy denies out-of-scope write/edit calls before they touch the disk, residue rules scan the written text, and every decision lands in a content-hashed JSONL ledger; can reuse the repo's agent-pr-gate.yaml so CI and session enforce one policy.
- [zhengqiuyang/dsh-prompt-drift](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-prompt-drift) - System-prompt surface drift gate: every section any plugin or preset contributes to the assembled system prompt is hashed and baselined; a silent rewrite of what the model is told fails loud.
- [zhengqiuyang/dsh-read-guard](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-read-guard) - Deterministic prompt-injection interception: tool results from file reads, repo searches and web fetches are scanned before they enter model context; high-severity findings quarantine-wrap or block, and credential-material files quarantine on the path alone.
- [zhengqiuyang/dsh-trust-panel](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-trust-panel) - Plain-language trust dashboard for the dsh trust family: aggregates the nine channels (injection interception, write denials, egress blocks, custody-chain verification, tool-surface and prompt drift, leftover scans, forgotten compaction constraints, profile composition) into one right-sidebar panel with a single status light and event cards that translate engine jargon into sentences a non-security user can act on; the read and egress engines run from the package's own npm dependencies so those channels work even without the sibling plugins, and absent plugins simply show as not installed.
- [zjuhbh/dsh-full-with-approval](https://github.com/zjuhbh/dsh-full-with-approval) - Fourth permission preset for dsh: unconfined, GPU-capable sessions (danger-full-access) with per-operation user approval for writes outside the workspace or to protected paths (.git/**, .env*); implemented purely as a bundle over the official tools/pre-execute ask hook, no core edits.
- [zoahdev/dsh-poison-guard](https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-poison-guard) - Pre-install supply-chain poison scanner for DSH plugins: AST (JS-X-Ray) + deobfuscation + regex heuristics, exits non-zero on findings for CI gating.
- [zzstar101/dsh-sandbox-noop-escalation](https://github.com/zzstar101/dsh-sandbox-noop-escalation) - Removes sandbox_permissions / justification arguments that cannot widen the call's current sandbox mode, so calls no longer fail with 'sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode'. GPT models tend to fill these optional fields on every call and pick workspace-write, which is narrower than danger-full-access. Runs in tools/pre-execute: compares the requested mode with the mode the session's sandbox policy resolves, and drops the fields when the request is the same or narrower (also drops a lone justification). Also understands the values GPT carries over from Codex's own shell tool: null, empty and use_default are treated as no request, and in a danger-full-access session any value (including require_escalated) is dropped because nothing is wider. Real widening requests, unknown modes and tools that do not advertise DSH's escalation schema are left to DSH core. Never widens permissions. Configurable tool list (default bash, pwsh, write, edit, run_code). Zero dependencies.

### Remote & Mobile

- [1032740078/dsh-web-url-view](https://github.com/1032740078/dsh-web-url-view) - Adds a View URL page to Settings showing the running session tokenized Web address plus a stable fixed address that survives desktop restarts and is reachable from other devices on the same LAN.
- [2710586329/dsh-qq](https://github.com/2710586329/dsh-qq) - Bridges QQ into DeepSeek Harness over OneBot 11: private and group chats, on-device voice-to-text, image support, and ten interaction tools (poke, react, like, image, file, recall and more). Needs an OneBot 11 implementation such as NapCat running alongside.
- [452926826/dsh-feishu-bot](https://github.com/452926826/dsh-feishu-bot) - Connect Feishu chats to DeepSeek Harness projects, conversations, replies, and scoped tool approvals over WebSocket.
- [452926826/dsh-ssh-logs](https://github.com/452926826/dsh-ssh-logs) - Read and search bounded log output from allowlisted SSH servers and log roots without exposing arbitrary remote commands.
- [534119219/chicheng-gate](https://github.com/534119219/chicheng-gate) - LAN / remote-access control, frpc NAT tunneling, a panel password gate, and mobile UI adaptation for the DSH Web GUI.
- [6mt/dsh-plugin-loopback-trust](https://github.com/6mt/dsh-plugin-loopback-trust) - Restores Host-persisted settings when dsh web is reached through a reverse proxy on a non-loopback hostname: marks the page connection as host-owning so the Settings and model pages load instead of reporting "settings are unavailable in this browser". For dsh 0.1.7 – 0.2.x.
- [abbaababa/dsh-mobile-access](https://github.com/abbaababa/dsh-mobile-access) - Open a Mac or Windows DeepSeek Harness Web instance from iPhone or iPad Safari: 8-digit pairing, a LAN gateway for loopback-only hosts, optional Tailscale Serve, and iOS-only Safari input and touch fixes. Installs with dsh plugin add.
- [AcidGr/dsh-web-lan-access](https://github.com/AcidGr/dsh-web-lan-access) - LAN/remote access for the Web UI: injects a crypto.randomUUID polyfill on plain-HTTP origins so the frontend survives LAN or Tailscale IP direct links.
- [ahian-lee/dsh-ssh-workspace](https://github.com/ahian-lee/dsh-ssh-workspace) - SSH workspaces for Windows DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.2: discover OpenSSH hosts, add or browse remote project directories, and route file, search and Bash operations by workspace while the DSH runtime stays local. A Desktop compatibility fork of Yan-Zero/dsh-remote-ssh that preserves local permission defaults.
- [ai-eks/dsh-auth-tunnel](https://github.com/ai-eks/dsh-auth-tunnel) - Password-gated public access for the DSH Web GUI through quick or named Cloudflare Tunnels, with HTTP/WebSocket proxying and an in-app directory picker.
- [AIcivilization/dsh-vps](https://github.com/AIcivilization/dsh-vps) - One-command VPS deployment for DeepSeek Harness: a zero-dependency login gateway with automatic HTTPS that proxies the native web UI, a token-protected setup wizard, and one-click DSH upgrades with automatic rollback; as a plugin it adds Settings → VPS Deploy to install DSH on (or remove it from) a VPS over SSH from a form, plus version, upgrade, gateway status and a QR code to add DSH to a phone's home screen.
- [AIcivilization/dsh-vps-manager](https://github.com/AIcivilization/dsh-vps-manager) - Manage VPS servers over SSH key login: 22 zero-token /vps- commands (status queries, recipe installs with a plan and /vps-yes confirmation, reboot that waits for the machine to come back), an in-conversation terminal (xterm.js over ssh -tt) for interactive programs, 5 agent tools with risk-tiered confirmation, file backup with automatic restore and a firewall/SSH safety net, 29 built-in recipes, and a settings page for adding machines.
- [aleksvega/dsh-tg-bridge](https://github.com/aleksvega/dsh-tg-bridge) - Drive a dsh agent from Telegram: one chat topic per project directory, voice and photo input, ordered per-topic job queue, per-topic goals and task checklists, session forks and branches, live progress message, command menu in en/ru/zh, and control commands for models, plugins, sessions and logs. Search the plugin registry, read a package card before installing, and update every plugin with one tap. Requires a Telegram bot token and your numeric user id in allowedUserIds.
- [alextangson/dsh-dispatch#plugin](https://github.com/alextangson/dsh-dispatch/tree/main/packages/plugin) - Phone-side command center rather than a web-UI mirror: dispatch tasks into isolated git worktrees from a PWA, tool-approval push notifications with phone/desktop first-answer-wins racing (never auto-approved), a multi-machine session board, and an end-to-end encrypted zero-knowledge relay you can self-host.
- [andyfan1094/dsh-winrm](https://github.com/andyfan1094/dsh-winrm) - Manage Windows hosts over WinRM from a web panel and seven agent tools with PowerShell exec, service and process control, SMB / chunked file transfer with SHA-256 verification, and cluster execution.
- [ANetResearch/ANet#dsh-anet](https://github.com/ANetResearch/ANet/tree/main/deploy/plugins/dist/dsh) - Connects DSH to a local anet node through a stdio MCP client, with three skills and 14 tools to discover agents on the AgentNetwork, send, track and answer end-to-end encrypted A2A tasks, pay or decline priced skills within the operator's limits, read the local evidence chain and report the node state. Linux/macOS only; requires an anet 0.3.0+ node running locally.
- [AprilCrystal/dsh-remote](https://github.com/AprilCrystal/dsh-remote) - OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint for DSH sessions plus a phone panel that reads transcripts, browses files, sends or queues messages, and answers approvals and questions.
- [ArimaKana-Akane/dsh-sakurafrp](https://github.com/ArimaKana-Akane/dsh-sakurafrp) - Manage the SakuraFrp phone-to-desktop link from the DSH interface - link status, mobile gateway switch, one-time pairing QR code, device revoke and gateway self-heal.
- [dsh-qq-bot](https://github.com/arrow1031-dev/dsh-qq-bot) - Connects DeepSeek Harness to QQ over OneBot 11/12, Satori, Milky or the official QQ bot API, with a separate session per group or private chat and nine built-in tools: group management, chat history with image understanding, web search, page fetching, reverse image search and image generation. Optional proactive chatter reads recent messages on an interval and decides whether to join in, with the judging and speaking stages able to use different models. Models, proxy and allowlists are configured in the DSH settings page. First run requires an owner (auth.owners): with it empty the plugin drives no sessions at all (deny by default, so installing it does not expose the bot); once set, private chats and groups work immediately, guests only reach the guest tool allowlist while qqbot and qqconfig stay owner-only.
- [Artenx/dsh-honeybee#dshb](https://github.com/Artenx/dsh-honeybee/tree/main/packages/dshb) - Routes DSH filesystem, shell, subprocess, and PTY operations to local, SSH, and Docker execution nodes, with a node registry, an authentication gate, a mobile-aware management UI, and per-workspace custom project instructions.
- [Autumn984/dsh-remote](https://github.com/Autumn984/dsh-remote) - Control DeepSeek Harness from a phone via QR code: read chats, send messages, upload images, over LAN, IPv6, or a Cloudflare tunnel.
- [Aztech-Lab/dsh-3301](https://github.com/Aztech-Lab/dsh-3301) - Password-optional LAN entry for the DSH Web GUI. DSH stays loopback-only while a settings-card plugin serves its HTTP and WebSocket traffic on port 3301, storing the password only as a scrypt verifier.
- [azure5100/huahua-dsh-chatroom](https://github.com/azure5100/huahua-dsh-chatroom) - Install-time patch guard for cross-machine DSH group chat: fixes dsh-weave rc.14 defects (inject crash, random UDP port, 4KB ack frame limit) with four idempotent patches, alongside setup, mechanism and ops docs for the dsh-chat x dsh-weave x dsh-bridge chatroom stack.
- [baixianger/dsh-network](https://github.com/baixianger/dsh-network) - Authenticated LAN, Tailnet, and public HTTPS access for a DSH Host, with persistent host identity, pairing, and QR setup.
- [baixianger/dsh-weave](https://github.com/baixianger/dsh-weave) - Trusted Iroh mesh networking for DSH hosts, with encrypted peer discovery, remote session delivery, and reachability status.
- [baosfeng/my-dsh-plugins#dsh-my-remote](https://github.com/baosfeng/my-dsh-plugins/tree/main/plugins/dsh-my-remote) - Remote control: pushes ask / approval / session-end events to an external channel webhook and lets you answer, approve, query status or continue a session from your phone with token auth (npm: `dsh-my-remote`).
- [bbtssama/dsh-webui-mobile](https://github.com/bbtssama/dsh-webui-mobile) - Mobile web shell for the DSH Web GUI: overlay drawers, draggable FAB, mobile composer fixes, and a floating image-upload button pinned above the composer (native gallery/camera, integrated with the validated add-images pipeline), zero desktop regression. Published on npm as dsh-webui-mobile.
- [beiheng127/dsh-dfy-qq](https://github.com/beiheng127/dsh-dfy-qq) - QQ chat behaviour layer for DeepSeek Harness over OneBot 11: persona files injected into every turn, a people file keyed by QQ number, sticker picking with probability and pity, optional non-mention replies, sub-personas distilled from group members, and scheduled messages. Enabling the built-in QQ channel accepts private messages from any QQ user and group messages from any group that @s the bot; there is no sender allowlist, so restrict the bot account or keep the channel off.
- [Bernardxu123/dsh-mobile-gate](https://github.com/Bernardxu123/dsh-mobile-gate) - LAN mobile gateway: isolated child-process reverse proxy with first-visit approval, per-device token binding, rate limiting, and mobile layout injection (compact composer pills, randomUUID polyfill).
- [better-er/dsh-remote-file-system](https://github.com/better-er/dsh-remote-file-system) - Model-visible SSH file tools read_remote, write_remote and edit_remote: read a remote UTF-8 file with line-numbered paging, create a new remote file (an existing target is refused, there is no overwrite branch), and apply literal replacements with unique-match checking — all addressed through a single "alias:path" field whose alias comes from ~/.ssh/config.
- [bigbigtooth/DSH-DevOps-Plugin](https://github.com/bigbigtooth/DSH-DevOps-Plugin) - Remote operations for the DSH Web app: manages SSH servers, collects hardware and process metrics, inspects logs with a read-only AI pass, and deploys a Git repo over SSH using git pull --ff-only plus a health check. Credentials are AES-256-GCM encrypted. Linux and macOS hosts; no Windows support.
- [Blank-not-black/dsh-Remote#plugin](https://github.com/Blank-not-black/dsh-Remote/tree/main/packages/plugin) - Mobile remote-control suite: bundle plugin with native sidebar entry and admin drawer, self-healing bearer-token gateway over LAN/Tailscale, Android app (sessions/approvals/questions/goals), /fs/* file transfer (Range resume, 2GB upload), latency-based multi-server auto-switch, offline chat cache.
- [BotonJ/dsh-remote-link](https://github.com/BotonJ/dsh-remote-link) - Secure remote access for the official Web UI: authenticated LAN/tunnel gateway with QR + HMAC one-time pairing, per-device sessions and revocation, mDNS discovery, and a fork_session tool.
- [btsd321/dsh-remote-explorer](https://github.com/btsd321/dsh-remote-explorer) - Remote development launcher for DeepSeek Harness: provisions dsh on a remote host via SSH (or a local WSL distro) and connects from the local client, with LLM credentials proxied through a reverse tunnel so they never leave the local machine. Ships as both a standalone CLI and a dsh plugin with a session panel, /remote-explorer slash command and remote_* agent tools.
- [Buzzso/dsh-sev](https://github.com/Buzzso/dsh-sev) - Manage your own remote DSH host from the local GUI: SSH tunnels, mixed remote session list, one-click remote GUI, auto-healing tunnels.
- [caoyiwei850/dsh-ssh-ops](https://github.com/caoyiwei850/dsh-ssh-ops) - SSH ops terminal for DSH Web UI: drive a connected server from the main conversation (ssh_connect/ssh_exec/ssh_read/ssh_write/ssh_disconnect) while keeping an interactive xterm.js terminal on the right.
- [CCYellowStar2/dsh-astrbot-ingress](https://github.com/CCYellowStar2/dsh-astrbot-ingress) - Drive a local DeepSeek Harness agent from QQ and other IM channels through AstrBot: send tasks with /dsh, continue by quoting or @-mentioning the bot, answer approvals and ask_user_question prompts from chat (in parallel with the DSH web UI), and get results, inline images and file cards back. Ships session / workspace / model / permission commands, /compact and /last recovery, three progress-display modes, and group-shared or per-user session scoping.
- [ChenJun25/dsh-console-plugin](https://github.com/ChenJun25/dsh-console-plugin) - Pair a phone with this computer's DSH instance by QR code or a six-digit code, then drive it remotely — send instructions, view images, answer approvals — from the panel, with public-tunnel support for pairing across networks.
- [chinahhy/DSH-plugins#dsh-tether-ios](https://github.com/chinahhy/DSH-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-tether-ios) - iOS remote companion for DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 on macOS Apple Silicon, with pairing, approval notifications, and device revocation.
- [Cike-money/dsh-qq-bridge](https://github.com/Cike-money/dsh-qq-bridge) - Bridge QQ (via NapCat) into DeepSeek Harness, turning private and group chats into session prompts and sending replies back to QQ.
- [cindyguyuehu123/dsh-mobile](https://github.com/cindyguyuehu123/dsh-mobile) - Use DSH from iPhone/iPad: an explicit-opt-in LAN reverse proxy (Host/Origin rewrite through the loopback trust fence, WebSocket upgrades included), iOS PWA chrome (home-screen icon, standalone meta, viewport-fit), and touch/mobile CSS (safe areas, keyboard lifting, composer row fit).
- [CJYLZS/dsh-remote-development](https://github.com/CJYLZS/dsh-remote-development) - Remote development over SSH: pick a directory on a registered machine as the session workspace and the file, shell, bash, and search tools run on the remote host — the agent works there with the same local tools, and no extra model-facing tools are added.
- [Clarklevis1995/dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway](https://github.com/Clarklevis1995/dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway) - Authenticated mobile gateway for DeepSeek Harness: connects the companion native iOS client over WebSocket for sessions, live events, tasks, goals, approvals, commands, and file transfers, with QR pairing and device revocation.
- [clarknu/dsh-gateway](https://github.com/clarknu/dsh-gateway) - HTTPS + login gateway for the DeepSeek Harness web surface: access your DSH Web UI securely from another machine on your LAN, or from the internet via port forwarding. Fail-closed defaults (loopback-only, no accounts until configured); setup and security notes in the README.
- [CLASSLU/dsh-telegram-bridge](https://github.com/CLASSLU/dsh-telegram-bridge) - Remote-control your dsh agent from Telegram: chat, skills, workspace browsing, and file transfer.

Requires @linxin666/dsh-remote-web-ui (it serves /pair-app); the watchdog scripts are Windows-only.

Also ships a GUI sidebar panel. Formerly dsh-taskwatch; the npm package is now dsh-in-hand.

- [donoteatme/dsh-local-link](https://github.com/donoteatme/dsh-local-link) - Browser-first, LAN-only access to the current DeepSeek Harness Web UI with one-time QR pairing, revocable devices, event-driven diagnostics, and a slot-preserving mobile layout; no companion app, cloud relay, or remote tunnel.
- [drliuhuan/dsh-plugin-feishu-im](https://github.com/drliuhuan/dsh-plugin-feishu-im) - Feishu IM bridge for dsh: create a dedicated Feishu bot by scanning a QR code, get one Card JSON 2.0 notice per finished turn, answer tool approvals and structured questions from the chat, and drive a session from it — listing and switching the bound session with /sessions and /resume, steering a running turn, and choosing per-chat permission modes (read-only, workspace, Auto Review, full). Long output paginates instead of being cut. Owner binding: the QR scan binds the scanner; with manually entered credentials the first sender claims ownership and everyone else is refused.
- [drscrewdriver/dsh-im-union](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-im-union) - Union IM bridge for DSH — an independent implementation uniting the capability sets of community peer plugins (xmanrui/dsh-im, MichengAI/dsh-im-connect). Drive your agent session from 15 channel adapters across 12 platforms (including email; WeCom/DingTalk/QQ each contribute two: bot + self-built app or notify tier) — WeChat (official iLink QR bind), Feishu/Lark (long-connection + streaming cards; the voice tier requires system ffmpeg), Telegram, Discord, WeCom intelligent bot & self-built app (signed callback), DingTalk (stream + AI Card and custom-robot notify), QQ official bot (plus notify tier), Slack (Socket Mode), WhatsApp (Baileys QR pairing; the dependency ships as an optionalDependency of the plugin package), Matrix, iMessage (macOS only), Email (IMAP/SMTP thread routing). The cross-version narrow waist auto-adapts settings gen1/gen2/gen3 across hosts 0.1.2-rc.1→0.2.1-rc.2 (12-tag enum; rc.2 verified by a real desktop-profile install with double read-back) using capability probing only, never version branches. In chat: a 25-command panel, tool-approval and question loops answered in the originating chat (deny-by-default, initiator-only, 5-min expiry), image/file input gated on host model metadata, deliverable file return, a delivery log with bounded retry (uncertain is never re-sent), proactive delivery and fragment composition. It also splits the native sidebar into self-owned Tasks / Channels tabs (standing down entirely when another plugin already owns the slot), registers an `im-concise` agent preset plus reply sanitisation that keeps GenUI fences and raw HTML out of text-only chats, renders `svg` fences to PNG images, guards model choice with an allowlist, and mirrors each turn's final answer to notify channels via `/relay` (addressed by account ID or alias, never guessed on ambiguity). Secrets are one-way into the vault and never echoed back. npm: `dsh-im-union`.

The relay can be hosted on the local machine (managed by the plugin) or on a VPS; the phone app and the plugin ship in one repository. 5 Remote methods.
- [MoRanYue/dsh-winrm](https://github.com/MoRanYue/dsh-winrm) - Node.js fork of andyfan1094/dsh-winrm: the same WinRM host panel and seven agent tools, with the backend ported from Python/pywinrm to a native Node WinRM client so the machine running dsh needs no Python.
- [moyu-good/dsh-lark-bridge](https://github.com/moyu-good/dsh-lark-bridge) - Feishu/Lark IM channel for DeepSeek Harness agents with native thinking-process messages, approval cards, live goal and todo cards, workflow fan-out lines, session text search, and background job and subagent settlement notices. Access is bounded by the Feishu app's own visibility scope by design — anyone the app admits can drive the agent and answer its approvals unless the optional sender, group and approver allowlists are filled in.
- [mrRisega/dsh-remote#dsh-remote-web](https://github.com/mrRisega/dsh-remote/tree/main/packages/dsh-remote-web) - Remote control for dsh web from a phone browser, from anywhere (no public IP needed): hosted cloud relay works over 4G, or self-host the router; one command installs the desktop bridge and this in-harness Settings panel (cloud/self-hosted tabs, account login, bridge start/stop, feedback); the tunnel data plane is end-to-end encrypted (E2EE phone↔desktop, with a QR / one-time-link desktop grant so you never re-type the password), with HTTP/WebSocket pass-through, access-key auth, a live device list and optional traffic quotas.
- [Mrsirlila/dsh-pocket-reportModify-and-add#plugin](https://github.com/Mrsirlila/dsh-pocket-reportModify-and-add/tree/main/plugin) - Patched build of dsh-pocket for DeepSeek Harness: a password-protected entry has its access password embedded in the QR code so the phone signs in with one scan, and a read-only /dsh-pocket/entry.json endpoint lets the phone app re-sync the current public URL and password while still on the LAN.
- [MyPanda-Hash/CHENGXIAO](https://github.com/MyPanda-Hash/CHENGXIAO) - Pairs two DeepSeek Harness machines with a one-time code - directly on a LAN, or across networks through an end-to-end-encrypted relay with a zero-config official default - so one agent can run tasks and exchange files on the other while each machine keeps its own files in place.
- [MyRemme/dsh-lan-pair](https://github.com/MyRemme/dsh-lan-pair) - LAN-only remote access for DSH: pair a phone or another PC by QR code or token to open the same web UI, with optional key-free access inside the LAN.
- [Mzy123l/dsh-plugin-remote-access](https://github.com/Mzy123l/dsh-plugin-remote-access) - Exposes the local DSH web GUI to one chosen CIDR range only (Tailscale by default) instead of binding 0.0.0.0: the proxy listens on addresses inside that range, rejects peers outside it, and admits clients by either a tokenised URL or a 4-12 character alphanumeric access code. Remote pages can be forced into a phone layout without changing the local UI, and the official appearance, font size, transcript view, code view and performance settings can be stored in the plugin config and re-applied on every remote page load.
- [mzzsfy/dsh-plugin#dsh-auto-trust-all](https://github.com/mzzsfy/dsh-plugin/tree/main/packages/dsh-auto-trust-all) - Dynamically trusts every Host header that actually arrives and flips the default web binding to 0.0.0.0: wildcard or unenumerable entry domains work without editing the start command, the authentication layer is untouched, and hosts are evicted by LRU beyond a capacity cap.
- [NattoCB/dsh-plugin-wechat-bridge](https://github.com/NattoCB/dsh-plugin-wechat-bridge) - Bridges WeChat (ilink bot) private chats into DSH agent sessions and streams replies back, with hot-plug and a Settings tab.
- [NelsonLongXiang/dsh-open-a2a-net](https://github.com/NelsonLongXiang/dsh-open-a2a-net) - Turns a DSH deployment into one node of a decentralized agent network — signed agent cards, peer and zone discovery, direct message-routing model tools, and joinable session nodes in the web sidebar.
- [netbka/local-commander-plugins](https://github.com/netbka/local-commander-plugins) - Connects DeepSeek Harness to the hosted Local Commander MCP server at localcmd.app via mcp-remote with browser sign-in, to read files and Git, run the checks you approve and check local services on your Windows computers. Requires a Local Commander account and the paired agent running on the Windows PC.
- [NOirBRight/dsh-mobile-pairing](https://github.com/NOirBRight/dsh-mobile-pairing) - Mobile remote pairing for DSH with QR offers, a loopback Host Gateway, encrypted Relay or Quick Tunnel transport, same-LAN WebRTC Direct, and revocable Device Tokens for the Android client.
- [OMSociety/dsh-ssh-tunnel](https://github.com/OMSociety/dsh-ssh-tunnel) - Multi-host SSH workbench: keep remote servers in a host library, grant them per project, and open an interactive terminal or dual-pane SFTP in the right sidebar, while the SSHManager tool runs remote commands and transfers files without exposing keys to the model.
- [onesmash/dsh-remote-bot-bridge](https://github.com/onesmash/dsh-remote-bot-bridge) - Bot-to-bot messaging across machines on top of ds-harness-remote: five tools let a local Bot list the peer Host Bots, pin a target device and send it a message, without switching the local window.
- [ook826092-cloud/dsh-mobile-css](https://github.com/ook826092-cloud/dsh-mobile-css) - Mobile adaptation for the DSH Web UI: compact typography, full-width composer with caret fix, drawer sidebar with overlay-close, two-page settings flow, responsive tables and stats, safe touch targets.
- [OrderG-X/dsh-mobile](https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-mobile) - Use DSH from a phone browser. Turn on phone access from the phone button in the session header (or the plugin card) and scan the QR code; the phone opens the official DSH web UI served by the desktop process, with the same sessions updating live, so you can follow a running task, reply and approve away from the computer. A gateway inside DSH (port 18765) proxies the web UI and handles the desktop login itself. One QR code works on Wi-Fi and on mobile data: turning access on also starts a free Cloudflare quick tunnel (cloudflared is downloaded from Cloudflare's GitHub releases if missing), and its address survives DSH restarts, so phones do not need to rescan. Pairing codes are one-time and expire in 10 minutes, each phone gets its own revocable credential, the header button shows when a phone is connected, and idle connections get keepalive pings. Optional push notifications go to Bark, ntfy, ServerChan, Feishu / WeCom / DingTalk group bots, Telegram or any webhook when a task finishes (after 30 seconds or more), stops with an error, or waits for an approval or an answer; they carry only the session title and status, and approval still happens in DSH. On a phone the web UI's side panels slide over the page, and it can be added to the home screen with its own icon.
- [oxmumu3/dot-dsh-connector#dot-dsh-management](https://github.com/oxmumu3/dot-dsh-connector/tree/main/management-plugin) - Native Harness workbench and local gateway for Dot to read saved projects and conversations, dispatch native tasks, inspect progress, continue or cancel tasks, and manage connection authorization.
- [pan17/dsh-wechat](https://github.com/pan17/dsh-wechat) - Bridges WeChat private chats into DeepSeek Harness as an in-process plugin over Tencent's iLink bot protocol, with two-way text, image, file and voice messaging, in-WeChat slash commands resolved through the native command registry, WeChat-side handling of approvals and agent questions, and proactive push through a send_wechat tool.
- [peng456/dsh-plugin-mesh](https://github.com/peng456/dsh-plugin-mesh) - Discovers other DSH instances on the local network by UDP multicast or port scan, lists them in a sidebar panel together with the capabilities each one reports, and dispatches tasks between machines in both directions over the LAN or over an automatically downloaded userspace Tailscale node.
- [PerryLink/dsh-reach](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-reach) - Pushes DSH approval and question cards to IM channels (WeChat first) and answers them from chat, with a session console, per-channel security, and an open push service.
- [polaris-smart/dsh-devices](https://github.com/polaris-smart/dsh-devices) - Decentralized multi-device fleet: mDNS LAN discovery, key pairing, and SSH direct execution across networks.
- [Raiyan007-gb/dsh-remote-tunnel-easy](https://github.com/Raiyan007-gb/dsh-remote-tunnel-easy) - Scan a QR code in Settings to open the DeepSeek Harness web UI on your phone inside the active session via a cloudflared quick tunnel.
- [RestRegular/dsh-pocket](https://github.com/RestRegular/dsh-pocket) - A separate narrow-screen web surface for DeepSeek Harness rather than the desktop GUI scaled down: it serves its own session list and chat stream behind a random access token over LAN, a tunnel (cloudflared, localtunnel or localhost.run) or an SSH reverse forward through a server you own. On the phone it streams assistant text, thinking, tool calls and results, sends prompts, stops the running turn, answers blocking questions and tool approvals (including ones waiting in other sessions), switches model, thinking level and permission preset, sends up to four photos compressed on the device, and keeps the computer awake.
- [rice-awa/dsh-lan-gateway](https://github.com/rice-awa/dsh-lan-gateway) - Publishes the DSH Web GUI to LAN or internet with dsh kept on loopback. Every source must sign in for an HMAC session cookie unless passwordless LAN is opted into. Adds self-signed or custom TLS, a secureCookies override for plaintext-HTTP proxies, and a UUID shim for plain-HTTP origins.
- [RyensX/dsh-remote-gateway](https://github.com/RyensX/dsh-remote-gateway) - Provides a secure reverse proxy, enabling DeepSeek Harness to be accessed remotely and to converse with AI anytime, anywhere.
- [SAXEM1997/dsh-cherry-bridge](https://github.com/SAXEM1997/dsh-cherry-bridge) - Bridge DeepSeek Harness sessions to Cherry Studio desktops over the LAN - QR pairing, 14 cherry_* tools for agents/sessions/history/interactions, and a settings page for devices and per-workspace tool scope.
- [saya-ch/dsh-mobile](https://github.com/saya-ch/dsh-mobile) - Access DeepSeek Harness from the Android app or a mobile browser with secure LAN and remote connections, persistent device pairing, and a customizable mobile interface.
- [scientificmaniac/dsh-ssh-vault](https://github.com/scientificmaniac/dsh-ssh-vault) - Store SSH hosts in an AES-256-GCM vault and let the agent run commands on them by alias, with passwords handed to ssh through SSH_ASKPASS instead of the command line. Windows only.
- [Shr-CS/dsh-wechat-channel](https://github.com/Shr-CS/dsh-wechat-channel) - WeChat Official Account channel for DSH — WeChat messages run agent turns and the answers are pushed back through the customer-service message API, with signature-checked callbacks and an openid allowlist.
- [siberiah2o/dsh-plugin-remote](https://github.com/siberiah2o/dsh-plugin-remote) - Remote access gateway for the DSH Web GUI: login auth plus an HTTP/WebSocket reverse proxy to the loopback server, no --trusted-host needed.
- [siqyka/dsh-ssh-workspace](https://github.com/siqyka/dsh-ssh-workspace) - Use a directory on an SSH host as a DSH workspace — hosts management, directory browser, five agent tools.
- [somebdly/dsh-docker](https://github.com/somebdly/dsh-docker) - Web management panel for Docker on DeepSeek Harness: manages Docker MCP servers (deploy/remove, official catalog search/pull, gateway start-stop-restart, custom deploy) and containers/images (list, start/stop/restart, remove, logs, inspect, interactive terminal, create, pull, build, load) across local CLI and SSH remote targets with one-click switching. - [songofhawk/dsh-alpha](https://github.com/songofhawk/dsh-alpha) - Multi-machine, multi-agent orchestration and control plane for DSH: discovers Agents and workspaces across devices, routes tasks by machine, repository, capability, and load to local or remote Agent runtimes, streams progress and results, forwards approvals, and recovers durable tasks after disconnections.
- [sunrulin123/dsh-community-web-ui](https://github.com/sunrulin123/dsh-community-web-ui) - Standalone remote Web UI for DeepSeek Harness with mobile viewport, soft-keyboard and touch-target adaptations while leaving the native Desktop presentation unchanged.
- [swarm-apps/dsh-swarmdrop](https://github.com/swarm-apps/dsh-swarmdrop) - Device channel between the agent and your own phone: it sends files it just produced, and you @-reference what your phone sent back. - [Sycada/dsh-remote-ssh-tools](https://github.com/Sycada/dsh-remote-ssh-tools) - SSH session manager for DeepSeek Harness: saved profiles, agent ssh_run, interactive terminals, and SFTP with secrets kept in the DSH credential center.
- [T1gerD/open-whale#dsh-openwhale](https://github.com/T1gerD/open-whale/tree/main/packages/plugin) - Turns a phone into a personal assistant for the DeepSeek Harness on your computer — pair once by QR code, then chat, send photos and files, watch replies stream, and collaborate from several phones at once over LAN, Tailscale or a public tunnel. - [taxah92/dsh-pve-vm](https://github.com/taxah92/dsh-pve-vm) - Control Proxmox VE virtual machines from the conversation: 16 tools for the VM console over VNC (screenshots, mouse, keyboard, batched actions, Unicode text and clipboard) and for running commands and reading or writing files through the QEMU guest agent, all over one ssh connection to the node, so the host needs no X11 or Wayland.
- [tbb051122/dsh-plugin-qq-bridge](https://github.com/tbb051122/dsh-plugin-qq-bridge) - Bridge an official QQ bot to DeepSeek Harness in-process: a QQ message starts or resumes a real DSH session inside the host (it appears in the desktop sidebar when its working directory is a registered workspace) and the answer is sent back to QQ as text, image or file. - [techflag/dsh-plugin-ssh](https://github.com/techflag/dsh-plugin-ssh) - SSH terminals, SFTP file transfer and text editing inside DeepSeek Harness, with server troubleshooting through host models.

- [TGYD-helige/dsh-plugins#dsh-a2a](https://github.com/TGYD-helige/dsh-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-a2a) - A2A protocol server for dsh agents, with JSON-RPC tasks, SSE streaming, cancellation, and an agent card.
- [TiantianFlow/dsh-one-gateway](https://github.com/TiantianFlow/dsh-one-gateway) - Private loopback DSH Web gateway for Tailscale Serve, Cloudflare Access, and Headscale TCP Serve, with exact principal allowlists and guided fail-closed setup.
- [tiphareth0/dsh-hardssh#dsh-hardssh](https://github.com/tiphareth0/dsh-hardssh/tree/master/packages/dsh-hardssh) - SSH workspace and operations for DeepSeek Harness: bind a server directory as a workspace whose fs/subprocess calls route to the remote host via cordis seam replacement, plus web terminal, file transfers, tunnels, cluster runs and host management.
- [toddpan/dsh-webapi](https://github.com/toddpan/dsh-webapi) - Drive DSH from anything that speaks HTTP: 47 routes (REST + SSE) for workspaces, sessions (create/prompt, live SSE generation, history, stats, todos, cancel, ask-user Q&A), models and the global default model, providers, agent presets, settings namespaces, skills, and workspace files including resumable chunked upload — plus an OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions, a built-in OpenAPI 3.0 spec and an interactive request page. - [TongaiLinC/dsh-mobile-access](https://github.com/TongaiLinC/dsh-mobile-access) - Mobile access gateway for the Web GUI: isolated child-process reverse proxy with a first-visit PC approval gate (admin-token auth, DNS-rebinding defense), LAN/VPN/WAN auto-detection with network-mode switching, QR-code entry, WebSocket forwarding, and narrow-screen UI adaptations (composer reflow, third-party plugin overlays, crypto.randomUUID polyfill).

- [Tuiltex-0216/dsh-wechat-share](https://github.com/Tuiltex-0216/dsh-wechat-share) - Forward WeChat chat records into DSH sessions: a Windows share target captures the merged-forward ZIP, an in-GUI overlay picks the destination workspace and session, and the ZIP arrives as a file-attachment user message the agent unpacks and reads. Requires Windows 10/11 with Developer Mode on and the repo installer to register the share target.
- [TwinsEarth/dsh-windows2macos](https://github.com/TwinsEarth/dsh-windows2macos) - Run one instruction on every online Windows and macOS machine, across networks and regions: a dependency-free relay talks to each machine over outbound connections only (Tailscale, a public VPS behind TLS, or a tunnel), every machine runs the command in its own checkout, and results come back with a commit, a working-tree fingerprint and a command hash so an environment mismatch is reported as unverifiable instead of being mistaken for a different result. Sending work needs its own operator token, separate from the per-machine device token.
- [TZHR-invest/dsh-plugins#dsh-lan-gateway](https://github.com/TZHR-invest/dsh-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-lan-access) - Complete LAN/remote access for the Web UI: 0.0.0.0 binding, crypto.randomUUID polyfill, token gate (401 login page + WebSocket interception, loopback exempt), privileged-fence and settings-persistence exemptions, and an idempotent installer with upgrade recovery.

- [wangzhishou/onebox-dsh-bridge](https://github.com/wangzhishou/onebox-dsh-bridge) - Android client implementation for DeepSeek Harness: bridges local dsh web to the OneBox app with QR scan-to-pair and an end-to-end encrypted cloud relay tunnel.
- [wanjiaju3108/dsh-feishu-assistant](https://github.com/wanjiaju3108/dsh-feishu-assistant) - Ops request channel for a team over Feishu DMs — a colleague's message waits in a serial queue behind an approval card that the paired admin must accept, then runs in one shared DSH session with a persona attached, and the answer is posted back to the requester.
- [wanjiaju3108/dsh-feishu-cui](https://github.com/wanjiaju3108/dsh-feishu-cui) - Remote DSH access that needs no hosting of your own — the Feishu DM chat is the interface over the bot's outbound long connection, with cards for workspace, session (switch and rename), model, reasoning effort, permission preset and balance, and tool approvals and agent questions answered in that same chat.
- [Wayne036/dsh-plugin-login-gate](https://github.com/Wayne036/dsh-plugin-login-gate) - Password-protected HTTPS login gate that lets LAN devices securely access the DeepSeek Harness web UI over the network.

- [wentao75/dsh-remote-auth](https://github.com/wentao75/dsh-remote-auth) - DSH remote-access authorization page that shows the current process browser-session URL as a clickable link or QR code, behind an optional authority/subnet allow-list and PIN.

- [wikkd/dsh-remote-access-web#remote-access-web](https://github.com/wikkd/dsh-remote-access-web/tree/main/packages/bundle/remote-access-web) - Reverse tunnel for the DSH Web GUI: exposes a `dsh --profile web` deployment at a public frp URL and switches the directory picker to the in-app browser, so a phone or remote machine can open and manage the workspace.
- [wingsky-1/dsh-plugin-hub#packages/dsh-lan-proxy](https://github.com/wingsky-1/dsh-plugin-hub/tree/main/packages/dsh-lan-proxy) - Access the dsh web UI over LAN: HTTP/HTTPS/WS forwarding plus TLS (self-signed or custom certificates); adaptive Brotli/gzip compression for HTTP and permessage-deflate for WebSocket; half-open WebSocket probing keeps mobile clients from going stale after backgrounding; launch-token auto-injection lets LAN devices connect without copying the token; DNS-rebinding protection + loopback-only upstream allowlist.
- [winlin926/dsh-roam](https://github.com/winlin926/dsh-roam) - Remote access to running DeepSeek Harness sessions from a phone browser: scan a one-time QR code to continue conversations, answer approvals and start new tasks over Wi-Fi or a tunnel.

- [wwwyyyc/dsh-ssh-agent-workspace](https://github.com/wwwyyyc/dsh-ssh-agent-workspace) - Live remote SSH workspaces with a resident Python RPC agent, remote shell/glob/grep execution, ProxyJump support, and conflict-safe three-way cache sync.

- [xingzhen199186/dsh-mini-remote](https://github.com/xingzhen199186/dsh-mini-remote) - A minimal phone remote control for DeepSeek Harness: the phone page carries only the instruction you send and the AI's final conclusion, while tool calls, file access, sub-agent dispatch, and reasoning traces stay on the computer, reachable over LAN, Tailscale, or a Cloudflare tunnel with a QR code, link, and password for each route.

A request may name any routable model; one that omits `model` gets the current chat selection, so switching model in chat switches the endpoint. Switched on, it can also lend the model the Harness tools switched on individually, run those calls through the Harness tool runtime and feed results back up to a round limit. The listener is the plugin's own, so 127.0.0.1, 0.0.0.0 and a NAT-forwarded port all behave the same with no change to the request path. Settings cover bind address, port, API key with a generator, fallback provider and model, reasoning effort, CORS origin and timeout.
- [yabolee-kkk/dsh-streaming-mcp-bridge](https://github.com/yabolee-kkk/dsh-streaming-mcp-bridge) - DeepSeek Harness streaming MCP bridge: live session events as MCP progress, plus ACP adapter for cc-connect/Feishu.
- [YE-ZINAN/dsh-lan-gate#plugin](https://github.com/YE-ZINAN/dsh-lan-gate/tree/main/plugin) - Control surface for the dsh-lan-gate LAN gateway: a button beside Settings that shows whether the gateway is running and how many phones or tablets are waiting for approval, opens the loopback-only approval page in one click instead of typing its URL, and starts the gateway through its scheduled task first when it is not running. Not rendered on phone or tablet surfaces.
- [yuunnn/dsh-on-imessage](https://github.com/yuunnn/dsh-on-imessage) - Chat with local DeepSeek Harness agents from iPhone iMessage: switch workspaces/sessions, start new sessions, and get replies in the Messages app — no extra apps, no servers, no cloud.
- [Z-6354/dsh-mobile-hanui](https://github.com/Z-6354/dsh-mobile-hanui) - Mobile UI shell for the DSH Web GUI: turns the desktop three-column layout into a touch-friendly phone layout (overlay drawers, draggable FAB, full-screen dialogs, infinite-scroll history) under a 1024px viewport, with zero desktop impact. - Complete mobile PWA for DSH, built on dsh-mobile-gate: secure remote-access gateway plus install-to-homescreen (manifest + service worker), offline capability, touch gestures (pull-to-refresh, edge-swipe back, pinch-zoom font), agent-done push notifications, and touch-first layout — desktop unaffected.
- [zbzbhs/dsh-remote-agent](https://github.com/zbzbhs/dsh-remote-agent) - Turn another computer into a remote Agent teammate: the worker runs its own DSH and a full Agent loop locally, so dispatched tasks keep running when the link drops and its model credentials never leave that machine. The hub dispatches through 8 remote_* tools, receives only a handoff summary plus an artifact manifest, and pulls finished products on demand — intermediate artifacts stay on the worker. Pairing-code onboarding, direct or relay transport for NAT, Web panel on both sides.
- [zdx8637-gitdog/dshmobile#dshmobile-plugin](https://github.com/zdx8637-gitdog/dshmobile/tree/main/plugins) - Phone access to DSH over a self-hosted relay (WSS via your own TLS-terminating proxy): bundle plugin with bridge supervisor and QR login, a native Android app, and server-side device revocation.
- [zengpu987-ctrl/dsh-deep-connect#plugin](https://github.com/zengpu987-ctrl/dsh-deep-connect/tree/main/plugin) - Cross-device conversation and task sync for DSH: one machine generates a relay station and the others join with its invite link; every frame is end-to-end encrypted, so the relay routes a hashed channel it cannot read. Peers read each other's full transcripts and task boards, interject into a turn that is running on the owning machine, send a work command that runs in a workspace of the target machine with the model strength chosen by the sender, and can copy a conversation into a new local session and keep working on it here. Ships a token-gated phone page for listing devices, reading tasks and sending a command.
- [zexadev/dsh-tether](https://github.com/zexadev/dsh-tether) - Use the dsh web UI on your dev machine from an Android or iOS phone, connected peer-to-peer across networks via iroh; no server to set up, with a relay fallback that only carries ciphertext.
- [zhaenggg/dsh-ssh-remote](https://github.com/zhaenggg/dsh-ssh-remote) - SSH remote execution set: give a session an ssh:// workspace and every file, command, and shell operation runs on the remote host.
- [ZhangFengshun/dsh-remote-ssh](https://github.com/ZhangFengshun/dsh-remote-ssh) - VSCode Remote-SSH-style development for DSH — connect to HPC and servers over SSH, read and edit remote files in the built-in Files tab, auto-SSH terminal, remote workspaces with single-roundtrip reads and result caching, and 12 session-aware remote_ssh_* model tools.
- [zhu1090093659/dsh-web#packages/dsh-remote-web-ui](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/tree/main/packages/dsh-remote-web-ui) - Remote control of a dsh web workspace from phone or PC: QR-code pairing through a token-gated channel, SSE real-time sync, and separate mobile and full desktop GUI modes.
- [zhu1090093659/dsh-web#packages/dsh-ssh](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/tree/main/packages/dsh-ssh) - SSH ops panel for DSH: web terminal, SFTP transfer with progress, local port forwarding, and one-command cluster execution across hosts; agents share the same host config.
- [zhuiyueya/dsh-im-gateway](https://github.com/zhuiyueya/dsh-im-gateway) - Aggregated IM gateway for DeepSeek Harness: drive agents from WeChat, Feishu, Telegram, Discord, QQ, WhatsApp and 20+ chat platforms with unified sessions, remote approvals and interactive questions. By default, anyone who can message a connected bot can drive the agent; configure allowedUserIds to restrict access.
- [zhy5/dsh-wx-bridge](https://github.com/zhy5/dsh-wx-bridge) - Drive your local DSH from WeChat: a self-hosted iLink bridge over a persistent ACP session (context lives in DSH and is resumable), phone conversations grouped into the desktop workspace, with image recognition, file messages (Excel/Word/PDF, parsed by the agent itself) and voice transcripts. Tool approvals are answered inside WeChat itself (numbered card; ask/allow/reject policy; 120s timeout means reject), and any process can push a message to your phone through the outbox helper. Access defaults to strict (only registered devices are served); the phone channel's permission preset is configurable - see the README security section before sharing the bot.
- [zingzheng/dsh-gb](https://github.com/zingzheng/dsh-gb) - Use your phone as a DSH peripheral remote: send messages (typed or dictated with the phone keyboard), answer yes/no and choice prompts, browse messages and switch sessions on a Game Boy-style screen, paired over LAN QR or a built-in Cloudflare tunnel.
- [Zoragyx/dsh-phone-pair#dsh-phone-pair-kit](https://github.com/Zoragyx/dsh-phone-pair/tree/main/plugin/dsh-phone-pair-kit) - Requires the phone app, not just this plugin: the phone half is a separate APK and must be installed first — download it from https://github.com/Zoragyx/dsh-phone-pair/releases — otherwise the computer side has nothing to pair with. This package is the computer half: it enables the upstream remote-web-ui pairing plugin with a Cloudflare quick tunnel and a fixed relay subdomain, so one scan keeps the phone connected from anywhere.
- [ZSeven-W/dsh-android](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/dsh-android) - A live Android device inside the conversation — emulator or USB phone, driven entirely through adb: 20 agent tools for streaming, Gradle build and run, UI-tree or OCR interaction, logcat, processes and memory, plus a three-button navigation panel.
- [ZSeven-W/dsh-ios](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/dsh-ios) - A live iOS Simulator or USB-connected iPhone inside the conversation: 22 agent tools for booting, building, driving the UI by accessibility identity or OCR text, list-row actions and SwiftUI preview hot reload, plus a streaming sidebar panel you can tap and drag on.
- [zshqzcn/dsh-plugin-agent-bridge](https://github.com/zshqzcn/dsh-plugin-agent-bridge) - Two-way agent bridge between two DeepSeek Harness hosts: either side can ask the other agent questions and run bounded dialogues over a PSK-authenticated TCP link, with a chat page on both sides and read-only tool posture by default. Both ends need the same shared key and a nodeId configured.
- [zyfgood/dsh-a2a](https://github.com/zyfgood/dsh-a2a) - Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol bridge: serves an A2A endpoint with agent card, message/send, message/stream SSE, task lifecycle (get/cancel/resubscribe) and input-required continuation; a2a_discover/a2a_send/a2a_task_status/a2a_cancel tools for calling remote agents; plus a web ops panel with live task board, one-click cancel and a remote agent directory.
- [zyfgood/dsh-feishu-bot](https://github.com/zyfgood/dsh-feishu-bot) - Binds a Feishu/Lark bot to DeepSeek Harness over a WebSocket long connection: incoming messages run through an agent session and stream back to the chat, chat commands such as /attach manage the live session, and feishu_* tools let the model push messages.
- [zyfgood/dsh-mobile](https://github.com/zyfgood/dsh-mobile) - Mobile web UI for DeepSeek Harness: a token-protected LAN server that lists all sessions, streams replies over SSE, and lets a phone continue any conversation; the desktop GUI shows a QR entry and, with dsh-whale-girl 0.3.0+, a phone held by the pet opens the same panel.
- [zylzyqzz/dsh-mobile-pwa](https://github.com/zylzyqzz/dsh-mobile-pwa) - Complete mobile PWA for DSH, built on dsh-mobile-gate: secure remote-access gateway plus install-to-homescreen (manifest + service worker), offline capability, touch gestures (pull-to-refresh, edge-swipe back, pinch-zoom font), agent-done push notifications, and touch-first layout — desktop unaffected.

### Plugin Markets & Managers

- [1708994293-hue/dsh-auto-update](https://github.com/1708994293-hue/dsh-auto-update) - On every DeepSeek Harness launch, checks the installed and enabled plugins for newer npm versions, lists them in the UI and updates them after confirmation.

- [2768651338/dsh-plugin-manager](https://github.com/2768651338/dsh-plugin-manager) - A plugin manager tab in Settings → Plugins: Chinese names and plain-language descriptions for every installed plugin, one-click enable/disable, in-UI notes editing, and search/filter over the installed catalog.

One-click install and enable/disable need dsh-market; without it each card only shows a copyable install command.
- [863683348/dsh-feed](https://github.com/863683348/dsh-feed) - Cross-ecosystem aggregation data layer: syncs the GitHub dsh-plugin topic and the npm registry into one open JSON index, queried by model tools, a CLI, and a minimal stdio MCP server.
