- [863683348/dsh-need-finder](https://github.com/863683348/dsh-need-finder) - Requirement-driven dsh plugin discovery and environment recipes: plugin_guide matches natural-language needs to a curated plugin directory with reasons and install commands; recipe installs whole setups (通知全家桶, 安全审计套装...) from bundled community bundles with ordered plans.
- [863683348/dsh-plugin-audit](https://github.com/863683348/dsh-plugin-audit) - Ecosystem-wide plugin health audit: syncs the dsh-plugin topic into a local scored catalog (maintenance / docs / npm + weekly downloads / ecosystem, 0-100, A-D), static security scan with high-finding grade veto, star history snapshots, web leaderboard and agent tools.
- [863683348/dsh-plugin-recommend](https://github.com/863683348/dsh-plugin-recommend) - Plugin recommender for DSH: search and rank plugins from an embedded 1100+ entry marketplace catalog by need description, category and tags, with match reasons and a live catalog refresh from the awesome-dsh-plugin README.
- [863683348/dsh-plugin-scorecard](https://github.com/863683348/dsh-plugin-scorecard) - Quality & security scorecard for the DSH plugin ecosystem: sync the dsh-plugin topic catalog, audit any plugin (0-100, A-D, security veto), rankings, search, and historical score curves with a workspace-persisted catalog.
- [863683348/dsh-recipe](https://github.com/863683348/dsh-recipe) - Scenario bundles of dsh plugins (插件界的 dotfiles): a recipe tool that lists, searches, applies and composes ready-made plugin environments with ordered install sequences.
- [99galaxy/dsh-plugin-market](https://github.com/99galaxy/dsh-plugin-market) - Browse the awesome-dsh-plugin catalog from a dedicated page opened through the DSH left sidebar. Search, filter by category or installed state, and sort by stars, downloads, name or date added. Three tabs show all, installed and updatable plugins, with a separate count when update status cannot be determined. Install into the active Web or Desktop profile using the package manager supplied by DSH, while preserving disabled bundles. Reload the profile through HMR when available, with restart guidance otherwise. Installed state is isolated per profile, installation and reload requests are mutually exclusive, and pagination keeps the submitted search. The catalog is cached locally for one hour, with mirror, CDN and npm fallbacks.
- [AIcivilization/dsh-pick](https://github.com/AIcivilization/dsh-pick) - Plugin advisor for DeepSeek Harness: describe what you need and it ranks the npm packages carrying the dsh-plugin keyword by denoised metrics (daily baseline, week-over-week growth, release cadence, freshness) into a first pick, alternates and plugins to avoid; ships a sidebar panel, four AI tools and one-click install.
- [alex04130/dsh-forge](https://github.com/alex04130/dsh-forge) - Runtime extension suite for DeepSeek Harness: cross-session mailbox with wake cold-start, agent teams (captain + members + dependency task board + team_wait), subagent spawn policy with escalation approval, task-aware routing preset, plugin market, skill manager and runtime injector.
- [AlexYin-Tongji/dsh-plugin-console](https://github.com/AlexYin-Tongji/dsh-plugin-console) - Browse and manage the community plugin catalog from a first-level DeepSeek Harness Settings page, with verified installs and updates, removal, pause and resume, installed-package state, and sanitized README previews.
- [Anguis-L/dsh-plugin-adoption](https://github.com/Anguis-L/dsh-plugin-adoption) - Ranks DSH plugins by real monthly npm downloads instead of GitHub stars, and names the plugins that star ordering under-rates. It reports the disagreement between the two orderings rather than a single quality verdict, and every number is a live read from npm's public downloads endpoint at call time, not a stored snapshot. A second dimension answers what downloads cannot: it reads the tools version line a plugin declares in peerDependencies and compares it with the version running here, so a popular plugin that cannot be installed on this host is reported instead of recommended. Read-only GETs, no HTTP route of its own.
- [awesome-dsh-plugin/dsh-find-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/dsh-find-plugin) - Find plugins without leaving the agent: search this curated registry by keyword or category, with ready-to-run install commands.
- [azure5100/huahua-dsh-plugin-orchestra](https://github.com/azure5100/huahua-dsh-plugin-orchestra) - A plugin management system for DeepSeek Harness: plugin inventory with L0/L1/L2 AI purpose summaries, changelog tracking, update alerts, one-click upgrade, and backup/rollback with crash recovery.
- [beartackler/dsh-bridge](https://github.com/beartackler/dsh-bridge) - Slash commands ported from other coding agents (setup, connect, install, trust, browse, doctor, status, model, memory, compact, resume, review, mcp, init, suggest, improve, refactor), a zero-dependency static scanner for plugin source, and an in-repo catalog of audited plugin report cards that cite file-and-line evidence.
- [bradeGithub/DSH-Plugins-Marketplace](https://github.com/bradeGithub/DSH-Plugins-Marketplace) - GitHub-topic-driven plugin & skill marketplace: a Settings page that browses the auto-collected registry (the whole dsh-plugin topic plus the skills index, CI-refreshed every 2 hours) with one-click install, type detection, install-script and host-shadow-dependency safety confirmations, env-key management, and the STANDARD.md recognition spec.
- [buhuikongpan/dsh-pluginmanager](https://github.com/buhuikongpan/dsh-pluginmanager) - Layered plugin manager for DSH web: native plugins grouped read-only by system/WebUI/tools, user extensions with enable/disable, register, uninstall and editable descriptions.
- [changan0617/dsh-plugin-market](https://github.com/changan0617/dsh-plugin-market) - A Plugin Market entry in the DSH settings sidebar that opens dshmarket.com, the community plugin market for DeepSeek Harness, in a new tab. The light-weight alternative to installing the market itself, for people who only want the button.
- [chendaleiQ/dsh-plugin-auto-update](https://github.com/chendaleiQ/dsh-plugin-auto-update) - Per-package automatic updates for the DeepSeek Harness plugins you choose. On a schedule it asks npm for the latest version of installed plugins, updates only the packages you check, and skips local link or file installs, pinned versions and packages with errors; upgrades stay inside the major version and skip prereleases by default. Updates go through the profile's own plugin manager, so the profile write lock, pnpm step, bundle-patch validation and hot reload are the host's, and a failed install puts the previous version back. Each cycle is appended to a JSON log.
- [ChengxiuCDP/dsh-plugin-advisor](https://github.com/ChengxiuCDP/dsh-plugin-advisor) - Quality-aware in-agent plugin discovery: a find_dsh_plugins tool that ranks the whole dsh-plugin topic through a daily quality-scored index (installable manifest, curated listing, license, activity) merged with a live gh search — zero LLM API cost, risk flags and exact install commands in every result.
- [crane-you/dsh-task-plugin-scout](https://github.com/crane-you/dsh-task-plugin-scout) - Ranks this DeepSeek Harness profile's installed, disabled and marketplace plugins for the task at hand, and prints the exact next step for each — enable, install, or nothing.
- [CREAIT-nl/dsh-plugins#to-english](https://github.com/CREAIT-nl/dsh-plugins/tree/main/to-english) - Rewrites the Chinese copy of a market-installed plugin into English using a model already configured in the harness — automatically when the plugin is installed, then live-reloaded. Each file is translated in one whole-file pass, validated by a real parser where one exists (node --check for JavaScript, JSON and YAML parsers otherwise) and handed back to the model with the error for up to three repair attempts; files above 48 KB, or that never parse, fall back to a line-range pass that checks every returned line against the original for structure. Trigger phrases and locale tables can optionally be preserved rather than translated, and the untouched original is kept beside the file as a .zh.bak.

Both keep running when the model is slow, offline or out of quota.

Includes a draggable on/off pill and volume slider.

SillyTavern character-card import is supported; v0.2.9 fixes distribution and installation.

A 60-second tick in the plugin host wakes a dedicated agent session at a random moment inside the configured time windows (opting out of a day is a configurable chance), then hands it a bundled CLI of 38 subcommands — feed, subtitles, danmaku, comments, ffmpeg frame grabs, and two diaries. Shares at most N items a day by commenting on them and @-mentioning the owner (default 3, enforced from a written quota log, and it stops on rate-limit or captcha signals). Also polls comment replies, direct messages and live-room danmaku; replies to anyone but the owner are queued for approval in Settings. Settings → 养鱼 writes ~/.dsh/bili-whale.config.json; cookies live separately in ~/.bili-ai/credentials.json and are never echoed back. The HTTP routes are loopback-only behind DSH's trust fence. Needs Node 18+ and ffmpeg on PATH for frame extraction.

When a term runs dry she takes another route. Five picks go into the jar, and she tells you what each video is about. - [dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-doudizhu](https://github.com/dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-doudizhu) - Available on npm as dsh-doudizhu-lan. Three-player LAN Dou Dizhu (斗地主) played from a floating window: one machine opens a room on its own port, the other two join with a six-character room code plus an address. Empty seats can be filled by computer players in four switchable strengths (easy, medium, hard, hell), so one or two people can still play a whole hand; the deal starts as soon as the three seats are filled. 54 cards in four suits, bidding of 1/2/3 or pass, the landlord takes the three bottom cards and holds 20, play runs clockwise, and the first-bid seat rotates clockwise between hands. The rule engine is pure and covers 11 legal shapes, with big joker > small joker > 2 > A > K down to 3, suits never compared, straights, pair-straights and planes excluding the 2s and the jokers, and a rocket that beats everything. The table itself is built to be read at a glance: three seat cards side by side in play order (you, then your next and previous seats) with role, hand count and a bar that runs out, one line that says whose hand is on the table and what would beat it, the bottom cards as text, an in-place play history that folds into a single summary line and unfolds into every trick including the passes, plus hint and auto-play buttons that pick the cheapest legal answer out of the local rule enumeration. Nicknames can be changed mid-hand (twelve characters, duplicates get a suffix). Computers run inside the authority and are handed only their own hand, the public record and the seat counts, so no hand can leak; the authority is the only place that decides which card ids leave it. Computers are driven by the room itself, so a one-person table keeps playing with nobody else on the LAN port. Humans have no turn timer, the collapsed floating pill can be dragged around the screen, and 179 unit tests pin the rules, the wire format, the theme tokens, the drag gesture, the history grouping and the computer seats.
- [dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-poker-night](https://github.com/dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-poker-night) - A no-limit Texas holdem table where you are the only human. Eight seats: you plus seven LLM agents written on AI-founder personas (Altman, Dario Amodei, Musk, Liang Wenfeng, Jensen Huang, Lei Jun, Zhang Yiming). Each agent bets through the currently selected host model and falls back to its own heuristic style when no model is available; every agent only ever sees its own hole cards, because the prompt is built from that seat alone. A hand ends by revealing the winner hole cards, with a flip animation replayed on every community card, and a rail keeps a live action-and-table-talk timeline. LAN mode (off by default, single-machine play is unaffected) lets another install on the same network join this very table: the host shows a six-digit room code, UDP broadcast discovers nearby tables, and a joiner randomly takes over one bot seat, with the seat handed back to its character on leave or after twenty seconds of silence. The room code is never put on the wire and every snapshot is generated for one viewer seat, so nobody, not even the host, can read another player hole cards. Fork of BubblePtr/dsh-holdem (MIT), credited in the README and in the UI.
- [dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-turing-table](https://github.com/dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-turing-table) - A social deduction game played against your own model configurations. A table has N seats (six by default, one of them yours) and some of the rest are played by agents bound to different provider, model, temperature, system prompt and disguise settings; you interrogate them and cross-check the answers to work out which seats are not human. Seat identity and each agent model configuration stay hidden in the host state until a seat is judged, then the disguise parameters are revealed. Every round exports a per-seat conversation JSONL plus the judgment record, and the same seed with the same move script replays byte-identical, so runs with different models or disguise strengths can be diffed.

The eight PNGs are bundled with the plugin and served by the plugin itself, so there are no third-party requests. - [Lucasli2018/totoro-pet](https://github.com/Lucasli2018/totoro-pet) - A desktop pet that lives in a floating overlay; click it to interact and switch between idle, sleeping, happy, and eating states.
- [lucky8197/dsh-devquest](https://github.com/lucky8197/dsh-devquest) - Turns coding into an RPG: finished turns, tool calls and completed todos earn XP, with 27+ achievement badges, levels, titles and seasons. Event-driven scoring with a pure-function engine — the work itself is the game.
- [luumod/dsh-achievements](https://github.com/luumod/dsh-achievements) - Achievement and gamification plugin: unlock badges for turns, tool calls, sessions, daily streaks and coding behavior (edits/reads/tests), with a badge wall, unlock toasts and a ctx.achievements SDK.
- [luweiyabo/dsh-whale-pet](https://github.com/luweiyabo/dsh-whale-pet) - A polished floating whale desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with 95 categorized transparent animations, state-aware event reactions, customizable actions and triggers, click interactions, dragging and screen wandering.
- [lyhtakeashot/dsh-lucky-block](https://github.com/lyhtakeashot/dsh-lucky-block) - Adds a draggable lucky-block button to the DeepSeek Harness web UI. Single-click plays zero-cost little performances (popups, a fake blue screen, daily fortune, trivia, cold jokes, music, and a set of visual stunts); a 1.4-second long-press mines the block open and starts a new session to write a random paper, read the news, invent something, or spin a short story. It also appends a "lucky block" choice to the model's multiple-choice questions and rolls a random pick, reversible by saying "rollback". Block appearance and event weights are adjustable in settings.

- [marvin9551/dynamic-schulte-dsh](https://github.com/marvin9551/dynamic-schulte-dsh) - Dynamic Schulte grid waiting-time mini-game: click 1..N in order on a static grid or a spinning roulette wheel while the model thinks.
- [marx-otto/dafeiyu-dsh-plugins#dafeiyu-pet-menu](https://github.com/marx-otto/dafeiyu-dsh-plugins/tree/main/dafeiyu-pet-menu) - Adds a Screen-sense submenu (turn on, turn off, and an interval of 15, 30, 60 or 120 seconds) to the dsh-pet desktop right-click menu, forwarding each choice to dafeiyu-screensense. dsh-pet exposes no menu extension point, so this plugin appends a marked patch to its renderer.js after backing the original up to renderer.js.dafeiyu.bak; the patch is idempotent and is re-applied when dsh-pet is reinstalled.
- [marx-otto/dafeiyu-dsh-plugins#dafeiyu-screensense](https://github.com/marx-otto/dafeiyu-dsh-plugins/tree/main/dafeiyu-screensense) - Screen-sense mode for the dsh-pet desktop pet: captures the primary display every 30 seconds, compares an 8x8 average hash of each frame, and sends the screenshot to the session model when the frame changed (and again after the idle interval even if unchanged) so the pet comments in one short bubble line. Adds /fish, /fish_look and /fish_screen commands, a status and control HTTP pair, and a change threshold plus an idle repeat interval that can be tuned in the plugin config. Windows only (PowerShell WinForms).
- [Matthew-Laplace/dsh-ark-pet](https://github.com/Matthew-Laplace/dsh-ark-pet) - DSH pet plugin that adds an Arknights operator library and custom image pets: pick one of 486 operators and the plugin downloads that operator Codex v2 atlas from the pinned upstream revision, verifies every Git blob hash and installs it locally, or import your own Codex atlas (1536x1872 or 1536x2288) or a plain PNG/WebP/GIF; the pet then follows session activity, shows a bubble while a decision is pending, and can be dragged and resized.

- [MichengAI/dsh-codex-pet](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-codex-pet) - An in-page pet for DSH Web with multi-session task notifications and controls to open tasks, stop turns, and respond to supported approval and question requests.

Spin speed and position are remembered.
- [MoonlitDropOfBlood/dsh-whale-pet](https://github.com/MoonlitDropOfBlood/dsh-whale-pet) - WhaleHarbor desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: an always-on-top transparent float window hosts a chibi whale-maid built from 13 AI-generated parts and animated as a CSS paper-doll (breathing, blinking, ahoge sway, sweat, hops, tremors), mirroring work state in eight moods — idle, busy, approval, question, error, celebration, nap, and subagent clones — with poke, drag, three sizes, tray toggle, and live stats in the speech bubble. - [Nagi-ovo/dsh-ads](https://github.com/Nagi-ovo/dsh-ads) - Parody ads in 2005-Chinese-web style: sidebar banners, in-chat feeds, corner popups, and a close button whose hit area is smaller than it looks. All fictional.
- [nailiang002-wq/deepseek-girl-harness](https://github.com/nailiang002-wq/deepseek-girl-harness) - Interactive character for Harness Desktop with task expressions, rice feeding, an iron-basin hat, dragging, and time-based greetings.
- [Nanki-nn/dsh-answer-pet](https://github.com/Nanki-nn/dsh-answer-pet) - Extensible animated response pet with blue-whale, orange-cat, and silver-shaded-cat themes, per-session progress, model and tool-call traces, token counts, output speed, elapsed time, and collapsible multi-session status cards.
- [NattoCB/dsh-plugin-petdex-market](https://github.com/NattoCB/dsh-plugin-petdex-market) - Browses the petdex.dev catalog in Settings and runs a floating macOS desktop pet that reacts to agent activity.

- [potoior/dsh-bull-bear](https://github.com/potoior/dsh-bull-bear) - Real-time quote bull/bear desk pet for DSH: a portfolio-average-driven pet that runs faster and jumps higher the closer gains reach 20%, with a watchlist panel for searching and adding stocks plus a live "race" of how each holding is moving.

- [pwping/moyu_games](https://github.com/pwping/moyu_games) - Five casual mini-games (sliding-number puzzle, Sudoku, snake, Schulte grid, number memory) that pop up when a turn starts, with auto-saved progress across sessions.

- [raymondkm2025/dsh-go-game](https://github.com/raymondkm2025/dsh-go-game) - Go (weiqi) for the DeepSeek Harness: a full rules engine, a three-level built-in AI, a dead-stone estimator, optional LLM review, SGF import/export, and an optional KataGo GTP bridge.
- [reisen-ww/dsh-bonk-pet](https://github.com/reisen-ww/dsh-bonk-pet) - Whale-girl desk pet in the corner of the DSH Web GUI. It sings along to a bundled track while the agent works; when a tool call fails a steel pipe falls on its head. Click it to bonk the basin it wears, which costs 12 rice — knock enough and it gets hungry and wanders off to beg, and rice appears somewhere on the page for it to dash across and eat. Draggable within the viewport, wriggles and complains if grabbed mid-dash, volume and behaviour configurable from Settings. All artwork, sound effects and the song ship inside the package.
- [sadnessXU/dsh-pet-game-guard](https://github.com/sadnessXU/dsh-pet-game-guard) - Hides the dsh-pet desktop pet while a game or fullscreen app is in the foreground, then brings it back. Decides from three signals — a captionless window covering the whole monitor, the foreground process living in a game directory, and the system's full-screen notification state — and requires two consistent polls before acting, so alt-tabbing does not make the pet flicker. It only toggles window visibility; dsh-pet's configuration and install directory are never touched. A tray menu offers pause, restore now, and reload config. Windows only.
- [ShenpingDD/wooden-fish-dsh](https://github.com/ShenpingDD/wooden-fish-dsh) - A clickable wooden-fish desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI. Click to knock; counts per day with a calendar heatmap of your streaks in settings.
- [sherconan/dsh-task-mascot](https://github.com/sherconan/dsh-task-mascot) - Web mascot that acts out each live tool call (read, write, edit, search, run, plan, sub-agent, wait, error) with matching step cards in chat; ships two swappable character packs.
- [shetengteng/dsh-lumina-tarot](https://github.com/shetengteng/dsh-lumina-tarot) - A draggable tarot card back in the corner of the DeepSeek Harness UI. Click to draw, right-click for the four spreads, full 78-card deck with bilingual meanings. Readings use only the cards actually drawn.
- [shinjiyu/holdem#dsh-plugin](https://github.com/shinjiyu/holdem/tree/main/dsh-plugin) - Host tools for Texas Hold'em on kuroneko.chat — seat token, hosted/manual control, legal actions, and act loop for one GitHub identity.
- [Signalight/codex-to-dsh-pet#dsh-codex-pet](https://github.com/Signalight/codex-to-dsh-pet/tree/main/packages/dsh-codex-pet) - DSH web-GUI pet runtime that renders any Codex spritesheet-atlas pet (v1/v2) as a draggable overlay: drag/wave/jump, v2 mouse-tracking eyes that follow the active mouse, live agent-status poses, progress bubbles, and an in-GUI atlas importer; ships one original CC BY-NC demo pet (nastya), and user pets live in ~/.dsh/pets.
- [skiuniverse/dsh-running-liang](https://github.com/skiuniverse/dsh-running-liang) - A Chrome-dino-style runner for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: play while the agent replies, score from 梁子 to 梁圣 on a persistent progress strip.
- [sknagato/dsh-plugin-fc-emulator](https://github.com/sknagato/dsh-plugin-fc-emulator) - Floating FC/NES game hall for DSH Web with fceumm, local ROM upload, and GitHub online library.
- [skr311/dsh-codex-pet#dsh-codex-pet](https://github.com/skr311/dsh-codex-pet/tree/main/packages/dsh-codex-pet) - Import Codex-style sprite-sheet pets and render them as a floating shell.overlay with a pet library, interactions, and agent-state linkage.
- [skymecode/dsh-bgm](https://github.com/skymecode/dsh-bgm) - Maps locally analyzed system audio to music-reactive conversation effects, rhythm-game judgements, score and combo feedback, and optional RGB spectrum bars in DSH Web.
- [ssamurias/dsh-fish](https://github.com/ssamurias/dsh-fish) - A pet fish you raise in DSH. No personality settings — she grows up through the event stream, and your interactions decide who she becomes. She browses Bilibili on her own, writes a diary, and brings what she finds back to ask you. Four stages and three bottlenecks advance only by what happens; only after all four does she begin to have a stance list. Her diary is hers by default; one switch in settings and you can read it. Records in the event stream can never be deleted, so it remains the only trustworthy source. Zero runtime dependencies.
- [Stellum-Waq/dsh-pet-ronaldo](https://github.com/Stellum-Waq/dsh-pet-ronaldo) - Cristiano Ronaldo desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: a chibi Portugal number 7 mascot in a bottom-right overlay whose animation follows the agent state — dribbling while tools run, thinking during a turn, waiting at approvals, diving on errors — and jumping in a SIU celebration with a host-process sound when a turn completes; it can be dragged, looks at the cursor on hover, dives on a triple click, and a settings panel manages several pets and imports custom spritesheets. It also runs as a borderless, always-on-top native Windows window that keeps living after the browser is closed: hovering shows the current workspace and conversation title, double-clicking opens the Harness page in Edge, and dragging, mouse-wheel resizing and a right-click menu work there too, sharing position, size and behaviour with the web panel. Pet sheets may use any cell resolution and scale preserving aspect ratio (atlas.scaling: smooth | pixelated). v2.2 adds a video route — feed it a clip (green screen or ordinary footage) and its real motion becomes the pet animations, via automatic backdrop sampling, chroma keying with spill suppression, motion-based segment splitting and union-bbox alignment; already-extracted PNG frames work too, with no video decoder installed, and the clip audio can be cut into per-action sounds. Pets can also be published to the community gallery under the DPSL-1.0 sharing declaration, and installed from it in one click. v2.3 adapts it to DSH 0.2 desktop clients — the celebration sound now falls back to spawning PowerShell when the host no longer provides the shell service — and makes a single click play a short, configurable taunt animation (`interactions.clickAnim`).
- [Sutera-Diffusus/dsh-whale-musume](https://github.com/Sutera-Diffusus/dsh-whale-musume) - A whale-girl companion for DeepSeek Harness with 45 achievements, daily quests and weekly check-ins, three mini-games, 92 artworks, 620 dialogue lines, a growth journal, weather and festival reactions, per-tool work poses, cross-device save export/import (JSON file or migration code), accessibility mode and an optional MiMo TTS bridge. Data stays in the host localStorage with no telemetry. Verified on DSH desktop 0.2.0-rc.2; compatible with 0.2.1-rc.1/rc.2 and legacy 0.1.x web.
- [swaylq/dsh-digipet](https://github.com/swaylq/dsh-digipet) - Digimon-style raising game: hatch an egg that feeds on real work (turns, tool calls, errors) and evolves along four branching lines shaped by how you work; zero tokens, invisible to the model.
- [swaylq/dsh-wildmon](https://github.com/swaylq/dsh-wildmon) - Pokemon-style catch-em-all: your real work is the tall grass — turns, tool calls and errors spawn wild encounters; throw balls, fill a 28-slot dex, walk a team of six. Zero tokens, invisible to the model.

- [THEWOLFWALKER/dsh-coyote](https://github.com/THEWOLFWALKER/dsh-coyote) - Agent- and GUI-controlled DG-LAB Coyote e-stim plugin: eight `coyote_*` tools plus a DSH web panel behind one safety envelope (soft limits, asymmetric rate limiter, session cooldown, playback caps, disconnect fail-safe); optional auto-stim layer maps agent events (tool calls, errors, turn end) to bounded pulses; official V3 socket protocol with QR pairing, programmable waveforms. Adults only.

- [ting-good/dsh-cook-pet](https://github.com/ting-good/dsh-cook-pet) - Desktop pet "Zhaozhao" (照照) that floats above all apps in a transparent always-on-top window and mirrors DeepSeek Harness state — idle, cooking, serving and waiting-for-you animations, click reactions, drag, right-click resize, plus an auto-downloading Electron helper.
- [Tisitan/dsh-live2d-companion](https://github.com/Tisitan/dsh-live2d-companion) - Live2D desk pet for DSH: 8-state AI status lamp, web widget, and always-on-top transparent Electron pet window with expressions, motions, and chat bubbles.
- [TongY1n/ui-muyu](https://github.com/TongY1n/ui-muyu) - A floating cyber wooden fish widget — tap it to strike and accumulate merit, drag it anywhere on the page.

- [txlznbzsdj-collab/dsh-deepseek-pet](https://github.com/txlznbzsdj-collab/dsh-deepseek-pet) - Animated DeepSeek blue-whale desktop pet floating on the DSH Web page: draggable with speech bubbles and mood poses, a pet_say tool for the model to make it talk, and turn-start/end thinking and celebrating states.

## Contributing

PRs welcome. **This page is generated — don't edit it by hand.** Add one file at `data/plugins/<owner>__<repo>.yml` instead:

```yaml
url: https://github.com/owner/repo
name: owner/repo
category: ui
description:
  en: One-line description ending with a period.
  zh: 一句话描述，以句号结尾。
```

One file per plugin means two submissions never touch the same file, so PRs stop conflicting with each other. You don't need to run anything: both READMEs are regenerated on `main` after your PR merges. Regenerating locally to preview is fine, and committing the result is still accepted, but it isn't required.

Your repo must:

- declare a **`dsh.bundle`** manifest in `package.json` — `dsh.client` alone is not installable, and this is checked automatically on every PR
- be at least **1 day old** — brand-new repos can resubmit once they clear this. (There is no commit-count bar: history length measures development habit, not quality.)
- carry the [`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) topic

Themes & skins: entries under **Themes & Appearance** power the Themes tab in `dsh-market` — one-click install/switch for users.

Full rules, examples, and the screenshots format: [contributing.md](contributing.md).

## Disclaimer

This is a community-maintained index. Plugins are developed and maintained by their respective authors; listing here is not an endorsement, and no guarantees are made about any plugin's safety, quality, or maintenance. Installing a plugin runs third-party code on your machine — review the source and install at your own risk. This project is not affiliated with DeepSeek.

Issues here are for the list and its website only. Problems inside the plugin market UI go to [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market/issues); problems with `dsh` itself go to [deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/issues); a bug in a plugin goes to that plugin's own repository.
